question_text:
Can: Would you like to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ece: ----
Can: That's a pity. Maybe next time.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_a: Sure, I'll be there at five.
option_c: I'd love to, but I'm visiting my grandparents.
explanation: Can'ın “That's a pity.” (Ne yazık.) cevabı, Ece'nin daveti reddettiğini gösterir. Bahane sunarak reddeden tek seçenek “I'd love to, but I'm visiting my grandparents.”dır.

question_text: Which of the following is used to apologize?
option_a: I'm sorry for breaking your pen.
option_d: How about going to the cinema?
explanation: “I'm sorry for …” kalıbı özür dilemek için kullanılır. Diğerleri teklif, kabul ve öneri bildirir.

question_text:
Read the message.
“Hi Mert! I'm having a picnic at the park on Sunday at 11 a.m. Everyone will bring some food. Can you bring some sandwiches? Let me know. — Defne”
What does Defne want Mert to do?
option_b: Come to her house at 11 a.m.
explanation: Defne mesajında Mert'ten pikniğe sandviç getirmesini istemektedir (“Can you bring some sandwiches?”).

question_text:
Four students describe a good friend:
Ali: A good friend keeps my secrets.
Beril: A good friend always tells lies to make me happy.
Cem: A good friend supports me when I am sad.
Dila: A good friend shares things with me.
Whose idea is NOT suitable for a good friend?
explanation: İyi bir arkadaş dürüst olmalıdır. Beril'in “her zaman yalan söyler” ifadesi iyi bir arkadaşın özelliğiyle bağdaşmaz.

question_text:
Eren: Hey Zeynep, we are going bowling after school. Do you want to join us?
Zeynep: I'd really like to, but I have a piano lesson at four. ----
Eren: Sure! See you there.
Which of the following best completes the dialogue?
option_c: Can I join you after my lesson?
explanation: Zeynep önce dersi olduğunu söylemiş, Eren de “Sure! See you there.” ile olumlu cevap vermiştir. Bu nedenle Zeynep'in dersten sonra katılmayı önerdiği seçenek uygundur.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“A trustworthy friend ---- your secrets.”
explanation: Güvenilir (trustworthy) bir arkadaş sırlarını saklar (keeps your secrets).

question_text:
Look at the chart showing what students do when a friend is upset.
ActionStudents
listen to him/her18
give advice12
make him/her laugh8
leave him/her alone2
Which of the following is TRUE according to the chart?
option_a: Most students listen to their upset friend.
option_b: More students leave their friend alone than give advice.
option_c: Making a friend laugh is the most popular action.
explanation: Tabloya göre en çok öğrenci (18) üzgün arkadaşını dinlemektedir.

question_text: Sena forgot her best friend's birthday. She feels very bad about it. What should she say to her friend?
option_b: Would you like to play tennis tomorrow?
option_d: I'm really sorry I forgot your birthday. Let me make it up to you.
explanation: Sena arkadaşının doğum gününü unuttuğu için özür dilemeli ve telafi etmeyi önermelidir.

question_text:
“Why don't we go to the cinema tonight?”
Which response ACCEPTS the invitation?
explanation: “That sounds fun!” daveti kabul eder; diğer cevaplar reddetme bildirir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option.
“I can't stand ---- in long queues.”
explanation: “Can't stand” fiilinden sonra fiil -ing almalıdır: “waiting”.

question_text:
The table shows how often Emir does some activities in a week.
ActivityDays a week
play basketball7
read books3
play video games1
go to the cinema0
Which of the following is TRUE?
option_b: Emir often goes to the cinema.
explanation: Haftanın 7 günü yapılan etkinlik “always” ile anlatılır; Emir her gün basketbol oynamaktadır. Sinemaya hiç gitmez (never).

question_text:
Read the text.
“My name is Lara. I'm fourteen. I'm keen on photography and I take photos of birds at weekends. I'm not fond of shopping. I prefer spending time in nature to staying at home.”
Which of the following is NOT true about Lara?
option_d: She prefers nature to staying at home.
explanation: Lara alışverişi sevmediğini (not fond of shopping) belirtmiştir; bu nedenle alışveriş yapmaktan hoşlandığı doğru değildir.

question_text: Which frequency adverb means “0%”?
explanation: “Never” hiçbir zaman (%0) anlamındadır.

question_text:
Four teenagers talk about their weekends:
Kaan: I usually hang out with my friends at the mall.
Leyla: I rarely watch TV; I prefer reading.
Mina: I always do my homework on Saturday mornings.
Nazlı: I sometimes go cycling with my dad.
Who does an activity EVERY weekend?
explanation: “Always” her zaman anlamına gelir; Mina ödevini her cumartesi sabahı yapmaktadır.

question_text:
“She prefers tea ---- coffee.”
Which word completes the sentence?
explanation: “Prefer A to B” kalıbında “to” kullanılır: She prefers tea to coffee.

question_text:
Arda: What do you do in your free time?
Berk: ----
Arda: Really? I'm keen on it, too.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_c: I'm fond of playing the guitar.
explanation: Arda boş zamanında ne yaptığını sormuş ve cevaba “Ben de buna meraklıyım.” demiştir. Bu nedenle bir hobi bildiren cevap uygundur.

question_text: Which kitchen verb means “to cook something in hot oil”?
explanation: “Fry” kızgın yağda pişirmek anlamındadır. “Boil” kaynatmak, “chop” doğramak, “peel” soymaktır.

question_text:
Read the recipe for a fruit salad.
“First, wash the fruits. Then, peel the bananas and slice them. ---- , chop the apples into small pieces. Finally, mix all the fruits and add some honey.”
Which word completes the recipe?
explanation: Tarifte “First” ve “Then”den sonra, “Finally”den önce bir sıralama sözcüğü gerekir; “After that” uygundur.

question_text:
Making tea:
1. Boil some water.
2. Put the tea leaves into the teapot.
3. ----
4. Wait for ten minutes and serve.
Which step completes the instructions?
option_b: Pour the hot water into the teapot.
explanation: Su kaynatılıp çay yaprakları demliğe konduktan sonra sıcak su demliğe dökülmelidir.

question_text:
Choose the correct passive form.
“They mix the eggs and the flour.”
option_a: The eggs and the flour were mix.
option_b: The eggs and the flour are mixed.
option_c: The eggs and the flour is mixing.
option_d: The eggs and the flour mix.
explanation: Geniş zamanda edilgen yapı “am/is/are + V3” ile kurulur: “are mixed”.

question_text:
A recipe for pancakes:
“Mix two cups of flour, one egg and a cup of milk in a bowl. Heat a pan and add a little oil. Pour some of the mixture into the pan. Cook each side for two minutes.”
According to the recipe, which of the following is NOT necessary?
explanation: Tarifte un, yumurta, süt ve yağ kullanılmaktadır; şekerden söz edilmemiştir.

question_text:
“Could you ---- the carrots, please? I need them for the cake.”
Which verb best completes the sentence?
explanation: Havuçlu kekte havuç rendelenir: “grate the carrots”.

question_text:
Chef Kerem: First, we chop the onions. Next, we fry them for three minutes. Then, we add the tomatoes and cook for ten minutes.
What does the chef do right after chopping the onions?
explanation: Şef soğanları doğradıktan hemen sonra (Next) onları üç dakika kızartır.

question_text:
Look at the table about three dishes.
DishCooking timeMethod
Menemen15 minfry
Lentil soup40 minboil
Baked potatoes50 minbake
Which of the following is TRUE?
option_b: Lentil soup is quicker than menemen.
option_c: Menemen is baked in the oven.
option_d: Baked potatoes take the longest time to cook.
explanation: En uzun pişirme süresi 50 dakika ile fırında patatestedir. Mercimek çorbası kaynatılır ve menemenden daha uzun sürer.

question_text: Which sentence is used to ask someone to wait on the phone?
explanation: “Hold on, please.” telefonda karşı tarafı beklemeye almak için kullanılır.

question_text:
Mrs. Aydın: Hello?
Ozan: Hello, this is Ozan. Can I speak to Burak, please?
Mrs. Aydın: Sorry, he isn't at home right now. ----
Ozan: Yes, please. Can you tell him to call me back?
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_b: Would you like to leave a message?
explanation: Ozan'ın “Yes, please. Can you tell him to call me back?” cevabı, kendisine mesaj bırakmak isteyip istemediğinin sorulduğunu gösterir.

question_text:
Read the phone message note.
“Message for: Elif · From: Coach Tarık · Message: Basketball practice is cancelled tomorrow. It will be on Friday at 5 p.m.”
Which of the following is TRUE?
option_a: The practice will be tomorrow at 5 p.m.
explanation: Nota göre yarınki antrenman iptal edilmiştir; antrenman cuma saat 17.00'de yapılacaktır.

question_text:
“I can't hear you very well. ----”
Which sentence completes the speech?
explanation: Karşı tarafı iyi duyamamak hattın kötü olmasıyla ilgilidir: “The line is bad.”

question_text:
Selin calls the dentist's office.
Receptionist: Good morning, Smile Dental Clinic. How can I help you?
Selin: ----
Receptionist: Let me check. We have an appointment on Tuesday at 3 p.m.
Which of the following best completes the dialogue?
option_a: Can I speak to my teacher?
option_b: I'm calling to cancel my flight.
option_c: I'd like to make an appointment, please.
option_d: I'd like to order a pizza.
explanation: Resepsiyon görevlisinin randevu saatini söylemesi, Selin'in randevu almak istediğini gösterir.

question_text: Which question is asked to learn who the caller is?
explanation: “Who's calling, please?” arayan kişinin kim olduğunu öğrenmek için sorulur.

question_text:
Gizem: Hi Ali, are you free tonight?
Ali: Sorry, I'm going to help my mom with the cleaning. I'll call you back later, okay?
Gizem: OK, talk to you later.
What is Ali going to do tonight?
explanation: Ali bu akşam annesine temizlikte yardım edeceğini söylemiştir.

question_text:
Four people describe a phone call problem:
Ahmet: I called my friend many times, but I heard a beep every time. Someone else was talking to her.
Belgin: My phone's battery died in the middle of the call.
Can: I dialled the wrong number by mistake.
Deniz: There was a lot of noise and the voice was breaking up.
Who had a problem because “the line was busy”?
explanation: Ahmet'in aradığı kişi başka biriyle konuştuğu için hat meşguldür (the line was busy).

question_text: Which of the following is a safe online behaviour?
option_c: Using a strong password with letters and numbers
explanation: Harf ve rakam içeren güçlü bir şifre kullanmak güvenli bir internet davranışıdır.

question_text:
Emre: I want to buy a new book online, but I don't have an account.
Aysu: ----
Emre: Good idea. Thanks!
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_d: Why don't you sign up on the website?
explanation: Emre'nin hesabı yoktur; siteye üye olmasını (sign up) öneren cevap uygundur.

question_text: “To ---- a file” means to copy it from the Internet to your computer.
explanation: İnternetten bilgisayara dosya indirmek “download” ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
Read the online safety tips.
• Don't share personal information.
• Think before you post.
• Tell an adult if someone bothers you.
• Log out after using public computers.
Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the tips?
option_c: Telling an adult about bothering messages
explanation: İpuçlarında şifreyi her gün değiştirmekten söz edilmemektedir.

question_text: Which word means “bullying someone online”?
explanation: İnternet üzerinden zorbalık yapmaya “cyberbullying” denir.

question_text:
Kemal: I spend six hours a day online. I can't sleep well and I feel tired at school.
Which advice is the most suitable for Kemal?
option_a: You should buy a new phone.
option_b: You should limit your screen time.
option_c: You should play more online games.
explanation: Kemal'in sorunu internette çok fazla zaman geçirmesidir; ekran süresini sınırlaması önerilmelidir.

question_text:
Defne: How about video chatting with Grandma tonight?
Mert: ----
Which response REFUSES the suggestion?
option_a: I'd rather not. I have a lot of homework.
option_d: Sure, let's call her at eight.
explanation: “I'd rather not.” öneriyi kibarca reddeder ve bir neden sunar.

question_text:
Choose the correct option.
“Skydiving is ---- than canoeing.”
explanation: İki şey karşılaştırılırken comparative yapı kullanılır: “more dangerous than”.

question_text:
Look at the table about adventure sports.
SportPriceRisk
Rafting400 TLmedium
Paragliding1 500 TLhigh
Trekking100 TLlow
Which of the following is TRUE?
option_a: Rafting is more expensive than paragliding.
explanation: Trekking 100 TL ile en ucuz spordur. Yamaç paraşütü en pahalı ve en riskli olanıdır.

question_text:
Melis: Would you like to go rock climbing this weekend?
Onur: ---- It's too dangerous for me.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
explanation: Onur kaya tırmanışının kendisi için çok tehlikeli olduğunu söylemiştir; başka bir etkinliği tercih ettiğini bildiren “I'd rather go hiking.” uygundur.

question_text: Which is the superlative form of “good”?
explanation: “Good” düzensiz bir sıfattır: good → better → the best.

question_text:
Four friends describe their adventure experiences:
Ayla: Scuba diving was amazing; I saw colourful fish under the sea.
Bora: Bungee jumping was the scariest thing I've ever done.
Ceren: Camping in the forest was relaxing.
Doruk: Paragliding gave me the best view of the city.
Who did an underwater activity?
explanation: Tüplü dalış (scuba diving) su altında yapılan bir etkinliktir; Ayla deniz altında balıklar görmüştür.

question_text: “Mount Ağrı is ---- mountain in Türkiye.”
explanation: Bir şeyin bir grup içinde en yüksek olduğu anlatılırken superlative kullanılır: “the highest”.

question_text:
Kaan prefers safe activities and he doesn't have much money. Which activity should he choose according to the table?
ActivitySafetyCost
Hikingvery safecheap
Skydivingdangerousexpensive
Raftingquite safeexpensive
Bungee jumpingdangerouscheap
explanation: Kaan güvenli ve ucuz bir etkinlik istemektedir; tabloda bu iki özelliği taşıyan tek etkinlik doğa yürüyüşüdür (hiking).

question_text:
“I'd rather stay at a hotel than camp in a tent.”
What does the speaker mean?
option_a: He/She prefers staying at a hotel.
option_c: He/She has never been to a hotel.
option_d: He/She loves camping in a tent.
explanation: “I'd rather A than B” kalıbı A'yı tercih ettiğini gösterir; konuşan otelde kalmayı tercih etmektedir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option.
“---- you ever been to Pamukkale?”
explanation: “Ever” ile deneyim sorulurken Present Perfect kullanılır: “Have you ever been …?”

question_text:
Read the travel blog.
“Last summer, we visited Cappadocia. We took a hot-air balloon tour at sunrise. The view of the fairy chimneys was breathtaking. We also bought some pottery as souvenirs.”
Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the text?
explanation: Metinde balon turu, peribacaları ve hediyelik çömlekten söz edilmiştir; kaldıkları otelden bahsedilmemiştir.

question_text:
Tourist: Excuse me, how can I get to the museum?
Local: ----
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_d: Go straight and turn left at the bank.
explanation: Turist müzeye nasıl gidileceğini sormaktadır; yol tarifi veren cevap uygundur.

question_text: Which word means “a small object you buy to remember a place”?
explanation: Bir yeri hatırlamak için alınan küçük eşyaya “souvenir” (hediyelik eşya) denir.

question_text:
The table shows information about three cities.
CityFamous forBest time to visit
Antalyabeachessummer
Erzurumski resortswinter
Mardinstone housesspring
Zehra wants to go skiing. Which city should she visit and when?
explanation: Kayak merkezleriyle ünlü şehir Erzurum'dur ve en uygun ziyaret zamanı kıştır.

question_text: “I have ---- visited Ephesus. It was amazing!”
explanation: Olumlu Present Perfect cümlelerinde “zaten, çoktan” anlamında “already” kullanılır.

question_text:
A travel agent: “This hotel is next to the beach. It has a swimming pool and a kids' club. Breakfast is free, but you have to pay for dinner.”
Which of the following is TRUE about the hotel?
option_d: It is far from the beach.
explanation: Kahvaltı ücretsizdir (free); akşam yemeği ücretlidir ve otel plajın yanındadır.

question_text:
Can: Have you ever tried Turkish delight?
Anna: ----
Can: You should! It's delicious.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_c: Yes, I have. I love it.
explanation: Can'ın “You should!” (Denemelisin!) cevabı, Anna'nın lokumu daha önce hiç denemediğini gösterir.

question_text:
“You ---- touch the hot stove. It's dangerous!”
Which modal completes the sentence?
explanation: Yasak bildirmek için “mustn't” kullanılır.

question_text:
The chart shows who does the chores in Ece's family.
ChoreEceBrotherMomDad
do the laundry✓
take out the rubbish✓
water the plants✓
vacuum the carpet✓
Which of the following is TRUE?
option_b: Ece is responsible for watering the plants.
explanation: Tabloya göre bitkileri Ece sular; çamaşırı annesi yıkar, çöpü erkek kardeşi çıkarır.

question_text: “It's Sunday. You ---- get up early.” (It isn't necessary.)
explanation: Zorunlu olmadığını bildirmek için “don't have to” kullanılır.

question_text: Which chore is done in the kitchen after a meal?
explanation: Yemekten sonra masayı toplamak (clear the table) mutfakta yapılan bir iştir.

question_text:
Mom: Kerem, your room is a mess! ----
Kerem: OK, Mom. I'll do it after lunch.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_c: You don't have to clean it.
option_d: You have to tidy it up.
explanation: Anne odanın dağınık olduğunu söylemiş, Kerem de öğle yemeğinden sonra yapacağını belirtmiştir. Odayı toplaması gerektiğini bildiren cümle uygundur.

question_text:
Four teenagers talk about chores:
Buse: I love cooking, so I help my mom in the kitchen.
Can: I hate ironing, but I have to do it every week.
Duru: I don't mind dusting the furniture.
Ege: I can't stand doing the dishes.
Who does a chore although he/she doesn't like it?
explanation: Can ütü yapmaktan nefret ettiğini ama her hafta yapmak zorunda olduğunu söylemiştir.

question_text:
Rules of a summer camp:
• You must make your bed every morning.
• You mustn't use your phone after 10 p.m.
• You don't have to join the morning run.
Which of the following is TRUE according to the rules?
option_a: Campers can use their phones at midnight.
option_b: Joining the morning run is optional.
option_c: Campers mustn't join the morning run.
option_d: Making the bed is not necessary.
explanation: “You don't have to join the morning run.” sabah koşusuna katılmanın zorunlu olmadığını, yani isteğe bağlı olduğunu gösterir.

question_text:
Read Selin's weekly plan.
DayChore
Mondayfeed the fish
Wednesdaytake out the rubbish
Saturdayvacuum the carpet
What does Selin have to do on Wednesday?
explanation: Plana göre Selin çarşamba günü çöpü çıkarmak zorundadır.

question_text: Which chore is done with an iron?
explanation: Ütü (iron) ile yapılan iş giysileri ütülemektir.

question_text:
A student's science notebook:
“Question: Do plants need light to grow?
Hypothesis: Plants without light won't grow well.
Experiment: I put one plant near the window and another in a dark cupboard.
Result: After two weeks, the plant in the cupboard turned yellow.”
What was the result of the experiment?
option_a: The plant near the window died.
option_d: The plant in the dark became yellow.
explanation: Deney sonucunda karanlık dolaptaki bitki sararmıştır; bu, hipotezi destekler.

question_text: Where do scientists usually do experiments?
explanation: Bilim insanları deneylerini genellikle laboratuvarda yapar.

question_text:
Choose the correct passive form.
“The light bulb ---- by Thomas Edison's team.”
explanation: Geçmişte yapılan bir işin edilgen anlatımı “was/were + V3” ile yapılır: “was developed”.

question_text:
Read the text.
“Aziz Sancar is a Turkish scientist. He won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2015. His research showed how cells repair damaged DNA.”
Which of the following is TRUE?
option_a: He studied how cells repair DNA.
option_c: He won the Nobel Prize in Physics.
explanation: Metne göre Aziz Sancar, hücrelerin hasarlı DNA'yı nasıl onardığını araştırmış ve 2015'te Nobel Kimya Ödülü'nü kazanmıştır.

question_text:
Put the steps of a scientific experiment in the correct order.
I. Do the experiment
II. Make a hypothesis
III. Write the conclusion
IV. Observe a problem
explanation: Bilimsel süreçte önce bir problem gözlemlenir, sonra hipotez kurulur, deney yapılır ve sonuç yazılır.

question_text: Which word means “a new thing that is created for the first time”?
explanation: İlk kez yapılan yeni bir şeye “invention” (icat) denir.

question_text:
The timeline shows some important inventions.
1876 → telephone
1903 → first powered aeroplane flight
1928 → penicillin was discovered
1969 → humans landed on the Moon
Which of the following is TRUE according to the timeline?
option_a: The aeroplane flew before the telephone was invented.
option_b: The telephone was invented after the aeroplane.
option_c: Penicillin was discovered before humans landed on the Moon.
option_d: Humans landed on the Moon in 1928.
explanation: Penisilin 1928'de keşfedilmiş, Ay'a iniş 1969'da gerçekleşmiştir; penisilin daha öncedir.

question_text:
Teacher: Scientists ---- a new planet outside our solar system recently.
Which of the following completes the sentence?
explanation: “Recently” (son zamanlarda) ile yakın geçmişte gerçekleşen bir olay Present Perfect ile anlatılır: “have discovered”.

question_text:
Four students talk about technology:
Ali: Smartphones have made communication easier.
Beyza: Robots are used in hospitals for surgery.
Cem: Electric cars were invented to reduce air pollution.
Deniz: I think science is boring.
Who expresses a personal opinion rather than a fact?
explanation: Deniz'in “I think science is boring.” sözü kişisel bir görüştür; diğerleri bilgi bildirir.

question_text: What should you do during an earthquake?
explanation: Deprem sırasında “çök, kapan, tutun” (drop, cover and hold on) yapılmalıdır.

question_text:
“If people cut down more trees, there ---- more floods and landslides.”
Which of the following completes the sentence?
explanation: Gelecekle ilgili koşul–sonuç bildiren cümlelerde sonuç kısmında “will” kullanılır.

question_text:
Look at the emergency kit list.
• water bottles
• a torch
• a first-aid kit
• a whistle
• ----
Which item is the most suitable to complete the list?
explanation: Acil durum çantasında hayati önemi olan malzemeler bulunur; battaniye bu listeye en uygun olanıdır.

question_text: Which natural disaster happens when there is no rain for a long time?
explanation: Uzun süre yağmur yağmamasına bağlı afet kuraklıktır (drought).

question_text:
Read the news.
“Heavy rain caused a flood in the city yesterday. Many streets were under water, so schools were closed. Experts say the flood happened because the drains were blocked with rubbish.”
What was the main cause of the flood according to experts?
option_b: The drains were blocked with rubbish.
explanation: Uzmanlara göre selin nedeni kanalizasyonların çöple tıkanmasıdır.

question_text: “Scientists predict that the temperature ---- in the next fifty years.”
explanation: Gelecekle ilgili tahmin “will” ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
The table shows some natural disasters and safety tips.
DisasterSafety tip
WildfireLeave the area quickly.
EarthquakeDrop, cover and hold on.
FloodGo down to the basement.
Which safety tip in the table is WRONG?
explanation: Sel sırasında bodruma inmek tehlikelidir; yüksek bir yere çıkılmalıdır. Bu nedenle sel için verilen ipucu yanlıştır.

question_text:
Mert: We should use less plastic. ----
Which sentence gives a reason for Mert's idea?
option_c: I bought a new bag yesterday.
option_d: It pollutes the oceans and harms animals.
explanation: Plastiğin okyanusları kirletmesi ve hayvanlara zarar vermesi, daha az plastik kullanılması gerektiğinin nedenidir.

question_text: Which of the following is used to accept an invitation?
explanation: “Sure, I'd love to come.” daveti kabul etmek için kullanılır. Diğer üçü daveti nazikçe reddetme ifadeleridir.

question_text:
Kaan: I'm organizing a movie night at my house on Friday. Would you like to come?
Selin: ----
Kaan: Great! It starts at seven.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_a: No, thanks. I don't like movies.
option_c: Of course! What time does it start?
option_d: Sorry, I have a lot of homework.
explanation: Kaan'ın “Great! It starts at seven.” cevabı, Selin'in daveti kabul edip saati sorduğunu gösterir.

question_text:
Read the text.
“My best friend is Arda. We have known each other since kindergarten. He is very generous; he always shares his snacks with me. He is also a bit stubborn, so it is hard to change his mind.”
Which of the following is NOT true about Arda?
option_a: He changes his mind very easily.
option_b: He has been the writer's friend for a long time.
explanation: Metinde Arda'nın inatçı olduğu ve fikrini değiştirmenin zor olduğu söylenmiştir (stubborn). Bu yüzden fikrini kolayca değiştirdiği yargısı yanlıştır.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“Elif is very ----. She always tells the truth.”
explanation: Her zaman doğruyu söyleyen kişi dürüsttür (honest).

question_text:
Look at the survey results about the most important quality in a friend.
QualityNumber of students
being supportive15
being funny9
being honest21
being generous5
According to the survey, which quality is the most important for the students?
explanation: Ankette en çok öğrenci (21) dürüstlüğü (being honest) en önemli özellik olarak seçmiştir.

question_text:
Defne: I had an argument with Ece yesterday, and now she isn't talking to me.
Mert: ----
Defne: You're right. I'll call her tonight.
Which of the following best completes the dialogue?
option_a: Why don't you call her and apologize?
option_b: Let's go to the cinema without her.
option_c: You should never talk to her again.
option_d: I don't like Ece at all.
explanation: Defne'nin “You're right. I'll call her tonight.” cevabı, Mert'in onu arayıp özür dilemesini önerdiğini gösterir.

question_text: Which of the following is used to refuse an invitation politely?
option_c: Yes, I'd be happy to join you.
option_d: Thanks for asking, but I have other plans.
explanation: “Thanks for asking, but I have other plans.” daveti kibarca reddetme ifadesidir; diğerleri daveti kabul eder.

question_text:
Read the invitation card.
“Dear friends, I'm turning fourteen! Join me for a pizza party at Funland on 12th May, from 2 p.m. to 5 p.m. Please reply by 8th May. — Can”
Which question CANNOT be answered according to the card?
option_b: What kind of present does Can want?
explanation: Kartta partinin yeri, Can'ın yaşı ve cevap için son tarih verilmiştir; ancak Can'ın nasıl bir hediye istediğine dair bilgi yoktur.

question_text:
Zehra wants to tell her friend that she misses her because her friend moved to another city.
Which of the following should she write in her message?
option_b: Can you lend me your notebook?
option_c: I really miss you. I hope we can meet soon.
option_d: I'm sorry, I'm busy this weekend.
explanation: Zehra arkadaşını özlediğini ifade etmek istemektedir; “I really miss you.” bu duyguyu doğrudan anlatır.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“I ---- watching documentaries. They are so informative.”
explanation: Belgeselleri bilgilendirici bulan kişi onları izlemekten hoşlanır (enjoy). Diğer seçenekler olumsuz duygular bildirir.

question_text:
Look at the table about Burak's weekly routine.
ActivityHow often
play basketballthree times a week
visit grandparentsonce a week
go to the cinemaonce a month
read a bookevery day
Which of the following is TRUE according to the table?
option_a: Burak reads a book every day.
option_c: Burak visits his grandparents three times a week.
option_d: Burak goes to the cinema every week.
explanation: Tabloya göre Burak her gün kitap okumaktadır. Sinemaya ayda bir gider, basketbolu haftada üç kez oynar, büyükanne ve büyükbabasını haftada bir ziyaret eder.

question_text:
Read the text.
“Hi, I'm Melis. On weekdays, I get up at seven and go to school. After school, I usually do my homework and then I chat with my friends online. At weekends, I sometimes go hiking with my family.”
What does Melis usually do after school?
explanation: Melis okuldan sonra genellikle ödevlerini yaptığını söylemektedir (“After school, I usually do my homework”).

question_text: Which of the following expresses dislike?
explanation: “can't stand” bir şeye katlanamamayı, yani hoşlanmamayı ifade eder. Diğer ifadeler hoşlanmayı bildirir.

question_text:
Four teenagers talk about their free time:
Onur: I prefer staying at home and playing chess.
Nil: I'm crazy about outdoor sports like cycling.
Tolga: I usually spend my free time in the library.
Su: I love making cakes in the kitchen.
Who prefers outdoor activities?
explanation: Nil bisiklet gibi açık hava sporlarına bayıldığını söylemektedir (outdoor sports). Diğerleri kapalı alan etkinliklerini tercih eder.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the dialogue.
Ayla: How often do you go swimming?
Emre: ----
explanation: “How often” sıklık sorar; “Twice a week.” (haftada iki kez) uygun cevaptır. Diğerleri yer, kişi ve neden bildirir.

option_a: Teenagers spend the same time on sports and studying.

explanation: Grafikte en uzun süre (4 saat) ekran başında geçirilmektedir. Okuma 1 saat ile en az zaman ayrılan etkinliktir.

question_text:
Kerem: I want to learn to play the guitar, but I'm not sure where to start.
Aslı: ----
Kerem: That's a good idea. I'll look for one.
Which of the following best completes the dialogue?
option_b: I play the piano every day.
option_d: Why don't you join a guitar course?
explanation: Kerem'in “That's a good idea. I'll look for one.” cevabı, Aslı'nın bir öneri sunduğunu ve önerinin bir şey araması gerektirdiğini gösterir: bir gitar kursuna katılmak.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the recipe.
“First, ---- the potatoes into small pieces.”
explanation: Patatesleri küçük parçalara ayırmak için doğrayın (chop) fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the recipe for a fruit salad.
“First, wash the fruits. Then, peel the bananas and oranges. Next, slice all the fruits. After that, put them in a bowl and add some honey. Finally, mix and serve.”
What should you do just before putting the fruits in a bowl?
explanation: Tarifte meyveleri kaseye koymadan hemen önceki adım dilimlemektir (“Next, slice all the fruits. After that, put them in a bowl”).

question_text: Which of the following words is NOT related to cooking?
explanation: Fry (kızartmak), stir (karıştırmak) ve grate (rendelemek) yemek yapmakla ilgilidir. Vacuum (elektrik süpürgesiyle temizlemek) bir ev işidir.

question_text:
Look at the ingredients list.
Pancakes (for 4 people)
flour2 cups
milk1 cup
eggs2
sugar1 spoon
Ayşe wants to make pancakes for 8 people. How many eggs does she need?
explanation: Tarif 4 kişiliktir ve 2 yumurta gerekir. 8 kişi için malzemeler iki katına çıkar: 4 yumurta.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“Bake the cake in the ---- for 40 minutes.”
explanation: Kek fırında (oven) pişirilir.

question_text:
Chef: Our soup is ready, but it tastes a bit bland.
Assistant: ----
Chef: Good idea! Pass me the salt and pepper, please.
Which of the following best completes the dialogue?
option_a: Let's put it in the fridge.
option_b: Why don't we add some spices?
explanation: Şefin tuz ve biber istemesi, yardımcısının çorbaya baharat eklemeyi önerdiğini gösterir. “Bland” tatsız anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Read what four people say about Turkish food.
Neşe: Baklava is my favourite. It's very sweet.
Umut: I love menemen. It's a great breakfast dish.
Lale: Mantı is delicious but it takes a long time to prepare.
Ozan: I don't eat lahmacun because it's too spicy for me.
Whose comment includes a negative point about the preparation of a dish?
explanation: Lale, mantının lezzetli olduğunu ama hazırlanmasının uzun sürdüğünü söylemiştir. Ozan'ın yorumu hazırlıkla değil, acılıkla ilgilidir.

question_text:
Look at the steps for making tea.
I. Pour the boiling water into the teapot.
II. Boil some water in the kettle.
III. Put the tea leaves into the teapot.
IV. Wait for about 10 minutes and serve.
What is the correct order of the steps?
explanation: Önce su kaynatılır, sonra çay demliğe konur, ardından kaynar su dökülür ve demlenmesi beklenip servis edilir: II – III – I – IV.

question_text: Which of the following is used to ask to speak to someone on the phone?
option_c: Can I speak to Mr. Yılmaz, please?
explanation: “Can I speak to …, please?” telefonda biriyle görüşmek istemek için kullanılır.

question_text:
Receptionist: Good morning, Star Dental Clinic. How can I help you?
Mr. Demir: ----
Receptionist: Let me check. Is Thursday at 3 p.m. OK for you?
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_a: Can I leave a message for my wife?
option_b: I'd like to make an appointment with the dentist.
option_c: I'm calling to complain about my phone bill.
option_d: I'd like to order a pizza.
explanation: Resepsiyonistin uygun gün ve saat önermesi, Bay Demir'in diş hekiminden randevu istediğini gösterir.

question_text:
Read the phone message.
“Phone message — To: Melike. From: Hakan. Message: The football match is cancelled because of the rain. Please call me back. Time: 4:15 p.m.”
Which of the following is TRUE according to the message?
option_b: The match is cancelled because of the snow.
option_d: Hakan wants Melike to call him back.
explanation: Mesajda Hakan'ın Melike'den kendisini geri aramasını istediği yazmaktadır. Maç kar değil yağmur nedeniyle iptal edilmiştir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the dialogue.
A: Hello, can I speak to Derya?
B: ---- I'll get her.
option_a: Sorry, you have the wrong number.
explanation: “I'll get her.” (Onu çağırıyorum.) ifadesi, B'nin karşı tarafı bekletip Derya'yı çağıracağını gösterir: “Just a moment, please.”

question_text:
Ahmet: Hello, is that Nilay?
Voice: No, this is 555 21 34.
Ahmet: Oh, ----
Voice: No problem.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_a: I'm sorry, I must have the wrong number.
option_b: Can I leave a message for her?
option_d: Please tell her to call me back.
explanation: Telefondaki kişinin Nilay olmaması ve “No problem.” cevabı, Ahmet'in yanlış numarayı aradığı için özür dilediğini gösterir.

question_text: What does “hang up” mean in a phone conversation?
explanation: “Hang up” telefonu kapatmak, yani görüşmeyi sonlandırmak demektir.

question_text:
Look at the table showing how four friends use their phones.
NameCalls per dayMessages per day
Ezgi240
Batu615
İrem160
Kemal425
Who makes the most phone calls?
explanation: Tabloya göre günde en çok telefon görüşmesi yapan kişi 6 aramayla Batu'dur. İrem en çok mesaj gönderen kişidir.

question_text:
Seda: Hi, can I talk to Mr. Aksoy, please?
Secretary: I'm afraid he is in a meeting right now.
Seda: ----
Secretary: Of course. What is your phone number?
Which of the following best completes the dialogue?
option_c: Can I speak to him now?
option_d: Could you ask him to call me back?
explanation: Sekreterin telefon numarasını sorması, Seda'nın Bay Aksoy'un kendisini geri aramasını rica ettiğini gösterir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“You should never share your ---- with anyone. Keep it secret.”
explanation: Şifre (password) kimseyle paylaşılmamalı ve gizli tutulmalıdır.

option_a: The same number of students do homework and watch videos.

option_c: Chatting is the most popular activity.
option_d: Most students use the Internet to watch videos.
explanation: Grafikte en yüksek değer 35 ile video izlemedir. Ödev yapanlar (30) oyun oynayanlardan (25) fazladır.

question_text:
Read the online safety tips.
“• Don't accept friend requests from strangers.
• Don't click on links from unknown e-mails.
• Tell an adult if someone bothers you online.”
Which of the following is a SAFE behaviour according to the tips?
option_a: Clicking a link in an e-mail from a stranger
option_b: Telling your parents about a rude online message
explanation: İpuçlarına göre çevrim içi rahatsız edildiğinde bir yetişkine haber vermek güvenli bir davranıştır.

question_text: Which word means “to send a file from your computer to a website”?
explanation: Bilgisayardaki bir dosyayı bir web sitesine göndermek “upload” (yüklemek) ile ifade edilir. Download indirmek, log out oturumu kapatmak, delete silmek demektir.

question_text:
Four students talk about the Internet:
Ceren: I use online dictionaries to learn new words.
Bora: I share my home address on social media.
Pelin: I check the information on different websites.
Taner: I log out after using a public computer.
Whose behaviour is risky?
explanation: Ev adresini sosyal medyada paylaşmak kişisel bilgileri yabancılara açar; bu riskli bir davranıştır.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“I ---- for information about volcanoes on a search engine.”
explanation: Arama motorunda bilgi aramak “search for” kalıbıyla ifade edilir.

question_text:
Read the e-mail.
“Dear Ms. Kaya, I'm writing to send my science project. I attached the file to this e-mail. Please let me know if you can't open it. Best wishes, Emir”
Why did Emir write the e-mail?
option_a: To send his project to his teacher
option_b: To invite his teacher to a party
option_c: To ask for a new project topic
explanation: Emir e-postayı fen projesini göndermek için yazmıştır ve dosyayı e-postaya eklediğini belirtmiştir.

question_text:
Mert: I spend about six hours online every day, and I can't sleep well at night.
Doctor: ----
Which of the following is the best advice from the doctor?
option_a: You should sleep with your phone.
option_b: You should buy a faster computer.
option_c: You should spend more time online.
option_d: You should limit your screen time, especially before bed.
explanation: Uzun süre ekran başında kalmak uyku sorunlarına yol açabilir. Doktorun en uygun tavsiyesi ekran süresini, özellikle yatmadan önce, sınırlamaktır.

question_text: Which of the following is an extreme sport?
explanation: Bungee jumping yüksek risk ve heyecan içeren bir ekstrem spordur.

question_text:
Read the text.
“Last summer, I tried rafting for the first time. At first, I was really nervous because the river was fast. However, our guide was very experienced, and in the end it was the most exciting day of my life.”
How did the writer feel at the beginning?
explanation: Yazar başlangıçta nehir hızlı olduğu için çok gergin olduğunu söylemektedir (“I was really nervous”).

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“Climbing a high mountain is ---- than walking in a park.”
explanation: İki şey karşılaştırılırken uzun sıfatlarda “more … than” kullanılır: more difficult than.

question_text:
Look at the table about four adventure activities.
ActivityPriceMinimum age
Paragliding1500 TL16
Rock climbing600 TL12
Scuba diving1200 TL14
Canoeing400 TL15
Tarık is 13 years old and has 700 TL. Which activity can he do?
explanation: Tarık 13 yaşında ve 700 TL'si var. Yaş ve fiyat koşulunu birlikte sağlayan tek etkinlik kaya tırmanışıdır (en az 12 yaş, 600 TL). Yamaç paraşütü ve dalış pahalıdır; kano için en az 15 yaşında olmak gerekir.

question_text:
Ozan: Do you want to try paragliding with me this weekend?
Esra: No way! ----
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_d: I've always wanted to try it.
explanation: “No way!” (Asla!) teklifin reddedildiğini gösterir. Reddin gerekçesi olarak yükseklik korkusu uygundur.

question_text: Choose the word that has a similar meaning to “thrilling”.
explanation: “Thrilling” heyecan verici anlamındadır ve “exciting” ile eş anlamlıdır.

question_text:
Four people describe their preferences:
Anıl: I prefer safe activities like hiking.
Gül: I'd rather go scuba diving than visit a museum.
Serkan: I don't like water sports at all.
Yeşim: I prefer reading a book at home to going camping.
Who prefers an underwater activity?
explanation: Gül müze gezmek yerine tüplü dalışı (scuba diving) tercih ettiğini söylemektedir; bu bir su altı etkinliğidir.

question_text:
Read the advertisement.
“Adventure Camp! Hiking, camping and rock climbing for teens aged 12–16. Professional guides. All equipment provided. Book before 1st June and get 10% off!”
Which of the following is TRUE according to the advertisement?
option_a: There aren't any guides at the camp.
option_c: Campers don't need to bring their own equipment.
option_d: The camp is for children under 10.
explanation: İlanda tüm ekipmanın sağlandığı belirtilmiştir (All equipment provided); bu yüzden katılımcıların kendi ekipmanlarını getirmesi gerekmez.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“I have ---- been to Cappadocia. It was amazing!”
explanation: Olumlu cümlede “daha önce yaptım” anlamı için “already” kullanılır; “It was amazing!” oraya gidildiğini gösterir.

question_text:
Read the postcard.
“Hi Elif! I'm in Antalya with my family. The weather is sunny and hot. Yesterday we visited the ancient city of Perge, and tomorrow we're going to swim at Konyaaltı Beach. See you soon! — Burcu”
What is Burcu going to do tomorrow?
explanation: Burcu yarın Konyaaltı Plajı'nda yüzeceklerini yazmıştır (“tomorrow we're going to swim”). Perge'yi dün ziyaret etmişlerdir.

question_text:
Look at the hotel information.
HotelPrice (per night)PoolNear the beach
Sunny2000 TLYesYes
Blue Sky1200 TLNoYes
Green Park900 TLYesNo
Sea View1500 TLYesYes
The Arslan family wants a hotel with a pool, near the beach, and cheaper than 1800 TL per night. Which hotel should they choose?
explanation: Havuzlu, plaja yakın ve 1800 TL'den ucuz olan tek otel 1500 TL ile Sea View'dır. Sunny pahalı, Blue Sky havuzsuz, Green Park plaja uzaktır.

question_text: Which of the following do you need to travel to another country?
explanation: Başka bir ülkeye seyahat etmek için pasaport (passport) gerekir.

question_text:
Tourist: Excuse me, how can I get to the museum?
Local: ----
Tourist: Thank you very much!
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_b: Go straight and turn left at the traffic lights.
option_c: I've never been to the museum.
explanation: Turist müzeye nasıl gideceğini sormaktadır; uygun cevap yol tarifi veren cümledir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the dialogue.
A: Have you ever visited Pamukkale?
B: ---- I went there last year.
explanation: “Have you ever …?” sorusuna olumlu kısa cevap “Yes, I have.” olur; “I went there last year.” oraya gidildiğini gösterir.

question_text:
Read what four tourists say about their holidays in Türkiye.
John: I loved the hot air balloon tour over the fairy chimneys.
Maria: The bazaars in İstanbul were crowded but colourful.
Kenji: I enjoyed the sunny beaches of the Aegean coast.
Anna: The food was delicious, but the hotel was too noisy.
Who complains about something during the holiday?
explanation: Anna yemeklerin lezzetli olduğunu ama otelin çok gürültülü olduğunu söyleyerek bir şeyden şikâyet etmektedir. Maria'nın “crowded but colourful” ifadesi şikâyetten çok bir betimlemedir.

question_text:
Look at the travel guide note.
“Mardin: Famous for its stone houses and historical streets. Best time to visit: spring and autumn. Summers are very hot. Don't miss the local food!”
Which of the following CANNOT be learned from the note?
option_a: The best time to visit Mardin
option_b: The weather in Mardin in summer
option_d: The price of hotels in Mardin
explanation: Notta Mardin'in neyle ünlü olduğu, en uygun ziyaret zamanı ve yaz havası verilmiştir; otel fiyatları hakkında bilgi yoktur.

question_text:
Lale is planning a holiday. She wants to see historical places and learn about ancient cultures.
Which of the following places is the best for her?
explanation: Lale tarihî yerleri görmek ve antik kültürler hakkında bilgi edinmek istemektedir; Efes Antik Kenti bu ilgiye en uygun yerdir.

question_text: Which of the following is a household chore?
explanation: Çamaşır yıkamak (doing the laundry) bir ev işidir.

question_text:
Look at the chore chart of the Kılıç family.
ChoreMotherFatherAdaEfe
set the table✓
take out the rubbish✓
water the plants✓
cook dinner✓✓
Which of the following is TRUE according to the chart?
explanation: Tabloya göre bitkileri Efe sular. Çöpü baba çıkarır, sofrayı Ada kurar, akşam yemeğini anne ve baba hazırlar.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“After dinner, I always ---- the dishes.”
explanation: Bulaşıklar yıkanır: “wash the dishes”.

question_text:
Read the text.
“I'm Deniz. I'm responsible for feeding our cat every morning. I also tidy my room at weekends. I hate ironing, so my mum does it. Sometimes I help my dad with the shopping.”
Which chore does Deniz NOT do?
explanation: Deniz ütü yapmaktan nefret ettiğini ve ütüyü annesinin yaptığını söylemiştir.

question_text:
Mother: Kids, the guests will arrive in an hour, and the living room is a mess!
Orhan: ----
Mother: Thank you, dear. Your sister can dust the shelves.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_a: I'm going out with my friends.
option_c: Don't worry, Mum. I'll vacuum the carpet.
explanation: Annenin teşekkür etmesi ve kız kardeşe de bir görev vermesi, Orhan'ın salonu temizlemek için yardım önerdiğini gösterir.

question_text: “Mow the lawn” means to ----.
explanation: “Mow the lawn” çimleri biçmek anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Four siblings talk about chores:
Can: I never make my bed in the mornings.
Esin: I sometimes help my mother with the cooking.
Arda: I always tidy my room without being told.
Beste: I rarely take out the rubbish.
Who is the most responsible about doing chores?
explanation: Arda odasını her zaman, kimse söylemeden topladığını belirtmiştir (always, without being told). Diğerleri ev işlerini nadiren ya da ara sıra yapmaktadır.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“A scientist does ---- in a laboratory.”
explanation: Bilim insanları laboratuvarda deney (experiments) yapar.

question_text:
Read the text.
“The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell in 1876. Before that, people sent letters or telegrams to communicate over long distances. Today, we use smartphones to make video calls.”
Which of the following is TRUE according to the text?
option_b: The telephone was invented in the 19th century.
option_d: People didn't communicate before the telephone.
explanation: Telefon 1876'da, yani 19. yüzyılda icat edilmiştir. Metinde telgrafı Bell'in icat ettiğine dair bilgi yoktur.

question_text:
Look at the experiment steps.
I. Put some ice in a glass.
II. Wait for 10 minutes.
III. Observe the water drops on the outside of the glass.
What is the student probably observing?
explanation: Soğuk bardağın dış yüzeyinde su damlacıklarının oluşması, havadaki su buharının yoğuşmasıdır (condensation).

question_text: Which of the following is a person who studies stars and planets?
explanation: Yıldızları ve gezegenleri inceleyen kişi gök bilimcidir (astronomer).

question_text:
Professor: In this experiment, first we mix baking soda with water. Then, we add some vinegar.
Student: ----
Professor: You will see bubbles because a gas is produced.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_a: What will happen after we add the vinegar?
option_c: How much does baking soda cost?
option_d: Where did you buy the vinegar?
explanation: Profesörün “You will see bubbles…” cevabı, öğrencinin sirke eklendikten sonra ne olacağını sorduğunu gösterir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“Penicillin ---- by Alexander Fleming in 1928.”
explanation: Penisilin keşfedilen şeydir; edilgen yapı (was discovered) kullanılır.

question_text:
Look at the table about some inventions.
InventionInventorYear
light bulbThomas Edison1879
airplaneWright brothers1903
World Wide WebTim Berners-Lee1989
Which invention is the newest?
option_b: They were all invented in the same year.
explanation: Tablodaki en yeni buluş 1989 yılı ile World Wide Web'dir.

question_text:
Four students talk about science:
Işıl: Science helps us find cures for diseases.
Oğuz: Science is useless in our daily lives.
Pınar: Thanks to science, we can communicate quickly.
Rüzgar: Scientists make new discoveries every year.
Whose opinion is NOT correct?
explanation: Bilim günlük hayatımızın her alanında (ulaşım, iletişim, sağlık) bize yardımcı olur. Bilimin günlük hayatta işe yaramadığı görüşü doğru değildir.

question_text: Which of the following is a natural disaster?
explanation: Deprem (earthquake) bir doğal afettir.

question_text:
Read the safety tips.
“During an earthquake: Drop to the ground, take cover under a sturdy table and hold on. Stay away from windows. Don't use the elevator.”
Which of the following should you NOT do during an earthquake?
option_b: Use the elevator to go outside
explanation: Güvenlik ipuçlarına göre deprem sırasında asansör kullanılmamalıdır (“Don't use the elevator.”).

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“A ---- is a very strong wind that moves in a circle.”
explanation: Daire şeklinde dönen çok güçlü rüzgâra hortum (tornado) denir.

question_text:
Reporter: What should people do if there is a flood warning?
Expert: ----
Which of the following is the best answer?
option_a: They should go to the basement.
option_b: They should swim in the flood water.
option_c: They should move to higher places immediately.
option_d: They should drive across flooded roads.
explanation: Sel uyarısında yapılması gereken, hemen yüksek yerlere çıkmaktır. Bodrum katlara inmek ve sel suyuna girmek tehlikelidir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“If it doesn't rain for a long time, there ---- a drought.”
explanation: Birinci tip koşul cümlesinde (if + şimdiki zaman) sonuç kısmında “will” kullanılır: there will be a drought.

question_text:
Read the news report.
“A heavy snowstorm hit the city yesterday. Schools were closed and many roads were blocked. The weather is expected to get better by Friday.”
Which of the following is TRUE according to the report?
option_a: Students didn't go to school because of the snowstorm.
option_c: The weather will get worse on Friday.
explanation: Haberde kar fırtınası nedeniyle okulların kapatıldığı belirtilmiştir. Hava cuma gününe kadar düzelecektir.

question_text:
Four people talk about protecting the environment:
Aylin: I turn off the tap while brushing my teeth.
Berk: I plant trees with my family every year.
Duru: I throw plastic bottles into the sea.
Ege: I use public transport instead of a car.
Whose behaviour is harmful to nature?
explanation: Plastik şişeleri denize atmak doğayı kirletir. Diğer davranışlar su tasarrufu, ağaçlandırma ve hava kirliliğini azaltma gibi doğayı koruyan davranışlardır.

question_text:
Look at the emergency bag list.
“• water • canned food • torch • first aid kit • radio”
What is the main purpose of preparing this bag?
option_b: To be ready for a natural disaster
option_c: To go on a shopping trip
explanation: Su, konserve yiyecek, el feneri, ilk yardım çantası ve radyo içeren çanta doğal afetlere hazırlıklı olmak için hazırlanır.

question_text:
Choose the best response.
“Can you keep a secret?”
option_d: Of course. I won't tell anyone.
explanation: Sır tutup tutamayacağı sorulan kişinin en uygun cevabı “Elbette, kimseye söylemem.” olur.

question_text:
Elif: Are you free this Saturday?
Murat: Yes, I don't have any plans. Why?
Elif: ----
Murat: Great idea! See you there.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_b: I went to the library last week.
option_c: I don't want to go out.
option_d: How about meeting at the library at three?
explanation: Murat'ın “Great idea! See you there.” cevabı, Elif'in bir yer ve saat önererek buluşma teklif ettiğini gösterir.

question_text:
Read the e-mail from a pen friend.
“Hi Selin! My name is Ana and I live in Lisbon, Portugal. I'm thirteen. I love drawing and playing volleyball. I'd like to learn some Turkish words. Write back soon!”
Which of the following is NOT mentioned in Ana's e-mail?
explanation: Ana yaşını, nerede yaşadığını ve hobilerini yazmıştır; en sevdiği yemekten söz etmemiştir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option.
“A ---- friend always encourages you and helps you when you have a problem.”
explanation: Sizi her zaman cesaretlendiren ve sorun yaşadığınızda yardım eden arkadaş destekleyicidir (supportive).

question_text:
Look at the table about four friends' hobbies.
NameHobby 1Hobby 2
Jalechessswimming
Keremcyclingpainting
Linaswimmingreading
Metefootballcycling
Who has a hobby in common with Jale?
explanation: Jale'nin hobileri satranç ve yüzmedir. Lina da yüzmeyi sevdiği için Jale ile ortak bir hobisi vardır.

question_text:
Your best friend practised hard for the school race, but she came last. She is very sad now.
What would you say to her?
option_b: Let's not talk about it ever again.
option_c: Never mind. You did your best.
explanation: Üzgün bir arkadaşı teselli etmek için “Boş ver, elinden geleni yaptın.” demek uygundur.

question_text: Which of the following sentences describes a bad friend?
option_a: She gossips about her friends behind their backs.
option_c: She listens to me when I'm upset.
option_d: She is always honest with me.
explanation: Arkadaşları hakkında arkalarından dedikodu yapmak kötü bir arkadaşın özelliğidir.

question_text:
Read the messages.
Burak: “I'm so sorry I forgot to bring your book back. I'll give it to you tomorrow, I promise.”
Tuna: “No problem. I don't need it until next week.”
Which of the following is TRUE according to the messages?
explanation: Tuna “No problem.” diyerek Burak'ın özrünü kabul etmiş ve kitaba gelecek haftaya kadar ihtiyacı olmadığını söylemiştir.

question_text:
Defne: My friend always borrows my things, but she never gives them back. What should I do?
Four students give advice:
Ata: You should talk to her honestly about it.
Beyza: You should take her things without asking.
Can: You should shout at her in front of everyone.
Deniz: You should never speak to her again.
Whose advice is the most suitable?
explanation: Sorunu çözmenin en uygun yolu arkadaşla dürüstçe ve sakin biçimde konuşmaktır.

question_text: Which of the following questions asks about frequency?
option_a: Where do you play video games?
option_b: Why do you play video games?
option_c: How often do you play video games?
option_d: Who do you play video games with?
explanation: “How often” bir eylemin ne sıklıkta yapıldığını sorar.

question_text:
Read the text.
“I'm Kaan. I'm really into technology, so I spend a lot of time building robots. I'm not interested in fashion at all. At weekends, I sometimes go to the cinema with my cousins.”
Which of the following is NOT true about Kaan?
option_b: He sometimes goes to the cinema.
explanation: Kaan modayla hiç ilgilenmediğini söylemiştir (“I'm not interested in fashion at all.”).

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“My sister is keen ---- photography. She takes photos everywhere.”
explanation: “Keen on” kalıbı bir şeye çok ilgi duymak anlamındadır.

question_text:
Ozan: What kind of music do you prefer?
Pelin: ----
Which of the following is the best response?
option_a: I play the guitar on Mondays.
option_c: I prefer pop music because it makes me happy.
explanation: Pelin'e hangi tür müziği tercih ettiği sorulmuştur; uygun cevap bir müzik türü ve nedenini söyleyen cümledir.

question_text:
Look at the table about four teenagers' likes and dislikes.
NameReadingSports
Asya✓✗
Bora✓✓
Cem✗✓
Duru✗✗
(✓: likes, ✗: doesn't like) Who likes both reading and sports?
explanation: Tabloya göre hem okumayı hem sporu seven tek kişi Bora'dır.

question_text: What does “hang out with friends” mean?
option_b: To spend free time with friends
explanation: “Hang out” arkadaşlarla boş zaman geçirmek anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Deniz: I'm really stressed about my exams. I can't concentrate on anything.
Counsellor: ----
Which of the following is the best advice?
option_a: You should drink a lot of coffee.
option_c: You should make a study plan and take short breaks.
option_d: You should stay up all night every night.
explanation: Sınav stresi yaşayan bir öğrenciye en uygun tavsiye bir çalışma planı yapması ve kısa molalar vermesidir.

question_text: Which of the following is a kitchen utensil?
explanation: Tava (frying pan) mutfakta kullanılan bir araçtır.

question_text:
Look at the steps for making an omelette.
I. Pour the eggs into the hot pan.
II. Break the eggs into a bowl and whisk them.
III. Heat some butter in a pan.
IV. Cook for two minutes and serve.
What is the correct order?
explanation: Önce yumurtalar kırılıp çırpılır, sonra tavada tereyağı ısıtılır, ardından yumurtalar tavaya dökülür ve pişirilip servis edilir.

question_text:
Look at the recipe for vegetable soup.
Vegetable soup (for 2 people)
carrots3
potatoes2
onion1
water4 cups
Kerem wants to make soup for 6 people. How many carrots does he need?
explanation: Tarif 2 kişiliktir. 6 kişi için malzemeler 3 katına çıkar: 3 · 3 = 9 havuç.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“---- the milk into a glass and drink it.”
explanation: Süt bardağa dökülür: “Pour”.

question_text:
Guest: This menemen is delicious! How do you make it?
Host: ----
Which of the following is the best response?
option_a: I don't like cooking at all.
option_c: I bought it from a restaurant.
option_d: First, I fry some peppers and tomatoes. Then, I add eggs.
explanation: Misafir menemenin nasıl yapıldığını sormaktadır; uygun cevap yapılış adımlarını anlatan cümledir.

question_text:
Read the text.
“My favourite dish is my grandmother's stuffed peppers. She fills the peppers with rice, onions and spices. It takes about an hour to cook them. We usually eat them with yoghurt.”
Which question CANNOT be answered according to the text?
option_a: How many peppers does she use?
option_c: How long does it take to cook?
option_d: What do they eat it with?
explanation: Metinde yemeği kimin yaptığı, ne kadar sürede piştiği ve neyle yendiği vardır; kaç biber kullanıldığı ise yazmamaktadır.

question_text: Which of the following words does NOT describe a taste?
explanation: Sweet (tatlı), sour (ekşi) ve salty (tuzlu) tat bildirir. Crunchy (çıtır) ise yiyeceğin dokusunu anlatır.

question_text:
Four people talk about food:
Gül: I always add lots of hot pepper to my meals.
Hakan: I prefer simple dishes without any spices.
İpek: I love desserts with chocolate.
Jan: I usually eat salads for lunch.
Who likes spicy food?
explanation: Gül yemeklerine her zaman bolca acı biber eklediğini söylemektedir; acılı yemekleri seven kişi odur.

question_text: In a phone conversation, what does “Hold on, please.” mean?
explanation: “Hold on, please.” telefonda “Lütfen bekleyin.” anlamında kullanılır.

question_text:
Receptionist: Good afternoon, Sunshine Hotel. How can I help you?
Mrs. Kaya: I'd like to speak to Mr. Arslan, please.
Receptionist: I'm sorry, he's out at the moment.
Mrs. Kaya: ----
Receptionist: Sure. Go ahead.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_a: Can I leave a message for him?
option_b: Can I book a table for two?
explanation: Resepsiyonistin “Sure. Go ahead.” cevabı, Bayan Kaya'nın Bay Arslan'a mesaj bırakmak istediğini gösterir.

question_text:
Read the text messages.
Zeynep (10:15): “The cinema starts at 7 p.m. Let's meet at 6:30 in front of the mall.”
Onur (10:20): “Sorry, I have a piano lesson until 6:30. Can we meet at 6:45?”
Zeynep (10:22): “OK, no problem.”
When will they meet?
explanation: Onur 6.45'te buluşmayı önermiş, Zeynep de kabul etmiştir.

question_text: Which of the following is used to ask who is on the phone?
explanation: “Who's calling, please?” telefonda arayan kişinin kim olduğunu sormak için kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the phone message.
“For: Dad. From: Uncle Tarık. He called at 3:30 p.m. He will visit us on Sunday with his family. Call him back if Sunday isn't OK.”
Which of the following is TRUE according to the message?
option_a: Uncle Tarık wants Dad to visit him.
option_b: Uncle Tarık is planning to visit on Sunday.
explanation: Mesaja göre Tarık Amca pazar günü ailesiyle birlikte ziyarete gelecektir.

question_text:
Leyla: Hello, Mert? It's Leyla.
Mert: Hi Leyla! Sorry, the line is very bad. I can't hear you well.
Leyla: ----
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_a: Shall I call you back in a minute?
explanation: Hat kötü olduğu için Leyla'nın birazdan geri aramayı önermesi en uygun cevaptır.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“I'm in a meeting now. I'll call you ---- in an hour.”
explanation: “Call back” geri aramak anlamındadır.

question_text:
Look at the monthly phone bills of four friends.

option_a: Using the Internet to hurt or threaten someone
explanation: Cyberbullying, interneti birini incitmek, tehdit etmek ya da rahatsız etmek için kullanmaktır (siber zorbalık).

question_text:
Read the online safety rules of a school.
“• Use strong passwords.
• Never share personal information with strangers.
• Think before you post.”
Which of the following behaviours does NOT follow the rules?
option_b: Posting your phone number on a public website
option_c: Checking a photo before sharing it
option_d: Using a password with letters and numbers
explanation: Telefon numarasını herkese açık bir sitede paylaşmak, kişisel bilgilerin yabancılarla paylaşılmaması kuralına aykırıdır.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“You need to ---- in with your username and password.”
explanation: Kullanıcı adı ve şifreyle sisteme giriş yapmak “log in” ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
Read the e-mail.
“Dear customer, your order has been sent. It will arrive in three days. You can track your package on our website. Thank you for shopping with us.”
What is the e-mail about?
explanation: E-posta, gönderilen bir siparişin üç gün içinde ulaşacağını bildirmektedir; konusu çevrim içi bir alışveriştir.

question_text:
Four students are doing research on climate change for a school project:
Ege: I read an article on a famous scientist's official website.
Feyza: I copied a comment from an anonymous social media account.
Gökhan: I believed a video with no source.
Hale: I used a message forwarded by a stranger.
Whose source is the most reliable?
explanation: Resmî ve tanınmış bir bilim insanına ait web sitesi, kaynağı belirsiz paylaşımlara göre en güvenilir kaynaktır.

question_text: Which of the following is a social media activity?
explanation: Takipçilerle fotoğraf paylaşmak bir sosyal medya etkinliğidir.

question_text:
Mother: You've been playing online games for five hours. You haven't done your homework and you look tired.
Emre: But I love playing games!
Mother: ----
Which of the following is the best response from the mother?
option_a: You should play more difficult games.
option_b: You can play, but you should set a time limit and finish your homework first.
option_d: You should never use a computer again.
explanation: Annenin en dengeli cevabı, oyun oynamayı yasaklamadan bir süre sınırı koymayı ve önce ödevleri bitirmeyi önermektir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“Mount Everest is the ---- mountain in the world.”
explanation: Bir şeyin grubun en üstünde olduğunu belirtmek için üstünlük derecesi kullanılır: the highest.

question_text:
Read the text.
“Last weekend, my friends and I went camping in the forest. We put up our tents near a lake. In the evening, we made a campfire and told stories. Unfortunately, it rained at night, so we didn't sleep well.”
Why didn't they sleep well?
explanation: Metinde gece yağmur yağdığı için iyi uyuyamadıkları belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
Look at the table about some adventure sports.
SportRisk levelEquipment
HikingLowBoots
RaftingMediumHelmet, life jacket
SkydivingVery highParachute
KayakingMediumPaddle, life jacket
Which sport is the most dangerous according to the table?
explanation: Tabloya göre risk düzeyi en yüksek (very high) olan spor paraşütle atlamadır (skydiving).

question_text: Which of the following sentences expresses a preference?
option_b: I'd rather go hiking than watch TV.
explanation: “I'd rather … than …” kalıbı bir şeyi diğerine tercih ettiğimizi belirtir.

question_text:
İnci: Would you rather go scuba diving or rock climbing?
Kaan: ----
Which of the following is the best response?
option_a: Scuba diving. I love exploring underwater.
option_d: I went to the cinema last night.
explanation: “Would you rather A or B?” sorusuna seçeneklerden birini seçip nedenini söylemek uygundur.

question_text:
Read the advertisement.
“Join our Cappadocia Balloon Tour! See the fairy chimneys at sunrise. Tour starts at 5 a.m. Children under 6 are not allowed. Hotel pickup is free.”
Which of the following is TRUE according to the advertisement?
option_a: You can't see the fairy chimneys on this tour.
option_b: Participants are picked up from their hotels for free.
option_c: Children of all ages can join.
option_d: The tour starts in the afternoon.
explanation: İlanda otelden alımın ücretsiz olduğu belirtilmiştir (“Hotel pickup is free.”).

question_text: Choose the word that is the opposite of “brave”.
explanation: “Brave” cesur demektir; zıt anlamlısı korkmuş anlamındaki “scared”dır. Diğerleri eş anlamlıdır.

question_text:
Four people talk about holidays:
Lale: I always choose quiet places where I can relax safely.
Mert: I'm looking for thrilling activities like bungee jumping.
Nur: I want to try paragliding next summer.
Oğuz: I love rafting on fast rivers.
Who prefers safe and calm holidays?
explanation: Lale güvenle dinlenebileceği sakin yerleri seçtiğini söylemektedir. Diğerleri heyecan verici, riskli etkinlikleri tercih etmektedir.

question_text:
Choose the best response.
“Have you ever been to London?”
option_d: No, I haven't, but I'd like to go.
explanation: “Have you ever …?” sorusuna kısa cevap “Yes, I have.” ya da “No, I haven't.” biçiminde verilir.

question_text:
Read the travel blog.
“Hello from Trabzon! Today we visited Sümela Monastery, which is built on a steep cliff. The view was breathtaking. Tomorrow we're going to Uzungöl to see the lake. The weather is a bit rainy, but we're having fun.”
Where are they going tomorrow?
explanation: Yazar yarın göl görmek için Uzungöl'e gideceklerini belirtmiştir. Sümela Manastırı'nı bugün ziyaret etmişlerdir.

question_text:
Look at the tour information.
TourDurationPrice per personLunch included
City Tour4 hours500 TLNo
Boat Tour6 hours800 TLYes
Museum Tour3 hours400 TLNo
Village Tour8 hours900 TLYes
The Demir family wants a tour with lunch that costs less than 850 TL per person. Which tour should they choose?
explanation: Öğle yemeği dâhil ve kişi başı 850 TL'den ucuz olan tek tur 800 TL ile tekne turudur.

question_text: What does “sightseeing” mean?
option_c: Visiting interesting places as a tourist
explanation: “Sightseeing” turist olarak ilginç yerleri gezip görmek anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Receptionist: Good evening. Welcome to Blue Hotel.
Guest: Good evening. I have a reservation for two nights.
Receptionist: ----
Guest: It's Yılmaz. Aylin Yılmaz.
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_c: May I have your name, please?
explanation: Konuğun soyadını söylemesi, resepsiyonistin adını sorduğunu gösterir.

question_text:
Read the travel tips.
“• Keep your passport in a safe place.
• Learn a few words in the local language.
• Respect local customs.
• Don't drink tap water in places where it isn't safe.”
Which of the following is NOT advised in the tips?
option_d: Leaving your passport in your hotel room door
explanation: İpuçlarında pasaportun güvenli bir yerde tutulması önerilmiştir; onu otel odası kapısında bırakmak bu öneriye aykırıdır.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“My uncle ---- Paris twice. He loves it there.”
explanation: Üçüncü tekil şahısla present perfect “has visited” biçimindedir.

question_text:
Read what four tourists say about a city.
Amy: The historical buildings were amazing.
Ben: The food was tasty, but everything was too expensive.
Cleo: The people were friendly and helpful.
Dan: The public transport was easy to use.
Who complains about the prices?
explanation: Ben yemeklerin lezzetli olduğunu ama her şeyin çok pahalı olduğunu söylemiştir.

question_text:
Read the directions.
“Walk along Atatürk Street and turn right at the post office. The museum is on your left, next to the bank and opposite the park.”
Which of the following is TRUE about the museum?
option_c: It is opposite the post office.
option_d: It is next to the bank.
explanation: Yol tarifine göre müze bankanın yanında ve parkın karşısındadır.

question_text: Which of the following chores is usually done in the garden?
explanation: Çiçekleri sulamak bahçede yapılan bir ev işidir.
