question_text:
Read the text.
“In our house, everyone has a responsibility. My father cooks dinner on weekdays. My mother does the shopping. My brother walks the dog, and I set the table.”
Who walks the dog?
explanation: Metinde köpeği gezdiren kişinin yazarın erkek kardeşi olduğu belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“Can you ---- out the rubbish, please?”
explanation: Çöpü dışarı çıkarmak “take out the rubbish” ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
Mother: Ayça, could you help me hang the washing?
Ayça: ----
Mother: Thanks, you're a star!
Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_a: Sure, Mum. I'll do it right now.
option_b: I don't know how to cook.
option_c: No, I'm busy with my phone.
explanation: Annenin teşekkür etmesi, Ayça'nın yardım istemini kabul ettiğini gösterir.

question_text:
Look at the survey results about the chores teenagers do most often.
ChoreNumber of teenagers
tidying their room28
setting the table20
vacuuming12
doing the laundry6
Which of the following is TRUE according to the survey?
option_a: More teenagers vacuum than set the table.
option_b: Tidying their room is the most common chore.
option_c: Doing the laundry is the most common chore.
option_d: The same number of teenagers vacuum and do the laundry.
explanation: Tabloya göre en çok yapılan ev işi 28 kişiyle oda toplamaktır.

question_text: What does “tidy up” mean?
option_c: To make a place clean and organized
explanation: “Tidy up” bir yeri toplamak, düzenlemek anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Read the note on the fridge.
“Kids, I'll be back at 7. Please feed the cat, empty the dishwasher and do your homework. Don't forget to water the plants on the balcony! — Mum”
Which of the following is NOT on the list?
explanation: Annenin notunda kediyi beslemek, bulaşık makinesini boşaltmak, ödev yapmak ve bitkileri sulamak vardır; akşam yemeği yapmak yoktur.

question_text: Which of the following is used to see very small things like cells?
explanation: Hücre gibi çok küçük şeyleri görmek için mikroskop kullanılır. Teleskop uzaktaki gök cisimlerini görmek için kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the text.
“In 1941, a Swiss engineer named George de Mestral went for a walk with his dog. When he came back, he noticed tiny seeds stuck to his clothes and his dog's fur. He looked at them under a microscope and saw small hooks. This gave him the idea for Velcro.”
What inspired the invention of Velcro?
explanation: De Mestral, kıyafetlerine yapışan küçük kancalı tohumları mikroskopla inceleyerek cırt cırt bandı (Velcro) icat etme fikrini bulmuştur.

question_text:
A student did an experiment with two identical plants.
• Plant A: kept near a sunny window and watered regularly
• Plant B: kept in a dark cupboard and watered regularly
After two weeks, Plant A was green and healthy, but Plant B was yellow and weak.
What can we learn from this experiment?
option_a: Plants need light to grow well.
option_b: Plants grow better in the dark.
explanation: İki bitki de düzenli sulanmış, yalnızca ışık koşulu farklıdır. Karanlıktaki bitkinin zayıflaması, bitkilerin iyi büyümek için ışığa ihtiyaç duyduğunu gösterir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“The telephone ---- by Alexander Graham Bell in 1876.”
explanation: Telefon icat edilen şeydir; geçmiş zamanda edilgen yapı “was invented” kullanılır.

question_text:
Look at the table about some scientists.
ScientistFieldFamous for
Marie CurieChemistry & PhysicsResearch on radioactivity
Isaac NewtonPhysicsLaws of motion
Cahit ArfMathematicsArf invariant
Charles DarwinBiologyTheory of evolution
Who is famous for a discovery in mathematics?
explanation: Tabloya göre matematik alanında tanınan bilim insanı Cahit Arf'tır.

question_text:
Student: Can I mix these two liquids in the lab?
Teacher: Yes, but ----
Which of the following completes the teacher's warning?
option_a: you should throw the bottles away.
option_b: you should wear safety goggles and gloves.
option_c: you should do it without asking anyone.
explanation: Laboratuvarda kimyasallarla çalışırken koruyucu gözlük ve eldiven takmak gerekir.

question_text: Which of the following sentences uses “discover” correctly?
option_a: Scientists discovered a new phone model in the factory.
option_b: My brother discovered his homework yesterday.
option_c: She discovered a cake for her mother.
option_d: Scientists discovered a new planet last year.
explanation: “Discover” daha önce var olan ama bilinmeyen bir şeyi bulmak anlamındadır; yeni bir gezegenin keşfi buna uygundur. Yeni bir ürün yapmak “invent” ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
Four students talk about the Turkish scientist Aziz Sancar:
Eda: He won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2015.
Fırat: He did research on how cells repair DNA.
Gizem: He was a famous football player.
Harun: He studied medicine before becoming a scientist.
Whose sentence is NOT correct?
explanation: Aziz Sancar, DNA onarımı üzerine çalışmalarıyla 2015 Nobel Kimya Ödülü'nü almış ve tıp eğitimi almış bir bilim insanıdır; futbolcu değildir.

question_text: Which of the following can happen after very heavy rain?
explanation: Çok şiddetli yağmurlardan sonra sel (flood) oluşabilir. Kuraklık ise uzun süre yağmur yağmamasıyla oluşur.

question_text:
Read the text.
“A volcano is an opening in the Earth's surface. When it erupts, hot melted rock called lava comes out. Ash from a volcano can travel very far and cause problems for planes. Mount Etna in Italy is one of the most active volcanoes in Europe.”
Which of the following is TRUE according to the text?
option_c: Volcanic ash can be dangerous for planes.
explanation: Metinde volkanik külün çok uzaklara gidebileceği ve uçaklar için sorun yaratabileceği belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
Look at the table showing natural disasters in four regions last year.
RegionFloodsForest firesLandslides
North1238
South2151
East426
West692
Which region had the most forest fires?
explanation: Tabloya göre en çok orman yangını 15 ile güney bölgesinde yaşanmıştır.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
“If we cut down all the trees, ----”
option_c: there was a lot of rain.
option_d: there will be more floods and landslides.
explanation: Birinci tip koşul cümlesinde sonuç kısmında “will” kullanılır ve olası bir gelecek sonucunu bildirir.

question_text:
During an emergency in Türkiye, you can call 112 for help from an ambulance, the police or the fire brigade.
Your neighbour has fallen down the stairs and is badly hurt. What should you do first?
option_a: Send an e-mail to a friend
option_c: Post a photo on social media
explanation: Acil durumlarda Türkiye'de 112 aranarak ambulans, polis ya da itfaiyeden yardım istenir.

question_text:
Reporter: There is a tsunami warning for the coast. What should people do?
Expert: ----
Which of the following is the best answer?
option_a: They should go to the beach to watch the waves.
option_b: They should stay in their boats.
option_c: They should move away from the coast to higher ground immediately.
option_d: They should swim in the sea.
explanation: Tsunami uyarısında kıyıdan uzaklaşıp hemen yüksek yerlere çıkmak gerekir.

question_text: What is an “avalanche”?
option_a: A large amount of snow falling down a mountain
explanation: “Avalanche” dağdan aşağı büyük miktarda karın kaymasıdır (çığ).

question_text:
Four people describe what they did during a thunderstorm:
Arda: I stayed inside and unplugged the TV.
Başak: I stood under a tall tree in an open field.
Ceyhun: I kept away from windows.
Dilan: I waited in a car with the windows closed.
Who acted dangerously?
explanation: Fırtına sırasında açık arazide uzun bir ağacın altında durmak tehlikelidir, çünkü yıldırım yüksek noktalara düşer.

question_text:
Read the text.
“Because of global warming, temperatures are rising all over the world. Glaciers are melting and sea levels are going up. Some animals, like polar bears, are losing their homes.”
What is the main idea of the text?
option_a: Global warming has serious effects on the planet.
option_b: Polar bears live in hot places.
explanation: Metin, küresel ısınmanın sıcaklıklar, buzullar, deniz seviyesi ve hayvanlar üzerindeki ciddi etkilerini anlatmaktadır.

question_text:
Maya: We are having a slumber party at my house on Saturday night. Would you like to join us?
Selin: ----, but I have to visit my grandparents with my parents.
Which of the following completes the dialogue appropriately?
explanation: 'but I have to...' ile devam eden bir mazeret cümlesinden önce nazik bir istek bildirimi ('I'd love to' - Çok isterdim ama...) kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the invitation card:
'Dear Friends, We are celebrating Emre's 14th birthday! Place: Green Cafe | Date: Sunday, May 18 | Time: 3:00 p.m. - 6:00 p.m. Please call 555-0142 until Friday if you can come.'
Which question does NOT have an answer on the card?
option_a: Who is the birthday party for?
option_b: What kind of food will be served?
option_c: Where will the party take place?
option_d: What time does the event finish?
explanation: Kartta kimin doğum günü olduğu (Emre), yeri (Green Cafe) ve bitiş saati (6:00 p.m.) yazıyor; ancak ikram edilecek yiyeceklerden söz edilmemiştir.

question_text: A true friend always ---- you when you are in trouble and never tells your secrets to anyone.
explanation: 'back up' (desteklemek, arka çıkmak) gerçek arkadaşlığın temel özelliklerinden biridir.

question_text:
A survey asked 100 teenagers about their favorite free-time activities:
• Reading books: 35%
• Doing sports: 30%
• Listening to music: 25%
• Playing chess: 10%
Which of the following is CORRECT according to the results?
option_a: More than half of the teens prefer playing chess.
option_b: Listening to music has the highest percentage.
option_c: Doing sports is less popular than playing chess.
option_d: Reading books is the most popular activity among teens.
explanation: Yüzde 35 ile kitap okumak gençler arasında en popüler etkinliktir.

question_text:
Kerem: What kind of music do you prefer listening to?
Arda: I'm keen on rock music because I think it is ----, whereas pop music is unbearable for me.
explanation: Arda rock müziğe 'keen on' (meraklı/düşkün) olduğu için olumlu bir sıfat ('energetic and impressive') seçilmelidir.

question_text: I usually wake up at 7 a.m., have breakfast, and walk to school. After school, I ---- guitar lessons twice a week.
explanation: Ders/kurs almak ifadesi İngilizcede 'take lessons' kalıbıyla kullanılır.

question_text:
Look at the recipe steps for making an omelette:
I. Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt in a bowl.
II. Heat a tablespoon of butter in a frying pan.
III. First, crack two eggs into a bowl.
IV. Pour the mixture into the pan and cook for 3 minutes.
What is the CORRECT order of the recipe?
explanation: Önce yumurtalar kırılır (III), sonra çırpılır (I), tavada tereyağı ısıtılır (II) ve karışım tavaya dökülüp pişirilir (IV).

question_text:
Waiter: Would you like some dessert after the main course?
Customer: No, thanks. ----. I'm really full.
option_a: Can I see the dessert menu?
option_b: Please bring me two slices of cake
explanation: 'I'm really full' (Çok tokum) diyen müşteri başka bir şey yiyemeyeceğini belirtir.

question_text: Which kitchen tool do you need to ---- potatoes into thin slices?
explanation: Patatesi ince dilimlere ayırmak için 'slice' (dilimlemek) fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Secretary: Good morning, ABC Tech. How can I help you?
Mr. Kaya: May I speak to Mrs. Demir, please?
Secretary: ----. I'll put you through to her office.
explanation: 'I'll put you through' (Sizi bağlıyorum) ifadesinden önce 'Hold on a moment, please' (Bir dakika bekleyin lütfen) denir.

question_text:
Elif: Hello, is Can there?
Can's mother: Sorry, he went out 10 minutes ago. ----?
Elif: Yes, please tell him to call me back when he returns.
option_c: Would you like to leave a message
explanation: Aranan kişi yoksa 'Would you like to leave a message?' (Mesaj bırakmak ister misiniz?) diye sorulur.

question_text: I prefer sending text messages to making phone calls because texting is quicker and I can ---- at any time.
explanation: Mesajlara her zaman yanıt verilebileceği için 'reply' (cevaplamak) uygundur.

question_text:
Read the internet safety rules:
1. Never share your passwords with strangers.
2. Avoid clicking on unknown links or pop-up ads.
3. Always ask your parents before downloading new files.
Which of the following follows these rules?
option_a: Bora uses strong passwords and never shares them online.
option_b: Ece sends her home address to people she met in a chat room.
option_c: Deniz clicks every pop-up advertisement to win free gifts.
option_d: Mert uses '123456' as his password on all websites.
explanation: Güçlü parola kullanmak ve bunları paylaşmamak internet güvenliği kurallarına uygundur.

question_text:
Teacher: Why do you use the Internet mostly, Zeynep?
Zeynep: I usually use it for ----. I read online articles and watch science videos for my school projects.
explanation: Makale okuyup bilim videoları izlemek ödev/proje için araştırma yapmak ('doing research') kapsamındadır.

question_text: If you want to send your homework file to your teacher via e-mail, you should click the ---- icon first.
explanation: E-postaya dosya eklemek için 'attachment' (ek/ataç) simgesi kullanılır.

question_text:
Look at the table of extreme sports:
• Skydiving: Very dangerous, exciting
• Trekking: Safe, relaxing
• Rafting: Challenging, wet
Ege says: 'I hate risky activities. I prefer being in nature and walking quietly.'
Which sport is the BEST for Ege?
explanation: Riskten hoşlanmayan ve doğada yürümeyi seven Ege için 'Trekking' (doğa yürüyüşü) en uygun seçenektir.

question_text:
Cem: Have you ever tried paragliding?
Onur: Yes, I tried it last summer in Fethiye. ----! You feel like a bird in the sky.
explanation: 'Gökyüzünde kuş gibi hissediyorsun' cümlesi deneyimin büyüleyici ('fascinating') olduğunu gösterir.

question_text: Before going rock climbing, you must wear a ---- to protect your head and use strong ropes.
explanation: Başı korumak için 'helmet' (kask) takılır.

question_text:
Read the short travel blog:
'Last summer I visited Cappadocia. I stayed in a cave hotel, took a hot-air balloon ride at sunrise, and tasted traditional pottery kebab. The fairy chimneys looked amazing!'
What did the writer NOT mention in the blog?
explanation: Konaklama (cave hotel), yerel yemek (pottery kebab) ve turistik yerler (fairy chimneys) geçiyor; ancak Kapadokya'ya nasıl ulaştığı (transportation) belirtilmemiş.

question_text:
Aylin: What is the ---- like in Antalya in July?
Buse: It is usually hot and sunny, around 35°C.
explanation: Sıcak ve güneşli (35°C) yanıtı hava durumunu ('weather') soran soruya verilir.

question_text: I prefer visiting ---- places such as ancient theaters and castles because I love learning about history.
explanation: Antik tiyatro ve kaleler tarihî ('historic') yerlerdir.

question_text:
Look at the family chore list:
• Mother: Cooking dinner
• Father: Taking out the garbage
• Ali: Vacuuming the carpets
• Eda: Watering the plants
Which of the following is FALSE according to the list?
option_a: Ali is responsible for cleaning the carpets.
option_b: The father prepares the evening meal.
option_c: Eda has to take care of the plants.
explanation: Akşam yemeğini pişiren annedir; baba çöpleri çıkarmakla sorumludur, bu yüzden babanın akşam yemeğini hazırladığı ifadesi yanlıştır.

question_text: In a shared house, everyone must ---- the chores equally so that no one gets too tired.
explanation: Ev işlerini eşit paylaşmak ('share the chores') sorumluluk bilincinin gereğidir.

question_text:
Library Rules:
• Keep quiet.
• Return books on time.
• Don't eat or drink inside.
Which rule is NOT related to the library?
option_a: Do not disturb others while they are reading.
option_b: Bring borrowed books back before the deadline.
option_c: Avoid bringing snacks into the reading room.
option_d: Feed the animals in the garden.
explanation: Bahçedeki hayvanları beslemek kütüphane kuralları arasında yer almaz.

question_text:
Aziz Sancar is a world-famous Turkish scientist. He won the 2015 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for his studies on how cells repair damaged DNA.
According to the text, Aziz Sancar ----.
option_a: received an international award in chemistry
explanation: 2015 Nobel Kimya Ödülü uluslararası bir kimya ödülüdür.

question_text: Scientists are currently ---- a new vaccine in the laboratory to protect people from seasonal viruses.
explanation: Laboratuvarda yeni bir aşı geliştirmek 'developing a new vaccine' ifadesiyle anlatılır.

question_text: Which of the following is an INVENTION rather than a scientific discovery?
explanation: Matbaa (printing press) insan tarafından yapılmış bir icattır (invention); diğerleri doğada zaten var olan şeylerin keşfidir (discovery).

question_text:
A severe ---- hit the coastal town yesterday. Heavy rain caused the river to overflow, and water covered the streets and first floors of houses.
Which natural disaster is described in the text?
explanation: Şiddetli yağmur sonucu nehrin taşması ve sokakların su altında kalması 'flood' (sel) felaketidir.

question_text: To prevent ---- and save our forests, people should never leave glass bottles in picnic areas or light uncontrolled fires.
explanation: Cam şişe bırakmamak ve kontrolsüz ateş yakmamak orman yangınlarını ('forest fires') önler.

question_text: What should we do to reduce global warming?
option_a: Cut down more trees in the Amazon
option_b: Use renewable energy sources like solar and wind power
option_c: Use private cars for short distances
option_d: Waste water and electricity at home
explanation: Güneş ve rüzgâr gibi yenilenebilir enerji kaynaklarını kullanmak küresel ısınmayı azaltır.

question_text:
Amy: Are you doing anything tonight?
Bella: Not really. Why do you ask?
Amy: How about watching a sci-fi movie at my place?
Bella: ________. I love science fiction!

Which of the following completes the conversation?
option_a: I am sorry, I must study
explanation: Bella bilim kurguyu çok sevdiğini söylediği için teklifi kabul eden "Yeah, that sounds awesome" (Evet, kulağa harika geliyor) ifadesi diyaloğu tamamlar.

question_text:
My best friend Leo never tells lies and always keeps my secrets. I can trust him in everything.

Which adjective describes Leo best?
explanation: Asla yalan söylemeyen ve sır tutan güvenilir bir arkadaş "honest and reliable" (dürüst ve güvenilir) sıfatlarıyla tanımlanır.

question_text:
Jack: Would you like to come to our slumber party on Saturday night?
Tom: I’d love to, but I can’t. ________.

Which option gives a valid excuse for refusing the invitation?
option_a: I don’t have anything to do on Saturday
option_b: What time should I be at your house
option_c: My grandparents are visiting us that evening
option_d: Slumber parties are my favorite events
explanation: Daveti reddettikten sonra geçerli bir mazeret bildiren seçenek büyükanne ve büyükbabanın ziyarete gelecek olmasıdır.

question_text:
“A true friend always backs you up when you are in trouble.”

What does the underlined phrase mean?
explanation: "Back someone up" deyimi birini desteklemek ve zor zamanında ona yardımcı olmak ("supports and helps you") anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Sarah: Shall we go cycling by the lake this afternoon?
Nina: That’s a great idea! ________?
Sarah: Let’s meet in front of the city library at 3 p.m.

Which question does Nina ask?
option_a: How much is the concert ticket
option_b: Who is organizing the book fair
option_c: Why do you dislike riding a bike
option_d: Where and what time shall we meet
explanation: Sarah buluşma yerini ve saatini söylediğine göre Nina "Nerede ve saat kaçta buluşalım?" sorusunu sormuştur.

question_text:
Look at the personality traits below:
• Generous: likes sharing things with friends
• Tactful: careful not to hurt others’ feelings
• Laid-back: relaxed and never worries about anything
• ________: only cares about himself/herself and never shares

Which word fills in the blank?
explanation: Sadece kendini düşünen ve hiçbir şeyi paylaşmayan kişiyi tanımlayan sıfat "selfish" (bencil) kelimesidir.

question_text:
David: Hey Mark, we are organizing a bowling tournament tomorrow. Do you want to join us?
Mark: Sure! Count me in.

What does Mark mean by saying “Count me in”?
option_a: He has an important exam tomorrow.
option_d: He doesn’t know how to count.
explanation: "Count me in" (Beni de dahil edin / yazın) ifadesi bir daveti memnuniyetle kabul etmek anlamında kullanılır.

question_text:
Emma and Clara have a lot of things in common. They enjoy the same music, read similar books and never argue.

We can say that Emma and Clara ________.
option_b: get on well with each other
explanation: Ortak noktaları çok olan ve hiç tartışmayan iki arkadaş birbirleriyle iyi anlaşır ("get on well with each other").

question_text:
Waiter: Welcome to Sunshine Café! May I take your order?
Customer: Yes, please. I’d like grilled chicken with seasonal salad.
Waiter: ________?
Customer: A glass of fresh lemonade, please.

Choose the correct question for the waiter.
option_a: How would you like to pay the bill
option_b: What would you like to have for main course
option_c: Do you want to eat any soup first
option_d: Would you like anything to drink
explanation: Müşteri taze limonata istediğine göre garson "İçecek bir şey ister misiniz?" ("Would you like anything to drink?") diye sormuştur.

question_text:
Invitation Card:
“Dear classmates, we are celebrating the end of the school year at Blue Park Café on Sunday, June 18, from 2 p.m. to 6 p.m. Hope to see you all!”

Which information is NOT on the invitation card?
explanation: Davetiyede etkinliğin tarihi, yeri ve saat aralığı yer almakta; ancak katılım ücreti ("fee") belirtilmemektedir.

question_text:
Kevin: Why don’t you invite Brian to your birthday party?
Paul: Because he is very ________. He always thinks he is better and smarter than everyone else.

Which word completes Paul’s sentence?
explanation: Kendini herkesten daha iyi ve zeki gören kibirli kişiler için "arrogant" sıfatı kullanılır.

question_text:
Waiter: Would you like to have a piece of apple pie for dessert?
Melis: No, thanks. I am ________. I cannot eat anything else.

Which word best completes the response?
explanation: Başka hiçbir şey yiyemeyecek kadar tok olduğunu ifade etmek için "stuffed / full" kelimesi kullanılır.

question_text:
Alice: Are you busy on Friday afternoon?
Kate: Not at all. Why?
Alice: There is a modern art exhibition at the cultural center. Shall we go together?
Kate: Cool! I can’t miss this chance.

According to the dialogue, Kate ________.
option_a: invites Alice to a rock concert on Friday
option_b: is not interested in art exhibitions at all
option_c: is too busy to go out on Friday afternoon
option_d: accepts Alice’s offer to visit the exhibition
explanation: Kate "Harika! Bu fırsatı kaçıramam." diyerek Alice'in sergiye gitme teklifini kabul etmiştir.

question_text:
A good friend should never tell your secrets to other people. In other words, you should ________ your close friends.

Which verb completes the sentence?
explanation: "Count on" (güvenmek, bel bağlamak) fiili yakın arkadaşlara güvenmek anlamında cümleyi doğru tamamlar.

question_text:
Mother: Who is your closest friend at school, Tim?
Tim: Definitely Sam. Whenever I feel sad, he cheers me up and shares my problems.

Tim likes Sam because Sam is ________.
explanation: Üzgün olduğunda arkadaşını neşelendiren ve sorunlarını paylaşan bir kişi destekleyici ve ilgilidir ("supportive and caring").

question_text:
Lucas: Let’s play table tennis after school today!
Henry: ________, but I have a dentist appointment at 4:30 p.m.

Choose the best expression to complete Henry’s reply.
explanation: Kibarca reddederken "I’d love to, but..." (Çok isterdim ama...) kalıbı kullanılır.

question_text: Which of the following is an ACCEPTING sentence for an invitation?
option_a: Sorry, I must finish my science project.
option_b: I am afraid I can’t make it.
option_c: Maybe another time, I am busy today.
option_d: Why not? I have nothing to do then.
explanation: "Why not? I have nothing to do then." (Neden olmasın? O zaman yapacak bir işim yok.) bir kabul cümlesidir; diğerleri reddetme ifadeleridir.

question_text:
Chloe: Do you need help with picking me up for the picnic?
Dad: Don’t worry, I’ll drive you and your friends there at 10 a.m.

How will Chloe go to the picnic?
explanation: Babası "I’ll drive you" (Sizi arabayla götüreceğim) dediği için pikniğe arabayla ("by car") gidecektir.

question_text:
Look at the menu items:
• Lentil soup
• Grilled meatballs
• Chocolate pudding
• Fresh orange juice

Which item is a dessert?
explanation: Menüdeki tatlı ("dessert") seçeneği çikolatalı pudingdir ("Chocolate pudding").

question_text:
Mert: Why don’t you get on well with Jason?
Can: Because he never changes his mind even when he is wrong. He is too ________.

Which adjective completes Can’s sentence?
explanation: Haksız olduğunda bile fikrini asla değiştirmeyen inatçı kişiler için "stubborn" sıfatı kullanılır.

question_text:
FriendSunday Plan (2 p.m. - 5 p.m.)
MiaVisiting her aunt at the hospital
NoahFree all afternoon, loves outdoor activities
LiamAttending his cousin’s wedding ceremony
ZoeStudying for the math exam on Monday

Oliver invites his four friends to go trekking in the forest on Sunday afternoon. Who will accept his invitation?
explanation: Tabloya göre Pazar öğleden sonra boş olan ve açık hava etkinliklerini seven tek kişi Noah'tır; diğerlerinin mazereti vardır.

question_text:
Invitation Email:
“Hi everyone! Our school basketball team is playing the final match against West High School this Saturday at 4 p.m. at the City Sports Hall. Let’s meet at the main gate at 3:30 p.m. and cheer for our team! Please let me know if you can come until Thursday evening. — Bora”

According to the email, which of the following is CORRECT?
option_a: Invitees should inform Bora about their attendance before Friday.
option_b: The basketball game will take place in the school garden.
option_c: The match starts at half past three on Saturday afternoon.
option_d: Bora is one of the players in the West High School team.
explanation: Bora Perşembe akşamına kadar ("until Thursday evening") haber verilmesini istediği için davetliler Cuma gününden önce katılım durumlarını bildirmelidir.

question_text:
Read the four students’ comments about friendship:
• Arda: “A buddy should always tell the truth even if it is hard.”
• Beren: “Close friends must have similar hobbies and interests.”
• Cem: “True friends never leave you alone when you need help.”
• Duru: “Good friends respect each other’s secrets.”

Who thinks sharing common interests is essential in friendship?
explanation: Yakın arkadaşların benzer hobi ve ilgi alanlarına ("similar hobbies and interests") sahip olması gerektiğini söyleyen Beren'dir.

question_text:
Waiter: Good evening! Are you ready to order?
Julia: Yes. I’d like tomato soup first. For the main course, I want baked salmon.
Waiter: Would you like a green salad with your fish?
Julia: Sure. And a bottle of mineral water, please. No dessert for me.

Which of the following did Julia NOT order?
option_a: A starter before the main course
option_b: A sweet dish after the meal
explanation: Julia "No dessert for me" diyerek yemekten sonra tatlı ("a sweet dish") istemediğini belirtmiştir.

question_text:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "What Matters Most in a Close Friend? (100 Teens)" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "45%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Honesty" size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 76.7 P d1 119.9 76.7 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 70.7 "30%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Being support." size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 123.3 P d2 188.4 123.3 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 117.3 "15%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Being amusing" size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 138.9 P d3 256.9 138.9 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 132.9 "10%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Sharing hobbi." size=10 ```
According to the survey results above, which statement is TRUE?
option_a: Nearly half of the teenagers value telling the truth most.
option_b: Being supportive is the least popular trait among teens.
option_c: Making jokes is more important than helping friends in trouble.
option_d: Most teenagers prefer friends who have the same hobbies.
explanation: Grafikte dürüstlük ("Honesty") %45 ile ilk sıradadır; yani gençlerin yaklaşık yarısı doğruyu söylemeye en çok değer vermektedir.

question_text:
Selin: I’m going to the book fair with Ece tomorrow morning. Would you like to join us?
Defne: I’d love to, sounds great! Should I bring anything?
Selin: Just your student ID card because admission is free for students.

Why does Defne need her student ID card?
option_a: To register for an online writing competition
option_b: To buy discounted train tickets for the trip
option_c: To enter the book fair without paying any money
option_d: To borrow textbooks from the school library
explanation: Selin öğrencilere girişin ücretsiz olduğunu ("admission is free for students") söylediği için öğrenci kimliği ücret ödemeden girmek için gereklidir.

question_text:
Teacher: Imagine one of your classmates invites you to a concert on Sunday, but you promised your mother to help her with gardening. Refuse the invitation politely and give your excuse.

Which student gives the most appropriate answer?
option_a: “I’m sorry I can’t. I must study for my English project all day.”
option_b: “Awesome! What time shall we meet in front of the concert hall?”
option_c: “No, I don’t want to come because concerts are too noisy.”
option_d: “That sounds fun, but I have to help my mom in the garden.”
explanation: Verilen duruma uygun olarak hem kibarca reddeden hem de bahçe işlerinde annesine yardım etme mazeretini doğru belirten ilk seçenektir.

question_text:
Read the sentences of a phone conversation:
I. Let’s meet at the bus stop at 1:30 p.m. then.
II. Hi Kerem, are you free this Saturday afternoon?
III. Sounds great! What time shall we meet?
IV. Yes, I don’t have any plans. Why do you ask?
V. I have two tickets for the robotics exhibition. Shall we go together?

What is the correct order of the dialogue?
explanation: Diyalog önce müsaitlik sorusuyla (II) başlar, Kerem planı olmadığını söyler (IV), sergi teklifi yapılır (V), kabul edilip saat sorulur (III) ve buluşma saati söylenir (I).

question_text:
Poster:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "Class 8-A Reunion Picnic" size=9 bold text 170 46 "Green Valley Park" size=9 text 170 68 "Sunday, May 21" size=9 text 170 90 "11:00 a.m. - 4:00 p.m." size=9 text 170 112 "Fee: 50 TL per person" size=9 text 170 134 "Contact: Mr. Demir (0555-010-2030)" size=9``` Which question does NOT have an answer on the poster?
option_a: What kind of food and drinks will be served at the picnic?
option_b: How much does each student need to pay for the event?
option_c: How long will the reunion picnic last on Sunday?
option_d: Who can students call to get more information?
explanation: Afişte yer, tarih, saat aralığı, kişi başı ücret ve iletişim kurulacak kişi yazılıdır; ancak hangi yiyecek ve içeceklerin sunulacağı belirtilmemiştir.

question_text:
Alp: What do you think about the new student, Emre?
Kaan: Well, he is very ________. Yesterday he bought sandwiches for a stray dog and helped me carry my heavy project boxes.

Which pair of adjectives best completes Kaan’s description?
explanation: Sokak köpeğini besleyen ve arkadaşının ağır kutularını taşımasına yardım eden biri nazik ve yardımseverdir ("kind and helpful").

question_text:
Derya: I invited Sinem, Burcu and Hale to watch a comedy movie at home tonight.
• Sinem said she never misses comedy films.
• Burcu said she had to look after her little brother.
• Hale asked me if she should bring some popcorn.

Who will be at Derya’s house tonight?
explanation: Sinem ve Hale daveti kabul etmiş, Burcu ise kardeşine bakması gerektiği için reddetmiştir. Evde Derya, Sinem ve Hale olacaktır.

question_text:
“Whenever we have a group project, Mert wants everything to be done only his way and never listens to our ideas. However, he never tells lies and always finishes his tasks on time.”

According to the text, Mert is ________.
explanation: Kendi dediğinde diretmesi onun "stubborn" (inatçı), yalan söylememesi ve görevini zamanında bitirmesi ise "honest and responsible" olduğunu gösterir.

question_text:
Ceren’s Weekly Planner:
• Monday: Violin lesson (16:00 - 17:30)
• Wednesday: Swimming training (15:30 - 17:00)
• Friday: Free after school
• Saturday: Family dinner at grandparents’ house (18:00)

Ezgi wants to invite Ceren to a theatre play that starts at 4 p.m. on a weekday. Which day is suitable for both of them?
explanation: Hafta içi ("on a weekday") saat 16:00'da Ceren'in boş olduğu tek gün Cuma ("Friday") günüdür.

question_text:
Linda: Are you coming to Betty’s farewell party tonight?
Susan: Yes, definitely. She is moving to London next week, so I want to give her a photo album of our memories.
Linda: That’s a wonderful gift! Do you know where the party is?
Susan: At Star Café on Oak Street.

Why is Betty throwing a party?
option_a: Because she just graduated from university in London
option_b: Because she won first prize in a photography contest
option_c: Because she is saying goodbye before moving to another city
option_d: Because she is celebrating her fourteenth birthday
explanation: "Farewell party" veda partisidir; Betty gelecek hafta Londra'ya taşınacağı için arkadaşlarına veda etmektedir.

question_text: Which of the following matching between the phrase and its function is WRONG?
option_a: “I have to visit my dentist.” → Making an excuse
option_b: “Would you like to join us?” → Making an invitation
option_d: “I’m sorry, but I can’t make it.” → Accepting an offer
explanation: "I’m sorry, but I can’t make it." (Üzgünüm ama gelemem) bir teklifi kabul etme değil, reddetme ("refusing") ifadesidir.

question_text:
Customer: Excuse me, may I look at the menu?
Waiter: Here you are, sir.
Customer: Hmm, I don’t eat red meat or chicken. What do you recommend for the main course?
Waiter: Our ________ is delicious and very fresh today.

Which food can the waiter suggest?
option_a: fried chicken wings with spicy sauce
option_b: grilled sea bass with steamed vegetables
explanation: Müşteri kırmızı et ve tavuk yemediğini belirttiği için garson balık ve sebzeden oluşan "grilled sea bass with steamed vegetables" önerebilir.

question_text:
Read the messages in the WhatsApp group about Tuna’s invitation:
• Tuna: “Hey guys! My dad bought tickets for the Science & Space Fair on Saturday at 1 p.m. I have 3 extra tickets. Who wants to come with me?”
• Efe: “I’m crazy about astronomy! I wouldn’t miss it for the world.”
• Sarp: “Sounds cool, Tuna. I have football practice from 10 a.m. to 11:30 a.m., so I can easily join you at 1 p.m.”
• Kuzey: “Thanks for inviting me, mate, but my cousin is arriving from İzmir at 12:30 p.m. and we will pick him up at the airport.”
• Doruk: “I’d love to come! Where shall we meet before the fair?”

According to the messages above, which of the following is CORRECT?
option_a: All three extra tickets will be used by Efe, Sarp and Doruk.
option_b: Kuzey accepts the invitation and asks about the meeting place.
option_c: Tuna still has one extra ticket left because two friends refused.
option_d: Sarp refuses the offer because of his football training.
explanation: Efe, Sarp (antrenmanı 11:30'da bittiği için 13:00'e yetişebiliyor) ve Doruk teklifi kabul etmiş, sadece Kuzey mazeret bildirerek reddetmiştir. Böylece 3 fazladan biletin tamamı kullanılacaktır.

question_text:
Menu CategoryDish OptionsPrice
SoupsTomato Soup / Chicken Soup60 TL
Main CoursesGrilled Meatballs (180 TL) / Vegetable Pasta (140 TL)140 - 180 TL
SaladsMediterranean Salad / Shepherd’s Salad70 TL
DessertsCheesecake (90 TL) / Rice Pudding (70 TL)70 - 90 TL

Pelin has 280 TL. She is a vegetarian (she never eats meat or chicken). She wants to order a soup, a main course, and a dessert. Which menu combination can Pelin choose?
option_a: Chicken Soup + Vegetable Pasta + Rice Pudding
option_b: Tomato Soup + Vegetable Pasta + Rice Pudding
option_d: Tomato Soup + Grilled Meatballs + Rice Pudding
explanation: Pelin vejetaryen olduğu için Tomato Soup (60 TL) ve Vegetable Pasta (140 TL) seçmelidir (toplam 200 TL). Kalan 80 TL bütçesiyle Cheesecake (90 TL) alamaz, Rice Pudding (70 TL) alabilir (toplam 270 TL ≤ 280 TL).

question_text:
Read the four personality profiles:
• Profile 1 (Aylin): She always shares her lunch, lends her books and buys small gifts for her classmates.
• Profile 2 (Berk): He tells everyone’s secrets to other students behind their backs.
• Profile 3 (Cansu): She carefully chooses her words so that nobody feels offended or sad.
• Profile 4 (Deniz): He never gets panicked before exams and always stays calm.

Which option correctly matches all four students with their personality traits?
option_a: Aylin: Generous — Berk: Loyal — Cansu: Arrogant — Deniz: Laid-back
option_b: Aylin: Selfish — Berk: Sneaky — Cansu: Tactful — Deniz: Jealous
option_c: Aylin: Generous — Berk: Sneaky — Cansu: Tactful — Deniz: Laid-back
option_d: Aylin: Tactful — Berk: Honest — Cansu: Generous — Deniz: Stubborn
explanation: Paylaşmayı seven Aylin "Generous", arkadan sır ifşa eden Berk "Sneaky", kimseyi kırmamaya dikkat eden Cansu "Tactful", hiç panik yapmayan Deniz ise "Laid-back" sıfatıyla eşleşir.

question_text:
Read the email below:
“Dear Ms. Carter,
On behalf of the 8th-grade students, we would like to invite you to our graduation dinner at Olive Garden Restaurant on Friday, June 14, at 7 p.m. You have always supported us for four years, and your presence will make us very happy. Please let us know if you can attend by Wednesday.
Sincerely, Elif Yılmaz”

We can understand from the email that ________.
option_a: the graduation dinner will take place at the school cafeteria
option_b: Ms. Carter is organizing a party for her 8th-grade students
option_c: the guests must reply to the invitation on Friday evening
option_d: Elif is the sender and Ms. Carter is the invitee of the event
explanation: E-postayı yazan (gönderen / sender) Elif Yılmaz, davet edilen kişi (invitee / receiver) ise öğretmenleri Ms. Carter'dır.

question_text:
Four friends are talking about what they expect from an ideal friend:
• Gökhan: “I can forgive mistakes, but I can never be friends with someone who lies to me.”
• Selma: “My best friend should cheer me up and make me laugh when we hang out.”
• Tarık: “An ideal friend must stand by me in difficult times, not only on happy days.”
• Yeliz: “I prefer friends who don’t get angry easily and respect different opinions.”

According to the statements above, who places the greatest emphasis on loyalty and support during hard times?
explanation: Zor zamanlarda yanında durulmasını ("stand by me in difficult times") vurgulayan Tarık, sadakat ve desteğe ("loyalty and support") en çok önem veren kişidir.

question_text:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Why Teenagers Refuse Their Friends’ Invitations" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "40%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Having anothe." size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 82.5 P d1 119.9 82.5 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 76.5 "25%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Studying for ." size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 100.0 P d2 188.4 100.0 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 94.0 "20%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Helping paren." size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 117.5 P d3 256.9 117.5 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 111.5 "15%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Feeling ill /." size=10 ```
Which of the following excuses belongs to the SECOND most common reason in the chart above?
option_a: “Sorry, I promised my aunt to attend her birthday dinner tonight.”
option_b: “I’d love to come, but I have to revise for my science test tomorrow.”
option_c: “I’m afraid I can’t. I need to help my dad wash the car.”
option_d: “Thanks for asking, but I have a terrible headache right now.”
explanation: Grafikteki en yaygın ikinci neden %25 ile sınavlara çalışmaktır ("Studying for exams"). Fen sınavına hazırlanma mazereti bu kategoriye aittir.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Nora: Hi Vicky! Are you coming to Leo’s surprise birthday party at 5 p.m.?
Vicky: Oh, nobody told me about it! Where is it?
Nora: At Leo’s cousin’s café near the train station. Remember, it’s a top secret! Don’t say anything to Leo.
Vicky: Don’t worry, my lips are sealed! I’ll be there at 4:45 p.m.

What does Vicky mean by saying “my lips are sealed”?
option_a: She doesn’t know how to go to the train station.
option_b: She refuses to come because she wasn’t invited early.
option_c: She promises to keep the party as a secret.
option_d: She will call Leo immediately to congratulate him.
explanation: "My lips are sealed" (Ağzım mühürlü / Sırrın bende güvende) deyimi partiyi sır olarak saklayacağına söz verdiği anlamına gelir.

question_text:
PersonPersonalityFavorite Activity
MelihAdventurous, energetic, outgoingRock climbing & cycling
NehirCalm, shy, bookwormReading novels at library
OzanSelfish, bad-tempered, aggressivePlaying solo video games
PınarTactful, supportive, energeticNature walks & cycling

Melih is looking for a close friend who shares his active lifestyle and has a positive personality. According to the table, who can get on best with Melih?
explanation: Melih hem aktif yaşam tarzını (doğa yürüyüşü ve bisiklet) paylaşan hem de olumlu karakter özelliklerine (düşünceli, destekleyici, enerjik) sahip Pınar ile en iyi anlaşır.

question_text:
Waiter: Welcome to Royal Restaurant! May I take your order?
Mr. Green: I’ll start with a bowl of mushroom soup, and then I’ll have grilled steak with rice.
Mrs. Green: I’d just like a Caesar salad with grilled chicken and a glass of apple juice, please.
Waiter: Would you like to order any desserts now?
Mr. Green: Maybe after we finish our meals, thank you.

Which of the following is TRUE according to the conversation?
option_a: Neither Mr. Green nor Mrs. Green ordered a dessert at the beginning.
option_b: Both Mr. Green and Mrs. Green ordered soup as a starter.
option_c: Mrs. Green didn’t order any beverage with her salad.
option_d: Mr. Green prefers white meat to red meat for his main course.
explanation: Bay Green tatlıyı yemekleri bittikten sonra düşünebileceklerini söylediği için başlangıçta ikisi de tatlı sipariş etmemiştir.

question_text:
Read the poem about friendship:
“We don’t need to agree on every single thing,
Or listen to the same songs that pop stars sing.
When clouds turn dark and everyone walks away,
A real friend is the one who chooses to stay.”

What is the main message of the poem?
option_a: People cannot be close friends if they don’t listen to the same kind of music.
option_b: True friendship is about being loyal in bad times rather than having the same tastes.
option_c: Friends only spend time together when the weather is sunny and warm.
option_d: Good friends should never have different opinions on any topic.
explanation: Şiirde her konuda aynı fikirde olmanın veya aynı şarkıları dinlemenin şart olmadığı, gerçek dostun herkes gittiğinde (zor zamanlarda) yanında kalan kişi olduğu vurgulanmaktadır.

question_text:
Situation: Your classmate, Burak, invites you to play basketball on Sunday morning. You really want to play basketball with him, but Sunday morning is not possible because of your guitar course (09:30 - 11:30). However, you are completely free after 1 p.m.

Which reply both explains your excuse and offers an alternative time?
option_a: “Sorry, I hate playing basketball. Why don’t we go to a guitar concert on Sunday morning?”
option_b: “I’m afraid I can’t make it on Sunday because I am busy all day long.”
option_c: “I’d love to, Burak, but I have a guitar lesson in the morning. How about playing at 2 p.m.?”
option_d: “That sounds awesome! Let’s meet at the basketball court at 10 o’clock on Sunday morning.”
explanation: Hem sabahki gitar kursu mazeretini açıklayan hem de öğleden sonra saat 14:00 için alternatif teklif sunan yanıt ilk seçenektir.

question_text:
Read the text:
“Sam and Peter have been classmates since primary school. Sam always keeps his word and never shares Peter’s secrets with anyone. However, Peter often forgets his promises and only calls Sam when he needs help with his homework.”

Which of the following can we conclude from the text?
option_a: Peter backs Sam up whenever Sam has a problem at school.
option_b: Sam is a sneaky person who tells Peter’s secrets to other classmates.
option_c: Both Sam and Peter are very supportive and loyal to each other.
option_d: Sam is a trustworthy friend, whereas Peter is self-centered and unreliable.
explanation: Sözünü tutan ve sır saklayan Sam güvenilir ("trustworthy"), sözlerini unutup sadece işi düştüğünde arayan Peter ise çıkarcı ve güvenilmezdir ("self-centered and unreliable").

question_text:
Look at the visual invitation card below:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "Sunset Acoustic Concert" size=9 bold text 170 46 "City Amphitheatre" size=9 text 170 68 "Saturday, August 12 at 20:00" size=9 text 170 90 "Ticket: 100 TL (Students: 50% off)" size=9 text 170 112 "Free shuttle bus from Town Square at 19:15" size=9 text 170 134 "RSVP: info@sunsetmusic.org" size=9``` Three 8th-grade students want to go to the concert together. They will take the shuttle bus from Town Square. How much will they pay in total for the concert tickets and transportation?
explanation: Bilet 100 TL, öğrencilere %50 indirimli olduğundan öğrenci başı 50 TL'dir. 3 öğrenci bilet için 3 × 50 = 150 TL öder. Servis otobüsü ("free shuttle bus") ücretsiz olduğu için toplam ödeme 150 TL'dir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Eda: Did you invite Sevgi to our study group on Thursday?
Mine: Yes, I did, but she turned it down.
Eda: Really? Why?
Mine: Her elder sister is graduating from university that day, and the whole family is attending the ceremony.

In the dialogue above, the phrase “turned it down” means ________.
explanation: "Turn down" deyimsel fiili bir teklifi veya daveti geri çevirmek, reddetmek ("refuse") anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Four students wrote notes on their friend Kaan’s yearbook:
• Aslı: “Thank you for never leaving me alone when I broke my leg last winter.”
• Bora: “You never told anyone what I shared with you in confidence.”
• Cemre: “Your jokes always made our boring Mondays super fun!”
• Demir: “You always shared your notes and books with the whole class.”

Whose note shows that Kaan is an amusing friend?
explanation: "Amusing" eğlenceli ve komik demektir. Kaan'ın şakalarının sıkıcı Pazartesileri çok eğlenceli hale getirdiğini söyleyen Cemre'dir.

question_text:
Read the three responses to an invitation:
• Response 1: “I’d love to join you, what time does it start?”
• Response 2: “Sounds great! I’ll definitely be there after my piano lesson.”
• Response 3: “That would be awesome, ______.”

If only two people are attending the event, how should Response 3 end?
option_a: so tell me the exact address of the bowling alley
option_b: count me in for the tournament on Sunday
option_c: and I can bring some homemade cookies for everyone
option_d: but I have to help my father at his shop all day
explanation: 1. ve 2. yanıtlar daveti kabul etmektedir. Etkinliğe sadece iki kişinin katılması için 3. yanıtın "but..." ile devam ederek bir mazeretle reddetmesi gerekir.

question_text:
Tina: I want to buy a book for my best friend, Rose. She loves reading biographies of honest and brave historical leaders, and she hates fantasy or horror stories.

Which book should Tina buy for Rose?
option_a: The Life of Courageous Pioneers: True Stories of Integrity
option_b: Dragons of the Magic Forest: The Secret Spell
option_c: Cooking Delicious Italian Pasta in 20 Minutes
option_d: Monsters in the Dark Castle: A Midnight Nightmare
explanation: Rose dürüst ("integrity/honest") ve cesur ("courageous/brave") tarihi liderlerin gerçek yaşam öykülerini (biyografilerini) sevdiği için ilk kitap ona en uygun seçimdir.

question_text:
Look at the table showing four friends’ food preferences:
NameLikesDislikes
HakanRed meat, pastaFish, spicy food
İremChicken, green saladRed meat, onion
KayaFish, grilled vegetablesChicken, fast food
LaleVegetable soup, pastaMeat, fish, chicken

Hakan and Lale are going to have lunch together. They want to order the same main course that both of them enjoy. What should they order?
option_b: Pasta with cheese and tomato sauce
explanation: Tabloya göre hem Hakan'ın hem de vejetaryen olan Lale'nin sevdiği ortak ana yemek makarnadır ("pasta").

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Pam: Why are you upset with Jenny?
Sue: She promised to help me prepare the posters for the science exhibition today, but she went to the shopping mall with her cousin without even calling me!
Pam: Oh, that’s terrible. You can’t rely on her.

Why is Sue angry with Jenny?
option_a: Because Jenny told Sue’s secrets to her cousin at the mall
option_b: Because Jenny didn’t like the posters Sue prepared for the fair
option_c: Because Jenny broke her promise and left Sue alone with the work
option_d: Because Jenny invited Sue to the shopping mall on a busy day
explanation: Jenny posterleri hazırlamaya yardım edeceğine söz vermesine rağmen haber bile vermeden kuzeniyle alışveriş merkezine gittiği (sözünü tutmadığı) için Sue ona kızgındır.

question_text:
Invitation Message:
“Hi Alex! We’re having a barbecue party in our backyard this Sunday at 1 p.m. My dad is grilling burgers and sausages. Bring your swimming shorts too because we have a pool! Hope you can make it. — Ryan”

Which of the following is FALSE according to the message?
option_a: The invitees can swim during the party on Sunday.
option_b: Ryan is the host and Alex is the invitee of the barbecue party.
option_c: The event will take place outdoors at Ryan’s house.
option_d: The guests need to bring their own food and meat to the party.
explanation: Ryan'ın babası hamburger ve sosis ızgara yapacağı için konukların kendi yiyeceklerini getirmelerine gerek yoktur; sadece şortlarını getirmeleri istenmiştir.

question_text:
Examine the Venn diagram about two best friends, Mert and Can:
• Mert only: Adventurous, loves cycling, hates board games
• Both Mert and Can: Honest, supportive, crazy about sci-fi movies
• Can only: Calm, enjoys playing chess, dislikes extreme sports

Which activity is the BEST choice for Mert and Can to do together at the weekend?
option_a: Going to the cinema to watch a new movie about space travel
option_b: Joining a mountain biking race in the forest
option_c: Playing a chess tournament at the school club
option_d: Trying paragliding from a high mountain
explanation: İkisinin ortak noktası bilim kurgu filmlerine bayılmalarıdır ("crazy about sci-fi movies"). Bu nedenle uzay yolculuğu konulu yeni bir filme gitmek ikisi için en uygun etkinliktir.

question_text:
Waiter: How would you like your steak, madam?
Customer: Well-done, please. And could you bring the salad without any dressing or oil?
Waiter: Certainly. Anything else?
Customer: Just a glass of water. I’m on a strict diet.

We can understand from the dialogue that the customer ________.
option_a: prefers fizzy drinks to water during her meal
option_b: pays attention to eating low-calorie food without extra sauce
option_c: wants her meat to be cooked for a very short time
option_d: orders a high-calorie dessert after her steak
explanation: Sıkı bir diyette olan müşteri salatasını sossuz/yağsız ve içecek olarak sadece su istediği için fazladan sos içermeyen düşük kalorili beslenmeye dikkat etmektedir.

question_text:
Choose the sentence that does NOT fit the paragraph:
(I) My best friend Clara and I have a great relationship. (II) We always back each other up and share our deepest secrets safely. (III) She is so sneaky and arrogant that nobody in our class wants to talk to her. (IV) I hope our friendship lasts forever because she is like a sister to me.
explanation: Paragrafta en yakın arkadaş Clara ile olan harika dostluk anlatılırken, III. cümlede onun sinsi ve kibirli olduğu söylenerek anlam bütünlüğü bozulmuştur.

question_text:
Read the notes on the fridge:
• Note 1 (Mom to Leo): “Leo, your friend Max called. He invited you to play bowling at 3 p.m. today. Call him back until 1 p.m.”
• Note 2 (Leo to Mom): “Mom, I talked to Max and accepted his offer. I’ll be back home before dinner at 6 p.m.”

According to the notes, which of the following is CORRECT?
option_a: Mom refused Max’s invitation because Leo had homework.
option_b: Leo and Max will have dinner together at the bowling alley.
option_c: Max came to Leo’s house at 1 p.m. to talk to Leo’s mother.
option_d: Leo called Max back and agreed to go bowling with him.
explanation: İkinci notta Leo'nun Max ile konuştuğu, teklifini kabul ettiği ("accepted his offer") ve akşam yemeğinden önce saat 18:00'de evde olacağı belirtilmektedir.

question_text:
Alex: How often do you go camping with your family?
Brian: ________. We always set up our tent in May and September.

Which frequency expression completes the dialogue?
explanation: Mayıs ve Eylül aylarında olmak üzere yılda iki kez çadır kurdukları için "Twice a year" (Yılda iki kez) ifadesi doğrudur.

question_text:
I really love listening to classical music because I find it very ________ and peaceful.

Which adjective fits the sentence best?
explanation: Klasik müziği huzurlu ("peaceful") bulduğuna göre onu dinlendirici/rahatlatıcı ("relaxing") olarak nitelendirmektedir.

question_text:
Cem: What kind of books do you like reading?
Ebru: I’m fond of ________ books. I love learning about different countries, cities and cultures.

Which word completes Ebru’s answer?
explanation: Farklı ülkeler, şehirler ve kültürler hakkında bilgi edinmeyi seven biri seyahat ("travel") kitaplarını sever.

question_text:
“Teenagers often wear casual clothes in their daily lives because they don’t want to look snob; they just want to feel comfortable.”

In this context, a “snob” person is someone who ________.
option_a: enjoys doing outdoor sports like trekking and camping
option_b: helps poor people and animals in the neighborhood
option_c: is always very polite and humble towards everyone
option_d: looks down on others and thinks he/she is superior
explanation: "Snob" (züppe / burnu havada) başkalarını küçümseyen ve kendisini üstün gören kişi anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Lily: Do you listen to heavy metal music?
Grace: No, never! To be honest, I ________ it. It is too noisy for me.

Which expression completes the blank?
explanation: Asla dinlemediğini ve kendisi için çok gürültülü olduğunu söylediğine göre ona tahammül edememektedir ("can’t stand").

question_text:
Look at the camping equipment list:
• Tent
• Sleeping bag
• Torch / Flashlight
• ________ (to find our way in the forest)

Which item completes the list according to the clue in brackets?
explanation: Ormanda yönümüzü bulmak için kullanılan kamp ekipmanı pusuladır ("Compass").

question_text:
Sam: What do you usually do after dinner on weekdays?
Nick: I ________ for an hour, and then I read a few pages of my novel before sleeping.

Which daily routine completes the sentence?
explanation: Akşam yemeğinden sonra yapılan rutin ödev yapmaktır ("do my homework"); uyanmak, kahvaltı etmek ve okula gitmek sabah rutinleridir.

question_text:
“I prefer ________ chess to ________ video games because chess improves my concentration.”

Which option fills in the blanks grammatically?
explanation: "Prefer + V-ing + to + V-ing" kuralına göre her iki boşluğa da "-ing" almış "playing / playing" gelmelidir.

question_text:
Helen: What do you think about wearing trendy clothes?
Mandy: I think following fashion all the time is ________. I only buy clothes that suit me.

Which negative adjective fits Mandy’s opinion?
explanation: Modayı sürekli takip etmeyi gereksiz bulup sadece kendine yakışanı aldığını söylediğine göre olumsuz anlamlı "ridiculous" (saçma/gülünç) sıfatı uygundur.

question_text:
Coach: Why do you want to join the archery club, Mete?
Mete: Because archery is a traditional sport and I find it very ________.

Which positive adjective completes the sentence?
explanation: Okçuluk kulübüne katılmak isteyen biri bu sporu heyecan verici ("exciting") bulduğu için tercih eder.

question_text:
Paul: Does your brother get up early at weekends?
Rita: No, he ________ gets up before 10:30 a.m. on Saturdays and Sundays.

Choose the correct frequency adverb.
explanation: "No" ile başladığı için olumsuz anlam taşıyan "hardly ever" (neredeyse hiç) sıklık zarfı cümleyi doğru tamamlar.

question_text:
Look at the words below:
• Terrific = Great / Wonderful
• Keen on = Interested in / Fond of
• ________ = Normal / Usual / Everyday

Which word matches the third definition?
explanation: Normal, sıradan ve günlük anlamına gelen kelime "Ordinary"dir.

question_text:
Zeynep: How do you usually go to school?
Arda: My house is very close to the school, so I always go there ________.

Which expression completes Arda’s sentence?
explanation: Evi okula çok yakın olduğu için okula her zaman yürüyerek ("on foot") gitmektedir.

question_text:
Reporter: What is your favorite free time activity?
Teenager: I love spending time in nature. Pitching a tent, sitting around a campfire and singing songs with my friends make me happy.

Which activity is the teenager talking about?
explanation: Çadır kurmak ("pitching a tent") ve kamp ateşi etrafında oturmak kampçılık ("Camping") etkinliğini anlatır.

question_text:
Burcu: Do you like reading biographical books?
Seda: Yes! Learning about the real life stories of famous scientists is very ________.

Which word completes Seda’s sentence?
explanation: Seda biyografi kitaplarını sevdiğini söylediğine göre ünlü bilim insanlarının gerçek hayat hikayelerini ilginç ("interesting") bulmaktadır.

question_text:
Father: Don’t forget to pack your ________ before going to the camp. It gets very dark in the woods at night.

Which word completes the warning?
explanation: Ormanda geceleri çok karanlık olduğu için yanına el feneri ("torch") alması hatırlatılmaktadır.

question_text:
Mert: Who is your favorite singer?
Ege: Barış Manço! He has a great ________ and his songs are still popular among young people.

Which word fits the blank?
explanation: Bir şarkıcının harika bir sesi ("voice") olduğundan bahsedilir.

question_text:
I always wash my face and brush my teeth ________ I get out of bed in the morning.

Which conjunction completes the sentence logically?
explanation: Sabah yataktan kalktıktan sonra ("after") yüz yıkamak ve diş fırçalamak mantıksal sıralamaya uygundur.

question_text:
Clara: Are you interested in board games?
Tina: Not really. I prefer ________ sports like rollerblading and cycling in the park.

Which word completes Tina’s preference?
explanation: Parkta paten kaymak ve bisiklete binmek açık hava ("outdoor") sporlarıdır.

question_text:
Jack: What time does your school start?
Liam: At 8:30 a.m., so I always leave home at ________ to be at school on time.

Which time makes the sentence logical?
explanation: Okul sabah 8:30'da başladığına göre zamanında okulda olmak için evden sabah 8:00'de ("8:00 a.m.") çıkması mantıklıdır.

question_text:
ActivityElifKaanMerveTuna
Listening to pop musicAlwaysNeverOftenSometimes
Going campingSeldomUsuallyAlwaysNever
Reading detective booksOftenAlwaysRarelyUsually
Playing basketballNeverOftenSometimesAlways

According to the table above, which of the following is CORRECT?
option_a: Elif prefers playing team sports to listening to pop music.
option_b: Kaan and Merve both enjoy spending time in nature with a tent.
option_c: Merve reads detective books more frequently than Kaan.
option_d: Tuna goes camping more often than Kaan and Merve.
explanation: Tabloya göre Kaan ("Usually") ve Merve ("Always") kampa gitmeyi sevmektedir; bu nedenle ikisinin de doğada çadırla vakit geçirmekten hoşlandığı doğrudur.

question_text:
Read the paragraph about Buse’s daily routine:
“Buse is an 8th-grade student. On weekdays, she gets up at 7:00 a.m. and has a healthy breakfast with her parents. Her classes start at 8:20 a.m. and finish at 3:10 p.m. After school, she attends archery training on Tuesdays and Thursdays. In the evenings, she revises her lessons for two hours and goes to bed at 10:30 p.m.”

How many days a week does Buse practice archery?
explanation: Metinde Buse'nin Salı ve Perşembe günleri ("on Tuesdays and Thursdays") okçuluk antrenmanına katıldığı belirtildiği için haftada 2 gün antrenman yapmaktadır.

question_text:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Book Preferences of 8th Grade Students" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "35%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Fantasy novels" size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 50.0 P d1 119.9 50.0 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 44.0 "30%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Detective sto." size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 90.0 P d2 188.4 90.0 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 84.0 "20%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Science books" size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 110.0 P d3 256.9 110.0 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 104.0 "15%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Biographies" size=10 ```
Which of the following is FALSE according to the chart?
option_a: Detective stories are the second favorite book genre.
option_b: More than half of the students prefer either fantasy or detective books.
option_c: Science books are more popular among students than biographies.
option_d: Reading about famous people’s lives is the most popular choice.
explanation: Ünlü insanların hayatlarını konu alan biyografiler (%15) en popüler değil, en az tercih edilen kitap türüdür.

question_text:
Look at four teenagers’ opinions about music genres:
• Deniz: “Rap music is energetic and the fast lyrics are impressive.”
• Eren: “I can’t stand heavy metal; it gives me a headache.”
• Filiz: “Folk music reflects our traditions and sounds very sincere.”
• Gül: “Classical music is too slow and boring for me.”

Who expresses a POSITIVE opinion about music?
explanation: Deniz rap müziği enerjik ve etkileyici bulurken, Filiz halk müziğini samimi bulmaktadır. Eren ve Gül ise olumsuz görüş bildirmiştir.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Oliver: What do you usually do on Sunday mornings, Jack?
Jack: I go jogging by the seaside with my dog, and then I buy fresh bagels for breakfast.
Oliver: Really? How nice! Do you ever play computer games on Sundays?
Jack: No, I prefer spending my weekend outdoors.

According to the dialogue, Jack ________.
option_a: dislikes walking animals or doing physical exercise
option_b: has an active and healthy Sunday morning routine
option_c: never eats breakfast with his family at the weekend
option_d: spends all Sunday playing online games in his room
explanation: Pazar sabahları sahilde köpeğiyle koşuya çıkıp açık havada vakit geçirmeyi tercih eden Jack'in aktif ve sağlıklı bir rutini vardır.

question_text:
Camp Rules Poster:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "Youth Nature Camp Rules" size=9 bold text 170 46 "1. Pitch your tent before sunset (19:00)" size=9 text 170 68 "2. Never light a campfire near the trees" size=9 text 170 90 "3. Put out the fire completely before sleeping" size=9 text 170 112 "4. Keep your food inside closed boxes" size=9 text 170 134 "5. Respect wildlife and don’t leave any trash" size=9``` Which teenager obeys the camp rules above?
option_a: Bora lights a big fire right under a pine tree to stay warm.
option_b: Sude arrives at the campsite at 9 p.m. and sets up her tent in the dark.
option_c: Can leaves his leftover sandwiches on the grass for wild bears.
option_d: Emir pours water on the campfire to extinguish it before going into his tent.
explanation: 3. kuralda uyumadan önce ateşin tamamen söndürülmesi ("Put out the fire completely before sleeping") istenmektedir; Emir ateşin üstüne su dökerek bu kurala uymuştur.

question_text:
Teacher: How often do you read a newspaper or news magazine, kids?
• Ali: “Every morning at breakfast.”
• Bora: “Once a week, on Sundays.”
• Cem: “Three times a week.”
• Doğa: “I never read printed news; I check news websites.”

Put the students in order from the one who reads printed news MOST frequently to LEAST frequently.
explanation: Her sabah okuyan Ali (haftada 7), haftada 3 kez okuyan Cem, haftada 1 kez okuyan Bora ve hiç basılı haber okumayan Doğa sıralaması: Ali - Cem - Bora - Doğa şeklindedir.

question_text:
Read the text:
“Most teenagers today care a lot about peer approval. They wear clothes that are popular on social media and listen to trending songs just to fit in with their school groups. However, psychologists say teens should discover their own talents and interests instead of copying others.”

What is the main advice given to teenagers in the text?
option_a: They should only listen to songs that their classmates share on social media.
option_b: They must buy the most expensive and trendy clothes to be popular at school.
option_c: They should be themselves and develop their own hobbies rather than imitating others.
option_d: They need to spend more time on social media to learn about fashion trends.
explanation: Metnin sonunda gençlerin başkalarını kopyalamak yerine kendi yetenek ve ilgi alanlarını keşfetmeleri ("discover their own talents and interests instead of copying others") tavsiye edilmektedir.

question_text:
Selim: I want to buy a concert ticket for my sister, Ayla. She is crazy about slow, relaxing jazz music, and she hates loud rock or techno concerts. Also, she has a French course until 6 p.m. on Saturday.

Which Saturday concert ticket should Selim buy for Ayla?
option_a: Thunder Rock Festival — Starts at 8:00 p.m.
option_b: Blue Note Jazz Night — Starts at 7:30 p.m.
option_c: Smooth Jazz Afternoon — Starts at 4:00 p.m.
option_d: Midnight Techno Party — Starts at 9:00 p.m.
explanation: Ayla caz müziğini seviyor ve Cumartesi saat 18:00'e kadar Fransızca kursu var. Bu nedenle saat 19:30'da başlayan "Blue Note Jazz Night" konseri onun için tek uygun seçenektir.

question_text:
Match the questions with the correct answers:
1. How often do you train for the swimming tournament?
2. Who do you usually go to the training with?
3. Where does the training take place?
4. How do you go to the swimming pool?

a. At the Olympic Sports Complex.
b. Four times a week.
c. By my dad’s car.
d. With my twin brother, Berk.

Which matching is CORRECT?
explanation: How often (Ne sıklıkla) → b (Haftada dört kez); Who (Kiminle) → d (İkiz kardeşim Berk ile); Where (Nerede) → a (Olimpik Spor Kompleksinde); How (Nasıl) → c (Babamın arabasıyla).

question_text:
Examine Sibel’s preferences:
• Watching movies at home: ♥♥♥
• Going to the cinema: ♥
• Reading sci-fi books: ♥♥♥
• Reading Gothic stories: ✗

Which sentence correctly reflects Sibel’s preferences?
option_a: Sibel likes going to the movie theatre more than staying at home.
option_b: Sibel is fond of reading scary Gothic stories before sleeping.
option_c: Sibel prefers Gothic stories to science fiction books.
option_d: Sibel prefers watching movies at home to going to the cinema.
explanation: Tabloda evde film izlemek (3 kalp) sinemaya gitmekten (1 kalp) daha çok sevildiği için "Sibel prefers watching movies at home to going to the cinema" cümlesi doğrudur.

question_text:
Interview with a Young Musician, Emre (14):
Reporter: When did you start playing the cello, Emre?
Emre: When I was nine years old. I practice for two hours every day after I finish my school homework.
Reporter: Isn’t it tiring for a teenager?
Emre: Sometimes it is, but playing in the youth orchestra makes me feel terrific!

According to the interview, Emre ________.
option_a: started learning the cello last year at the age of thirteen
option_b: thinks playing in the youth orchestra is unbearable and boring
option_c: has been playing the cello for five years and enjoys orchestra rehearsals
option_d: neglects his school homework because of his music practice
explanation: 14 yaşındaki Emre 9 yaşında çello çalmaya başladığına göre 5 yıldır çalmaktadır ve gençlik orkestrasında çalmak ona harika ("terrific") hissettirmektedir.

question_text:
Look at the adjectives below:
• Group A: Fascinating, Terrific, Impressive, Harmonic
• Group B: Unbearable, Ridiculous, Boring, Awful

If you want to add one more word to each group, which pair is suitable?
option_a: Group A: Terrible — Group B: Awesome
option_b: Group A: Energetic — Group B: Loud
option_c: Group A: Snob — Group B: Relaxing
option_d: Group A: Tiring — Group B: Wonderful
explanation: Group A olumlu sıfatlardan, Group B ise olumsuz sıfatlardan oluşmaktadır. Bu nedenle A grubuna "Energetic", B grubuna "Loud" (aşırı gürültülü) eklenebilir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Aslı: Do you want to come to the shopping mall with me after school? I want to buy a new pair of trendy sneakers.
Nil: Thanks, Aslı, but I never spend my pocket money on fashion items. I save it to buy camping gear and science magazines.

We can understand that Nil ________.
option_a: doesn’t get any pocket money from her parents
option_b: accepts Aslı’s invitation to go shopping for clothes
option_c: spends all her money on expensive shoes and trendy dresses
option_d: is interested in nature and science rather than fashion
explanation: Nil harçlığını moda ürünlerine harcamayıp kamp malzemeleri ve bilim dergileri almak için biriktirdiğinden doğa ve bilime ilgi duymaktadır.

question_text:
Camping Checklist of 4 Friends:
• Oğuz: Brought the large tent and hammers.
• Poyraz: Brought four sleeping bags and mats.
• Rüzgar: Brought matches, firewood and a cooking pot.
• Sinan: Brought a map, a compass and two flashlights.

Who is responsible for finding directions and lighting the dark?
explanation: Harita, pusula ("map, compass" - yön bulma) ve el fenerlerini ("flashlights" - karanlığı aydınlatma) getiren kişi Sinan'dır.

question_text:
Read the statement:
“My twin sister, Lara, and I look identical, but our tastes are completely different. While I enjoy staying in a tent and trekking in the mountains, she prefers five-star hotels and shopping centers.”

Which of the following is TRUE about the twins?
option_a: Lara is fond of sleeping in a tent and walking in the forest.
option_b: They have the same free time activities because they are twins.
option_c: The speaker loves nature activities, whereas Lara prefers comfort and city life.
option_d: Both twins are keen on extreme camping in the mountains.
explanation: Konuşmacı çadırda kalmayı ve dağ yürüyüşünü severken, ikizi Lara beş yıldızlı otelleri ve alışveriş merkezlerini (konfor ve şehir yaşamını) tercih etmektedir.

question_text:
Choose the correct question for the underlined part:
“Pamela attends folk dance courses twice a week, on Wednesdays and Saturdays.”
option_a: Who teaches folk dance to Pamela at the club?
option_b: How often does Pamela attend folk dance courses?
option_c: Where does Pamela take folk dance lessons?
option_d: Why is Pamela keen on traditional folk dances?
explanation: Altı çizili kısım eylemin yapılma sıklığını ("twice a week") belirttiği için soru "How often...?" (Ne sıklıkla?) olmalıdır.

question_text:
Kerem’s Afternoon Schedule on Tuesday:
• 15:30 — Leave school and walk home
• 16:00 — Have a snack and rest
• 16:30 - 18:00 — Basketball training at the gym
• 18:30 - 19:15 — Have dinner with family
• 19:30 - 21:00 — Do homework and read a book

What does Kerem do right before having dinner with his family?
option_a: He practices basketball at the sports hall.
option_b: He finishes his homework and reads a novel.
option_c: He goes to bed early to wake up on time.
option_d: He walks from home to school in the morning.
explanation: Saat 18:30'daki akşam yemeğinden hemen önce (16:30 - 18:00 arası) spor salonunda basketbol antrenmanı yapmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the book review:
“Journey to the Red Planet is a great novel for teenagers. It tells the story of four young astronauts trying to build the first greenhouse on Mars in the year 2085.”

What genre is this book?
explanation: 2085 yılında Mars'ta sera kurmaya çalışan astronotların hikayesini anlatan roman bir bilim kurgu ("Science fiction") eseridir.

question_text:
Club NameDay & TimeActivitiesPersonality Fit
Young ExplorersSaturday 09:00 - 14:00Camping, trekking, orienteeringEnergetic & nature lover
Bookworms CircleWednesday 15:30 - 17:00Reading & discussing novelsCalm & imaginative
Harmony BandTuesday & Thursday 16:00 - 17:30Playing instruments, singingTalented in music
Checkmate ClubFriday 15:30 - 17:00Playing chess and board gamesPatient & strategic

Read the information about three students:
• Efe loves learning how to use a compass in the woods and is free at the weekend.
• Duru plays the violin and wants to practice twice a week after school.
• Mert prefers quiet indoor games that require deep thinking and strategy.

Which clubs should Efe, Duru and Mert join?
option_a: Efe: Young Explorers — Duru: Bookworms Circle — Mert: Checkmate Club
option_b: Efe: Harmony Band — Duru: Young Explorers — Mert: Bookworms Circle
option_c: Efe: Checkmate Club — Duru: Harmony Band — Mert: Bookworms Circle
option_d: Efe: Young Explorers — Duru: Harmony Band — Mert: Checkmate Club
explanation: Ormanda pusula kullanmayı (orienteering) seven Efe "Young Explorers", haftada iki gün keman çalmak isteyen Duru "Harmony Band", strateji gerektiren sessiz salon oyunlarını seven Mert ise "Checkmate Club" kulübüne katılmalıdır.

(Note: Each teenager could choose more than one activity.)

According to the chart above, which of the following deductions is DEFINITELY CORRECT?
option_a: Only a quarter of the teenagers spend their free time camping in nature.
option_b: More than half of the teenagers read books in their spare time.
option_c: Nobody in the survey group enjoys both listening to music and doing sports.
option_d: Doing sports is the most popular free time activity among the teens.

question_text:
Read the text about two brothers, Kaan and Alp:
“Kaan and Alp share the same room, but their daily lives are completely opposite. Kaan wakes up at 6:30 a.m. every day, goes for a morning run, and prefers wearing simple sports clothes. He thinks spending hours in front of the mirror is ridiculous. On the other hand, Alp never gets up early at weekends, follows fashion blogs every day, and spends all his pocket money on designer jackets. Also, while Kaan listens to calming acoustic folk songs, Alp is fond of loud techno music.”

According to the text, which of the following is FALSE?
option_a: Kaan is an early bird who enjoys morning exercise and comfortable outfits.
option_b: The two brothers have different tastes in both music and clothing.
option_c: Both brothers care a lot about wearing expensive and trendy clothes.
option_d: Alp is very interested in the latest fashion trends and electronic music.
explanation: Kaan sade spor kıyafetler giymeyi tercih edip aynanın karşısında saatler geçirmeyi saçma ("ridiculous") bulduğu için her iki kardeşin de pahalı ve moda kıyafetlere önem verdiği söylenemez.

question_text:
Examine the survey answers of four teenagers:
QuestionsSedaTarkanUfukYaren
1. Do you follow fashion trends?YesNoNoYes
2. Do you enjoy sleeping in a tent?NoYesYesYes
3. Do you read at least two books a month?YesYesNoYes
4. Do you listen to classical music?YesYesNoNo

Which teenager is a nature-loving bookworm who doesn’t care about fashion and enjoys classical music?
explanation: Modayı takip etmeyen (1: No), çadırda uyumayı seven doğasever (2: Yes), ayda en az iki kitap okuyan kitap kurdu (3: Yes) ve klasik müzik dinleyen (4: Yes) kişi Tarkan'dır.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Ceyda: Look at this poster! Our school is organizing a 3-day youth camp by Lake Abant next weekend. Are you coming?
Berna: I’d love to! I really enjoy trekking and sitting around the campfire. What about you?
Ceyda: To be honest, I can’t stand sleeping in a sleeping bag or seeing insects in the tent. I prefer reading my fantasy novels on my sofa at home.

What can we say about Ceyda and Berna?
option_a: Ceyda is more adventurous and fond of wildlife than her friend Berna.
option_b: Both Ceyda and Berna are going to attend the youth camp by Lake Abant.
option_c: Berna refuses to join the camp because she is afraid of insects.
option_d: Berna is keen on camping activities, whereas Ceyda prefers staying indoors.
explanation: Berna doğa yürüyüşü ve kamp ateşini çok sevdiğini söylerken, Ceyda uyku tulumuna ve çadırdaki böceklere tahammül edemediğini, evde kanepede roman okumayı tercih ettiğini belirtmektedir.

question_text:
Look at Onur’s weekly routine chart:
• Every day (Mon–Sun): Walk the dog in the park (07:30), Read a book before bed (21:30)
• Weekdays (Mon–Fri): Attend school (08:30 - 15:20), Do homework (17:00 - 18:30)
• Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays: Swimming training (15:45 - 17:00)
• Saturdays: Guitar course (11:00 - 12:30), Meet friends at a café (14:00)

According to the chart, which statement is CORRECT?
option_a: Onur practices swimming three times a week right after school.
option_b: Onur meets his friends at a café every afternoon after school.
option_c: Onur never walks his dog or reads a book at the weekend.
option_d: Onur takes guitar lessons twice a week on weekdays.
explanation: Onur Pazartesi, Çarşamba ve Cuma günleri okul 15:20'de bittikten hemen sonra 15:45'te (haftada 3 kez) yüzme antrenmanı yapmaktadır.

question_text:
Four classmates are talking about the same concert they attended last night:
• Hakan: “The lead singer’s voice was so harmonic and impressive!”
• İpek: “It was a complete waste of time; the sound system was unbearable.”
• Kaan: “I think it was a terrific performance. Everybody danced happily.”
• Leman: “The band played energetic songs and the atmosphere was fascinating.”

Who didn’t enjoy the concert last night?
explanation: Konserin tam bir zaman kaybı olduğunu ve ses sisteminin dayanılmaz ("unbearable") olduğunu söyleyen İpek konseri beğenmemiştir.

question_text:
Read the text:
“In our school survey, we asked 200 students about their morning routines. 120 students said they always have breakfast at home before leaving for school. 50 students eat a toast or bagel at the school canteen, and 30 students skip breakfast because they wake up late. Teachers warn that students who don’t have breakfast have difficulty concentrating on morning lessons.”

According to the text, ________.
option_a: the majority of the students go to school without eating anything
option_b: more than half of the students eat breakfast at home in the morning
option_c: only thirty students eat breakfast at home with their families
