option_d: skipping breakfast helps teenagers focus better on their morning classes
explanation: 200 öğrencinin 120'si (%60'ı, yani yarısından fazlası) okula çıkmadan önce evde kahvaltı yapmaktadır.

question_text:
Look at the diagram showing how Melis spends her 6 hours of free time on Saturday:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "Cycling in the park (2 hours)" size=9 bold text 170 46 "10:00 - 12:00" size=9 text 170 68 "Reading realistic novels (2 hours)" size=9 text 170 90 "13:00 - 15:00" size=9 text 170 112 "Playing the flute (1 hour)" size=9 text 170 134 "15:30 - 16:30" size=9``` Which of the following is TRUE according to Melis’s Saturday schedule?
option_a: She practices her musical instrument for more than two hours.
option_b: She prefers fantasy books to realistic novels in the afternoon.
option_c: She watches documentaries in the morning before riding her bike.
option_d: She spends equal time on outdoor sports and reading books.
explanation: Melis parkta bisiklet sürmeye (açık hava sporu) 2 saat, kitap okumaya da 2 saat (eşit süre) ayırmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the three clues to find the mysterious object in the backpack:
1. Campers always take it with them when they go into the forest.
2. It doesn’t need electricity or batteries to show you North.
3. If you lose your way while trekking, you look at its magnetic needle.

What is this camping item?
explanation: Elektrik veya pil gerektirmeden manyetik ibresiyle Kuzey'i gösteren ve ormanda kaybolunca yön bulmaya yarayan alet pusuladır ("A compass").

question_text:
Dialogue:
Pamela: Do you want to listen to the new album of the Techno Beats band?
Sandra: No, thanks. Electronic music is not my thing. I’m keen on Indian and Turkish traditional melodies.
Pamela: Really? Why do you prefer them?
Sandra: Because learning about the cultural heritage of nations through their instruments is fascinating.

What does Sandra mean by saying “Electronic music is not my thing”?
option_a: She composed the songs in the new Techno Beats album.
option_b: She thinks electronic music is the best genre in the world.
option_c: She is not interested in or fond of electronic music.
option_d: She doesn’t have any headphones to listen to the album.
explanation: "Not my thing" (Bana göre değil / İlgi alanım değil) deyimi elektronik müzikten hoşlanmadığı ve ilgi duymadığı anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Look at the movie ticket requirements of four friends:
• Aras: Loves space travel and future technology.
• Bora: Enjoys solving crimes and mysterious cases.
• Cenk: Likes real life stories of historical athletes.
• Doruk: Prefers funny movies that make him laugh.

Cinema Hall Poster: “The Secret of the Missing Diamond — Detective Sherlock Jr. follows the clues in an old train to catch the thief!”

Who will enjoy watching this movie the most?
explanation: Afişteki film kayıp elmasın izini süren bir dedektifin gizemli vakasını anlattığı için suç çözme ve gizem seven Bora bu filmden en çok keyif alacaktır.

question_text:
Read the paragraph:
“Being a teenager in a village is quite different from living in a big city. Village teens usually wake up early, help their families feed the animals or water the vegetable garden before school. In their free time, they ride bikes by the river or climb trees instead of spending hours in crowded shopping malls.”

What is the paragraph mainly about?
option_a: Why all village teenagers want to move to big cities for shopping malls
option_b: The rules of riding bicycles safely in heavy city traffic
option_c: How to grow tropical fruits in a modern city apartment
option_d: The daily routine and natural lifestyle of teenagers living in the countryside
explanation: Paragraf kırsalda/köyde yaşayan gençlerin günlük rutinlerini ve doğayla iç içe yaşam tarzlarını büyük şehirle karşılaştırarak anlatmaktadır.

question_text:
Compare the preferences of Ezgi and Pelin:
• Ezgi: “I never miss pop concerts, I wear casual jeans and T-shirts, and I go skating every weekend.”
• Pelin: “I find pop music unbearable, I love wearing elegant trendy dresses, and I prefer playing chess at home.”

Which of the following can we conclude from their statements?
option_a: Ezgi and Pelin have completely different tastes in music, clothing and hobbies.
option_b: Both Ezgi and Pelin are fond of outdoor sports and casual clothes.
option_c: Pelin enjoys listening to pop songs while playing chess at home.
option_d: Ezgi cares about wearing elegant dresses more than Pelin does.
explanation: Ezgi pop müzik, rahat kıyafet ve paten severken; Pelin pop müziğe katlanamamakta, şık elbiseler ve evde satranç oynamayı tercih etmektedir. Yani müzik, giyim ve hobi zevkleri tamamen farklıdır.

question_text:
DayMorning (10:00)Afternoon (14:30)Evening (19:30)
SaturdayArchery TrainingBook Fair VisitCampfire & Guitar
SundayForest TrekkingCanoeing on the LakeReturn Home

The table above shows the weekend program of the Teen Adventure Camp. If a student joins the camp on Saturday at 1:00 p.m. and stays until Sunday evening, which activity will he/she MISS?
explanation: Cumartesi öğleden sonra saat 13:00'te kampa katılan bir öğrenci, Cumartesi sabah 10:00'da yapılan Okçuluk Antrenmanını ("Archery Training") kaçırmış olur.

question_text:
Choose the sentence that best restates the following statement:
“Mark would rather read biographical books than watch comedy films.”
option_a: Mark hates both biographical books and comedy films.
option_b: Mark prefers reading biographical books to watching comedy films.
option_c: Mark prefers watching comedy films to reading biographical books.
option_d: Mark thinks comedy films are much more interesting than biographies.
explanation: "Would rather A than B" yapısı "Prefer A to B" (A'yı B'ye tercih etmek) yapısıyla eş anlamlıdır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Interviewer: Many adults think teenagers spend all their free time on their smartphones. Do you agree?
Zeynep (14): Not at all! In my class, most of us are members of sports teams or music clubs. For example, I train for volleyball four days a week and volunteer at an animal shelter on Sundays.

Why does Zeynep disagree with the interviewer’s comment?
option_a: Because she spends ten hours a day playing games on her mobile phone.
option_b: Because her school bans sports clubs and music lessons on weekdays.
option_c: Because nobody in her school owns a smartphone or a computer.
option_d: Because she and her classmates actively participate in sports, arts and charity work.
explanation: Zeynep kendisinin ve sınıf arkadaşlarının spor takımlarında, müzik kulüplerinde ve hayvan barınağı gönüllülüğünde aktif yer aldığını belirterek yetişkinlerin önyargısına katılmamaktadır.

question_text:
Find the odd sentence out in the paragraph:
(I) Camping is one of the best ways for teenagers to learn self-reliance and teamwork. (II) They learn how to pitch a tent, cook simple meals on a fire and read a compass. (III) Heavy metal music uses electric guitars and very loud drums on stage. (IV) Moreover, spending time away from city noise reduces exam stress and refreshes their minds.
explanation: Paragraf kamp yapmanın gençlere kazandırdığı beceri ve faydaları anlatırken, III. cümle heavy metal müzikten bahsederek akışı bozmaktadır.

question_text:
Look at the four students’ statements:
• Can: “I brush my teeth twice a day and wash my hands before every meal.”
• Eda: “I never wear clothes just because famous singers wear them.”
• Mert: “I always help my grandfather carry his shopping bags on Saturdays.”
• Sude: “I practice playing the piano every evening from 6 p.m. to 7 p.m.”

Who is talking about personal hygiene habits?
explanation: Günde iki kez diş fırçalamak ve her yemekten önce el yıkamak kişisel hijyen alışkanlıklarıyla ("personal hygiene habits") ilgilidir ve bunu Can söylemektedir.

question_text:
Read the brochure of the Teen Summer School:
• Course 1 (Stage Stars): Drama, acting and body language (Fee: Free)
• Course 2 (Code Masters): Designing mobile apps and games (Fee: 200 TL)
• Course 3 (Nature Guides): Trekking, map reading and first aid in the woods (Fee: 150 TL)
• Course 4 (Rhythm & Strings): Learning acoustic guitar and violin (Fee: 250 TL)

Barış has 180 TL. He loves outdoor adventures and wants to learn how to survive in the forest. Which course can he register for?
explanation: Hem doğa maceralarını ve ormanda hayatta kalmayı (trekking, harita okuma, ilk yardım) kapsayan hem de Barış'ın 180 TL bütçesine uyan (150 TL) kurs "Course 3 (Nature Guides)" seçeneğidir.

question_text:
Examine the bar chart comparing girls’ and boys’ music preferences in Class 8-B:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Music Preferences in Class 8-B (32 Students)" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "12 students" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Pop (Girls)" size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 100.0 P d1 119.9 100.0 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 94.0 "6 students" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Pop (Boys)" size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 123.3 P d2 188.4 123.3 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 117.3 "4 students" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Rock (Girls)" size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 53.3 P d3 256.9 53.3 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 47.3 "10 students" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Rock (Boys)" size=10 ```
Which of the following is CORRECT according to the graph?
option_a: Equal numbers of boys like pop music and rock music.
option_b: Rock music is more popular than pop music in the whole class.
option_c: More girls than boys are keen on listening to rock music.
option_d: Girls in Class 8-B prefer pop music twice as much as boys do.
explanation: Grafikte pop müziği tercih eden kız öğrenci sayısı 12, erkek öğrenci sayısı ise 6'dır; yani kızlar pop müziği erkeklerin iki katı kadar tercih etmektedir (toplamda Pop=18, Rock=14).

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Mother: Why aren’t you reading the detective book your uncle bought you?
Tim: I read the first two chapters, Mom, but the plot is too predictable and ordinary. I guessed who the criminal was on page ten! I’ll read my astronomy magazine instead.

Why did Tim stop reading the detective book?
option_a: Because he didn’t find the story exciting or mysterious enough
option_b: Because the book was written in a foreign language he didn’t know
option_c: Because he lost the book on the school bus yesterday
option_d: Because he can’t stand reading books or magazines at all
explanation: Olay örgüsünü çok tahmin edilebilir ve sıradan ("predictable and ordinary") bulup suçluyu 10. sayfada tahmin ettiği için hikayeyi yeterince heyecanlı veya gizemli bulmamıştır.

question_text:
Look at the timetable of the school shuttle bus:
• Morning Departure from Square: 07:45 → Arrival at School: 08:15
• Afternoon Departure from School (Normal classes): 15:30
• Late Departure from School (After-school clubs): 17:15

Damla stays at school for the Folk Dance Club from 15:30 to 17:00 on Wednesdays. If she takes the school shuttle bus home and the journey takes 30 minutes, what time does she arrive at the Square on Wednesdays?
explanation: Damla kulüp sonrası 17:15 servisine biner; yolculuk 30 dakika sürdüğü için meydana saat 17:45'te varır.

question_text:
Read the quote by a famous educator:
“A teenager who learns to enjoy both a quiet book in a library and a long walk in a forest will never feel bored or lonely in life.”

According to this quote, teenagers should ________.
option_a: stop reading books and live permanently in the forest
option_b: balance intellectual indoor activities with outdoor nature experiences
option_c: spend all their time inside libraries without going outside
option_d: avoid walking alone in nature because it is too boring
explanation: Alıntıda hem kütüphanede sessiz bir kitaptan (zihinsel iç mekan etkinliği) hem de ormanda uzun bir yürüyüşten (açık hava doğa deneyimi) keyif almayı öğrenen gencin asla sıkılmayacağı, yani ikisini dengelemesi gerektiği vurgulanmaktadır.

question_text:
“First, wash the potatoes and ________ their skins with a sharp knife.”

Which cooking verb completes the sentence?
explanation: Patateslerin kabuklarını ("skins") bıçakla soymak için "peel" fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Amy: How do you usually cook salmon?
Chef: I never fry it in oil because it becomes too fatty. I always ________ it in the oven at 200°C.

Which cooking method completes the chef’s answer?
explanation: Fırında ("in the oven") 200 derecede pişirme yöntemi "bake / roast" fiiliyle ifade edilir.

question_text:
If you want to make bread or pizza, you must mix flour, water, salt and yeast, and then ________ the dough well with your hands.

Which verb fills in the blank?
explanation: Hamuru ("dough") elle yoğurmak anlamına gelen fiil "knead"dir.

question_text:
Son: Mom, this lemonade is too ________! I can’t drink it.
Mother: Oh, I forgot to add sugar to the lemon juice. Let me add some honey.

Which taste adjective completes the dialogue?
explanation: Şeker eklenmemiş limon suyu çok ekşi ("sour") olur.

question_text:
Look at the kitchen tools and their uses:
• Grater: to grate cheese or carrots
• Rolling pin: to roll out the dough flat
• ________: to drain boiled pasta or washed vegetables

Which kitchen tool completes the list?
explanation: Haşlanmış makarnayı veya yıkanmış sebzeleri süzmek ("drain") için süzgeç ("Strainer / Colander") kullanılır.

question_text:
“________ the eggs and sugar in a deep bowl with a mixer until the mixture becomes foamy.”

Which verb fits the recipe instruction?
explanation: Yumurta ve şekeri mikserle köpürene kadar çırpmak için "Whisk / Beat" fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Waiter: What is in the Mexican taco?
Chef: Minced beef, red beans, onions and lots of hot chili peppers.

According to the ingredients, Mexican taco is a ________ dish.
explanation: İçinde bolca acı biber ("hot chili peppers") bulunan bir yemek baharatlı/acıdır ("spicy").

question_text:
Look at the sequence words in a recipe:
First → Second → Next → Then → After that → ________

Which word always comes at the very end of the cooking steps?
explanation: Tarif adımlarının en sonunda son aşamayı belirtmek için "Finally" (Son olarak) zarfı kullanılır.

question_text:
Grandma: Please cut the bread into thin pieces for breakfast, dear.

Which verb has the same meaning as “cut into thin flat pieces”?
explanation: Ekmeği ince düz parçalar halinde dilimlemek "Slice" fiiliyle ifade edilir.

question_text:
“Put two tablespoons of butter in the saucepan and ________ it over low heat before adding the flour.”

Which verb completes the sentence?
explanation: Tereyağını kısık ateşte eritmek için "melt" fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Emma: ________ do we need to bake the chocolate brownies?
Mother: For about 25 minutes at 180°C.

Which question word completes Emma’s question?
explanation: Yanıtta pişirme süresi ("For about 25 minutes") verildiği için soru "How long" (Ne kadar süre) olmalıdır.

question_text:
To make mashed potatoes, first boil the potatoes in water until they are soft, and then ________ them with a fork or potato masher.

Which verb completes the sentence?
explanation: Yumuşayan patatesleri çatal veya eziciyle ezmek için "mash" fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Lisa: What are the ________ of your lentil soup?
Meltem: Red lentils, an onion, a carrot, a tablespoon of butter, salt and dried mint.

Which word completes Lisa’s question?
explanation: Çorbanın içindeki malzemeleri (kırmızı mercimek, soğan, havuç, tereyağı, tuz, nane) sorarken "ingredients" (içindekiler/malzemeler) kelimesi kullanılır.

question_text:
“________ some grated mozzarella cheese and dried herbs on top of the pizza before putting it into the oven.”

Which cooking verb fits the blank?
explanation: Pizzanın üzerine rendelenmiş peynir ve kuru baharat serpmek için "Sprinkle" fiili kullanılır.

question_text: Which of the following cooking methods is the HEALTHIEST because it uses hot water vapor without any oil?
explanation: Hiç yağ kullanmadan sıcak su buharıyla pişirme yöntemi buharda pişirmedir ("Steaming") ve en sağlıklı yöntemlerden biridir.

question_text:
Brother: Why are your eyes watering, Selin?
Selin: Because I am ________ three big onions into small cubes for the meat stew!

Which verb completes Selin’s explanation?
explanation: Soğanları küçük küpler halinde doğramak ("cutting into small cubes") "dicing / chopping" fiiliyle ifade edilir.

question_text:
“Pour the hot soup into four ________ and serve it immediately with lemon slices.”

Which tableware item completes the sentence?
explanation: Sıcak çorba kaselere ("bowls") dökülerek servis edilir.

question_text:
Chef: Always ________ the sauce continuously with a wooden spoon so that it doesn’t burn at the bottom of the pot.

Which verb completes the chef’s advice?
explanation: Sosun tencerenin dibine tutmaması için tahta kaşıkla sürekli karıştırmak "stir" fiiliyle ifade edilir.

question_text:
I have a sweet tooth. I can never say no to ________ after dinner.

Which food completes the sentence according to the underlined idiom?
explanation: "Have a sweet tooth" tatlıya çok düşkün olmak demektir; bu yüzden çikolatalı kek veya baklava cümleyi doğru tamamlar.

question_text:
“________ two eggs into the frying pan and add a pinch of salt.”

Which verb is specifically used for breaking eggs to cook?
explanation: Tavaya yumurta kırmak için "Crack" fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Before putting the cake mixture into the baking pan, ________ some butter inside the pan so the cake won’t stick.

Which verb completes the sentence?
explanation: Kekin kalıba yapışmaması için kalıbın içine tereyağı sürmek/yaymak "spread" fiiliyle ifade edilir.

question_text:
Doctor: Your cholesterol is high. You should avoid eating ________ food like French fries and fried chicken.

Which adjective completes the doctor’s warning?
explanation: Patates kızartması ve kızarmış tavuk gibi aşırı yağlı yiyecekler "greasy / fatty" sıfatıyla tanımlanır.

question_text:
Put the steps of making a fruit salad in the correct order:
I. Next, put all the diced fruits into a large glass bowl.
II. First, wash the strawberries, apples and bananas with cold water.
III. Finally, pour some honey and lemon juice over the fruits and serve cold.
IV. Second, peel the apples and bananas, and dice them into small pieces.
V. Then, mix the fruits gently with a big spoon.

Which of the following is the correct order?
explanation: Sıralama bağlaçlarına göre: First (II - meyveleri yıka) → Second (IV - soy ve küp doğra) → Next (I - kaseye koy) → Then (V - nazikçe karıştır) → Finally (III - bal ve limon suyu döküp servis et).

question_text:
Recipe: Homemade Tomato Pasta Sauce
“First, peel four ripe tomatoes and grate them into a bowl. Second, chop two cloves of garlic and an onion finely. Next, heat two tablespoons of olive oil in a saucepan and fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes. Then, pour the grated tomatoes into the pan and add salt, black pepper and basil. Finally, simmer the sauce over low heat for 15 minutes while stirring with a wooden spoon.”

Which kitchen tool is NOT needed to prepare this sauce?
explanation: Domatesleri rendelemek için rende ("grater"), soğan ve sarımsağı doğramak için bıçak ("knife"), pişirmek için tencere ("saucepan") gerekir; ancak hamur açmaya yarayan oklava/merdane ("rolling pin") bu tarifte kullanılmaz.

question_text:
PersonCooking Method PreferenceTaste Preference
AhmetGrilling or roastingSpicy and salty meat dishes
BernaSteaming or boilingLight vegetables with olive oil
CenkFrying in oilCrispy fast food and chips
DeryaBaking in the ovenSweet pastries and chocolate cakes

According to the table, who prefers the healthiest and lowest-calorie eating style?
explanation: Buharda pişirme veya haşlama yöntemini ("Steaming or boiling") ve zeytinyağlı hafif sebzeleri tercih eden Berna en sağlıklı ve düşük kalorili beslenme tarzına sahiptir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue in the kitchen:
Mother: Can you help me with the dinner, Kaan?
Kaan: Sure, Mom! What should I do first?
Mother: The pasta has been boiling in the pot for ten minutes. It’s ready now. Take the strainer and separate the hot water from the pasta.

Which action is Kaan’s mother asking him to do?
explanation: Süzgeci ("strainer") alıp haşlanmış makarnayı sıcak sudan ayırmak makarnayı süzmektir ("Drain the boiled pasta").

question_text:
Recipe Card: Traditional Turkish Menemen
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "Step 1: Dice 3 green peppers and 4 tomatoes" size=9 bold text 170 46 "Use a chopping board and knife" size=9 text 170 68 "Step 2: Fry the peppers in olive oil for 3 mins" size=9 text 170 90 "Use a frying pan over medium heat" size=9 text 170 112 "Step 3: Add tomatoes and cook until soft" size=9 text 170 134 "Stir occasionally for 5 mins" size=9``` According to the diagram, what should you do right after frying the green peppers in olive oil?
option_a: Serve the dish cold with slices of toasted bread
option_b: Wash and dice the green peppers on the chopping board
option_c: Crack three eggs directly onto the raw green peppers
option_d: Put the diced tomatoes into the pan and cook them until they get soft
explanation: Şemaya göre 2. adımda biberleri zeytinyağında kavurduktan hemen sonra 3. adımda doğranmış domatesleri ekleyip yumuşayana kadar pişirmek gerekir.

question_text:
Read the text:
“Sushi is a traditional Japanese dish. Its main ingredients are boiled rice seasoned with vinegar, fresh raw fish, and seaweed. Chefs roll the rice and fish inside the seaweed sheet and slice the roll into bite-sized pieces. It is usually served with soy sauce.”

According to the text, which of the following is TRUE about sushi?
option_a: The fish used in traditional sushi is not cooked.
option_b: Sushi is a sweet dessert served with chocolate sauce.
option_c: Sushi is baked in a hot oven for forty minutes.
option_d: Chefs deep-fry the rice and seaweed in vegetable oil.
explanation: Metinde suşide taze çiğ balık ("fresh raw fish") kullanıldığı belirtildiği için balığın pişirilmediği ("not cooked") bilgisi doğrudur.

question_text:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "How 100 Families Cook Chicken at Home" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "40%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Grilling" size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 65.0 P d1 119.9 65.0 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 59.0 "30%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Baking" size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 100.0 P d2 188.4 100.0 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 94.0 "20%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Steaming" size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 135.0 P d3 256.9 135.0 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 129.0 "10%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Frying" size=10 ```
Which of the following statements is CORRECT according to the chart?
option_a: Half of the families prefer boiling or steaming chicken.
option_b: More families steam chicken than bake it in the oven.
option_c: Cooking chicken in hot oil is the least preferred method among families.
option_d: Baking is more popular than grilling when cooking chicken.
explanation: Kızgın yağda kızartma ("Frying") %10 ile aileler arasında en az tercih edilen pişirme yöntemidir.

question_text:
Customer: Excuse me, does this mushroom soup contain any flour or milk? I am allergic to dairy products.
Waiter: Let me ask the chef... Yes, madam, our chef uses a cup of milk and a tablespoon of butter to make it creamy. However, our lentil soup is made only with water, olive oil, red lentils and vegetables.

What will the customer most probably do?
option_a: She will drink two bowls of creamy mushroom soup.
option_b: She will order the lentil soup because it has no milk or butter.
option_c: She will drink a glass of cold milk before her meal.
option_d: She will ask for extra cheese and cream on her mushroom soup.
explanation: Müşterinin süt ürünlerine ("dairy products") alerjisi olduğu için süt ve tereyağı içermeyen mercimek çorbasını sipariş edecektir.

question_text:
Chef’s Tip:
“When you make an omelette, never add the salt while the eggs are still raw in the bowl because it makes the eggs watery. Wait until the eggs start cooking in the pan, and then sprinkle the salt.”

When should we add salt to an omelette according to the chef?
option_a: Before cracking the eggs into the mixing bowl
option_b: Two hours before heating the frying pan
option_c: Right after whisking the raw eggs in the bowl
option_d: While the eggs are cooking in the frying pan
explanation: Şefin ipucuna göre tuz, yumurtalar tavada pişmeye başladıktan sonra ("Wait until the eggs start cooking in the pan") serpilmelidir.

question_text:
Read the ingredients of four different recipes:
• Recipe A: 3 apples, 1 cup of sugar, 2 eggs, 1 packet of baking powder, 2 cups of flour, cinnamon.
• Recipe B: 500 g minced beef, 1 grated onion, breadcrumbs, salt, cumin, black pepper.
• Recipe C: 2 cucumbers, 3 tomatoes, 1 onion, parsley, olive oil, lemon juice.
• Recipe D: 1 liter of milk, 1 cup of rice, 1 cup of sugar, vanilla.

Which recipe is for making Grilled Meatballs?
explanation: Kıyma ("minced beef"), rendelenmiş soğan, galeta unu ("breadcrumbs") ve kimyon içeren Recipe B ızgara köfte ("Grilled Meatballs") tarifidir (A: Elmalı kek, C: Çoban salatası, D: Sütlaç).

question_text:
Sinem: How do you serve your baked potatoes?
Burak: First, I bake large potatoes wrapped in foil for an hour. Then, I cut them open in the middle, mash the inside with butter and mozzarella cheese, and finally put corn, olives and pickles on top.

Which step comes BEFORE cutting the potatoes open in the middle?
option_a: Mashing the inside of the potatoes with butter and cheese
option_b: Adding sweet corn, black olives and diced pickles on top
option_c: Baking the foil-wrapped potatoes in the oven for 60 minutes
option_d: Serving the hot kumpir on plates to the guests
explanation: Patatesleri ortadan kesmeden önce ("First"), folyoya sarılı büyük patateslerin bir saat (60 dakika) fırında pişirilmesi gerekmektedir.

question_text:
Match the kitchen problems with the correct solutions:
1. The soup tastes too bland (tasteless).
2. The cake dough is too thick and dry.
3. The pasta sauce is too sour.

a. Add half a glass of milk and whisk again.
b. Add a pinch of salt and some spices.
c. Add half a teaspoon of sugar to balance the acidity.

Which matching is CORRECT?
explanation: Çorba tatsızsa ("bland") tuz ve baharat eklenir (1-b); kek hamuru çok koyu ve kuruysa süt eklenir (2-a); makarna sosu çok ekşiyse asiditeyi dengelemek için yarım çay kaşığı şeker eklenir (3-c).

question_text:
Look at the fridge inventory of Hale:
• 4 eggs, 1 liter of milk, 250 g butter
• 1 kg flour, sugar, baking powder, cocoa powder
• Missing items: Strawberries, bananas, chicken, meat, tomatoes

With ONLY the ingredients she has at home right now, what can Hale prepare?
option_c: Grilled beef steak with mashed potatoes
explanation: Hale'nin evinde yumurta, süt, tereyağı, un, şeker, kabartma tozu ve kakao bulunduğu için çikolatalı pankek veya kakaolu kek hazırlayabilir.

question_text:
Read the sentences:
• “Remember to preheat the oven to 180°C ten minutes before putting the tray in.”

What does the underlined verb preheat mean?
option_a: Wash the baking tray with cold water
option_b: Keep the food inside the refrigerator
option_c: Heat the oven in advance before cooking
option_d: Turn off the oven after the cake is ready
explanation: "Preheat" ("pre-" = önceden + "heat" = ısıtmak) fırını yemeği koymadan önce önceden ısıtmak anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Aylin: What is the secret of your delicious walnut cookies?
Grandma: After I shape the dough into small balls, I leave them in the fridge for 20 minutes before baking. Thus, they don’t spread too much in the oven.

Why does Grandma put the cookie balls into the fridge before baking?
option_a: To keep their round shape while baking in the oven
option_b: To melt the butter inside the dough quickly
option_c: To serve them as frozen ice cream without baking
option_d: To make the cookies taste much saltier and spicier
explanation: Büyükanne kurabiye toplarını fırında çok yayılmasınlar, yani yuvarlak şekillerini korusunlar ("keep their round shape") diye pişirmeden önce 20 dakika buzdolabında bekletmektedir.

question_text:
Read the recipe for Vegetable Muffins carefully:
“First, preheat the oven to 180°C. Second, peel two carrots and one zucchini, and grate them into a bowl. Next, whisk three eggs, half a glass of olive oil and a glass of milk in another deep bowl. Then, add the grated vegetables, two glasses of flour, a packet of baking powder and some grated white cheese into the liquid mixture and stir well with a spoon. After that, pour the mixture into muffin cups. Finally, bake them for 30 minutes.”

According to the recipe above, which of the following is CORRECT?
option_a: The oven is turned on only after pouring the mixture into the muffin cups.
option_b: You need to knead a hard dough with your hands for half an hour.
option_c: This recipe is a sweet dessert made with lots of sugar and chocolate.
option_d: The carrots and zucchini are grated before they are mixed with the liquid ingredients.
explanation: Tarifte ikinci adımda havuç ve kabak rendelenmekte, üçüncü adımda sıvı malzemeler (yumurta, zeytinyağı, süt) çırpılmakta ve dördüncü adımda rendelenmiş sebzeler sıvı karışıma eklenmektedir.

question_text:
GuestDietary Restriction / Preference
Mr. YılmazDiabetic — cannot eat any sugar or honey
Mrs. YılmazGluten intolerance — cannot eat wheat flour, pasta or bread
Ece (Daughter)Vegetarian — never eats red meat, chicken or fish
Mert (Son)Allergic to seafood — cannot eat fish or shrimp

Chef Selim wants to prepare ONE main course that ALL four members of the Yılmaz family can safely eat together. Which dish should Chef Selim cook?
option_a: Grilled salmon served with boiled broccoli and lemon sauce
option_b: Roasted meatballs served with buttered rice and green salad
option_c: Baked potatoes stuffed with steamed vegetables, olive oil and cheese
option_d: Vegetable pizza made with wheat flour dough and mozzarella cheese
explanation: Buğday unu (Mrs. Yılmaz yiyemez), somon balığı (Ece ve Mert yiyemez) ve etli köfte (Ece yiyemez) elendiğinde; un, şeker, et ve deniz ürünü içermeyen fırında sebzeli ve peynirli kumpir/patates ("Baked potatoes stuffed with steamed vegetables, olive oil and cheese") dört aile üyesinin de güvenle yiyebileceği tek yemektir.

question_text:
Look at the visual timeline of preparing Homemade Lemonade:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "1. Wash 4 lemons and grate their yellow skins (5 mins)" size=9 bold text 170 46 "Do not grate the bitter white part" size=9 text 170 68 "2. Rub the grated skins with 1 cup of sugar (5 mins)" size=9 text 170 90 "Squeeze the juice of the 4 lemons and mix" size=9 text 170 112 "3. Add 1 liter of cold water and stir until sugar dissolves (5 mins)" size=9 text 170 134 "Keep in the fridge for 45 minutes" size=9``` If Defne starts making this lemonade at 14:00, what is the earliest time she can serve the cold lemonade after completing all steps?
explanation: Hazırlık aşamaları 5 + 5 + 5 = 15 dakika ve buzdolabında dinlendirme süresi 45 dakika olmak üzere toplam 60 dakika (1 saat) sürmektedir. 14:00'te başlayan Defne limonatayı en erken 15:00'te servis edebilir.

question_text:
Read the conversation between two chefs:
Chef Marco: In Italian cuisine, we never break spaghetti in half before boiling it, and we take it out of the boiling water while it is still slightly firm, which we call “al dente”.
Chef Elif: Interesting! In Turkish home cooking, we usually cook pasta until it is completely soft, drain it, and then toss it in a pan with melted butter and tomato paste.

How does the traditional Italian way of boiling pasta differ from the Turkish way mentioned by Chef Elif?
option_a: Turkish people eat raw pasta without boiling it in hot water.
option_b: Italians boil spaghetti for a shorter time so that it stays a bit firm.
option_c: Italians always break spaghetti into small pieces before boiling.
option_d: Italians fry dry spaghetti in butter without using any water.
explanation: Şef Marco İtalyanların spagettiyi kırmadan ve tamamen yumuşamadan, hafif diri ("slightly firm / al dente") kalacak şekilde daha kısa süre haşladıklarını belirtmektedir.

question_text:
Examine the table of cooking verbs and kitchen tools:
StepAction in the RecipeTool Used
Step 1Remove the skin of five applesKnife / Peeler
Step 2Shred the cheddar cheese into tiny piecesRolling pin
Step 3Separate the boiled green beans from hot waterStrainer
Step 4Beat four eggs with sugar rapidlyWhisk / Mixer

In which step is the WRONG kitchen tool matched with the cooking action?
explanation: 2. adımda peyniri küçük parçalar halinde rendelemek ("shred / grate") için oklava ("Rolling pin") değil, rende ("Grater") kullanılmalıdır.

question_text:
Read the four comments below an online pancake recipe video:
• User 1 (Merve): “I followed all the steps, and my kids loved the fluffy pancakes with maple syrup!”
• User 2 (Tolga): “You didn’t mention how much flour or milk we should put into the bowl. Mine became like water!”
• User 3 (Seda): “Can we use honey instead of sugar in the batter?”
• User 4 (Kaan): “Adding a pinch of cinnamon gave a wonderful smell to the pancakes.”

Who complains about the lack of exact measurements in the recipe?
explanation: Kaseye ne kadar un veya süt konulması gerektiğinin belirtilmediğinden ("didn’t mention how much flour or milk") yani tam ölçü eksikliğinden şikayet eden kişi Tolga'dır.

question_text:
Read the text:
“When making homemade bread, yeast is a magical ingredient. You must dissolve the yeast in warm water or warm milk with a teaspoon of sugar. If the liquid is cold, the yeast won’t activate and the dough won’t rise. If the liquid is boiling hot, it kills the yeast! After kneading, cover the bowl with a clean cloth and wait for 45 minutes in a warm room.”

According to the text, why did Pelin’s bread dough fail to rise when she used boiling milk?
option_a: Because yeast only works when you mix it with ice water.
option_b: Because she added a teaspoon of sugar to the milk.
option_c: Because extremely hot liquid destroys the yeast.
option_d: Because she covered the bowl with a clean cloth.
explanation: Metinde sıvı kaynar sıcaklıkta olursa mayayı öldürdüğü ("If the liquid is boiling hot, it kills the yeast!") açıkça belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "World Cuisine Survey Among 100 Tourists" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "42%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Turkish Cuisi." size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 76.7 P d1 119.9 76.7 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 70.7 "28%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Italian Cuisi." size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 110.0 P d2 188.4 110.0 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 104.0 "18%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Japanese Cuis." size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 130.0 P d3 256.9 130.0 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 124.0 "12%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Mexican Cuisi." size=10 ```
Which of the following is TRUE according to the survey results?
option_a: Japanese sushi is the most preferred traditional dish.
option_b: 70% of the tourists prefer either Turkish or Italian dishes.
option_c: More than half of the tourists chose Italian pizza and pasta.
option_d: Spicy Mexican food is more popular than Japanese seafood.
explanation: Türk mutfağı (%42) ve İtalyan mutfağını (%28) tercih edenlerin toplamı %42 + %28 = %70'tir.

question_text:
Read the steps of a recipe whose order is mixed:
• (K) After that, shape the mixture into flat round patties and grill them for 4 minutes on each side.
• (L) First, grate one onion and squeeze out its excess juice.
• (M) Finally, place the grilled meatballs between burger buns with lettuce and tomato slices.
• (N) Second, put 500g minced beef, the grated onion, breadcrumbs, an egg and spices into a bowl and knead well for 10 minutes.

What is the correct sequence of letters to make a homemade burger?
explanation: Önce (L - First) soğan rendelenir, ikinci olarak (N - Second) kıyma ve malzemelerle yoğrulur, ardından (K - After that) şekil verilip ızgarada pişirilir, son olarak (M - Finally) ekmek arasına konulur.

question_text:
Read the three riddles about kitchen verbs:
1. “You do this action when you heat solid butter or chocolate until it turns into liquid.” → Verb X
2. “You do this action when you cut vegetables into very small square cubes.” → Verb Y
3. “You do this action when you scatter salt, sugar or grated cheese lightly over a dish.” → Verb Z

Which option correctly identifies Verbs X, Y and Z?
option_a: X: Melt — Y: Dice — Z: Sprinkle
option_b: X: Melt — Y: Mash — Z: Drain
option_c: X: Roast — Y: Dice — Z: Whisk
option_d: X: Boil — Y: Peel — Z: Knead
explanation: Katı tereyağını veya çikolatayı sıvılaşana kadar ısıtmak "Melt" (X), sebzeleri küçük küpler halinde doğramak "Dice" (Y), yemeğin üzerine tuz/şeker/peynir serpmek ise "Sprinkle" (Z) fiilidir.

question_text:
Examine the two recipes below:
• Omelette: Whisk 2 eggs with salt in a bowl. Melt 1 teaspoon of butter in a pan, pour the eggs and cook for 3 minutes.
• Scrambled Eggs: Whisk 2 eggs with 2 tablespoons of milk and salt. Melt 1 teaspoon of butter in a pan, pour the mixture and stir continuously with a spatula while cooking.

According to the descriptions, what are the TWO differences between making Scrambled Eggs and an Omelette?
option_a: Adding flour and sugar to the eggs to make a sweet dessert
option_b: Boiling the eggs in their shells and peeling them under cold water
option_c: Adding milk to the eggs and stirring continuously while cooking in the pan
option_d: Using olive oil instead of butter and baking the eggs in the oven
explanation: İki tarif karşılaştırıldığında Scrambled Eggs tarifinde yumurtaya süt eklenmesi ("2 tablespoons of milk") ve tavada pişirirken spatulayla sürekli karıştırılması ("stir continuously") olmak üzere iki fark vardır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Mother: Did you add the baking powder to the cake batter, Elif?
Elif: Oh no! I already poured the batter into the baking pan, and I haven’t put it into the oven yet. Is it too late?
Mother: Don’t worry! Since it hasn’t entered the oven yet, pour the batter back into the bowl, add the baking powder, whisk for 30 seconds and pour it into the pan again.

Why was Elif able to fix her mistake?
option_a: Because her mother bought a ready-made cake from the bakery
option_b: Because she realized the missing ingredient before baking the batter in the oven
option_c: Because she had already baked the cake at 180°C for forty minutes
option_d: Because cakes rise much better without any baking powder or eggs
explanation: Elif kek harcını henüz fırına koymadan önce ("before baking the batter in the oven") eksik malzemeyi fark ettiği için hatasını telafi edebilmiştir.

question_text:
Look at the table showing how long different dishes take to prepare and cook:
Dish NamePreparation TimeCooking TimeCooking Method
Lentil Soup10 mins25 minsBoiling
Roasted Chicken15 mins55 minsRoasting in oven
Steamed Broccoli5 mins10 minsSteaming
Rice Pudding10 mins30 minsSimmering

Mr. Demir arrives home at 18:10. His guests are coming for dinner at 19:00. If he has only one stove and one oven, which dish can he NOT finish cooking before the guests arrive?
explanation: 18:10 ile 19:00 arasında 50 dakika vardır. Roasted Chicken 15 dk hazırlık + 55 dk pişirme = 70 dakika sürdüğü için konuklar gelmeden önce yetişmesi imkansızdır.

question_text:
Read the chef’s safety rules in the kitchen:
1. Never pour water into a pan with burning hot oil; cover it with a metal lid instead.
2. Always dry washed vegetables with a paper towel before putting them into hot oil so the oil doesn’t splash.
3. Use oven gloves when taking hot trays out of the oven.

Which accident happens if someone puts wet potatoes directly into hot frying oil?
option_a: The hot oil splashes out of the pan and may burn the person.
option_b: The potatoes freeze immediately inside the frying pan.
option_c: The potatoes taste too sweet like chocolate cake.
option_d: The oven door locks automatically for two hours.
explanation: 2. kurala göre yıkanmış sebzeler kurulanmadan kızgın yağa atılırsa yağ etrafa sıçrar ("splash") ve kişiyi yakabilir.

question_text:
Read the paragraph:
“Gaziantep is one of the most famous gastronomy cities in the world and is on the UNESCO Creative Cities list. Its cuisine combines fresh local ingredients like pistachios, lamb meat, garlic, dried eggplants and special spices. From rich soups like Beyran to world-famous sweet pastries like Baklava, every dish requires great skill and patience.”

We can understand from the text that Gaziantep cuisine ________.
option_a: uses imported frozen vegetables and fast-food cooking techniques
option_b: consists only of sweet desserts made with pistachios and sugar
option_c: is internationally recognized and offers both savory dishes and desserts
option_d: is easy to prepare in five minutes without any culinary skill
explanation: UNESCO listesinde yer alması uluslararası alanda tanındığını ("internationally recognized"), Beyran çorbasından Baklavaya uzanması ise hem tuzlu yemekler hem de tatlılar sunduğunu gösterir.

question_text:
Find the odd sentence out in the recipe:
(I) First, boil four potatoes in a pot until they become soft. (II) Second, peel the warm potatoes and mash them in a bowl with butter and milk. (III) Extreme sports like skydiving and rafting require safety helmets and life jackets. (IV) Finally, sprinkle some black pepper and grated cheese on top and serve hot.
explanation: Paragraf patates püresi tarifini anlatırken, III. cümle ekstrem sporlardan bahsederek anlam bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır.

question_text:
Look at the four dishes ordered at a table:
• Dish 1: Grilled sea bass with lemon and arugula.
• Dish 2: Spicy Mexican chili beef with red beans and hot peppers.
• Dish 3: Boiled chicken breast with steamed carrots (no salt, no spices).
• Dish 4: Fried potato chips with creamy garlic mayonnaise.

Grandpa had a stomach operation last month, so his doctor told him: “Never eat spicy, salty, fried or fatty food. Only eat boiled or steamed white meat and vegetables.”

Which dish is suitable for Grandpa?
explanation: Doktorun tuzsuz, baharatsız, kızartılmamış, haşlanmış veya buharda pişmiş beyaz et ve sebze tavsiyesine tam uyan yemek "Dish 3" (haşlanmış tavuk göğsü ve buharda havuç) seçeneğidir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Clara: This carrot cake is so moist and delicious! What did you put in it?
Beren: Besides grated carrots, flour, eggs and sugar, I added half a cup of crushed walnuts and a teaspoon of cinnamon. Also, I didn’t bake it too long—just 35 minutes at 170°C.

According to the dialogue, which ingredient is NOT in Beren’s carrot cake?
explanation: Beren kekin içinde rendelenmiş havuç, un, yumurta, şeker, ezilmiş ceviz ve tarçın olduğunu söylemiştir; kakao tozu ("Cocoa powder") yoktur.

question_text:
Examine the recipe puzzle:
“First, ________ the onions into small pieces and fry them in oil. Second, add the minced meat and stir for 5 minutes. Next, ________ the boiled potatoes with a fork in another bowl. Then, spread half of the mashed potatoes at the bottom of a baking tray, put the meat mixture in the middle, and cover with the rest of the potatoes. Finally, ________ it in the oven at 190°C until the top turns golden brown.”

Which verbs fill in the three blanks in order?
explanation: Soğanları küçük parçalara doğramak "chop", haşlanmış patatesleri çatalla ezmek "mash", fırında 190 derecede pişirmek ise "bake" fiilidir.

question_text:
Read the nutritionist’s article:
“Many people think healthy food is always tasteless and boring. In fact, you don’t need deep-frying or heavy cream sauces to make vegetables delicious. By roasting broccoli, cauliflower and carrots in the oven with a tablespoon of olive oil, garlic powder, thyme and lemon juice, you can create a crispy and tasty side dish with very few calories.”

What is the main idea of the article?
option_a: Vegetables only taste good when they are deep-fried in lots of vegetable oil.
option_b: Herbs, spices and oven-roasting can make healthy vegetables delicious without heavy oil or cream.
option_c: Heavy cream sauces have fewer calories than lemon juice and dried thyme.
option_d: People should stop eating broccoli and carrots if they want to lose weight.
explanation: Makalenin ana fikri; sağlıklı sebzelerin kızartma veya ağır krema sosları olmadan, fırınlama ("oven-roasting") ve baharatlarla düşük kalorili ve çok lezzetli hale getirilebileceğidir.

question_text:
Read the instructions on a packet of Instant Tomato Soup:
1. Empty the packet into a pot and add 5 glasses (1 liter) of cold water.
2. Stir well with a whisk before turning on the stove.
3. Cook over medium heat while stirring until it starts boiling.
4. After it boils, turn the heat down to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
5. Let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.

Why did Kerem’s soup become lumpy (full of dry powder balls)?
option_a: Because he waited for 3 minutes before pouring the soup into bowls.
option_b: Because he used 5 glasses of cold water as written on the packet.
option_c: Because he simmered the soup over low heat for 5 minutes.
option_d: Because he poured the powder into boiling water instead of stirring it in cold water first.
explanation: 1. ve 2. adımda tozun soğuk suya dökülüp ocağı açmadan önce çırpma teliyle iyice karıştırılması istenmektedir; doğrudan kaynar suya dökülürse topaklanır ("lumpy").

question_text:
Compare the two desserts:
• Fruit Yogurt Bowl: Mix a bowl of plain yogurt with diced fresh peaches, strawberries, a teaspoon of honey and oats. (No cooking needed — 10 mins)
• Apple Pie: Knead butter, flour and egg to make dough, roll it out, fill with cooked cinnamon apples, and bake at 180°C. (Prep + Bake — 65 mins)

Which of the following is TRUE about both desserts?
option_a: You need a rolling pin and flour to prepare the Fruit Yogurt Bowl.
option_b: Both desserts must be baked in a hot oven at 180°C for over an hour.
option_c: Both desserts contain fruit, but the Yogurt Bowl is much faster and requires no baking.
option_d: Neither of the desserts contains any sweet ingredients or fruit.
explanation: Her iki tatlı da meyve (şeftali/çilek ve elma) içermektedir; ancak Meyveli Yoğurt Kasesi pişirme gerektirmez ve çok daha hızlı (10 dk) hazırlanır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Customer: I ordered a medium-cooked steak, but this meat is almost black and super hard to chew!
Waiter: I apologize, sir. Our new cook left it on the grill for too long. I will bring you a freshly grilled steak right away.

What is the problem with the customer’s steak?
option_a: It is overcooked and burned on the grill.
option_b: It has too much sugar and honey on it.
option_c: It is completely raw and cold inside.
option_d: It was boiled in water instead of grilled.
explanation: Etin neredeyse siyah olması, çiğnenmesinin çok zor olması ve aşçının ızgarada çok uzun süre bırakması etin fazla pişip yandığını ("overcooked and burned") gösterir.

question_text:
Look at the pie chart of ingredients in Grandma’s 1000-gram Apple Cake:
• Apples: 350 g
• Flour: 250 g
• Sugar: 150 g
• Milk & Oil: 150 g
• Eggs & Walnuts: 100 g

According to the measurements above, which ingredient makes up MORE than one-third of the total weight of the cake?
explanation: 1000 gramın üçte biri yaklaşık 333 gramdır. 350 gram ile üçte birden fazlasını oluşturan tek malzeme elmadır ("Apples").

question_text:
Read the culinary note:
“Marinating meat means keeping raw meat or chicken in a mixture of olive oil, yogurt, grated onion, garlic and spices in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours before grilling. This process makes the meat much softer and richer in flavor.”

Why do chefs marinate meat before cooking?
option_a: To cook the meat completely inside the cold refrigerator
option_b: To avoid using any spices, olive oil or yogurt in the meal
option_c: To make the meat hard, dry and tasteless on the grill
option_d: To make the meat tender and more delicious when grilled
explanation: Marine etme işlemi eti çok daha yumuşak ("softer / tender") ve lezzet açısından zengin ("richer in flavor / more delicious") hale getirmek için yapılır.

question_text:
Chef’s Quiz:
• I am a white powder used to make bread, pasta and pastries.
• You mix me with water, yeast and salt to knead dough.
• People with celiac disease (gluten allergy) cannot eat products made from me.

What ingredient am I?
explanation: Ekmek, makarna ve hamur işi yapımında kullanılan, su ve mayayla yoğrulan ve gluten içeren beyaz toz malzeme buğday unudur ("Wheat flour").

question_text:
Secretary: Good morning, Star Company. How may I help you?
Caller: Hello! Could I speak to Mr. Brown, please?
Secretary: ________. I’ll put you through to his office.

Which phrase completes the secretary’s response?
option_c: He left the company last year
explanation: Sekreter arayan kişiyi Bay Brown'ın ofisine bağlayacağını ("I’ll put you through") söylediğine göre "Bir dakika bekleyin lütfen" ("Hold on a moment, please") demektedir.

question_text:
Caller: Hi, is Kerem there?
Kerem’s Mom: I’m afraid he isn’t available right now. He has gone to the library. ________?
Caller: Yes, please. Could you tell him to call Doruk back?

Which question completes the dialogue?
option_a: Would you like to leave a message
option_b: Can you put me through to the manager
option_c: Why are you calling him so late
option_d: When did you go to the library
explanation: Arayan kişi "Evet lütfen, Doruk'u geri aramasını söyler misiniz?" dediğine göre Kerem'in annesi "Mesaj bırakmak ister misiniz?" diye sormuştur.

question_text:
Tom: I’m sorry, I can’t hear you well. It’s a ________ line. Could you speak louder, please?

Which word completes Tom’s complaint about the phone connection?
explanation: Telefon hattında sesin iyi duyulmadığı bozuk bağlantılar için "It’s a bad line" ifadesi kullanılır.

question_text:
Look at the phone phrasal verbs and their meanings:
• Pick up: answer the phone
• Put through: connect someone on the phone
• ________: end a phone conversation

Which phrasal verb completes the table?
explanation: Telefon görüşmesini sonlandırmak (telefonu kapatmak) "Hang up" deyimsel fiiliyle ifade edilir.

question_text:
Sarah: I tried to call Emma three times, but her line is still ________. She must be talking to her grandmother.

Which adjective fits the sentence?
explanation: Birisiyle telefonda konuştuğu için hattın meşgul olduğunu ifade etmek üzere "engaged / busy" sıfatı kullanılır.

question_text:
Customer: Hello, I bought a washing machine from your store yesterday, but it isn’t working properly. I want to ________ about the faulty product.

Which verb completes the customer’s reason for calling?
explanation: Bozuk çıkan bir ürün hakkında şikayette bulunmak "make a complaint" ifadesiyle anlatılır.

question_text:
Receptionist: Hello, Grand Hotel. How can I help you?
Mr. Kaya: Hello, I’d like to ________ a double room for three nights starting from July 10.

Which verb fits the blank?
explanation: Otelde oda ayırtmak (rezervasyon yapmak) için "reserve / book" fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Wait, the phone is ringing! Don’t get up, Mom; I ________ it.

Which verb form is used for instant decisions made at the moment of speaking?
explanation: Konuşma anında verilen anlık kararlar ("instant decisions") için "will + V1" ("will answer") kullanılır.

question_text:
Lisa: Why do you prefer sending text messages to making phone calls?
Mark: Because texting is ________ and I can send messages even in quiet places like the library.

Which positive adjective completes Mark’s reason?
explanation: Kütüphane gibi sessiz yerlerde bile mesaj gönderilebilmesi mesajlaşmanın pratik ve ucuz ("practical and cheap") olma avantajını açıklar.

question_text:
Caller: May I speak to Dr. Evans, please?
Nurse: May I ask ________?
Caller: This is his patient, Robert Miller.

Which question does the nurse ask to learn the caller’s identity?
explanation: Telefonda arayan kişinin kim olduğunu öğrenmek için "May I ask who is calling?" (Kimin aradığını sorabilir miyim?) kalıbı kullanılır.

question_text:
If you see an injured person in a traffic accident in Türkiye, you should immediately ________ 112 for an ambulance.

Which verb completes the instruction?
explanation: Bir telefon numarasını tuşlamak/çevirmek için "dial" fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Bora: Why didn’t you answer my call an hour ago?
Sarp: Sorry, mate! My phone ran out of ________, so it turned off automatically.

Which word completes Sarp’s excuse?
explanation: Telefonun kendiliğinden kapanmasına neden olan durum şarjının/bataryasının bitmesidir ("ran out of battery").

question_text:
Look at the history of communication:
Smoke signals → Messenger birds → Printing press → Telegraph → Telephone → ________

Which modern device comes at the end of this timeline?
explanation: İletişim tarihi kronolojisinin en sonunda günümüzün modern cihazı olan akıllı telefonlar ("Smartphones") yer alır.

question_text:
Secretary: I’m sorry, Mr. Jenkins is in a meeting right now. I’ll tell him to ________ as soon as the meeting finishes.

Which phrase completes the sentence?
explanation: "Get back to someone" birine geri dönüş yapmak (geri aramak) anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Grandma: My eyesight isn’t very good, so I can’t read small text messages. I always prefer ________ communication or video calls to see my grandchildren.

Which phrase fits Grandma’s preference?
explanation: Küçük yazılı mesajları okuyamayan büyükanne torunlarını görmek için yüz yüze ("face-to-face") iletişimi veya görüntülü aramayı tercih eder.

question_text:
Operator: Could you please ________ your surname, madam? The connection is a bit noisy.
Caller: Sure! It is Y-I-L-M-A-Z.

Which verb completes the operator’s request?
explanation: Arayan kişi soyadını harf harf kodladığına göre operatör soyadını kodlamasını/harf harf söylemesini ("spell") istemiştir.

question_text:
Many teenagers use ________ applications on their smartphones to practice foreign languages and learn new vocabulary every day.

Which adjective completes the sentence?
explanation: Yabancı dil pratiği yapmak ve kelime öğrenmek için kullanılan uygulamalar eğitici ("educational") uygulamalardır.

question_text:
Mother: Don’t forget to write a short ________ and stick it on the fridge so your father sees the plumber’s phone number.

Which word means a short written note?
explanation: Kısa yazılı hatırlatma notuna "memo" denir.

question_text:
Customer Service: Thank you for calling Tech Support. Your call is important to us. Please ________ until the next available representative answers.

Which phrasal verb completes the recorded message?
explanation: Müşteri hizmetlerinde sıradaki temsilci yanıt verene kadar hatta kalınmasını/beklenmesini istemek için "hold on" kullanılır.

question_text:
Alex: Do you keep in touch with your primary school friends?
Nina: Yes! We have a group chat on a messaging app, so we ________ every day.

Which verb phrase completes the dialogue?
explanation: "Keep in touch" (iletişimde kalmak) ifadesini destekleyen seçenek her gün birbirleriyle iletişim kurmalarıdır ("communicate with each other").

question_text:
Put the sentences of the phone conversation in the correct order:
I. Hold on a moment, please. I’ll check if she is in her office... I’m sorry, her line is engaged.
II. Good afternoon, Green Valley Clinic. How may I help you?
III. Yes, please. Could you tell her that Mrs. Tekin called about her blood test results?
IV. Good afternoon. Could I speak to Dr. Aydın, please?
V. Would you like to leave a message for her?

What is the correct order?
explanation: Telefon önce kliniğin açılış cümlesiyle (II) başlar, arayan Dr. Aydın'ı ister (IV), sekreter kontrol edip hattın meşgul olduğunu söyler (I), mesaj bırakmak isteyip istemediğini sorar (V) ve arayan mesajını bırakır (III).

question_text:
NamePreferred Way of CommunicationReason
CemSending text messages & emojisQuick and doesn’t disturb people
DeryaMaking video callsSeeing facial expressions of friends
EmreWriting emailsSending long project files easily
FatmaMeeting face-to-faceMore sincere and warm than screens

According to the table, who prefers using technology to both hear and see the other person live while talking?
explanation: Teknoloji kullanarak konuşurken karşı tarafın yüz ifadelerini canlı görmeyi ("Seeing facial expressions") sağlayan görüntülü aramayı ("video calls") tercih eden kişi Derya'dır.

question_text:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Why Adults Use Smartphone Apps Most" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "35%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Ordering food." size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 50.0 P d1 119.9 50.0 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 44.0 "30%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Learning fore." size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 90.0 P d2 188.4 90.0 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 84.0 "20%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Finding direc." size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 110.0 P d3 256.9 110.0 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 104.0 "15%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Mobile bankin." size=10 ```
According to the chart, which statement is CORRECT?
option_a: Nobody uses smartphone applications for shopping or food delivery.
option_b: More adults use apps to find their way in traffic than to order food.
option_c: Paying bills via mobile banking is the most common reason for using apps.
option_d: More than a quarter of adults use smartphone apps for educational language practice.
explanation: Yetişkinlerin %30'u (yani %25 olan çeyrekten fazlası / "more than a quarter") akıllı telefon uygulamalarını yabancı dil öğrenmek için kullanmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the phone message memo on the desk:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "WHILE YOU WERE OUT" size=9 bold text 170 46 "To: Mr. Erdem | Date: May 14, 10:30 a.m." size=9 text 170 68 "From: Ms. Selin Kurt (Sunrise Architecture)" size=9 text 170 90 "Phone: 0212-555-0199" size=9 text 170 112 "Message: The meeting on Thursday is postponed to Friday at 2 p.m." size=9 text 170 134 "Action: Please call her back to confirm." size=9``` According to the memo above, why did Ms. Selin Kurt call Mr. Erdem?
option_a: To inform him that the time of their meeting has been changed
option_b: To invite him to a birthday party on Thursday morning
option_c: To apply for a secretary job at Mr. Erdem’s company
option_d: To complain about a broken computer she bought yesterday
explanation: Notta Perşembe günkü toplantının Cuma saat 14:00'e ertelendiği ("postponed to Friday at 2 p.m.") yazılıdır; yani toplantı zamanının değiştiğini bildirmek için aramıştır.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Customer Service: Hello, Fast Air Airlines. How can I help you?
Passenger: Hello. I booked a flight from Ankara to Antalya for tomorrow morning (Flight FA-204), but I need to change it to Sunday evening.
Customer Service: Let me check... Yes, there is a seat available on Sunday at 19:30. May I have your reservation code, please?

Why is the passenger calling the airline company?
option_a: To cancel his hotel booking in Ankara
option_b: To change the date and time of his flight reservation
option_c: To report a lost suitcase at Antalya Airport
option_d: To ask for the price of a train ticket to İstanbul
explanation: Yolcu yarın sabahki uçuşunu Pazar akşamına değiştirmesi gerektiğini ("need to change it to Sunday evening") söylediği için uçuş rezervasyonunun tarih ve saatini değiştirmek amacıyla aramaktadır.

question_text:
Read the text about smartphone addiction:
“Smartphones make our lives much easier, from instant messaging to online banking. However, staring at the screen for 7–8 hours a day causes serious health and social problems such as eye strain, neck pain, sleep disorders, and spending less quality time with family members.”

Which of the following is mentioned as a NEGATIVE effect of excessive smartphone use?
option_a: Having stronger relationships with family members at home
option_b: Paying electricity bills quickly through mobile banking
option_c: Having difficulty sleeping well and hurting your eyes and neck
option_d: Sending instant messages to friends in emergencies
explanation: Günde 7-8 saat ekrana bakmanın olumsuz etkileri olarak göz yorgunluğu ("eye strain"), boyun ağrısı ("neck pain") ve uyku bozuklukları ("sleep disorders") sayılmıştır.

question_text:
Caller: Hello! Is this 0312-444-0909?
Receiver: No, sir. Our number ends with 0990, not 0909. And this is a private house, not the dentist’s clinic.
Caller: Oh, excuse me! I dialed the last two digits incorrectly. Have a nice day!

What happened in the dialogue above?
option_a: The phone connection was cut off because of a storm.
option_b: The caller made an appointment with the dentist for tomorrow.
option_c: The receiver put the caller through to the doctor’s office.
option_d: The caller dialed the wrong phone number by mistake.
explanation: Arayan kişi son iki rakamı yanlış tuşladığını ("dialed the last two digits incorrectly") söyleyerek özür dilemiştir; yani yanlış numarayı aramıştır.

question_text:
Look at the pros and cons list prepared by 8th-grade students:
• Group 1: Easy to carry in pocket / Quick access to emergency help / Helpful navigation apps
• Group 2: Causes lack of concentration in class / Risk of cyberbullying / Reduces face-to-face communication

What are the best titles for Group 1 and Group 2?
option_a: Group 1: Advantages of Smartphones — Group 2: Disadvantages of Smartphones
option_b: Group 1: Disadvantages of Smartphones — Group 2: Advantages of Smartphones
option_c: Group 1: History of the Telegraph — Group 2: Benefits of Smoke Signals
option_d: Group 1: How to Cook Pasta — Group 2: Kitchen Safety Rules
explanation: Group 1 akıllı telefonların olumlu yönlerini (avantajlarını / pros), Group 2 ise olumsuz yönlerini (dezavantajlarını / cons) sıralamaktadır.

question_text:
Read the four phone calls made by Arzu today:
• 10:00 a.m. — To City Library: “Could I extend the return date of the novel I borrowed for one more week?”
• 12:30 p.m. — To Green Café: “Could you deliver two vegetable pizzas to our office address?”
• 03:00 p.m. — To Tech Store: “The headphones I bought yesterday don’t work on the left side.”
• 05:30 p.m. — To Best Friend: “Let’s meet at the cinema at 7 p.m. tonight!”

At what time did Arzu make a phone call to report a broken product?
explanation: Dün aldığı kulaklığın sol tarafının çalışmadığını (bozuk ürün bildirimini) saat 03:00 p.m.'de Tech Store'u arayarak yapmıştır.

question_text:
Secretary: Mr. Demir is out of the office until 3 p.m. Would you like to leave a message?
Mr. Wilson: Yes, please. Tell him that I’m flying to Berlin tonight, so he can reach me via my email address instead of my office phone tomorrow.

How should Mr. Demir contact Mr. Wilson tomorrow?
option_a: By calling his office landline phone
option_d: By visiting his office in Ankara
explanation: Bay Wilson bu gece Berlin'e uçacağı için yarın kendisine ofis telefonu yerine e-posta adresi üzerinden ("via my email address") ulaşılabileceğini belirtmiştir.

question_text:
Read the text:
“Before Alexander Graham Bell patented the telephone in 1876, people used the telegraph to send urgent messages over long distances. However, the telegraph could only transmit short and long electrical signals called Morse code, not the human voice. The invention of the telephone allowed people to hear each other’s real voices live for the first time.”

What was the main difference between the telegraph and the telephone?
option_a: People could make live video calls using the telegraph in 1876.
option_b: The telegraph was invented fifty years after the smartphone.
option_c: Alexander Graham Bell used pigeons to carry telegraph cables.
option_d: The telephone transmitted real human voices, while the telegraph only sent coded signals.
explanation: Metne göre telgraf sadece Mors alfabesi denilen kodlu elektrik sinyallerini iletirken, telefon ilk kez gerçek insan sesini canlı olarak iletmiştir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Pelin: Hi Ece! I’m outside your apartment building, and I’m ringing the doorbell, but nobody is opening!
Ece: Oh, Pelin! Didn’t you see my text message? My mom and I came to the supermarket ten minutes ago. Wait for us at the park bench across the street; we’ll be back in five minutes!
Pelin: My mobile data was turned off, so I didn’t receive your message. Okay, I’ll wait on the bench.

Why didn’t Pelin know that Ece was at the supermarket?
option_a: Because her internet connection on her phone was off, so she didn’t get the text
option_b: Because Ece’s phone was broken and out of battery all day
option_c: Because Ece forgot to send any message before leaving home
option_d: Because Pelin went to the wrong apartment building on another street
explanation: Pelin mobil verisi kapalı olduğu için ("My mobile data was turned off") Ece'nin gönderdiği mesajı alamamıştır.

question_text:
Examine the emergency numbers in Türkiye:
Today, all emergency services in Türkiye—including Ambulance, Fire Department, Police, Gendarmerie, and Forest Fire—are united under a single emergency number: 112.

Why is uniting all emergency numbers under 112 a big advantage for citizens?
option_a: Citizens are not allowed to call for an ambulance when someone is sick.
option_b: People don’t have to remember different numbers in stressful emergency moments.
option_c: Only tourists can dial 112 when they lose their passports.
option_d: It takes much longer to reach the fire department during a fire.
explanation: Tüm acil servislerin tek bir numarada (112) birleştirilmesi, stresli ve panik anlarında insanların farklı numaraları hatırlamak zorunda kalmaması açısından büyük kolaylıktır.

question_text:
Look at the icons on a smartphone screen during a call:
• Microphone with a slash (Mute): Turns off your microphone so the other person cannot hear your voice.
• Speaker icon: Turns on the loudspeaker so everyone in the room can hear the caller.
• Keypad icon: Opens the number buttons during a call.
• Red phone icon: Ends the phone call.

If you are talking to your grandmother and your whole family in the living room wants to hear her voice too, which icon should you tap?
explanation: Odadaki herkesin arayan kişinin sesini duyabilmesi için hoparlörü açan "Speaker icon" düğmesine dokunulmalıdır.

question_text:
Read the four sentences:
1. “Could you put me through to extension 405, please?”
2. “I’m afraid the manager is not available at the moment.”
3. “I’ll get back to you in ten minutes.”
4. “May I speak to the headmaster, please?”

Which two sentences are spoken by the CALLER (the person who makes the call)?
explanation: 1. cümle ("Beni dahili 405'e bağlar mısınız?") ve 4. cümle ("Okul müdürüyle görüşebilir miyim?") arayan kişi ("caller") tarafından söylenir; 2 ve 3 ise telefonu açan sekreter/alıcı tarafından söylenir.

question_text: Situation: You are the secretary at an international company. A British customer calls and speaks very fast. You cannot understand his company’s name. How do you ask him to repeat it politely?
option_a: “I’m sorry, I couldn’t catch that. Could you speak more slowly and repeat your company’s name, please?”
option_b: “Hold on, I will put you through to the wrong department immediately.”
option_c: “No, I don’t want to take any message from your company today.”
option_d: “You speak too fast! Hang up the phone and write a letter instead!”
explanation: Telefonda söylenen bir şeyi anlayamadığımızda kibarca tekrar etmesini istemek için "I’m sorry, I couldn’t catch that. Could you speak more slowly and repeat..., please?" denir.

question_text:
Read the statement:
“In the 15th century, Johannes Gutenberg invented the printing press. Before this invention, books were copied by hand, so they were very rare and expensive. Thanks to the printing press, thousands of books and newspapers were printed quickly, and knowledge spread across the world.”

How did the invention of the printing press change communication?
option_a: It caused books to become much more expensive and harder to find.
option_b: It made books affordable and helped information reach large numbers of people rapidly.
option_c: It allowed people to send instant voice messages via satellites.
option_d: It replaced smartphones and computers in the 21st century.
explanation: Matbaanın icadıyla kitaplar hızla basılıp ucuzlamış ve bilginin geniş kitlelere hızla yayılması sağlanmıştır.

question_text:
Mother: Your grandfather is trying to call us on video chat, but he says he can only see a black screen on his side!
Son: Let me look at our tablet, Mom... Haha, you accidentally turned off the front camera! Let me tap the camera button.

Why couldn’t the grandfather see them during the video call?
option_a: Because the son dialed the wrong phone number
option_b: Because the grandfather’s house had no electricity
option_c: Because the tablet’s front camera was switched off
option_d: Because they were sending a fax message instead of calling
explanation: Annesi yanlışlıkla tabletin ön kamerasını kapattığı ("turned off the front camera") için büyükbaba siyah ekran görmüştür.

question_text:
Read the two phone conversations below:
Call 1 (10:15 a.m.):
Receptionist: Blue Sky Dental Clinic, how can I help you?
Mr. Aksoy: Hello, I have a toothache. Could I make an appointment with Dr. Yıldız for this afternoon?
Receptionist: Dr. Yıldız has only one free slot today, at 3:30 p.m. Does that suit you?
Mr. Aksoy: Perfect! Please book it for Tarık Aksoy.

Call 2 (01:45 p.m.):
Mr. Aksoy: Hello, this is Tarık Aksoy again. I have an emergency meeting at my office at 3:00 p.m. today. Can we move my dental appointment to tomorrow morning at 10:00 a.m.?
Receptionist: Let me check... Yes, Mr. Aksoy, I’ve updated your appointment to tomorrow at 10:00 a.m.

According to the two phone calls, which of the following is CORRECT?
option_a: The receptionist refused to change Mr. Aksoy’s appointment time during the second call.
option_b: Mr. Aksoy canceled his dental treatment completely because his toothache stopped.
option_c: Dr. Yıldız examined Mr. Aksoy’s tooth at half past three in the afternoon today.
option_d: Mr. Aksoy postponed his dental appointment to the next morning because of an urgent work meeting.
explanation: İlk aramada bugün 15:30'a randevu alan Bay Aksoy, ikinci aramada saat 15:00'te acil bir iş toplantısı çıktığı için randevusunu ertesi sabah saat 10:00'a erteletmiştir.

question_text:
Company ExtensionDepartmentStaff MemberCurrent Status (14:00)
Ext. 101General ManagerMrs. KorkmazIn a board meeting until 15:30
Ext. 102Customer SupportMr. ŞahinAvailable at his desk
Ext. 103Accounting & BillsMs. DemirTalking on another line (Engaged)
Ext. 104Technical ServiceMr. PolatOut of office for a repair

At 14:00, a customer calls the switchboard operator and says: “Hello, there is a mistake in the invoice (bill) you sent me this morning. Could you connect me to the relevant person?”

What will the operator tell the customer after checking the table?
option_a: “I’m putting you through to Mr. Şahin at extension 104 immediately.”
option_b: “Mrs. Korkmaz is available at extension 103 to check your invoice.”
option_c: “I tried to put you through to Ms. Demir at extension 103, but her line is engaged right now.”
option_d: “Ms. Demir is out of the office for a repair, please call next week.”
explanation: Fatura ("invoice / bill") sorunu için Muhasebe ve Faturalar ("Accounting & Bills") bölümündeki Ms. Demir'e (Dahili 103) bağlanması gerekir; ancak saat 14:00'te onun hattı meşguldür ("Engaged").

question_text:
Examine the results of a survey conducted with 100 teenagers and 100 elderly people (65+):
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Most Preferred Mobile Communication Method (%)" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 48.7 P d0 51.4 48.7 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 42.7 "65%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Instant Messa." size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 142.0 P d1 119.9 142.0 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 136.0 "15%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Instant Messa." size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 132.7 P d2 188.4 132.7 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 126.7 "20%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Voice Calls (." size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 30.0 P d3 256.9 30.0 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 24.0 "75%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Voice Calls (." size=10 ```
(The remaining percentages belong to video calls.)

Which conclusion can be drawn from the chart above?
option_a: Video calling is the most popular communication method for both age groups.
option_b: Elderly people prefer hearing the other person’s voice on a phone call much more than texting.
option_c: Teenagers make voice calls more frequently than elderly people do.
option_d: More than half of the elderly people prefer sending text messages to making voice calls.
explanation: Yaşlıların %75'i sesli aramayı ("Voice Calls"), sadece %15'i yazılı mesajlaşmayı tercih etmektedir; yani karşı tarafın sesini duymayı mesajlaşmaya göre çok daha fazla tercih etmektedirler.

question_text:
Read the dialogue between a mother and her 14-year-old son, Kaan:
Mother: Kaan, a delivery courier called the landline phone ten minutes ago while you were in the shower.
Kaan: Was it about my new science books?
Mother: Yes! He said nobody opened the door yesterday, so they left the package at the Central Post Office Branch. You need to pick it up before Friday with the tracking code TR-8492.
Kaan: Thanks for writing down the code, Mom! I’ll go there after school tomorrow.

Which of the following is FALSE according to the conversation?
option_a: The courier delivered the books directly to Kaan’s mother at the door today.
option_b: Kaan’s mother took a message and noted the tracking number for her son.
option_c: Kaan must go to the post office branch before Friday to get his package.
option_d: Kaan couldn’t answer the landline phone because he was taking a shower.
explanation: Kurye dün kapıyı kimse açmadığı için paketi Merkez PTT Şubesine bıraktıklarını telefonla bildirmiştir; kitapları bugün kapıda annesine teslim etmemiştir.

question_text:
Look at the flowchart of an Automated Call Center (IVR):
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "Welcome to SmartBank Call Center" size=9 bold text 170 46 "Press 1 for Turkish / Press 2 for English" size=9 text 170 68 "Main Menu: Press 1 for Lost Card | Press 2 for Credit Cards | Press 3 for Loans" size=9 text 170 90 "Press 0 to speak to a Customer Representative" size=9 text 170 112 "Under Menu 2 (Credit Cards): Press 1 for Debt Inquiry | Press 2 for Limit Increase" size=9 text 170 134 "Press 9 to return to the Main Menu" size=9``` Mr. John Smith, an English-speaking tourist, wants to increase the limit of his credit card. Which sequence of buttons should he press on his phone keypad?
explanation: İngilizce için önce 2 ("Press 2 for English"), ardından Ana Menüde Kredi Kartları için 2 ("Press 2 for Credit Cards"), ve alt menüde Limit Artırımı için 2 ("Press 2 for Limit Increase") tuşlanmalıdır: 2 → 2 → 2.

question_text:
Read the four customer complaints left on an online store’s voicemail:
• Customer 1: “I ordered a blue medium sweater, but you sent me a red extra-large one!”
• Customer 2: “It has been two weeks since I paid for the toaster, and it still hasn’t arrived!”
• Customer 3: “When I opened the box, the glass screen of the tablet was cracked in the middle.”
• Customer 4: “The price on your website was 400 TL, but you charged 500 TL from my credit card.”

Which option correctly matches the customers with their complaint topics?
option_a: 1: Late delivery — 2: Wrong item — 3: Billing error — 4: Damaged product
option_b: 1: Damaged product — 2: Late delivery — 3: Wrong item — 4: Billing error
option_c: 1: Wrong item — 2: Late delivery — 3: Damaged product — 4: Billing error
option_d: 1: Wrong item — 2: Damaged product — 3: Late delivery — 4: Billing error
explanation: Mavi M beden yerine kırmızı XL gelmesi "Wrong item" (1), iki haftadır teslim edilmemesi "Late delivery" (2), ekranın çatlak çıkması "Damaged product" (3), 400 TL yerine 500 TL çekilmesi ise "Billing error" (4) ile eşleşir.

question_text:
Read the article about “Phubbing”:
“Have you ever tried to talk to a friend at a café while they kept looking at their smartphone screen instead of your face? This rude habit is called phubbing (phone + snubbing). Studies show that constantly checking notifications during a face-to-face conversation makes the other person feel unimportant and damages close friendships.”

According to the article, how can we avoid “phubbing” when meeting our friends?
option_a: By checking our social media notifications every two minutes while talking
option_b: By putting our phones away on silent mode and making eye contact with our friends
option_c: By playing mobile games at the café table instead of listening to our friends
option_d: By never meeting our friends face-to-face at cafés or parks
explanation: Yüz yüze sohbet sırasında sürekli bildirimlere bakmak arkadaşlığı zedelediği için, telefonları sessize alıp kaldırarak arkadaşımızla göz teması kurmak "phubbing" alışkanlığını önler.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Selin: Hello, may I speak to Mrs. Özkan, the head of the charity organization?
Assistant: Hold on, please... I’m sorry, she has just stepped out of her room to welcome guests from UNICEF. Would you like to hold or leave a message?
Selin: I don’t want to keep the line busy. Please tell her that Selin from Atatürk Secondary School called. Our students collected 15 boxes of storybooks and toys for village schools. My number is 0532-000-1122.

Why is Selin calling Mrs. Özkan?
option_a: To arrange the donation of books and toys collected by her school’s students
option_b: To invite the guests from UNICEF to a music concert in the evening
option_c: To ask Mrs. Özkan to donate 15 computers to Atatürk Secondary School
option_d: To complain that the village school library is closed at weekends
explanation: Selin okullarındaki öğrencilerin köy okulları için 15 kutu hikaye kitabı ve oyuncak topladığını söyleyerek bu bağışı ulaştırmak amacıyla yardım kuruluşunun başkanını aramaktadır.

question_text:
