Examine the timeline of communication milestones:
• 1837: Samuel Morse develops the electric telegraph and Morse code.
• 1876: Alexander Graham Bell makes the first voice call on the telephone.
• 1973: Martin Cooper makes the first handheld mobile phone call in New York (the phone weighed 1.1 kg!).
• 1992: The first SMS text message (“Merry Christmas”) is sent.
• 2007: Modern touchscreen smartphones with internet apps become widespread.

According to the timeline above, which statement is TRUE?
option_a: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone before the electric telegraph was developed.
option_b: Samuel Morse sent the first SMS text message using the telegraph in 1837.
option_c: The first handheld mobile phone in 1973 had a touchscreen and weighed only 100 grams.
option_d: People were able to make mobile voice calls nearly twenty years before the first SMS was sent.
explanation: İlk taşınabilir cep telefonu araması 1973'te, ilk SMS ise 1992'de (yaklaşık 19-20 yıl sonra) gönderilmiştir.

question_text:
Read the three phone messages received by Mert between 16:00 and 16:10:
• 16:02 (Mom): “Mert, buy two loaves of bread on your way home at 17:00.”
• 16:05 (Coach): “Today’s basketball practice at 16:30 is canceled because the gym roof is leaking.”
• 16:08 (Can): “Since practice is canceled, let’s study for the English quiz at my house until 17:30!”

If Mert wants to obey his mother’s request to be home with bread at 17:00, what should he text back to Can?
option_a: “Sorry, I am already at the bakery and I won’t study for the English quiz.”
option_b: “I can only study with you until 16:45 because I need to buy bread and be home at 17:00.”
option_c: “I can’t come because I have basketball practice at the gym at 16:30 today.”
option_d: “Great! I will stay at your house until 19:00 and we can order pizza.”
explanation: Antrenman iptal olduğu için Mert'in 17:00'ye kadar vakti vardır; ancak 17:00'de ekmek alıp evde olması gerektiği için Can'a saat 16:45'e kadar birlikte çalışabileceklerini söylemesi en mantıklı yanıttır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Operator: Emergency 112, what is your emergency?
Caller: There is smoke coming out of the third-floor window of the apartment across from the City Museum!
Operator: Is anyone trapped inside the flat?
Caller: I see an elderly woman on the balcony waving for help! Please hurry!
Operator: Stay calm, sir. The fire trucks and an ambulance are already on their way to the City Museum street. Do not enter the burning building.

Which information did the caller give to the 112 operator?
option_a: That he entered the building and put out the fire by himself
option_b: The name and phone number of the elderly woman on the balcony
option_c: The exact location of the fire and that a person is stuck on the balcony
option_d: The cause of the fire inside the kitchen of the third-floor flat
explanation: Arayan kişi yangının tam yerini ("across from the City Museum, third-floor") ve balkonda yardım isteyen yaşlı bir kadının mahsur kaldığını operatöre bildirmiştir.

question_text:
Look at the table comparing four smartphone applications:
App NameCategoryPriceMain Feature
LinguaGoEducationFreeTeaches 12 languages with daily voice quizzes
QuickBiteFood & DrinkFreeOrders meals from 500 local restaurants
SafePathNavigation40 TL/monthShows offline mountain maps & compass for hikers
TuneBoxMusic30 TL/monthStreams millions of songs without advertisements

Which of the following is CORRECT according to the table?
option_a: You don’t need to pay any subscription fee to practice foreign languages or order food.
option_b: LinguaGo is more expensive per month than TuneBox and SafePath.
option_c: TuneBox helps trekkers find their directions when there is no internet.
option_d: SafePath is a free application designed for ordering meals in the mountains.
explanation: Tabloya göre yabancı dil öğreten LinguaGo ve yemek sipariş edilen QuickBite uygulamaları ücretsizdir ("Free").

question_text:
Find the odd sentence out in the paragraph:
(I) Smartphones have become an essential tool for modern people to stay connected. (II) With a single device, we can make video calls, send instant messages, and translate foreign texts. (III) Before baking the apple pie, you must knead the dough and preheat the oven to 180 degrees. (IV) However, experts remind us to use smartphones responsibly so they don’t harm our social lives.
explanation: Paragraf akıllı telefonların iletişimdeki yeri ve sorumlu kullanımını anlatırken, III. cümle elmalı turta tarifinden bahsederek bütünlüğü bozmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Mr. Carter: Hello, I’m calling from Room 308. The air conditioner in my room is making a terrible noise and blowing warm air.
Hotel Reception: We are very sorry for the inconvenience, Mr. Carter. I’ll send our technician to Room 308 in five minutes. If he cannot fix it immediately, we will move you to a quiet deluxe room on the fourth floor.

How does the hotel reception handle Mr. Carter’s complaint?
option_a: By ignoring the phone call and hanging up on the hotel guest
option_b: By asking Mr. Carter to pay extra money for calling the reception
option_c: Politely and helpfully, by sending a repairman and offering a room change if needed
option_d: Rudely, by telling Mr. Carter to repair the air conditioner by himself
explanation: Otel resepsiyonu özür dileyerek 5 dakika içinde teknisyen göndereceğini, hemen tamir edilemezse dördüncü katta sessiz bir odaya geçireceklerini söyleyerek çok nazik ve çözüm odaklı yaklaşmıştır.

question_text:
Read the four students’ comments on how they communicate with their grandparents:
• Ege: “My grandparents live in the flat downstairs, so I visit them and talk face-to-face every evening.”
• Lale: “My grandma lives in Germany. We make a WhatsApp video call every Sunday morning.”
• Ozan: “My grandpa doesn’t use a smartphone or internet, so I call his home landline phone twice a week.”
• Sinem: “I love sending handmade postcards and letters to my grandparents on special holidays.”

Who uses a traditional postal method to keep in touch with her/his grandparents?
explanation: Özel günlerde el yapımı kartpostal ve mektup ("postcards and letters") gönderen Sinem geleneksel posta yöntemini kullanmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Defne: Hi Burcu, I’m calling to ask about tomorrow’s science presentation. What time is our turn?
Burcu: Defne, your voice is breaking up... I only heard the word “science”... Are you on the subway?
Defne: Yes, the train is entering an underground tunnel right now! I’ll text you when I get off at the next station.

Why couldn’t Burcu understand what Defne was asking?
option_a: Because the mobile signal was weak inside the underground subway tunnel
option_b: Because Burcu didn’t prepare anything for the science presentation
option_c: Because Burcu’s smartphone fell into water and stopped working
option_d: Because Defne spoke in a foreign language that Burcu didn’t know
explanation: Tren yer altı tünelinden geçerken telefon sinyali zayıfladığı için Defne'nin sesi kesik kesik gelmiş ("voice is breaking up") ve Burcu soruyu anlayamamıştır.

question_text:
Examine the chart showing what happens in 1 minute of mobile communication around the world:
• 41 million instant messages are sent.
• 1.4 million voice & video calls are made.
• 200,000 apps are downloaded.
• 150,000 photos are shared via messaging apps.

Which of the following is CORRECT according to the statistics above?
option_a: More photos are shared per minute than voice and video calls are made.
option_b: Downloading mobile applications is more frequent than sending instant messages.
option_c: Nobody makes voice calls anymore because instant messaging is free.
option_d: People send far more text messages per minute than they make voice or video calls.
explanation: Dakikada 41 milyon anlık mesaj gönderilirken 1,4 milyon sesli/görüntülü arama yapılmaktadır; yani yazılı mesaj sayısı aramalardan katbekat fazladır.

question_text:
Read the short note left by the secretary for Mrs. Tekin:
“Mrs. Tekin, Mr. Kaya from Star Printing Press called at 11:20. The 500 brochures for our company exhibition are ready. However, their delivery van broke down today. If we need the brochures before tomorrow morning, someone from our office must pick them up from their printing shop before 6 p.m.”

Why can’t Star Printing Press deliver the brochures to Mrs. Tekin’s office today?
option_a: Because Mrs. Tekin’s office is closed all day today
option_b: Because their delivery vehicle has a mechanical problem
option_c: Because the company exhibition was canceled last week
option_d: Because they haven’t finished printing the 500 brochures yet
explanation: Notta matbaanın dağıtım aracının bugün arızalandığı ("their delivery van broke down today") belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
Match the phone situations with the most appropriate responses:
1. Someone asks to speak to your sister, who is in her room right now.
2. The person on the phone speaks too quietly and you can’t hear them.
3. You call a company and the secretary says the manager is in a meeting.

a. “Could you speak up a bit, please? I can barely hear you.”
b. “Hold on a second, I’ll get her.”
c. “Could you ask him to call me back when he is free?”

Which matching is CORRECT?
explanation: Kardeşiniz odasındaysa "Bir saniye bekleyin, onu çağırayım" (1-b); karşı taraf çok kısık sesle konuşuyorsa "Biraz yüksek sesle konuşabilir misiniz?" (2-a); müdür toplantıdaysa "Müsait olduğunda beni geri aramasını söyler misiniz?" (3-c) denir.

question_text:
Read the text about Sign Language Video Calls:
“Before video calling technology became available on smartphones, deaf and hearing-impaired people could only use text messages to communicate on mobile phones. Today, thanks to high-speed 4G and 5G video calls, they can communicate in sign language live with their friends, family, and even specially trained 112 emergency operators!”

How did video calling technology improve the lives of hearing-impaired people?
option_a: It enabled them to use sign language live on phone calls, including emergency services.
option_b: It forced them to stop using sign language and only write long letters.
option_c: It made mobile phones much heavier and impossible to carry in pockets.
option_d: It prevented them from contacting 112 emergency operators.
explanation: Görüntülü arama teknolojisi sayesinde işitme engelli bireyler hem yakınlarıyla hem de özel eğitimli 112 acil operatörleriyle canlı olarak işaret diliyle ("sign language") iletişim kurabilmektedir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Caller: Hello, is this the Vet Clinic? My cat swallowed a small plastic button five minutes ago!
Vet Assistant: Stay calm, madam. Is the cat breathing normally right now?
Caller: Yes, she is breathing, but she looks uncomfortable.
Vet Assistant: Do not try to make her vomit and do not give her any food or water. Bring her to our clinic immediately; Dr. Aras is waiting for you in Emergency Room 1.

What did the vet assistant advise the cat owner NOT to do?
option_a: Not to let Dr. Aras examine the cat in Emergency Room 1
option_b: Not to bring the cat to the veterinary clinic today
option_c: Not to stay calm while coming to the emergency room
option_d: Not to feed the cat or try to make her throw up before arriving at the clinic
explanation: Veteriner asistanı kedi sahibine kediyi kusturmaya çalışmamasını ve hiçbir yiyecek/su vermemesini ("Do not try to make her vomit and do not give her any food or water") söylemiştir.

question_text:
Look at the phone bill summary of Mr. Tekin for October:
• Monthly Package Fee (1000 mins + 1000 SMS + 15 GB Internet): 200 TL
• Used Minutes: 650 mins (Extra cost: 0 TL)
• Used SMS: 120 SMS (Extra cost: 0 TL)
• Used Internet: 18 GB (3 GB over the limit → 50 TL per extra GB)

How much will Mr. Tekin pay in total for his October phone bill?
explanation: Paket ücreti 200 TL'dir. Dakika ve SMS sınırını aşmamıştır; ancak 15 GB internet sınırını 3 GB aşmıştır. Ekstra her GB 50 TL olduğundan 3 × 50 = 150 TL aşım ücreti öder. Toplam fatura: 200 + 150 = 350 TL.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Paul: Did you call the ticket office for Saturday’s theatre play?
Mark: Yes, I just hung up. Unfortunately, all tickets for Saturday evening are sold out. The clerk said there are still front-row tickets for the Sunday matinee at 2 p.m., so I reserved two seats for us.
Paul: Great decision! Sunday afternoon is completely fine for me.

What did Mark do during his phone call with the ticket office?
option_a: He refused to buy any tickets because Paul is busy on Sunday afternoon.
option_b: He canceled the theatre play because the actors were sick.
option_c: He booked two tickets for Sunday afternoon since Saturday’s tickets were sold out.
option_d: He bought two front-row tickets for Saturday evening’s theatre performance.
explanation: Cumartesi akşamı biletleri tükendiği ("sold out") için Pazar saat 14:00 matinesinden ön sırada iki koltuk ayırtmıştır ("reserved two seats").

question_text:
Examine the meanings of four common phone idioms/phrases:
• “You’re breaking up” → Your voice is cutting in and out because of bad signal.
• “I’ll put you on speaker” → I’m turning on the loudspeaker.
• “We got cut off” → The phone connection ended suddenly by accident.
• “Give me a ring” → Call me on the phone.

Which sentence uses one of the phrases above INCORRECTLY?
option_a: “My mom bought me a golden ring for my finger, so she said: We got cut off!”
option_b: “I can’t understand you because you’re breaking up; please walk to a window.”
option_c: “Give me a ring as soon as your plane lands in İzmir.”
option_d: “Sorry, we got cut off when my train entered the tunnel!”
explanation: "We got cut off" telefon bağlantısının aniden kesilmesi demektir; parmağa altın yüzük almakla hiçbir ilgisi yoktur.

question_text:
Read the school announcement:
“Dear students, according to our new school policy, students must switch off their smartphones and place them in the classroom locker at 08:20 a.m. You can take your phones back at 15:20 p.m. If parents need to reach a student urgently during school hours, they can call the school secretary at 0216-111-2233.”

According to the announcement, how can a mother contact her son at 11:30 a.m. in case of an emergency?
option_a: By calling her son’s mobile phone directly during math class
option_b: By sending a WhatsApp message to her son’s smartphone at 11:30
option_c: She cannot contact her son in any way until the next week
option_d: By calling the school secretary’s landline number
explanation: 08:20 ile 15:20 arasında öğrencilerin telefonları kapalı ve dolapta olduğu için acil durumda velilerin okul sekreterliğini (0216-111-2233) araması gerekmektedir.

question_text:
Teacher: Never share your personal information such as your home address, phone number or school schedule with ________ on the Internet.

Which word completes the Internet safety rule?
explanation: İnternet güvenliği kurallarına göre kişisel bilgiler tanımadığımız yabancı kişilerle ("strangers") asla paylaşılmamalıdır.

question_text:
Sam: I can’t send this email with the project photos! Look at the warning on the screen.
Dad: Look at the Wi-Fi icon at the top corner. There is no internet ________ right now. Let me restart the modem.

Which word completes the dialogue?
explanation: Modemi yeniden başlatması gerektiğine göre şu anda internet bağlantısı ("internet connection") yoktur.

question_text:
If you want to send a Word document or a PDF report together with your email, you need to click the paperclip icon and add it as an ________.

Which term completes the sentence?
explanation: E-postaya eklenen belge, fotoğraf veya dosyalara "attachment" (ek dosya) denir.

question_text:
Look at the opposite pairs of Internet verbs:
• Log in (Sign in) ↔ Log out (Sign out)
• ________ (from the Net to your PC) ↔ Upload (from your PC to the Net)

Which verb completes the opposite pair?
explanation: Bilgisayardan internete dosya yüklemek "Upload", internetten bilgisayara dosya indirmek ise onun zıttı olan "Download" fiilidir.

question_text:
Leo: My brother spends ten hours a day playing online games, refuses to go outside, and gets very angry when the Wi-Fi is off.
Counselor: I’m afraid your brother has become an Internet ________. We need to help him reduce his screen time.

Which word fits the blank?
explanation: Günde on saat çevrimiçi oyun oynayan ve internet kesilince öfkelenen kişi internet bağımlısı ("Internet addict") olmuştur.

question_text:
To create a strong and safe password, you should use a combination of uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and ________.

Which option completes the tip?
explanation: Güçlü bir şifre oluşturmak için büyük-küçük harfler, rakamlar ve noktalama işaretleri/semboller ("punctuation marks / symbols") bir arada kullanılmalıdır.

question_text:
Mia: How do you access the Internet when you travel on the intercity bus?
Noah: I use my ________ because it is small, light and has a touchscreen.

Which device completes Noah’s answer?
explanation: Şehirler arası otobüste seyahat ederken küçük, hafif ve dokunmatik ekranlı olan akıllı telefon veya tablet ("smartphone or tablet") kullanılır.

question_text:
When you want to find information about a science topic on the web, you type keywords into a ________ like Google or Bing.

Which term fills in the blank?
explanation: Web üzerinde anahtar kelimeler yazarak bilgi aradığımız Google veya Bing gibi sistemlere arama motoru ("search engine") denir.

question_text:
Customer: Excuse me, my laptop screen is completely black and it doesn’t turn on.
Technician: Don’t worry, leave it here. Our technical team will ________ it until tomorrow evening.

Which verb completes the technician’s promise?
explanation: Açılmayan bozuk bir dizüstü bilgisayarı teknik ekip tamir eder ("repair / fix").

question_text:
Tina: I haven’t understood what you meant. Could you explain it more clearly?

Which sentence has the SAME meaning as Tina’s question?
option_a: What time does the bus leave?
option_b: What do you mean by that?
option_d: How much does this laptop cost?
explanation: Bir şeyi anlamadığımızda açıklama istemek ("asking for clarification") için "What do you mean by that?" (Bununla ne demek istiyorsun?) sorusu kullanılır.

question_text:
“After filling in the registration form on the website, they sent a link to my email address. I clicked the link to ________ my new account.”

Which verb completes the sentence?
explanation: E-postaya gelen bağlantıya tıklayarak yeni hesabı onaylamak/doğrulamak için "confirm / verify" fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Eren: Do you follow any educational YouTube channels?
Kaan: Yes, I ________ to three science channels so I get a notification whenever they upload a new experiment video.

Which verb completes Kaan’s answer?
explanation: Bir video kanalından yeni video yüklendiğinde bildirim almak için o kanala abone olunur ("subscribe to").

question_text:
Always install a reliable ________ program on your computer to protect your files from hackers and harmful software.

Which word fits the blank?
explanation: Bilgisayarı bilgisayar korsanlarından ve zararlı yazılımlardan korumak için antivirüs ("antivirus") programı kurulmalıdır.

question_text:
Look at the common chat abbreviations:
• BTW: By the way
• ASAP: As soon as possible
• FYI: ________

What does “FYI” stand for in emails and messages?
explanation: E-posta ve mesajlarda sık kullanılan "FYI" kısaltması "For your information" (Bilginize) ifadesinin baş harfleridir.

question_text:
Mother: Don’t believe everything you read on social media! Always check the information from two or three ________ sources such as official ".gov" or ".edu" websites.

Which adjective completes the mother’s advice?
explanation: Bilginin doğruluğunu kontrol etmek için resmi ".gov" veya ".edu" uzantılı güvenilir ("reliable / trustworthy") kaynaklara bakılmalıdır.

question_text:
Zoe: How many hours a day are you ________?
Max: About two hours. I check my school portal and chat with my friends.

Which word means “connected to the Internet”?
explanation: İnternete bağlı olma durumunu ifade eden kelime "online" (çevrimiçi) kelimesidir.

question_text:
When you use a public computer at an Internet café or school library, never click “Remember my password” and always ________ of your accounts before leaving.

Which phrasal verb completes the safety rule?
explanation: Ortak kullanılan bir bilgisayardan kalkmadan önce hesaplardan mutlaka çıkış yapılmalıdır ("log out / sign out").

question_text:
Sude: I love writing articles about the books I read and sharing them on my personal website every week.
Mert: Oh, I didn’t know you were a ________!

Which noun completes Mert’s response?
explanation: Kişisel web sitesinde (blogunda) düzenli yazı paylaşımları yapan kişiye "blogger" denir.

question_text:
If someone sends you rude, threatening or insulting messages on social media, do not reply to them; block the user and tell your ________ immediately.

Which word completes the advice against cyberbullying?
explanation: Siber zorbalık ("cyberbullying") içeren kaba veya tehditkar mesajlar alındığında kullanıcı engellenmeli ve hemen ebeveynlere veya öğretmenlere ("parents or teachers") haber verilmelidir.

question_text:
Can: What does “Netiquette” mean?
IT Teacher: It means the rules of ________ behavior when communicating on the Internet.

Which adjective completes the teacher’s definition?
explanation: "Netiquette" (Internet + Etiquette), internette iletişim kurarken uyulması gereken nazik ve saygılı ("polite and respectful") davranış kurallarıdır.

question_text:
Family MemberDaily Time OnlineMain Internet HabitDevice Used
Father (Mr. Aydın)3 hoursReading news & online bankingLaptop
Mother (Mrs. Aydın)2 hoursSearching for recipes & shoppingTablet
Efe (Son, 14)4 hoursDoing research & playing online gamesDesktop PC
Zeynep (Daughter, 17)3 hoursAttending online coding coursesLaptop

According to the table above, which of the following is CORRECT?
option_a: Mr. Aydın and Zeynep use different types of devices to go online.
option_b: Nobody in the Aydın family uses the Internet for educational purposes.
option_c: Mrs. Aydın accesses the Internet via her desktop computer for four hours.
option_d: Efe spends the most time on the Internet among the family members.
explanation: Tabloya göre günde 4 saat ile aile üyeleri arasında internette en çok vakit geçiren kişi Efe'dir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Grandpa: Deniz, I received an email saying that I won 100,000 TL in a lottery! It asks me to click a link and enter my bank card number and password.
Deniz: Stop, Grandpa! Don’t click that link! You didn’t even buy a lottery ticket. That is a “phishing” scam sent by cyber criminals to steal your money!

What is Deniz warning his grandfather about?
option_a: Fake emails designed by hackers to steal bank account details
option_b: How to spend the 100,000 TL prize he won from the bank
option_c: Why he should share his bank password with everyone via email
option_d: How to buy lottery tickets from official websites safely
explanation: Deniz dedesini siber suçluların banka hesap bilgilerini çalmak için gönderdiği sahte oltalama ("phishing") e-postalarına karşı uyarmaktadır.

question_text:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Why 8th Grade Students Use the Internet" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "40%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Doing school ." size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 82.5 P d1 119.9 82.5 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 76.5 "25%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Using social ." size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 100.0 P d2 188.4 100.0 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 94.0 "20%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Watching movi." size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 117.5 P d3 256.9 117.5 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 111.5 "15%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Playing onlin." size=10 ```
According to the chart, which statement is TRUE?
option_a: Students spend more time playing online games than using social media.
option_b: Searching for information for school assignments is the number one reason.
option_c: Half of the students use the Internet only to watch movies and videos.
option_d: Social networking is the least popular Internet activity among 8th graders.
explanation: Grafikte %40 ile ilk sırada okul ödevleri yapmak ("Doing school homework") yer almaktadır.

question_text:
Look at the four passwords created by four students:
• Ali’s password: ali2012 (his name and birth year)
• Burcu’s password: 12345678 (sequential numbers)
• Cem’s password: Tr#9kL!4mQ (random letters, numbers and symbols)
• Duru’s password: password (a single common dictionary word)

According to cybersecurity rules, whose password is the SAFEST?
explanation: Kişisel bilgi veya ardışık sayı içermeyen; büyük-küçük harf, rakam ve özel sembollerin rastgele birleşiminden oluşan Cem'in şifresi en güvenli şifredir.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
IT Help Desk: Hello, how can I help you with your computer?
Student: I typed my username and password on the school portal, but it says “Invalid Credentials” and won’t let me log in.
IT Help Desk: Check your keyboard’s “Caps Lock” key. Passwords are case-sensitive, so if Caps Lock is on, all your lowercase letters become uppercase!
Student: Oh, you’re right! The Caps Lock light was on. Now it worked, thank you!

Why couldn’t the student log in to the school portal at first?
option_a: Because he didn’t have a student account at that school
option_b: Because his computer was not connected to the electrical outlet
option_c: Because the school website was closed for maintenance all week
option_d: Because he accidentally typed his password in capital letters
explanation: Caps Lock tuşu açık kaldığı için şifresindeki küçük harfleri yanlışlıkla büyük harf ("capital/uppercase letters") olarak yazmış ve şifre büyük-küçük harfe duyarlı olduğu için giriş yapamamıştır.

question_text:
Examine the visual guide for “Clarification Phrases” in English:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "Asking for Clarification" size=9 bold text 170 46 "What do you mean? / Can you explain what it means?" size=9 text 170 68 "Giving Clarification" size=9 text 170 90 "I mean... / In other words... / That is to say..." size=9``` Dialogue:
Bora: You shouldn’t upload high-resolution videos using your mobile data.
Sarp: What do you mean by that?
Bora: ________.

Which sentence completes Bora’s explanation appropriately?
option_a: In other words, large video files will quickly finish your monthly mobile internet limit
option_b: What do you mean by high-resolution videos on your smartphone
option_c: I mean you should never use Wi-Fi at home when downloading large files
option_d: Could you explain how to turn on the computer screen
explanation: Sarp açıklama istediğinde Bora "In other words..." (Başka bir deyişle...) diyerek yüksek çözünürlüklü büyük video dosyalarının aylık mobil internet kotasını hızla bitireceğini açıklamalıdır.

question_text:
Read the text about the “Internet of Things (IoT)”:
“Today, not only computers and phones are connected to the Internet, but also home appliances! With a smart home system, you can turn on your house heater from your phone before arriving home, check what is inside your smart refrigerator while at the supermarket, or let a robot vacuum clean the floors while you are at school.”

What is the text mainly about?
option_a: The history of the first desktop computer in the 1950s
option_b: How internet-connected smart home devices make daily life more convenient
option_c: How to repair a broken robot vacuum cleaner with a screwdriver
option_d: Why people should stop using refrigerators and heaters in winter
explanation: Metin internete bağlı akıllı ev cihazlarının ("smart home devices / IoT") günlük yaşamı nasıl kolaylaştırdığını örneklerle anlatmaktadır.

question_text:
Look at the four students’ online behaviors:
• Melih: He asks his parents’ permission before downloading any new game or program.
• Nil: She accepts friend requests from everyone, even people she has never met.
• Okan: He shares his live location and home address publicly on his social media profile.
• Pelin: She clicks on every pop-up advertisement that says “Free Smartphone!”.

Who follows the Internet Safety Rules correctly?
explanation: Yeni bir oyun veya program indirmeden önce ailesinden izin alan Melih internet güvenlik kurallarına doğru uymaktadır; diğer üç davranış tehlikelidir.

question_text:
Read the instructions for sending an assignment via email:
1. Open your email account and click the “Compose / New Email” button.
2. Type your teacher’s email address in the “To” box.
3. Write your name and homework title in the “Subject” line.
4. Click the paperclip icon to attach your homework file from your computer.
5. Click “Send”.

Selim followed steps 1, 2, 3 and 5, but he skipped Step 4. What will happen when his teacher opens the email?
option_a: The teacher won’t know which student sent the email.
option_b: The email will go to a wrong person instead of the teacher.
option_c: The email will remain in the drafts folder without being sent.
option_d: The teacher will see Selim’s name in the subject line, but there will be no homework file attached.
explanation: 4. adım ödev dosyasını ekleme ("attach your homework file") adımıdır. Bu adım atlanırsa öğretmen konu satırında Selim'in adını görür ancak e-postanın içinde ödev dosyası olmaz.

question_text:
Match the computer parts / icons with their functions:
1. Router / Modem
2. Web Browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari)
3. Cloud Storage (Google Drive, iCloud)
4. Webcam

a. Allows you to save and access your files online from any device.
b. Connects your home devices to the Internet via Wi-Fi or cable.
c. Records your live video during online meetings.
d. A software program used to visit and view websites.

Which matching is CORRECT?
explanation: Modem cihazları internete bağlar (1-b); Web tarayıcısı siteleri görüntülemeye yarar (2-d); Bulut depolama dosyaları çevrimiçi saklar (3-a); Webcam görüntülü toplantıda kameradır (4-c).

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Aslı: Why were you offline all weekend, Ceren? We waited for you in the study group chat.
Ceren: There was a heavy storm in our neighborhood on Friday night, and a falling tree broke the main fiber-optic cable on our street. The repair team fixed it this morning.

Why couldn’t Ceren join the online study group at the weekend?
option_a: Because she forgot the password of her chat application
option_b: Because a storm damaged the internet cable on her street
option_c: Because her parents took away her smartphone as a punishment
option_d: Because she went on a holiday abroad without her laptop
explanation: Cuma gecesi çıkan fırtınada devrilen bir ağaç sokaklarındaki ana fiber optik internet kablosunu kopardığı için hafta sonu internete girememiştir.

question_text:
Read the survey summary:
“In a survey of 50 teenagers, 35 teens said they always check product reviews and ratings before buying anything online. 10 teens said they only buy from official brand websites, and 5 teens said they never shop online because they prefer trying on clothes in real stores.”

According to the text, what do the majority of the surveyed teenagers do when shopping online?
option_a: They share their credit card passwords in public product comments.
option_b: They never buy anything from the Internet under any circumstances.
option_c: They read other customers’ comments and scores before purchasing an item.
option_d: They buy products from the first website they see without checking reviews.
explanation: 50 gencin 35'i (%70'i, yani çoğunluğu) internetten bir şey satın almadan önce ürün yorumlarını ve puanlarını ("product reviews and ratings") kontrol etmektedir.

question_text:
Father: Look at this pop-up window on my screen: “WARNING! 5 Viruses Detected! Download SuperClean.exe immediately!” Should I click it?
Daughter: No, Dad! Close that browser tab immediately. Fake virus warnings try to trick you into downloading real malware onto your PC. Let’s run our own official antivirus software instead.

According to the daughter, what happens if her father clicks the pop-up button?
option_a: His internet connection speed will become twice as fast.
option_b: The website will clean five viruses from his computer for free.
option_c: The official antivirus program will update itself automatically.
option_d: He will accidentally install harmful software (malware) on his computer.
explanation: Sahte virüs uyarıları kullanıcıyı kandırıp bilgisayara gerçek zararlı yazılım ("malware") indirtmeye çalışmaktadır.

question_text:
Examine the two terms:
• Digital Footprint: Every comment, photo, like and search you make online leaves a permanent trace on the Internet.
• Netiquette: Respecting others’ privacy, avoiding ALL CAPS (which means shouting), and being kind in online comments.

Which student pays attention to BOTH their digital footprint and netiquette?
option_a: Emir thinks carefully before posting a photo and always writes polite, lowercase comments.
option_b: Bora posts rude jokes online because he thinks he can delete them later.
option_c: Kaan writes angry comments in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS under his classmates’ photos.
option_d: Sude shares her friends’ private photos without asking for their permission.
explanation: Fotoğraf paylaşmadan önce dikkatlice düşünen (dijital ayak izine dikkat eden) ve her zaman nazik, küçük harfli yorumlar yazan (netiquette kurallarına uyan) öğrenci Emir'dir.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Merve: Do you pay your electricity and water bills at the bank branch?
Selma: No, waiting in long queues at the bank is a waste of time. I log in to my mobile banking app and pay all my bills in two minutes.

Why does Selma prefer online banking?
option_a: Because she enjoys waiting in crowded queues at the bank branch
option_b: Because it saves time and she doesn’t have to wait in line at the bank
option_c: Because she doesn’t know how to use a smartphone or internet
option_d: Because banks give free electricity to people who don’t pay bills
explanation: Bankada uzun kuyruklarda beklemeyi zaman kaybı olarak gördüğü için tüm faturalarını iki dakikada ödeyerek zamandan tasarruf etmek adına mobil bankacılığı tercih etmektedir.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence:
“If a website’s address starts with https:// and has a closed padlock (lock) icon next to it, it means ________.”
option_a: the website is closed today and you must visit it tomorrow morning
option_b: the website contains dangerous viruses that will break your screen
option_c: the connection between your browser and the website is encrypted and secure
option_d: you need a real metal key to open your laptop computer
explanation: Web adresinin "https://" ile başlaması ve yanında kapalı kilit simgesi bulunması, tarayıcı ile site arasındaki bağlantının şifrelenmiş ve güvenli ("encrypted and secure") olduğunu gösterir.

question_text:
Look at Tarık’s Internet usage rules at home:
1. No screens (phones, tablets, PC) during family dinner.
2. Finish all school homework before playing online games.
3. Turn off Wi-Fi and leave smartphones in the living room at 22:00 before sleeping.

Why did Tarık’s parents set Rule 3?
option_a: To make Tarık play online games in the living room until morning
option_b: To stop Tarık from doing his school homework in the afternoon
option_c: To use Tarık’s smartphone for online shopping while he sleeps
option_d: To prevent late-night screen use and ensure Tarık gets healthy sleep
explanation: Gece saat 22:00'de Wi-Fi'ı kapatıp telefonları salonda bırakma kuralı, gece geç saatlere kadar ekrana bakmayı önlemek ve sağlıklı bir uyku uyumasını sağlamak içindir.

question_text:
Read the message on the screen:
“Error 404: The webpage you are looking for might have been removed, had its name changed, or is temporarily unavailable.”

When does a user see this message?
option_a: When the clicked link is broken or the webpage no longer exists at that address
option_b: When a friend sends a birthday invitation via instant messaging
option_c: When the computer battery is 100% charged and ready to use
option_d: When the user wins first prize in an international coding competition
explanation: "Error 404" (Sayfa Bulunamadı) hatası, tıklanan bağlantı bozuk olduğunda veya aranan web sayfası artık o adreste mevcut olmadığında ekrana gelir.

question_text:
Teacher: What do we call the software programs like Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Microsoft Edge and Apple Safari?
Student: They are called ________.

Which term completes the student’s answer?
explanation: Chrome, Firefox, Edge ve Safari web sayfalarını açmaya yarayan web tarayıcılarıdır ("web browsers"). (Google, Bing, Yandex ise arama motorudur / "search engines").

question_text:
StudentDaily Screen TimeShares Password?Accepts Strangers?Checks Info Sources?
Arda2 hoursNo, neverNo, only real friendsYes, from 3 reliable sites
Bora8 hoursYes, with classmatesNo, only real friendsYes, from official sites
Ceren1.5 hoursNo, neverYes, to have more followersNo, believes everything
Derya3 hoursYes, with best friendYes, everyoneNo, never checks

The school counselor wants to select the student with the SAFEST and MOST RESPONSIBLE Internet habits as the “Digital Safety Ambassador”. According to the table, who should be selected?
explanation: Ekran süresi dengeli (2 saat) olan, şifresini kimseyle paylaşmayan, sadece gerçek arkadaşlarını ekleyen ve bilgileri 3 güvenilir siteden doğrulayan tek öğrenci Arda'dır.

question_text:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Devices Used by 200 University Students to Access the Net" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "55%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Smartphone" size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 106.4 P d1 119.9 106.4 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 100.4 "25%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Laptop" size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 139.5 P d2 188.4 139.5 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 133.5 "12%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Desktop PC" size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 149.6 P d3 256.9 149.6 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 143.6 "8%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Tablet" size=10 ```
According to the chart above, which of the following statements is CORRECT?
option_a: Tablets are the second most popular device among university students.
option_b: Less than half of the students access the Internet via their smartphones.
