question_text:
Read the text about the “Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)” security system:
“Even if you create a strong password, cyber criminals might still steal it through fake websites. That is why cybersecurity experts recommend turning on Two-Factor Authentication (2FA). When 2FA is active, typing your password is not enough to log in from a new computer; the system also sends a 6-digit temporary code to your mobile phone via SMS. Without entering that code within 60 seconds, nobody can access your account.”

Why does Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) protect your account even if a hacker learns your password?
option_a: Because 2FA allows you to log in without typing any username or password
option_b: Because the hacker cannot log in without the temporary SMS code sent to your personal phone
option_c: Because 2FA deletes your social media account permanently every evening
option_d: Because the hacker receives your smartphone in the mail within 60 seconds
explanation: 2FA aktif olduğunda yeni bir cihazdan giriş yapmak için sadece şifre yetmez; kişinin kendi cep telefonuna SMS ile gelen 6 haneli geçici kodu da 60 saniye içinde girmek gerekir.

question_text:
Read the conversation between a father and his daughter, Elif:
Father: Elif, our home internet bill is much higher than usual this month! Did we exceed our 100 GB monthly home quota?
Elif: Wait, Dad... Remember last week we didn’t change our Wi-Fi password from the default “12345678”? Yesterday I noticed four unknown devices connected to our home Wi-Fi network!
Father: Oh! Someone in the building must be using our Wi-Fi without permission. Let’s change the router password right away!

What caused the family’s monthly internet quota to run out so fast?
option_a: Unauthorized people connected to their Wi-Fi because the password was too simple
option_b: Elif downloaded 500 movies on her desktop computer in one night
option_c: The father forgot to pay last month’s electricity and water bills
option_d: The internet company disconnected their modem because of a storm
explanation: Modem şifresini varsayılan basit "12345678" olarak bıraktıkları için dört yabancı cihaz ağlarına izinsiz bağlanmış ve aylık kotalarını doldurmuştur.

question_text:
Examine the email screenshot below:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "To: mr.demir@school.edu.tr | CC: kaan@student.edu.tr, ece@student.edu.tr" size=9 bold text 170 46 "Subject: Science Fair Group 3 Presentation Slides" size=9 text 170 68 "Attachment: Solar_System_Group3.pptx (14 MB)" size=9 text 170 90 "Message: Dear Mr. Demir, I have attached our group’s final slides. Best regards, Mert." size=9``` According to the email details above, which of the following is CORRECT?
option_a: Mr. Demir is the sender of the email and Mert is the only receiver.
option_b: The email is about canceling the Science Fair at the school.
option_c: Mert sent the presentation file to his teacher and shared a copy with his teammates Kaan and Ece.
option_d: Mert forgot to attach the presentation file before sending the email.
explanation: E-postayı Mert göndermiş, alıcı ("To") olarak öğretmeni Bay Demir'i, bilgi kopyası ("CC") olarak grup arkadaşları Kaan ve Ece'yi eklemiş ve 14 MB'lık sunum dosyasını ("Attachment") iliştirmiştir.

question_text:
Read the four teenagers’ statements about their Internet habits:
• Hakan: “Whenever I feel sad or bored, I immediately open online games. If I can’t go online for an hour, I feel nervous and angry. I even skip meals to keep playing.”
• İrem: “I use the Internet for an hour a day to watch English documentaries and read world news.”
• Kaya: “After I finish my homework and basketball training, I chat with my classmates online for 30 minutes.”
• Lale: “At weekends, I use online encyclopedias and museum websites to prepare my history projects.”

Who shows clear symptoms of Internet addiction?
explanation: Bir saat bile internete giremediğinde gergin ve öfkeli hisseden, oyun oynamaya devam etmek için öğünlerini bile atlayan Hakan açıkça internet bağımlılığı belirtileri göstermektedir.

question_text:
Read the text about “Fake News” on the Internet:
“False news stories spread six times faster on social media than real news because they usually have shocking titles like ‘Miracle Tea Cures All Diseases in One Day!’. To spot fake news, you should check the author’s name, look at the publication date, verify if other respected news agencies report the same event, and inspect the website’s URL carefully.”

According to the text, what should you do when you see a shocking news title on social media?
option_a: Cross-check the story on reputable news websites before believing or sharing it
option_b: Believe the story without checking the author or publication date
option_c: Buy the miracle product advertised in the article with your credit card
option_d: Share it immediately with all your friends in every WhatsApp group
explanation: Metne göre şok edici bir başlık görüldüğünde inanmadan veya paylaşmadan önce yazar, tarih, URL ve diğer saygın haber ajanslarında yer alıp almadığı çapraz kontrol edilmelidir ("cross-check").

question_text:
Look at the table showing how 100 people solved their computer problems last month:
Solution MethodNumber of PeopleAverage CostTime Taken
Watching free tutorial videos online and fixing it themselves450 TL30 mins
Calling a professional computer technician30400 TL2 days
Asking a tech-savvy friend or family member for help150 TL2 hours
Buying a brand-new computer part101,500 TL3 days

Which of the following is TRUE according to the table?
option_a: Only fifteen people watched free online tutorial videos to fix their PCs.
option_b: 60% of the people solved their computer problems without paying any money.
option_c: Calling a professional technician is the fastest and cheapest method.
option_d: Most people bought a brand-new computer part when they had a problem.
explanation: Ücretsiz eğitim videoları izleyerek kendisi çözenler (45 kişi = 0 TL) ile bilgili bir arkadaşına/akrabasına soranlar (15 kişi = 0 TL) toplandığında 45 + 15 = 60 kişi (%60) hiç para ödemeden sorununu çözmüştür.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Selin: Look! This online shoe store sells famous brand sneakers for only 100 TL—that’s 90% cheaper than normal stores! However, they don’t accept credit cards or cash on delivery; they only want us to send cash directly to a personal IBAN number.
Burak: Wait, Selin! Look at the URL: it has no company address, no tax number, and it was created just two days ago. If you transfer money to that personal IBAN, they will never send the shoes!

How did Burak realize that the online shoe store was a fraud (fake store)?
option_a: Because the store accepted cash payment at the door upon delivery
option_b: Because 100 TL is too expensive for a pair of brand sneakers
option_c: By checking the suspicious payment method and the lack of official company information
option_d: Because he already bought ten pairs of shoes from that store last year
explanation: Burak hem şüpheli ödeme yöntemine (sadece şahıs IBAN'ına havale istemesi) hem de sitede şirket adresi ve vergi numarası olmayıp sitenin iki gün önce açılmış olmasına bakarak dolandırıcı olduğunu anlamıştır.

question_text:
Read the four definitions and find the term that is NOT defined below:
• A person who uses computers to gain unauthorized access to other people’s data.
• A secret word or combination of characters used to access a private account.
• A global computer network providing a variety of information and communication facilities.

Which of the following terms is NOT described above?
explanation: Birinci tanım "Hacker", ikinci tanım "Password", üçüncü tanım ise "The Internet" kavramına aittir. Masaüstü yazıcı ("Desktop Printer") tanımlanmamıştır.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Teacher: For your English project, you can use online dictionaries and encyclopedias, but copying and pasting whole paragraphs from Wikipedia as if you wrote them yourself is strictly forbidden. This is called “plagiarism”.
Student: What do you mean by plagiarism, ma’am? How should we prepare the project properly?
Teacher: ________.

Which explanation should the teacher give?
option_a: I mean you must read the sources, summarize the ideas in your own words, and list the websites you used
option_b: I mean you should ask an online stranger to write the whole project for you
option_c: That is to say, you are not allowed to read any books or websites for your project
option_d: In other words, you should copy the entire article without changing a single word
explanation: İntihalden ("plagiarism") kaçınmak için öğretmenin "Kaynakları okumalı, fikirleri kendi cümlelerinizle özetlemeli ve kullandığınız web sitelerini kaynakçada belirtmelisiniz" demesi gerekir.

question_text:
Examine the steps of setting up a safe social media account:
1. Sign up with a strong password that doesn’t include your birth date.
2. Go to “Privacy Settings” and switch your profile from “Public” to “Private / Friends Only”.
3. Turn off “Location Sharing” for the camera and posts.
4. Only accept follow requests from people you know in real life.

What is the main benefit of completing Step 2 and Step 3?
option_a: Your internet speed increases from 10 Mbps to 100 Mbps automatically.
option_b: Strangers cannot see your personal photos or track where you are right now.
option_c: Everyone on the Internet can see your home address and daily location.
option_d: You can log in to your account without typing any password.
explanation: 2. adımda profili "Gizli / Sadece Arkadaşlar" yapmak ve 3. adımda konum paylaşımını kapatmak, yabancıların fotoğraflarınızı görmesini ve anlık konumunuzu takip etmesini engeller.

question_text:
Find the odd sentence out in the paragraph:
(I) Online education platforms have made learning accessible to students all over the world. (II) Students living in remote villages can watch science lectures from top universities for free. (III) When making vegetable soup, you should dice the carrots and boil them for twenty minutes. (IV) Furthermore, interactive quizzes on these platforms help learners test their progress immediately.
explanation: Paragraf çevrimiçi eğitim platformlarının sağladığı fırsatları anlatırken, III. cümle sebze çorbası tarifinden bahsederek anlam bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the comparison between two brothers’ weekend routines:
• Kuzey (14): Spends 1.5 hours online on Saturday to practice chess strategies and code a simple game. The rest of the weekend, he plays basketball outdoors with his friends and reads novels.
• Güney (15): Stays in his dark room for 11 hours a day on Saturday and Sunday scrolling through short social media videos. He refuses to join family meals and complains of constant headaches.

What can we conclude from this comparison?
option_a: Güney uses the Internet only for coding games and learning chess strategies.
option_b: Kuzey suffers from constant headaches because he stays online for 11 hours a day.
option_c: Both brothers are Internet addicts who never leave their rooms at the weekend.
option_d: Kuzey uses the Internet productively and balances it with real-life activities, while Güney has an unhealthy screen habit.
explanation: Kuzey interneti satranç ve kodlama için verimli kullanıp açık hava sporu ve kitapla dengelerken; Güney günde 11 saat karanlık odada ekran kaydırarak sağlıksız bir bağımlılık sergilemektedir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue at an electronics store:
Customer: My daughter is starting 8th grade. She needs a device to write essays on a keyboard, prepare slide presentations, and carry easily to the library.
Salesperson: A desktop PC is too heavy to carry, and a small smartphone screen isn’t comfortable for writing long essays. I recommend this light 14-inch laptop with long battery life.

Why did the salesperson recommend a laptop instead of a desktop PC or a smartphone?
option_a: Because a laptop combines a full keyboard and large screen with portability
option_b: Because the daughter only wants to play games in her bedroom
option_c: Because smartphones don’t have any screen or internet connection
option_d: Because a desktop computer can fit easily into a small school backpack
explanation: Satış görevlisi masaüstü bilgisayarın taşınamayacak kadar ağır, akıllı telefon ekranının ise uzun kompozisyon yazmak için küçük olduğunu belirterek hem klavye/geniş ekran sunan hem de kütüphaneye kolay taşınabilen dizüstü bilgisayarı önermiştir.

question_text:
Look at the data transfer table for downloading a 1,000 MB (1 GB) educational documentary:
• Connection A (Old 3G Mobile): Downloads 5 MB per second → Takes 200 seconds
• Connection B (Home ADSL): Downloads 10 MB per second → Takes 100 seconds
• Connection C (4.5G Mobile): Downloads 25 MB per second → Takes 40 seconds
• Connection D (Fiber Optic Home Wi-Fi): Downloads 100 MB per second → Takes 10 seconds

According to the table, how many times faster is Fiber Optic Home Wi-Fi than Home ADSL?
explanation: Fiber Optik bağlantı saniyede 100 MB indirirken (10 sn), Ev ADSL bağlantısı saniyede 10 MB indirmektedir (100 sn). 100 ÷ 10 = 10 kat daha hızlıdır.

question_text:
Read the notice on a school computer lab door:
“LAB RULES:
1. Log in only with your own student ID number.
2. Do not plug unknown USB flash drives into the computers without scanning them for viruses.
3. Save your project files to your school Cloud Drive before shutting down, because local desktop files are erased automatically every night.
4. Log out of your account when the bell rings.”

Berk saved his history presentation on the computer’s Desktop screen on Tuesday afternoon and didn’t upload it to his Cloud Drive. What will happen when he comes back on Wednesday morning?
option_a: His presentation will be sent to the principal’s email automatically.
option_b: The computer will print 100 copies of his presentation overnight.
option_c: His presentation file will be gone because local desktop files are deleted every night.
option_d: His file will still be on the desktop screen for the whole year.
explanation: 3. kurala göre bilgisayarların yerel masaüstündeki dosyalar her gece otomatik olarak silindiği ("local desktop files are erased automatically every night") için Berk Çarşamba sabahı geldiğinde dosyasını bulamayacaktır.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Nehir: I want to sell my old bicycle on an online second-hand website. A buyer sent me a message saying he wants to meet me alone at an empty park at 9 p.m. to see the bike.
Older Sister: Never do that, Nehir! First of all, you are under 18, so Mom or Dad must handle the sale. Second, people should only meet in crowded, well-lit public places during the daytime with an adult.

What is the older sister’s main concern?
option_a: Teaching Nehir how to ride a bicycle in an empty park at 9 p.m.
option_b: Making sure Nehir sells the bicycle for a much cheaper price at night
option_c: Helping the buyer repair the old bicycle in the dark
option_d: Protecting Nehir’s personal physical safety when dealing with online strangers
explanation: Ablası 18 yaşından küçük olduğu için satışı anne-babasının yapması gerektiğini ve internetteki yabancılarla gece ıssız bir parkta yalnız buluşmanın fiziksel güvenlik açısından çok tehlikeli olduğunu vurgulamaktadır.

question_text:
Examine the four browser tabs open on Sinan’s laptop:
• Tab 1: www.meb.gov.tr — Checking the official LGS exam guide.
• Tab 2: www.tdk.gov.tr — Looking up the spelling of Turkish words.
• Tab 3: www.nationalgeographic.com — Reading an article about earthquakes and natural forces.
• Tab 4: www.chess.com — Playing a 10-minute chess match against a classmate.

What can we say about Sinan’s Internet usage based on his open tabs?
option_a: He spends all his time watching horror movies and chatting with strangers.
option_b: He uses official and educational websites for his lessons and plays a mind game in his break.
option_c: He uses the Internet only for online shopping and ordering fast food.
option_d: He visits dangerous and unreliable websites that steal his personal data.
explanation: İlk üç sekmede resmi (MEB, TDK) ve bilimsel (National Geographic) sitelerden ders araştırması yapmakta, dördüncü sekmede ise sınıf arkadaşıyla zeka oyunu olan satranç oynamaktadır.

question_text:
Read the short text about “Cookies” on websites:
“When you visit a website, a banner often pops up saying: ‘This website uses cookies.’ Internet cookies are not sweet biscuits! They are tiny text files saved by your browser to remember your language preference, keep items in your online shopping cart, or track which ads you click.”

What is the function of an Internet “cookie”?
option_a: It stores your preferences and browsing data on a website so the site remembers you.
option_b: It delivers real chocolate biscuits to your home address for free.
option_c: It turns off your Wi-Fi router whenever you open a shopping website.
option_d: It cleans the dust from your computer keyboard and screen.
explanation: İnternet çerezleri ("cookies"), ziyaret edilen sitedeki dil tercihini, alışveriş sepetindeki ürünleri veya gezinme verilerini hatırlamak için tarayıcı tarafından kaydedilen küçük metin dosyalarıdır.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Tim: My internet connection is working, because I can send messages on WhatsApp. However, when I type www.schoollibrary.org into my browser, the page doesn’t load at all!
Librarian: That’s normal, Tim. Our school’s IT team shut down the library server for two hours today to upload 500 new e-books. It will be back online at 2 p.m.

Why couldn’t Tim open the school library website even though his internet was working?
option_a: Because WhatsApp blocked all educational websites on Tim’s phone
option_b: Because Tim’s smartphone had no internet connection or battery
option_c: Because the library website’s server was temporarily offline for an update
option_d: Because the school closed the library permanently last year
explanation: Tim'in interneti çalışmasına rağmen okulun bilgi işlem ekibi 500 yeni e-kitap yüklemek için kütüphane sunucusunu ("server") iki saatliğine bakıma aldığından site açılmamıştır.

question_text:
Read the four comments under a technology forum question:
Forum Question: “How can I keep my files safe in case my laptop’s hard drive breaks down?”
• User A: “Back up your important folders to a Cloud Storage service or an external USB drive every week.”
• User B: “Never save any files on your computer; memorize everything in your head.”
• User C: “Share your computer password on social media so hackers can keep your files.”
• User D: “Pour cold water on your laptop keyboard once a month to keep it cool.”

Which user gives the ONLY sensible and correct technical advice?
explanation: Bilgisayarın sabit diski bozulursa dosyaları kaybetmemek için önemli klasörleri her hafta bulut depolamaya ("Cloud Storage") veya harici USB belleğe yedeklemeyi ("Back up") öneren User A tek doğru teknik tavsiyeyi vermiştir.

question_text:
Look at the meaning of the symbols in an email address:
ahmet.yilmaz@ankara.edu.tr
• ahmet.yilmaz → Username
• @ → “at” symbol
• ankara → Organization / University name
• .edu → Educational institution domain
• .tr → Country code for Türkiye

Looking at the extensions above, who does the email address info@kultur.gov.tr belong to?
option_a: An international music festival in Japan
option_b: An official government institution in Türkiye
option_c: A private commercial pizza restaurant in Italy
option_d: A primary school student living in England
explanation: .gov ("government" = devlet kurumu) ve .tr (Türkiye ülke kodu) uzantılarına sahip olan info@kultur.gov.tr Türkiye'deki resmi bir devlet kurumuna (Kültür ve Turizm Bakanlığı) aittir.

question_text:
Read the quote by a cybersecurity teacher:
“Think of your password like your toothbrush: choose a good one, don’t share it with anyone, and change it regularly!”

Why does the teacher compare a password to a toothbrush?
option_a: To emphasize that passwords are strictly personal and should be updated periodically
option_b: To say that classmates should use the same password for all their accounts
option_c: To explain that passwords are only useful when you visit the dentist
option_d: To remind students to brush their computer keyboards with toothpaste every night
explanation: Öğretmen şifrelerin tıpkı diş fırçası gibi tamamen kişiye özel olduğu, kimseyle paylaşılmaması ve belirli aralıklarla yenilenmesi gerektiğini akılda kalıcı bir benzetmeyle vurgulamaktadır.

question_text:
Jack: Why do you love extreme sports so much?
Leo: Because I am an ________ seeker! I love taking risks and testing my limits.

Which word completes Leo’s sentence?
explanation: Risk almayı ve sınırlarını zorlamayı seven ekstrem spor tutkunlarına "adrenaline seeker" (adrenalin tutkunu) denir.

question_text:
If you go kayaking or rafting on a rough river, you must always wear a ________ to protect your head from the rocks and a life jacket not to drown.

Which safety equipment completes the rule?
explanation: Nehirde başı kayalardan korumak için kask ("helmet") takılması zorunludur.

question_text:
Emma: Which one do you prefer, caving or paragliding?
Noah: I prefer paragliding because flying in the sky is ________ than walking in a dark cave.

Choose the correct comparative form.
explanation: "Than" ile yapılan iki şey arasındaki karşılaştırmada çok heceli "exciting" sıfatı önüne "more" alarak "more exciting" olur.

question_text:
In ________, you jump from a very high bridge or crane with a long elastic rope tied to your ankles.

Which extreme sport is described above?
explanation: Ayak bileklerine bağlı elastik bir halatla yüksek bir köprü veya vinçten atlama sporu "bungee jumping"dir.

question_text:
Mert: Have you ever tried scuba diving in Kaş, Antalya?
Sarp: Yes! Swimming with colorful fish and sea turtles under the water was ________!

Which positive adjective fits Sarp’s experience?
explanation: Su altında renkli balıklar ve deniz kaplumbağalarıyla yüzme deneyimini büyüleyici ("fascinating") olarak nitelendirmiştir.

question_text:
Look at the categories of extreme sports:
• Air Sports: Skydiving, Paragliding, Hang-gliding
• Water Sports: Rafting, Scuba diving, ________

Which sport belongs to the Water Sports category?
explanation: Uçurtma sörfü ("Kitesurfing") denizde/suda yapılan bir su sporudur ("Water Sport"); diğerleri kara sporlarıdır.

question_text:
“I would rather ________ trekking in a safe forest than ________ down a dangerous waterfall in a kayak.”

Which verb forms complete the “would rather” structure?
explanation: "Would rather + V1 (yalın fiil) + than + V1 (yalın fiil)" kuralına göre boşluklara yalın haldeki "go / paddle" gelmelidir.

question_text:
When you go skateboarding or rollerblading on concrete roads, you should wear elbow pads and ________ pads so you don’t hurt your joints if you fall.

Which word completes the safety gear?
explanation: Düştüğünde eklemleri korumak için dirseklik ("elbow pads") ve dizlik ("knee pads") takılır.

question_text:
Reporter: What is the biggest risk in high-altitude mountaineering in winter?
Climber: Freezing temperatures and sudden snowstorms. That’s why we always wear ________ clothes and special climbing boots.

Which adjective completes the climber’s answer?
explanation: Dondurucu soğuklara ve kar fırtınalarına karşı dağcılar ısıyı koruyan ve su geçirmeyen ("thermal and waterproof") kıyafetler giyer.

question_text:
Alice: Why don’t you want to try caving with us?
Kate: Because I have claustrophobia. Being in narrow, dark underground spaces is too ________ for me.

Which adjective completes Kate’s reason?
explanation: Klostrofobisi (kapalı alan korkusu) olan biri için dar ve karanlık yer altı mağaralarında bulunmak çok korkutucudur ("frightening").

question_text:
To go rafting on a river, a team of 4 to 8 people sits in an inflatable rubber boat and uses ________ to control the boat in the fast water.

Which equipment fills in the blank?
explanation: Rafting botunu hızlı akan suda yönlendirmek için kürekler ("paddles") kullanılır.

question_text:
Bora: I think base jumping is ________ than cycling in the park.
Cem: Definitely! Base jumping is one of the riskiest sports in the world.

Choose the correct comparative form.
explanation: Cem base jumping'in dünyanın en riskli sporlarından biri olduğunu onayladığına göre Bora parkta bisiklet sürmekten daha tehlikeli ("more dangerous") olduğunu söylemiştir.

question_text:
Look at the job description:
“I put out fires in tall buildings and forests, rescue people from car accidents, and risk my life every day to save others.”

What is this person’s occupation?
explanation: Binalardaki ve ormanlardaki yangınları söndüren, kazalardan insan kurtaran meslek itfaiyeciliktir ("Firefighter").

question_text:
In ________, you jump out of an airplane from 4,000 meters, free-fall through the air for a minute, and then open your parachute to land safely.

Which air sport is described?
explanation: 4.000 metredeki bir uçaktan atlayıp bir süre serbest düşüş yaptıktan sonra paraşüt açarak inilen hava sporu "skydiving"dir.

question_text:
Coach: Before we jump into the sea for scuba diving, check your ________ tank and diving mask carefully!

Which word completes the diving instructor’s warning?
explanation: Tüplü dalışta ("scuba diving") su altında nefes almak için oksijen tüpü ("oxygen tank") kullanılır.

question_text:
Seda: Why do you prefer taking photos of wild animals in Africa to staying at a beach hotel?
Tuna: Because going on a wildlife Jeep safari is much more ________ than lying on the beach all day.

Which adjective fits Tuna’s sentence?
explanation: Afrika'da vahşi yaşam safarisine çıkmak sahilde uzanmaktan çok daha macera doludur ("adventurous").

question_text:
A ________ is a brave person who performs dangerous scenes in action movies (like jumping from a moving train) instead of the famous actor.

Which job title completes the sentence?
explanation: Aksiyon filmlerinde tehlikeli sahneleri ünlü oyuncu yerine oynayan dublöre "stuntman / stuntwoman" denir.

question_text:
Paul: Which city in Türkiye is world-famous for hot air balloon rides over fairy chimneys at sunrise?
Guide: ________, in Nevşehir!

Which place completes the guide’s answer?
explanation: Nevşehir'de peri bacaları üzerinde gün doğumunda yapılan sıcak hava balonu turlarıyla dünyaca ünlü bölgemiz Kapadokya'dır ("Cappadocia").

question_text:
Look at the synonyms:
• Challenging: Difficult, testing your ability
• Fascinating: Extremely interesting, captivating
• ________: Giving you a feeling of great excitement and pleasure

Which adjective matches the third definition?
explanation: Büyük bir heyecan ve coşku veren anlamına gelen sıfat "Thrilling / Exciting"dir.

question_text:
Mother: Don’t stand up in the canoe while paddling, kids! The canoe can easily turn upside down.

What is the mother warning the children about?
option_a: Following safety rules on the water so they don’t fall into the lake
option_b: Climbing a snowy mountain without thermal boots
option_c: Riding a skateboard on a busy highway
option_d: Jumping from an airplane without a parachute
explanation: Kanoda kürek çekerken ayağa kalkılırsa kanonun kolayca devrilebileceğini söyleyerek su üzerindeki güvenlik kuralına uymaları konusunda çocukları uyarmaktadır.

question_text:
NameFavorite SportEnvironmentEquipment Needed
ArasParaglidingAir / SkyWing, helmet, harness, reserve parachute
BerenRaftingRiver / WaterRaft boat, paddle, life jacket, helmet
CenkCavingUndergroundHelmet with headlamp, rope, boots
DuruSnowboardingSnowy MountainSnowboard, goggles, thermal jacket, helmet

Look at the table above. Which safety item is COMMON to ALL four extreme sports listed in the table?
explanation: Tablodaki dört ekstrem sporun (yamaç paraşütü, rafting, mağaracılık ve snowboard) ekipman listesinde de ortak olan tek güvenlik malzemesi kasktır ("helmet").

question_text:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Extreme Sports Tried by 100 Tourists in Fethiye & Antalya" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "40%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Rafting" size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 65.0 P d1 119.9 65.0 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 59.0 "30%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Paragliding" size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 100.0 P d2 188.4 100.0 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 94.0 "20%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Scuba diving" size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 135.0 P d3 256.9 135.0 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 129.0 "10%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Bungee jumping" size=10 ```
According to the chart above, which of the following is CORRECT?
option_a: Half of the tourists jumped from a bridge with an elastic rope.
option_b: More tourists tried flying in the sky than paddling on a river.
option_c: Sixty percent of the tourists preferred water-based adventure sports.
option_d: Bungee jumping is more popular among tourists than scuba diving.
explanation: Su sporları olan Rafting (%40) ve Scuba diving (%20) toplamı %40 + %20 = %60'tır.

question_text:
Read the brochure for Babadağ Paragliding in Ölüdeniz, Fethiye:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "Fly Over the Blue Lagoon from 1,960 Meters!" size=9 bold text 170 46 "Tandem flights with certified experienced pilots" size=9 text 170 68 "Duration: 30 - 40 minutes in the air" size=9 text 170 90 "Age limit: 6 to 65 years old (Weight limit: max 105 kg)" size=9 text 170 112 "Note: Flights are canceled on stormy or very windy days." size=9 text 170 134 "Price: 2,500 TL (Includes safety gear & insurance)" size=9``` According to the brochure, why don’t tourists need prior flight training to fly from Babadağ?
option_a: Because they fly together (tandem) with a certified professional pilot
option_b: Because the mountain is only two meters high from the beach
option_c: Because tourists fly alone without any parachute or pilot
option_d: Because flights only take place indoors in a sports hall
explanation: Broşürde uçuşların sertifikalı ve deneyimli pilotlarla ikili ("Tandem flights with certified experienced pilots") yapıldığı belirtildiği için turistlerin önceden uçuş eğitimi almasına gerek yoktur.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Kevin: Would you rather go rock climbing or kayaking this weekend, Sam?
Sam: I’d rather go kayaking. I hurt my ankle while playing football last month, so climbing steep cliffs is too painful for my foot right now. Sitting in a kayak and using my arms to paddle is much better for me.

Why does Sam prefer kayaking to rock climbing this weekend?
option_a: Because he hates water sports and loves climbing high mountains
option_b: Because he doesn’t know how to swim or use a paddle on the water
option_c: Because rock climbing is much easier and less tiring for his injured foot
option_d: Because his injured ankle makes climbing difficult, whereas kayaking mostly uses arm strength
explanation: Sam geçen ay futbol oynarken ayak bileğini incittiği için dik kayalara tırmanmak ayağını ağrıtmaktadır; kanoda oturup kollarıyla kürek çekmek onun için çok daha uygundur.

question_text:
Look at four people’s comments about risky jobs:
• Aylin (Window Cleaner on Skyscrapers): “Hanging on ropes outside the 50th floor requires having no fear of heights.”
• Burak (Coal Miner): “Working hundreds of meters underground in dark tunnels is very hard and risky.”
• Cem (Coast Guard Rescuer): “We sail into giant sea waves during winter storms to save sinking boats.”
• Deniz (Air Traffic Controller): “I sit in the airport tower and guide hundreds of planes safely on radar screens; one tiny mistake can cause a disaster.”

Whose job is dangerous because of mental stress and responsibility rather than physical danger to himself/herself?
explanation: Havaalanı kulesinde oturup radar ekranlarından yüzlerce uçağı yönlendiren Deniz'in işi (Hava Trafik Kontrolörü) kendi fiziksel güvenliğinden ziyade en ufak hatanın felakete yol açabileceği zihinsel stres ve yüksek sorumluluk nedeniyle risklidir.

question_text:
Read the text about Cave Diving:
“Cave diving is considered much more dangerous than open-sea scuba diving. In the open sea, if your oxygen gets low, you can swim straight up to the surface immediately. However, in an underwater cave, there is a rock ceiling above you! You must swim all the way back through dark tunnels following a guide rope to reach the exit.”

According to the text, why is cave diving riskier than open-sea diving?
option_a: Because open-sea diving takes place in dark underground tunnels without water
option_b: Because there are giant sharks and whales inside narrow mountain caves
option_c: Because a rock ceiling prevents divers from swimming directly up to the surface in an emergency
option_d: Because cave divers don’t carry any oxygen tanks or flashlights under the water
explanation: Açık denizde doğrudan yukarı yüzerek su yüzeyine çıkılabilirken, su altı mağarasında tepede kaya tavanı ("rock ceiling") olduğu için doğrudan yüzeye çıkılamaz; kılavuz ipini takip ederek çıkışa kadar geri yüzmek gerekir.

question_text:
Examine the preferences of four friends:
• Efe: Crazy about winter sports on snowy slopes.
• Kaan: Loves exploring coral reefs and underwater wildlife.
• Mert: Fond of soaring high in the sky like a bird.
• Sarp: Keen on riding waves on the ocean surface when it is windy.

Which option matches all four boys with their ideal adventure sports?
option_a: Efe: Windsurfing — Kaan: Scuba diving — Mert: Hang-gliding — Sarp: Heli-skiing
option_b: Efe: Heli-skiing — Kaan: Hang-gliding — Mert: Scuba diving — Sarp: Windsurfing
option_c: Efe: Scuba diving — Kaan: Heli-skiing — Mert: Windsurfing — Sarp: Hang-gliding
option_d: Efe: Heli-skiing — Kaan: Scuba diving — Mert: Hang-gliding — Sarp: Windsurfing
explanation: Karlı yamaçları seven Efe "Heli-skiing", su altı mercanlarını seven Kaan "Scuba diving", kuş gibi gökyüzünde süzülmeyi seven Mert "Hang-gliding", rüzgarlı havada okyanus dalgalarında gitmeyi seven Sarp ise "Windsurfing" ile eşleşir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Reporter: Ms. Kaya, you became the first woman from your city to climb Mount Everest (8,848 m). What was the hardest part of the expedition?
Ms. Kaya: Above 8,000 meters, the air has very little oxygen, and the temperature drops to -35°C. Every single step feels like running a marathon. Mental determination is just as important as physical strength.

What can we understand from Ms. Kaya’s words?
option_a: Climbing Everest requires both strong physical endurance and great mental willpower.
option_b: The weather at the top of Mount Everest is warm and rich in oxygen.
option_c: Anyone can easily walk to the summit of Everest without training.
option_d: Ms. Kaya gave up climbing at 8,000 meters and returned home.
explanation: 8.000 metrenin üzerinde çok az oksijen ve -35°C soğukta her adımın maraton koşmak gibi olduğunu, zihinsel kararlılığın da fiziksel güç kadar önemli olduğunu vurgulamaktadır.

question_text:
Read the two statements:
• Statement 1: “To me, caving is less exciting than rafting.”
• Statement 2: “I prefer rafting to caving.”

Which of the following has the SAME meaning as the two statements above?
option_a: I would rather explore dark underground caves than go rafting.
option_b: I think rafting is more exciting than caving, so I’d rather go rafting.
option_c: I think caving is much more thrilling than rafting on a river.
option_d: Neither rafting nor caving is an outdoor adventure activity.
explanation: "Mağaracılık raftingden daha az heyecan vericidir" ve "Raftingi mağaracılığa tercih ederim" cümleleri, raftingin mağaracılıktan daha heyecanlı olduğu ("rafting is more exciting than caving") anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Look at the equipment checklist for a Hot Air Balloon tour:
• Provided by the tour company: Balloon basket, burner, pilot, safety briefing, flight certificate.
• What passengers should bring/wear: Warm jacket (mornings are chilly at sunrise!), flat sports shoes (no high heels!), sunglasses, and a camera.

Why does the tour company advise passengers to wear a warm jacket even in summer?
option_a: Because the flight starts early at sunrise and the air high in the sky is cold
option_b: Because the burner inside the balloon blows freezing ice onto passengers
option_c: Because passengers have to swim in cold river water during the flight
option_d: Because it snows heavily every afternoon inside the balloon basket
explanation: Uçuşlar gün doğumunda ("at sunrise") erken saatte başladığı ve gökyüzünde yükseklerde hava serin olduğu için yazın bile kalın/sıcak tutan bir ceket giyilmesi tavsiye edilmektedir.

question_text:
Read the paragraph:
“Many people think extreme athletes are reckless people who don’t care about their lives. On the contrary, professional extreme athletes spend hundreds of hours checking their equipment, studying weather forecasts, and practicing safety procedures before attempting a jump or climb.”

According to the paragraph, professional extreme athletes ________.
option_a: never check their parachutes or ropes before jumping from high cliffs
option_b: try difficult stunts without any training or safety equipment
option_c: take safety precautions and preparation very seriously to minimize risks
option_d: ignore weather forecasts and jump during dangerous thunderstorms
explanation: Yaygın kanının aksine profesyonel ekstrem sporcuların ekipman kontrolüne, hava tahminlerine ve güvenlik prosedürlerine yüzlerce saat ayırarak hazırlığı çok ciddiye aldıkları anlatılmaktadır.

question_text:
Match the extreme sports with the places in Türkiye where they are most famous:
1. Rafting on the Çoruh River
2. Paragliding from Mount Babadağ
3. Skiing and Snowboarding on Mount Palandöken
4. Hot Air Ballooning over Fairy Chimneys

a. Erzurum
b. Artvin
c. Nevşehir (Cappadocia)
d. Muğla (Fethiye)

Which matching is CORRECT?
explanation: Çoruh Nehri'nde rafting → Artvin (1-b); Babadağ'dan yamaç paraşütü → Muğla/Fethiye (2-d); Palandöken'de kayak → Erzurum (3-a); Peri bacaları üzerinde balon → Nevşehir/Kapadokya (4-c).

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Tina: Did you enjoy your first motor racing experience on the track yesterday?
Brad: To be honest, it was a bit disappointing. Because I was a beginner, the instructor didn’t let me drive faster than 50 km/h! It felt like driving in normal city traffic.

Why did Brad find the motor racing experience disappointing?
option_a: Because he drove at 250 km/h and felt too scared on the track
option_b: Because he wasn’t allowed to drive at high speed as a beginner
option_c: Because the racing car broke down before he could start the engine
option_d: Because it rained heavily and the race track was closed all day
explanation: Başlangıç seviyesinde olduğu için eğitmen 50 km/sa hızın üzerine çıkmasına izin vermemiş, bu yüzden normal şehir trafiğinde araba sürmek gibi hissettirip beklentisini karşılamamıştır.

question_text:
Look at the riddle:
• It is a water and wind sport.
• You stand on a small surfboard attached to your feet.
• You hold the control bar of a large parachute-like kite in the air, and the wind pulls you across the sea waves and even lets you jump high!

Which sport is it?
explanation: Ayaklarda küçük bir sörf tahtası, elde ise havadaki paraşüt benzeri büyük bir uçurtmanın ("kite") kontrol barıyla rüzgarın deniz üzerinde çektiği spor uçurtma sörfüdür ("Kitesurfing").

question_text:
Mother: Your cousin Ozan invited you to go bungee jumping from a 70-meter crane on Sunday. Will you go?
Selim: No way, Mom! I have acrophobia (fear of heights). Even looking down from the third-floor balcony makes me dizzy. I’ll invite Ozan to go kayaking on the calm lake instead.

Why does Selim refuse to go bungee jumping?
option_a: Because he has an important math exam on Sunday afternoon
option_b: Because Ozan doesn’t want to spend time with Selim on Sunday
option_c: Because he is afraid of high places and gets dizzy looking down from heights
option_d: Because he prefers air sports like skydiving to water sports
explanation: Selim'in yükseklik korkusu ("acrophobia / fear of heights") olduğu ve üçüncü kat balkonundan aşağı bakmanın bile başını döndürdüğü için 70 metrelik vinçten bungee jumping yapmayı reddetmektedir.

question_text:
Examine the difficulty levels of river rafting (Class I to Class VI):
• Class I – II: Calm water with small waves. Suitable for families and beginners.
• Class III – IV: Fast water, medium rocks and narrow passages. Requires a guide and paddling skills.
• Class V – VI: Extremely violent rapids and big waterfalls. Only for expert professionals; life-threatening.

The Yılmaz family (parents and their 10-year-old twins) have never tried rafting before. Which river course should they choose?
option_b: A Class IV rocky course without a guide
option_d: A Class I or II course
explanation: Daha önce hiç rafting yapmamış çocuklu bir aile için ailelere ve yeni başlayanlara uygun olan Class I veya II ("Suitable for families and beginners") parkuru seçilmelidir.

question_text: Choose the sentence that is grammatically and meaningfully CORRECT:
option_a: She prefers jump from a bridge than walk in the forest.
option_b: Skateboarding in a skatepark is safer than skydiving from a plane.
option_c: I would rather going caving to swimming in the pool.
option_d: Skydiving is more safer than riding a bicycle in the garden.
explanation: "Safer than" karşılaştırma yapısı hem dil bilgisi hem de anlam ("kaykay parkında kaymak uçaktan atlamaktan daha güvenlidir") açısından tek doğru seçenektir ("more safer" yanlış, "would rather V-ing to" yanlış, "prefers V1 than" yanlıştır).

question_text:
Read the quote by a famous mountaineer:
“Getting to the summit of a mountain is optional; getting back down to the base camp alive is mandatory (obligatory).”

What does the mountaineer advise climbers to do if a sudden dangerous snowstorm starts near the summit?
option_a: Turn back immediately to stay safe rather than risking their lives for the summit
option_b: Throw away their compass and radio to walk faster
option_c: Take off their thermal jackets and wait at the summit for three days
option_d: Continue climbing in the blind storm without oxygen or ropes
explanation: "Zirveye ulaşmak isteğe bağlıdır, ana kampa sağ dönmek ise zorunludur" sözüyle, zirveye yakın tehlikeli bir fırtına çıktığında hayatı riske atmak yerine güvenle geri dönülmesi gerektiği öğütlenmektedir.

question_text:
Adventure TourCategoryMin. AgePrice per PersonSpecial Requirement
Deep Blue ScubaWater14+1,200 TLMust know how to swim & have no ear problems
Eagle Wings ParaglidingAir10+2,000 TLMust have no fear of heights (Max 100 kg)
Wild River RaftingWater12+800 TLTeamwork required (6 people per raft)
Dark Echoes CavingLand15+600 TLMust not have claustrophobia (narrow tunnels)

Read the profile of Kerem:
• Age: 14 years old
• Budget: 1,500 TL
• Health/Fears: He is a great swimmer, loves water sports, has claustrophobia, and has a severe ear infection this week.

According to the table and Kerem’s profile, which tour is the ONLY suitable choice for him this week?
explanation: Kerem 14 yaşında ve 1.500 TL bütçesi var: Paraşüt (2.000 TL) bütçesini aşar; Mağaracılık (15+ yaş ve klostrofobisi var) uygun değil; Tüplü dalış (bu hafta kulak enfeksiyonu olduğu için "no ear problems" şartına uymaz) elenir. Geriye hem yaşına (12+) hem bütçesine (800 TL) hem de su sporu sevgisine uyan "Wild River Rafting" kalır.

question_text:
Read the interview with Deniz, a Volunteer Search and Rescue (AKUT / AFAD) team member:
Reporter: Why do you practice rock climbing, caving, and rafting every month even though you are not competing in sports tournaments?
Deniz: Because our training saves lives in real emergencies! When hikers get lost in deep canyons, climbers get stuck on cliffs, or villages get flooded, we use those exact extreme sports skills and ropes to rescue people safely.

What is the main reason Deniz practices extreme sports regularly?
option_a: To win gold medals and prize money in international television shows
option_b: To spend her holidays far away from people who need help
option_c: To take exciting selfies on high cliffs for her social media followers
option_d: To use those climbing, caving and water skills to rescue people in real disasters and accidents
explanation: Deniz kaya tırmanışı, mağaracılık ve rafting becerilerini yarışmalar için değil; kanyonlarda kaybolanları, kayalıklarda mahsur kalanları veya selzedeleri gerçek afet ve kazalarda kurtarmak için çalıştığını belirtmektedir.

Look at the statements of four athletes:
• Athlete 1: “I used to be terrified of heights, so I started rock climbing to defeat my phobia.”
• Athlete 2: “I want to see how far and how high my body and mind can go!”
• Athlete 3: “I love the quiet beauty of snowy mountain peaks where no cars can go.”
• Athlete 4: “Nothing beats the fast heartbeat when you jump out of a plane!”

Which athlete represents the MOST common motivation (45%) in the chart?
explanation: Grafikte %45 ile en yaygın motivasyon kişisel sınırları test etmektir ("Testing personal limits"). Bedeninin ve zihninin ne kadar ileri ve yükseğe gidebileceğini görmek isteyen Athlete 2 bu grubu temsil eder (1: Korkuları yenmek %10, 3: El değmemiş doğa %15, 4: Adrenalin %30).

question_text:
Read the text comparing two water sports: Kayaking vs. Rafting:
“Although people often confuse kayaking and rafting, they have clear differences. First, a raft is a large inflatable boat for a team of 4 to 10 people guided by a captain, whereas a kayak is usually a narrow solid plastic boat for just one person (or sometimes two). Second, rafters use a single-bladed paddle (a blade on only one end), while a kayaker holds a double-bladed paddle (blades on both left and right ends) to stroke alternately on each side.”

According to the text, which of the following is TRUE?
option_a: A kayaker uses a paddle with blades on both ends, while a rafter uses a single-bladed paddle.
option_b: Rafting is an individual sport done alone in a narrow solid plastic boat.
option_c: Neither kayaking nor rafting requires using a paddle or wearing a life jacket.
option_d: A kayak carries up to ten people and a captain on rough rivers.
explanation: Metinde raftingcilerin tek taraflı kürek ("single-bladed paddle"), kanocuların ise her iki ucunda da pal bulunan çift taraflı kürek ("double-bladed paddle") kullandığı açıkça belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
Look at the 4-day Adventure Camp schedule and weather forecast:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "Thursday: Mountain Biking (Forecast: Sunny, 22°C)" size=9 bold text 170 46 "Equipment: Bike, helmet, knee & elbow pads" size=9 text 170 68 "Friday: Paragliding from Hill (Forecast: Heavy Thunderstorm & 70 km/h Wind)" size=9 text 170 90 "Backup Indoor Plan: Climbing on Indoor Climbing Wall" size=9 text 170 112 "Saturday: River Canoeing (Forecast: Partly Cloudy, 24°C)" size=9 text 170 134 "Equipment: Canoe, paddle, life jacket" size=9``` Because the camp management strictly obeys weather safety rules, what will the campers do on Friday?
option_a: They will fly with paragliders in the heavy thunderstorm and 70 km/h wind.
option_b: They will cancel the whole 4-day camp and go home on Thursday morning.
option_c: They will practice climbing on the indoor climbing wall instead of paragliding.
option_d: They will go skiing on a snowy mountain without any equipment.
explanation: Cuma günü şiddetli gök gürültülü fırtına ve 70 km/sa rüzgar tahmin edildiği için güvenlik kuralları gereği yamaç paraşütü yapılmaz ve yedek kapalı alan planı olan Kapalı Tırmanış Duvarı ("Backup Indoor Plan: Climbing on Indoor Climbing Wall") uygulanır.

question_text:
Read the four friends’ preferences:
• Alp: “I prefer air sports to water sports, and I’d rather jump from a plane than fly from a hill.”
• Bora: “I’d rather explore underwater coral reefs than climb a rocky mountain.”
• Can: “To me, winter sports on snow are much more exciting than summer water sports.”
• Doruk: “I don’t like taking life-threatening risks; I prefer safe nature walks with a backpack.”

Which of the following is FALSE according to their statements?
option_a: Can would rather go snowboarding in winter than go windsurfing in summer.
option_b: Bora is keen on scuba diving under the sea rather than rock climbing.
option_c: Doruk prefers trekking in nature to dangerous extreme sports.
option_d: Alp prefers paragliding from a hill to skydiving from an airplane.
explanation: Alp tepeden uçmaktansa uçaktan atlamayı tercih ettiğini ("I’d rather jump from a plane than fly from a hill") söylediği için yamaç paraşütünü skydiving'e tercih ettiği bilgisi yanlıştır.

question_text:
Read the historical adventure story:
“In 1914, the explorer Ernest Shackleton and his 27 crew members sailed to Antarctica on their ship, Endurance. However, giant sea ice trapped and crushed their ship! Stranded on floating ice in freezing temperatures with no radio communication, Shackleton never lost hope. Using small lifeboats across the stormy ocean and climbing over icy mountains, he managed to bring all 27 of his men back home alive after nearly two years!”

Why is Shackleton’s Antarctica expedition remembered as an extraordinary achievement?
option_a: Because they sailed across Antarctica in five days during a warm summer holiday
option_b: Because despite losing their ship in freezing ice, every single crew member survived thanks to leadership and teamwork
option_c: Because Shackleton left his crew behind on the ice and returned to England alone
option_d: Because they called a rescue helicopter on their smartphones right after the ship sank
explanation: Gemileri buzullarda ezilip batmasına ve telsiz iletişimi olmamasına rağmen yaklaşık iki yıl süren zorlu mücadele sonunda 27 mürettebatının tamamını tek bir kayıp bile vermeden sağ salim kurtarması bu seferi olağanüstü kılmıştır.

question_text:
Look at the equipment table of a Sports Rental Shop:
Package CodeItems Included in the Rental Box
Box AWetsuit, diving mask, snorkel, fins (flippers), oxygen tank
Box BCrampons (spiked boots), ice axe, thermal coat, rope, helmet
Box CSkateboard, helmet, knee pads, elbow pads, wrist guards
Box DLife jacket, helmet, single-bladed paddle, waterproof shoes

Sinem and her team are going to climb an icy glacier mountain, while her brother Tolga is going to practice tricks at the city skatepark. Which boxes should Sinem and Tolga rent?
option_a: Sinem: Box B — Tolga: Box C
option_b: Sinem: Box D — Tolga: Box C
option_c: Sinem: Box B — Tolga: Box D
option_d: Sinem: Box A — Tolga: Box D
explanation: Buzul dağına tırmanacak olan Sinem çivili bot (krampon), buz kazması ve termal mont içeren Box B'yi; kaykay parkına gidecek olan Tolga ise kaykay, kask, dizlik ve dirseklik içeren Box C'yi kiralamalıdır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Instructor: Welcome to your first tandem skydiving lesson! Before boarding the plane, remember the golden rule: when the plane door opens at 4,000 meters, cross your arms over your chest, bend your legs backward, and keep your chin up.
Student: Why shouldn’t I grab the plane door with my hands when we jump?
Instructor: Because grabbing the door can unbalance both of us in the strong wind and injure your shoulder!

Why must the student cross their arms over their chest before jumping out of the plane?
option_a: To fly the airplane by themselves without the pilot
option_b: To take off their safety harness at 4,000 meters
option_c: To open the parachute inside the cabin before the plane takes off
option_d: To keep a balanced posture and prevent shoulder injury from grabbing the door
explanation: Kolları göğüs üzerinde çaprazlamak, atlarken uçak kapısına tutunup şiddetli rüzgarda dengeyi bozmayı ve omuz yaralanmasını önlemek içindir.

question_text:
Find the odd sentence out in the paragraph:
(I) Scuba diving in the Red Sea or the Mediterranean coast of Türkiye offers an unforgettable view of marine life. (II) Divers must learn hand signals before diving because they cannot speak to each other underwater. (III) To make a delicious chocolate cake, you should whisk three eggs with a cup of sugar for five minutes. (IV) For example, pointing your thumb up underwater does not mean “OK”; it is the emergency signal for “We must go up to the surface!”.
explanation: Paragraf tüplü dalış ve su altında kullanılan el işaretlerini anlatırken, III. cümle çikolatalı kek tarifinden bahsederek anlam bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır.

question_text:
Look at the meaning of the scuba diving hand signal mentioned in the previous question:
• Forming a circle with thumb and index finger (👌): “Everything is OK / Are you OK?”
• Pointing thumb UP (👍): “Go up to the surface (End the dive)!”
• Pointing thumb DOWN (👎): “Go deeper down!”
• Moving flat hand across the throat: “I am out of air (oxygen)!”

While diving 15 meters underwater, diver Melih notices that his diving partner’s mask is leaking water, so he wants both of them to swim up to the surface immediately. Which hand signal must Melih show?
option_a: Clapping his hands and singing a song
option_c: Forming a circle with his thumb and index finger
explanation: Su altında başparmağı yukarı kaldırmak ("Pointing thumb UP") "Tamam" demek değil, "Hemen su yüzeyine çıkalım / Dalışı bitirelim" demektir.

question_text:
Read the comparison chart of four extreme sports scored from 1 (Low) to 5 (High):
SportPhysical Effort NeededEquipment CostDanger / Risk Level
Trekking3 / 51 / 51 / 5
Rafting4 / 52 / 53 / 5
Rock Climbing5 / 53 / 54 / 5
Heli-skiing4 / 55 / 55 / 5

(Note: In heli-skiing, a helicopter takes skiers to the top of untouched snowy mountains.)

According to the scores in the table, which statement is CORRECT?
option_a: Heli-skiing is both the most expensive and the riskiest sport in the table, while rock climbing requires the highest physical effort.
option_b: Trekking is much more dangerous and expensive than rafting and rock climbing.
option_c: Rock climbing requires less physical strength than trekking in the forest.
option_d: Rafting is the cheapest and safest sport among all four activities.
explanation: Tabloya göre Heli-skiing hem maliyet (5/5) hem de tehlike/risk (5/5) açısından en yüksek puana sahipken, Kaya Tırmanışı ("Rock Climbing") fiziksel efor (5/5) açısından en yüksek spordur.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Eda: Look at these two holiday brochures. The first one is an “All-Inclusive Luxury Beach Resort” in Side, and the second one is a “7-Day Lycian Way Trekking & Camping Expedition” from Fethiye to Antalya.
Sinem: You know me, Eda! Lying by a hotel pool and eating at an open buffet all week is too monotonous for me. Walking along ancient mountain paths with a backpack and sleeping under the stars is way more appealing!

Which holiday will Sinem choose and why?
option_a: The All-Inclusive Luxury Beach Resort, because she hates walking and carrying a backpack
option_b: Neither of them, because she wants to stay at home and play computer games all summer
option_c: The Lycian Way Expedition, because she finds beach resorts boring and loves active nature adventures
option_d: The Beach Resort, because she thinks open buffets and hotel pools are very exciting
explanation: Otel havuzu kenarında uzanmayı çok tekdüze/sıkıcı ("monotonous") bulan Sinem, antik dağ patikalarında sırt çantasıyla yürüyüp yıldızların altında uyumayı çok daha çekici ("appealing") bulduğu için Likya Yolu Doğa Yürüyüşü turunu seçecektir.

question_text:
Read the text about Wingsuit Flying:
“Wingsuit flying is one of the most extreme air sports ever invented. The athlete wears a special jumpsuit with fabric wings between the arms and legs, looking like a flying squirrel! After jumping from a high cliff or airplane, the athlete glides horizontally through the air at speeds over 200 km/h before opening a parachute to land. To even start wingsuit training, a person must first complete at least 200 regular solo skydives!”

Why isn’t a beginner allowed to try wingsuit flying immediately?
option_a: Because wingsuit athletes land on the ground without opening any parachute
option_b: Because wingsuit flying is much slower and easier than riding a bicycle
option_c: Because the special winged jumpsuit can only be used under the sea
option_d: Because it is extremely dangerous and requires experience from at least 200 solo skydives first
explanation: Metinde wingsuit eğitimine başlayabilmek için bile bir kişinin önce en az 200 kez tek başına normal paraşüt atlayışı ("200 regular solo skydives") yapmış olması şartı bulunduğu belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
Read the four comments of teenagers who tried Zip-lining across a canyon:
• Kaan: “Sliding down a steel cable 100 meters above the green river was the most thrilling 60 seconds of my life!”
• Lara: “At first my knees were shaking on the platform, but once I pushed off, the view of the waterfall was breathtaking!”
• Mert: “The steel harness and helmet made me feel totally safe, so I wasn’t scared at all; I want to do it again!”
• Nil: “When I looked down at the deep canyon from the platform, I panicked and couldn’t jump, so I walked back down the stairs.”

According to the comments, how many of the four teenagers actually completed the zip-line ride across the canyon?
explanation: Kaan, Lara (başta dizleri titrese de kendisini itip kaymış ve şelale manzarasını izlemiş) ve Mert zip-line geçişini tamamlamış; sadece Nil platformdan aşağı bakınca panikleyip atlayamamış ve merdivenlerden geri inmiştir. Yani 3 kişi tamamlamıştır.

question_text:
Examine the sentences below:
• Canoeing is safer than white-water rafting.
• White-water rafting is safer than waterfall kayaking.

Based on these two facts, which comparison is LOGICALLY TRUE?
option_a: Waterfall kayaking is more dangerous than both canoeing and white-water rafting.
option_b: Canoeing is the most dangerous water sport among the three.
option_c: White-water rafting is less dangerous than canoeing.
option_d: Waterfall kayaking is much safer than canoeing on a calm lake.
explanation: Kano raftingden daha güvenli, rafting de şelale kanosundan daha güvenli olduğuna göre; en güvenli olan kano, en tehlikeli olan ise şelale kanosudur ("Waterfall kayaking is more dangerous than both...").

question_text:
Read the dialogue between a father and a rafting guide:
Father: Excuse me, my 13-year-old daughter wants to join the rafting tour, but she is wearing flip-flops (beach slippers). Is that okay?
Guide: I’m afraid not, sir. Flip-flops slip off immediately in the fast river water, and sharp rocks on the riverbed can cut her feet if she steps into the water. She can rent a pair of closed neoprene water shoes from our stand.

Why doesn’t the guide allow the girl to wear flip-flops on the rafting tour?
option_a: Because flip-flops are too heavy and make the inflatable raft sink
option_b: Because they easily come off in the river and cannot protect her feet from sharp rocks
option_c: Because the river water is boiling hot like lava
option_d: Because girls under 18 are not allowed to wear any shoes on the boat
explanation: Parmak arası plaj terlikleri hızlı nehir suyunda ayaktan hemen çıktığı ve suya basıldığında nehir yatağındaki keskin kayalar ayağı kesebileceği için kapalı su ayakkabısı giyilmesi zorunludur.

question_text:
Read the biography note about Sabiha Gökçen:
“Born in Bursa in 1913, Sabiha Gökçen was adopted by Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, who encouraged her to study aviation at the Turkish Aeronautical Association (Türkkuşu). She first mastered gliding (flying planes without engines) and parachuting, and later became the world’s first female combat pilot. Throughout her career, she flew 22 different types of aircraft for over 8,000 hours!”

Which of the following is CORRECT about Sabiha Gökçen according to the text?
option_a: She only flew passenger balloons for two hours during her whole career.
option_b: She was afraid of flying and preferred water sports like scuba diving.
option_c: She was a pioneer in aviation who trained in gliding, parachuting and flying many aircraft types.
option_d: Atatürk discouraged her from learning how to fly airplanes.
explanation: Atatürk'ün teşvikiyle Türkkuşu'nda planör, paraşüt ve uçuş eğitimi alarak dünyanın ilk kadın savaş pilotu olan ve 22 farklı uçak tipiyle 8.000 saatten fazla uçan bir havacılık öncüsüdür.

question_text:
Look at the weather table for 4 cities on Sunday:
CityWeather ConditionWind SpeedSea / River Condition
Bursa (Uludağ)Fresh powder snow, -4°C, clear sky10 km/h (Light)—
Muğla (Alaçatı/Akyaka)Sunny, 27°C35 km/h (Steady breeze)Good waves for boards
Artvin (Çoruh)Heavy rain & flood warning60 km/h (Stormy)Dangerous overflow
Nevşehir (Ürgüp)Thick fog & hail storm55 km/h (Gale)—

According to the Sunday weather conditions above, which two activities can be done SAFELY and IDEALLY?
option_a: Rafting in Artvin and hot air ballooning in Nevşehir
option_b: Rafting in Artvin and scuba diving in Bursa
option_c: Hot air ballooning in Nevşehir and snowboarding in Muğla
option_d: Snowboarding in Bursa and kitesurfing/windsurfing in Muğla
explanation: Bursa Uludağ'da taze kar ve açık gökyüzü snowboard için; Muğla'da güneşli hava ve 35 km/sa düzenli rüzgar uçurtma/rüzgar sörfü için idealdir. Artvin'de sel uyarısı, Nevşehir'de ise yoğun sis ve dolu fırtınası olduğundan oralarda etkinlik yapılamaz.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Interviewer: You photograph active volcanoes around the world. How close do you get to the boiling lava?
Photographer: Sometimes within 15 meters! The heat is so intense that normal plastic cameras melt, so I wear a silver heat-reflective suit and a gas mask to protect my lungs from toxic sulfur smoke.

Why does the volcano photographer wear a gas mask in addition to a heat-reflective suit?
option_a: To avoid breathing in poisonous gases coming out of the volcano
option_b: To keep his face cold when the temperature drops to -40°C
option_c: To hide his face from wild lions and tigers on the volcano
option_d: To breathe underwater while swimming inside the volcano lake
explanation: Gaz maskesini akciğerlerini volkandan çıkan zehirli kükürt dumanından ("toxic sulfur smoke / poisonous gases") korumak için takmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the safety instruction for Mountain Biking:
“When riding a mountain bike down a steep rocky trail, never squeeze ONLY the front brake lever hard! If you lock the front wheel on a downhill slope, the back wheel lifts into the air and you will fly over the handlebars. Instead, shift your body weight slightly back and squeeze both front and rear brakes gently together.”

What happens if a mountain biker presses ONLY the front brake hard while going downhill?
option_a: The tires automatically inflate themselves with extra air.
option_b: The bike stops smoothly and safely without any problem.
option_c: The bicycle flies up into the clouds like a helicopter.
option_d: The bike flips forward and throws the rider over the handlebars.
explanation: Yokuş aşağı inerken sadece ön frene sert basılırsa ön tekerlek kilitlenir, arka tekerlek havaya kalkar ve sürücü gidonun üzerinden öne doğru fırlayarak düşer ("fly over the handlebars").

question_text:
Examine the four students’ answers to the question: “What is the most challenging thing you have ever done?”
• Emre: “Camping in a tent at -10°C on Mount Erciyes last winter.”
• Filiz: “Swimming across the 6.5-kilometer Dardanelles Strait (Çanakkale Boğazı) race in open sea.”
• Gökhan: “Walking across a 150-meter high glass bridge over a canyon even though I’m afraid of heights.”
• Hale: “Riding a mountain bike for 40 kilometers through muddy forest trails.”

Whose challenge was an open-water endurance competition?
explanation: Açık denizde 6,5 kilometrelik Çanakkale Boğazı yüzme yarışını ("open-water endurance competition") tamamlayan kişi Filiz'dir.

question_text:
Read the short text about Orienteering:
“Orienteering is an outdoor adventure sport that combines cross-country running with navigation skills. Participants are given a specially detailed topographic map and a magnetic compass—smartphones and GPS watches are strictly forbidden! The goal is to find several orange-and-white checkpoint flags hidden in the forest in the shortest time.”

Why are smartphones and GPS watches banned in orienteering competitions?
option_a: Because orienteering only takes place inside underwater caves
option_b: Because the sport tests the athletes’ own ability to navigate using only a traditional map and compass
option_c: Because smartphones are too heavy for athletes to carry while running
option_d: Because the orange-and-white checkpoint flags emit dangerous radiation
explanation: Oryantiring sporu sporcuların yalnızca geleneksel topoğrafik harita ve manyetik pusula kullanarak kendi yön bulma becerilerini ölçtüğü için akıllı telefon ve GPS saatleri yasaktır.

question_text:
Choose the option that best combines the two sentences below without changing the meaning:
Sentence 1: Paragliding is very thrilling.
Sentence 2: However, skydiving is even more thrilling, so I choose skydiving.
option_a: I prefer skydiving to paragliding because skydiving is more thrilling than paragliding.
option_b: Neither paragliding nor skydiving is an exciting air sport for me.
option_c: Paragliding is more thrilling than skydiving, so I never try air sports.
option_d: I would rather go paragliding than skydiving because paragliding is safer.
explanation: Skydiving yamaç paraşütünden daha heyecan verici olduğu için skydiving'i tercih ettiğini belirten ilk cümle iki cümleyi anlam kaybı olmadan birleştirir.

question_text:
Read the final paragraph of an adventure magazine editorial:
“Whether you dive ten meters under the sea, soar a thousand meters in the sky, or simply hike along a quiet forest path, adventure is not about being fearless. True adventure is about respecting nature, preparing well, and stepping slightly outside your comfort zone to discover how capable you really are.”

According to the writer, what is “true adventure”?
option_a: Never leaving your bedroom so that nothing unexpected happens to you
option_b: Having zero fear and ignoring all safety equipment while doing extreme sports
option_c: Only jumping from airplanes without a parachute to prove you are brave
option_d: Respecting nature, being well-prepared, and expanding your comfort zone to discover your potential
explanation: Yazara göre gerçek macera korkusuz olmak değil; doğaya saygı duymak, iyi hazırlanmak ve konfor alanının biraz dışına çıkarak kendi potansiyelini keşfetmektir.

question_text:
Tourist: Excuse me, have you ________ visited the Ephesus Ancient City in İzmir?
Local Guide: Yes, I have been there many times! It is truly magnificent.

Which word completes the Present Perfect question?
explanation: Present Perfect Tense ile hayatında hiç yapıp yapmadığını sorarken "Have you ever + V3...?" kalıbı kullanılır.

question_text:
When my parents go on a summer holiday in Antalya, they always stay at an ________ resort because all meals, snacks and drinks are included in the hotel price.

Which accommodation type completes the sentence?
explanation: Tüm öğünlerin, atıştırmalıkların ve içeceklerin fiyata dahil olduğu otel konseptine "all-inclusive resort" (her şey dahil tatil köyü) denir.

question_text:
Sarah: What was the ________ like in Trabzon during your trip last week?
Mert: It was rainy and cool on the highlands, so we wore our raincoats.

Which word fits Sarah’s question?
explanation: Yanıtta yağmurlu ve serin olduğu söylendiği için hava durumu ("weather") sorulmuştur.

question_text:
Before flying back to London, the tourists visited the Grand Bazaar in İstanbul to buy traditional carpets, evil eye beads and ceramic bowls as ________ for their families.

Which word means “gifts bought to remember a place”?
explanation: Gezilen bir yeri hatırlamak veya yakınlara hediye etmek için alınan hediyelik eşyalara "souvenirs" denir.

question_text:
Look at the adjectives used to describe historical places:
• Ancient: Very old, from thousands of years ago
• Magnificent / Splendid: Extremely beautiful and impressive
• ________: Full of modern factories and current technology

Which adjective matches the third definition?
explanation: Günümüz teknolojisi ve modern yapılarla dolu çağdaş yerleri tanımlamak için "Contemporary / Modern" sıfatı kullanılır.

question_text:
Leo: Where do you prefer staying when you travel on a tight budget (with little money)?
Sam: I prefer staying at a youth ________ or a campsite because five-star hotels are too expensive for students.

Which low-cost accommodation completes the sentence?
explanation: Öğrenciler ve düşük bütçeli gezginler için uygun fiyatlı konaklama yeri gençlik pansiyonudur ("youth hostel").

question_text:
“Göbeklitepe in Şanlıurfa is the oldest known temple complex in the world. It attracts thousands of tourists who are interested in ________ and archaeology.”

Which word completes the sentence?
explanation: Dünyanın bilinen en eski tapınak kompleksi olan Göbeklitepe, tarih ("history") ve arkeolojiye ilgi duyan turistleri çeker.

question_text:
Emma: ________ have you been in Mardin?
Bora: For four days. We arrived here on Wednesday and we are leaving tomorrow.

Which question word asks about the duration of the stay?
explanation: Yanıtta kalış süresi ("For four days") verildiği için soru "How long" (Ne kadar süredir) olmalıdır.

question_text:
Look at the geographical terms:
• Location: Where a city or country is on the map (e.g., in the south of Türkiye)
• Climate: General weather conditions through the year (e.g., Mediterranean climate)
• ________: Local dishes and traditional food of a region (e.g., Adana Kebab, Baklava)

Which tourism term completes the list?
explanation: Bir bölgenin yerel yemeklerini ve mutfak kültürünü ifade eden terim "Cuisine"dir.

question_text:
Nina: Have you packed your suitcase for the Cyprus trip ________?
Clara: No, I haven’t packed it ________. I will do it after dinner.

Which word is used at the end of Present Perfect questions and negative sentences?
explanation: Present Perfect Tense soru ve olumsuz cümlelerinin sonunda "henüz" anlamında "yet" zarfı kullanılır.

question_text:
A ________ is a building that was built in the past to protect a city or king from enemy attacks, with high stone walls and towers (for example, Bodrum ________ or Alanya ________).

Which historical structure fills in all the blanks?
explanation: Yüksek taş duvarları ve kuleleriyle şehri savunmak için inşa edilmiş tarihi yapı kaledir ("castle").

question_text:
Tourist: How can I go from Kabataş to Kadıköy across the Bosphorus in İstanbul?
Officer: Taking the ________ across the sea is the fastest and most scenic way!

Which means of sea transportation completes the dialogue?
explanation: İstanbul Boğazı'nda deniz üzerinden karşı yakaya geçmenin en güzel yolu vapur/feribottur ("ferry / boat").

question_text:
Jack: Why do millions of people visit Pamukkale in Denizli every year?
Guide: Because its white travertine terraces with warm thermal water are a unique ________ wonder.

Which adjective completes the sentence?
explanation: Pamukkale'nin beyaz travertenleri insan yapımı değil, eşsiz bir doğal ("natural") harikadır.

question_text:
If you live in a noisy, crowded metropolis with heavy traffic, spending a week in a quiet green village in the Black Sea region is very ________.

Which positive adjective completes the sentence?
explanation: Gürültülü bir metropolden sonra sessiz ve yeşil bir köyde bir hafta geçirmek çok huzurlu ve ferahlatıcıdır ("peaceful and refreshing").

question_text:
Receptionist: May I see your passport and flight ticket, please?
Passenger: Here you are. Could you give me a window seat on the plane, please?

Where does this conversation take place?
explanation: Pasaport, uçak bileti ve uçakta cam kenarı koltuk istendiğine göre bu konuşma havaalanı biniş bankosunda ("airport check-in desk") geçmektedir.

question_text:
The Mausoleum at Halicarnassus in Bodrum and the Temple of Artemis in Ephesus were two of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, and both were ________ structures built as tombs or temples.

Which word means “historically important and grand”?
explanation: Antik Dünyanın Yedi Harikasından ikisi olan bu eserler anıtsal ve tarihi açıdan önemli ("monumental / historic") yapılardır.

question_text:
David: Which holiday type do you prefer: a cultural holiday or a seaside holiday?
Helen: Definitely a cultural holiday! I would rather visit ________ than sunbathe on the beach.

Which option completes Helen’s preference?
option_b: only water parks and swimming pools
explanation: Kültür tatilini ("cultural holiday") tercih eden biri plajda güneşlenmek yerine müzeleri, sarayları ve antik kalıntıları ("museums, palaces and ancient ruins") ziyaret etmeyi tercih eder.

question_text:
“Mount Nemrut in Adıyaman is famous for its giant stone head statues built by King Antiochus I, and watching the sunrise from its summit is ________.”

Which positive adjective fits the blank?
explanation: Nemrut Dağı'nın zirvesinde dev taş heykeller arasında gün doğumunu izlemek nefes kesicidir ("breathtaking").

question_text:
Tourist: How much is the entrance ________ for the Topkapı Palace Museum?
Clerk: It is free for Turkish students under 18, and you can also use a MuseumCard (Müzekart).

Which word completes the tourist’s question?
explanation: Müzeye giriş ücretini veya biletini sorarken "entrance fee / ticket" ifadesi kullanılır.

question_text:
A ________ place is located in the countryside (like a village or farm), whereas an urban place is located in a town or big city.

Which word is the opposite of “urban”?
explanation: Kentsel/şehir içi ("urban") kelimesinin zıttı kırsal/köy ("rural") kelimesidir.

question_text:
Zeynep: I have ________ returned from my school trip to Çanakkale. Look, my suitcase is still by the door!

Which adverb means “a very short time ago” in Present Perfect Tense?
explanation: Bavulunun hala kapının yanında olması geziden henüz/az önce döndüğünü gösterir; Present Perfect Tense'te "az önce / yeni" anlamında "just" kullanılır.

question_text:
CityLocationClimateFamous AttractionLocal Dish
TrabzonNorth (Black Sea)Rainy in all seasonsSümela MonasteryKuymak & Anchovy (Hamsi)
AntalyaSouth (Mediterranean)Hot summers, mild wintersAspendos TheatrePiyaz & Citrus jam
ŞanlıurfaSoutheast AnatoliaHot & dry summersGöbeklitepe & BalıklıgölÇiğ Köfte & Kebab
NevşehirCentral AnatoliaHot summers, cold snowy wintersFairy ChimneysTesti Kebabı (Pottery Kebab)

According to the information table above, which statement is CORRECT?
option_a: If you visit Trabzon, you should take an umbrella even in summer and taste seafood or kuymak.
option_b: Antalya has cold snowy winters and is located in the north of Türkiye.
option_c: Şanlıurfa is a rainy coastal city by the Black Sea famous for anchovies.
option_d: Göbeklitepe and Balıklıgöl are famous tourist attractions in Nevşehir.
explanation: Tabloya göre Trabzon her mevsim yağışlı ("Rainy in all seasons") olduğu için yazın bile şemsiye alınmalı ve yerel yemeği olan kuymak veya hamsi tadılmalıdır.
