Which of the following is TRUE according to the chart?
option_a: More tourists visit Türkiye for winter skiing than for summer beaches.
option_b: Seaside holidays are unpopular among foreign tourists visiting Türkiye.
option_c: Visiting ancient cities, museums and historical monuments is the top reason for visiting Türkiye.
option_d: Half of the foreign tourists come to Türkiye only for highland eco-tours.
explanation: Grafikte %40 ile ilk sırada Tarihi ve Kültürel Alanlar ("Historical & Cultural Sites") yer almaktadır.

question_text:
Read the travel blog post of Martin:
“Last April, my wife and I spent five days in Safranbolu, Karabük. Instead of staying at a modern concrete hotel, we stayed in a restored 200-year-old Ottoman wooden house with a lovely courtyard. We walked along cobblestone streets, visited the historical Cinci Inn, and bought delicious Turkish delight with saffron.”

Which topic did Martin NOT mention in his blog post?
option_a: The time and duration of their holiday
option_c: The type of accommodation they stayed in
option_d: The cost of the plane or bus tickets to Karabük
explanation: Martin yazısında zaman ve süreyi (geçen Nisan, 5 gün), konaklama türünü (restore edilmiş 200 yıllık Osmanlı konağı) ve aldıkları yerel ürünü (safranlı lokum) belirtmiş; ancak ulaşım biletlerinin fiyatından bahsetmemiştir.

question_text:
Look at the Travel Fact Card of Amasya:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "AMASYA — The City of Princes (Şehzadeler Şehri)" size=9 bold text 170 46 "Location: Black Sea Region, along the Yeşilırmak River" size=9 text 170 68 "Attractions: King Rock Tombs, Harsena Castle, Yalıboyu Houses" size=9 text 170 90 "Museums: Ferhat & Şirin Lovers Museum, Sabuncuoğlu Medical Museum" size=9 text 170 112 "Local Cuisine: Amasya Misket Apples, Toyga Soup, Keşkek" size=9 text 170 134 "Best Time to Visit: Spring (April - June) and Autumn" size=9``` According to the fact card above, why is Amasya an attractive destination for a tourist interested in history of medicine?
option_a: Because tourists can swim in the sea in April and June
option_b: Because it hosts the Sabuncuoğlu Medical Museum
option_c: Because it has modern glass skyscrapers and airports
option_d: Because it produces famous Misket apples along the river
explanation: Tıp tarihine ("history of medicine") ilgi duyan bir turist için Amasya'da Sabuncuoğlu Tıp ve Cerrahi Tarihi Müzesi ("Sabuncuoğlu Medical Museum") bulunmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the four tourists’ holiday preferences:
• Alice: “I want to see wild animals like lions, giraffes and elephants in their natural habitat.”
• Brian: “I love cruising on a giant luxury ship and visiting three different Mediterranean ports.”
• Clara: “I’d rather explore ancient Roman amphitheatres and archaeological museums.”
• David: “I prefer staying in a wooden bungalow in a pine forest and listening to birds.”

Who prefers a safari holiday and who prefers a cruise holiday?
explanation: Aslan, zürafa ve filleri doğal yaşam alanında görmek isteyen Alice "Safari", dev bir gemiyle Akdeniz limanlarını gezmek isteyen Brian ise "Cruise" (gemi turu) tatilini tercih etmektedir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Ebru: Have you ever been abroad, Kaan?
Kaan: No, I haven’t traveled outside Türkiye yet, but I have visited more than thirty provinces in our country, including Kars, Mardin, İzmir, and Çanakkale!
Ebru: Wow! Which city impressed you the most?
Kaan: Definitely Kars! Travelling on the Eastern Express train through snowy mountains and visiting the ancient ruins of Ani was unforgettable.

According to the dialogue, which of the following is TRUE?
option_a: Ebru has visited the ancient ruins of Ani in Kars many times.
option_b: Kaan went to Kars by airplane in the middle of a hot summer.
option_c: Kaan hasn’t visited a foreign country yet, but he has traveled widely in Türkiye.
option_d: Kaan traveled to thirty different countries in Europe by train last winter.
explanation: Kaan henüz yurt dışına çıkmadığını ("haven’t traveled outside Türkiye yet"), ancak Türkiye'de 30'dan fazla ili gezdiğini ve en çok Doğu Ekspresi ile gittiği Kars'tan etkilendiğini söylemektedir.

question_text:
Read the text about the Hagia Sophia (Ayasofya) and Blue Mosque (Sultanahmet):
“Located facing each other in the Historical Peninsula of İstanbul, Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque are two masterpieces of world architecture. Built in 537 AD during the Byzantine era and later enriched with Ottoman minarets and calligraphy, Hagia Sophia is famous for its massive dome. Right across the park stands the 17th-century Blue Mosque, known for its six minarets and over 20,000 handmade blue İznik tiles inside.”

Why is Sultanahmet Mosque called the “Blue Mosque” by foreign tourists?
option_a: Because it was built under the blue waters of the Bosphorus in 537 AD
option_b: Because its outer stone walls and six minarets are painted bright blue
option_c: Because tourists are only allowed to wear blue clothes inside the mosque
option_d: Because its interior walls are decorated with thousands of handmade blue İznik tiles
explanation: Metnin son cümlesinde caminin iç kısmında 20.000'den fazla el yapımı mavi İznik çinisi ("over 20,000 handmade blue İznik tiles inside") bulunduğu için Mavi Cami olarak adlandırıldığı açıklanmıştır.

question_text:
Compare two types of accommodation:
• Five-Star All-Inclusive Hotel: 4,000 TL per night. Includes open-buffet meals, swimming pools, room service, spa. Fixed meal hours and crowded dining halls.
• Caravan (Campervan) Holiday: 1,000 TL per day. You cook your own food, park by different beaches or forests every day, and enjoy freedom and nature.

Why would a traveler choose a Caravan Holiday instead of a Five-Star Hotel?
option_a: Because travelers in a caravan never have to drive or cook their own meals
option_b: Because it is more economical and offers the freedom to wake up in different natural places every day
option_c: Because staying in a caravan is four times more expensive than a five-star hotel
option_d: Because a caravan provides 24-hour room service and giant open-buffet dining halls
explanation: Karavan tatili gecelik 1.000 TL ile çok daha ekonomiktir ve her gün farklı bir kumsalda veya ormanda uyanma özgürlüğü sunar.

question_text:
Match the questions about a holiday with their answers:
1. Where did you stay during your holiday in Fethiye?
2. How did you travel to Fethiye?
3. What did you do during the day?
4. How was the food at the town restaurants?

a. We flew to Dalaman Airport and took a shuttle bus.
b. At a small boutique hotel by the marina.
c. The fresh Mediterranean seafood and olive oil dishes were delicious.
d. We took a boat tour to the 12 Islands and swam in turquoise bays.

Which matching is CORRECT?
explanation: Where did you stay (Nerede kaldınız) → b (Butik otelde); How did you travel (Nasıl gittiniz) → a (Uçak ve servisle); What did you do (Ne yaptınız) → d (12 Adalar tekne turu); How was the food (Yemekler nasıldı) → c (Deniz ürünleri lezzetliydi).

question_text:
Read the short note about Sumela Monastery:
“Sumela Monastery is built into a steep rock cliff at an altitude of 1,200 meters in the Altındere Valley of Maçka, Trabzon. Surrounded by misty green pine forests and rushing mountain streams, the monastery dates back to the 4th century AD and is famous for its colorful wall frescoes.”

According to the note, what makes Sumela Monastery’s location extraordinary?
option_a: It is a modern glass building in the center of Ankara.
option_b: It is built on a flat sandy beach right next to the Mediterranean Sea.
option_c: It is carved into a steep cliff high up in a forested mountain valley.
option_d: It is located in the middle of a dry desert without any trees or water.
explanation: Sümela Manastırı'nı sıra dışı kılan konumu, 1.200 metre yükseklikte ormanlık bir dağ vadisinde sarp bir kayalığın yüzüne ("steep rock cliff") inşa edilmiş olmasıdır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue at the Tourist Information Office:
Tourist: Hello! We only have one day in İzmir city center before our flight tomorrow. What do you suggest we see today?
Officer: First, visit the Iconic Clock Tower in Konak Square and feed the pigeons. Then, walk through the historical Kemeraltı Bazaar and drink Turkish coffee at Kızlarağası Inn. Finally, take the Historical Elevator (Tarihi Asansör) in Karataş to watch the sunset over the gulf!

What does the officer recommend the tourists to do at the end of the day (at sunset)?
option_a: Travel to another province by train in the morning
option_b: Go directly to the airport and wait inside the plane for twelve hours
option_c: Stay in their hotel room without going out to Konak Square
option_d: Go up the Historical Elevator in Karataş to enjoy the view of the İzmir Gulf
explanation: Görevli günün sonunda ("Finally") gün batımını körfez manzarasıyla izlemek için Karataş'taki Tarihi Asansör'e çıkmalarını önermektedir.

question_text:
Examine the grammar structure:
• “Mr. Tekin has gone to Rome.” → He is still in Rome now; he hasn’t returned yet.
• “Mr. Tekin has been to Rome.” → He visited Rome in the past and he is back home now.

Dialogue:
Aylin: You look very tanned and happy, Selin! Where were you last week?
Selin: Thanks! I ________ to Bodrum with my family. We came back home last night.

According to the rule above, which option completes Selin’s sentence in Present Perfect?
explanation: Selin dün gece eve döndüğüne ve şu an Aylin ile yüz yüze konuştuğuna göre "gidip döndüm / bulundum" anlamındaki "have been to" yapısı kullanılmalıdır.

question_text:
Look at the four review scores of Sunset Boutique Hotel:
• Cleanliness of Rooms: ★★★★★ (5/5)
• Friendliness of Staff: ★★★★★ (5/5)
• Quality of Breakfast: ★★★★☆ (4/5)
• Distance to the Beach: ★☆☆☆☆ (1/5 — 4 km away up a steep hill)

According to the guest ratings, what is the ONLY weakness of Sunset Boutique Hotel?
option_a: Its location is far from the sea and requires walking up a steep hill.
option_b: The hotel rooms are very dirty and never cleaned by the staff.
option_c: The hotel doesn’t serve any breakfast in the morning.
option_d: The receptionists and waiters are very rude to the guests.
explanation: Otelin temizlik (5/5), personel nezaketi (5/5) ve kahvaltı (4/5) puanları çok yüksekken, plaja uzaklığı ("Distance to the Beach" — 4 km dik yokuş yukarıda olması) 1/5 puanla tek zayıf yönüdür.

question_text:
Read the text:
“Mount Ararat (Ağrı Dağı), at 5,137 meters, is the highest peak in Türkiye. Not far from the mountain, in the Doğubayazıt district of Ağrı, stands the magnificent Ishak Pasha Palace. Completed in 1784, this Ottoman palace is famous for having one of the world’s earliest central heating systems running through stone pipes inside its walls!”

What surprising technological feature does the 18th-century Ishak Pasha Palace have?
option_a: A modern electric elevator reaching 5,137 meters into the sky
option_b: A solar-powered swimming pool on the roof of the palace
option_c: An early central heating system built with stone pipes inside the walls
option_d: An underground subway train connecting Ağrı to İstanbul
explanation: Metinde 1784'te tamamlanan İshak Paşa Sarayı'nın duvarlarının içindeki taş borulardan geçen dünyanın en eski merkezi ısıtma sistemlerinden ("earliest central heating systems") birine sahip olduğu belirtilmiştir.

question_text: Teacher: Imagine you are preparing a tourism poster for your hometown. Which of the following FOUR headings should you include on a complete travel guide poster?
option_a: Only the list of hospitals and police stations in the city
option_b: How to knead bread dough and boil pasta in ten minutes
option_c: Math Formulas — Kitchen Tools — Computer Viruses — Phone Extensions
option_d: Location & Climate — Places to Visit — Traditional Dishes — Accommodation Options
explanation: Tam bir turizm rehberi afişinde Konum ve İklim ("Location & Climate"), Gezilecek Yerler ("Places to Visit"), Geleneksel Yemekler ("Traditional Dishes") ve Konaklama Seçenekleri ("Accommodation Options") yer almalıdır.

Which tour package should Mr. and Mrs. Demir book?
explanation: 4 günlük ve 6.800 TL bütçe altı iki kültür turu vardır: Aegean Pearls (6.000 TL) ve Mesopotamia Mystery (6.500 TL). Ancak İzmir ve Efes'i daha önce üç kez gezdikleri ve tarihi taş konakta ("Historical Stone Mansion") kalmak istedikleri için "Mesopotamia Mystery" turunu seçmelidirler.

question_text:
Read the travel diary of Julia, a Canadian tourist in Türkiye:
• Day 1–2 (İstanbul): “We crossed from Europe to Asia by ferry, visited Topkapı Palace and Basilica Cistern, and ate grilled fish sandwiches by Galata Bridge.”
• Day 3–4 (Cappadocia): “We took a 1-hour flight to Kayseri. We explored the Derinkuyu Underground City, which goes 8 floors deep under the earth! At sunrise, we watched hundreds of colorful balloons.”
• Day 5–6 (Pamukkale & Ephesus): “We walked barefoot on the warm white calcium terraces of Pamukkale and admired the two-story Celsus Library in Ephesus.”

According to Julia’s diary, on which days did she visit an engineering wonder carved deep beneath the ground to shelter thousands of people in ancient times?
option_a: On Day 5–6 on the white terraces of Pamukkale
option_b: On Day 3–4 in Cappadocia (Derinkuyu Underground City)
option_c: On Day 1–2 on the Bosphorus ferry in İstanbul
option_d: On the flight from İstanbul to Kayseri Airport
explanation: Yerin 8 kat derinliğine inen Derinkuyu Yer Altı Şehri'ni ("Derinkuyu Underground City") 3 ve 4. günlerde Kapadokya'da ziyaret etmiştir.

question_text:

Which of the following deductions is CORRECT according to the chart above?
option_a: Thirty percent of the tourists prefer mobile or outdoor nature accommodation (tents or caravans) over hotel buildings.
option_b: Caravan holidays are more popular than staying at boutique pensions.
option_c: More than half of the tourists stay at five-star all-inclusive hotels.
option_d: Nobody prefers staying at small boutique pensions or hostels in summer.
explanation: Otel binaları yerine doğada/taşınabilir konaklamayı seçen Kamp ve Çadır (%18) ile Karavan (%12) toplamı %18 + %12 = %30'dur.

question_text:
Read the conversation between two friends at the end of the summer holiday:
Kerem: How was your family trip to Black Sea highlands, Sinan?
Sinan: The nature and green plateaus were like heaven, Kerem! However, on the third day in Rize, it rained so heavily that a thick fog covered the mountain roads. We couldn’t drive up to Pokut Highland, so we spent that day visiting the Rize Tea Museum and drinking fresh tea by the stove.

What can we say about Sinan’s trip?
option_a: They drove up to Pokut Highland easily on the third day because the sky was clear.
option_b: The weather was sunny and hot every single day during their trip in Rize.
option_c: Sinan hated the Black Sea region and returned home on the first day.
option_d: Although bad weather prevented them from visiting Pokut Highland, he still enjoyed the green nature and local culture.
explanation: Üçüncü gün şiddetli yağmur ve yoğun sis nedeniyle Pokut Yaylası'na çıkamasalar da Sinan yeşil doğayı cennet gibi bulmuş ve o günü Rize Çay Müzesi'ni gezerek keyifle değerlendirmiştir.

question_text:
Examine the brochure of the UNESCO World Heritage Site — Hattusha (Boğazkale, Çorum):
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "HATTUSHA — Capital of the Hittite Empire (1600 - 1200 BC)" size=9 bold text 170 46 "Location: Boğazkale district, Çorum (Central Anatolia)" size=9 text 170 68 "Famous Ruins: The Lion Gate, The King’s Gate, The Great Temple" size=9 text 170 90 "Yazılıkaya Open-Air Sanctuary (Rock reliefs of Hittite gods)" size=9 text 170 112 "Historical Importance: Home to the Treaty of Kadesh (1258 BC)" size=9 text 170 134 "The oldest known written peace treaty in world history!" size=9``` According to the brochure, why is Hattusha important in the history of international diplomacy and law?
option_a: Because tourists can go heli-skiing from the Lion Gate in July
option_b: Because it was the capital of the empire that signed the world’s oldest known written peace treaty (Kadesh)
option_c: Because the Hittites invented the first electric telegraph in 1258 BC
option_d: Because it is the largest modern summer beach resort on the Mediterranean coast
explanation: Dünya tarihinin bilinen en eski yazılı barış antlaşması olan Kadeş Antlaşması'na (MÖ 1258) ev sahipliği yapması Hattuşa'yı uluslararası diplomasi ve hukuk tarihinde çok önemli kılmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the four hotel reviews written by guests on a travel website:
• Guest 1: “The historical architecture of the hotel was lovely, and the price was very cheap, so we got great value for our money.”
• Guest 2: “The brochure said the hotel was ‘right on the beach’, but we had to take a bus for 20 minutes to reach the sea! Complete false advertising!”
• Guest 3: “The traditional village breakfast with homemade jams, olives and hot pastry was the best meal I have ever eaten.”
• Guest 4: “Even though our flight landed at 2 a.m., the receptionist welcomed us with a warm smile and carried our heavy bags.”

Which guest is complaining about misleading information in the hotel brochure?
explanation: Broşürde otelin "tam denize sıfır" ("right on the beach") yazdığını ancak denize ulaşmak için 20 dakika otobüse binmek zorunda kaldıklarını söyleyerek yanıltıcı reklamdan şikayet eden Guest 2'dir.

question_text:
Read the text about Sustainable (Eco-Friendly) Tourism:
“Mass tourism can sometimes harm fragile natural areas and ancient ruins if visitors leave plastic trash, pick rare wildflowers, or use too much water. Eco-tourism (sustainable tourism) aims to protect nature and support local villagers. Eco-tourists carry reusable water bottles, stay in solar-powered local guesthouses, buy handmade crafts directly from villagers, and follow the rule: ‘Take only photos, leave only footprints.’”

What does the eco-tourism motto “Take only photos, leave only footprints” mean?
option_a: Do not take any plants, stones or historical pieces from nature, and do not leave any garbage behind.
option_b: Do not wear any shoes while walking on rocky mountains so your feet leave marks.
option_c: Tourists should never spend money in local villages or take a camera with them.
option_d: Throw plastic water bottles in the forest after taking photos of wildflowers.
explanation: "Sadece fotoğraf çekin, sadece ayak izi bırakın" sloganı; doğadan veya tarihi alanlardan hiçbir bitki, taş ya da parça koparıp almamayı ve geride hiçbir çöp bırakmamayı öğütlemektedir.

question_text:
Look at the table showing which cities four cousins have visited in Türkiye (✓ = Visited, ✗ = Not visited yet):
CousinİstanbulÇanakkaleGaziantepNevşehir
Emir✓✓✗✓
Fırat✓✗✓✓
Gizem✓✓✓✗
Hande✗✓✓✓

This autumn, the four cousins want to travel together to ONE of the four cities above where as many of them as possible have already been, OR they want to check their travel history. Wait—read the statements below carefully:
Which statement is CORRECT according to the table?
option_a: Nobody in the group has ever been to Gaziantep or Çanakkale.
option_b: Emir has visited Gaziantep, whereas Fırat has visited Çanakkale.
option_c: All four cousins have already visited İstanbul and Nevşehir.
option_d: Each of the four cities has been visited by three cousins and missed by only one cousin.
explanation: Tablodaki her sütuna (İstanbul, Çanakkale, Gaziantep, Nevşehir) bakıldığında her şehirde üç adet ✓ ve sadece bir adet ✗ bulunduğu, yani her şehrin 3 kuzen tarafından ziyaret edilip 1 kuzen tarafından henüz görülmediği doğrudur.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Travel Agent: Welcome to Globe Travel! Are you planning a trip for the mid-term break in January?
Mrs. Akın: Yes. My husband and kids want to go skiing for three days, and I want to relax in natural hot thermal pools because of my back pain. Is there a place in Türkiye where we can find BOTH a ski center and famous thermal hotels in the same city?
Travel Agent: Definitely! You should go to ________, where you can ski on Mount Uludağ during the day and stay at the historic thermal hotels in the Çekirge district in the evening!

Which Turkish city completes the travel agent’s recommendation?
explanation: Hem Uludağ'da kayak merkezi hem de Çekirge semtinde tarihi termal kaplıca otelleri bulunan şehrimiz Bursa'dır.

question_text:
Find the odd sentence out in the paragraph:
(I) Mardin is one of the most poetic cities in southeastern Türkiye with its amber-colored limestone houses built on a hillside. (II) Visitors can admire the harmony of different cultures by visiting historical mosques, churches and monasteries in the same neighborhood. (III) To protect your computer from hackers, you should install an antivirus program and never share your password. (IV) In the evening, looking out over the vast Mesopotamian plain from a rooftop restaurant is a truly magical experience.
explanation: Paragraf Mardin'in taş mimarisi, kültürel uyumu ve Mezopotamya ovası manzarasını anlatırken, III. cümle bilgisayar güvenliğinden bahsederek akışı bozmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the four sentences and identify the tense difference:
• Sentence A: “I have visited the Zeugma Mosaic Museum in Gaziantep twice.”
• Sentence B: “I visited the Zeugma Mosaic Museum in Gaziantep in May 2023.”

Why does Sentence A use Present Perfect Tense (have visited) while Sentence B uses Simple Past Tense (visited)?
option_a: Because Sentence A talks about life experience without giving a specific past date, while Sentence B states the exact past time (May 2023).
option_b: Because there is no difference in grammar rules when we use “in May 2023”.
option_c: Because the speaker in Sentence A has never seen the Gypsy Girl mosaic in Gaziantep.
option_d: Because Sentence A talks about a future plan for next summer, while Sentence B talks about today.
explanation: Present Perfect Tense (birinci cümle) geçmişte ne zaman olduğu belirtilmeyen yaşam deneyimlerini ("twice") anlatırken, Simple Past Tense (ikinci cümle) "in May 2023" gibi belirli bir geçmiş zaman zarfıyla kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the information about four famous structures in Türkiye:
• 1. Selimiye Mosque (Edirne): Built by the great Ottoman architect Mimar Sinan in 1575; he called it “my masterpiece”.
• 2. Aspendos Theatre (Antalya): Built by the Romans in the 2nd century AD; its acoustics are so perfect that a whisper on stage can be heard from the top row.
• 3. Mount Nemrut Statues (Adıyaman): Built by the Kingdom of Commagene in 62 BC at a 2,134-meter mountain peak.
• 4. Anıtkabir (Ankara): Completed in 1953 as the eternal resting place (mausoleum) of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, the founder of the Turkish Republic.

Put these four monumental structures in chronological order from the OLDEST to the NEWEST.
explanation: MÖ 62 (Nemrut - 3) en eski tarihtir; ardından MS 2. yüzyıl (Aspendos - 2), MS 1575 (Selimiye - 1) ve MS 1953 (Anıtkabir - 4) gelir.

question_text:
Read the conversation between a tourist and a museum guide in Gaziantep:
Tourist: This mosaic of the young woman with deep, sad eyes is incredible! Why are all the visitors standing in a dark room to look at her?
Guide: This is the famous “Gypsy Girl” (Çingene Kızı) mosaic from the ancient city of Zeugma. The architects placed it in a special dimly lit labyrinth room so that the spotlight highlights the 3D effect of her eyes, which seem to follow you whichever corner of the room you move to!

Why is the “Gypsy Girl” mosaic displayed in a dimly lit room with a spotlight?
option_a: Because the mosaic melts like ice if normal light touches it
option_b: Because the museum ran out of electricity and couldn’t pay the bill
option_c: To hide the mosaic so that tourists cannot see the colorful stones
option_d: To bring out the three-dimensional look of her eyes that seem to follow the viewer from every angle
explanation: Odanın loş ("dimly lit") yapılıp özel spot ışığıyla aydınlatılmasının nedeni, odanın hangi köşesine gidilirse gidilsin izleyiciyi takip ediyormuş gibi görünen gözlerin üç boyutlu etkisini ortaya çıkarmaktır.

question_text:
Look at the travel budget calculation of the Kaya Family (2 Adults + 2 Children):
• Transportation (Round-trip bus tickets): 500 TL per person (No child discount on bus)
• Accommodation (3 nights at a Bed & Breakfast pension): 1,000 TL per night for the whole family room
• Food & Museum Tickets (Total for 4 days): 3,000 TL for the whole family

How much does the Kaya family spend IN TOTAL for their 4-day holiday?
explanation: Ulaşım: 4 kişi × 500 TL = 2.000 TL. Konaklama: 3 gece × 1.000 TL = 3.000 TL. Yemek ve müze biletleri: 3.000 TL. Toplam harcama: 2.000 + 3.000 + 3.000 = 8.000 TL.

question_text:
Read the short text about Lake Salda (Burdur) and Lake Van:
“Türkiye has many extraordinary lakes. Lake Van, in Eastern Anatolia, is the largest lake in Türkiye; its alkaline (soda) water is famous for the historic Akdamar Island and its 10th-century church. On the other hand, Lake Salda in Burdur is famous for its bright white shore and turquoise water. Scientists at NASA even studied Lake Salda because its white hydromagnesite mineral rocks are very similar to the Jezero Crater on the planet Mars!”

Why did NASA scientists study Lake Salda in Burdur?
option_a: Because its white mineral formations closely resemble a crater on Mars
option_b: Because it is the largest lake in Eastern Anatolia with an island church
option_c: Because Lake Salda is an artificial swimming pool built in 2020
option_d: Because astronauts land their spaceships in the middle of Lake Salda
explanation: NASA bilim insanları Salda Gölü'ndeki beyaz hidromanyezit mineral kayalarının Mars gezegenindeki Jezero Krateri'ne çok benzemesi ("very similar to the Jezero Crater on the planet Mars") nedeniyle gölü incelemiştir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Pelin: How was your holiday in Rome, Mert? Did you throw a coin into the Trevi Fountain and eat authentic Italian pizza?
Mert: The pizza and gelato (ice cream) were fantastic, and the Colosseum was magnificent! However, when we went to the Trevi Fountain on Tuesday, it was drained (empty of water) and surrounded by glass barriers for a monthly cleaning and restoration, so we couldn’t take good photos there.

What was the only disappointing part of Mert’s trip to Rome?
option_a: He lost his passport and money on the plane to Italy.
option_b: The Trevi Fountain was empty and under maintenance when they visited it.
option_c: The Colosseum was closed and demolished before they arrived.
option_d: Italian pizza and ice cream tasted terrible at the restaurants.
explanation: Mert'in Roma gezisindeki tek hayal kırıklığı, Salı günü Trevi Çeşmesi'ne (Aşk Çeşmesi) gittiklerinde aylık temizlik ve bakım nedeniyle suyunun boşaltılmış ve cam bariyerlerle çevrilmiş olmasıdır.

question_text:
Examine the four sentences below:
1. “To me, ancient cities are more fascinating than modern shopping malls.”
2. “I’d rather visit historical ruins than spend time in modern shopping centers.”
3. “I prefer modern shopping malls to ancient historical sites.”
4. “I find historical sites much more attractive than contemporary shopping centers.”

Which sentence expresses an OPPOSITE preference compared to the other three?
explanation: 1, 2 ve 4. cümleler antik/tarihi yerleri modern alışveriş merkezlerine tercih ederken; 3. cümle modern alışveriş merkezlerini antik alanlara tercih ederek tam zıt bir görüş bildirmektedir.

question_text:
Look at the table of 4 UNESCO World Heritage Sites in Türkiye and the year they were added to the list:
UNESCO Heritage SiteProvinceYear AddedCategory
Great Mosque and Hospital of DivriğiSivas1985Cultural
Hierapolis – PamukkaleDenizli1988Mixed (Both Cultural & Natural)
City of SafranboluKarabük1994Cultural
GöbeklitepeŞanlıurfa2018Cultural

According to the table, which site is on the UNESCO list for BOTH its natural beauty and its historical ruins?
option_a: Great Mosque and Hospital of Divriği (Sivas)
explanation: Tabloda "Mixed (Both Cultural & Natural)" yani hem kültürel (Hierapolis antik kenti) hem de doğal (Pamukkale travertenleri) miras kategorisinde yer alan tek alan Hierapolis – Pamukkale'dir.

question_text:
Read the text about the “MuseumCard” (Müzekart) in Türkiye:
“If you are a Turkish citizen and love visiting historical places, buying a single ticket at every museum entrance can be expensive. With the official Müzekart issued by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, you pay a very small annual fee once, and you can visit more than 350 museums and archaeological sites—such as Ephesus, Göbeklitepe, Topkapı Palace, and Sumela Monastery—for free for a whole year!”

What is the main advantage of having a “Müzekart”?
option_a: It allows citizens to enter over 350 museums and ancient sites across Türkiye for a whole year by paying a single low annual fee.
option_b: It can only be used once at a single museum in Ankara on Sundays.
option_c: It is ten times more expensive than buying individual tickets at museum gates.
option_d: It gives free plane tickets and five-star hotel rooms to foreign tourists in Europe.
explanation: Müzekart'ın temel avantajı, yılda tek bir düşük ücret ödeyerek Türkiye genelindeki 350'den fazla müze ve ören yerine bir yıl boyunca ücretsiz girilebilmesidir.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Dad: Kids, we are going to Çanakkale this weekend! On Saturday, we will visit the Gallipoli (Gelibolu) Historical National Park, the Martyrs’ Memorial (Şehitler Abidesi), and the 57th Infantry Regiment Memorial. On Sunday, we will see the Ancient City of Troy and the Trojan Horse.
Daughter: That’s wonderful, Dad! We just studied the Çanakkale Victory of 1915 in our 8th-grade History class last week!

Why is the daughter especially excited about Saturday’s program?
option_a: Because they are going to visit the Ancient City of Troy on Saturday morning
option_b: Because she wants to swim at an all-inclusive water park on Saturday morning
option_c: Because she will see the real historical places of the 1915 Çanakkale Victory that she recently learned about at school
option_d: Because she doesn’t know anything about the history of Çanakkale
explanation: Geçen hafta 8. sınıf İnkılap Tarihi dersinde 1915 Çanakkale Zaferi'ni işledikleri için Cumartesi günü Gelibolu Tarihi Milli Parkı ve Şehitler Abidesi'ni yerinde görecek olmaktan büyük heyecan duymaktadır.

question_text:
Read the four clues to guess the famous Turkish province:
1. It is located in the Aegean Region and has a warm Mediterranean climate with lovely beaches like Çeşme and Foça.
2. Its symbol is the historical Clock Tower in Konak Square.
3. It is home to the UNESCO World Heritage ancient cities of Ephesus (in Selçuk) and Pergamon / Bergama.
4. Its famous local delicacies include Boyoz, Kumru, and İzmir Köfte.

Which province is described above?
explanation: Çeşme, Foça, Konak Saat Kulesi, Efes, Bergama, boyoz ve kumru ipuçlarının tamamı İzmir ilimize aittir.

question_text:
Read the notice on the wall of an Archaeological Museum:
“DEAR VISITORS:
• Photography is allowed inside the museum, but FLASH photography is strictly prohibited because bright flash light fades the ancient pigments on 2,000-year-old frescoes and manuscripts.
• Do not touch the marble statues because natural oils on human skin damage the stone surface over time.
• Large backpacks and umbrellas must be left at the cloakroom at the entrance.”

According to the notice, why is taking photos with a flash forbidden inside the museum?
option_a: Because flash light wakes up the security guards at the entrance
option_b: Because cameras are completely banned inside the museum building
option_c: Because marble statues break into pieces when someone takes a photo
option_d: Because strong flash light damages and fades the colors of ancient paintings and manuscripts
explanation: Duyuruda güçlü flaş ışığının 2.000 yıllık fresklerin ve el yazmalarının üzerindeki antik boyaları soldurduğu ("fades the ancient pigments") açıkça belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Sarp: Which city would you rather visit in winter: Kars or Antalya?
Ece: Definitely Kars! I know Antalya has mild weather even in January, but watching the snow-covered Baltic architecture in Kars, riding a horse sleigh on the frozen Lake Çıldır, and eating goose meat is a unique winter fairy tale!

Why does Ece prefer visiting Kars to Antalya in winter?
option_a: Because she wants to experience a snowy winter atmosphere and walk on the frozen Lake Çıldır
option_b: Because Kars is much hotter than Antalya in January and has sandy beaches
option_c: Because she hates snow and cold weather during her winter holidays
option_d: Because Lake Çıldır is located in the center of Antalya
explanation: Ece Antalya'nın Ocak ayında ılıman olduğunu bilmesine rağmen, karla kaplı Baltık mimarisini görmek ve donmuş Çıldır Gölü üzerinde atlı kızakla kaymak gibi kış masalı atmosferini yaşamak için Kars'ı tercih etmektedir.

question_text:
Examine the travel statistics of Bora:
• Countries visited so far: Italy (2021), Japan (2022), Egypt (2024).
• Favorite trip: Japan (because of its high-speed bullet trains, cherry blossoms, and polite people).
• Next travel plan: Norway (in December, to see the Northern Lights — Aurora Borealis).

Which sentence is CORRECT according to Bora’s travel notes?
option_a: Bora has already visited Norway in December to see the Northern Lights.
option_b: Bora has already been to three foreign countries, and he hasn’t seen the Northern Lights in Norway yet.
option_c: Bora liked his trip to Egypt more than his trip to Japan.
option_d: Bora has never traveled by high-speed train or seen cherry blossoms.
explanation: Bora şu ana kadar 3 yabancı ülkede (İtalya, Japonya, Mısır) bulunmuştur ("has already been to three foreign countries"); Norveç ise gelecek planı olduğu için Kuzey Işıklarını henüz görmemiştir ("hasn’t seen... yet").

question_text:
Read the quote by Ibn Battuta, the famous 14th-century traveler:
“Traveling—it leaves you speechless, then turns you into a storyteller.”

What does Ibn Battuta mean by this quote?
option_a: Travelers should never talk to local people or tell their friends about their trips.
option_b: You should only read storybooks at home instead of traveling to new cities.
option_c: At first you are amazed by the beauty of new places, and later you have wonderful experiences and memories to share with others.
option_d: People who travel to foreign countries lose their ability to speak forever.
explanation: Ünlü gezgin İbn Battuta bu sözüyle; seyahat etmenin insanı önce gördüğü güzellikler karşısında hayranlıkla susturduğunu ("leaves you speechless"), ardından anlatacak harika anılarla bir hikaye anlatıcısına dönüştürdüğünü ifade etmektedir.

question_text:
Mother: The clean clothes in the basket are dry now, but they are very wrinkled. Who is going to ________ the laundry today?
Father: Don’t worry, it’s my turn. I’ll plug in the iron right now.

Which household chore verb completes the mother’s question?
explanation: Kurumuş ancak kırışmış ("wrinkled") çamaşırları ütülemek için "iron" fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Look at the kitchen chores:
• Cooking the meal
• Setting the table before dinner
• ________ the dishwasher with dirty plates after dinner

Which verb completes the third chore?
explanation: Yemekten sonra kirli tabakları bulaşık makinesine doldurmak/yerleştirmek "Loading the dishwasher" (boşaltmak ise "Emptying") ifadesiyle anlatılır.

question_text:
Teacher: Remember our classroom rules, kids! You ________ raise your hand before speaking, and you mustn’t interrupt your friends.

Which modal verb expresses an obligation / rule?
explanation: Sınıf kurallarını ve zorunlulukları ifade ederken "must / have to" kullanılır.

question_text:
Every Sunday morning, my elder brother goes into the garden and ________ the lawn because the grass grows very fast in spring.

Which verb completes the outdoor chore?
explanation: Bahçedeki çimleri ("the lawn / grass") biçmek için "mow" fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Selin: Who is ________ for taking out the garbage in your house?
Kaan: I am! I take the trash bags out every evening at 8 p.m.

Which adjective completes the question with the preposition “for”?
explanation: "for" edatıyla birlikte "sorumlu olmak" anlamında kullanılan sıfat "responsible" ("be responsible for") kelimesidir ("in charge" ise "of" ile kullanılır).

question_text:
After vacuuming the carpets, my mother uses a bucket of soapy water and a wet mop to ________ the kitchen and bathroom tiles.

Which verb fits the blank?
explanation: Kovadaki sabunlu su ve paspasla mutfak/banyo fayanslarını paspaslamak için "mop" fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Son: Mom, can I play football in the garden now?
Mother: First, you have to ________ your bed and tidy up your toys on the floor!

Which verb completes the bedroom chore?
explanation: Sabah kalkınca yatağı toplamak/düzeltmek İngilizcede "make the bed" kalıbıyla ifade edilir.

question_text:
Look at the synonym expressions for chores:
• It’s my duty = It’s my responsibility
• I am in charge of... = I am responsible for...
• ________ = To share the housework equally and help each other

Which phrase matches the third definition?
option_a: Make a mess in the house
explanation: Ev işlerini eşit paylaşmak ve yardımlaşmak "Cooperate / Share the chores" ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
“When you wash the dishes or brush your teeth, don’t leave the water tap running! We mustn’t ________ water.”

Which verb completes the household rule?
explanation: Musluğu açık bırakarak suyu boşa harcamamamız/israf etmememiz ("mustn’t waste water") gerekir.

question_text:
Ece: Do you have any pet chores at home?
Bora: Yes! It’s my duty to ________ our golden retriever dog, Max, in the park every morning and evening.

Which verb completes Bora’s duty?
explanation: Evcil köpeği her sabah ve akşam parkta gezdirmek veya beslemek "walk / feed the dog" ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
After the washing machine finishes washing the clothes, we take the wet clothes out and ________ them on the balcony rope to dry in the sun.

Which verb completes the laundry process?
explanation: Yıkanmış ıslak çamaşırları kuruması için balkondaki ipe asmak "hang out the laundry / clothes" deyimsel fiiliyle anlatılır.

question_text:
Librarian: Shh! This is a reading hall. You must keep quiet and you ________ talk loudly or eat food here.

Which negative modal expresses prohibition (something forbidden)?
explanation: Kütüphanede yüksek sesle konuşmanın ve yemek yemenin yasak olduğunu ("prohibition") belirtmek için "mustn’t" kullanılır.

question_text:
We ran out of milk, eggs, bread and tomatoes at home, so my father went to the supermarket to do the ________ shopping.

Which word completes the chore?
explanation: Süt, yumurta, ekmek ve sebze gibi temel gıda ve mutfak alışverişi yapmak "do the grocery shopping" olarak adlandırılır.

question_text:
Sister: Why are you holding a soft cloth and spray?
Brother: Because I am ________ the bookshelves and the TV table in the living room.

Which verb means “removing dust from furniture”?
explanation: Yumuşak bir bezle kitaplıkların ve televizyon sehpasının tozunu almak "dusting the furniture / shelves" ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
In our family, everyone removes their shoes at the entrance door so that we don’t bring mud and dirt onto the clean ________.

Which household item completes the sentence?
explanation: Eve girerken ayakkabıların çıkarılması temiz halılara ve zemine ("carpets / floors") çamur gelmemesi içindir.

question_text:
Dad: Don’t forget to pay the electricity and natural gas ________ before Friday, or they will cut off the power!

Which word completes the father’s reminder?
explanation: Elektrik ve doğal gaz faturalarını ödemek "pay the bills" ifadesiyle anlatılır.

question_text:
In autumn, the yellow leaves fall from the trees onto our garden path, so I use a rake or broom to ________ the leaves every Saturday.

Which verb fits the blank?
explanation: Bahçe yoluna dökülen kuru yaprakları süpürge veya tırmıkla süpürmek için "sweep" fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Students: Do we have to wear our school uniforms on Saturday’s picnic, sir?
Teacher: No, you ________ wear your uniforms at the picnic; you can wear comfortable sports clothes.

Which form means “it is not necessary / no obligation”?
explanation: Bir şeyin yapılmasının zorunlu olmadığını ("gerek yok") ifade etmek için "don’t have to / needn’t" kullanılır.

question_text:
Before putting the washed glasses and plates back into the kitchen cupboards, we should ________ them with a clean kitchen towel so they aren’t wet.

Which verb completes the kitchen chore?
explanation: Yıkanmış bardak ve tabakları dolaba kaldırmadan önce ıslak kalmamaları için temiz bir bezle kurulamak ("dry the dishes") gerekir.

question_text:
Family MemberKitchen ChoresLiving Room ChoresOutdoor Chores
Mother (Sevgi)Cooking dinnerDusting the shelvesWatering the flowers
Father (Murat)Loading the dishwasherVacuuming the carpetsDoing grocery shopping
Daughter (Elif, 14)Setting the tableTidying up cushionsWalking the dog
Son (Kaan, 11)Drying the dishesPicking up toysTaking out the garbage

According to the family chore chart above, which statement is CORRECT?
option_a: Only the mother does all the kitchen and living room chores in the house.
option_b: The father is responsible for cooking dinner and walking the dog.
option_c: The children don’t have any outdoor chores to do during the week.
option_d: Every member of the family shares the responsibilities in the kitchen, living room and outdoors.
explanation: Tabloya bakıldığında anne, baba, kız ve erkek çocuğun tamamının hem mutfakta hem oturma odasında hem de dış mekan işlerinde birer sorumluluk üstlendiği (işlerin adil paylaşıldığı) görülmektedir.

question_text:

According to the survey chart above, which chore do teenagers do the LEAST?
explanation: Grafikte %10 ile gençlerin evde en az yaptığı iş çamaşır ütülemektir ("Ironing clothes / laundry").

question_text:
Read the diary of 14-year-old Mert:
“Both my mom and dad work on weekdays and come home at 6:30 p.m. Because my school finishes at 3:30 p.m., I help them before they arrive. Every weekday at 5:30 p.m., I empty the clean dishes from the dishwasher, set the dinner table for four people, and feed our cat, Pamuk. When my parents come home and see the table ready, they feel so happy and proud of me!”

Why does Mert do these chores before 6:30 p.m. on weekdays?
option_a: Because his parents pay him 500 TL every day for feeding the cat
option_b: To support his working parents and share the family responsibilities
option_c: Because he doesn’t go to school on weekdays
option_d: Because he cooks a three-course meal for twenty guests every evening
explanation: Anne ve babası hafta içi çalışıp akşam 18:30'da eve geldikleri için Mert çalışan ailesine destek olmak ve aile içi sorumlulukları paylaşmak adına bu işleri yapmaktadır.

question_text:
Look at the Classroom & School Rules poster:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "1. Arrive at school on time before the morning bell (08:30)" size=9 bold text 170 46 "2. Keep your desk and classroom floor clean" size=9 text 170 68 "3. Listen to your teachers and classmates respectfully" size=9 text 170 90 "4. Return borrowed library books within 14 days" size=9 text 170 112 "5. Do not run in the school corridors during breaks" size=9 text 170 134 "6. Cooperate with your group mates in project tasks" size=9``` Which student breaks Rule 4 on the poster?
option_a: Bora borrowed a science book from the school library a month ago and still hasn’t brought it back.
option_b: Sude puts her waste paper into the recycling bin next to her desk.
option_c: Duru listens silently while her friend is giving a presentation.
option_d: Emre arrives at his classroom at 08:15 every morning.
explanation: 4. kural ödünç alınan kütüphane kitaplarının 14 gün içinde iade edilmesini emreder; bir ay önce aldığı kitabı hala getirmeyen Bora bu kuralı ihlal etmiştir.

question_text:
Read the four teenagers’ feelings about household chores:
• Aslı: “I love watering the plants on the balcony and feeding the birds; it relaxes me.”
• Berk: “I don’t mind vacuuming the floor, but I can’t stand cleaning the bathroom tiles!”
• Ceren: “I enjoy helping my dad wash the car in the garden on sunny Sundays.”
• Demir: “To me, loading and emptying the dishwasher is super easy and quick.”

Which teenager mentions a chore that he/she HATES doing?
option_a: Ceren (washing the car with her dad)
explanation: "I can’t stand cleaning the bathroom tiles!" (Banyo fayanslarını temizlemeye katlanamıyorum/nefret ediyorum) diyen kişi Berk'tir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Mother: Kids, Grandmother and Grandfather are coming for dinner tonight at 7 p.m., and the house is in a mess! We have two hours to get everything ready. I’ll cook the soup, meat dish and rice.
Daughter: Don’t worry, Mom! I’ll vacuum the living room carpets and dust the coffee table.
Son: And I’ll go to the bakery to buy fresh bread and then set the dining table!

What can we say about this family?
option_a: The mother has to do all the cleaning, shopping and cooking alone.
option_b: They decide to cancel the dinner because the house is too messy.
option_c: They cooperate harmoniously and divide the tasks to prepare for their guests.
option_d: The children refuse to help their mother and go out to play with friends.
explanation: Anne yemekleri yaparken kızının salonu süpürüp toz alması, oğlunun ise fırından ekmek alıp sofrayı kurması ailenin uyum içinde iş birliği yaptığını ("cooperate harmoniously") gösterir.

question_text:
Examine the order of doing the laundry properly:
1. Separate the dirty clothes into whites and dark/colored ones.
2. Put them into the washing machine and add detergent.
3. Take the wet clothes out and hang them on the drying rack.
4. After they dry, iron the wrinkled shirts and fold the clothes into the wardrobe.

Why is Step 1 (separating white clothes from dark/colored clothes) necessary before washing?
option_a: Because white clothes don’t need any water or detergent
option_b: So that dark or bright colors don’t bleed and dye the white clothes in hot water
option_c: To make the clothes much dirtier before hanging them on the balcony
option_d: Because washing machines cannot wash white T-shirts at all
explanation: Kirli çamaşırları beyazlar ve renkliler diye ayırmanın nedeni, koyu veya parlak renkli giysilerin sıcak suda boya verip beyaz çamaşırları boyamasını önlemektir.

question_text:
Read the teacher’s explanation about teaching children chores:
“Giving age-appropriate chores to children is not just about keeping the house clean. When a 6-year-old picks up their toys, or a 14-year-old prepares a simple salad and takes care of a pet, they learn time management, self-confidence, empathy for their parents’ hard work, and essential life skills for their future adulthood.”

What is the main idea of the text?
option_a: Doing household chores helps children develop responsibility, empathy and independent life skills.
option_b: Parents should force 6-year-old children to repair electrical cables and paint the roof.
option_c: Doing chores prevents students from learning time management and self-confidence.
option_d: Children under the age of eighteen should never touch anything in the kitchen or bedroom.
explanation: Metnin ana fikri, çocuklara yaşlarına uygun ev işleri vermenin onlara zaman yönetimi, özgüven, ebeveynlerinin emeğine empati ve gelecek için bağımsız yaşam becerileri kazandırdığıdır.

question_text:
Look at the note on the kitchen table:
“Hi Can! I had to go to the office early for a meeting. Before you go to your afternoon basketball training at 3 p.m., please:
1. Take the chicken out of the freezer so it defrosts for dinner.
2. Hang out the wet clothes inside the washing machine.
3. Water the tomato plants on the balcony.
Love, Mom.”

Which chore did Can’s mother NOT ask him to do before 3 p.m.?
option_a: Hang the washed laundry up to dry
option_b: Take the frozen chicken out of the freezer
option_c: Cook the chicken in the oven for dinner
option_d: Give water to the plants on the balcony
explanation: Annesi Can'dan tavuğu pişirmesini değil, akşam yemeğine kadar buzunun çözülmesi ("defrost") için derin dondurucudan çıkarmasını istemiştir.

question_text:
Match the places with the rules that belong to them:
1. Library
2. Museum
3. Home
4. Traffic / Road

a. You must fasten your seatbelt and stop at the red light.
b. You mustn’t touch the ancient statues or use flash photography.
c. You should help your family members with the daily chores.
d. You must whisper and return borrowed books on time.

Which matching is CORRECT?
explanation: Kütüphane → sessiz konuşmak ve kitapları zamanında iade etmek (1-d); Müze → heykellere dokunmamak ve flaş kullanmamak (2-b); Ev → aileye ev işlerinde yardım etmek (3-c); Trafik → emniyet kemeri takmak ve kırmızıda durmak (4-a).

question_text:
Read the dialogue between two flatmates (university students sharing a house):
Ozan: Tarık, we agreed last week that I would cook the meals and you would wash the dishes every evening. I have cooked dinner for four days, but all the dirty pots and plates are still piled up in the sink!
Tarık: You’re right, Ozan, I apologize. I had two big exams this week, so I neglected my duty. I’ll wash all the dishes and mop the kitchen floor right now.

Why was Ozan upset with his flatmate Tarık?
option_a: Because Tarık washed the dishes too early every evening
option_b: Because Tarık didn’t keep his promise to do his share of the kitchen chores
option_c: Because Tarık cooked a very salty meal for four days in a row
option_d: Because Ozan hates cooking dinner and wants to move to another city
explanation: Ev işlerini paylaşma anlaşmalarına göre yemekleri Ozan'ın yapması, bulaşıkları ise Tarık'ın yıkaması gerekirken Tarık dört gündür bulaşıkları lavaboda biriktirdiği için Ozan haklı olarak sitem etmiştir.

question_text: Choose the correct sentence that uses “in charge of” or “responsible for” accurately:
option_a: My sister is in charge of sweeping the leaves in the backyard.
option_b: My father is responsible of vacuuming the living room.
option_c: I am in charge for feeding the cat every morning.
option_d: We are responsible to pay the bills.
explanation: İngilizcede "in charge OF + V-ing" ve "responsible FOR + V-ing" edat eşleşmeleri kullanılır. İlk cümledeki "is in charge of sweeping" dil bilgisi açısından tek doğru kullanımdır.

question_text:
Look at the weekend chore list of the Yıldız family:
• Indoor Chores: Vacuuming carpets, mopping floors, dusting furniture, cleaning windows, ironing clothes.
• Outdoor Chores: Mowing the lawn, washing the family car, doing grocery shopping, paying bills at the post office, sweeping the garden path.

If Mr. Yıldız does two indoor chores and one outdoor chore on Saturday, which combination could be his tasks?
option_a: Mowing the lawn, washing the car, and doing grocery shopping
option_b: Dusting furniture, mopping floors, and cleaning windows
option_c: Vacuuming carpets, ironing clothes, and mowing the lawn
option_d: Washing the car, sweeping the garden path, and ironing clothes
explanation: Halı süpürmek ("Vacuuming carpets") ve ütü yapmak ("ironing clothes") 2 ev içi iş; çim biçmek ("mowing the lawn") ise 1 dış mekan işidir.

question_text:
Read the short story:
“Little Emre always left his Lego blocks scattered on his bedroom carpet. His mother warned him every evening: ‘Emre, put your blocks into their box before sleeping, or someone will step on them in the dark!’ One night, Emre didn’t tidy up his room. When he woke up at midnight to drink water, he stepped on a sharp plastic block himself! Since that night, Emre has never forgotten to tidy up his toys.”

How did Emre learn the importance of tidying up his toys?
option_a: Because his teacher gave him a low grade in his mathematics exam
option_b: By reading a scientific encyclopedia about plastic factories
option_c: Because his mother threw all his Lego blocks into the garbage bin
option_d: By experiencing the consequence of his untidiness when he stepped on a toy block himself
explanation: Gece su içmeye kalktığında kendi dağıttığı keskin Lego parçasına kendisi basarak dağınıklığının sonucunu bizzat yaşayıp ders çıkarmıştır.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Hale: Why do you look so tired, Berna?
Berna: We painted all the walls of our apartment yesterday! Today, my parents and I have to clean the paint drops on the floor, wash all the curtains, and put the furniture back in place.

Why does Berna’s family have so much heavy cleaning to do today?
option_a: Because they are moving to a new country tomorrow morning
option_b: Because they painted the apartment walls yesterday and need to clean up afterwards
option_c: Because they are opening a restaurant inside their living room
option_d: Because they haven’t cleaned their house for ten years
explanation: Dün evin tüm duvarlarını boyadıkları için bugün yerdeki boya damlalarını temizlemek, perdeleri yıkamak ve eşyaları yerleştirmek gibi ağır bir temizlik işleri vardır.

question_text:
Look at the meaning of the modal verbs:
• Must / Have to: Obligation (Zorunluluk)
• Mustn’t: Prohibition (Yasak)
• Don’t have to: Lack of necessity (Gereklilik yok)

Sentence: “Today is Sunday and schools are closed, so I ________ wake up at 6:30 a.m. However, I ________ feed my puppy before 9:00 a.m. because he gets hungry.”

Which pair fills in the blanks?
explanation: Pazar günü okul kapalı olduğu için 06:30'da uyanmak zorunda değildir ("don’t have to"); ancak yavru köpeği acıktığı için 09:00'dan önce onu beslemelidir ("must").

question_text:
Teacher: What happens in a house or classroom if nobody obeys the rules and everyone refuses to do their duties?
Student: ________.

Which answer is the most logical?
option_a: The house will clean itself automatically and everyone will be much happier
option_b: People will have cleaner rooms and stronger friendships without any effort
option_c: The dishes in the sink will wash and dry themselves in five minutes
option_d: There will be chaos, unfairness and a dirty environment where nobody feels peaceful
explanation: Hiç kimsenin kurallara uymadığı ve görevini yapmadığı bir evde veya sınıfta kargaşa ("chaos"), adaletsizlik ve kimsenin huzurlu hissetmediği kirli bir ortam oluşur.

question_text:
Read the statement:
“My grandmother is 78 years old and lives next door to us. Because carrying heavy bags and climbing on chairs is dangerous for her, I do her grocery shopping every Saturday and my dad cleans her windows once a month.”

What value does this statement highlight?
option_a: Asking a 78-year-old grandmother to clean all the windows in the building
option_b: Leaving elderly people alone with heavy bags and dangerous housework
option_c: Helping elderly family members with chores that are physically difficult for them
option_d: Refusing to do grocery shopping on weekends
explanation: Yaşlı aile büyüklerine fiziksel olarak onlar için zor ve tehlikeli olan ev işlerinde (ağır poşet taşıma, cam silme) yardım etme değerini vurgulamaktadır.

question_text:
ChoreTime NeededFrequency per WeekPerson in Charge
Cooking dinner & setting the table60 mins7 days a weekMom & Dad (together)
Loading & emptying the dishwasher15 mins7 days a weekSarp (Son, 14)
Vacuuming & mopping the whole house90 mins2 days a week (Wed & Sun)Dad
Doing the laundry & ironing90 mins2 days a week (Tue & Sat)Mom
Walking the dog & taking out trash25 mins7 days a weekZeynep (Daughter, 15)

Examine the weekly chore table of the Kaya Family carefully. How many minutes in total per week does Zeynep spend on her assigned chores?
explanation: Zeynep köpeği gezdirme ve çöp çıkarma işine günde 25 dakika ayırmaktadır ve bunu haftanın 7 günü ("7 days a week") yapmaktadır: 25 × 7 = 175 dakika (Sarp ise 15 × 7 = 105 dk).

question_text: Look at the same Kaya Family table in the previous question. Which of the following statements is CORRECT?
option_a: Both children have daily responsibilities that they must do every single day of the week.
option_b: Sarp only loads the dishwasher on Wednesdays and Sundays.
option_c: The mother does the laundry and ironing every day of the week.
option_d: The father spends more time per week on vacuuming than the mother spends on cooking.
explanation: Tabloya göre her iki çocuğun da (Sarp: bulaşık makinesi, Zeynep: köpek gezdirme ve çöp) haftanın 7 günü ("7 days a week" / her gün) yaptıkları günlük sorumlulukları vardır.

What is the most accurate conclusion we can draw from the sociological chart above?
option_a: In 2025, men do a higher percentage of housework than women do.
