question_text:
Read the conversation between four classmates about their weekend duties:
• Efe: “Because my mom works at the hospital on Saturdays, I am in charge of looking after my 5-year-old sister and preparing lunch for both of us.”
• Duru: “We have a large vegetable garden in our village house, so every Sunday I help my grandparents weed the garden and pick ripe tomatoes.”
• Kaan: “My dad and I clean the house together on Saturday mornings: he vacuums the carpets and I mop the floors and dust the shelves.”
• Mine: “I never do any chores at home because I think housework is only for adults; I just leave my dirty clothes on my bedroom floor.”

According to the statements, which student lacks a sense of family cooperation and personal responsibility?
explanation: Ev işlerinin sadece yetişkinler için olduğunu düşünüp kirli kıyafetlerini odasının zemininde bırakan Mine, aile içi iş birliği ve kişisel sorumluluk bilincinden yoksundur.

question_text:
Look at the rotation wheel of a 4-student dormitory room for the month of October:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "Week 1: Ali (Floor) | Berk (Bathroom) | Can (Trash) | Deniz (Desk & Dust)" size=9 bold text 170 46 "Every Monday, each student moves to the NEXT chore in order!" size=9 text 170 68 "Order of Rotation: Floor → Bathroom → Trash → Desk & Dust → Floor" size=9 text 170 90 "Fair rotation ensures nobody does the hardest chore all month." size=9``` In Week 1, Ali cleans the Floor. Following the rotation rule in the diagram (Floor → Bathroom → Trash → Desk & Dust), what will be Ali’s chore in Week 3?
explanation: Ali 1. hafta Zemini ("Floor") temizler; sırayla bir sonrakine geçtiğinde 2. hafta Banyo ("Bathroom"), 3. hafta ise Çöp ("Trash") görevini üstlenir.

question_text:
Read the text about Japanese School Cleaning Tradition (Soji):
“In Japan, schools do not employ janitors (cleaning workers) to clean classrooms and corridors. Instead, every day for 20 minutes after lunch, all students and even teachers put on headscarves, take cloths and brooms, and clean their own classrooms, hallways and stairs together! This tradition is called Soji. Educators say that when students clean their own school, they never throw trash on the floor or draw on desks because they respect the effort it takes to clean.”

According to the text, why don’t Japanese students litter (throw trash) or damage their school desks?
option_a: Because there are hundreds of security cameras and heavy fines in every classroom
option_b: Because Japanese students never eat lunch or use pencils inside the school building
option_c: Because professional cleaning companies clean the classrooms every twenty minutes
option_d: Because cleaning the school themselves teaches them to respect cleanliness and the effort behind it
explanation: Kendi sınıflarını ve koridorlarını bizzat kendileri temizledikleri için temizliğin arkasındaki emeğe saygı duymayı öğrenmekte ve bu yüzden yerlere çöp atmamakta veya sıraları çizmemektedirler.

question_text:
Read the four household safety rules about cleaning products:
1. Never mix bleach (çamaşır suyu) with acidic cleaners (tuz ruhu / vinegar), because the chemical reaction releases deadly toxic chlorine gas!
2. Keep all detergents and laundry capsules on high locked shelves out of reach of small children and pets.
3. Always wear rubber gloves when using strong oven or bathroom cleaners to protect your skin.
4. Unplug the electric iron and vacuum cleaner from the wall socket immediately after finishing your chore.

Why is Rule 1 critical for human health during bathroom cleaning?
option_a: Because acidic cleaners freeze the water inside the bathroom pipes
option_b: Because bleach only works when you drink a glass of cold milk before cleaning
option_c: Because mixing bleach with acidic cleaners produces poisonous gas that can seriously harm the lungs
option_d: Because mixing two cleaners makes the bathroom tiles change their color to pink
explanation: 1. kurala göre çamaşır suyu ("bleach") ile asitli temizleyicilerin karıştırılması akciğerlere ciddi zarar veren ölümcül zehirli klor gazı ("deadly toxic chlorine gas") açığa çıkarmaktadır.

question_text:
Examine the dialogue between a mother and her son, Tolga:
Mother: Tolga, thank you for washing the dishes while I was at the dentist! However, why is there white soap foam all over the kitchen floor?
Tolga: Well, Mom, we ran out of dishwasher tablets, so I poured half a bottle of liquid hand-washing dish soap into the dishwasher machine!
Mother: Oh, Tolga! Liquid hand dish soap creates giant bubbles and overflows from the machine! We must only use special machine tablets or gel in the dishwasher.

What mistake did Tolga make while doing the kitchen chore?
option_a: He put the dirty plates into the clothes washing machine in the bathroom.
option_b: He put liquid hand dish soap into the dishwasher machine instead of special machine detergent.
option_c: He forgot to turn on the dishwasher before his mother came home.
option_d: He washed the plates by hand in the sink without using any water.
explanation: Bulaşık makinesi tableti bitince makinenin içine elde yıkama sıvı bulaşık deterjanı ("liquid hand-washing dish soap") dökmüş ve aşırı köpük makineden taşarak mutfak zeminini kaplamıştır.

question_text:
Look at the table showing four teenagers’ attitudes towards four chores (☺ = Likes, 😐 = Doesn’t mind, ☹ = Can’t stand):
TeenagerMopping the floorIroning shirtsCooking pastaWalking the dog
Aylin😐☹☺☺
Burak☺😐☹☺
Cansu☹☺☺😐
Deniz☹☹😐☺

Their mother wants to assign ONE different chore to each teenager so that NOBODY gets a chore they can’t stand (☹), and preferably gets one they like (☺). Which distribution makes everyone happy?
option_a: Burak: Mopping — Cansu: Ironing — Aylin: Cooking — Deniz: Walking the dog
option_b: Cansu: Mopping — Deniz: Ironing — Aylin: Cooking — Burak: Walking the dog
option_c: Deniz: Mopping — Aylin: Ironing — Burak: Walking the dog — Cansu: Cooking
option_d: Aylin: Ironing — Burak: Cooking — Cansu: Mopping — Deniz: Walking the dog
explanation: Tabloda Paspas yapmayı (Mopping) tek seven Burak (☺), Ütüyü (Ironing) tek seven Cansu (☺), Yemek pişirmeyi (Cooking) seven Aylin (☺) ve Köpek gezdirmeyi (Walking the dog) seven Deniz (☺) eşleştirildiğinde dördü de sevdiği işi almış olur.

question_text:
Find the odd sentence out in the paragraph:
(I) Sharing household chores fairly makes family life much more peaceful and enjoyable for everyone. (II) When parents and children cooperate, housework finishes quickly and the family has more free time to spend together. (III) Paragliding from Mount Babadağ in Fethiye requires a helmet, a harness and an experienced tandem pilot. (IV) In addition, children who take part in daily chores grow up to be self-reliant and tidy individuals.
explanation: Paragraf aile içinde ev işlerini paylaşmanın huzur ve çocuk gelişimine katkısını anlatırken, III. cümle Fethiye Babadağ'da yamaç paraşütünden bahsederek anlam bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the two notices in an apartment building elevator:
• Notice 1 (Management): “Please put your tied garbage bags outside your flat door ONLY between 19:30 and 20:00. Leaving garbage in the corridor during the day causes bad smells.”
• Notice 2 (Quiet Hours): “According to apartment rules, running noisy appliances such as vacuum cleaners, washing machines or drills is forbidden after 21:30 at night and before 09:00 in the morning.”

Which neighbor obeys BOTH apartment rules?
option_a: Mr. Kaya drills the wall to hang a picture at 07:30 on Sunday morning.
option_b: Ms. Demir leaves her open trash bag in the corridor all afternoon and vacuums at midnight.
option_c: Mr. Erdem vacuums his carpets at 18:00 and puts his garbage bag outside at 19:45.
option_d: Mrs. Yılmaz puts her garbage bag outside at 10:00 a.m. and runs her vacuum cleaner at 23:00.
explanation: Saat 18:00'de halı süpüren (09:00–21:30 arası serbest) ve çöp poşetini saat 19:45'te kapı önüne koyan (19:30–20:00 arası) Bay Erdem her iki apartman kuralına da tam uymuştur.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Father: Kids, our garden looks very dry, and the grass has grown up to our knees! Also, the front porch is covered with dry leaves.
Arda: I’ll mow the lawn with the lawnmower, Dad!
Beren: And I’ll sweep the dry leaves on the porch with the broom and water the flowerbeds with the hose!
Father: Great teamwork! After we finish the garden, I’ll make cold homemade lemonade for all of us.

Which tool will NOT be used by Arda or Beren while doing their garden chores?
explanation: Arda çim biçme makinesi ("lawnmower"), Beren ise süpürge ("broom") ve bahçe hortumu ("hose") kullanacaktır; ütü masası ("ironing board") bahçe işlerinde kullanılmaz.

question_text:
Examine the sentences and find the one where “have to / has to” is used for an EXTERNAL obligation (a rule set by school, law or authority), while “must” is used for an INTERNAL personal feeling of duty:
• Sentence 1: “All drivers have to stop when the traffic light turns red; it is the law.”
• Sentence 2: “My grandma has been sick for two days; I must visit her and cook some hot soup for her tonight.”

Why does Sentence 2 represent an internal sense of responsibility?
option_a: Because visiting grandparents is forbidden by school rules on weekdays.
option_b: Because the speaker hates cooking soup and refuses to visit their grandmother.
option_c: Because the traffic police will give the speaker a ticket if they don’t cook soup.
option_d: Because no law forces the speaker; their own love and conscience tell them to help their sick grandmother.
explanation: 2. cümlede kişiyi zorlayan bir yasa veya resmi kural yoktur; hasta büyükannesini ziyaret edip ona sıcak çorba pişirme isteği kişinin kendi sevgisinden ve vicdani sorumluluk duygusundan ("internal personal feeling of duty") kaynaklanmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the text about “Robot Vacuum Cleaners”:
“In the past, vacuuming and mopping the floors of a three-bedroom house took at least an hour of physical effort. Today, smart robot vacuums use laser sensors (LiDAR) to map the rooms, vacuum the dust, and even wipe hard floors automatically while the family is at work or school! However, before letting the robot vacuum start, family members still have to pick up small toys, socks, and phone charger cables from the floor so they don’t get tangled in the robot’s brushes.”

According to the text, what chore do humans STILL have to do before the robot vacuum starts cleaning?
option_a: Tidy up small objects, socks and cables from the floor so the robot doesn’t get stuck
option_b: Push the robot vacuum with their hands across every room for an hour
option_c: Draw a paper map of the rooms with a pencil and compass
option_d: Wash the robot vacuum inside the dishwasher after every room
explanation: Metnin son cümlesinde robot süpürge çalışmaya başlamadan önce fırçalarına dolanmaması için aile üyelerinin yerdeki küçük oyuncakları, çorapları ve şarj kablolarını toplaması ("pick up small toys, socks, and phone charger cables from the floor") gerektiği belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
Look at the 4 steps of washing dishes by hand when saving water and energy:
1. Scrape leftover food from the plates into the organic trash bin before putting them into the sink.
2. Wash the least dirty items (glasses and cups) first, and the greasiest pans last.
3. Do not keep the hot water tap running at full speed continuously while soaping the plates; turn it on only when rinsing.
4. Place the rinsed plates on the drying rack and dry them with a clean towel.

Why does Step 2 tell us to wash glasses and cups BEFORE greasy frying pans?
option_a: Because drinking glasses are much heavier and larger than frying pans
option_b: Because frying pans don’t need any dish soap or water to become clean
option_c: So that the oil from the greasy pans doesn’t stick to the sponge and make the clean drinking glasses oily
option_d: To break the drinking glasses under the heavy metal pans in the sink
explanation: Önce en az kirli olan bardakların, en son ise yağlı tavaların yıkanmasının nedeni; tavadaki yağın süngere bulaşıp su bardaklarını yağlandırmasını önlemektir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Sister: Tuna, it’s your turn to walk Leo (our dog) this evening, remember?
Tuna: I know, Selin, but I have a high fever (38.8°C) and Mom told me to stay in bed and rest. If you walk Leo for me tonight, I promise I’ll walk him both on Saturday and Sunday for you!
Sister: Oh, get well soon, Tuna! Don’t worry, you don’t even have to do my weekend turns; I’ll gladly walk Leo tonight while you rest.

What does this conversation show about Selin?
option_a: She is a selfish sister who forces her sick brother to walk the dog in the cold rain.
option_b: She is an understanding and caring sister who takes over her sick brother’s chore without expecting anything back.
option_c: She doesn’t know how to walk the dog in the park.
option_d: She refuses to walk the dog unless Tuna pays her 100 TL.
explanation: Selin yüksek ateşi olan kardeşine geçmiş olsun diyerek hafta sonu nöbetlerini bile istemeden onun görevini memnuniyetle üstlenmiş, anlayışlı ve şefkatli bir abla/kardeş olduğunu göstermiştir.

question_text:
Examine the weekly allowance (pocket money) and chore rule in the Smith house:
• Basic daily duties (No money paid — part of family life): Making your own bed, tidying your room, setting the table, clearing your own plate.
• Extra weekend jobs (Optional — earns extra pocket money for charity or savings): Washing the family car (50 TL), cleaning out the garage (75 TL), mowing the big backyard lawn (60 TL).

Why don’t Mr. and Mrs. Smith pay money to their children for making their own beds or setting the dinner table?
option_a: Because washing the family car is easier than making a bed
option_b: Because the children never make their beds or eat dinner at home
option_c: Because Mr. and Mrs. Smith forbid their children from tidying their rooms
option_d: Because basic daily chores are natural responsibilities of being a family member, not paid jobs
explanation: Kendi yatağını toplamak ve sofrayı kurmak ücretli bir iş değil, bir ailenin bireyi olmanın doğal günlük sorumluluğu ("basic daily duties — part of family life") olduğu için bunlara para ödenmemektedir.

question_text:
Read the four notes left by four different people at home:
• Note A: “I took the clean plates out of the machine and put them in the cupboards.”
• Note B: “I wiped all the windows with glass cleaner and newspaper until they shone.”
• Note C: “I folded the dry T-shirts and put them neatly into the drawers.”
• Note D: “I bought two kilos of apples, cheese, olives and bread from the market.”

Which note was written by the person who emptied the dishwasher?
explanation: Temiz tabakları makineden çıkarıp dolaplara yerleştirmek bulaşık makinesini boşaltmaktır ("emptied the dishwasher" → birinci not).

question_text:
Read the short text about Ergonomics while doing housework:
“Many people suffer from back pain after doing household chores because they bend their waist sharply while lifting heavy laundry baskets or vacuuming. Physical therapists advise two simple rules: first, adjust the telescopic metal pipe of the vacuum cleaner to your height so you can stand upright while vacuuming; second, always bend your knees—not your waist—when lifting a heavy bucket or basket from the floor.”

According to physical therapists, how should you lift a heavy laundry basket from the floor without hurting your back?
option_a: By keeping your knees locked straight and bending your waist sharply
option_b: By shortening the vacuum cleaner pipe to thirty centimeters
option_c: By bending your knees and keeping your back straight while lifting
option_d: By lifting the heavy basket with only one finger while running
explanation: Fizyoterapistler yerden ağır bir kova veya çamaşır sepeti kaldırırken beli bükerek değil, dizleri bükerek ("bend your knees—not your waist") kaldırılmasını tavsiye etmektedir.

question_text:
Look at the Saturday timeline of Mrs. Aydın:
• 09:00 - 09:45: Prepare breakfast and load the dishwasher.
• 10:00 - 11:00: Put the dirty clothes into the washing machine (the machine washes for 60 mins).
• 10:05 - 11:00: While the machine is washing, dust the living room and mop the hallway.
• 11:05 - 11:20: Hang out the washed laundry on the balcony.

Why was Mrs. Aydın able to finish FOUR different chores in just 2 hours and 20 minutes?
option_a: Because she hung out the dirty clothes on the balcony before washing them
option_b: Because she managed her time well by dusting and mopping while the washing machine was running
option_c: Because she didn’t wash any clothes or prepare breakfast on Saturday morning
option_d: Because she sat in front of the washing machine and watched it turn for sixty minutes
explanation: Çamaşır makinesinin 60 dakikalık yıkama süresi boyunca boş beklemek yerine o sürede (10:05 - 11:00) salonun tozunu alıp koridoru paspaslayarak zamanını çok verimli yönetmiştir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Teacher: In our school’s “Zero Waste (Sıfır Atık)” project, every classroom has three different colored bins: Blue for paper/cardboard, Yellow for plastic/metal, and Gray for organic/other waste. Who is the Eco-Monitor of Class 8-C this week?
Elif: I am, sir! It’s my duty to check that nobody throws plastic bottles into the blue paper bin and to remind my friends to turn off the classroom lights when we go out for P.E. class.

What are Elif’s two responsibilities as the Eco-Monitor of Class 8-C?
option_a: Making sure recyclable waste is sorted into the correct bins and saving electricity when the classroom is empty
option_b: Keeping the classroom lights and smartboard turned on all night long
option_c: Burning all paper and plastic bottles in the school garden every afternoon
option_d: Throwing plastic water bottles into the blue paper bin during breaks
explanation: Çevre nöbetçisi ("Eco-Monitor") olan Elif'in iki görevi; geri dönüştürülebilir atıkların doğru kutulara ayrıştırılmasını sağlamak ve beden eğitimi dersine çıkarken sınıf ışıklarını kapatarak elektrik tasarrufu yapmaktır.

question_text:
Compare the rules of two different summer camps:
• Camp Pine (Traditional): Campers must make their own beds at 07:30, wash their own metal plates after meals, and sweep their cabin floors every morning.
• Camp Luxury (Hotel-style): Cleaners make the beds and clean the rooms, and waiters serve meals. Campers don’t have to do any cleaning or tidying.

According to a survey of parents, 85% of parents preferred sending their teenagers to Camp Pine. Why?
option_a: Because Camp Pine has waiters and cleaners who do everything for the children
option_b: Because parents don’t want their children to know how to make a bed or wash a plate
option_c: Because teenagers at Camp Luxury have to sweep the cabin floors every morning
option_d: Because they want their children to learn self-reliance, discipline and how to take care of their own living space
explanation: Velilerin %85'inin Camp Pine'ı tercih etmesinin nedeni, çocuklarının kendi yataklarını toplayıp tabaklarını yıkayarak öz yeterlilik ("self-reliance"), disiplin ve kendi yaşam alanlarının sorumluluğunu almayı öğrenmelerini istemeleridir.

question_text:
Read the riddle about a household appliance:
• I stand in the kitchen, usually next to the sink.
• You load me with dirty plates, glasses, forks and spoons after meals.
• Using me saves much more water than washing plates one by one under a running tap!

What appliance am I?
explanation: Mutfakta lavabonun yanında duran, yemekten sonra kirli tabak-bardak-çatal-kaşıkların doldurulduğu ve elde yıkamaya göre çok daha fazla su tasarrufu sağlayan cihaz bulaşık makinesidir ("A dishwasher").

question_text:
Choose the sentence that best summarizes the proverb:
“Many hands make light work.” (Birlikten kuvvet doğar / El el ile değirmen yel ile.)
option_a: You should turn on all the lights in the house while doing housework with your hands.
option_b: When everyone in the family cooperates and does a small share, even heavy housework finishes quickly and easily.
option_c: It is better if only one person does all the chores while others watch television.
option_d: Housework becomes much heavier and harder when family members help each other.
explanation: "Many hands make light work" atasözü, kalabalık bir işi herkes iş birliği yaparak ucundan tuttuğunda en ağır işlerin bile hafifleyip hızla ve kolayca biteceğini anlatır.

question_text:
Read the teacher’s final note on citizenship and rules:
“Doing our chores at home prepares us for obeying rules in school, and obeying rules in school prepares us for being responsible citizens in society. A person who respects their mother’s clean floor at home will also respect public parks, libraries, and traffic rules in the city.”

According to the teacher, how are household chores connected to being a good citizen?
option_a: Learning responsibility and respect for shared spaces starts at home and extends to school and public life.
option_b: School rules and traffic laws have nothing to do with responsibility or respect.
option_c: Good citizens only keep their own bedrooms clean and throw garbage in public parks.
option_d: People who do chores at home are not allowed to visit public libraries or parks.
explanation: Öğretmene göre ortak yaşam alanlarına saygı ve sorumluluk bilinci evde başlayıp okula ve toplumsal hayata (parklara, kütüphanelere, trafik kurallarına) uzanan bir zincirdir.

question_text:
Teacher: Who ________ the law of gravity when he saw an apple fall from a tree?
Student: Sir Isaac Newton!

Since gravity already existed in nature before Newton found it, which verb must we use?
explanation: Doğada zaten var olan bir kanunu veya maddeyi bulmak "discover" (keşfetmek), daha önce var olmayan bir cihaz tasarlayıp yapmak ise "invent" (icat etmek) fiiliyle ifade edilir.

question_text:
In the school science laboratory, students must always wear safety goggles and lab coats while conducting chemical ________.

Which plural noun completes the sentence?
explanation: Fen laboratuvarında güvenlik gözlüğü ve önlük giyilerek yapılan kimyasal çalışmalara deney ("experiments") denir.

question_text:
Alex: What are the biologists doing in the lab right now?
Nina: They are examining blood cells and bacteria under a high-powered ________.

Which scientific instrument completes Nina’s answer?
explanation: Kan hücrelerini ve bakterileri büyütüp incelemek için kullanılan laboratuvar cihazı mikroskoptur ("microscope"). (Gezegen ve yıldızlar için ise "telescope" kullanılır).

question_text:
Prof. Dr. Aziz Sancar won the 2015 Nobel Prize in ________ for his groundbreaking research on how cells repair damaged DNA.

Which scientific field completes the sentence?
explanation: Prof. Dr. Aziz Sancar hücrelerin hasarlı DNA'yı nasıl onardığını haritalandıran çalışmasıyla 2015 Nobel Kimya ("Chemistry") Ödülü'nü kazanmıştır.

question_text:
Look at the medical terms:
• Diagnose: find out what illness a patient has
• Cure / Treat: make a sick person healthy again
• ________: a substance given to people (usually by injection) to protect them from getting a dangerous disease like rabies or measles

Which medical word matches the third definition?
explanation: İnsanları tehlikeli bulaşıcı hastalıklardan korumak için (genellikle enjeksiyonla) uygulanan koruyucu maddeye aşı ("Vaccine") denir.

question_text:
Sam: Look at that humanoid robot at the technology fair! What is the scientist doing right now?
Dad: He ________ the robot’s artificial intelligence software on his laptop.

Choose the correct Present Continuous verb form for an action happening right now.
explanation: "Right now" (şu anda) gerçekleşmekte olan eylemler Present Continuous Tense ("am/is/are + V-ing" → "is testing") ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
In 1928, Alexander Fleming noticed a green mold in his petri dish that killed bacteria. This led to the discovery of ________, the world’s first antibiotic medicine.

Which famous medicine completes the sentence?
explanation: Alexander Fleming'in 1928'de bakterileri öldüren küften keşfettiği dünyanın ilk antibiyotiği penisilindir ("penicillin").

question_text:
ToPour and measure liquids accurately during a chemistry experiment, scientists use narrow glass containers called ________.

Which lab item fills in the blank?
explanation: Kimya deneylerinde sıvıları koymak ve ısıtmak/ölçmek için kullanılan dar cam kaplara deney tüpü ("test tubes / beakers") denir.

question_text:
Reporter: How do ________ limbs help people who lost an arm or a leg in an accident?
Doctor: Modern robotic prosthetics connect to the person’s nerves and allow them to walk or hold objects again!

Which word means “man-made / prosthetic, not natural”?
explanation: Uzuv kaybı yaşayan insanlara takılan biyonik veya yapay kol ve bacaklar için "bionic / artificial limbs" ifadesi kullanılır.

question_text:
Guglielmo Marconi invented the ________, which allowed people to transmit sound and news wirelessly through electromagnetic waves.

Which invention belongs to Marconi?
explanation: Elektromanyetik dalgalarla sesi kablosuz ileten radyoyu ("radio") Guglielmo Marconi icat etmiştir.

question_text:
Mert: Who invented the electric ________ bulb that illuminated houses at night?
Kaan: Thomas Alva Edison!

Which word completes the invention?
explanation: Thomas Edison geceleri evleri aydınlatan elektrik ampulünü ("electric light bulb") geliştirmiştir.

question_text:
Look at the fields of science and what they study:
• Astronomy: Planets, stars, galaxies and space
• Biology: Living organisms, plants, animals and cells
• ________: Fossils, rocks and the structure of the Earth’s crust

Which branch of science matches the third description?
explanation: Kayaçları, fosilleri ve yer kabuğunun yapısını inceleyen bilim dalı yer bilimidir ("Geology").

question_text:
With a 3D ________, doctors and engineers can design a digital model on a computer and produce three-dimensional plastic or metal objects layer by layer.

Which high-tech machine completes the sentence?
explanation: Bilgisayardaki dijital tasarımı katman katman basarak üç boyutlu nesneye dönüştüren cihaz 3 boyutlu yazıcıdır ("3D printer").

question_text:
Ceren: Why is Marie Curie so famous in the history of science?
Teacher: Because she discovered radium and polonium, and she was the first person ever to win two ________ Prizes in two different sciences (Physics and Chemistry)!

Which prestigious international award completes the dialogue?
explanation: Marie Curie hem Fizik hem de Kimya alanında iki kez Nobel ("Nobel Prize") kazanan tarihteki ilk bilim insanıdır.

question_text:
Astronomers use giant space ________ like Hubble and James Webb to observe distant galaxies and black holes millions of light-years away.

Which optical instrument completes the sentence?
explanation: Uzaktaki galaksileri ve kara delikleri gözlemlemek için kullanılan Hubble ve James Webb birer uzay teleskobudur ("space telescopes").

question_text:
Doctor: Before giving you the medicine, the nurse will ________ you against tetanus with a small needle in your arm.

Which verb completes the medical action?
explanation: Kola küçük bir iğne ile tetanoza karşı aşı yapmak "vaccinate" fiiliyle ifade edilir.

question_text:
“Be careful in the chemistry lab! If you heat that closed glass bottle too much, the high gas pressure inside can make it ________!”

Which verb means “burst violently with a loud bang”?
explanation: Aşırı ısıtılan kapalı cam şişenin yüksek gaz basıncıyla patlaması "explode" fiiliyle anlatılır.

question_text:
Look at the word family:
• Science (Noun: the field)
• Scientific (Adjective: related to science)
• ________ (Noun: the person who works in science)

Which word refers to the person?
explanation: Bilim alanında çalışan kişiye (bilim insanına) "Scientist" denir.

question_text:
In the 15th century, Ali Kuşçu wrote important books on ________ and mathematics in İstanbul, calculating the movements of the Moon and stars accurately.

Which branch of science completes the historical fact?
explanation: Ay'ın ve yıldızların hareketlerini hesaplayan bilim dalı gök bilimidir ("astronomy").

question_text:
Student: What is the difference between a genius and an ordinary student?
Teacher: Thomas Edison once said: “Genius is 1% inspiration and 99% perspiration (hard work and ________)!”

Which quality completes Edison’s famous quote?
explanation: Edison dehanın %1 ilham, %99 ter (yani sıkı çalışma, sabır ve çaba / "patience / effort") olduğunu vurgulamıştır.

question_text:
Thanks to the invention of the ________ by the Wright Brothers in 1903, people can travel across continents and oceans in the sky in just a few hours today.

Which vehicle did the Wright Brothers invent?
explanation: Wright Kardeşler 1903'te ilk motorlu uçağı ("powered airplane") icat ederek gökyüzünde kıtalar arası yolculuğun önünü açmışlardır.

question_text:
ScientistLifetimeFieldMajor Achievement
İbn-i Sina (Avicenna)980 – 1037Medicine & PhilosophyWrote "The Canon of Medicine", used in European universities for 500 years
Marie Curie1867 – 1934Physics & ChemistryDiscovered radium & polonium; pioneered radioactivity research
Nikola Tesla1856 – 1943Electrical EngineeringDeveloped Alternating Current (AC) electricity and wireless power transmission
Canan Dağdeviren1985 – PresentMaterials Science & PhysicsInvented wearable piezoelectric heart pacemaker and ultrasound breast scanner

According to the table above, which scientist developed modern wearable medical devices and is still alive and working today?
explanation: Tabloda 1985 doğumlu olup günümüzde hala yaşayan ("1985 – Present") ve giyilebilir kalp pili ile ultrason tarayıcısı icat eden Türk bilim insanı Dr. Canan Dağdeviren'dir.

question_text: Look at the same table of four scientists above. Which of the following statements is CORRECT?
option_a: İbn-i Sina’s medical encyclopedia was taught as a standard textbook in Europe for five centuries.
option_b: Marie Curie invented the alternating current (AC) electrical system.
option_c: Nikola Tesla discovered radium and polonium in the 10th century.
option_d: All four scientists in the table lived in the 20th century.
explanation: Tabloya göre İbn-i Sina'nın "El-Kanun fi't-Tıb" ("The Canon of Medicine") adlı eseri Avrupa üniversitelerinde 500 yıl (beş asır) boyunca ders kitabı olarak okutulmuştur.

question_text:

According to the survey results above, which statement is TRUE?
option_a: More students chose electricity than vaccines and antibiotics.
option_b: Three quarters (75%) of the students chose either digital technology or medical breakthroughs.
option_c: The Internet and computers are considered the least important development.
option_d: Transportation inventions like airplanes and cars received the highest percentage of votes.
explanation: Dijital teknoloji (İnternet ve Bilgisayarlar: %40) ile tıbbi buluşları (Aşılar ve Antibiyotikler: %35) seçenlerin toplamı %40 + %35 = %75'tir (dörtte üçü / "three quarters").

question_text:
Read the conversation at the Science Museum:
Student: Sir, why is there a model of a compass, a printing press, gunpowder and paper in the “Ancient China” hall?
Guide: Because those are called the “Four Great Inventions” of ancient China! Long before Europeans used them, Chinese inventors developed paper, woodblock printing, gunpowder, and the magnetic compass for navigation.

What did the student learn from the museum guide?
option_a: That ancient Chinese scientists only studied medicine and biology
option_b: That the museum guide invented the printing press last week
option_c: That paper, printing, gunpowder and the magnetic compass were first invented in ancient China
option_d: That the magnetic compass was invented in Europe in the 20th century
explanation: Rehber kağıt, matbaa, barut ve pusulanın Avrupa'da kullanılmasından çok önce antik Çin'de icat edildiğini ("Four Great Inventions of ancient China") açıklamıştır.

question_text:
Examine the steps of the Scientific Method diagram:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "Step 1: Make an Observation & Ask a Question" size=9 bold text 170 46 "Example: Why do cut apples turn brown in the air?" size=9 text 170 68 "Step 2: Form a Hypothesis (An educated guess)" size=9 text 170 90 "Example: Oxygen in the air reacts with enzymes in the apple; lemon juice can stop it." size=9 text 170 112 "Step 3: Conduct a Controlled Experiment" size=9 text 170 134 "Put lemon juice on Apple Slice A, leave Apple Slice B plain, and wait 1 hour." size=9``` According to the diagram, what is a “Hypothesis” (Step 2)?
option_a: Buying apples and lemons from the grocery store on Sunday
option_b: The final report written after the experiment is completely finished
option_c: Cleaning the glass test tubes with soap after leaving the laboratory
option_d: A testable scientific explanation or prediction made before conducting the experiment
explanation: Şemaya göre Hipotez (2. adım), deneyi yapmadan önce gözleme dayanarak ortaya atılan ve deneyle sınanabilir bilimsel tahmin veya açıklamadır ("An educated guess").

question_text:
Read the text about Louis Pasteur:
“In the 19th century, the French chemist and microbiologist Louis Pasteur proved that microscopic germs (bacteria) cause food like milk to spoil and cause dangerous diseases in humans. He invented a process of heating milk to kill harmful bacteria, which is still called pasteurization today. Even more importantly, he developed the first vaccines for rabies (kuduz) and anthrax, saving millions of lives.”

Why is the heating process used to make milk safe called “pasteurization”?
option_a: Because it was named after Louis Pasteur, who discovered how to kill harmful bacteria in liquids by heating
option_b: Because the process was invented after smartphones became popular
option_c: Because Louis Pasteur loved eating Italian pasta while drinking cold milk
option_d: Because pasteurization adds harmful bacteria into fresh milk
explanation: Sütü ısıtarak içindeki zararlı bakterileri öldürme yöntemini Louis Pasteur bulduğu için bu işleme onun soyadından hareketle pastörizasyon ("pasteurization") adı verilmiştir.

question_text:
Look at what four students are doing in the school science lab right now:
• Aras is looking at plant leaf cells through a microscope.
• Beren is pouring blue liquid from a beaker into three glass test tubes.
• Cem is taking notes of the temperature changes on his tablet.
• Duru is programming a small solar-powered robot car at the corner table.

Who is recording the experimental data on a digital device?
explanation: Deneydeki sıcaklık değişimlerini (deney verilerini / "experimental data") tabletine (dijital cihaza) not ederek kaydeden öğrenci Cem'dir.

question_text:
Categorize the four items below into DISCOVERIES vs. INVENTIONS:
1. DNA’s double-helix structure
2. The 3D printer
3. The planet Neptune
4. The smartphone

Which option puts them in the correct categories?
explanation: Doğada ve evrende zaten var olan DNA'nın çift sarmal yapısı (1) ve Neptün gezegeni (3) birer keşiftir ("Discoveries"); insan eliyle sıfırdan tasarlanan 3B yazıcı (2) ve akıllı telefon (4) ise birer icattır ("Inventions").

question_text:
Read the biography note about Prof. Dr. Oktay Sinanoğlu (1935–2015):
“Known as the ‘Turkish Einstein’, Oktay Sinanoğlu became a full professor at Yale University at the age of just 28—the youngest professor in Yale’s modern history! He developed fundamental theories in quantum chemistry and molecular biology, solving a 50-year-old mathematical problem in chemistry.”

Why did Oktay Sinanoğlu make history at Yale University when he was 28 years old?
option_a: He opened a Turkish restaurant next to Yale University.
option_b: He became the youngest full professor in the modern history of the university.
option_c: He graduated from primary school at the age of twenty-eight.
option_d: He invented the first steam engine in the university garden.
explanation: Henüz 28 yaşındayken Yale Üniversitesi'nin modern tarihindeki en genç profesör ("youngest full professor") unvanını alarak tarihe geçmiştir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Ece: Have you heard about the new “Smart Cane” (Akıllı Baston) developed by young Turkish engineers for visually impaired (blind) people?
Mert: Yes! It has ultrasonic sensors at the front. When there is an obstacle like a tree branch or a parked car ahead, the cane vibrates in the user’s hand and gives voice directions via Bluetooth.

How does the Smart Cane warn a visually impaired person about an obstacle at head or chest level?
option_a: It detects the obstacle with ultrasonic sensors and vibrates in the user’s hand.
option_b: It flies over the parked car like a small helicopter.
option_c: It cuts down the tree branch with a laser beam.
option_d: It flashes bright colored lights on a television screen.
explanation: Akıllı baston önündeki ultrasonik sensörlerle ağaç dalı veya park etmiş araç gibi engelleri algılayıp kullanıcının elinde titreşerek ("vibrates in the user’s hand") ve sesli yönlendirme yaparak uyarı vermektedir.

question_text:
Match the inventions with the problems they solved:
1. Braille Alphabet (by Louis Braille)
2. Wheelchair
3. Hearing Aid (Cochlear Implant)
4. Air Conditioner (by Willis Carrier)

a. Helped people with walking disabilities move around independently.
b. Enabled blind people to read and write using raised dots with their fingertips.
c. Cooled down hot indoor rooms and controlled humidity.
d. Helped hearing-impaired people perceive sounds and speech.

Which matching is CORRECT?
explanation: Braille alfabesi görme engellilerin kabartma noktalarla okumasını sağladı (1-b); Tekerlekli sandalye yürüme engellilere bağımsız hareket sağladı (2-a); İşitme cihazı sesleri duymayı sağladı (3-d); Klima sıcak odaları serinletti (4-c).

question_text:
Read the text about Bionic Eyes and 3D Bioprinting:
“Medical science is advancing rapidly. Today, surgeons are experimenting with bionic eyes that send camera signals directly to the optic nerve, and scientists are working on 3D bioprinters that use living patient cells instead of plastic ink to print artificial skin and cartilage tissue in the laboratory!”

What do 3D bioprinters use instead of plastic ink to create artificial human tissues?
option_b: Living cells taken from the patient
explanation: Metinde 3 boyutlu biyoyazıcıların ("3D bioprinters") plastik mürekkep yerine hastanın canlı hücrelerini ("living patient cells") kullanarak yapay deri ve kıkırdak dokusu ürettiği belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
Look at the Laboratory Safety Rules:
• Never taste or smell any chemical substance directly.
• Tie back long hair before lighting a Bunsen burner (gas flame).
• Wash your hands thoroughly with soap before leaving the lab.

Why must students with long hair tie their hair back in the science lab?
option_a: Because only students with short hair are allowed to study science
option_b: Because long hair makes the microscope lenses bigger
option_c: To prevent their hair from catching fire over the Bunsen burner or dipping into chemicals
option_d: To help the chemical liquids boil faster in the test tubes
explanation: Uzun saçların arkadan toplanmasının nedeni, deney yaparken saçların Bunsen beki alevinde tutuşmasını veya kimyasal sıvıların içine değmesini önlemektir.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Sarp: Did you watch the live broadcast from the International Space Station (ISS) yesterday?
Tuna: Yes! Turkish astronaut Alper Gezeravcı conducted 13 different scientific experiments in microgravity (zero gravity), including testing how special microalgae grow in space and how new metal alloys form without gravity!

Where did Alper Gezeravcı carry out these 13 scientific experiments?
option_a: In the zero-gravity environment of the International Space Station
option_b: On the snowy summit of Mount Ağrı in winter
option_c: In a high school chemistry laboratory in Ankara
option_d: Inside an underwater submarine at the bottom of the Black Sea
explanation: Alper Gezeravcı bu 13 bilimsel deneyi Uluslararası Uzay İstasyonu'nun ("International Space Station - ISS") mikroçekim (sıfır yer çekimi) ortamında gerçekleştirmiştir.

question_text:
Examine the timeline of medical imaging inventions:
• 1895: Wilhelm Röntgen discovers X-rays, allowing doctors to see broken bones inside the body without surgery.
• 1950s: Medical Ultrasound is developed, using safe sound waves to see soft organs and unborn babies.
• 1970s: MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) and CT scans are invented to create detailed 3D images of the brain and internal organs.

Why is Ultrasound preferred over X-rays when doctors check the health of an unborn baby?
option_a: Because ultrasound requires a dangerous surgical operation
option_b: Because ultrasound uses safe sound waves instead of radiation
option_c: Because X-rays can only take photos of trees and rocks
option_d: Because ultrasound was invented fifty years before X-rays
explanation: Ultrason radyasyon (X-ışını) yerine güvenli ses dalgaları ("safe sound waves") kullandığı için anne karnındaki bebeklerin kontrolünde tercih edilir.

question_text:
Choose the sentence that uses Past Continuous and Simple Past together correctly:
“While Archimedes ________ a bath in the tub, he suddenly ________ how to measure the volume of irregular objects by water displacement.”
explanation: Geçmişte devam etmekte olan uzun eylem ("While" ile küvette yıkanırken) Past Continuous ("was taking"), o sırada aniden gerçekleşen kısa eylem (suyun kaldırma kuvvetini/hacim ölçümünü keşfetmesi) ise Simple Past ("discovered") ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
Project CodeStudent InventorScientific FieldProblem SolvedEnergy Source Used
Eco-DropElif (8-A)Environmental EngineeringFilters greywater from kitchen sinks to water garden plantsGravity (No electricity)
Sun-WingKaan (8-B)Aerospace & RoboticsFires early-warning drone that detects forest smokeSolar panels on wings
Bio-GloveMerve (8-C)Biomedical & AITranslates sign language hand movements into spoken voiceRechargeable battery
Seismo-GuardTuna (8-D)Geology & ElectronicsShuts off home natural gas valve automatically during an earthquakeBackup battery

At the TÜBİTAK 4006 Science Fair, the jury wants to give the “Medical & Accessibility Innovation Award” to the project that helps people with speech or hearing disabilities communicate with everyone. According to the table, who wins this award?
explanation: İşaret dili el hareketlerini sesli konuşmaya çevirerek ("Translates sign language hand movements into spoken voice") konuşma veya işitme engelli bireylerin herkesle iletişim kurmasını sağlayan proje Merve'nin "Bio-Glove" projesidir.

question_text: Look at the same TÜBİTAK 4006 Science Fair table in the previous question. Which of the following is CORRECT?
option_a: Tuna’s project uses solar panels to filter dirty water in the kitchen.
option_b: Elif’s project saves water without using any electrical power, while Kaan’s drone runs on solar energy.
option_c: All four projects require being plugged into a wall socket with a cable.
option_d: Kaan’s drone translates sign language into spoken voice during forest fires.
explanation: Tabloya göre Elif'in "Eco-Drop" projesi elektrik kullanmadan yer çekimiyle ("Gravity - No electricity") gri suyu filtreleyerek su tasarrufu sağlamakta, Kaan'ın dronu ise kanatlarındaki güneş panelleriyle ("Solar panels on wings") çalışmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the text about Prof. Dr. Aziz Sancar’s Nobel Prize discovery:
“Every day, our DNA is damaged by ultraviolet (UV) rays from the Sun and harmful chemicals. If our cells didn’t repair this damage, we would quickly get sick. Prof. Dr. Aziz Sancar mapped the molecular mechanism called Nucleotide Excision Repair (NER). Like a microscopic pair of scissors and needle, special enzymes find the damaged piece of DNA, cut it out, replace it with the correct genetic code, and seal it! After receiving his Nobel medal in 2015, Prof. Sancar donated his original golden Nobel medal and certificate to Anıtkabir, saying: ‘This prize belongs to Atatürk and the Republic’s education system that raised me.’”

Which of the following is FALSE according to the text above?
option_a: Prof. Sancar expressed his gratitude to Atatürk and the Republic’s education system.
option_b: Human cells have special repair enzymes that cut out and fix damaged DNA parts.
option_c: Prof. Dr. Aziz Sancar kept his original Nobel medal in his private bank vault in the USA.
option_d: Ultraviolet rays from the Sun can cause damage to human DNA molecules.
explanation: Prof. Dr. Aziz Sancar orijinal Nobel madalyasını ve sertifikasını ABD'de bir banka kasasında saklamamış; "Beni yetiştiren Atatürk'e ve Cumhuriyet'in eğitim sistemine aittir" diyerek Anıtkabir'e armağan etmiştir.

question_text:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Fields Where 500 Young Science Students Want to Work in the Future" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "38%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Renewable Ene." size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 52.1 P d1 119.9 52.1 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 46.1 "32%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Artificial In." size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 103.7 P d2 188.4 103.7 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 97.7 "18%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Space Explora." size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 125.8 P d3 256.9 125.8 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 119.8 "12%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Genetic Engin." size=10 ```
According to the graph above, which statement is CORRECT?
option_a: Seven out of every ten students (70%) want to work in either green energy technology or AI & robotics.
option_b: Space exploration is the most popular future career field among the science students.
option_c: More students want to become genetic engineers than AI and robotics specialists.
option_d: Less than 30% of the students are interested in renewable energy and climate technology.
explanation: Yenilenebilir Enerji (%38) ile Yapay Zeka ve Robotik (%32) alanlarının toplamı %38 + %32 = %70'tir; yani her 10 öğrenciden 7'si bu iki alandan birinde çalışmak istemektedir.

question_text:
Read the controlled experiment report of Class 8-A:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "Research Question: Does classical music or sunlight affect bean plant growth?" size=9 bold text 170 46 "Setup: Three identical bean seeds planted in the same soil and watered equally (50 ml/day)" size=9 text 170 68 "Pot 1: Kept by a sunny window + No music → Grew 18 cm in 2 weeks (Healthy green)" size=9 text 170 90 "Pot 2: Kept by a sunny window + Classical music (2 hrs/day) → Grew 19 cm in 2 weeks (Healthy green)" size=9 text 170 112 "Pot 3: Kept inside a dark closed cupboard + Classical music (2 hrs/day) → Grew 4 cm (Yellow & weak)" size=9 text 170 134 "Conclusion: Without sunlight, photosynthesis cannot occur even if water and music are provided!" size=9``` Why did the students give the exact same amount of water (50 ml/day) and the same type of soil to all three pots?
option_a: To kill the plants in Pot 1 and Pot 2 before the two weeks ended
option_b: Because they ran out of water in the laboratory on the first day
option_c: Because bean plants don’t need any soil or water to grow in a dark cupboard
option_d: To keep other variables constant so they could test only the effects of sunlight and music fairly
explanation: Kontrollü bir deneyde yalnızca incelenen değişkenlerin (güneş ışığı ve müzik) etkisini adil biçimde ölçebilmek için diğer tüm değişkenlerin (toprak türü, günlük 50 ml su miktarı, tohum cinsi) sabit tutulması gerekir.

question_text:
Read the historical story of how Velcro (cırt cırt bant) was invented:
“In 1941, a Swiss electrical engineer named George de Mestral went for a walk in the Alps with his dog. When he returned home, he noticed that his wool trousers and his dog’s fur were covered with tiny prickly plant seeds called burrs (pıtrak). Curious, he examined one seed under his microscope! He saw hundreds of tiny microscopic hooks on the seed that grabbed onto the tiny loops of fabric and fur. Inspired by nature, he invented Velcro (hook-and-loop fastener), which is used today on shoes, jackets, blood pressure cuffs, and even by NASA astronauts in zero gravity!”

What is this scientific approach—studying designs in nature (like plant seeds or bird wings) to invent new human technologies—called?
option_b: Biomimicry (taking inspiration from nature to solve engineering problems)
option_d: Archaeology (digging up ancient coins from the soil)
explanation: Doğadaki canlıların ve bitkilerin yapısını (örneğin pıtrak tohumunun mikroskobik kancalarını) inceleyerek mühendislik ve teknoloji icatlarına uyarlama yaklaşımına "Biomimicry" (Biyomimetik / Doğadan ilham alma) denir.

question_text:
Read the four scientists’ quotes and match them with their mindsets:
• Thomas Edison: “I have not failed 1,000 times while trying to make the light bulb; I have successfully found 1,000 ways that won’t work!”
• Marie Curie: “Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood. Now is the time to understand more, so that we may fear less.”
• Albert Einstein: “I have no special talent. I am only passionately curious.”
• Louis Pasteur: “In the fields of observation, chance favors only the prepared mind.”

Which scientist emphasizes that mistakes and unsuccessful attempts are valuable steps toward final success (perseverance)?
explanation: 1.000 kez başarısız olmadığını, işe yaramayan 1.000 yolu başarıyla bulduğunu söyleyerek hataların ve başarısız denemelerin nihai başarıya giden değerli adımlar olduğunu (azmi / "perseverance") vurgulayan Thomas Edison'dur.

question_text:
Find the odd sentence out in the paragraph:
(I) Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming modern medicine in extraordinary ways. (II) Deep-learning algorithms can scan thousands of X-ray and MRI images in seconds to detect early signs of cancer that the human eye might miss. (III) Before you hang out the wet clothes on the balcony, you must separate the white shirts from the dark jeans. (IV) As a result, doctors can diagnose diseases much earlier and start life-saving treatments immediately.
explanation: Paragraf yapay zekanın tıbbi görüntüleme ve erken teşhisteki devrim niteliğindeki rolünü anlatırken, III. cümle çamaşır yıkama ve asmadan bahsederek anlam bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır.

question_text:
Examine the table of 4 milestones in the History of Computing:
YearScientist / PioneerContribution / Milestone
1843Ada LovelaceWrote the world’s first computer algorithm for Charles Babbage’s mechanical machine
1936 / 1950Alan TuringLaid the theoretical foundations of modern computers and the “Turing Test” for AI
1946ENIAC TeamBuilt ENIAC, the first general-purpose electronic computer (weighed 27 tons and filled a huge room!)
1989Tim Berners-LeeInvented the World Wide Web (WWW) at CERN to share scientific documents easily

According to the table above, which of the following statements is CORRECT?
option_a: Tim Berners-Lee built a 27-ton mechanical computer in 1843.
option_b: Alan Turing invented the World Wide Web in 1989 after ENIAC was built.
option_c: The first electronic computer, ENIAC, was small enough to fit inside a shirt pocket.
option_d: The world’s first computer algorithm was written in the 19th century, more than a hundred years before the first electronic computer (ENIAC) was built.
explanation: Tabloya göre dünyanın ilk bilgisayar algoritması Ada Lovelace tarafından 1843'te (19. yüzyılda), yani 1946'da üretilen ilk elektronik bilgisayar ENIAC'tan 103 yıl önce yazılmıştır.

question_text:
Read the conversation between a journalist and an archaeologist at Göbeklitepe:
Journalist: How do you know for sure that these T-shaped limestone pillars in Göbeklitepe were built around 9600 BC (nearly 12,000 years ago)? There are no written dates on the stones!
Archaeologist: We use a scientific method from nuclear physics called Radiocarbon Dating (Carbon-14 test). By measuring how much Carbon-14 isotope remains in the organic charcoal and animal bones found in the soil layers around the pillars, laboratory scientists can calculate the exact age of the site!

How does the science of physics/chemistry help archaeologists at Göbeklitepe?
option_a: Archaeologists use telescopes to look at the stars and guess the age of the stones.
option_b: Radiocarbon (Carbon-14) testing measures organic remains in the soil layers to determine the age of ancient sites.
option_c: Physicists read the modern calendar dates carved in English on the T-shaped stones.
option_d: Carbon-14 testing melts the limestone pillars into liquid water.
explanation: Nükleer fizik ve kimyadaki Radyokarbon (Karbon-14) yaş tayini yöntemi, sütunların çevresindeki toprak katmanlarında bulunan organik kömür ve kemik kalıntılarındaki Karbon-14 izotop miktarını ölçerek alanın yaşını bilimsel olarak hesaplamaktadır.

question_text:
Read the text about Hulusi Behçet (1889–1948):
“Turkish dermatologist and scientist Prof. Dr. Hulusi Behçet observed several patients who suffered from three seemingly unrelated symptoms at the same time: mouth ulcers, skin lesions, and eye inflammation. For years, other doctors thought these were separate infections. After careful clinical research, Dr. Behçet proved in 1937 that all three symptoms belonged to a single systemic autoimmune blood-vessel disease. The international medical world named this condition Behçet’s Disease in his honor, making him the first Turkish scientist to have a disease named after him in medical literature.”

What made Prof. Dr. Hulusi Behçet’s clinical observation so important?
option_a: He was an astronomer who named three new planets in the solar system.
option_b: He proved that bacteria never cause any infections in humans.
option_c: He discovered that three symptoms previously thought to be separate were actually caused by one single disease.
option_d: He invented the first microscope and telescope in 1937.
explanation: Daha önce doktorların birbirinden bağımsız enfeksiyonlar sandığı üç belirtinin aslında tek bir sistemik damar hastalığından kaynaklandığını kanıtlamış ve tıp literatürüne kendi adıyla ("Behçet’s Disease") geçen ilk Türk bilim insanı olmuştur.

question_text:
Examine the two sides of a scientific debate about Autonomous (Self-Driving) Cars:
• Proponents (Supporters): “90% of traffic accidents are caused by human errors such as tired driving, speeding, or looking at phones. AI-controlled cars have 360-degree radar and cameras, never get tired, and obey speed limits strictly.”
• Critics (Doubters): “Sensor cameras can be blinded by heavy snow or thick fog, and hackers could potentially break into the car’s computer system remotely.”

According to the debate above, why do supporters believe self-driving cars will reduce traffic accidents?
option_a: Because AI computers do not get tired, distracted by phones, or break speed limits like human drivers
option_b: Because heavy snow and thick fog make sensor cameras see ten times better
option_c: Because hackers help self-driving cars drive faster on icy roads
option_d: Because self-driving cars never use any radar, sensors or cameras on the road
explanation: Destekleyenlere göre trafik kazalarının %90'ı yorgunluk, hız ve telefona bakma gibi insan hatalarından kaynaklanmaktadır; yapay zekalı araçlar ise asla yorulmaz, dikkati dağılmaz ve hız sınırlarına tam uyar.

question_text:
Look at the schedule of Dr. Selin’s workday at the Biotechnology Research Institute:
• 09:00 - 11:00: Examine cell cultures under the electron microscope.
• 11:30 - 12:30: Attend an online video conference with geneticists in Tokyo.
• 13:30 - 16:00: Test the new mRNA vaccine formula on tissue samples in Lab 4.
• 16:30 - 18:00: Write a scientific paper about today’s findings for an international journal.

If the clock shows 14:45 right now, what is Dr. Selin doing at the moment?
option_a: She is talking to geneticists in Tokyo on a video call.
option_b: She is looking at cell cultures through the electron microscope.
option_c: She is writing an article for an international science journal.
option_d: She is testing the new mRNA vaccine formula on tissue samples in Lab 4.
explanation: Saat 14:45, "13:30 - 16:00" aralığına denk geldiği için Dr. Selin şu anda Lab 4'te doku örnekleri üzerinde yeni mRNA aşısı formülünü test etmektedir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Teacher: Kids, why did ancient civilizations like Mesopotamia, Egypt, and China develop astronomy and geometry so early?
Cenk: Was it just because they liked looking at pretty stars at night, sir?
Teacher: Not just for beauty, Cenk! They needed an accurate calendar from the stars to know when rivers would flood and when to plant crops, and they needed geometry to measure and divide farmland boundaries again after every river flood!

According to the teacher, what drove ancient civilizations to develop astronomy and geometry?
option_a: To take digital photos of galaxies with space telescopes
option_b: Practical daily needs such as predicting agricultural seasons and measuring farmland after floods
option_c: Their desire to build spaceships and fly to the planet Mars
option_d: Because they didn’t have any rivers or farms in Mesopotamia and Egypt
explanation: Öğretmene göre antik uygarlıklar astronomi ve geometriyi sadece yıldızları izlemek için değil; nehirlerin ne zaman taşacağını ve ekinlerin ne zaman ekileceğini bilmek (takvim) ve sel sonrası tarla sınırlarını yeniden ölçmek gibi pratik yaşamsal ihtiyaçlar nedeniyle geliştirmiştir.

question_text:
Read the short text about Edward Jenner and the first vaccine (1796):
“In the 18th century, Smallpox (çiçek hastalığı) was a deadly disease that killed millions of people. An English doctor, Edward Jenner, noticed a fascinating fact in villages: milkmaids (women who milked cows) sometimes caught a mild, harmless cow disease called Cowpox on their hands, and those women never caught the deadly Smallpox! In 1796, Jenner used fluid from a cowpox blister to inoculate a young boy, and proved that the boy’s immune system became completely protected against smallpox. In fact, the word vaccine comes from the Latin word vacca, which means cow!”

Why does the English word “vaccine” come from the Latin word for “cow” (vacca)?
option_a: Because doctors only give vaccines to cows and farm animals, not to humans
option_b: Because Edward Jenner was a farmer who hated studying medicine
option_c: Because the world’s first vaccine was developed by Edward Jenner using harmless cowpox to protect against deadly smallpox
option_d: Because drinking warm cow milk cures all viral diseases in five minutes
explanation: Edward Jenner sağım yapan köylü kadınların ineklerden bulaşan zararsız sığır çiçeği ("cowpox") geçirdikten sonra ölümcül çiçek hastalığına hiç yakalanmadığını gözlemleyip ilk aşıyı buradan geliştirdiği için Latince inek ("vacca") kelimesinden "vaccine" terimi doğmuştur.

question_text:
Look at the four safety symbols found on chemical bottles in a laboratory:
• Symbol 1 (Flame icon): Flammable — Keep away from fire, sparks and heat!
• Symbol 2 (Skull and Crossbones): Toxic / Poisonous — Can cause death if swallowed or inhaled!
• Symbol 3 (Liquid dripping on hand and metal): Corrosive — Burns human skin and melts metal/wood!
• Symbol 4 (Tree and dead fish icon): Environmental Hazard — Do not pour down the sink; harms aquatic life!

While cleaning up after an experiment, a student has a bottle with Symbol 1 and Symbol 4 on its label. What two rules must the student follow?
option_a: Keep the bottle far away from the Bunsen burner flame, and dispose of it in a special chemical waste container instead of pouring it down the sink.
option_b: Drink the liquid without gloves and throw the bottle into the paper recycling bin.
option_c: Wash the bottle with boiling oil over a lit candle.
option_d: Heat the bottle over a strong flame and pour the liquid directly into the river.
explanation: Symbol 1 (Yanıcı - "Flammable") ateş ve ısıdan uzak tutulmasını, Symbol 4 (Çevre İçin Tehlikeli) ise lavaboya dökülmeyip özel kimyasal atık kutusunda bertaraf edilmesini gerektirir.

question_text:
Read the biography note about Jābir ibn Hayyān (Cabir bin Hayyan, 721–815):
“Often called the father of early chemistry, Jābir ibn Hayyān emphasized that science cannot be done merely by reading old books; it must be based on systematic laboratory experiments! He invented or improved many laboratory apparatuses still used today (such as the alembic for distillation), discovered strong acids like hydrochloric and nitric acid, and studied crystallization and evaporation.”

What was Jābir ibn Hayyān’s golden principle for doing chemistry?
option_a: Reading ancient stories is enough to discover new chemical acids.
option_b: Scientists should never enter a laboratory or touch glass equipment.
option_c: Distillation and evaporation cannot be done in a laboratory.
option_d: Chemistry must rely on practical, systematic laboratory experimentation rather than just reading theory.
explanation: Cabir bin Hayyan bilimin sadece eski kitapları okuyarak yapılamayacağını, mutlaka sistematik laboratuvar deneylerine ("systematic laboratory experiments") dayanması gerektiğini vurgulamıştır.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Reporter: Dr. Yılmaz, your team designed a biodegradable plastic made from waste potato peels and corn starch instead of petroleum (oil). Why is this invention so important?
Dr. Yılmaz: Normal petroleum plastic takes 450 years to decompose in nature and pollutes the oceans with microplastics. Our bio-plastic bag is just as strong for carrying groceries, but when buried in moist soil, natural bacteria break it down completely into harmless compost in just 60 days!

What is the biggest advantage of Dr. Yılmaz’s potato-and-corn bio-plastic compared to normal petroleum plastic?
option_a: It stays under the ocean for 1,000 years without ever breaking down.
option_b: People can eat the plastic shopping bags for breakfast after shopping.
option_c: It decomposes naturally in soil in 60 days without leaving harmful pollution, whereas normal plastic takes 450 years.
option_d: It is made from crude oil and coal instead of renewable plant waste.
explanation: Normal petrol türevi plastik doğada 450 yılda çözünüp okyanusları kirletirken, atık patates kabuğu ve mısır nişastasından üretilen biyo-plastik nemli toprakta sadece 60 günde tamamen zararsız gübreye dönüşmektedir.

question_text:
Examine the two sentences and their meanings:
• Sentence 1: “The Wright Brothers invented the first powered airplane in 1903.” (Active Voice — Focuses on the inventors)
• Sentence 2: “The first powered airplane was invented by the Wright Brothers in 1903.” (Passive Voice — Focuses on the invention)

Following the same pattern, which sentence has the EXACT SAME meaning as:
“Wilhelm Röntgen discovered X-rays in 1895.”?
option_a: X-rays are discovering Wilhelm Röntgen every year.
option_b: X-rays were discovered by Wilhelm Röntgen in 1895.
option_c: Wilhelm Röntgen will discover X-rays in the future.
option_d: Wilhelm Röntgen was discovered by X-rays in 1895.
explanation: "Wilhelm Röntgen 1895'te X-ışınlarını keşfetti" etken cümlesinin edilgen ("Passive Voice") karşılığı "X-rays were discovered by Wilhelm Röntgen in 1895" (X-ışınları 1895'te Wilhelm Röntgen tarafından keşfedildi) cümlesidir.

question_text:
Look at the table comparing 3 generations of prosthetic legs:
GenerationPeriodMaterial & TechnologyUser Experience
1st Gen16th – 19th CenturyHeavy wood and ironStiff, heavy, difficult to walk smoothly
2nd GenLate 20th CenturyCarbon-fiber blades (like running springs)Very light and flexible; allows paralympic athletes to sprint fast
3rd Gen21st Century (Today)Bionic smart joints with microchips & nerve sensorsAdjusts automatically to stairs and slopes as the brain thinks of stepping

According to the table, what makes 3rd Generation bionic legs superior to 1st and 2nd generation prosthetics?
option_a: Microchips and nerve sensors allow the bionic joint to respond to brain signals and adapt to stairs automatically.
option_b: They are made of heavy solid wood and iron so they never bend on stairs.
option_c: Users cannot climb stairs or walk on slopes with 3rd generation legs.
option_d: They were invented in the 16th century before electricity was discovered.
explanation: 3. nesil biyonik bacakları üstün kılan özellik, mikroçipler ve sinir sensörleri sayesinde beyin adım atmayı düşündüğünde merdivenlere ve eğimlere otomatik uyum sağlamasıdır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Alp: Why does a huge steel cargo ship weighing 50,000 tons float on the sea, while a small 10-gram steel nail sinks immediately to the bottom?
Physics Teacher: Because the nail is solid steel with very tiny volume, so its average density is much greater than water. The cargo ship, however, has a huge hollow hull filled with air! Its large volume displaces a massive amount of water, making its overall average density less than water.

According to the physics teacher, why does a 50,000-ton steel ship float instead of sinking like a steel nail?
option_a: Because there is no gravity over the ocean water
option_b: Because cargo ships are actually made of white paper and cotton instead of steel
option_c: Because a 10-gram steel nail is heavier in mass than a 50,000-ton cargo ship
option_d: Because its large air-filled hollow volume lowers its average density below the density of water
explanation: Geminin içi hava dolu devasa boşluklu gövdesi ("hollow hull filled with air") sayesinde toplam hacmi çok büyümekte, böylece ortalama yoğunluğu suyun yoğunluğunun altına düştüğü için yüzmektedir.

question_text:
Read the text about the “ printing press” in the Ottoman Empire (İbrahim Müteferrika):
“In 1727, İbrahim Müteferrika established the first Ottoman Turkish printing press in İstanbul. The very first book he printed in 1729 was not a storybook, but a two-volume Arabic-Turkish dictionary called Vankulu Lügati! Later, he printed books on history, geography, astronomy, and magnetism (including maps and compass guides), helping scientific knowledge spread among scholars.”

What type of book was the very first work printed by İbrahim Müteferrika in 1729?
option_a: A science-fiction novel about space travel
option_c: A comic book for primary school children
option_d: A cookbook of Italian pasta recipes
explanation: İbrahim Müteferrika'nın 1729'da matbaasında bastığı ilk eser iki ciltlik Arapça-Türkçe sözlük olan Vankulu Lügati'dir ("a two-volume Arabic-Turkish dictionary").

question_text:
Read the riddle about a scientific instrument:
• Doctors wear me around their necks in hospitals and clinics.
• I was invented in 1816 by a French physician named René Laennec.
• When a doctor places my round chest-piece on your back or chest, they can listen clearly to your heartbeat and lungs breathing.

What medical instrument am I?
explanation: Doktorların boyunlarına astığı, göğse veya sırta konulduğunda kalp atışlarını ve akciğer solunum seslerini dinlemeye yarayan tıbbi alet stetoskop ("A stethoscope") adını taşır.

question_text:
Examine the four students’ statements about the ethics of science:
• Hakan: “Scientific inventions should always be used to protect peace, human health, and nature, never to destroy life.”
• İpek: “Scientists should share vaccine formulas globally during pandemics so poor countries are protected too.”
• Kaan: “When testing new medicines, researchers must follow strict ethical rules and never hide side effects.”
• Leman: “Scientists can change their experimental data to get famous quickly, even if the results are fake.”

Whose statement violates (breaks) scientific ethics and honesty?
explanation: Hızlıca ünlü olmak için sonuçlar sahte olsa bile bilim insanlarının deney verilerini değiştirebileceğini söyleyen Leman, bilimsel etik ve dürüstlük ilkelerini açıkça ihlal etmektedir.

question_text:
Read Mustafa Kemal Atatürk’s famous quote inscribed on the wall of faculties and schools across Türkiye:
“Our true mentor (guide) in life is science.” (Hayatta en hakiki mürşit ilimdir, fendir.)

What does this principle advise young generations to do when solving problems in life and society?
option_a: To study only history and close all physics and chemistry laboratories
option_b: To ignore modern universities, laboratories and scientific discoveries
option_c: To believe unverified rumors instead of doing scientific experiments
option_d: To rely on rational thinking, scientific evidence, research and technology rather than superstitions or ignorance
explanation: Atatürk'ün "Hayatta en hakiki mürşit ilimdir, fendir" ilkesi, genç nesillere hurafeler veya cehalet yerine akılcı düşünceye, bilimsel kanıtlara, araştırmaya ve teknolojiye dayanmayı öğütlemektedir.

question_text:
After three days of non-stop heavy rain in the Black Sea region, the wet soil and rocks on the steep mountain slope slid down and blocked the highway.

Which natural disaster is described above?
explanation: Şiddetli yağışların ardından dik yamaçtaki ıslak toprak ve kayaların aşağı kayarak yolu kapatması toprak kayması / heyelandır ("Landslide").

question_text:
Reporter: Why are the water levels in the city dams so low this summer?
Expert: Because it hasn’t rained for five months, and the extreme heat caused a severe ________.

Which natural disaster means “a long period without rain, causing water shortage”?
explanation: Uzun süre yağmur yağmaması ve aşırı sıcaklar nedeniyle baraj sularının çekilip su kıtlığı yaşanması kuraklıktır ("drought").

question_text:
When a huge mass of snow, ice and rocks falls rapidly down the side of a high mountain, it is called an ________.

Which winter disaster fills in the blank?
explanation: Yüksek bir dağın yamacından büyük bir kar ve buz kütlesinin hızla aşağı kopup düşmesine çığ ("avalanche") denir.

question_text:
Teacher: During an earthquake inside the classroom, what is the golden safety rule you must do immediately next to a sturdy desk?
Students: ________!

Which three emergency actions complete the earthquake rule?
option_a: Light a candle and call everyone
option_b: Drop, Cover, and Hold on (Çök - Kapan - Tutun)
option_c: Run, Jump, and Use the elevator
option_d: Open the windows and jump out
explanation: Deprem anında sağlam bir sıranın yanında yapılması gereken altın kural "Drop, Cover, and Hold on" (Çök - Kapan - Tutun) hareketidir.

question_text:
If a powerful earthquake occurs under the ocean floor, it pushes the sea water and creates giant destructive waves called a ________ that hit the coastal cities.

Which natural disaster completes the sentence?
explanation: Okyanus tabanındaki güçlü depremlerin oluşturduğu ve kıyı şehirlerini vuran dev yıkıcı deniz dalgalarına "tsunami" denir.

question_text:
Look at the “3 Rs” of protecting the environment:
• Reduce: use less water, energy and plastic
• Reuse: use glass jars and cloth bags again instead of throwing them away
• ________: process waste paper, glass, metal and plastic to make new products

Which “R” word completes the list?
explanation: Atık kağıt, cam, metal ve plastiği işleyerek yeni ürünlere dönüştürmek geri dönüşümdür ("Recycle").

question_text:
Burning fossil fuels like coal, oil and petrol in factories and cars releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, which traps heat and causes ________ warming.

Which word completes the environmental problem?
explanation: Fosil yakıtların atmosfere saldığı sera gazlarının ısıyı hapsederek Dünya'nın ortalama sıcaklığını artırmasına küresel ısınma ("global warming") denir.

question_text:
Sarp: What is the ________ of the earthquake that shook the island this morning?
News Anchor: The observatory announced that it measured 5.4 on the Richter scale.

Which term means “the size/strength of an earthquake on the Richter scale”?
explanation: Depremin Richter ölçeğine göre büyüklüğünü ifade eden bilimsel terim "magnitude" (büyüklük) kelimesidir.

question_text:
To stop soil erosion and landslides, and to produce more oxygen for the planet, we should never cut down forests; instead, we should ________ millions of new trees.

Which verb completes the sentence?
explanation: Toprak erozyonunu ve heyelanı önlemek, oksijen üretmek için milyonlarca yeni fidan dikmeliyiz ("plant trees").

question_text:
Because the polar ice caps in the Arctic are melting due to global warming, polar bears are losing their natural habitat and are in danger of ________ (disappearing forever).

Which noun completes the sentence?
explanation: Bir canlı türünün doğal yaşam alanını kaybederek neslinin tükenme tehlikesiyle karşı karşıya kalması "danger of extinction" ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
Mother: Don’t buy disposable plastic bags at the supermarket! Always carry a ________ cloth shopping bag with you.

Which eco-friendly adjective fits the blank?
explanation: Tek kullanımlık plastik poşetler yerine tekrar kullanılabilir ve çevre dostu ("reusable / eco-friendly") bez çanta taşınmalıdır.

question_text:
When a volcano ________, it throws out hot melted rock (lava), ash and thick smoke from its crater into the sky.

Which verb describes an active volcano?
explanation: Bir yanardağın lav, kül ve duman püskürterek patlaması "erupt" (isim hali: "volcanic eruption") fiiliyle anlatılır.

question_text:
To reduce air pollution in big cities, people should use ________ transportation (like buses, trams and subways) or ride bicycles instead of driving private cars alone.

Which word completes the solution?
explanation: Özel araçlar yerine otobüs, tramvay ve metro gibi toplu taşıma ("public transportation") araçları kullanılmalıdır.

question_text:
Firefighter: Never throw glass bottles or cigarette butts in dry pine forests in summer! Even a broken glass piece can focus sunlight like a lens and start a huge ________.

Which disaster completes the warning?
explanation: Yazın kuru çam ormanlarına atılan cam şişelerin güneş ışığını mercek gibi odaklayarak çıkardığı felaket orman yangınıdır ("forest fire / wildfire").

question_text:
Solar energy, wind energy and hydroelectric power are called ________ energy sources because they never run out and do not pollute the atmosphere.

Which adjective completes the definition?
explanation: Güneş, rüzgar ve su enerjisi tükenmeyen ve atmosferi kirletmeyen yenilenebilir/temiz ("renewable / clean") enerji kaynaklarıdır.

question_text:
After the river overflowed its banks during the storm, muddy water covered the streets and the first floors of the houses.

Which natural disaster happened in the town?
explanation: Fırtınada nehrin yatağından taşarak sokakları ve evlerin giriş katlarını su altında bırakması sel ("flood") felaketidir.

question_text:
Rescue Leader: During the earthquake, three buildings collapsed, but our search and rescue dogs helped us find and save twelve ________ alive under the rubble!

Which word means “people who stay alive after a disaster”?
explanation: Bir afetten veya enkaz altından sağ kurtulan kişilere "survivors" (hayatta kalanlar/kurtulanlar) denir.

question_text:
Every family living in an earthquake zone should prepare an emergency ________ containing water, dry food, a first-aid kit, a whistle, a flashlight and extra batteries.

Which term completes the earthquake preparation tip?
explanation: Deprem bölgesinde yaşayan her ailenin içinde su, kuru gıda, ilk yardım çantası, düdük ve el feneri bulunan bir deprem/acil durum çantası ("emergency disaster kit / survival bag") hazırlaması gerekir.

question_text:
A ________ is a violent, funnel-shaped spinning windstorm that reaches down from dark clouds to the ground and pulls up roofs, trees and cars.

Which wind disaster is described?
explanation: Bulutlardan yere uzanan huni şeklinde ("funnel-shaped") hızla dönen yıkıcı hortum fırtınasına "tornado" denir.

question_text:
Scientist: If we don’t stop deforestation (cutting down rainforests), we ________ serious oxygen and climate problems in the near future.

Choose the correct future form for a prediction.
explanation: "If + Present Simple, will + V1" (Type 1 Conditional) yapısında gelecekteki olası sonuçları ve tahminleri anlatırken "will have / will face" kullanılır.

question_text:
Natural DisasterMain CauseRegion AffectedPrecaution (Before It Happens)
EarthquakeSudden movement of tectonic platesFault line zonesBuild quake-resistant buildings & fix furniture to walls
LandslideHeavy rain on steep, treeless slopesBlack Sea mountain roadsPlant deep-rooted trees & build retaining stone walls
FloodOverflowing rivers after extreme rainLow river valleys & concrete streetsKeep riverbeds clear & do not build houses in stream beds
DroughtLack of rainfall & global warmingInland agricultural plainsUse drip irrigation in farming & save tap water at home

According to the table above, how can farmers and citizens help reduce the impact of a Drought?
option_a: By cutting down deep-rooted trees on steep mountain slopes
option_b: By building houses directly inside dry river and stream beds
option_c: By leaving water taps running while brushing teeth and washing dishes
option_d: By using drip irrigation in agriculture and avoiding water waste in houses
explanation: Tablonun son satırına göre kuraklığın ("Drought") etkisini azaltmak için tarımda damla sulama ("drip irrigation") kullanılmalı ve evlerde musluk suyu tasarruflu kullanılmalıdır.

question_text: Look at the same table of four natural disasters above. Why should people never build apartment buildings inside dry stream beds (dere yatakları)?
option_a: Because drip irrigation does not work near river valleys.
option_b: Because when extreme rain falls, rivers overflow their beds and cause deadly floods.
option_c: Because tectonic plates only move inside dry stream beds.
option_d: Because planting trees on mountain slopes causes volcanic eruptions.
explanation: Tablodaki "Flood" (Sel) satırına göre aşırı yağışlarda nehirler ve dereler yataklarından taştığı için dere yataklarına ev inşa edilmemelidir.

question_text:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Causes of Forest Fires in the Mediterranean Region (%)" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 66.8 170.0 P b0 142.2 170.0 P c0 142.2 30.0 P d0 66.8 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 104.5 24.0 "88%" size=10 text 104.5 184.0 "Human neglige." size=10 P a1 203.8 170.0 P b1 279.2 170.0 P c1 279.2 150.9 P d1 203.8 150.9 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 241.5 144.9 "12%" size=10 text 241.5 184.0 "Natural cause." size=10 ```
What is the most important message of the chart above?
option_a: Human actions have no effect on starting forest fires in summer.
option_b: Almost all forest fires are caused by natural lightning strikes during storms.
option_c: Nearly nine out of every ten forest fires can be prevented if people act responsibly and carefully in forests.
option_d: Lighting campfires and throwing glass bottles in dry forests is completely safe.
explanation: Orman yangınlarının %88'i (her 10 yangından yaklaşık 9'u) insan ihmalinden ("Human negligence" - kamp ateşi, cam kırığı, sigara izmariti) kaynaklandığına göre, insanlar ormanda dikkatli ve sorumlu davranırsa bu yangınların büyük çoğunluğu önlenebilir.

question_text:
