Examine the Emergency Earthquake Bag (Deprem Çantası) checklist:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "1. Water & Non-perishable Food" size=9 bold text 170 46 "Bottled water (at least for 72 hours), canned food, energy bars" size=9 text 170 68 "2. First-Aid & Hygiene" size=9 text 170 90 "Bandages, antiseptic, personal prescription medicines, wet wipes" size=9 text 170 112 "3. Signalling & Lighting Tools" size=9 text 170 134 "Loud whistle, flashlight, portable battery radio, powerbank, spare batteries" size=9``` Why is a tiny plastic or metal whistle (Group 3) one of the most life-saving items in an earthquake bag if someone is trapped under rubble?
option_a: Because blowing a whistle makes a loud sound that rescue teams can hear easily without exhausting the trapped person’s voice and oxygen
option_b: Because a whistle stops the tectonic plates from moving under the earth
option_c: Because a whistle provides light in the dark for seventy-two hours without batteries
option_d: Because trapped people can cook canned food using a plastic whistle
explanation: Enkaz altında kalan bir kişi saatlerce bağırırsa sesi kısılır, yorulur ve oksijenini hızla tüketir; oysa düdük çok az nefesle kurtarma ekiplerinin kolayca duyabileceği yüksek ve keskin bir ses çıkarır.

question_text:
Read the news report:
“Good evening! Mount Etna on the east coast of Sicily, Italy, erupted again early this morning. Thick black volcanic ash rose 6 kilometers into the sky and covered the runway of Catania Airport. Although the hot lava stream is flowing slowly toward an uninhabited valley and no towns are in danger, aviation authorities canceled all flights at Catania Airport for 48 hours.”

According to the news report, why were all flights canceled at Catania Airport?
option_a: Because hot lava burned down all the passenger airplanes at the airport
option_b: Because there was a severe snowstorm and avalanche in Sicily
option_c: Because a giant tsunami wave hit the airport terminal building
option_d: Because thick volcanic ash covered the airport runway and made flying unsafe
explanation: Haberde volkanik kül bulutunun 6 km yükselip Katanya Havaalanı'nın pistini kapladığı ("covered the runway of Catania Airport") için uçuşların 48 saatliğine iptal edildiği belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue between two students:
Melis: Our geography teacher said that the “Greenhouse Effect” (Sera Etkisi) is actually a natural process that keeps Earth warm enough for life, around +15°C on average. Without any greenhouse gases, Earth would be a frozen ball of ice at -18°C!
Kaan: Really? Then why do scientists warn us that greenhouse gases are dangerous today?
Melis: Because over the last 150 years, factories and cars have pumped too much extra carbon dioxide into the air, making the greenhouse blanket too thick and overheating the planet!

What did Melis explain to Kaan about the Greenhouse Effect?
option_a: All greenhouse gases must be removed so that the Earth freezes to -18°C.
option_b: A natural amount of greenhouse gas is necessary for life, but excess human-made emissions cause dangerous global warming.
option_c: Factories and cars help cool down the planet by releasing carbon dioxide.
option_d: The Greenhouse Effect only happens inside small glass vegetable gardens.
explanation: Melis doğal miktardaki sera gazının Dünya'yı yaşanabilir sıcaklıkta (+15°C) tutmak için gerekli olduğunu, ancak son 150 yılda fabrika ve araçların saldığı aşırı karbondioksitin bu örtüyü kalınlaştırarak gezegeni aşırı ısıttığını (küresel ısınmaya yol açtığını) açıklamıştır.

question_text:
Look at the four safety instructions for different natural disasters:
• Instruction A: “If you see the sea water suddenly pull back (recede) far from the beach after a tremor, run immediately to high ground or hills!”
• Instruction B: “Stay away from tall bookshelves, windows and elevators; drop next to a solid table and protect your head with your arms.”
• Instruction C: “Never try to walk or drive your car through fast-moving water covering a road; just 30 cm of flowing water can sweep a car away!”
• Instruction D: “If you are caught outside during a thunderstorm with lightning, stay away from tall isolated trees and metal poles.”

Which instruction is a life-saving warning against a TSUNAMI?
explanation: Bir sarsıntıdan sonra deniz suyunun kıyıdan aniden geri çekilmesi ("sea water suddenly pull back") tsunaminin en belirgin habercisidir ve hemen yüksek tepelere koşulmalıdır (ilk talimat). (İkincisi: Deprem, C: Sel, D: Yıldırım).

question_text:
Read the text about Deforestation in the Amazon:
“The Amazon Rainforest is often called the ‘Lungs of the Earth’ because its billions of trees absorb huge amounts of carbon dioxide and produce oxygen. It is also home to 10% of all known animal and plant species in the world. Unfortunately, large areas of the forest are cut down every year to open cattle farms and timber fields. This deforestation destroys wildlife habitats, accelerates climate change, and reduces rainfall.”

Which of the following is NOT a negative consequence of cutting down the Amazon Rainforest?
option_a: Increasing the number of wild animal species and cooling down the global climate
option_b: Disrupting the water cycle and reducing rainfall in the region
option_c: Speeding up global warming because fewer trees absorb carbon dioxide
option_d: Destroying the natural homes of rare animals and plants
explanation: Ormanların kesilmesi vahşi hayvan türlerinin sayısını artırıp iklimi serinletmez; tam aksine yaşam alanlarını yok eder ve küresel ısınmayı hızlandırır.

question_text:
Examine the Water Conservation calculations at home:
• Leaving the tap running while brushing teeth for 2 minutes wastes 12 liters of water; turning it off uses only 1 liter.
• Washing dishes by hand under a running tap uses 100 liters; using an eco-mode full dishwasher uses only 12 liters.
• Fixing a leaking toilet tank saves 200 liters of clean water per day.

If a person brushes their teeth twice a day (morning and night) and turns the tap off while brushing instead of leaving it running, how many liters of water does that ONE person save in a single day?
explanation: Her fırçalamada 12 - 1 = 11 litre su tasarruf edilir. Günde iki kez (sabah ve akşam) diş fırçalayan bir kişi günde 11 × 2 = 22 litre su tasarruf etmiş olur.

question_text:
Read the four predictions about the year 2050:
• Eren: “I think all cars and buses will run on clean solar and electric energy, so city air will be much cleaner.”
• Filiz: “I’m afraid severe droughts will cause water wars if we don’t protect our freshwater lakes today.”
• Gökhan: “In my opinion, scientists will develop early-warning satellites that stop hurricanes before they hit cities.”
• Hale: “I believe polar ice caps will melt completely and many low coastal islands will disappear under the sea.”

Which two students have an OPTIMISTIC (positive/hopeful) view about the future?
explanation: Tüm araçların temiz güneş ve elektrik enerjisiyle çalışıp şehir havasının temizleneceğine inanan Eren ile uyduların kasırgaları şehirlere vurmadan durduracağına inanan Gökhan geleceğe dair iyimser ("optimistic") tahminlerde bulunmuştur (Filiz ve Hale ise karamsar / "pessimistic" uyarılar yapmıştır).

question_text:
Match the terms with their definitions:
1. Aftershock (Artçı sarsıntı)
2. Epicenter (Merkez üssü)
3. Evacuate (Tahliye etmek)
4. Rubble / Debris (Enkaz)

a. Move people away from a dangerous disaster area to a safe place.
b. A smaller earthquake that follows the main large earthquake in the same area.
c. Broken stones, bricks and concrete left after a building collapses.
d. The exact point on the Earth’s surface directly above where an earthquake starts.

Which matching is CORRECT?
explanation: Aftershock → ana depremden sonra gelen daha küçük sarsıntı (1-b); Epicenter → depremin yeryüzündeki merkez noktası (2-d); Evacuate → insanları tehlikeli bölgeden güvenli yere tahliye etmek (3-a); Rubble → yıkılan binanın enkazı (4-c).

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Ski Instructor: Listen carefully, team! Heavy fresh snow fell on the upper peaks last night, and the weather warmed up suddenly today. That means the snow layer on the steep off-piste slopes is unstable. Never ski outside the marked safe tracks, and don’t shout or make loud vibrations near steep snow cliffs!

Which natural disaster is the ski instructor warning the skiers about?
explanation: Üst zirvelere yağan yoğun taze karın havanın aniden ısınmasıyla dik yamaçlarda kararsız hale gelmesi ve işaretli pist dışına çıkılmaması uyarısı çığ ("avalanche") tehlikesine karşıdır.

question_text:
Read the short article about “Earth Hour”:
“Every year on the last Saturday of March, millions of people, landmarks, and government buildings in over 190 countries turn off their non-essential electric lights for one hour from 20:30 to 21:30. Organized by the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF), this symbolic event is called Earth Hour. Its goal is not just to save electricity for sixty minutes, but to raise global awareness about climate change and nature loss.”

What is the main purpose of the annual “Earth Hour” event?
option_a: To close all schools and libraries permanently every Saturday evening
option_b: To leave hospitals and ambulances without electricity for a whole week in March
option_c: To encourage people to burn candles and coal instead of using clean solar power
option_d: To draw the world’s attention to climate change and inspire people to protect nature all year round
explanation: Etkinliğin temel amacı yalnızca 60 dakika elektrik tasarrufu yapmak değil, iklim değişikliği ve doğa kaybı konusunda küresel farkındalık yaratmak ("raise global awareness about climate change and nature loss") ve insanları yıl boyu doğayı korumaya teşvik etmektir.

question_text:
Look at the eco-friendly habits of four students:
• Can: “I collect used batteries in a special box and take them to the school battery recycling bin so their toxic heavy metals don’t poison the soil.”
• Eda: “I replaced all old yellow incandescent bulbs in our house with energy-saving LED bulbs.”
• Mert: “Instead of throwing leftover vegetable peels into the trash, I bury them in our garden compost box to make natural fertilizer.”
• Sude: “I always take 5-minute quick showers instead of filling the bathtub with 150 liters of water.”

Which student is specifically preventing toxic chemical soil pollution from heavy metals?
explanation: Atık pilleri özel bir kutuda biriktirip içlerindeki zehirli ağır metaller ("toxic heavy metals") toprağı zehirlemesin diye okulun atık pil kutusuna götüren öğrenci Can'dır.

question_text:
Read the conversation after a small earthquake (Magnitude 4.2):
Neighbor 1: The shaking has stopped! Let’s run to the elevator on the 8th floor to go down quickly!
Neighbor 2: Stop! Never use the elevator after an earthquake! The electricity might cut off during an aftershock, or the elevator rails might be bent, trapping us inside. Let’s take our emergency bag and walk down the concrete stairs calmly.

Why is it dangerous to use an elevator right after an earthquake?
option_a: Because emergency bags are too heavy for elevators to carry
option_b: Because elevators move too slowly on sunny days
option_c: Because a power outage or damaged rails during an aftershock can trap people inside the elevator cabin
option_d: Because concrete stairs disappear during a 4.2 magnitude tremor
explanation: Depremden hemen sonra bir artçı sarsıntıda elektrik kesilebileceği veya asansör rayları eğilmiş olabileceği için asansörde mahsur kalma tehlikesi vardır; bu yüzden merdivenler kullanılmalıdır.

question_text:
Examine the cause-and-effect chain of Global Warming:
Burning Fossil Fuels → Increase in Greenhouse Gases (CO₂) → Global Temperature Rises → Polar Ice Caps Melt → ________

Which event logically comes at the end of this chain?
option_a: Sea levels rise and low-lying coastal areas face flooding.
option_b: Polar bears have larger icebergs to hunt and live on.
option_c: Deserts turn into snowy ski resorts in summer.
option_d: The Earth enters a freezing Ice Age immediately.
explanation: Kutup buzullarının erimesinin ("Polar Ice Caps Melt") doğrudan sonucu deniz seviyelerinin yükselmesi ve alçak kıyı bölgelerinin sular altında kalma tehlikesidir ("Sea levels rise and low-lying coastal areas face flooding").

question_text:
Teacher: What is the difference between a natural event and a natural disaster?
Geography Expert: If a 7.0 magnitude earthquake happens in the middle of an empty desert where nobody lives and no buildings exist, it is just a natural geological event. It turns into a “disaster” only when people build unsafe, weak buildings on fault lines and suffer loss of life and property.

What is the expert’s main message?
option_a: Earthquakes only happen in empty deserts where nobody lives.
option_b: Humans can stop tectonic plates from moving under the earth’s crust.
option_c: Building weak houses on active fault lines is the safest way to live.
option_d: Safe engineering and proper urban planning can prevent natural earth movements from turning into human disasters.
explanation: Uzmanın temel mesajı; depremin kendisinin bir doğa olayı olduğu, onu felakete dönüştüren şeyin fay hatları üzerine yapılan çürük ve güvensiz binalar olduğu, dolayısıyla sağlam mühendislik ve doğru kentleşmeyle felaketin önlenebileceğidir.

question_text:
Country / CityCommon Natural HazardEngineering & Prevention Measure TakenResult During Recent Event
Tokyo, JapanStrong Earthquakes (Mag 7.0+)Flexible steel skyscrapers on rubber shock absorbers (seismic isolators)Buildings swayed gently without collapsing
NetherlandsRising Sea Levels & North Sea StormsGiant movable storm-surge sea barriers (Maeslantkering) and dikesCoastal cities below sea level stayed completely dry
Swiss AlpsWinter AvalanchesSteel snow-nets on upper mountain slopes and avalanche tunnels over roadsMountain villages and trains remained safe
Coast of ChilePacific Ocean TsunamisImmediate SMS alert system + tsunami evacuation bridges to high hillsCitizens reached high ground 15 mins before waves hit

Examine the global disaster prevention table above carefully. What common lesson do ALL four examples in the table prove?
option_a: Although humans cannot stop natural forces from occurring, scientific engineering and early-warning systems can prevent loss of life and destruction.
option_b: Natural disasters only happen in Japan and Chile, while Europe never faces any natural hazards.
option_c: The only way to survive a natural disaster is to abandon your country permanently.
option_d: Engineering measures like seismic isolators and sea barriers are useless against nature.
explanation: Tablodaki dört ülke örneği de (Japonya'da sismik izolatörler, Hollanda'da dev deniz bariyerleri, İsviçre'de çelik çığ ağları, Şili'de erken uyarı ve tahliye köprüleri) doğa olayları durdurulamasa bile bilimsel mühendislik ve erken uyarı sistemleriyle can ve mal kaybının önlenebildiğini kanıtlamaktadır.

question_text: Look at the same global disaster prevention table in the previous question. How do tall skyscrapers in Tokyo survive 7.0+ magnitude earthquakes without collapsing?
option_a: They are covered with steel snow-nets on their roofs in winter.
option_b: They are surrounded by giant sea barriers that block ocean waves.
option_c: They are built with heavy brittle bricks and rigid mud without any steel.
option_d: They are built with flexible steel structures resting on rubber shock absorbers (seismic isolators) that absorb the shaking.
explanation: Tablonun ilk satırına göre Tokyo'daki gökdelenler sarsıntıyı emen kauçuk şok emiciler (sismik izolatörler / "rubber shock absorbers - seismic isolators") üzerinde esnek çelik yapılarla inşa edildiği için yıkılmadan esneyerek depremi atlatmaktadır.

question_text:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Where Freshwater Is Used in Türkiye (%)" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 56.5 170.0 P b0 106.8 170.0 P c0 106.8 30.0 P d0 56.5 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 81.7 24.0 "70%" size=10 text 81.7 184.0 "Agriculture (." size=10 P a1 147.9 170.0 P b1 198.1 170.0 P c1 198.1 132.0 P d1 147.9 132.0 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 173.0 126.0 "19%" size=10 text 173.0 184.0 "Industry (Fac." size=10 P a2 239.2 170.0 P b2 289.4 170.0 P c2 289.4 148.0 P d2 239.2 148.0 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 264.3 142.0 "11%" size=10 text 264.3 184.0 "Domestic Use ." size=10 ```
Read the comment of a Hydrologist (Water Scientist) based on the chart above:
“Saving water at home by turning off the tap is very important, as domestic use makes up 11% of our water consumption. However, as you can see in the chart, 70% of all freshwater goes to one single sector! If farmers switch from old-fashioned ‘wild flooding irrigation’ (vahşi salma sulama) to modern ‘closed-pipe drip irrigation’ (damla sulama), we can cut agricultural water waste in half and save our lakes from drying up!”

According to the chart and the scientist’s comment, why is modernizing agricultural irrigation the MOST effective way to prevent water shortage in Türkiye?
option_a: Because factories and energy plants do not use any freshwater at all.
option_b: Because agriculture consumes 70% of all freshwater, so switching to drip irrigation saves the largest volume of water.
option_c: Because turning off the tap at home increases water waste in farming.
option_d: Because homes and municipalities consume 70% of all freshwater in Türkiye.
explanation: Tatlı su kaynaklarının %70 gibi en büyük payı tarımsal sulamada kullanıldığı için tarımda vahşi sulamadan modern damla sulamaya geçilmesi en büyük miktarda su tasarrufunu sağlayacak en etkili adımdır.

question_text:
Read the text about the “Triangle of Life / Drop-Cover-Hold On” during an earthquake:
“AFAD (Disaster and Emergency Management Presidency of Türkiye) trains students across the country on what to do before, during, and after an earthquake:
• BEFORE: Fasten tall wardrobes, bookshelves, and TV units to the wall with L-brackets. Prepare a disaster kit and choose a Family Meeting Area (Toplanma Alanı) via e-Devlet.
• DURING: Stay calm. Do NOT run toward balconies, stairs, or elevators (stairs and balconies are often the weakest parts of a shaking building!). Instead, Drop, Cover, and Hold On next to a sturdy desk, a heavy sofa, or a solid washing machine, keeping away from glass windows.
• AFTER: Turn off the main gas, water, and electricity valves before evacuating via the stairs to the open assembly area.”

According to AFAD’s training guide above, why must you turn off the main natural gas and electricity valves right after the shaking stops before leaving your house?
option_a: To keep the house dark so neighbors cannot see inside the rooms
option_b: Because turning off the gas valve stops aftershocks from happening under the ground
option_c: To prevent secondary disasters such as fires or gas explosions caused by cracked pipes or short-circuited wires
option_d: To save money on next month’s electricity and natural gas bills while waiting in the park
explanation: Sarsıntı durduktan sonra evden çıkmadan önce ana doğal gaz ve elektrik vanalarının kapatılmasının nedeni, çatlayan borulardan veya kısa devre yapan kablolardan kaynaklanabilecek yangın ve gaz patlaması gibi ikincil felaketleri önlemektir.

question_text:
Look at the diagram showing how a Hurricane / Tropical Cyclone forms and weakens:
```fig size 340 160 P R1a 6.0 6.0 P R1b 334.0 6.0 P R1c 334.0 154.0 P R1d 6.0 154.0 poly R1a R1b R1c R1d fill c=blue a=0.08 text 170 24 "Stage 1: Ocean water temperature rises above 26.5°C near the Equator" size=9 bold text 170 46 "Warm, moist air rises rapidly from the ocean surface (The hurricane’s fuel!)" size=9 text 170 68 "Stage 2: Earth’s rotation makes the rising storm clouds spin faster" size=9 text 170 90 "When wind speed exceeds 119 km/h, it becomes a Hurricane / Typhoon" size=9 text 170 112 "Stage 3: The hurricane hits the coast with violent winds and heavy rain" size=9 text 170 134 "Storm surge floods coastal roads and uproots trees" size=9``` According to the scientific diagram above, why does a powerful hurricane weaken and die out after it moves inland away from the ocean (Stage 4)?
option_a: Because its main energy source (fuel) is warm, moist air from ocean water above 26.5°C, which is absent over dry land
option_b: Because the Earth stops rotating when a hurricane touches the beach
option_c: Because tall trees and buildings on land push the wind back into the ocean
option_d: Because people turn on air conditioners to cool down the hurricane clouds
explanation: Şemada kasırganın yakıtının ("fuel") 26,5°C üzerindeki sıcak okyanus suyundan yükselen sıcak ve nemli hava olduğu; karaya ilerlediğinde bu sıcak su ve nem kaynağını kaybettiği için hızla zayıflayıp söndüğü (Stage 4) açıklanmıştır.

question_text:
Read the four news headlines from different corners of the world on the same day:
• Headline 1 (Australia): “Record 46°C heatwave and dry winds cause bushfires to spread across eucalyptus forests near Sydney!”
• Headline 2 (Bangladesh): “Monsoon rains cause the Ganges and Brahmaputra rivers to overflow, submerging thousands of hectares of rice fields under water!”
• Headline 3 (Iceland): “Glowing red magma fountains shoot 100 meters into the night sky as a new fissure opens on the Reykjanes Peninsula!”
• Headline 4 (Kenya): “After three consecutive dry seasons without rainfall, crops have withered and villagers walk 15 km to find drinking water.”

Which option correctly matches the four headlines with the natural disasters?
explanation: Avustralya'daki çalı/orman yangını "Wildfire" (1), Bangladeş'te muson yağmurlarıyla nehirlerin taşması "Flood" (2), İzlanda'da kırmızı magma püskürmesi "Volcanic eruption" (3), Kenya'da üç mevsim yağmur yağmaması nedeniyle ekinlerin kuruması ise "Drought" (4) ile eşleşir.

question_text:
Read the text about the TEMA Foundation in Türkiye:
“Founded in 1992 by Hayrettin Karaca (‘Grandpa Earth’ / Toprak Dede) and Nihat Gökyiğit (‘Grandpa Leaf’ / Yaprak Dede) with the slogan ‘Türkiye Çöl Olmasın’ (Let Türkiye Not Become a Desert), the TEMA Foundation works to protect our country’s fertile topsoil. Many people don’t realize that it takes nature 500 to 1,000 years to form just 2.5 centimeters of fertile topsoil! Yet, wind and rain erosion can wash that soil away into the sea in a single stormy season if hills are left bare without trees and grass cover.”

Why is soil erosion considered such an irreversible danger according to the text?
option_a: Because nature creates 10 meters of fertile topsoil every twenty-four hours.
option_b: Because fertile topsoil washed away in a single season takes 500 to 1,000 years for nature to recreate just 2.5 cm of it.
option_c: Because planting trees on hills speeds up wind and rain erosion.
option_d: Because soil erosion causes volcanoes to erupt under the Black Sea.
explanation: Tek bir yağışlı mevsimde çıplak tepelerden denize süpürülen sadece 2,5 santimetrelik verimli üst toprağın doğada yeniden oluşması 500 ila 1.000 yıl sürdüğü için toprak erozyonu telafisi çok güç bir tehlikedir.

question_text:
Find the odd sentence out in the paragraph:
(I) Glaciers in Greenland and Antarctica are melting at an alarming rate due to rising global temperatures. (II) As these massive ice sheets melt into the ocean, global sea levels rise and threaten coastal cities around the world. (III) To make a traditional Turkish omelette, crack three eggs into a pan with melted butter and add salt. (IV) Furthermore, the loss of white ice reduces Earth’s ability to reflect sunlight back into space, which makes the planet warm up even faster.
explanation: Paragraf Grönland ve Antarktika buzullarının erimesini ve küresel ısınma üzerindeki etkilerini anlatırken, III. cümle omlet tarifinden bahsederek anlam bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue between a city mayor and an urban planner (city architect):
Mayor: Every time heavy rain falls for two hours, our city’s main avenues turn into rivers and cars get stuck in flash floods! Why is this happening more often now than thirty years ago?
Urban Planner: Thirty years ago, 60% of the city had green parks, soil gardens, and trees that absorbed rainwater like a giant sponge. Today, 90% of the ground is covered with impermeable asphalt and concrete! Rainwater cannot soak into the soil anymore, so it all rushes into the narrow storm drains at once. We must build “Sponge City” parks, rain gardens, and permeable pavements!

According to the urban planner, why do modern cities suffer from flash floods during heavy rain much more than in the past?
option_a: Because covering the ground with concrete and asphalt prevents rainwater from soaking naturally into the soil
option_b: Because green parks and trees push rainwater onto the asphalt streets
option_c: Because thirty years ago it never rained in the city at all
option_d: Because citizens drink less tap water during rainy days
explanation: Şehir plancısına göre geçmişte yağmur suyunu sünger gibi emen yeşil alanların yerini geçirimsiz asfalt ve betonun alması, suyun toprağa sızmasını engelleyip tüm yağmur suyunun aynı anda caddelere dolmasına yol açmaktadır.

question_text:
Examine the table showing the Decomposition Time of Waste Materials in Nature (Marine/Soil Environment):
Waste ItemTime to Decompose in NatureRecyclable?
Banana Peel / Apple Core2 to 5 weeksCompostable (Organic fertilizer)
Newspaper / Cardboard Box2 to 6 monthsYes (100% Recyclable — saves trees)
Plastic Water Bottle (PET)450 yearsYes (Recyclable into fleece & plastic)
Glass Bottle / Jar4,000+ years (up to 1 million years)Yes (100% endlessly recyclable)
Waste Alkaline Battery100+ years (Leaks toxic mercury/cadmium)Must go to Special E-Waste / Battery Bin

Look at the table above. Why is throwing a Glass Bottle into nature in a sunny forest doubly dangerous?
option_a: Wild animals eat glass bottles as organic fertilizer.
option_b: It cannot be recycled or reused once it is emptied.
option_c: It decomposes in two weeks and turns into poisonous mercury gas.
option_d: It stays in nature for thousands of years without decomposing, AND it can focus sunlight like a magnifying lens to start a forest fire.
explanation: Cam şişe hem doğada binlerce yıl (4.000+ yıl) çözünmeden kalır hem de güneşli bir ormanda güneş ışığını büyüteç/mercek gibi kuru otların üzerine odaklayarak orman yangını çıkarabilir.

question_text: Look at the same Waste Decomposition table in the previous question. Which of the following is CORRECT?
option_a: Glass bottles cannot be recycled, so they must be buried in the forest.
option_b: Organic food waste like banana peels decomposes in weeks and can be turned into natural compost for soil.
option_c: Waste batteries should be buried in vegetable gardens to help plants grow.
option_d: Plastic water bottles decompose faster in nature than cardboard boxes and newspapers.
explanation: Tablonun ilk satırına göre muz kabuğu ve elma koçanı gibi organik gıda atıkları 2 ila 5 hafta içinde çözünmekte ve toprak için doğal kompost gübreye dönüştürülebilmektedir.

question_text:
Read the text about the “Richter Scale” (Magnitude) vs. “Destructiveness” (Intensity):
“Many people think that an earthquake’s magnitude is the only factor that determines how much damage it causes. In fact, three other factors are equally important:
1. Focal Depth (Odak Derinliği): A shallow earthquake (only 7 km underground) shakes the surface much more violently than a deep earthquake (100 km underground) of the same magnitude!
2. Soil Type: Buildings built on soft alluvial soil (old lake or riverbed mud) experience amplified shaking compared to buildings built on solid mountain bedrock.
3. Building Quality: Whether the buildings follow strict earthquake engineering codes.”

Two cities experience a 6.2 magnitude earthquake. City X suffers heavy damage, while City Y suffers zero damage. Based on the text, which combination explains why City Y was unharmed?
option_a: In City Y, the earthquake was very shallow (5 km) and unreinforced brick houses stood on soft mud.
option_b: In City Y, nobody fastened their furniture to the walls or followed engineering codes.
option_c: In City Y, the earthquake was deep underground, and well-engineered buildings stood on solid rocky ground.
option_d: City X had solid bedrock and earthquake-resistant steel buildings.
explanation: Metindeki 3 faktöre göre depremin derinde gerçekleşmesi, şehrin sağlam kaya zemin ("solid mountain bedrock") üzerinde kurulması ve binaların deprem yönetmeliğine uygun sağlam mühendislikle yapılması City Y'nin hiç hasar almamasını açıklar.

question_text:
Read the conversation about Electric Vehicles (EVs) and Clean Energy:
Sarp: My uncle bought an electric car yesterday. He says his car produces zero exhaust smoke, so it is 100% eco-friendly!
Science Teacher: Electric cars are definitely much cleaner for city streets, Sarp. However, to make an electric car truly 100% green, we must also look at how the electricity that charges its battery is produced! If the power plant burns coal to make electricity, it still releases carbon dioxide. If the car is charged with electricity from solar panels or wind turbines, then it becomes truly zero-emission!

What important scientific point does the teacher make about electric cars?
option_a: An electric car is truly zero-emission only when the electricity used to charge it comes from renewable sources like solar or wind rather than coal.
option_b: Gasoline cars produce less exhaust smoke in cities than electric cars do.
option_c: Electric cars burn coal and petrol inside their engines while driving on city streets.
option_d: Solar panels and wind turbines release huge amounts of carbon dioxide into the air.
explanation: Öğretmen elektrikli araçların şehir sokaklarında egzoz dumanı çıkarmadığını, ancak bataryasını şarj eden elektriğin kömür santrali yerine güneş veya rüzgar gibi yenilenebilir kaynaklardan üretilmesi halinde gerçek anlamda %100 sıfır emisyonlu olacağını vurgulamaktadır.

question_text:
Read the four students’ campaign posters for “World Environment Day (June 5)”:
• Poster 1 (Arda): “Stop Fast Fashion Waste! Donate your outgrown clothes or recycle old fabrics instead of throwing 2,700 liters of water away with every single cotton T-shirt!”
• Poster 2 (Beren): “Protect the Bees! Do not use toxic chemical pesticides in gardens; without bees pollinating flowers, one-third of our human food crops will disappear!”
• Poster 3 (Cem): “Say No to Microplastics! Carry a stainless steel water flask instead of buying 500 disposable plastic bottles every year!”
• Poster 4 (Duru): “Unplug Vampire Power! Even when turned off, TVs and chargers plugged into wall sockets consume 10% of home electricity!”

Which student’s poster focuses on protecting agricultural biodiversity and food production by saving a vital insect species?
explanation: Bahçelerde zehirli tarım ilaçları kullanılmamasını, çiçekleri tozlaştıran arılar olmazsa insan gıda ürünlerinin üçte birinin yok olacağını belirterek hayati bir böcek türünü ve gıda üretimini korumaya odaklanan Beren'dir (Poster 2).

question_text: Look at the same four World Environment Day posters in the previous question. What does Duru mean by “Vampire Power” in Poster 4?
option_a: Electricity generated by wind turbines at midnight in Transylvania
option_b: The standby electricity silently wasted by appliances and chargers that remain plugged into the wall socket even when turned off
option_c: The battery power used when talking on a smartphone during the daytime
option_d: The solar energy absorbed by dark solar panels on house roofs
explanation: Poster 4'te kapalı olsalar bile prizde takılı bırakılan televizyon ve şarj aletlerinin bekleme konumunda ("standby") sessizce tükettiği %10'luk elektrik israfına "Vampire Power" (Vampir Güç / Hayalet Tüketim) denmektedir.

question_text:
Read the survival story from the 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami:
“On December 26, 2004, 10-year-old British schoolgirl Tilly Smith was on holiday with her family at Maikhao Beach in Phuket, Thailand. Suddenly, she saw the sea water bubbling like foam and pulling far back from the shore, exposing the wet sand and fish. Just two weeks earlier, her geography teacher in England had shown her class a video about how the ocean recedes and bubbles right before a tsunami hits! Tilly screamed at her parents and the hotel staff to evacuate the beach immediately. Thanks to her geography knowledge, all 100 tourists on that beach ran to the third floor of the hotel minutes before the giant waves struck, and not a single person died on Maikhao Beach!”

What is the most inspiring lesson of Tilly Smith’s true story?
option_a: Geography lessons at school have no practical value in real life.
option_b: Tourists should run toward the sea to collect fish when the ocean water suddenly recedes.
option_c: Disaster education learned in school geography classes can save hundreds of lives in a real emergency.
option_d: Ten-year-old children cannot notice natural warning signs before adults do.
explanation: Henüz 10 yaşındaki Tilly Smith'in iki hafta önce okulda coğrafya dersinde öğrendiği tsunami öncesi denizin çekilmesi ve köpürmesi bilgisini hatırlayıp plajdaki 100 turisti zamanında uyararak hayatlarını kurtarması, okuldaki afet eğitiminin gerçek hayatta hayat kurtardığını kanıtlamaktadır.

question_text:
Examine the table of Air Quality Index (AQI) colors and health warnings:
AQI ScoreColor CodeAir Quality LevelHealth Advice for Citizens
0 – 50GreenGoodIdeal air quality! Enjoy outdoor sports and open your windows.
51 – 100YellowModerateAcceptable, but extremely sensitive people should limit heavy outdoor exertion.
101 – 150OrangeUnhealthy for Sensitive GroupsPeople with asthma, children and the elderly should avoid outdoor running.
151 – 300Red / PurpleUnhealthy / Very UnhealthyEveryone should stay indoors, keep windows closed, and wear N95 masks outside.

On a cold winter day in a valley city where coal is burned for heating and there is no wind, the city’s digital board shows AQI: 185 (Red). What should the school principal decide for today’s Physical Education (P.E.) football match?
option_a: Cancel the outdoor football match and hold a light indoor activity in the ventilated gym instead.
option_b: Announce that the air quality is Green (Good) and ideal for asthma patients.
option_c: Open all classroom windows wide for six hours to let the smoky air inside.
option_d: Take all students outside to run a 5-kilometer marathon in the open air.
explanation: AQI: 185 puanı "151 – 300 (Red / Unhealthy)" aralığında yer aldığı ve herkesin kapalı alanda kalması tavsiye edildiği için okul müdürü açık havadaki futbol maçını iptal edip kapalı spor salonuna almalıdır.

question_text:
Read the text about Geothermal Energy in Türkiye:
“Because Türkiye is located on active tectonic fault lines (especially in the Aegean Region like Aydın, Denizli, and Manisa), underground magma heats the groundwater deep beneath the Earth’s crust. While fault lines bring earthquake risks, they also provide a wonderful clean blessing: Geothermal Energy! Hot steam and water pumped from deep underground are used to generate clean electricity and to heat more than 150,000 homes and winter vegetable greenhouses without burning any coal or gas!”

According to the text, how does Türkiye turn its geological location on tectonic fault lines into an environmental and economic advantage?
option_a: By building houses without roofs in winter
option_b: By burning coal and oil inside the fault lines to warm up the Aegean Sea
option_c: By exporting cold snow from Denizli and Aydın to tropical countries
option_d: By using underground geothermal hot water and steam to produce clean electricity and heat thousands of homes and greenhouses
explanation: Türkiye aktif fay hatları üzerinde yer almasının getirdiği yer altı sıcak su ve buhar kaynaklarını (jeotermal enerjiyi) kömür veya gaz yakmadan temiz elektrik üretmek ve 150.000'den fazla konut ile kışlık serayı ısıtmak için kullanarak çevresel ve ekonomik bir avantaja dönüştürmektedir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue between two brothers while camping in winter:
Older Brother: Never bring the glowing charcoal barbecue grill inside our closed tent to warm up while sleeping!
Younger Brother: Why not? There are no flames left on the charcoal, just red glowing coals!
Older Brother: Glowing charcoal in a closed space without oxygen produces Carbon Monoxide (CO)—an invisible, odorless (smell-less) and tasteless poisonous gas! People can’t smell it while sleeping, and it causes fatal poisoning.

Why is Carbon Monoxide (CO) called the “Silent Killer” during winter heating accidents?
option_a: Because it smells strongly like rotten eggs and turns the air bright purple
option_b: Because it has no color, no smell and no taste, so people cannot notice they are breathing it in inside closed spaces
option_c: Because it only exists high up in the clouds above 10,000 meters
option_d: Because it makes a very loud siren noise that wakes up the whole neighborhood
explanation: Karbonmonoksit (CO) gazı görünmez (renksiz), kokusuz ("odorless") ve tatsız olduğu için kapalı ortamda uyuyan insanlar onu soluduklarını fark edemezler; bu nedenle "sessiz katil" olarak adlandırılır.

question_text:
Examine the two conditional sentences about the environment:
• Type 1 (Real possibility in the future): “If we plant millions of trees today, we will prevent landslides and clean the air.”
• Warning with “Unless” (Unless = If... not): “Unless we stop polluting the oceans with plastic, marine animals will become extinct.”

Which sentence has the EXACT SAME meaning as the second sentence above (with “Unless”)?
option_a: Because we stopped polluting the oceans, all marine animals became extinct yesterday.
option_b: If we stop polluting the oceans with plastic, marine animals will become extinct.
option_c: If we don’t stop polluting the oceans with plastic, marine animals will become extinct.
option_d: Marine animals will survive easily if we throw more plastic into the oceans.
explanation: "Unless" bağlacı "If ... not" (-mezsek / -mazsak) anlamına gelir. Dolayısıyla "Unless we stop polluting..." cümlesi "If we don’t stop polluting the oceans with plastic, marine animals will become extinct" ile birebir aynı anlamdadır.

question_text:
Read the text about Honeybees and Wildfires in Marmaris & Muğla:
“The pine forests of Muğla are famous for producing 80% of the world’s Pine Honey (Çam Balı). Unlike flower honey, pine honey is produced with the help of a tiny insect called Marchalina hellenica (Basra böceği) that lives only on Turkish red pine trees (Kızılçam) and secretes sweet honeydew for bees. When huge forest fires burned the red pine forests in Muğla, not only the trees were lost, but also the habitat of this special insect and the livelihood of thousands of local beekeepers! Thankfully, ecologists and beekeepers are working together to replant red pines and restore the pine honey ecosystem.”

Why did the forest fires in Muğla heavily affect world pine honey production?
option_a: Because the fires burned the red pine trees where the special insect needed by bees to make pine honey lives
option_b: Because beekeepers stopped keeping bees and started working in coal mines
option_c: Because pine honey is made artificially in factories without any trees or bees
option_d: Because honeybees only make pine honey inside cold snowy caves in winter
explanation: Çam balı, arıların yalnızca kızılçam ağaçlarında yaşayan özel bir böceğin ("Marchalina hellenica / Basra böceği") salgısını toplamasıyla üretildiği için, Muğla'daki kızılçam ormanlarının yanması bu böceğin yaşam alanını ve çam balı üretimini doğrudan etkilemiştir.

question_text:
Look at the 4 emergency scenarios and decide which person makes a WRONG and DANGEROUS decision:
• Scenario 1 (Burak — Indoors during an earthquake): He drops, covers his head, and holds on next to a solid sofa away from the windows.
• Scenario 2 (Cansu — Outdoors during a thunderstorm): She runs under the tallest single oak tree on top of an open hill and holds her metal-tipped umbrella up.
• Scenario 3 (Deniz — On a beach when tsunami sirens sound): He leaves his beach towel behind and runs immediately up the road to a 40-meter hill.
• Scenario 4 (Ece — Driving when a flash flood covers an underpass): She stops her car before the flooded underpass, turns around, and drives to a higher street.

Who makes a life-threatening mistake?
explanation: Yıldırımlı fırtınada açık bir tepedeki en yüksek tek ağacın altına girip metal uçlu şemsiye tutmak yıldırımı doğrudan üzerine çekeceği için Cansu (Scenario 2) hayati tehlike yaratan yanlış bir karar vermiştir.

question_text:
Read the riddle about a natural force / weather disaster:
• I am not a water wave from the sea, and I am not a shaking fault line underground.
• I happen in summer and autumn when there has been no rain for months.
• Because of me, the soil cracks into dry pieces, dam reservoirs drop below 10%, farmers lose their wheat harvest, and cities have to limit tap water.

What natural disaster am I?
explanation: Aylarca yağmur yağmaması sonucu toprağın çatlaması, barajların %10'un altına düşmesi ve tarım ürünlerinin kurumasıyla ortaya çıkan afet kuraklıktır ("A drought").

question_text:
Read the Native American proverb often quoted by environmental scientists:
“We do not inherit the Earth from our ancestors; we borrow it from our children.” (Dünya bize atalarımızdan miras kalmadı; biz onu çocuklarımızdan ödünç aldık.)

What is the core message of this proverb?
option_a: We can use up all fossil fuels, cut down all forests and pollute the rivers because the Earth belongs only to us.
option_b: Children should pay rent money to their parents and grandparents for living on Earth.
option_c: We have a moral duty to protect the planet’s clean water, forests and climate so we can hand it over undamaged to future generations.
option_d: Our ancestors destroyed the whole planet thousands of years ago.
explanation: Bu atasözü, gezegenimizin temiz suyunu, ormanlarını ve iklimini tüketme hakkımız olmadığını; onu gelecek nesillere (çocuklarımıza) aldığımız gibi temiz ve yaşanabilir biçimde teslim etme ahlaki sorumluluğumuz olduğunu vurgulamaktadır.

question_text:
Mert: How about going to the book fair on Sunday afternoon?
Kaan: ________. I need to buy some new science-fiction novels.

Which of the following completes the dialogue?
option_c: No, I have to visit my uncle.
explanation: Kaan bilim kurgu romanları almak istediğini söylediği için daveti kabul eden “Sure, that sounds great!” seçeneği doğrudur.

question_text:
Selin never misses folk music concerts because she thinks traditional melodies are harmonic and relaxing. However, she finds heavy metal unbearable.

Which sentence is TRUE about Selin?
option_a: She is crazy about heavy metal concerts.
option_b: She prefers folk music to heavy metal.
option_c: She thinks folk music is ridiculous.
option_d: She hates all kinds of music.
explanation: Halk müziğini dinlendirici bulup heavy metali katlanılmaz bulduğuna göre “prefers folk music to heavy metal” doğrudur.

question_text:
Chef: First, peel the potatoes. Second, chop them into small cubes. ________, fry them in hot oil for ten minutes.

Which linker fills in the blank?
explanation: Birinci ve ikinci adımlardan sonraki basamağı anlatırken sıralama bağlacı olarak “Next / Then” kullanılır.

question_text:
Secretary: Hello, Star Tech Company. How may I help you?
Caller: May I speak to Mr. Yılmaz, please?
Secretary: I’m afraid he is in a meeting now. ________?

Which question completes the phone call?
option_a: Would you like to leave a message
option_b: What is your favorite smartphone app
option_c: Did you send an e-mail yesterday
explanation: Görüşülmek istenen kişi toplantıda olduğunda “Would you like to leave a message?” (Mesaj bırakmak ister misiniz?) diye sorulur.

question_text:
Look at the table showing how four teens use the Internet:
NameOnline ActivityDaily Time
EcePracticing English & doing research1 hour
BoraPlaying multiplayer games5 hours
DefneDownloading music & chatting2 hours
KeremReading e-books & watching documentaries1.5 hours

According to the table, who uses the Internet ONLY for entertainment and gaming for the longest time?
explanation: Tabloda 5 saat ile en uzun süre ve yalnızca oyun (entertainment and gaming) amacıyla internet kullanan kişi Bora’dır.

question_text:
Read the safety brochure for Rafting:
• Always wear your helmet and life jacket.
• Listen carefully to your experienced instructor.
• Never stand up inside the raft while passing through rapids.

Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the brochure?
option_b: Rules to follow inside the boat
explanation: Broşürde koruyucu ekipman, bot içi kural ve rehberi dinleme yer alır; ancak gençler için bilet fiyatından söz edilmemiştir.

question_text:
Tour Guide: Welcome to Cappadocia! Today we will visit the Fairy Chimneys, explore an underground city, and stay in a traditional cave hotel.

Which aspect of tourism is NOT mentioned by the guide?
explanation: Peri Bacaları (doğal güzellik), yeraltı şehri (tarihî yapı) ve mağara oteli (konaklama) belirtilmiş; ulaşım (transportation) hakkında bilgi verilmemiştir.

question_text:
Look at the chart of weekly household chores shared by 100 teenagers:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Weekly Chores (%)" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "45%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Tidying Room" size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 76.7 P d1 119.9 76.7 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 70.7 "30%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Setting Table" size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 123.3 P d2 188.4 123.3 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 117.3 "15%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Taking Out Trash" size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 138.9 P d3 256.9 138.9 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 132.9 "10%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Ironing" size=10 ```
According to the chart, which statement is CORRECT?
option_a: More than 50% of the teens iron clothes every week.
option_b: Ironing is more popular than setting the table.
option_c: Taking out the trash is the most common chore.
option_d: Nearly half of the teenagers tidy their own rooms.
explanation: Grafikte odasını toplama oranı %45 ile yarıya (%50) en yakın değerdir (“Nearly half of the teenagers...”).

question_text:
Read the short note about Aziz Sancar:
“Prof. Dr. Aziz Sancar was born in Mardin in 1946. After graduating from Istanbul University Faculty of Medicine, he went to the USA to conduct research in biochemistry. In 2015, he won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for mapping how cells repair damaged DNA.”

Why did Aziz Sancar receive the Nobel Prize in Chemistry?
option_a: For discovering the radium element in Paris
option_b: For explaining the DNA repair mechanism in cells
option_c: For designing the first steam locomotive
option_d: For inventing the first smartphone microprocessor
explanation: Metinde Aziz Sancar’ın hücrelerin hasarlı DNA’yı nasıl onardığını haritaladığı (“mapping how cells repair damaged DNA”) için Nobel Kimya Ödülü kazandığı belirtilmektedir.

question_text:
Read the environmental report:
“Deforestation and burning fossil fuels increase the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere. As a result, global temperatures rise, glaciers melt, and severe droughts occur in many regions. To slow this down, we should plant more trees and switch to solar and wind energy.”

According to the report, what is one effective precaution against global warming?
option_a: Using renewable energy sources and afforestation
option_b: Cutting down more forests for factories
option_d: Increasing the use of coal and oil
explanation: Raporda ağaç dikmenin (“plant more trees” / afforestation) ve güneş-rüzgâr gibi yenilenebilir enerjiye geçmenin etkili önlemler olduğu vurgulanmıştır.

question_text:
Mert: Would you like to come over for a movie night on Saturday?
Kaan: _____ I have to finish my science project.
option_a: Of course, I'll bring some popcorn.
option_b: Why not? See you at 7 p.m.
option_d: I'd love to, but I can't.
explanation: Kaan, fen projesini bitirmesi gerektiğini söyleyerek bir mazeret bildiriyor. Bu nedenle daveti kibar bir şekilde reddeden ifade doğru cevaptır.

question_text:
Selin: What about going to the new bowling alley after school?
Defne: _____ I really enjoy bowling.
explanation: Defne bovling oynamayı gerçekten sevdiğini belirttiği için teklifi kabul eden bir yanıt vermelidir.

question_text: A true friend always _____ when you are in trouble. You can always trust him or her.
explanation: Gerçek bir arkadaş başınız dertteyken size her zaman destek olur (back up: desteklemek). Diğer seçenekler olumsuz davranışlardır.

question_text:
Ece: Are you doing anything tomorrow afternoon?
Beren: No, not at all. _____
Ece: How about visiting the book fair together?
option_d: I have a lot of homework.
explanation: Beren yarın öğleden sonra hiçbir işi olmadığını söyledikten sonra Ece'nin teklif yapabilmesi için 'Neden sordun?' anlamına gelen soruyu sorması gerekir.

question_text:
Waiter: Welcome to Star Cafe. May I take your order?
Customer: Yes, please. _____
option_b: I'm sorry, I can't make it.
option_c: Where is the nearest post office?
option_d: I'd like a grilled chicken salad.
explanation: Garson sipariş almak istediğinde müşteri ne yemek istediğini söylemelidir. 'I'd like...' sipariş vermek için kullanılan kalıptır.

question_text:
Class 8B Picnic Invitation
Place: Green Valley Park
Date: Sunday, May 14
Time: 11:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.
Bring your own drinks!

Which question does NOT have an answer on the invitation?
option_a: How much does the picnic cost?
explanation: Davetiyede pikniğin yeri (Green Valley Park), tarihi (Sunday, May 14) ve bitiş saati (4:00 p.m.) yazılıdır; ancak ücreti hakkında bilgi yoktur.

question_text:
Arda: Shall we order a large pizza with mushrooms?
Tuna: _____ I don't like mushrooms. Let's order a cheese pizza.
explanation: Tuna mantar sevmediğini ve peynirli pizza sipariş etmeyi önerdiği için ilk teklifi reddetmiştir. 'I'd rather not.' (Tercih etmem.) uygun yanıttır.

question_text: I always share my secrets with Zeynep because she is _____. She never tells them to anyone else.
explanation: Sırları başkasına söylemeyen güvenilir kişiler için 'reliable' (güvenilir) sıfatı kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the text message:
'Hi Emre, we are having a slumber party at my house tonight. Can you join us? – Burak'

What is Burak doing in this message?
explanation: Burak, Emre'yi bu gece evindeki pijama partisine katılmaya davet etmektedir (inviting).

question_text:
Waiter: Would you like anything for dessert?
Sude: No, thanks. _____
explanation: Sude tatlı istemediğini belirttiğine göre tok olduğunu söylemelidir. 'I'm stuffed.' (Çok doydum / tıka basa doydum) ifadesi buna uygundur.

question_text: Deniz never changes his mind easily. Even when he is wrong, he doesn't accept it. He is very _____.
explanation: Fikrini kolay değiştirmeyen ve hatalı olduğunda bile kabul etmeyen kişi 'stubborn' (inatçı) olarak tanımlanır.

question_text:
Cem: Why don't we study together for the English exam?
Ozan: _____ When shall we meet?
explanation: Ozan 'Ne zaman buluşalım?' diye sorduğuna göre birlikte ders çalışma teklifini kabul etmiştir. 'Yeah, why not?' (Evet, neden olmasın?) kabul ifadesidir.

question_text:
Message from Melis:
'Dear Nil, thank you for inviting me to your birthday party. I'd love to come, but my grandparents are visiting us this weekend. Happy birthday!'

Why can't Melis attend the party?
option_b: She is going on a holiday.
option_c: She forgot to buy a present.
option_d: She has family guests at the weekend.
explanation: Melis mesajında hafta sonu büyükanne ve büyükbabasının kendilerini ziyaret edeceğini (family guests) mazeret olarak belirtmiştir.

question_text: Which word has a NEGATIVE meaning?
explanation: 'Arrogant' (kibirli) olumsuz bir kişilik özelliğidir. Honest (dürüst), loyal (sadık) ve generous (cömert) olumlu sıfatlardır.

question_text:
Kerem: Let's go cycling by the lake on Sunday morning.
Yusuf: _____ I don't have a bike.
explanation: Yusuf bisikleti olmadığını söyleyerek bir mazeret sunduğu için teklifi reddeden ifadeyi seçmelidir.

question_text:
Look at the restaurant menu:
StartersMain CoursesDesserts
Tomato SoupMeatballsApple Pie
Lentil SoupGrilled FishIce Cream

Ali doesn't eat meat or fish. Which of the following can he order?
explanation: Ali et ve balık yemediğine göre ana yemeklerden köfte (Meatballs) ve ızgara balığı (Grilled Fish) seçemez. Mercimek çorbası ve elmalı turta sipariş edebilir.

question_text: My best friend and I _____ well. We have similar hobbies and we never argue.
explanation: 'Get on well' iyi geçinmek anlamına gelir. 'Benzer hobilerimiz var ve hiç tartışmayız' cümlesi bunu destekler.

question_text:
Waiter: Would you like some lemonade with your meal?
Customer: _____, please. I'm very thirsty.
explanation: Müşteri çok susadığını belirttiği için limonata teklifini 'Yes, I'd love some' diyerek kabul etmelidir.

question_text:
Art Exhibition
Date: 20 October
Time: 13:00 – 17:00
Place: City Art Gallery
Fee: Free for students

According to the poster, the exhibition is _____.
explanation: Sergi 13:00 ile 17:00 saatleri arasında, yani öğleden sonra (in the afternoon) yapılacaktır ve öğrenciler için ücretsizdir.

question_text:
Caner: _____ we go to the amusement park this Saturday?
Tolga: Sounds fun! Let's go.
explanation: Teklif cümlelerinde 'we' öznesiyle 'Shall we...?' kalıbı kullanılır.

question_text: Pınar is very _____. She always buys nice gifts for her friends and shares her things.
explanation: Arkadaşlarına güzel hediyeler alan ve eşyalarını paylaşan kişi 'generous' (cömert) olarak tanımlanır.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Ege: Hi, Mert! Are you busy tonight?
Mert: No, why?
Ege: I'm having a barbecue party in our garden. Would you like to come?
Mert: Sure! What time does it start?
Ege: At 6 p.m.

Where is the party?
explanation: Ege diyalogda 'I'm having a barbecue party in our garden' diyerek partinin kendi bahçelerinde olduğunu belirtmiştir.

question_text: I always _____ my best friend, Burcu. I know she will never let me down.
explanation: 'Count on' güvenmek anlamındadır. 'Beni asla yarı yolda bırakmayacağını biliyorum' cümlesi güveni ifade eder.

question_text:
Nehir: How about watching a comedy film at my place?
İrem: _____ I need a good laugh.
explanation: İrem gülmeye ihtiyacı olduğunu söylediği için komedi filmi izleme teklifini kabul eden seçeneği işaretlemelidir.

question_text:
Read the note:
'Dear Elif, I'm sorry I missed your graduation party yesterday. I had a terrible headache. Can we meet for coffee tomorrow? – Damla'

Why is Damla writing this note?
option_b: To invite Elif to a graduation party
option_c: To ask for help with her homework
option_d: To apologize for not coming and suggest meeting
explanation: Damla, mezuniyet partisine gelemediği için özür dilemekte ve yarın kahve içmek için buluşmayı önermektedir.

question_text: A good friend should be _____ and always tell the truth.
explanation: Her zaman doğruyu söyleyen kişi dürüsttür (honest).

question_text:
Waiter: _____
Customer: I'd like a cup of Turkish coffee, please.
option_a: What would you like to drink?
option_b: Are you coming to the party?
explanation: Müşteri bir fincan Türk kahvesi istediğini söylediğine göre garson içecek olarak ne istediğini sormuş olmalıdır.

question_text:
Look at the chat:
Aslı: Hey girls! Let's go shopping on Friday.
Buse: I'd love to, I need new sneakers.
Ceren: My cousin is coming on Friday, sorry.
Derya: Count me in!

Who refuses Aslı's invitation?
explanation: Ceren cuma günü kuzeninin geleceğini söyleyerek özür dilemiş ve daveti reddetmiştir.

question_text: Hakan and I have many things _____. We both love playing chess and listening to rock music.
explanation: 'Have things in common' ortak yönleri/ilgi alanları olmak demektir.

question_text:
Kuzey: Would you like to join our basketball tournament?
Bora: _____ I twisted my ankle yesterday.
explanation: Bora dün ayak bileğini burktuğunu söylediği için turnuvaya katılamaz ve daveti reddetmelidir.

question_text:
Read the invitation card:
'Hi! I'm turning 14 next Saturday. Come and celebrate with me at Moonlight Bowling Club at 3 p.m. Please text me if you can't make it. – Tarık'

Which of the following is CORRECT according to the card?
option_a: Guests should inform Tarık if they can't attend.
option_b: Tarık is inviting his friends to a dinner.
option_c: The event starts in the morning.
option_d: The party will be at Tarık's house.
explanation: Kartta 'Please text me if you can't make it' ifadesiyle gelemeyecek olanların Tarık'a mesaj atması istenmektedir. Diğer seçenekler yanlıştır (yer bovling kulübü, saat öğleden sonra 3).

question_text:
Read the comments about Leyla:
Eda: She always listens to my problems.
Mina: She never shares my secrets.
Sıla: She sometimes forgets her promises.
Kaya: She helps everyone in class.

Who says something NEGATIVE about Leyla?
explanation: Sıla, Leyla'nın bazen verdiği sözleri unuttuğunu (forgets her promises) söyleyerek olumsuz bir yorum yapmıştır.

question_text:
E-mail from Can to Murat:
'Hey Murat, our school is organizing a science fair on Thursday. I know you are keen on robotics. Shall we go together at 2 p.m.? Let me know soon.'

Why does Can invite Murat to the science fair?
option_a: Because Murat is interested in robotics.
option_c: Because Can doesn't want to go alone on Sunday.
option_d: Because Murat is organizing the fair.
explanation: Can e-postasında 'I know you are keen on robotics' diyerek Murat'ın robotiğe meraklı olduğu için onu davet ettiğini belirtmektedir.

question_text:
Alper: Are you free on Sunday evening?
Sinan: _____
Alper: We are going to a jazz concert. Do you want to join us?
Sinan: I'm sorry, I don't like jazz music.
option_a: No, I have to visit my uncle.
option_b: Yes, I have no plans. Why?
explanation: Alper'in davet yapabilmesi için Sinan'ın önce müsait olduğunu söyleyip nedenini sorması gerekir. Sonrasında ise Sinan sevmediği için reddeder.

question_text:
Look at the table about four friends' weekend plans:
NameSaturdaySunday
UmutSoccer matchVisit grandparents
KaanFreeStudy math
EmirGuitar courseFree
TahaFreeFree

Mert wants to go to the cinema on Saturday afternoon with one of them. Who CANNOT join him?
explanation: Tabloya göre Cumartesi günü Umut'un futbol maçı, Emir'in ise gitar kursu vardır. Bu yüzden ikisi de Cumartesi günü sinemaya gidemez.

question_text:
Waiter: Welcome! Are you ready to order?
Ela: Yes. Can I have grilled salmon with salad?
Waiter: Sure. Anything to drink?
Ela: Just a bottle of water, please.
Waiter: _____
Ela: No, thank you. That's all.

Which question completes the dialogue?
option_a: Where would you like to sit?
explanation: Ela ana yemek ve içecek siparişini verdikten sonra 'Hayır, teşekkürler. Hepsi bu kadar.' dediğine göre garson tatlı isteyip istemediğini sormuştur.

question_text: My brother is very _____. He doesn't care about other people's feelings and only thinks about himself.
explanation: Başkalarının duygularını önemsemeyen ve sadece kendini düşünen kişi bencil/benmerkezci (self-centered) biridir.

question_text:
Class 8A Survey: What is the most important quality of a true friend?
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "True Friend Qualities" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "45%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Honest" size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 76.7 P d1 119.9 76.7 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 70.7 "30%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Supportive" size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 123.3 P d2 188.4 123.3 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 117.3 "15%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Generous" size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 138.9 P d3 256.9 138.9 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 132.9 "10%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Funny" size=10 ```
Which statement is TRUE according to the chart?
option_a: Most students think a true friend shouldn't tell lies.
option_b: Being funny is more important than being generous.
option_c: Supporting friends is the least popular answer.
explanation: Grafiğe göre %45 ile en yüksek oran 'Honest' (dürüst) seçeneğindedir; yani öğrencilerin çoğu gerçek bir arkadaşın yalan söylememesi gerektiğini düşünmektedir.

question_text:
WhatsApp Group: 'Bookworms'
Nisa: Shall we meet at the library tomorrow at 4 p.m.?
Eylül: I'd love to, but I have a piano lesson at 4.
Zehra: What about 5:30 p.m. then?
Eylül: That works for me!
Nisa: Okay, 5:30 p.m. at the library!

Why do they change the meeting time?
option_a: Because Nisa has a piano lesson.
option_b: Because Zehra doesn't want to go to the library.
option_c: Because the library is closed at 4 p.m.
option_d: Because Eylül isn't available at 4 p.m.
explanation: Eylül saat 4'te piyano dersi olduğu için buluşma saatini 5:30'a almışlardır.

question_text: I think Barış is a _____ person. Whenever I call him for help, he drops everything and comes to me.
explanation: Yardım için arandığında her şeyi bırakıp gelen kişi güvenilir/dayanılacak (dependable) biridir.

question_text:
Read the invitation:
'Summer Camp Reunion! Meet your old camp friends on July 12 at Pine Forest Park. Barbecue starts at 12:30. Bring a guitar if you play one! Contact: 555-0192 (Doruk)'

If you want to learn more details about the reunion, you should _____.
option_b: bring a tent to the park
option_c: go to the park in the evening
explanation: Davetiyede iletişim bilgisi olarak 'Contact: 555-0192 (Doruk)' verilmiştir; ayrıntılar için Doruk aranmalıdır.

question_text:
Öykü: I'm throwing a surprise party for Pelin on Friday. _____
Sena: Of course! I can prepare the playlist and bring some balloons.
option_b: Can you help me organize it?
option_c: Where did you buy the cake?
explanation: Sena şarkı listesini hazırlayıp balon getirebileceğini söylediğine göre Öykü partiyi organize etmek için yardım istemiştir.

question_text:
Customer: Excuse me, this soup is completely cold.
Waiter: Oh, I'm terribly sorry about that, madam. _____
Customer: Thank you.

Choose the best option to complete the dialogue.
option_a: Would you like to pay the bill?
option_b: It is our special cold soup.
option_d: I'll bring you a hot one right away.
explanation: Müşteri çorbanın soğuk olduğunu söylediğinde kibar bir garson özür dileyip hemen sıcak bir çorba getireceğini söylemelidir.

question_text: Which pair of words are SYNONYMS (have similar meanings)?
explanation: 'Buddy' ve 'Mate' kelimelerinin ikisi de arkadaş/dost anlamında eş anlamlıdır. Diğer çiftler zıt anlamlıdır.

question_text:
İdil's Diary:
'Today I had an argument with my best friend, Beste. I feel really bad because she always backs me up. I should apologize to her tomorrow and buy her favorite coffee.'

How does İdil feel now?
explanation: İdil en yakın arkadaşıyla tartıştığı için kendini çok kötü hissettiğini ve özür dilemesi gerektiğini yazmıştır; yani pişman ve üzgündür (regretful and sad).

question_text: Poyraz is really _____ because he never worries about anything and stays calm even in difficult situations.
explanation: Hiçbir şey için endişelenmeyen ve zor durumlarda bile sakin kalan kişi rahat/kaygısız (laid-back) biridir.

question_text:
Look at the table of four friends' food preferences:
NameLikesDislikes
ErenPasta, ChickenFish, Soup
BatuFish, SaladPasta, Dessert
MertMeatballs, SoupSalad, Fish
KaanPizza, Ice CreamMeatballs, Soup

Which two friends can eat the same main dish together without any problem?
option_d: Eren and Kaan (Pizza or Chicken is okay? Let's check: neither dislikes Chicken/Pizza!)
explanation: Tabloya göre Batu makarna sevmez (Eren-Batu olmaz), Mert balık sevmez (Batu-Mert olmaz), Kaan köfte sevmez (Mert-Kaan olmaz). Eren ve Kaan ise tavuk ya da pizza konusunda çakışma yaşamaz.

question_text:
Can: I'm going to a rock concert with my cousin tonight. Would you like to come with us?
Tarik: _____ Can you pick me up at 7:30?
option_a: Sorry, I can't stand rock music.
option_b: I'm afraid I have an exam.
explanation: Tarık 'Beni 7:30'da alabilir misin?' diye sorduğuna göre daveti kabul etmiştir.

question_text:
Poster:
'TEEN BOOK CLUB MEETING'
We are discussing 'The Little Prince' this Wednesday at 16:30 in Room 204. Free tea and cookies! Everyone in 7th and 8th grades is welcome.

Who CANNOT join this meeting?
option_b: A 7th grade student who likes tea
explanation: Afişte yalnızca 7. ve 8. sınıf öğrencilerinin davetli olduğu belirtilmiştir; bu yüzden 5. sınıf öğrencisi katılamaz.

question_text: Always _____! If you arrive late to a meeting with friends, they might get upset.
explanation: Buluşmalara geç kalmamak için dakik olmak (be punctual) gerekir.

question_text:
Duygu: Hey, we're organizing a chess tournament on Sunday. Are you in?
Yaman: I'd love to, _____
Duygu: Oh, what a pity! Maybe next month.

Which one completes Yaman's excuse?
option_a: and I'm sure I will win first prize.
option_b: so let's meet at the chess club.
option_c: because chess is my favorite board game.
option_d: but I have to take care of my little sister.
explanation: Duygu 'Ne yazık! Belki gelecek ay' dediğine göre Yaman daveti reddetmiş ve geçerli bir mazeret sunmuştur.

question_text:
Read the sentences:
I. Sure, what time shall we meet?
II. Are you doing anything on Saturday?
III. How about going to the skating rink?
IV. Nothing special. Why?

What is the CORRECT order of the dialogue?
explanation: Doğru akış: Cumartesi bir şey yapıyor musun? (II) -> Özel bir şey yok. Neden? (IV) -> Buz pateni pistine gitmeye ne dersin? (III) -> Elbette, saat kaçta buluşalım? (I).

question_text:
Ece's Note to Her Best Friend:
'You are like a sister to me. Even when everyone else leaves, I know you are always there for me.'

Which personality trait of her friend does Ece emphasize?
explanation: Ece, herkes gitse bile arkadaşının her zaman yanında olduğunu söyleyerek onun sadakatini (loyalty) vurgulamaktadır.

question_text:
Waiter: Would you like to have your steak with fries or mashed potatoes?
Guest: _____
option_d: I'd like a glass of cola.
explanation: Garson bifteğin yanında patates kızartması mı yoksa patates püresi mi istediğini sorduğunda müşteri ikisinden birini seçmelidir.

question_text:
Email:
'Subject: Weekend Trekking
Hi team, we are walking in Belgrad Forest on Sunday morning. Wear comfortable shoes and bring at least 1 liter of water. Meeting point: Main Gate at 8:30 a.m.'

Which item is NOT mentioned in the email?
explanation: E-postada rahat ayakkabılar, su ve buluşma saati (8:30 a.m.) geçmektedir; ancak fotoğraf makinesinden (camera) bahsedilmemiştir.

question_text: I don't get on well with Koray because he is _____. He always thinks he is better than everyone else.
explanation: Kendini herkesten üstün gören kişi kibirli (arrogant) biridir.

question_text:
Look at the invitation responses:
Ali: I'll definitely be there!
Veli: Sorry, I'm going out of town.
Can: That sounds awesome, count me in!
Efe: I'd love to, but I feel sick.

How many people ACCEPT the invitation?
explanation: Ali ('Kesinlikle orada olacağım') ve Can ('Kulağa harika geliyor, beni de say') daveti kabul etmiştir; toplam 2 kişi.

question_text:
Beren: Why don't we have a picnic by the river?
Sinem: _____ The weather forecast says it will rain all day.
option_b: I'm afraid that's not a good idea.
explanation: Hava durumu bütün gün yağmur yağacağını söylediği için nehir kenarında piknik yapmak iyi bir fikir değildir; teklif reddedilir.

question_text:
Survey: How do you usually celebrate your birthday?
ActivityNumber of Students
Party at home18
Dinner at a cafe12
Going to the cinema6
Outdoor picnic4

Which of the following is FALSE according to the survey?
option_a: Home parties are the most popular choice.
option_b: 40 students took part in the survey.
option_c: Cinema is less popular than a cafe dinner.
option_d: Students prefer picnics to eating at a cafe.
explanation: Tabloya göre kafede yemek 12, piknik 4 öğrenci tarafından seçilmiştir. Yani öğrenciler pikniği kafeye tercih etmezler; bu ifade yanlıştır.

question_text: Melike is very _____. She always tells jokes and makes everyone laugh when we feel down.
explanation: Şakalar yapan ve herkesi güldüren kişi eğlenceli/güldürücü (amusing) biridir.

question_text:
Read the text messages among four classmates:
Oğuz: Hey guys, I'm throwing a farewell party for Kerem on Saturday at 7 p.m. at Joy Cafe. Can you come?
Mert: I have basketball training until 6:30, so I'll be there around 7:15.
Berk: I promised my dad to help him wash the car on Saturday morning, so I'm free in the evening!
Tuna: My flight to Ankara is at 6 p.m. on Saturday. Give Kerem my best wishes!

Who will NOT attend Kerem's farewell party?
explanation: Mert antrenmandan sonra 7:15 gibi orada olacağını, Berk ise akşam müsait olduğunu söylemiştir. Tuna'nın ise saat 6'da Ankara uçağı olduğu için partiye katılamayacaktır.

question_text:
Read the description of four friends:
- Ada: Never tells lies and keeps secrets.
- Ece: Always arrives 15 minutes late.
- Nil: Doesn't share her snacks with anyone.
- Sude: Listens carefully and helps when you have a problem.

Duru wants to choose a partner for a trust-based school project. Who are the BEST two choices?
explanation: Güvene dayalı bir proje için yalan söylemeyen/sır tutan Ada ve yardımsever Sude en doğru seçimlerdir. Ece geç kalır, Nil paylaşımcı değildir.

question_text:
Customer: Good evening. Can we have a table for three near the window?
Waiter: Let me check. Yes, right this way, please. Here are your menus.
Customer: Thank you. What is the soup of the day?
Waiter: Cream of mushroom soup. Would you like to try it?
Customer: Two of us will have it, please. And for the main course, three grilled steaks.

Which statement is TRUE according to the dialogue?
option_a: There are no free tables near the window.
option_b: The waiter forgot to bring the menus.
option_c: One of the guests doesn't want soup.
option_d: All three guests ordered mushroom soup.
explanation: Üç kişilik masada müşteri 'Two of us will have it' (İkimiz çorba alacağız) demiştir; bu da bir kişinin çorba istemediğini gösterir.

question_text:
Look at the event flyer and answer:
ANNUAL SCIENCE & ART FESTIVAL
Date: May 18-19 (Saturday & Sunday)
Hours: 10:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m.
Tickets: 50 TL (Students: 25 TL)
Note: Workshop registration closes on May 15.

Selen wants to join the robotics workshop at the festival on May 18. Today is May 16. What is the problem?
option_a: The festival is only on weekdays.
option_b: The festival starts in the evening.
option_c: Tickets are not sold to students.
option_d: She missed the deadline for workshop registration.
explanation: Atölye kayıtları 15 Mayıs'ta kapanmıştır ve bugün 16 Mayıs'tır. Yani Selen kayıt son tarihini (deadline) kaçırmıştır.

question_text:
Read the e-mail:
'Dear Defne, Thanks for the invitation to your slumber party on Friday! I'd love to come, but my little brother has a high fever and my parents are out of town, so I need to stay with him. I promise I'll visit you on Sunday with your favorite cupcakes. Love, Yağmur.'

Which of the following is NOT mentioned in Yağmur's e-mail?
option_a: The exact time the slumber party starts
option_b: Why Yağmur can't attend the party
option_c: What Yağmur plans to do on Sunday
option_d: Who is sick in Yağmur's family
explanation: E-postada mazeret (kardeşinin ateşi var), pazar günü planı (cupcake ile ziyaret) ve hasta olan kişi geçmektedir; ancak pijama partisinin başlangıç saati yazmamaktadır.

question_text:
Survey Results: Why do 8th graders argue with their friends?
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Reasons for Arguments" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "40%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Gossip" size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 47.5 P d1 119.9 47.5 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 41.5 "35%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Lies" size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 117.5 P d2 188.4 117.5 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 111.5 "15%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Selfishness" size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 135.0 P d3 256.9 135.0 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 129.0 "10%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Being late" size=10 ```
According to the graph, which sentence is CORRECT?
option_a: Half of the students argue because of dishonesty.
option_b: Three-quarters of the arguments are caused by gossip and lies.
option_c: Selfishness is the main reason for arguments.
option_d: Being late is a bigger problem than selfishness.
explanation: Dedikodu (%40) ve yalan (%35) toplamda %75 eder, yani tartışmaların dörtte üçü (three-quarters) bu iki sebepten kaynaklanmaktadır.

question_text:
Four friends are talking about their weekend:
Emre: I hate crowded places, so I prefer quiet activities.
Cem: I love outdoor sports and nature.
Kaan: I'm crazy about board games and indoor fun.
Arda: I enjoy live music and energetic atmospheres.

Which activity is suitable for ALL of them? Wait—actually, they want to invite Cem and Emre to one activity. Which activity suits BOTH Emre and Cem?
option_a: Going to a loud rock concert
option_d: Playing chess in a crowded cafe
explanation: Emre sessiz yerleri sever, Cem ise doğa ve açık hava sporlarını sever. Sessiz bir göl kenarında balık tutmak (fishing by a quiet lake) ikisine de uygundur.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Aylin: We are planning a surprise picnic for Beste on Sunday. Are you in?
Buse: Sure, I'd love to help! What should I bring?
Aylin: _____
Buse: No problem. I'll make lemonade and bring some paper cups too.

Which sentence best fits the blank?
option_a: Can you buy a birthday cake from the bakery?
option_b: Why don't you bring your guitar?
option_d: Could you be responsible for the drinks?
explanation: Buse yanıtında limonata yapacağını ve karton bardak getireceğini söylediğine göre Aylin içeceklerden sorumlu olup olamayacağını sormuştur.

question_text:
Read the personality profiles:
1. Tolga: He never keeps promises and always talks behind his friends' backs.
2. Kerem: He gets angry very quickly when things don't go his way.
3. Baran: He supports his friends in hard times and never judges them.
4. Demir: He only calls his friends when he needs money or homework help.

If you are looking for a 'true friend' according to the unit's values, who should you choose?
explanation: Zor zamanlarda destek olan ve yargılamayan Baran gerçek arkadaş tanımına uyar. Diğerleri güvenilmez, öfkeli veya çıkarcıdır.

question_text:
Restaurant Bill & Order Check:
Ali ordered: Tomato Soup (40 TL) + Grilled Chicken (160 TL) + Water (15 TL).
Ece ordered: Salad (70 TL) + Pasta (130 TL) + Lemonade (45 TL).
They want to split the total bill equally.

How much will EACH of them pay?
explanation: Ali'nin siparişi 40+160+15 = 215 TL, Ece'nin siparişi 70+130+45 = 245 TL tutar. Toplam hesap 460 TL'dir. Eşit böldüklerinde kişi başı 230 TL öderler.

question_text:
Read the dialogue carefully:
Merve: Would you like to come to my painting exhibition on Thursday?
Selin: I'd love to, but I have to look after my grandfather.
Merve: Oh, I understand. Maybe we can meet on Friday afternoon instead?
Selin: Friday sounds great! Where shall we meet?

What can we infer from the dialogue?
option_a: Merve is angry with Selin for not coming to the exhibition.
option_b: They will go to the exhibition together on Friday.
option_c: Selin refuses Thursday's invitation but accepts Friday's plan.
option_d: Selin doesn't like painting exhibitions at all.
explanation: Selin Perşembe günkü daveti dedesine bakması gerektiği için reddeder, ancak Cuma öğleden sonra buluşma teklifini kabul eder.

question_text:
Invitation Card:
'GRADUATION PARTY! Join Class 8C on June 15 at 7:00 p.m. at Seaside Hotel. Dress code: Smart casual. R.S.V.P. by June 10 to Mrs. Demir.'

What does 'R.S.V.P. by June 10' mean for the students?
option_a: They should wear school uniforms to the hotel.
option_b: They cannot bring any friends after June 10.
option_c: They must buy their tickets on June 15.
option_d: They must inform Mrs. Demir if they will attend before June 11.
explanation: R.S.V.P. (Lütfen cevap veriniz) ifadesi, öğrencilerin 10 Haziran'a kadar (11 Haziran'dan önce) katılıp katılmayacaklarını Bayan Demir'e bildirmeleri gerektiğini anlatır.

question_text:
Look at the table showing four friends' excuses:
PersonInvitationExcuse
OnurCinemaDentist appointment
CanFootball matchSprained ankle
EfeBirthday partyOut of the city
AlpStudy groupToo tired

Which friend has a HEALTH-related excuse related to a sports injury?
explanation: Can'ın mazereti 'sprained ankle' (burkulmuş ayak bileği) bir spor yaralanması/sağlık sorunudur. Onur'un dişçi randevusu vardır ama yaralanma değildir.

question_text:
Chat History:
14:02 – Yiğit: Hey, anyone up for bowling at 5?
14:05 – Kuzey: I'm in! Should I book a lane?
14:08 – Bora: Wait for me, my bus arrives at 5:15.
14:10 – Yiğit: Okay, let's make it 5:30 then.

At what time will they probably start playing bowling?
explanation: Bora'nın otobüsü 5:15'te geleceği için Yiğit saati 5:30 olarak güncellemiştir.

question_text: Which sentence is grammatically and contextually INCORRECT?
option_a: How about going to the theatre tonight?
option_b: I'm sorry, I can't make it because I'm ill.
option_c: I'd love to come, so I have to finish my project.
option_d: Would you like some apple juice?
explanation: 'Gelmeyi çok isterim, bu yüzden projemi bitirmeliyim' cümlesinde bağlaç hatası vardır; zıtlık olduğu için 'so' yerine 'but' kullanılmalıdır.

question_text:
Read the paragraph:
'Nehir and I have been best friends since primary school. We don't always agree on everything—she loves horror movies while I prefer comedies. However, we respect each other's choices and always support one another.'

What is the main idea of the paragraph?
option_a: Best friends must always like the same movies.
option_b: They became friends in high school.
option_c: Nehir and the writer often argue about movies.
option_d: Different tastes don't stop them from being great friends.
explanation: Paragrafta farklı zevklere sahip olsalar da birbirlerinin tercihlerine saygı duydukları ve birbirlerini destekledikleri vurgulanmaktadır.

question_text:
Waiter: Welcome to Olive Bistro. What would you like to have?
Doruk: I'd like lentil soup and chicken curry.
Waiter: I'm sorry, we ran out of chicken curry. Would you like grilled meatballs instead?
Doruk: Sure, that's fine. And a glass of ayran, please.

Why doesn't Doruk eat chicken curry?
option_a: There is no chicken curry left at the restaurant.
option_b: The waiter forgot to write down chicken curry.
explanation: Garson 'we ran out of chicken curry' (tavuk körimiz tükendi) dediği için Doruk köfte tercih etmiştir.

question_text:
Class 8D Friendship Survey (40 students):
- 16 students say 'Always tells the truth'
