- 12 students say 'Never leaves you alone in bad times'
- 8 students say 'Has a good sense of humor'
- 4 students say 'Shares everything'

Which statement is TRUE?
option_a: Sharing everything is more popular than humor.
option_b: More than half of the students value honesty and support most.
option_c: Sense of humor is the least important quality.
option_d: Only 10 students chose 'Always tells the truth'.
explanation: Dürüstlük (16) ve destek (12) toplam 28 öğrenci eder; 40 öğrencinin yarısından (20'den) fazlası bu iki değeri en çok önemsemektedir.

question_text:
Note from Teacher:
'Dear 8th graders, our end-of-year picnic is postponed from May 20 to May 27 due to heavy rain forecast. All other details (10:00 a.m. at Oak Park) remain the same.'

What changed about the picnic?
explanation: Notta ağır yağmur tahmini nedeniyle pikniğin 20 Mayıs'tan 27 Mayıs'a ertelendiği, diğer tüm detayların (saat ve yer) aynı kaldığı belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
Pelin: Do you think Kerem is a good buddy?
Sarp: Well, he is funny and generous, _____ he sometimes reveals my secrets to others, which really upsets me.
explanation: Cümlenin ilk yarısında olumlu özellikler (komik ve cömert), ikinci yarısında ise olumsuz bir durum (sırları başkasına söylemesi) verildiği için zıtlık bağlacı 'but' gerekir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Ege: Hi, Mert! Are you doing anything on Saturday morning?
Mert: Nothing much. Why?
Ege: My cousin and I are going fishing. Would you like to join us?
Mert: Oh, I'd love to, but I'm allergic to fish!Wait, I don't have to eat it, right? Just catching them?
Ege: Haha, yes! We release them back into the lake anyway.
Mert: Awesome, then count me in!

Why does Mert change his mind and accept?
option_a: Because they won't eat the fish; they'll release them.
option_b: Because they are going on Sunday instead.
option_c: Because he took his allergy medicine.
explanation: Mert balığa alerjisi olduğunu söyler ancak balıkları yemeyip göle geri bırakacaklarını öğrenince fikrini değiştirip kabul eder.

question_text:
Read the four invitations and find the ODD one out based on the event type:
1. Come to my 14th birthday bash!
2. Join our neighborhood clean-up day!
3. Let's celebrate my sister's graduation!
4. Welcome to our New Year's Eve party!

Which invitation is NOT a celebration?
explanation: 1 (doğum günü), 3 (mezuniyet) ve 4 (yılbaşı) birer kutlamadır; 2 numaralı davetiye ise mahalle temizlik günüdür, kutlama değildir.

question_text:
Menu Decision:
Deniz has 150 TL. She wants one starter, one main course, and one drink.
Starters: Soup (35 TL), Salad (45 TL)
Main: Pasta (85 TL), Burger (100 TL)
Drinks: Water (15 TL), Soda (25 TL)

Which combination can Deniz afford?
explanation: Çorba (35) + Makarna (85) + Soda (25) = 145 TL eder ve 150 TL bütçeye sığar. Diğer kombinasyonlar 155-160 TL tutar.

question_text: Which response is an example of 'Accepting with a condition'?
option_a: I'm sorry, I have a terrible toothache.
option_b: Sure, I'll definitely be there at 8.
option_c: No way! I hate crowded parties.
option_d: I'd love to come, if my dad lets me.
explanation: 'Babam izin verirse gelmeyi çok isterim' ifadesi bir şarta bağlı kabul etmedir (accepting with a condition).

question_text:
Text Message:
'Hey Tuna, sorry I couldn't answer your call earlier. I was at the library and my phone was on silent. About the movie tonight: I've already seen it, so how about trying the new escape room instead? – Emir'

What does Emir suggest?
option_b: Going to an escape room instead of the cinema
option_c: Watching the same movie together tonight
explanation: Emir filmi zaten izlediğini söyleyerek bunun yerine yeni kaçış odasına (escape room) gitmeyi önermektedir.

question_text:
Table: Friends' Availability
TimeEceDilaSu
Friday 4 p.m.BusyFreeFree
Saturday 2 p.m.FreeFreeBusy
Sunday 11 a.m.FreeFreeFree
Sunday 5 p.m.BusyFreeFree

When can ALL THREE friends meet together?
explanation: Tabloya göre üç arkadaşın da aynı anda müsait (Free) olduğu tek zaman Pazar sabahı saat 11:00'dir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Burak: What do you think of our new classmate, Can?
Kaan: Actually, I don't trust him. He told me a secret about Ozan yesterday, and today he was super nice to Ozan's face.
Burak: Oh, really? That's not cool.

What personality trait does Can show according to Kaan?
explanation: Başkasının sırrını yayıp yüzüne karşı iyi davranan kişi sinsi ve güvenilmezdir (sneaky and unreliable).

question_text:
E-mail:
'Hi Nil, I'm organizing a charity bake sale at school on Wednesday. All the money will go to the animal shelter. Would you like to bake some brownies for the stand? Let me know by Monday evening. – Zeynep'

Which question CANNOT be answered from the e-mail?
option_a: What is the purpose of the event?
option_d: How much will the brownies cost?
explanation: E-postada etkinliğin amacı (hayvan barınağına yardım), günü (Çarşamba) ve cevap son tarihi (Pazartesi akşamı) bellidir; ancak brownielerin fiyatı yazmamaktadır.

question_text:
Choose the best response to keep the conversation going positively:
Friend: I'm feeling really nervous about tomorrow's math exam.
You: _____
option_a: Why didn't you study earlier? It's your fault.
option_b: Don't worry, you studied hard. I believe in you!
option_c: Well, math is super difficult, you'll probably fail.
option_d: I don't care about exams, let's play games.
explanation: İyi bir arkadaş sınav öncesi gergin olan arkadaşını cesaretlendirip desteklemelidir.

question_text:
Poster:
'YOUTH THEATRE FESTIVAL'
Plays: 'Hamlet' (Friday 6 p.m.) & 'The Miser' (Saturday 7 p.m.)
Note: No late entry after the play starts. Bring your student ID for a 50% discount!

Which rule must visitors obey?
option_a: They must arrive before the play begins.
option_c: They must buy tickets only on Friday.
explanation: Afişte 'No late entry after the play starts' (Oyun başladıktan sonra geç giriş yoktur) uyarısı vardır; yani ziyaretçiler oyun başlamadan önce gelmelidir.

question_text:
Arda: What kind of music do you like listening to?
Batu: I'm _____ on rock music. I listen to it every day.
explanation: 'Be keen on' bir şeye çok meraklı/düşkün olmak anlamına gelen kalıptır.

question_text: I _____ pop music to heavy metal because pop music is more energetic and fun.
explanation: 'Prefer A to B' kalıbı 'A'yı B'ye tercih etmek' anlamında kullanılır.

question_text:
Ece: _____ do you go to the swimming pool?
Duru: Twice a week, on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
explanation: Yanıt 'haftada iki kez' (Twice a week) sıklık bildirdiği için soru 'How often' (Ne sıklıkla) olmalıdır.

question_text: I think classical music is _____. It makes me feel sleepy, so I never listen to it.
explanation: Kişiyi uykulu yapan ve hiç dinlemediği bir müzik türü olumsuz bir sıfatla (unbearable: katlanılmaz) tanımlanır.

question_text:
Mert's Daily Routine:
07:30 – Wake up and have breakfast
08:15 – Go to school
15:30 – Come home and rest
17:00 – Do homework

What does Mert do at half past three in the afternoon?
explanation: Saat 15:30 (half past three in the afternoon) programında 'Come home and rest' yazmaktadır.

question_text: My sister is fond of reading _____ books because she loves learning about famous people's lives.
explanation: Ünlü kişilerin hayatlarını anlatan kitap türü biyografidir (biographical).

question_text:
Can: Do you enjoy going camping in the mountains?
Kaan: Yes, I love it! _____ a tent and sleeping under the stars is amazing.
explanation: 'Pitch a tent' çadır kurmak anlamına gelen kalıptır.

question_text: Selin _____ eats fast food. She prefers healthy home-cooked meals every day.
explanation: Her gün sağlıklı ev yemekleri yiyen biri asla (never) fast food yemez.

question_text:
Note on the Fridge:
'Hi Emir, don't forget your guitar course at 4:00 p.m. Take your backpack and compass for tomorrow's trekking club too. – Mom'

What time is Emir's guitar course?
explanation: Notta gitar kursunun saat 4:00 p.m.'de olduğu açıkça belirtilmiştir.

question_text: I _____ horror movies. They are too scary for me, so I never watch them.
explanation: Çok korkutucu olduğu için hiç izlemediği film türünden nefret eder/katlanamaz (can't stand).

question_text: Before going on a camping trip, you should pack a _____ to see in the dark at night.
explanation: Gece karanlıkta görebilmek için el feneri (torch) almak gerekir.

question_text:
Look at Deniz's free-time activities:
DayActivity
MondayBasketball training
WednesdayChess club
FridayBasketball training
SaturdayCycling in the park

How often does Deniz have basketball training?
explanation: Tabloda Pazartesi ve Cuma olmak üzere haftada iki kez (Twice a week) basketbol antrenmanı vardır.

question_text:
Yusuf: What do you think about rap music?
Ozan: To me, it is _____. I love its rhythm and lyrics.
explanation: Ritmini ve sözlerini seven Ozan için rap müziği etkileyicidir (impressive).

question_text: Nehir always wears _____ clothes because she follows the latest fashion.
explanation: En son modayı takip eden kişi modaya uygun/trend (trendy) kıyafetler giyer.

question_text:
Burak: _____
Tuna: I usually read a book or listen to music before I go to bed.
option_a: How many books do you have?
option_b: Where do you go on holiday?
option_d: What do you do in the evenings?
explanation: Tuna yatmadan önce kitap okuduğunu veya müzik dinlediğini söylediğine göre soru akşamları ne yaptığıyla ilgilidir.

question_text: On weekends, my family and I love _____ in the forest to breathe fresh air and walk in nature.
explanation: Ormanda temiz hava alıp doğada yürüyüş yapmak 'trekking' (doğa yürüyüşü) etkinliğidir.

question_text: Which book genre is about space travel, robots, and the future?
explanation: Uzay yolculuğu, robotlar ve geleceği konu alan kitap türü bilim kurgudur (Science fiction).

question_text:
Aslı: Do you like playing chess?
Beren: No, I don't. I think it is _____.
explanation: Satranç oynamayı sevmeyen Beren, bunun sıkıcı (boring) olduğunu düşünmektedir.

question_text:
Read the text:
'Hi, I'm Kerem. I'm 14 years old. On weekdays, I wake up at 7 a.m., have a quick breakfast, and take the school bus. After school, I attend the robotics club.'

How does Kerem go to school?
explanation: Metinde 'take the school bus' ifadesiyle okul servisine bindiği belirtilmiştir.

question_text: My brother is crazy _____ skateboarding. He practices at the skatepark every afternoon.
explanation: 'Be crazy about' bir şeye bayılmak/çok sevmek anlamına gelen kalıptır.

question_text: Which item do you need for a camping trip?
explanation: Kamp gezisi için uyku tulumu (sleeping bag) gereklidir.

explanation: Köpeği yürüyüşe çıkarmak için 'take my dog for a walk' ifadesi kullanılır.

question_text: I think detective novels are _____. You never know who the guilty person is until the very last page!
explanation: Son sayfaya kadar suçlunun kim olduğunu bilmediğiniz polisiye romanlar heyecan vericidir (thrilling).

explanation: Mesajda 'buy a new fantasy novel' ifadesi yer almaktadır.

option_b: Not really, she finds it boring.

explanation: Her ay canlı konsere gittiğine göre konserlere gitmeyi çok sevmektedir.

question_text: In my free time, I enjoy _____ with my friends at the shopping mall or a cozy cafe.
explanation: Arkadaşlarla dışarıda vakit geçirmek/takılmak 'hang out' fiiliyle ifade edilir.

NameRead BooksPlay Video GamesDo Sports

explanation: E-postada 8 km yürümek, piknik yapmak ve doğa fotoğrafı çekmek geçmektedir; gölde yüzmekten bahsedilmemiştir.

How many days a week does Leyla practice the violin?
explanation: Pazartesi, Çarşamba ve Cuma olmak üzere haftada üç gün (Three days a week) pratik yapmaktadır.

option_a: Reading comics before bed is so relaxing.
option_b: I think heavy metal is loud and unbearable.
option_c: I'm really into photography and painting.
option_d: I'm crazy about playing table tennis.
explanation: 'Ağır metal müziğin gürültülü ve katlanılmaz olduğunu düşünüyorum' cümlesi hoşlanmamayı (dislike) ifade eder.

question_text:

- Tent ✓
- Sleeping bag ✓
- Pocketknife ✓
- First-aid kit ✘
- Torch ✓

What is MISSING from the camping checklist?
explanation: Listede ilk yardım çantasının (First-aid kit) yanında çarpı işareti vardır, yani o eksiktir.

Doruk: _____
Selin: I usually wake up at 7:15 a.m., brush my teeth, and get dressed.
option_a: Who wakes you up in the morning?
option_b: What time do you go to bed?
option_c: Do you like going to school?
explanation: Selin sabah uyanma, diş fırçalama ve giyinme sırasını anlattığı için soru sabah rutiniyle ilgilidir.

question_text:
Blog Post by Ceren:
'Some teens spend hours on social media, but I'm different. I prefer spending time outdoors. Every Sunday, I ride my bike for two hours along the coast and then read my book under a tree.'

Which activity does Ceren NOT mention doing on Sundays?
explanation: Ceren Pazar günleri bisiklete binip ağaç altında kitap okuduğunu anlatır; internette gezinmekten (surfing the Internet) bahsetmez.

question_text: My cousin lives in London, and we _____ once a month on video call to catch up.
explanation: Görüntülü aramada ayda bir kez sohbet etmek (chat) anlamlıdır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Emir: Shall we go to the rock concert on Saturday?
Mina: Sorry, I don't like rock music. How about a classical music concert?
Emir: Actually, classical music is too slow for me. Let's go to the cinema instead!
Mina: Great idea!

option_b: Go to a classical music concert
option_d: Stay at home and listen to music
explanation: Müzik zevkleri uyuşmayınca bunun yerine sinemaya gitmeye (Go to the cinema) karar verirler.

question_text: Choose the ODD one out:
explanation: Jazz, Classical ve Hip-hop müzik türleridir; Compass (pusula) ise bir kamp ekipmanıdır.

'Title: The Lost Island
Author: J. K. Stone
Pages: 240
Comment: Full of mysteries and exciting adventures. I couldn't put it down!'

What does 'I couldn't put it down!' mean?
option_a: The book was very interesting and exciting.
option_b: I lost the book before finishing it.
option_c: The book was boring, so I stopped reading.
option_d: The book was too heavy to carry.
explanation: 'I couldn't put it down' (Elimden bırakamadım) deyimi kitabın çok sürükleyici ve ilgi çekici olduğunu ifade eder.

question_text:
Tuna: Do you like wearing casual clothes or formal clothes?
Yaman: I prefer casual clothes because they are more _____.
explanation: Günlük (casual) kıyafetler daha rahat (comfortable) olduğu için tercih edilir.

question_text:

ActivityHours per day

Homework2 hours
Sports1.5 hours
Free time / Gaming1 hour

Which statement is TRUE?
option_a: Ali plays games for two hours a day.
option_b: Ali spends the most time doing sports.
option_c: Ali spends more time on homework than on gaming.
option_d: Ali goes to school for 8 hours a day.
explanation: Tabloya göre Ali ödeve 2 saat, oyuna 1 saat ayırmaktadır. Yani ödeve oyundan daha fazla zaman ayırır.

question_text: Before you go to a concert, you should book your _____ online so you don't wait in a long line.
explanation: Konsere gitmeden önce uzun kuyrukta beklememek için bilet (tickets) ayırtmak gerekir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Teacher: What do you do to keep fit, Ece?
Ece: I go jogging every morning before school, and I never eat junk food.

Why does Ece go jogging every morning?
explanation: Öğretmen formda kalmak (keep fit) için ne yaptığını sorduğunda Ece her sabah koşuya çıktığını söyler.

question_text: My grandfather thinks today's pop music is _____, so he only listens to Turkish folk music.
explanation: Sadece halk müziği dinleyen büyükbaba bugünün pop müziğini saçma/gülünç (ridiculous) bulmaktadır.

question_text:
Weekend Camp Schedule:
Saturday 09:00 – Arrive & set up tents
Saturday 14:00 – Forest walk
Saturday 20:00 – Campfire & guitar songs
Sunday 10:00 – Breakfast & pack up

When will the campers sing songs around the fire?
explanation: Kamp ateşi ve gitar şarkıları Cumartesi saat 20:00'de, yani Cumartesi akşamı (Saturday evening) yapılacaktır.

question_text: Which question is about FREQUENCY?
option_a: Who do you go to the gym with?
option_b: What time does the movie start?
option_c: What kind of books do you read?
option_d: How often do you visit your grandparents?
explanation: 'How often' (Ne sıklıkla) sorusu sıklık sorar.

question_text:
Read the speech bubbles:
Alp: I love learning about past events and ancient civilizations.
Buse: I enjoy reading books about magic and imaginary worlds.

Which books should Alp and Buse buy?
option_a: Alp: History book / Buse: Fantasy book
option_b: Alp: Travel guide / Buse: History book
explanation: Alp geçmiş olayları ve antik medeniyetleri sevdiği için tarih (History), Buse ise sihir ve hayali dünyaları sevdiği için fantastik (Fantasy) kitap almalıdır.

question_text: I always _____ my backpack the night before school so I don't forget any books in the morning.
explanation: Sırt çantasını hazırlamak/toplamak için 'pack' fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Text:
'Barış is a real bookworm. He finishes at least two novels every week. However, he rarely watches TV because he thinks TV shows are a waste of time.'

What does Barış think about TV shows?
explanation: Barış TV programlarının zaman kaybı (waste of time) olduğunu düşündüğü için onları faydalı bulmamaktadır (not useful).

question_text:
Pelin: Do you prefer listening to music with headphones or speakers?
Defne: _____ I don't want to disturb anyone.
explanation: Kimseyi rahatsız etmek istemeyen Defne kulaklıkla (with headphones) dinlemeyi tercih eder.

question_text:
Teen Life Interview:
Interviewer: What's your favorite after-school activity, Kaan?
Kaan: I attend a chess club on Tuesdays and Thursdays. I love planning strategies.

Why does Kaan like chess?
option_a: Because he enjoys making strategic plans.
option_b: Because it is an outdoor team sport.
option_c: Because he wants to become a singer.
option_d: Because he plays it every day.
explanation: Kaan 'I love planning strategies' diyerek strateji planlamaktan hoşlandığı için satrancı sevdiğini belirtmiştir.

question_text: In our English class, we _____ use dictionaries when we don't know a word.

question_text:

explanation: Duyuru enstrüman çalabilen veya şarkı söyleyebilen (müzik yeteneği olan) öğrencilere yöneliktir.

- Ece: I want to learn how to act on stage.
- Mert: I'm crazy about cameras and taking portraits.
- Sıla: I enjoy writing stories for the school magazine.

explanation: Sıla okul dergisi için hikâye yazmayı sevdiği için Edebiyat/Gazetecilik kulübüne gitmelidir; Spor Kulübü (Sports Club) yanlıştır.

question_text:
Read the survey about 100 teenagers' weekend habits:
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Weekend Habits (%)" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "42%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Hang out" size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 76.7 P d1 119.9 76.7 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 70.7 "28%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Sports" size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 110.0 P d2 188.4 110.0 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 104.0 "18%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Reading" size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 130.0 P d3 256.9 130.0 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 124.0 "12%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Cinema" size=10 ```
Which sentence CANNOT be concluded from the graph?
option_a: Teenagers never read books on weekdays.
option_b: More teens do sports than go to the cinema.
option_c: Hanging out with friends is the most common habit.
option_d: Less than one-fifth of the teens prefer reading.
explanation: Grafik yalnızca hafta sonu alışkanlıklarını göstermektedir; hafta içi kitap okuyup okumadıkları hakkında grafikten hiçbir sonuç çıkarılamaz.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Beren: I bought two tickets for the jazz festival on Sunday. Would you like to come?
Nil: Honestly, jazz isn't my cup of tea. I'd rather go to a pop concert.
Beren: Oh, okay. I'll ask Aslı then.

What does Nil mean by saying 'jazz isn't my cup of tea'?
option_a: She wants to drink tea at the festival.
option_b: She loves jazz more than pop.
explanation: 'Not my cup of tea' deyimi 'bana göre değil / sevdiğim bir şey değil' anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Read about Kerem's preferences:
'I prefer reading sci-fi books to detective books. I'm fond of playing basketball, and I go to training three times a week. I can't stand loud rock concerts, so I never go to them. On Sundays, I always go cycling with my dad.'

Which question does NOT have an answer in the text?
option_a: How often does Kerem train for basketball?
option_b: Why doesn't Kerem go to rock concerts?
option_c: Which book genre does Kerem like more?
option_d: What time does Kerem's basketball training start?
explanation: Metinde basketbol antrenmanının haftada 3 kez olduğu yazılıdır ama saat kaçta başladığı bilgisi yoktur.

question_text:
Table: Four Teens' Music Tastes
NameLovesHates
OzanRock, RapClassical
DilaPop, JazzRock
TunaClassical, JazzRap
EdaPop, RockJazz

Ozan and Dila want to listen to a music genre together, but they can't agree. Which genre do Tuna and Dila BOTH like?
explanation: Tabloya göre Dila 'Pop, Jazz' sever; Tuna ise 'Classical, Jazz' sever. İkisinin ortak sevdiği tür Jazz'dır.

question_text:
E-mail from Coach Demir:
'Hi team, our Saturday morning cycling tour is still on! Meet at Blue Lake at 8:00 a.m. Remember: No helmet, no ride! Bring a bottle of water and a light snack. See you!'

What is MANDATORY (a must) to join the tour?
option_c: Having a big breakfast at the lake
explanation: E-postada 'No helmet, no ride!' (Kask yoksa sürüş de yok!) ifadesiyle kask takmanın zorunlu olduğu vurgulanmıştır.

question_text: Which sentence has the SAME meaning as: 'I prefer camping to staying at a hotel.'?
option_a: I can't stand camping, so I stay at a hotel.
option_b: I hate both camping and hotels.
option_c: I would rather camp than stay at a hotel.
option_d: Staying at a hotel is better than camping.
explanation: 'Prefer A to B' ile 'would rather A than B' aynı tercih anlamını verir.

question_text:
Read the weekly schedule of Ada:
Monday: Piano lesson (16:00)
Tuesday: Free
Wednesday: Swimming (17:00)
Thursday: Piano lesson (16:00)
Friday: Book club (15:30)
Weekend: Family time

Ada's friend Melis wants to invite her to a movie on a weekday afternoon when Ada has NO club or lesson. Which day should Melis choose?
explanation: Hafta içi günler arasında Ada'nın hiçbir dersi veya kulübü olmayan tek gün Salı (Tuesday) günüdür.

question_text:
Text:
'In a recent study, 60% of teenagers said they listen to music while studying, 25% prefer complete silence, and 15% study with background TV noise. Most teachers recommend studying in a quiet room for better concentration.'

Which statement is CORRECT according to the text?
option_b: More than half of the teens listen to music while studying.
option_d: Teachers think watching TV helps concentration.
explanation: Gençlerin %60'ı (yarısından fazlası) ders çalışırken müzik dinlediğini söylemiştir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Emre: Hey, look at this new jacket! Is it cool?
Kaan: To be honest, it's a bit too bright for my taste. I prefer darker colors.
Emre: Oh, I see. I really like bright colors though.

What does Kaan think about the jacket?
option_a: He doesn't like its bright color.
option_b: He thinks dark colors are terrible.
option_c: He wants to buy the same jacket.
option_d: He finds the jacket very trendy.
explanation: Kaan ceketin kendi zevki için biraz fazla parlak olduğunu ve daha koyu renkleri tercih ettiğini söylemektedir.

question_text:
Compare two campers:
Yusuf: Brings a map, a compass, a first-aid kit, and checks the weather forecast.
Bora: Only packs snacks, a phone, and sneakers; doesn't check the weather.

Who is a MORE responsible camper, and why?
option_a: Bora, because sneakers are enough for mountains.
option_b: Both are equally prepared for emergencies.
option_c: Yusuf, because he prepares for safety and navigation.
option_d: Bora, because he travels light with snacks.
explanation: Yusuf harita, pusula, ilk yardım çantası alıp hava durumunu kontrol ettiği için güvenlik ve yön bulma konusunda daha sorumludur.

question_text:
Read the sentences and find the one that breaks the meaning:
(I) I'm very interested in astronomy. (II) I watch documentaries about planets every week. (III) I think space is boring and a waste of time. (IV) I hope to visit a space museum this summer.
explanation: I, II ve IV numaralı cümleler astronomiye olan ilgiyi anlatırken III numaralı cümle uzayın sıkıcı ve zaman kaybı olduğunu söyleyerek anlam bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır.

question_text:
Poster: YOUTH CAMP 2026
Activities: Canoeing, Archery, Campfire, Nature Art
Price: 800 TL (Includes meals and tent)
Dates: July 5–8
Note: Bring your own sleeping bag.

Which item do participants NOT need to bring or pay extra for?
explanation: Afişte 'Includes meals and tent' (Yemekler ve çadır dahildir) yazdığı için katılımcıların çadır ve yemek için ekstra ödeme yapmasına gerek yoktur.

question_text:
Teen Habit Comparison:
Habit1990s TeensToday's Teens
MusicCassette / CDStreaming apps
ReadingPrinted booksPrinted + E-books
CommunicationLandline phoneTexting / Video calls

What can we infer from the table?
option_a: Technology has changed how teens listen to music and communicate.
option_b: Today's teens never read printed books.
option_c: Teens today only use landline phones.
option_d: 1990s teens used streaming apps for music.
explanation: Tablo, teknolojinin gençlerin müzik dinleme (kasetten uygulamalara) ve iletişim kurma (sabit telefondan mesaj/görüntülü aramaya) şeklini değiştirdiğini göstermektedir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Selin: I'm bored. Let's do something fun!
Derya: How about playing a board game?
Selin: Not again! We played Monopoly yesterday. Let's go outside!
Derya: Okay, how about riding our bikes to the seaside?
Selin: Now you're talking! Let's grab our helmets.

What does 'Now you're talking!' mean?
explanation: 'Now you're talking!' ifadesi 'İşte şimdi güzel bir fikir söyledin / Harika fikir!' anlamında onaylama deyimidir.

question_text:
Read about three teens' Sunday mornings:
- Eren: Wakes up at 7 a.m., goes running, eats eggs and fruit.
- Mert: Wakes up at 11:30 a.m., plays video games for 4 hours, eats chips.
- Taha: Wakes up at 8 a.m., helps his dad in the garden, eats breakfast with family.

Which teenager has an UNHEALTHY Sunday routine?
explanation: Geç uyanıp 4 saat oyun oynayan ve cips yiyen Mert'in rutini sağlıksızdır.

question_text:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence:
'Although I am very keen on _____, I rarely have time for it because of my exam preparations.'
explanation: 'Be keen on' edatla (on) bittiği için ardından gelen fiil '-ing' takısı (gerund) alır: 'keen on painting'.

question_text:
Library Borrowing Record (Last Month):
Can: 4 detective books, 1 biography
Ece: 3 sci-fi books, 2 fantasy books
Nil: 1 history book, 0 novels

Which statement is TRUE?
option_a: Can and Ece borrowed the same total number of books.
option_b: Nil read more novels than Can.
option_c: Ece is not interested in imaginative stories.
option_d: Can borrowed more biographies than detective books.
explanation: Can toplam 4+1 = 5 kitap, Ece de toplam 3+2 = 5 kitap ödünç almıştır; yani toplam kitap sayıları eşittir.

question_text:
Read the note:
'Dear Diary, I tried ice skating for the first time today. At first, I fell down three times and felt embarrassed. However, my friend Burcu helped me stand up and encouraged me. By the end of the hour, I could skate without holding the wall!'

How did the writer's feelings change?
explanation: Başta düşüp utanmış (embarrassed) hissetse de saatin sonunda duvara tutunmadan kayabilmesi özgüvenli (confident) hissetmesini sağlamıştır.

question_text:
Survey: Why do teens prefer e-books or printed books?
E-books (35%): Easy to carry, cheaper.
Printed books (65%): Smell of paper, no eye strain, better focus.

According to the survey, why do MOST teens still choose printed books?
option_a: They are much cheaper than e-books.
option_c: They are lighter to carry in a backpack.
option_d: They are easier on the eyes and help them focus.
explanation: Gençlerin %65'i basılı kitapları kağıt kokusu, göz yormaması (no eye strain) ve daha iyi odaklanma (better focus) sağladığı için tercih etmektedir.

question_text: Which dialogue shows a DISAGREEMENT about music?
option_a: A: Rap has great rhythm. / B: I totally agree with you.
option_b: A: Jazz is so relaxing! / B: Really? I find it quite boring.
option_c: A: I love pop music! / B: Me too, it's awesome.
option_d: A: Rock concerts are exciting. / B: Yes, I'm crazy about them.
explanation: Bir kişi cazı rahatlatıcı bulurken diğerinin sıkıcı bulması fikir ayrılığını (disagreement) gösterir.

question_text:
Read the paragraph:
'Every Saturday, 14-year-old Bora volunteers at an animal shelter. He cleans the cages, feeds the dogs, and walks them in the yard. He says spending time with animals makes him forget all the stress of school.'

Why does Bora volunteer at the shelter?
option_a: Because it helps him relax and reduce stress.
option_b: Because he gets paid a lot of money.
option_c: Because he doesn't have any friends.
option_d: Because his school forces him to go.
explanation: Bora hayvanlarla vakit geçirmenin okul stresini unutturduğunu söylemektedir; yani rahatlamak ve stresi azaltmak için gönüllü olmaktadır.

question_text:
Event Comparison:
Event A: Outdoor Jazz Night – Saturday 8 p.m. – Free – Bring a blanket.
Event B: Indoor Book Swap – Sunday 2 p.m. – Free – Bring 2 old books.

Kaan hates cold evening air and loves reading. Which event should Kaan attend?
option_a: Event A, because he likes blankets.
option_c: Event B, because it is indoors and about books.
option_d: Event A, because it is free.
explanation: Kaan soğuk akşam havasından nefret ettiği ve okumayı sevdiği için kapalı alanda yapılan ücretsiz kitap takası etkinliği ona uygundur.

question_text:
Complete the sentence logically:
'Arda never goes to the gym; _____, he plays basketball in the school yard every afternoon to stay active.'
explanation: Spor salonuna hiç gitmemesi ile her öğleden sonra basketbol oynaması arasında zıtlık olduğu için 'however' (ancak/buna karşın) bağlacı kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Mom: Why are you still awake, Sinan? It's 11:30 p.m.!
Sinan: Sorry, Mom. I'm finishing the last chapter of my detective novel. I'll sleep in ten minutes.
Mom: Okay, don't stay up too late, you have an early class tomorrow.

What is Sinan doing at 11:30 p.m.?
option_b: Reading the end of a book
explanation: Sinan polisiye romanının son bölümünü (last chapter) bitirmektedir.

question_text:
Table: Teenagers' Monthly Allowance Spending
CategoryDenizTolga
Books & Magazines40%10%
Snacks & Drinks20%50%
Cinema & Concerts30%15%
Video Games10%25%

Which statement is TRUE?
option_a: Tolga spends half of his allowance on snacks and drinks.
option_b: Tolga spends more on cinema than Deniz.
option_c: Deniz spends more on video games than on books.
explanation: Tabloya göre Tolga harçlığının %50'sini (yarısını) atıştırmalık ve içeceklere harcamaktadır.

question_text:
Read the four teens' statements about camping:
1. 'Insects drive me crazy in the forest.'
2. 'Waking up to bird songs is priceless.'
3. 'Cooking over a campfire is super fun.'
4. 'Sleeping in a tent feels so peaceful.'

Who would probably refuse a camping invitation?
explanation: 1. konuşmacı ormandaki böceklerin kendisini çıldırttığını söylediği için kamp davetini muhtemelen reddedecektir.

question_text: Which sentence uses a frequency adverb in the WRONG position?
option_a: She is never late for her guitar lesson.
option_b: We usually have breakfast at 7:30 a.m.
option_c: They sometimes play chess after school.
option_d: I go always to the cinema on Fridays.
explanation: Sıklık zarfı 'always' ana fiilden ('go') önce gelmelidir: 'I always go...'. 'I go always' dil bilgisi açısından yanlıştır.

question_text:
Article Excerpt:
'Many teens think classical music is only for older people. However, studies show that listening to Mozart or Beethoven while doing homework can actually improve memory and reduce exam anxiety.'

What is the author's purpose in this excerpt?
option_a: To compare Mozart and modern pop singers
option_b: To show a surprising benefit of classical music for teens
option_c: To explain why classical music is boring
option_d: To criticize teenagers for doing homework
explanation: Yazar, klasik müziğin sadece yaşlılar için sanılmasına rağmen gençlerin hafızasını güçlendirip sınav kaygısını azaltabileceğini (şaşırtıcı bir faydasını) göstermeyi amaçlamaktadır.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Aslı: Did you enjoy the school trip to the botanical garden?
Defne: Yes, it was fascinating! Seeing hundreds of rare plants and taking photos was awesome. What about you?
Aslı: Well, I preferred the science museum we visited last month. Plants aren't really my thing.

What do Aslı and Defne disagree on?
option_a: How exciting the botanical garden trip was
option_c: Going on a trip next month
option_d: Whether they went to the science museum
explanation: Defne botanik bahçesi gezisini büyüleyici bulurken Aslı bitkilerin pek ilgisini çekmediğini ve bilim müzesini tercih ettiğini söyleyerek gezinin heyecanı konusunda farklı düşünmektedir.

question_text: You should _____ the potatoes before you fry them in hot oil.
explanation: Patatesleri kızartmadan önce soymak (peel) gerekir.

question_text: Which kitchen tool do you need to grate cheese or carrots?
explanation: Peynir veya havuç rendelemek için rende (grater) kullanılır.

question_text: Lemons taste very _____, so we usually add some sugar when making lemonade.
explanation: Limonun tadı ekşidir (sour).

question_text:
Ece: _____ do you usually cook chicken?
Mom: I usually roast it in the oven.
explanation: Anne fırında kızarttığını (pişirme yöntemini) söylediğine göre soru 'Nasıl pişirirsin?' (How) olmalıdır.

question_text:
Simple Omelette Recipe:
First, crack two eggs into a bowl.
Second, add a pinch of salt and whisk them.
Next, melt some butter in a pan.
Finally, pour the mixture into the pan and cook for 3 minutes.

What is the FIRST step of making an omelette?
option_b: Cracking two eggs into a bowl
explanation: Tarifte 'First, crack two eggs into a bowl' ifadesiyle ilk adımın yumurtaları kâseye kırmak olduğu belirtilmiştir.

question_text: After you boil the pasta for 10 minutes, use a _____ to drain the water.
explanation: Haşlanan makarnanın suyunu süzmek için süzgeç (strainer) kullanılır.

question_text: Which cooking method is the HEALTHIEST because it uses no oil?
explanation: Buharda pişirme (Steaming) hiç yağ kullanılmadığı için en sağlıklı pişirme yöntemidir.

question_text:
Waiter: Would you like some chili pepper on your soup?
Customer: No, thanks. I don't like _____ food.
explanation: Acı biber (chili pepper) istemeyen müşteri baharatlı/acılı (spicy) yemek sevmemektedir.

question_text:
Grocery List for Chocolate Cake:
- 3 eggs
- 1 glass of milk
- 200 g flour
- 150 g sugar
- 2 tablespoons of cocoa

Which ingredient is NOT on the list?
explanation: Listede yumurta, süt, un, şeker ve kakao vardır; tuz (Salt) listede yoktur.

question_text: Put the cake mixture into the _____ and bake it at 180°C for 35 minutes.
explanation: Kek karışımı fırına (oven) konur ve 180 derecede pişirilir.

question_text: To make a fresh salad, first _____ the tomatoes and cucumbers into small pieces.
explanation: Salata yapmak için domates ve salatalıkları küçük parçalara doğramak (chop) gerekir.

question_text:
Can: _____
Chef: You need flour, water, yeast, and a pinch of salt.
option_a: What are the ingredients of bread?
option_c: How long does it take to bake bread?
option_d: Who taught you to make bread?
explanation: Şef malzemeleri (un, su, maya, tuz) saydığına göre soru ekmeğin malzemeleriyle ilgilidir.

question_text:
Look at the kitchen steps:
1. Wash the strawberries.
2. Put them into a blender with milk.
3. Add a spoonful of honey.
4. Blend until smooth.

What are we making?
explanation: Çilek, süt ve balı blenderdan geçirerek çilekli milkshake hazırlanmaktadır.

question_text: Don't forget to _____ the mixture continuously while cooking pudding, or it will burn!
explanation: Puding pişerken yanmaması için sürekli karıştırmak (stir) gerekir.

question_text: Which word is a KITCHEN TOOL, not an ingredient?
explanation: Zeytinyağı, karabiber ve sarımsak malzemedir; kızartma tavası (Frying pan) mutfak aracıdır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Ali: Mom, what's for dinner?
Mom: I'm grilling meatballs and making a green salad.
Ali: Yummy! Can I help you?
Mom: Sure, you can wash the lettuce.

How is the mom cooking the meatballs?
option_b: By frying them in deep oil
explanation: Anne 'I'm grilling meatballs' diyerek köfteleri ızgarada pişirdiğini belirtmiştir.

question_text: My dad loves _____ bread with butter and jam for breakfast.
explanation: Ekmeğe tereyağı ve reçel sürmek için 'spread' fiili kullanılır.

question_text: You should _____ some cheese over the pizza before putting it into the oven.
explanation: Pizzanın üzerine peynir serpmek için 'sprinkle' fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Baking Tip:
'Always preheat your oven for 10 minutes before you put the cookies inside.'

What does 'preheat' mean?
option_a: To clean the oven with water
option_c: To turn off the oven after baking
option_d: To heat the oven before baking
explanation: 'Preheat' fırını pişirmeden önce önceden ısıtmak demektir.

question_text: Use a _____ to mix the eggs and sugar quickly.
explanation: Yumurta ve şekeri hızlıca çırpmak için çırpıcı (whisk) kullanılır.

question_text: French fries are delicious, but they are too _____ because they are cooked in a lot of oil.
explanation: Bol yağda pişirilen patates kızartması çok yağlıdır (greasy).

question_text:
Table: Favorite Cooking Methods in Class 8A
MethodVotes
Grilling14
Baking10
Boiling6
Frying8

Which cooking method is the LEAST popular?
explanation: Tabloda en düşük oy (6) haşlama (Boiling) yöntemindedir.

question_text: First, _____ the dough for five minutes until it becomes soft.
explanation: Hamuru yumuşayana kadar yoğurmak için 'knead' fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Beren: How _____ sugar do we need for the apple pie?
Eda: Just one cup is enough.
explanation: Şeker (sugar) sayılamayan bir isim olduğu için miktar sorarken 'How much' kullanılır.

question_text:
Message from Sister:
'Hey Can, I put the chicken in the oven at 5:00 p.m. Please take it out after 45 minutes!'

What time should Can take the chicken out of the oven?
explanation: Saat 5:00'ten 45 dakika sonra saat 5:45 p.m. olur.

question_text: I prefer _____ meat to fried meat because it has less fat.
explanation: Daha az yağlı olduğu için ızgara (grilled) et tercih edilir.

question_text: Dark chocolate with 85% cocoa tastes a bit _____, not very sweet.
explanation: Yüzde 85 kakaolu bitter çikolatanın tadı acımsıdır (bitter).

question_text:
Menu:
Today's Special: Creamy Mushroom Soup
Ingredients: Mushrooms, cream, butter, onion, garlic, salt, black pepper.

Which vegetable is in today's soup?
explanation: Malzemeler listesinde soğan (onion) ve sarımsak yer almaktadır; havuç, patates veya domates yoktur.

question_text: Cut the bread into thin _____ to make sandwiches.
explanation: Ekmeği sandviç yapmak için ince dilimler (slices) halinde kesmek gerekir.

question_text: Finally, _____ the hot soup into bowls and serve it with lemon.
explanation: Sıcak çorbayı kâselere dökmek/koymak için 'pour' fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Put the steps of making lemonade in the CORRECT order:
I. Finally, add cold water and ice cubes, and stir well.
II. Next, pour the lemon juice into a pitcher and add sugar.
III. First, wash four lemons and cut them in half.
IV. Then, squeeze the lemons to get their juice.
explanation: Doğru sıra: First (III: limonları yıka ve kes) -> Then (IV: sık) -> Next (II: sürahiye dök ve şeker ekle) -> Finally (I: su ve buz ekleyip karıştır).

question_text:
Dialogue:
Tuna: This pasta tastes amazing! What's your secret?
Leyla: I always add a little fresh basil and garlic to the tomato sauce.
Tuna: Could you give me the recipe?
Leyla: _____ I'll text it to you tonight.

Choose the best option.
option_a: Sorry, I don't know how to cook.
option_d: No, you should buy a cookbook.
explanation: Leyla 'Bu akşam sana mesajla atarım' dediğine göre tarifi vermeyi memnuniyetle kabul etmiştir.

question_text: To make crispy potato chips at home, you should _____ the potatoes very thinly before frying.
explanation: Evde çıtır cips yapmak için patatesleri çok ince dilimlemek (slice) gerekir.

question_text:
Read the recipe card:
'Quick Menemen (Serves 2)
Ingredients: 3 tomatoes, 2 green peppers, 3 eggs, 2 tbsp olive oil, salt.
Preparation time: 5 mins | Cooking time: 10 mins.'

How long does it take to prepare AND cook Menemen in total?
explanation: Hazırlık süresi 5 dakika, pişirme süresi 10 dakika olduğuna göre toplam süre 15 dakikadır.

question_text:
Survey: Why do students prefer homemade food?
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Homemade Food" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "48%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Healthy" size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 91.3 P d1 119.9 91.3 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 85.3 "27%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Tasty" size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 126.3 P d2 188.4 126.3 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 120.3 "15%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Cheap" size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 140.8 P d3 256.9 140.8 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 134.8 "10%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Clean" size=10 ```
Which statement is TRUE according to the chart?
option_a: Cleanliness is more important than taste.
option_b: Being cheap is the most important reason.
option_c: Nearly half of the students choose homemade food for health.
explanation: Grafikte 'Healthy' %48'dir; bu da neredeyse öğrencilerin yarısının (nearly half) sağlık nedeniyle ev yemeğini tercih ettiğini gösterir.

question_text:
Aslı: Why are you putting the butter in that hot pan?
Mert: I'm going to _____ it before I add the chopped onions.
explanation: Tereyağını sıcak tavaya koyma amacı eritmektir (melt).

question_text:
Kitchen Safety Rules:
1. Always wash your hands before cooking.
2. Use oven mitts when holding hot trays.
3. Keep sharp knives away from young children.
4. Never leave a frying pan unattended on the stove.

Which rule helps prevent BURNS?
explanation: Sıcak tepsileri tutarken fırın eldiveni (oven mitts) kullanmak yanmaları (burns) önler.

question_text: Which matching between the food and its usual cooking method is WRONG?
explanation: Çorba fırında kızartılmaz (Roasting); tencerede kaynatılır/pişirilir. Diğer eşleştirmeler doğrudur.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Emir: I'm making fruit salad. Do we have any bananas?
Sude: Yes, there are three in the fruit bowl. Anything else?
Emir: I also need two apples and some lemon juice so the fruit doesn't turn brown.

Why does Emir need lemon juice?
option_c: To keep the fruit from changing color
option_d: To boil the bananas and apples
explanation: Emir meyvelerin kararmaması (doesn't turn brown) için limon suyuna ihtiyacı olduğunu söylemektedir.

question_text: First, boil the potatoes until they are soft. Then, _____ them with butter and milk to make a smooth side dish.
explanation: Haşlanmış patatesleri tereyağı ve sütle ezerek püre yapmak için 'mash' fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Table: Four Friends' Breakfast Preferences
NameFoodDrink
KaanBoiled egg, cheeseTea
DuruPancakes, honeyMilk
EfeToast, olivesOrange juice
NilOatmeal, berriesHerbal tea

Who prefers a SWEET breakfast?
explanation: Tabloda pankek ve bal (Pancakes, honey) yiyen Duru tatlı bir kahvaltı tercih etmektedir.

question_text: Chef: Before you put the pizza dough on the _____, grease it with a little olive oil so it doesn't stick.
explanation: Pizza hamuru yapışmasın diye fırın tepsisini (baking tray) yağlamak gerekir.

question_text:
Read the text:
'In Turkish cuisine, baklava is a world-famous dessert. Bakers use thin layers of dough, butter, and pistachios or walnuts. After baking it until golden brown, they pour sweet syrup over it.'

Which ingredient is NOT mentioned in the text?
explanation: Metinde hamur, tereyağı, Antep fıstığı veya ceviz ve şerbet geçmektedir; çikolata (Chocolate) geçmemektedir.

question_text: Which word is a synonym for 'delicious'?
explanation: 'Tasty' (lezzetli), 'delicious' kelimesiyle eş anlamlıdır.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Kerem: Let's bake chocolate chip cookies!
Buse: Great! Let me check the fridge. We have butter and eggs, but we ran out of chocolate chips.
Kerem: No problem. I'll go to the market and buy some.

What is missing for the cookies?
explanation: Buse 'we ran out of chocolate chips' (damla çikolatamız bitti) demiştir.

question_text: Wait until the water starts to _____ before you put the spaghetti into the pot.
explanation: Spagettiyi tencereye koymadan önce suyun kaynamasını (boil) beklemek gerekir.

question_text:
Cooking Show Transcript:
'Welcome back! Today we are making garlic bread. First, slice a baguette. Next, mix soft butter with crushed garlic and parsley. Spread the mixture on the slices. Finally, bake them for 8 minutes.'

What do we do right AFTER slicing the baguette?
explanation: Bageti dilimledikten hemen sonraki adım (Next) yumuşak tereyağını ezilmiş sarımsak ve maydanozla karıştırmaktır.

question_text: Don't eat those green apples yet; they are not _____ enough and taste too sour.
explanation: Henüz yeterince olgunlaşmamış (ripe) elmalar çok ekşi olur.

question_text:
Read the recipe tip:
'If your soup is too salty, peel a raw potato and put it into the pot for 15 minutes. The potato will absorb the extra salt!'

Why should you put a raw potato in salty soup?
option_a: To reduce the saltiness of the soup
option_b: To cool down the soup quickly
option_d: To change the color of the soup
explanation: Çiğ patates tenceredeki fazla tuzu emer (absorb the extra salt), böylece çorbanın tuzluluğunu azaltır.

question_text:
Selin: _____
Chef: About 25 minutes at 180 degrees.
option_a: What ingredients do I need for muffins?
option_b: How many muffins will this make?
option_d: How long should I bake the muffins?
explanation: Şef '180 derecede yaklaşık 25 dakika' yanıtını verdiğine göre soru pişirme süresiyle (How long) ilgilidir.

question_text:
Email:
'Hi Mom, I tried making lentil soup on my own today! I followed your recipe step by step, but I forgot to drain the lentils after washing them, and I added two tablespoons of salt instead of one teaspoon. Oops!'

What happened to the soup?
option_b: It had no water at all.
explanation: Bir çay kaşığı yerine iki yemek kaşığı tuz eklediği için çorba aşırı tuzlu olmuştur.

question_text: After washing the fresh spinach, _____ it carefully with paper towels before making the salad.
explanation: Yıkanan ıspanağı salata yapmadan önce kâğıt havluyla kurulamak (dry) gerekir.

question_text:
Look at the food items:
1. Ice cream
2. French fries
3. Steamed broccoli
4. Grilled fish

Which two items are healthier choices for dinner?
explanation: Buharda pişmiş brokoli (3) ve ızgara balık (4) akşam yemeği için daha sağlıklı seçimlerdir.

question_text: To make pancake batter, put flour, milk, and eggs into a large _____ and mix them well.
explanation: Malzemeleri koyup karıştırmak için büyük bir karıştırma kâsesi (mixing bowl) kullanılır.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Ozan: What are you doing with the cucumbers?
Mina: I'm _____ them into small cubes for the shepherd's salad.

Which verb fits best?
explanation: Küçük küpler halinde doğramak 'dice' (küp küp doğramak) fiiliyle ifade edilir.

question_text: Which sentence is about a COOKING PROCESS?
option_a: My favorite dessert is strawberry cheesecake.
option_b: Next, heat two tablespoons of olive oil in a pan.
option_c: How often do you eat out with your family?
option_d: I prefer eating grilled chicken to fried chicken.
explanation: 'Sonra bir tavada iki yemek kaşığı zeytinyağını ısıtın' cümlesi yemek yapma sürecini (process) anlatır.

question_text:
Label on a Jar:
'Homemade Strawberry Jam – Ingredients: Strawberries, sugar, lemon juice. Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening.'

Where should you keep the jar AFTER you open it?
explanation: Etikette 'Refrigerate after opening' (Açtıktan sonra buzdolabında saklayın) yazmaktadır.

question_text: Be careful when you _____ the hot tea into the glass, or you might burn your fingers.
explanation: Sıcak çayı bardağa dökerken (pour) dikkatli olmak gerekir.

question_text:
Four teens talk about their cooking skills:
Arda: I can only boil eggs and make toast.
Ece: I can bake cakes, make pasta, and grill fish.
Can: I never enter the kitchen except to grab water.
Sıla: I always help my dad chop vegetables for salad.

Who is the MOST experienced cook?
explanation: Kek pişirebilen, makarna yapabilen ve balık ızgara edebilen Ece en deneyimli aşçıdır.

question_text: Always use a _____ when chopping onions so you don't damage the kitchen counter.
explanation: Mutfak tezgâhına zarar vermemek için kesme tahtası (cutting board) kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the scrambled recipe for 'Banana Smoothie':
1. Blend everything for 1 minute until smooth.
2. Peel two ripe bananas and slice them.
3. Pour the smoothie into two tall glasses and serve cold.
4. Put the banana slices, a glass of cold milk, and a spoon of honey into a blender.

Which sequence is CORRECT?
explanation: Doğru sıra: Önce muzları soy ve dilimle (2) -> Dilimleri, sütü ve balı blendera koy (4) -> 1 dakika karıştır (1) -> Bardaklara döküp soğuk servis et (3).

question_text:
Table: Cooking Club Preferences (60 Students)
DishBoysGirls
Pizza1412
Chocolate Cake415
Grilled Burgers105

Which statement is FALSE according to the table?
option_a: Boys like making chocolate cake more than girls.
option_b: Pizza is the most popular dish in total.
option_c: Girls are more interested in baking cake than grilling burgers.
option_d: More boys prefer grilled burgers than girls.
explanation: Tabloda çikolatalı keki 4 erkek, 15 kız seçmiştir; yani erkekler kızlardan daha çok sevmez. Bu ifade yanlıştır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Nehir: I'm planning to cook dinner for my parents' anniversary. Any ideas?
Kaan: Well, your dad doesn't eat red meat, and your mom is allergic to seafood.
Nehir: Hmm, that's true. What should I make then?
Kaan: Why don't you roast a whole chicken with rosemary potatoes and make a fresh salad?

Why does Kaan suggest roasted chicken?
option_a: Because Nehir doesn't know how to boil pasta.
option_b: Because her parents only eat vegetarian food.
option_c: Because neither parent can or wants to eat red meat or seafood.
option_d: Because chicken is the fastest dish to fry.
explanation: Babası kırmızı et yemediği, annesinin de deniz ürünlerine alerjisi olduğu için tavuk ikisine de uygun tek seçenektir.

question_text:
Chef's Blog:
'Many people overcook pasta and end up with a mushy dish. Here is my golden rule: Use a large pot with plenty of water, add salt only after the water boils, and cook the pasta for 1–2 minutes less than the package says. Drain it immediately, and never rinse it with cold water if you are adding hot sauce!'

According to the chef, what is a MISTAKE when cooking pasta?
option_a: Using a large pot with plenty of water
option_b: Adding salt after the water starts boiling
option_c: Draining the pasta right after cooking
option_d: Rinsing the pasta with cold water before adding hot sauce
explanation: Şef 'never rinse it with cold water if you are adding hot sauce' (sıcak sos ekleyecekseniz asla soğuk suyla durulamayın) diyerek bunun bir hata olduğunu belirtmiştir.

question_text:
Look at the ingredients on the kitchen counter:
- Flour, baking powder, sugar, 3 eggs, milk, vanilla, cocoa powder.
Tools available:
- Mixing bowl, whisk, baking pan, oven.

Which dish CANNOT be made with ONLY these items?
option_c: Sweet pancakes (if cooked in a pan? Wait: oven + baking pan -> cake/muffins, no tomato/salt/pot for soup!)
explanation: Tezgâhta domates, tuz, su ve tencere yoktur; bu yüzden domates çorbası (Tomato soup) yapılamaz.

question_text:
Read the text:
'Sushi is a traditional Japanese dish made with vinegared rice and various ingredients such as raw or cooked fish, vegetables, and seaweed. Wasabi (a spicy green paste) and soy sauce are usually served alongside it.'

Which question does NOT have an answer in the text?
option_a: How many minutes does it take to prepare sushi?
option_c: What is the main ingredient of sushi?
option_d: What sauces are served with sushi?
explanation: Metinde suşinin kökeni (Japonya), ana malzemesi (sirkeli pirinç) ve yanındaki soslar (wasabi, soya sosu) vardır; ancak hazırlama süresi yazmamaktadır.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Deniz: Let's make homemade pizza! I'll knead the dough.
Bora: Okay, what should I do?
Deniz: While I'm kneading, could you grate the mozzarella and slice the mushrooms?
Bora: Sure! Should I turn on the oven too?
Deniz: Yes, please set it to 220°C.

Which kitchen tools will Bora definitely use?
option_b: A pot and a wooden spoon
option_d: A rolling pin and a whisk
explanation: Bora peyniri rendeleyecek (grater) ve mantarları dilimleyecektir (knife).

question_text:
Choose the sentence that disrupts the flow of the recipe:
(I) Making Turkish coffee is an art. (II) First, put one cup of cold water and a teaspoon of coffee into the cezve for each person. (III) My uncle prefers drinking herbal tea in the winter. (IV) Then, stir well before placing it on low heat.
explanation: Paragraf Türk kahvesi yapımını anlatırken III numaralı cümle amcanın kışın bitki çayı içmesini anlatarak akışı bozar.

question_text:
Survey: Cooking Habits of 100 Teens
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "How often do teens cook?" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "35%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Never" size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 50.0 P d1 119.9 50.0 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 44.0 "30%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Once a week" size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 70.0 P d2 188.4 70.0 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 64.0 "25%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "2-3 times/wk" size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 130.0 P d3 256.9 130.0 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 124.0 "10%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Every day" size=10 ```
Which statement is TRUE according to the chart?
option_a: Half of the teens never enter the kitchen.
option_b: More than half of the teens cook at least once a week.
option_c: Cooking every day is more common than cooking once a week.
option_d: Every teen knows how to cook well.
explanation: Haftada bir (%30), haftada 2-3 kez (%25) ve her gün (%10) yemek yapanların toplamı %65 eder; yani yarısından fazlası haftada en az bir kez yemek yapmaktadır.

question_text:
Restaurant Menu Warning:
'ALLERGY NOTICE: Our Spicy Chicken Wrap contains wheat, dairy (cheese), and sesame seeds. Our Green Detox Salad is 100% nut-free and dairy-free.'

Mert is allergic to cheese and milk products. What should he know before ordering?
option_a: He can safely order the Green Detox Salad.
option_b: The salad contains sesame seeds and cheese.
option_d: He should order the Spicy Chicken Wrap.
explanation: Süt ürünlerine (dairy) alerjisi olan Mert, süt ürünü içermeyen (dairy-free) Green Detox Salad'ı güvenle sipariş edebilir.

question_text:
Read the kitchen mishap:
'Efe wanted to surprise his mom with pancakes. He mixed flour, milk, and eggs, heated the pan, and poured the batter. When he tried to flip the first pancake, he noticed it was stuck to the pan and burned!'

What did Efe probably forget to do?
option_a: He forgot to turn on the stove.
option_b: He forgot to add flour to the batter.
option_c: He forgot to put oil or butter in the pan.
option_d: He forgot to wash the plates.
explanation: Pankek tavaya yapıştığına göre Efe tavaya yağ veya tereyağı sürmeyi unutmuştur.

question_text:
Complete the analogy:
Peel : Peeler :: Grate : _____
explanation: Soymak (Peel) -> Soyacak (Peeler) ilişkisi gibi, Rendelemek (Grate) -> Rende (Grater) olmalıdır.

question_text:
Four people describe their favorite meal:
- Ada: I love sweet desserts with lots of fruit.
- Cem: I enjoy hot, spicy meat dishes.
- Nil: I prefer light, boiled or steamed vegetables.
- Berk: I'm crazy about crispy fried snacks.

A restaurant offers: (1) Chili Beef Tacos, (2) Steamed Broccoli & Carrots, (3) Strawberry Tart, (4) Onion Rings.
Which matching is CORRECT?
explanation: Ada (tatlı/meyveli) -> Çilekli Tart (3); Cem (acılı et) -> Chili Beef Tacos (1); Nil (buharda sebze) -> Brokoli & Havuç (2); Berk (çıtır kızartma) -> Soğan Halkası (4).

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Mom: Did you turn off the oven, Tuna?
Tuna: Oh no! Wait, I think I only turned the temperature down to 100°C.
Mom: Good thing I asked! Please turn it off completely right now.

What was the problem?
option_b: The cake was not baked yet.
option_c: Tuna turned the oven up to 250°C.
explanation: Tuna fırını tamamen kapatmak yerine sadece sıcaklığını 100 dereceye düşürmüştü; yani fırın hâlâ açıktı.

question_text:
Nutrition Comparison (Per 100g):
FoodCaloriesFatSugar
Baked Potato93 kcal0.1 g1.2 g
French Fries312 kcal15 g0.3 g
Chocolate Muffin377 kcal16 g28 g

Which statement is TRUE according to the table?
option_a: Chocolate muffin is the lowest-calorie food in the table.
option_b: French fries have more sugar than chocolate muffins.
option_c: Baking potatoes has much fewer calories and fat than frying them.
option_d: Baked potato has more fat than French fries.
explanation: Fırınlanmış patates 93 kcal ve 0.1 g yağ içerirken, kızartılmış patates 312 kcal ve 15 g yağ içerir. Yani fırınlamak çok daha az kalori ve yağ demektir.

question_text: Which question CANNOT be answered by looking at a recipe's 'Ingredients' list?
option_a: How much flour should I use?
option_b: Do I need any eggs for this dish?
option_c: Are there any nuts in this recipe?
option_d: At what temperature should I bake the dish?
explanation: Malzemeler (Ingredients) listesi nelerin ve ne kadar kullanılacağını gösterir; pişirme sıcaklığını (temperature) göstermez.

question_text:
Read the tip for making fluffy omelettes:
'The secret to a light and fluffy omelette is whisking the eggs with a tablespoon of milk until bubbles appear, and cooking it over medium-low heat—never high heat!'

According to the tip, what makes an omelette fluffy?
option_a: Adding a lot of flour and sugar
option_b: Whisking eggs with milk until bubbly and using medium-low heat
option_c: Cooking the eggs over very high heat
option_d: Boiling the eggs before cracking them
explanation: İpucuna göre yumurtaları bir kaşık sütle kabarcıklar çıkana kadar çırpmak ve orta-düşük ateşte pişirmek omleti kabarık (fluffy) yapar.

question_text:
E-mail from Aunt Zeynep:
'Dear Melis, here is grandma's apple pie recipe you asked for! Don't forget: she always used sour green apples instead of sweet red ones, and she added a teaspoon of cinnamon to the filling. Let me know how it turns out!'

What is special about grandma's apple pie?
option_a: It uses sour green apples and cinnamon.
option_b: It has no sugar or spices.
option_c: It is fried in a pan instead of baked.
option_d: It uses sweet red apples and cocoa.
explanation: Büyükannenin elmalı turtasının özelliği tatlı kırmızı elma yerine ekşi yeşil elma ve tarçın (cinnamon) kullanmasıdır.

question_text:
Choose the correct quantifier:
'We have _____ tomatoes left, so we can make a big bowl of tomato soup, but we only have _____ garlic—just one clove.'
explanation: Domates çoğul/bol olduğu için 'a lot of', sarımsak (sayılamayan) sadece bir diş kaldığı için 'a little' kullanılır.

question_text:
Cooking Contest Rules:
- Time limit: 45 minutes.
- Each team must prepare 1 main course and 1 dessert.
- Using ready-made sauces is forbidden.
- Judges score on taste (50%), presentation (30%), and hygiene (20%).

What would DISQUALIFY a team?
option_d: Buying a bottle of ready-made tomato sauce
explanation: Kurallarda hazır sos kullanmanın yasak olduğu (Using ready-made sauces is forbidden) belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Kerem: Why are you adding baking powder to the flour?
Sena: Because without it, the cake won't rise—it will stay flat like a pancake!

What is the function of baking powder?
option_c: It keeps the cake from burning.
explanation: Sena kabartma tozu (baking powder) olmadan kekin kabarmayacağını (won't rise) söylemiştir.

question_text:
Read the paragraph:
'Mediterranean cuisine is famous for being both delicious and healthy. People in this region use olive oil instead of butter, eat plenty of fresh vegetables and fish, and rarely consume heavy, greasy fast food.'

Why is Mediterranean cuisine considered healthy?
option_a: It relies on olive oil, fresh vegetables, and fish.
option_b: It uses a lot of butter and fried meat.
option_c: People in this region eat fast food every day.
option_d: It avoids all kinds of vegetables.
explanation: Akdeniz mutfağı tereyağı yerine zeytinyağı kullandığı, bol taze sebze ve balık tükettiği için sağlıklı kabul edilir.

question_text: Which pair of verbs describes OPPOSITE actions or states in the kitchen?
explanation: Dondurmak (Freeze) ve eritmek (Melt) zıt eylemlerdir. Diğer çiftler benzer anlamlıdır.

question_text:
Recipe Note:
'Warning: Let the boiled potatoes cool for 10 minutes before peeling them, or you will burn your fingers!'

When should you peel the boiled potatoes?
option_a: Before putting them into the pot
option_b: Immediately after draining the hot water
option_c: While they are boiling in hot water
option_d: After waiting 10 minutes for them to cool
explanation: Notta parmaklarınızı yakmamak için haşlanmış patatesleri soymadan önce 10 dakika soğumasını beklemeniz gerektiği yazmaktadır.

question_text:
Student Survey: What is the hardest part of cooking for you?
- 40% say 'Chopping onions without crying'
- 30% say 'Washing the dishes afterwards'
- 20% say 'Getting the right amount of salt'
- 10% say 'Following time instructions'

Which statement is TRUE?
option_a: Most students hate following time instructions.
option_b: Cleaning up after cooking is the second biggest problem.
option_c: Chopping onions is the easiest part.
option_d: Half of the students struggle with salt.
explanation: Bulaşıkları yıkamak (%30), soğan doğramaktan (%40) sonra ikinci en büyük sorundur.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Emre: What's that delicious smell?
Dad: I'm roasting peppers and eggplants in the oven for our dinner salad.
Emre: Yum! Should I set the table?
Dad: Yes, please. Put out four plates, forks, and napkins.

What is Emre going to do?
explanation: Emre masayı kurmayı (set the table) teklif eder ve babası da tabak, çatal ve peçeteleri çıkarmasını ister.

question_text:
Choose the best linker:
'First, wash the rice thoroughly. _____, soak it in warm salted water for 20 minutes before cooking.'
explanation: 'First' ile başlayan süreçte bir sonraki adımı anlatmak için 'Then' (Sonra) kullanılır; 'Finally' en son adım içindir.

question_text:
Read the food blog:
'I used to eat fast food four times a week, which made me feel tired all the time. Two months ago, I started cooking simple meals at home like grilled chicken and vegetable soup. Now I have much more energy!'

What caused the writer's energy to increase?
option_b: Eating fast food four times a week
option_d: Switching from fast food to homemade meals
explanation: Yazar fast food yerine evde ızgara tavuk ve sebze çorbası gibi basit yemekler pişirmeye başladığı için enerjisinin arttığını anlatmaktadır.

question_text:
Kitchen Riddle:
'I have many sharp holes, but I am not a strainer. You slide cheese or carrots over me to turn them into tiny pieces. What am I?'
explanation: Keskin delikleri olan, peynir veya havucu küçük parçalara ayırmak için kullanılan mutfak aleti rendedir (grater).

question_text:
Dialogue:
Elif: Can I taste the soup?
Can: Sure! What do you think?
Elif: Hmm, it's nice and creamy, but it's a bit bland.
Can: Oh, let me add some salt and black pepper then.

What does 'bland' mean in this dialogue?
explanation: Can bunun üzerine tuz ve karabiber eklediğine göre 'bland' tadı tuzu eksik/yavan anlamına gelmektedir.

question_text:
Secretary: Hello, Star Tech Company. How may I help you?
Caller: Hello, _____ speak to Mr. Yılmaz, please?
explanation: Telefonda biriyle görüşmek isterken 'May I speak to...?' (Görüşebilir miyim?) kalıbı kullanılır.

question_text:
Ece: Is Selin there?
Mom: _____ I'll get her.
option_b: I'm sorry, it's a bad line.
option_c: She is not available right now.
option_d: Would you like to leave a message?
explanation: Anne 'Onu çağırıyorum' (I'll get her) dediğine göre arayan kişiden bir dakika beklemesini (Hold on a moment) istemelidir.

question_text:
Receptionist: I'm sorry, Dr. Kaya is in a meeting right now. _____
Caller: Yes, please. Tell him to call Deniz back.
option_c: Would you like to leave a message?
explanation: Arayan kişi mesaj bıraktığına göre resepsiyonist 'Mesaj bırakmak ister misiniz?' diye sormuştur.

question_text: I can't hear you well because it's a _____. Could you speak louder, please?
explanation: Karşı tarafı iyi duyamadığımızda 'hat kötü' (bad line) ifadesini kullanırız.

question_text:
Phone Note:
'To: Arda
Your friend Mert called at 2:15 p.m. He wants you to bring your chess set to school tomorrow. Call him back after 5 p.m.'

Who called Arda?
explanation: Telefon notunda 'Your friend Mert called' (Arkadaşın Mert aradı) yazmaktadır.

question_text:
Kaan: Hello, can I talk to Emre?
Sister: Sorry, he isn't here at the moment. He _____.
explanation: Emre şu an burada değilse dışarı çıkmıştır (went out).

question_text: Operator: Please hold the line. I'll _____ you _____ to the customer service.
explanation: Telefonda birini başka bir birime bağlamak için 'put through' phrasal verb'ü kullanılır.

question_text:
Smartphone App Icons:
1. Map app – Find directions
2. Dictionary app – Learn new words
3. Weather app – Check the forecast
4. Music app – Listen to songs

Which app should Tuna use if he is lost in a new city?
explanation: Yeni bir şehirde kaybolan Tuna yön bulmak için harita uygulamasını (Map app) kullanmalıdır.

question_text: When the phone rings, you _____ to answer it.
explanation: Çalan telefonu açmak için 'pick up' ifadesi kullanılır.

question_text:
Beren: Hello, this is Beren calling. Is Defne available?
Defne's Dad: Hang on a minute, Beren. _____
explanation: Baba bir dakika beklemesini söyledikten sonra 'Onu çağıracağım' (I'll call her) der.

question_text:
Call Center Dialogue:
Agent: Blue Airlines, how can I help you?
Passenger: I'd like to book a flight ticket from İzmir to Ankara for Friday.

Why is the passenger calling?
explanation: Yolcu İzmir'den Ankara'ya uçak bileti ayırtmak (book a flight ticket / make a reservation) için aramaktadır.

question_text: My battery is only 2%! I need to _____ my smartphone right now.
explanation: Pil %2'ye düştüğünde telefonu şarj etmek (charge) gerekir.

question_text: Can: I tried calling you three times, but the line was _____.
explanation: Hat meşgul olduğunda 'busy' veya 'engaged' kelimeleri kullanılır.
