What is the MOST popular way of communication among teens?
explanation: Grafikte %50 ile en yüksek oran mesajlaşma (Texting) seçeneğindedir.

question_text: I prefer _____ communication because seeing people's facial expressions is very important to me.
explanation: İnsanların yüz ifadelerini görebilmek için yüz yüze (face-to-face) iletişim tercih edilir.

question_text: Excuse me, I didn't catch that. Could you _____ your phone number, please?
explanation: Karşı tarafın söylediğini anlayamadığımızda telefon numarasını tekrar etmesini (repeat) isteriz.

question_text:
Message on Screen:
'Sorry, I'm in a class right now. I'll call you back at 3:30 p.m. – Yusuf'

Why can't Yusuf answer the phone?
explanation: Yusuf mesajında şu an derste olduğunu (in a class) belirtmiştir.

question_text: Before mobile phones, people used to write _____ and send them by post.
explanation: Cep telefonlarından önce insanlar mektup (letters) yazıp postayla gönderirdi.

question_text: Which one is a DISADVANTAGE of smartphones?
option_a: We can call our family in emergencies.
option_c: They can cause addiction and eye problems.
option_d: They help us learn new languages.
explanation: Bağımlılık ve göz sorunlarına yol açması akıllı telefonların bir dezavantajıdır.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Operator: Welcome to TechnoFix. Press 1 for sales, press 2 for technical support.
Ali: My new laptop won't turn on.

Which number should Ali press?
explanation: Ali'nin yeni dizüstü bilgisayarı açılmadığı için teknik destek (technical support) olan 2'ye basmalıdır.

question_text: Don't _____ the phone! I have one more question to ask you.
explanation: Soracak bir sorum daha var diyerek telefonu kapatmamasını (hang up) istemektedir.

question_text:
Sude: _____ is calling?
Ozan: It's Ozan, your cousin!
explanation: Yanıt 'Kuzenin Ozan' olduğu için soru 'Kim arıyor?' (Who) olmalıdır.

question_text:
Read the text:
'In ancient times, people used smoke signals and messenger birds to communicate over long distances.'

What is the text about?
option_d: How to use a call center
explanation: Eski çağlarda duman işaretleri ve haberci kuşların kullanılması eski iletişim yöntemlerini (old ways of communication) anlatır.

question_text: When you _____ a wrong number, you should say 'Sorry, wrong number' politely.
explanation: Yanlış numarayı tuşlamak/aramak için 'dial' fiili kullanılır.

question_text: I use a language learning _____ on my phone every day to practice English vocabulary.
explanation: Telefondaki dil öğrenme uygulaması 'application' (app) kelimesiyle ifade edilir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Nisa: Hello, Nisa speaking.
Kerem: Hi Nisa, it's Kerem. Is your brother at home?
Nisa: No, he went to the library. _____
Kerem: No, thanks. I'll text him later.

What does Nisa ask?
option_a: Do you want to leave a message?
explanation: Kerem 'Hayır, teşekkürler. Ona daha sonra mesaj atarım' dediğine göre Nisa mesaj bırakmak isteyip istemediğini sormuştur.

question_text: Using _____ like smiley faces makes text messages warmer and easier to understand.
explanation: Gülen yüz gibi ifadeler 'emojis' olarak adlandırılır.

question_text: If you lose your phone, you should immediately call your mobile operator to _____ your SIM card.
explanation: Telefon kaybolduğunda SIM kartı bloke ettirmek/kapatmak (block) gerekir.

question_text:
Table: Smartphone Usage of 8B
PurposeNumber of Students
Chatting with friends15
Playing games10
Doing homework5
Watching videos10

What do students use their phones for the MOST?
explanation: Tabloda en yüksek sayı (15) arkadaşlarla sohbet etme (Chatting with friends) amacındadır.

question_text: My uncle is old-fashioned; he still prefers sending _____ instead of texting on WhatsApp.
explanation: Eski moda olan amca WhatsApp yerine kartpostal (postcards) göndermeyi tercih etmektedir.

question_text:
Phone Conversation:
Secretary: Good morning, Green Dental Clinic. How can I help you?
Patient: Good morning. I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Aksoy for Tuesday.
Secretary: Let me check... She is full on Tuesday, but she has an opening on Wednesday at 10 a.m.
Patient: Wednesday at 10 a.m. works for me. Thank you!

When will the patient see the doctor?
explanation: Salı günü dolu olduğu için hasta Çarşamba sabahı saat 10:00 (Wednesday morning) için randevu almıştır.

question_text:
Aylin: Hello, is Mr. Demir in his office?
Assistant: No, he's at a conference. _____
Aylin: Could you please tell him that Aylin from the bank called? My number is 555-3412.
explanation: Aylin not bırakıp adını ve numarasını verdiğine göre asistan 'Mesajınızı alabilir miyim?' diye sormuştur.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Customer: Hello, I ordered a pair of headphones from your website five days ago, and they still haven't arrived.
Agent: I'm sorry for the delay, sir. Could you give me your order number so I can track the package?

Why is the customer calling?
option_a: To ask about a delayed delivery
option_c: To complain about the website design
option_d: To buy a new pair of headphones
explanation: Müşteri 5 gün önce sipariş ettiği kulaklık hâlâ gelmediği için geciken teslimat (delayed delivery) hakkında bilgi almak amacıyla aramaktadır.

question_text: Which expression is used when you CANNOT hear the other person clearly?
option_a: Would you like to book a single room?
option_b: Wait a second, I'll get him for you.
option_c: Excuse me, you're breaking up. Could you repeat that?
option_d: Thanks for calling our customer service.
explanation: 'You're breaking up' (Sesiniz kesik kesik geliyor) ifadesi karşı tarafı net duyamadığımızda kullanılır.

question_text:
Pros and Cons of Smartphones:
Mert: We can access maps and dictionaries anytime.
Ece: Teens spend too much time looking at screens instead of talking.
Can: It's great for keeping in touch with family far away.
Nil: People check notifications even while crossing the street, which is dangerous.

Who talks about the PROS (advantages) of smartphones?
explanation: Mert (harita ve sözlüklere erişim) ve Can (uzaktaki aileyle iletişim) avantajlardan bahsetmektedir.

question_text:
Put the phone dialogue in the CORRECT order:
I. Hold on, I'll put you through.
II. Hello, ABC Bank. How can I help you?
III. One moment, please. May I ask who is calling?
IV. Hello, I'd like to speak to the manager, please.
V. This is Emre Kaya.
explanation: Doğru akış: Merhaba, nasıl yardımcı olabilirim? (II) -> Müdürle görüşmek istiyorum (IV) -> Kimin aradığını sorabilir miyim? (III) -> Ben Emre Kaya (V) -> Bekleyin, bağlıyorum (I).

question_text:
Text Message:
'Hi Mom, my basketball practice finished early today. I'm at Mert's house doing our science project. Don't worry, I'll be home by 6:00 p.m. – Kaan'

Why did Kaan send this message?
option_a: To inform his mom about where he is and when he'll be back
option_b: To say that basketball practice was cancelled
option_c: To invite Mert to their house for dinner
option_d: To ask his mom to pick him up from school
explanation: Kaan annesine nerede olduğunu (Mert'in evinde) ve saat kaçta döneceğini (6:00 p.m.) haber vermek için mesaj atmıştır.

question_text:
Caller: Could I speak to Ms. Yıldız, please?
Receptionist: I'm afraid she is _____ at the moment. She is on another call.
explanation: Başka bir görüşmede olduğu için şu an meşgul (busy) durumdadır.

question_text:
Survey: How often do teens make voice calls vs. text?
Age GroupPrefer TextingPrefer Voice Calls
13–1578%22%
16–1870%30%
40–5035%65%

Which statement is TRUE according to the table?
option_a: Nobody in the 13–15 group makes voice calls.
option_b: Adults aged 40–50 hate making voice calls.
option_c: 16–18 year olds prefer voice calls to texting.
option_d: Younger people prefer texting much more than adults aged 40–50.
explanation: Tabloya göre 13-15 yaş (%78) ve 16-18 yaş (%70) gençler mesajlaşmayı 40-50 yaş grubundan (%35) çok daha fazla tercih etmektedir.

question_text: Please don't forget to switch your phone to _____ mode when you enter the cinema.
explanation: Sinemaya girerken telefonu sessiz (silent) moda almak gerekir.

question_text:
Customer Service Call:
Agent: Thank you for calling SkyNet Internet. What seems to be the problem?
User: My Wi-Fi connection keeps dropping every ten minutes.
Agent: Have you tried restarting your modem?
User: Yes, twice, but it didn't work.

What is the user's problem?
explanation: Kullanıcı Wi-Fi bağlantısının her 10 dakikada bir koptuğunu (unstable Internet connection) söylemektedir.

question_text:
Eda: Hey, did you get my voice message?
Tuna: Sorry, I didn't listen to it yet. My _____ aren't working, and I'm on a crowded bus.
explanation: Kalabalık otobüste sesli mesajı dinleyebilmek için kulaklığa (earphones) ihtiyaç vardır.

question_text:
Read the memo on the office desk:
'Mr. Kaya, Mrs. Akın called at 11:20. She wants to change Friday's meeting from 2 p.m. to 4 p.m. Please confirm by 5 p.m. today.'

What should Mr. Kaya do before 5 p.m.?
option_b: Go to the meeting at 2 p.m. today
option_c: Call Mrs. Akın on Friday afternoon
option_d: Let Mrs. Akın know if the new time works for him
explanation: Notta saat 5'e kadar onaylaması (Please confirm) istenmektedir; yani yeni saatin uygun olup olmadığını bildirmelidir.

question_text: Which word does NOT match the others?
explanation: Voicemail, Caller ve Receiver telefon iletişimiyle ilgilidir; Microwave (mikrodalga) mutfak aletidir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Deniz: Hello! Could I speak to Burak?
Burak's Mom: He's taking a shower right now. _____
Deniz: Okay, please tell him Deniz called. Thank you!

Which sentence fits best?
option_a: Can I tell him to call you back?
option_b: Hold on, he's coming to the phone.
option_c: Why are you calling so early?
option_d: He doesn't want to talk to you.
explanation: Burak duşta olduğu için anne 'Seni geri aramasını söyleyeyim mi?' diye sorar, Deniz de 'Tamam, lütfen Deniz aradı deyin' yanıtını verir.

question_text: Many teenagers suffer from 'nomophobia', which is the fear of being without a _____.
explanation: Nomofobi (no-mobile-phone phobia), cep telefonundan uzak kalma korkusudur.

question_text:
Read the four reasons teens use smartphones:
- Ada: I use a flashcard app to memorize English words.
- Mert: I check bus arrival times every morning.
- Sıla: I play puzzle games on the subway.
- Can: I transfer money and check my pocket money.

Who uses a smartphone for EDUCATIONAL purposes?
explanation: İngilizce kelimeleri ezberlemek için bilgi kartı uygulaması kullanan Ada telefonunu eğitim amaçlı (educational) kullanmaktadır.

question_text:
Waiter on the Phone: Hello, Pizza Express. May I take your order?
Customer: Yes, I'd like two medium vegetarian pizzas. _____
Waiter: About 25 minutes, madam.
option_a: How much do I have to pay?
option_b: How long will the delivery take?
option_d: Do you have any cheese pizza?
explanation: Garson 'Yaklaşık 25 dakika' yanıtını verdiğine göre müşteri teslimatın ne kadar süreceğini sormuştur.

question_text:
Article Excerpt:
'In the past, people had to remember their friends' phone numbers or write them in an address book. Today, smartphones store hundreds of contacts, and we just tap a name to call.'

How have smartphones made calling easier?
option_a: We don't need to memorize phone numbers anymore.
option_b: Phone calls are completely free for everyone.
option_c: We can only save ten contacts on a phone.
option_d: Address books are more popular than ever.
explanation: Metne göre akıllı telefonlar yüzlerce kişiyi kaydettiği için artık telefon numaralarını ezberlemeye gerek kalmamıştır.

question_text: I'm calling to _____ my dentist appointment from Monday to Thursday because I have an exam on Monday.
explanation: Pazartesi sınavı olduğu için dişçi randevusunu Pazartesi'den Perşembe'ye değiştirmek (change) istemektedir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Operator: City Library, how may I help you?
Student: Hello, I'd like to ask about your weekend opening hours.
Operator: We are open from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. on Saturdays, and closed on Sundays.

When can the student visit the library at the weekend?
option_d: On Saturday between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m.
explanation: Kütüphane Cumartesi günleri 09:00–17:00 arası açık, Pazar günleri ise kapalıdır.

question_text:
Arda: Hello, is that 555-8901?
Stranger: No, this is 555-8910. I think you dialed the wrong number.
Arda: _____
option_a: No, you answered the wrong phone.
option_b: Oh, I'm so sorry to bother you.
option_c: Hold on, I'll check my bag.
option_d: Put me through to the manager.
explanation: Yanlış numara arandığında kibar bir şekilde 'Rahatsız ettiğim için çok özür dilerim' denir.

option_a: Making calls is more popular than using the camera.

option_d: Messaging is the number one feature.

question_text: When you leave a voice message, always state your name, your phone number, and the _____ for calling.
explanation: Sesli mesaj bırakırken adınızı, numaranızı ve arama sebebinizi (reason) belirtmelisiniz.

question_text:
Read the text:
'Video calls are very useful for people who live far from their families. Unlike simple phone calls, you can see your loved ones' smiles and reactions in real time.'

What is the main advantage of video calls mentioned in the text?
option_a: Using less battery than text messages
option_d: Being able to see the other person while talking
explanation: Metinde görüntülü aramaların ana avantajı olarak sevdiklerinizin gülümsemesini ve tepkilerini gerçek zamanlı görebilmek (see the other person) vurgulanmaktadır.

question_text: Don't forget to _____ the phone call before you put the phone in your pocket, or the other person will hear everything!
explanation: Telefonu cebinize koymadan önce aramayı sonlandırmayı (end) unutmayın.

question_text:
Phone Call:
Receptionist: Grand Hotel, good afternoon.
Guest: Hello, I'd like to book a double room for two nights starting July 10.
Receptionist: Certainly. May I have your full name, please?

What information does the guest give?
option_a: Room type, number of nights, and check-in date
option_d: Credit card number and home address
explanation: Konuk oda tipini (double room), gece sayısını (two nights) ve giriş tarihini (July 10) vermiştir.

question_text: If you want to learn how to pronounce an English word, a talking _____ app on your phone can help.
explanation: Kelimelerin telaffuzunu öğrenmek için sesli sözlük (dictionary) uygulaması yardımcı olur.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Buse: Why didn't you answer my call last night?
Melis: Oh, sorry! My phone was on airplane mode because I was studying for the history exam.

Why couldn't Buse reach Melis?
option_a: Melis was talking to someone else.
option_b: Melis lost her phone at school.
option_d: Melis turned off her network connection to study.
explanation: Melis tarih sınavına çalışırken telefonunu uçak moduna (airplane mode) aldığı için Buse ona ulaşamamıştır.

question_text: I always use _____ when I drive or walk in a crowded place so I can keep my hands free during a call.
explanation: Eller serbest konuşabilmek için Bluetooth kulaklık (Bluetooth headphones) kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the phone conversation carefully:
Caller: Hello, this is Emre Demir. May I speak to Mr. Yılmaz, the sales manager?
Secretary: Hold on, let me check if he's in his office... I'm sorry, he just stepped out for lunch. Would you like to leave a message?
Caller: Actually, it's urgent about today's shipment. Is there another number I can reach him at, or will he be back soon?
Secretary: He usually returns within 30 minutes. I'll mark it urgent and have him call you as soon as he's back.

Which statement is TRUE according to the dialogue?
option_a: Mr. Yılmaz is out of the city for a conference.
option_b: The secretary connected Emre directly to Mr. Yılmaz.
option_c: Mr. Yılmaz is expected to return in about half an hour.
option_d: Emre refused to let Mr. Yılmaz know it was urgent.
explanation: Sekreter 'He usually returns within 30 minutes' (Genellikle 30 dakika içinde döner) dediği için yarım saat içinde dönmesi beklenmektedir.

question_text:
Customer Service Call Log:
- Caller 1 (9:15): Wants to return a jacket that is too small.
- Caller 2 (9:30): Wants to change the delivery address of an order.
- Caller 3 (9:45): Reports that a coffee machine stopped working after 2 days.
- Caller 4 (10:00): Asks when a sold-out book will be back in stock.

Who is calling to report a DEFECTIVE (broken) product?
explanation: 3 numaralı arayan, kahve makinesinin 2 gün sonra çalışmayı durdurduğunu (bozuk/kusurlu ürün) bildirmektedir.

question_text:
Read the text:
'Although smartphones make our lives easier, overuse can lead to serious problems. Studies show that teenagers who spend more than 4 hours a day on their phones often experience poor sleep quality, neck pain, and lower school grades. Experts suggest turning off notifications during study hours and keeping phones out of the bedroom at night.'

Which recommendation is NOT made by the experts?
option_b: Limiting daily phone use to avoid health issues
option_c: Selling your smartphone if your grades drop
option_d: Not keeping phones in the bedroom at night
explanation: Uzmanlar ders çalışırken bildirimleri kapatmayı ve gece telefonu yatak odasından uzak tutmayı önerir; telefonu satmayı önermez.

question_text:
Table: Communication Preferences by Situation (Class 8C)
SituationPhone CallText MessageFace-to-Face
Emergency85%10%5%
Sharing a quick note10%80%10%
Apologizing to a friend20%15%65%

What can we conclude from the table?
option_a: Text messaging is the top choice in emergencies.
option_b: Students rarely text for quick notes.
option_c: Phone calls are the most popular way to apologize.
option_d: Students prefer direct personal contact when saying sorry.
explanation: Tabloya göre özür dilerken %65 oranla yüz yüze iletişim (direct personal contact) tercih edilmektedir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Agent: SunTravel Agency, how can I help you?
Client: I'd like to book a train ticket from Eskişehir to Istanbul for Saturday morning.
Agent: We have high-speed trains at 08:15 and 10:30. Which one do you prefer?
Client: The earlier one, please. A window seat if possible.
Agent: Done! Your seat 14A is reserved. The ticket costs 320 TL.

Which detail is INCORRECT about the reservation?
option_c: The trip is on Saturday morning.
option_d: The client chose a window seat.
explanation: Müşteri 'The earlier one' (Daha erken olan) diyerek 08:15 trenini seçmiştir; 10:30 bilgisi yanlıştır.

question_text:
Choose the correct future response for a spontaneous decision on the phone:
Caller: Oh, I didn't know Mr. Akın was in a meeting. Could you ask him to call me?
Secretary: Sure, I _____ him your message as soon as he comes out.
explanation: Telefon görüşmesi sırasındaki anlık kararlar ve söz vermeler için 'will + V1' (will give) kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the voicemail transcript:
'Hi Selin, it's Ece. It's 4:15 p.m. I'm outside the bookstore waiting for you, but your phone is switched off. Remember we agreed to meet at 4:00? I'll wait at the cafe next door until 4:45. Call me when you get this!'

How long will Ece wait at the cafe after leaving this message?
explanation: Mesaj saat 4:15'te bırakılmıştır ve Ece saat 4:45'e kadar bekleyeceğini söylemiştir; yani 30 dakika bekleyecektir.

question_text:
Phone Etiquette Guide:
1. Don't use speakerphone in public transport.
2. Always introduce yourself when making a call.
3. Never text while walking across busy streets.
4. Don't call people very late at night unless it's an emergency.

Which rule is specifically about ROAD SAFETY?
explanation: Yoğun caddelerden geçerken mesajlaşmamak (Rule 3) doğrudan yol güvenliğiyle (road safety) ilgilidir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Kaan: Hello, TechWorld? I bought a tablet yesterday, and the screen freezes every time I open an app.
Support: I'm sorry to hear that. Have you updated the software?
Kaan: Yes, it's up to date, and I even restarted it three times.
Support: In that case, please bring it to our service center with your receipt for a free replacement.

What does Kaan need to take to the service center?
option_a: The tablet and its purchase receipt
explanation: Destek görevlisi ücretsiz değişim (free replacement) için tableti ve fişini/faturasını (receipt) getirmesini istemiştir.

question_text: Which sentence CANNOT be said by the CALLER?
option_a: Could you ask him to call me back?
option_b: Hold on a second, I'll put you through to her.
option_c: Hello, this is Tarık speaking. Is Mert available?
option_d: I'm calling to confirm my hotel reservation.
explanation: 'Bir saniye bekleyin, sizi ona bağlıyorum' cümlesini arayan kişi (caller) değil, telefonu açan kişi/sekreter söyler.

question_text:
Survey Results: Why do teens use messaging apps instead of calling?
- 45% say 'It's faster for short questions.'
- 30% say 'You can reply whenever you are free.'
- 15% say 'You can send photos and links easily.'
- 10% say 'It's quieter in public places.'

Which statement is TRUE?
option_a: Sending photos is the top reason teens text.
option_b: Teens never make phone calls anymore.
option_c: Three-quarters of teens like messaging for speed and flexibility.
option_d: Half of the teens text because it is quieter.
explanation: Hız (%45) ve müsait olunca cevap verme esnekliği (%30) toplamda %75 (dörtte üç / three-quarters) eder.

question_text:
Read the four sentences and find the ODD one out:
(I) Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone in 1876. (II) This invention changed human communication forever. (III) Today, people also use smartphones to take high-quality photos and play games. (IV) To make a good fruit salad, you should chop fresh apples and bananas.
explanation: I, II ve III numaralı cümleler telefon ve iletişimle ilgiliyken IV numaralı cümle meyve salatasından bahsederek anlam bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Dad: Who was on the phone, Zeynep?
Zeynep: It was Aunt Leyla. She asked if we are free this Sunday.
Dad: What did you tell her?
Zeynep: I wasn't sure about your work schedule, so I told her you would call her back this evening.

Why didn't Zeynep give Aunt Leyla a definite answer?
option_a: She didn't know if her dad was working on Sunday.
option_b: Her phone battery died during the call.
option_c: She didn't want to see Aunt Leyla.
option_d: The line was too bad to hear Aunt Leyla.
explanation: Zeynep babasının çalışma programından emin olmadığı için kesin yanıt verememiştir.

question_text:
Compare Two Mobile Plans:
PlanCallsSMSInternetPrice
Basic500 mins250 SMS5 GB150 TL
Smart1000 mins500 SMS15 GB220 TL
UltraUnlimited1000 SMS30 GB300 TL

Can barely makes phone calls, rarely sends SMS, but watches lots of videos online (needs at least 12 GB). Which is the CHEAPEST plan that meets his needs?
explanation: Can'ın en az 12 GB internete ihtiyacı vardır. Basic planında 5 GB olduğu için yetmez; 15 GB sunan en ucuz plan Smart (220 TL) planıdır.

question_text:
Read the text:
'Many schools now have a 'phone-free' policy during lessons. Students place their phones in a locker in the morning and pick them up after school. Teachers report that students focus better in class and talk to each other more during breaks.'

What are the TWO positive effects of the 'phone-free' policy?
option_a: Shorter school hours and fewer exams
option_b: Higher battery life and better Wi-Fi speed
option_c: Better concentration in class and more face-to-face chatting at breaks
option_d: Faster homework completion and cheaper phone bills
explanation: Öğretmenler öğrencilerin derste daha iyi odaklandığını (focus better) ve teneffüslerde birbirleriyle daha çok konuştuğunu (talk more) belirtmektedir.

question_text:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence:
'I tried to reach my brother all morning, _____ his phone was out of coverage because he was camping in the mountains.'
explanation: Sabah boyunca ulaşmaya çalışması ile telefonun kapsama alanı dışında olması arasında zıtlık olduğu için 'but' kullanılır.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Operator: Hello, City Hospital. How may I direct your call?
Caller: Hello, I'd like to check the results of my blood test.
Operator: Certainly. Let me transfer you to the laboratory department. Please stay on the line.

What does 'transfer you' mean here?
option_a: Connect the call to another department
option_c: Send a taxi to the caller's house
option_d: Ask the caller to call back tomorrow
explanation: 'Transfer you' (sizi aktarmak/bağlamak) aramayı başka bir birime yönlendirmek anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Read the warning message:
'SECURITY ALERT: Never share one-time verification codes sent to your phone via SMS with anyone, even if they claim to be calling from your bank!'

What is the purpose of this warning?
option_a: To tell people to switch off their phones at banks
option_b: To protect people from phone scams and fraud
option_c: To advertise a new banking application
option_d: To encourage people to delete their SMS inbox
explanation: SMS ile gelen tek kullanımlık doğrulama kodlarını kimseyle paylaşmamak telefon dolandırıcılığından (scams and fraud) korunmak içindir.

question_text:
Note Left by Dad:
'Efe, the plumber called while you were at school. He can't come at 3 p.m. today because of an emergency job. He asked if tomorrow at 11 a.m. is okay. Please call him at 555-7721 before 6 p.m. to confirm.'

What happened to today's 3 p.m. appointment?
option_a: Efe cancelled it because he was at school.
option_b: The plumber already fixed the pipe at 11 a.m.
option_c: The plumber postponed it because of an urgent job.
explanation: Tesisatçı acil bir iş nedeniyle bugünkü saat 3 randevusunu yarına ertelemek (postponed) istemiştir.

question_text: Which pair of phrasal verbs have OPPOSITE meanings in phone conversations?
explanation: 'Pick up' telefonu açmak, 'Hang up' ise telefonu kapatmak anlamında zıttır.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Aslı: Hey, did you hear? Sinem won first prize in the painting contest!
Buse: Really? That's awesome! Wait, let me call her right now to congratulate her.
Aslı: Don't call her now, she's on stage receiving her medal. Send her a text instead!

Why does Aslı stop Buse from calling Sinem?
option_a: Because Sinem is currently on stage at the ceremony.
option_b: Because Buse forgot Sinem's phone number.
option_c: Because Aslı wants to call Sinem first.
option_d: Because Sinem doesn't have a mobile phone.
explanation: Sinem şu an sahnede madalyasını aldığı için aramak yerine mesaj atmasını söylemektedir.

question_text:
Chart: Average Daily Screen Time (Hours)
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Daily Screen Time" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "2,5h" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Videos" size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 86.0 P d1 119.9 86.0 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 80.0 "1,5h" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Messaging" size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 114.0 P d2 188.4 114.0 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 108.0 "1h" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Games" size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 142.0 P d3 256.9 142.0 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 136.0 "0,5h" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Study Apps" size=10 ```
How many hours IN TOTAL are spent on the phone daily according to the chart?
explanation: 2.5 + 1.5 + 1.0 + 0.5 = 5.5 saat toplam ekran süresi vardır.

question_text:
Read the paragraph:
'Before calling customer service, it is smart to have your customer ID and product serial number ready. This saves time and helps the agent solve your issue much faster without putting you on hold repeatedly.'

Why should you prepare your customer ID before calling?
option_a: To make the phone call more expensive
option_b: To get a free discount on your next order
option_c: To get faster help and avoid long waiting times
option_d: Because agents don't answer without a serial number
explanation: Müşteri numarasını hazır tutmak zaman kazandırır ve tekrar tekrar beklemeye alınmadan sorunun daha hızlı çözülmesini sağlar.

question_text:
Choose the most polite response when taking a message:
Caller: Could you tell Mr. Kaya that the blueprints are ready?
Secretary: _____
option_a: Why didn't you send an email instead?
option_c: Maybe, if I don't forget it.
option_d: Certainly, I'll make sure he gets the message.
explanation: 'Elbette, mesajı aldığından emin olacağım' en kibar ve profesyonel yanıttır.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Doruk: Hello, I'd like to order a large pepperoni pizza.
Staff: Sure, could I have your address, please?
Doruk: 42 Oak Street, Apartment 5.
Staff: Oh, I'm sorry, sir. Oak Street is outside our delivery area. Would you like to pick it up from our shop instead?

Why can't the pizza shop deliver to Doruk's house?
option_a: His address is too far from their delivery zone.
option_b: They ran out of pepperoni pizzas.
option_d: Doruk forgot to give his apartment number.
explanation: Çalışan, Oak Street'in teslimat bölgelerinin dışında (outside our delivery area) olduğunu belirtmiştir.

question_text:
Four teens talk about phone habits:
1. 'I never use my phone at the dinner table.'
2. 'I check my messages first thing when I wake up.'
3. 'I always ask permission before taking someone's photo.'
4. 'I keep my phone in my bag when hanging out with friends.'

Which teen shows a sign of smartphone dependency rather than good etiquette?
explanation: Uyanır uyanmaz ilk iş mesajlarını kontrol eden 2. genç telefon bağımlılığı işareti göstermektedir; diğerleri görgü kurallarına uymaktadır.

question_text:
Complete the dialogue:
Caller: Hello, is that the City Museum?
Staff: No, I think you have the wrong number. This is the City Library.
Caller: _____
option_a: Can I book a museum ticket anyway?
option_b: Please put me through to the museum.
option_c: Oh, my apologies! Have a nice day.
option_d: Why did you answer the library phone?
explanation: Yanlış numara aradığını anlayan arayan kişi özür dileyip iyi günler dilemelidir.

question_text:
Read the text:
'Voice assistants on smartphones can set alarms, send texts, and check the weather hands-free. However, they sometimes misunderstand accents or background noise, leading to funny or wrong messages.'

What is a limitation of voice assistants mentioned in the text?
option_a: They cannot check the weather forecast.
option_c: They only work when you type on the keyboard.
option_d: They may not understand speech clearly in noisy places.
explanation: Sesli asistanların aksanları veya arka plan gürültüsünü (background noise) yanlış anlayabildiği belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
Email vs. Phone Call Decision:
Melis needs to send a 10-page PDF report with charts to her science teacher, and she also wants to ask a quick yes/no question about tomorrow's trip.

Which combination is the MOST practical?
option_a: Email for the PDF report; text or quick call for the trip question
option_b: Phone call to read the 10-page report aloud
option_c: Postcard for the PDF report; email for the emergency
explanation: 10 sayfalık PDF raporu için e-posta, yarınki geziyle ilgili hızlı evet/hayır sorusu için ise mesaj veya kısa arama en pratik yoldur.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Eren: I called you at 8 p.m., why did it go straight to voicemail?
Bora: Oh, I was in the underground metro! There's no signal down there.

Why did Eren's call go to voicemail?
option_b: Bora's phone had no network signal in the metro.
option_d: Eren dialed the wrong country code.
explanation: Bora metroda olduğu ve aşağıda sinyal çekmediği için arama doğrudan sesli mesaja düşmüştür.

question_text: To enter your email account, you need to type your username and _____.
explanation: E-posta hesabına giriş yapmak için kullanıcı adı ve şifre (password) yazmanız gerekir.

question_text:
Ece: _____ do you use the Internet?
Kaan: About two hours a day.
explanation: Yanıt 'günde yaklaşık iki saat' olduğu için soru 'Kaç saat?' (How many hours) olmalıdır.

question_text: Click on the paperclip icon to add a file or photo as an _____ to your email.
explanation: E-postaya dosya veya fotoğraf eklemek için ataç simgesine tıklanır; buna ek (attachment) denir.

question_text: I want to _____ my vacation photos to my social media profile so my friends can see them.
explanation: Kendi fotoğraflarımızı internete/sosyal medyaya yüklemek için 'upload' fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Internet Safety Rule:
'Never share your home address, phone number, or school name with strangers online.'

What is this rule about?
explanation: Ev adresi, telefon numarası ve okul adını yabancılarla paylaşmamak kişisel bilgileri korumakla (protecting personal information) ilgilidir.

question_text: My dad uses the Internet to _____ bills and do online banking because it saves time.
explanation: Fatura ödemek için 'pay bills' kalıbı kullanılır.

question_text: Which one is a WEB BROWSER?
explanation: Google Chrome bir web tarayıcısıdır (web browser).

question_text:
Survey: Why do 8th graders use the Internet?
```fig size 320 200 text 160 14 "Internet Purposes" size=12 bold P O0 36.0 170.0 P O1 314.0 170.0 P O2 36.0 22.0 seg O0 O1 seg O0 O2 P a0 51.4 170.0 P b0 89.1 170.0 P c0 89.1 30.0 P d0 51.4 30.0 poly a0 b0 c0 d0 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 70.3 24.0 "40%" size=10 text 70.3 184.0 "Videos" size=10 P a1 119.9 170.0 P b1 157.6 170.0 P c1 157.6 82.5 P d1 119.9 82.5 poly a1 b1 c1 d1 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 138.8 76.5 "25%" size=10 text 138.8 184.0 "Homework" size=10 P a2 188.4 170.0 P b2 226.1 170.0 P c2 226.1 100.0 P d2 188.4 100.0 poly a2 b2 c2 d2 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 207.3 94.0 "20%" size=10 text 207.3 184.0 "Games" size=10 P a3 256.9 170.0 P b3 294.6 170.0 P c3 294.6 117.5 P d3 256.9 117.5 poly a3 b3 c3 d3 fill c=blue a=0.45 text 275.8 111.5 "15%" size=10 text 275.8 184.0 "Shopping" size=10 ```
What is the LEAST common purpose in the chart?
explanation: Grafikte %15 ile en düşük oran alışveriş (Shopping) seçeneğindedir.

question_text: Before you can post comments on this website, you need to _____ for a free account.
explanation: Yeni bir hesap oluşturmak/kayıt olmak için 'sign up' (register) kullanılır.

question_text:
Arda: My computer is running very slowly and weird pop-ups keep appearing.
Mert: You should scan it with an _____ program.
explanation: Bilgisayar yavaşladığında ve garip pencereler çıktığında antivirüs (antivirus) programıyla taramak gerekir.

question_text:
Read the message:
'Hi Selin, I found a great website for our geography project. Here is the link! Let me know if you can open the PDF file. – Burcu'

Why did Burcu send this message?
option_b: To invite Selin to play an online game
option_c: To help Selin with their geography project
option_d: To ask for Selin's email password
explanation: Burcu coğrafya projeleri için harika bir web sitesi bulduğunu söyleyerek link paylaşmıştır.

question_text: I always _____ my favorite science channel on YouTube so I don't miss new videos.
explanation: Bir kanala abone olmak için 'subscribe to' ifadesi kullanılır.

question_text: Which device do we need to connect our home to the wireless Internet?
explanation: Evde kablosuz internete bağlanmak için modem/yönlendirici (Modem / Router) gerekir.

question_text:
Button Guide on a Website:
- Sign in: Enter your existing account
- Sign out: Leave your account safely
- Download: Save a file to your device
- Search: Find information

Which button should you click after using a public computer at the library?
explanation: Kütüphanedeki ortak bilgisayarı kullandıktan sonra hesabınızdan güvenli çıkış yapmak için 'Sign out' butonuna tıklamalısınız.

question_text:
Nehir: Can I _____ this song to my phone so I can listen to it offline?
Batu: Yes, just click the download button.
explanation: İnternetten telefona şarkı indirmek için 'download' fiili kullanılır.

question_text: Don't click on unknown _____ in emails from strangers; they might contain viruses.
explanation: Yabancılardan gelen e-postalardaki bilinmeyen bağlantılara (links) tıklamamak gerekir.

question_text:
Table: Family Internet Habits
MemberMain Activity
MomReading online news
DadDoing online banking
EfeResearching for school
SudeWatching cartoons

Who uses the Internet for educational purposes?
explanation: Tabloda okul için araştırma yapan (Researching for school) Efe interneti eğitim amaçlı kullanmaktadır.

question_text: A strong password should include uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and _____.
explanation: Güçlü bir şifre büyük harf, küçük harf, rakam ve semboller (symbols) içermelidir.

question_text:
Can: _____
Duru: I usually use it to check my emails and search for recipes.
option_c: What do you use the Internet for?
option_d: When did you buy your laptop?
explanation: Duru interneti e-posta kontrol etmek ve tarif aramak için kullandığını söylediğine göre soru kullanım amacıdır.

question_text:
Online Store Review:
'★★★★★ Great backpack! Fast shipping and strong zipper. I totally recommend it! – Tarık'

What is Tarık doing?
option_d: Writing a positive comment about a product
explanation: Tarık 5 yıldız verip ürünü tavsiye ederek olumlu bir yorum (positive comment) yazmaktadır.

question_text: Spending 7 or 8 hours a day playing online games can lead to Internet _____.
explanation: Günde 7-8 saat çevrimiçi oyun oynamak internet bağımlılığına (addiction) yol açabilir.

question_text: When you finish writing an email, click '_____' to deliver it.
explanation: E-postayı yazmayı bitirince göndermek için 'Send' (Gönder) butonuna tıklanır.

question_text:
Read the notice:
'FREE WI-FI ZONE! Network Name: Cafe_Guest | Password: coffee2026'

Where would you probably see this sign?
explanation: Ağ adı 'Cafe_Guest' ve şifresi 'coffee2026' olduğu için bu tabela bir kafede görülür.

question_text: Be polite when you write _____ under someone's blog post or video. Cyberbullying is never okay.
explanation: Birinin blog yazısı veya videosunun altına yorum (comments) yazarken kibar olunmalıdır.

question_text: I couldn't join the online English lesson yesterday _____ my Internet connection was down.
explanation: Derse katılamama nedeni internet bağlantısının kesik olmasıdır; neden bildiren 'because' bağlacı kullanılır.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Ozan: Hey, the Wi-Fi symbol has an exclamation mark on it.
Bora: That means there is no Internet access right now.

What is the problem?
option_a: The printer ran out of paper.
option_b: They cannot connect to the Internet.
explanation: Wi-Fi simgesindeki ünlem işareti internet erişimi olmadığını (cannot connect to the Internet) gösterir.

question_text: If you want to find information about penguins, type 'penguins' into a _____ like Google or Bing.
explanation: Bilgi aramak için Google veya Bing gibi bir arama motoru (search engine) kullanılır.

question_text: Which word means 'to stay connected to the Internet'?
explanation: 'Online' (çevrimiçi) internete bağlı olma durumunu ifade eder.

question_text:
Read the tip:
'Always check the URL! Safe shopping websites usually start with https:// and show a padlock icon.'

What helps you know a shopping site is secure?
option_a: A padlock icon and 'https://' in the address
explanation: İpucuna göre adresin 'https://' ile başlaması ve kilit simgesi (padlock icon) sitenin güvenli olduğunu gösterir.

question_text: My grandmother doesn't know how to _____ the Net, so I help her find health articles.
explanation: İnternette gezinmek için 'surf the Net' kalıbı kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the four students' statements:
- Ada: I never meet people in real life whom I only know online.
- Cem: I use '123456' as my password for all my accounts.
- Ece: I ask my parents before downloading any new software.
- Kaan: I only visit reliable educational websites for homework.

Who is NOT following Internet safety rules?
explanation: Tüm hesapları için '123456' gibi çok zayıf ve aynı şifreyi kullanan Cem internet güvenliği kurallarına uymamaktadır.

question_text:
Melis: I'm trying to send this 50 MB video via email, but it won't attach.
Tuna: The file is too large for email. Why don't you _____ it to a cloud drive and share the link?
explanation: Büyük dosyayı e-postayla gönderemediği için bulut sürücüye yükleyip (upload) link paylaşması önerilir.

question_text:
Email Inbox:
From: Unknown_Prize@winfast.xyz
Subject: CONGRATULATIONS! YOU WON A FREE PHONE!
Message: Click this link and enter your credit card number for shipping.

What should you do with this email?
option_b: Enter your credit card number right away
option_c: Forward it to all your classmates
option_d: Delete it immediately without clicking the link
explanation: Tanınmayan bir adresten gelen sahte ödül ve kredi kartı bilgisi isteyen e-posta dolandırıcılıktır; linke tıklamadan hemen silinmelidir.

question_text: Which sentence expresses a NEGATIVE effect of the Internet?
option_a: People can buy train tickets in seconds.
option_b: Spending too much time online can make teens antisocial.
option_c: Online dictionaries help students learn new vocabulary.
option_d: Video conferencing allows teams to work from home.
explanation: Çevrimiçi çok fazla vakit geçirmenin gençleri antisosyal yapması internetin olumsuz bir etkisidir.

question_text:
Survey: Daily Internet Time of 100 Teens
Hours per dayPercentage
Less than 1 hour10%
1–2 hours35%
3–4 hours40%
More than 4 hours15%

Which statement is TRUE according to the table?
option_a: 1–2 hours is more common than 3–4 hours.
option_b: Nobody spends more than 4 hours on the Internet.
option_c: The largest group spends 3 to 4 hours online every day.
option_d: Half of the teens spend less than 1 hour online.
explanation: Tabloda en büyük grup %40 ile günde 3–4 saat çevrimiçi olanlardır.

question_text:
Sude: Do you believe every news story you see on social media?
Emir: Of course not! I always _____ the information from reliable news sites first.
explanation: Sosyal medyadaki haberlere hemen inanmayıp güvenilir kaynaklardan doğrulamak/iki kez kontrol etmek (double-check) gerekir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Mom: Sinan, you've been staring at that screen for three hours! Give your eyes a rest.
Sinan: Just five more minutes, Mom. I'm finishing my history presentation.
Mom: Okay, but remember to save your work before shutting down the computer.

What is Sinan using the computer for?
explanation: Sinan 'I'm finishing my history presentation' diyerek tarih sunumunu hazırladığını belirtmektedir.

question_text: I prefer online shopping _____ it is sometimes risky if you don't use trusted websites.
explanation: Çevrimiçi alışverişi tercih etmesi ile bazen riskli olması arasında zıtlık vardır; 'even though' (-e rağmen) bağlacı kullanılır.

question_text:
Netiquette (Internet Etiquette) Poster:
1. Don't type in ALL CAPS; it looks like shouting.
2. Respect people's privacy—don't post their photos without asking.
3. Give credit when you use someone else's work.

Which rule is about COPYRIGHT?
explanation: Başkasının eserini kullanırken kaynak/atıf göstermek (Give credit) telif haklarıyla (copyright) ilgilidir.

question_text: If you forget your password, click 'Forgot Password?' to _____ it via your email.
explanation: Şifre unutulduğunda e-posta üzerinden sıfırlamak (reset) gerekir.

question_text:
Bar Chart: Teens' Favorite Online Activities

question_text:
Doruk: Why did you block that user on your social media account?
Leyla: Because he kept leaving rude _____ on my drawings.
explanation: Çizimlerinin altına kaba yorumlar (comments) bıraktığı için kullanıcıyı engellemiştir.

question_text:
Read the text:
'E-learning platforms allow students from all over the world to watch recorded lectures, take online quizzes, and practice languages from home—often for free.'

What is the main topic of the text?
option_d: How to fix a slow computer
explanation: Metin çevrimiçi eğitim platformlarının öğrencilere sunduğu imkânları ve faydaları (benefits of online education) anlatmaktadır.

question_text: Always _____ the file you downloaded with antivirus software before opening it.
explanation: İndirilen dosyayı açmadan önce antivirüsle taramak (scan) gerekir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Can: Hey, look at this website! It sells brand-new sneakers for 50 TL!
Buse: Wait a minute, Can. That price is way too low to be real. Let's check if the site has any real reviews or contact info.
Can: Good idea, I don't want to get scammed.

Why is Buse suspicious of the website?
option_a: She wants to buy the sneakers first.
option_b: The website is in another language.
explanation: Buse fiyatın gerçek olamayacak kadar düşük olduğunu düşündüğü için siteden şüphelenmektedir.

question_text: Which pair of words are OPPOSITES?
explanation: 'Upload' (yüklemek) ve 'Download' (indirmek) zıt anlamlıdır. Diğer çiftler eş anlamlıdır.

question_text:
Email from Teacher:
'Dear 8A, please upload your English essays to the school portal by Friday 5 p.m. Do not send them via WhatsApp. Make sure your file is named: Name_Surname_Essay.pdf.'

How should students submit their essays?
option_a: By printing them out and leaving them on the desk
option_b: By emailing them on Saturday morning
option_c: By uploading a properly named PDF to the school portal
option_d: By sending a WhatsApp message to the teacher
explanation: Öğretmen ödevlerin Cuma 17:00'ye kadar okul portalına doğru isimlendirilmiş PDF olarak yüklenmesini istemiştir.

question_text: When you create an account, read the _____ carefully so you know how the website uses your data.
explanation: Web sitesinin verilerinizi nasıl kullandığını anlamak için gizlilik politikasını (privacy policy) okumak gerekir.

question_text:
Read the four sentences:
1. Check your Internet connection first.
2. Open your web browser.
3. Type the website address in the address bar.
4. Press 'Enter' to visit the page.

What do these steps explain?
option_a: How to change a Wi-Fi password
option_b: How to install an antivirus program
option_c: How to delete an email account
explanation: Bu 4 adım bir web sitesini nasıl ziyaret edeceğimizi (How to visit a website) anlatmaktadır.

question_text:
Kaan: I want to watch the documentary, _____ my Internet speed is too slow right now and it keeps buffering.
Efe: Try lowering the video quality to 480p.
explanation: Belgeseli izlemek istemesi ile internet hızının yavaş olması arasında zıtlık olduğu için 'but' kullanılır.

question_text:
Tech Support Chat:
User: I keep getting an 'Incorrect Password' error.
Bot: Please check if your 'Caps Lock' key is turned on, as passwords are case-sensitive.

What does 'case-sensitive' mean?
option_a: You must type your password very slowly.
option_c: Uppercase and lowercase letters are treated differently.
explanation: 'Case-sensitive' (büyük/küçük harf duyarlı), şifrede büyük ve küçük harflerin farklı değerlendirildiği anlamına gelir.

question_text: To join an online video meeting, you need a working webcam and a _____.
explanation: Çevrimiçi görüntülü toplantıya katılmak için çalışan bir kamera ve mikrofon (microphone) gerekir.

question_text:
Read the note:
'Whenever I study online, I close all social media tabs and put my phone in another room. Otherwise, notifications distract me every two minutes!'

Why does the writer close social media tabs?
option_a: To save battery on the phone
explanation: Yazar bildirimlerin dikkatini dağıtmaması ve ders çalışırken odaklanabilmek (stay focused) için sosyal medya sekmelerini kapatmaktadır.

question_text: Which one is an example of CYBERBULLYING?
option_a: Reporting a fake account to the website moderators
option_b: Posting mean and hurtful messages about a classmate online
option_c: Sharing a funny cat video with your family
option_d: Helping a friend find a good math website
explanation: Bir sınıf arkadaşı hakkında internetten kaba ve kırıcı mesajlar paylaşmak siber zorbalık (cyberbullying) örneğidir.

question_text:
Table: Pros & Cons of Online Shopping
ProsCons
Open 24/7Can't try clothes on
Easy price comparisonShipping takes days
Home deliveryRisk of fake websites

Which item is a DISADVANTAGE of online shopping according to the table?
explanation: Tabloda 'Cons' (Dezavantajlar) sütununda 'Shipping takes days' (Kargo günler sürer) yer almaktadır.

question_text: Before you throw away or sell an old computer, remember to _____ all your personal files.
explanation: Eski bilgisayarı satmadan veya atmadan önce kişisel dosyaları yedekleyip silmek (back up and erase) gerekir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Selin: Did you see the email from our science teacher?
Mert: No, I checked my inbox, and there's nothing from her.
Selin: Check your 'Spam' or 'Junk' folder! Sometimes school emails go there.

Where might Mert find the teacher's email?
explanation: Selin öğretmenin e-postasının 'Spam' veya 'Junk' (Gereksiz) klasörüne düşmüş olabileceğini söylemektedir.

question_text: Which website ending usually belongs to an EDUCATIONAL institution like a university?
explanation: Eğitim kurumlarının web siteleri genellikle '.edu' (education) uzantısını kullanır.

question_text:
Text:
'Digital footprints are the trails of data you leave behind every time you go online—like your search history, likes, comments, and uploaded photos. Even if you delete something, copies may still exist online.'

What is the main message of this text?
option_a: Deleting a photo removes it from the entire world instantly.
option_b: Never use search engines for homework.
option_c: Think carefully before posting anything online.
option_d: Digital footprints only happen when you shop online.
explanation: Metin internette bıraktığımız dijital ayak izlerinin silsek bile kalabileceğini, bu yüzden paylaşım yapmadan önce dikkatli düşünmemiz gerektiğini vurgular.

question_text: I always use _____ mode or clear my browser history when I use a shared computer at school.
explanation: Ortak bilgisayarda gizlilik için gizli (private / incognito) mod kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue carefully:
Ece: Hey Arda, someone sent me a message saying I won a gaming console, and they want my home address to deliver it.
Arda: Did you enter any contest recently?
Ece: No, never!
Arda: Then it's definitely a phishing scam. Don't reply, block the sender, and report the account.

Why is Arda sure that the message is a scam?
option_a: Because the sender asked for Ece's favorite color.
option_b: Because gaming consoles are not sold online.
option_c: Because Ece never entered any contest to win a console.
option_d: Because Arda also won the same console.
explanation: Ece hiçbir yarışmaya katılmadığı halde ödül kazandığının söylenmesi bunun kesinlikle bir oltalama dolandırıcılığı (phishing scam) olduğunu gösterir.

question_text:
Table: Internet Usage in Two Households
ActivityYılmaz FamilyKaya Family
Online BankingYesNo
E-LearningYesYes
Online ShoppingNoYes
Video StreamingYesYes

Which statement is TRUE according to the table?
option_a: The Kaya family pays bills via online banking.
option_c: The Yılmaz family prefers online shopping to banking.
option_d: Both families use the Internet for education and entertainment.
explanation: Tabloya göre her iki aile de E-Learning (eğitim) ve Video Streaming (eğlence) için interneti kullanmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the article excerpt:
'Fake news spreads six times faster than true news on social media because it is often designed to shock people or make them angry. Before sharing a dramatic headline, check who wrote it, look at the date, and see if major reliable news agencies are reporting the same story.'

Which is NOT one of the ways to spot fake news mentioned in the text?
option_a: Checking if reliable news agencies report it
option_b: Checking the author of the article
option_c: Checking how many likes the post has
explanation: Metinde yazarı, tarihi ve güvenilir haber ajanslarını kontrol etmek önerilir; gönderinin kaç beğeni (likes) aldığına bakmak önerilmez.

question_text:
Password Strength Check:
- Password 1: ali1999
- Password 2: password
- Password 3: Tr#89!mK2v
- Password 4: 11223344

Which password is the SAFEST against hackers, and why?
option_a: Password 1, because it includes a name and a birth year.
option_b: Password 2, because it is easy to remember.
option_c: Password 4, because it has eight digits.
option_d: Password 3, because it mixes uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols.
explanation: Password 3 (Tr#89!mK2v) büyük harf, küçük harf, rakam ve sembolleri karıştırdığı için en güvenli şifredir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Nehir: I'm doing a science report on climate change, and I copied three paragraphs directly from a blog without mentioning the website.
Teacher: Be careful, Nehir. That's called plagiarism. You should summarize the ideas in your own words and cite your source.

What does the teacher advise Nehir to do?
option_b: Rewrite the ideas in her own words and name the source
option_c: Copy more paragraphs from different blogs
option_d: Hide the website name from the teacher
explanation: Öğretmen fikirleri kendi cümleleriyle özetlemesini ve kaynağını belirtmesini (cite your source) tavsiye etmektedir.

question_text:

How many teens (out of 200) tell their parents about cyberbullying?
explanation: Ankete 200 genç katılmıştır ve %30'u ailesine söylemektedir: 200 × 30 / 100 = 60 genç.

question_text:
Find the sentence that breaks the paragraph's unity:
(I) The Internet has revolutionized how we work and learn. (II) Today, millions of people attend online courses or work remotely from home. (III) You should always preheat the oven before baking chocolate cookies. (IV) However, spending too much time sitting in front of a screen can harm our posture.
explanation: I, II ve IV numaralı cümleler internetin çalışma ve öğrenme üzerindeki etkisini anlatırken III numaralı cümle kurabiye pişirmeden bahsederek bütünlüğü bozar.

question_text:
Read the email problem:
'Hi IT Support, every time I try to log in to my school portal, it says "Account Locked due to too many failed attempts." I think my little brother typed wrong passwords while playing on my laptop. How can I unlock it?'

Why was the student's account locked?
option_a: The student forgot to pay the Internet bill.
option_b: A virus deleted the student's laptop files.
option_c: The school portal website was shut down.
option_d: Someone entered the wrong password too many times.
explanation: Küçük kardeşinin çok fazla kez yanlış şifre girmesi nedeniyle hesap güvenlik amacıyla kilitlenmiştir.

question_text:
Compare Two Study Habits:
Kerem: Searches a topic on 3 different reliable sites, takes handwritten notes, and checks facts.
Bora: Clicks the very first link he sees, copies the text, and doesn't check who wrote it.

Why is Kerem's research method better?
option_a: He finishes his homework in two minutes.
option_b: He verifies information from multiple trusted sources.
option_c: He never uses the Internet for school.
option_d: He copies text faster than Bora.
explanation: Kerem bilgiyi birden fazla güvenilir kaynaktan doğruladığı için araştırma yöntemi daha iyidir.

question_text:
Complete the sentence with the correct connector:
'My tablet's storage is completely full, _____ I need to delete some old videos before I can download the new study app.'
explanation: Depolama alanının dolu olması sebep, eski videoları silme ihtiyacı ise sonuçtur; sonuç bildiren 'so' (bu yüzden) kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the software update pop-up:
'Update Ready! Version 4.2 fixes security bugs and improves battery performance. Estimated time: 5 minutes. Note: Your device will restart during the update.'

What should you do BEFORE clicking 'Install Now'?
option_c: Save any open documents or unfinished work
explanation: Güncelleme sırasında cihaz yeniden başlatılacağı (restart) için açık belgeleri ve yarım işleri kaydetmek gerekir.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Aslı: I'm trying to buy a concert ticket online, and the site asks for my 3-digit CVV code on the back of the card.
Mom: Let me check the site first. Okay, it's the official ticket seller and has 'https://'. It's safe to enter it.
Aslı: Great, thanks for checking!

What did Mom check before allowing Aslı to pay?
option_a: How many songs the band would play
option_b: Whether the concert was sold out
option_c: If Aslı's friends were going too
option_d: Whether the website was official and encrypted
explanation: Anne sitenin resmi satıcı olup olmadığını ve 'https://' şifrelemesine sahip olup olmadığını kontrol etmiştir.

question_text:
Read the text:
'Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your online accounts. Even if a hacker steals your password, they cannot log in without the temporary code sent to your phone.'

How does 2FA protect your account?
option_a: It automatically deletes your social media posts.
option_b: It requires a second verification step besides the password.
option_c: It blocks all emails from your friends.
option_d: It makes your password shorter and easier.
explanation: İki faktörlü doğrulama (2FA), şifreye ek olarak telefona gelen geçici kod gibi ikinci bir doğrulama adımı gerektirerek hesabı korur.

question_text: Which action shows GOOD 'Netiquette'?
option_a: Asking a friend's permission before tagging them in a photo
option_b: Sharing a private chat screenshot in a public group
option_c: Using someone else's Wi-Fi without telling them
option_d: Leaving angry comments in ALL CAPS
explanation: Bir arkadaşını fotoğrafta etiketlemeden önce izin istemek iyi bir internet görgü kuralı (netiquette) örneğidir.

question_text:
Internet Usage Log (One Week):
Mert spent: 6 hours on online classes, 4 hours on coding tutorials, 3 hours on gaming, and 2 hours on watching music videos.

What percentage of Mert's weekly Internet time was spent on LEARNING (classes + coding)?
explanation: Toplam süre 6+4+3+2 = 15 saattir. Öğrenme (ders + kodlama) 6+4 = 10 saattir. 10/15 = %66,7 (yaklaşık %67).

question_text:
Read the warning on a public Wi-Fi network:
'You are connected to Airport_Free_WiFi. Avoid logging into banking apps or entering sensitive passwords on unencrypted public networks.'

What should you avoid doing on Airport_Free_WiFi?
option_b: Checking the weather in your destination city
option_d: Checking your bank account or typing important passwords
explanation: Şifrelenmemiş halka açık ağlarda bankacılık uygulamalarına girmekten ve hassas şifreler yazmaktan kaçınılmalıdır.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Deniz: Can you send me the math worksheet?
Kaan: Sure, I just emailed it to you.
Deniz: Hmm, I got your email, but there's no file in it!
Kaan: Oops! I wrote the message and clicked Send, but I forgot to click the paperclip icon.

What did Kaan forget to do?
option_b: Attach the worksheet file to the email
option_d: Connect his computer to the Wi-Fi
explanation: Kaan ataç simgesine tıklamayı, yani çalışma kâğıdını e-postaya eklemeyi (attach) unutmuştur.

question_text:
Choose the correct word to complete the sentence:
'Because of the _____ on that website, my browser kept opening five new tabs every time I clicked anywhere.'
explanation: Tıklanan her yerde yeni reklam sekmeleri açtıran zararlı yazılıma malware/adware denir.

question_text:
Read the paragraph:
'Cloud storage services allow you to save your files on remote servers instead of just your phone's memory. This means even if your phone breaks or gets lost, your photos and documents remain safe and accessible from any device.'

What is the main benefit of cloud storage?
option_a: It doubles your phone's battery life.
option_b: It fixes broken phone screens automatically.
option_c: Your files stay safe and accessible even if you lose your device.
option_d: You don't need an Internet connection to upload files.
explanation: Bulut depolamanın ana faydası, cihazınız bozulsa veya kaybolsa bile dosyalarınızın güvende kalması ve başka cihazlardan erişilebilmesidir.

question_text:
Four teens talk about their online habits:
1. Efe: I use a password manager so every site has a unique strong password.
2. Nil: I accept friend requests from anyone to get more followers.
3. Cem: I check the privacy settings on my profile every month.
4. Ada: I never click on 'You won a prize!' pop-ups.

Which teen is putting their online safety at RISK?
explanation: Sırf daha fazla takipçi kazanmak için tanımadığı herkesin arkadaşlık isteğini kabul eden Nil çevrimiçi güvenliğini riske atmaktadır.

question_text:
Tech Article:
'Cookies are small text files that websites save on your browser to remember your preferences, such as your language choice or items in your shopping cart. While useful, many users clear them regularly for privacy.'

Why do websites use cookies?
option_a: To remember user settings and shopping cart items
option_b: To block you from visiting other sites
option_c: To damage your computer's hard drive
option_d: To speed up your Wi-Fi router
explanation: Çerezler (Cookies) dil tercihi veya alışveriş sepetindeki ürünler gibi kullanıcı ayarlarını hatırlamak için kullanılır.

question_text: Which question is about INTERNET CONNECTION SPEED?
option_a: Who do you usually video-chat with?
option_b: How many megabits per second (Mbps) is your Wi-Fi?
option_c: How often do you change your password?
option_d: What is your favorite social media platform?
explanation: Saniyede kaç megabit (Mbps) olduğu internet bağlantı hızını (connection speed) sorar.

question_text:
Dialogue:
Teacher: Why didn't you upload your project last night, Ozan?
Ozan: I tried at 11:55 p.m., but the website crashed because too many students were uploading at the exact same minute!
Teacher: That's why I always remind you not to wait until the last minute.

What caused the website to crash?
option_a: Ozan's computer had no antivirus program
option_b: The teacher deleted the school portal
option_c: Heavy traffic from many students uploading at the deadline
option_d: Ozan forgot his username and password
explanation: Çok fazla öğrencinin son dakikada aynı anda yükleme yapması (heavy traffic) web sitesinin çökmesine neden olmuştur.

question_text:
Table: Website Evaluation Checklist
FeatureSite ASite B
Author listed?Yes (Dr. Akın)No
Last updated20262011
References cited?YesNo
Pop-up adsNoneMany

Which website is MORE reliable for a science project, and why?
option_a: Site B, because 2011 information never changes.
option_b: Both are equally reliable for school research.
option_c: Site B, because it has lots of pop-up ads.
option_d: Site A, because it has a known author, recent info, and references.
explanation: Site A'nın yazarı bellidir, 2026 yılında güncellenmiştir, kaynakçası vardır ve reklam yoktur; bu yüzden daha güvenilirdir.

question_text:
Read the text:
'Screen-free evenings are becoming popular among families. Once a week, they turn off all phones, tablets, and computers at 7 p.m. and spend the evening playing board games, talking, or reading together.'

What is the goal of 'screen-free evenings'?
option_a: To strengthen family communication without digital distractions
option_b: To save money on buying new tablets
option_c: To practice typing faster on keyboards
option_d: To watch more movies on television
explanation: Ekransız akşamların amacı dijital dikkat dağıtıcılar olmadan aile içi iletişimi güçlendirmektir.

question_text:
Choose the correct order of steps to send an email with a file:
I. Click 'Attach' and select your file.
II. Click 'Compose' (New Email).
III. Type the recipient's email address and subject.
IV. Write your message and click 'Send'.
explanation: Doğru sıra: Yeni e-posta aç (II) -> Alıcı ve konu yaz (III) -> Dosya ekle (I) -> Mesajı yazıp gönder (IV).

question_text:
Dialogue:
Sena: I love this recipe video! How can I find it easily next week?
Mert: Just click the 'Save' or 'Bookmark' icon under the video, and it will stay in your saved list.

What does 'bookmark' mean here?
option_a: Send the video to a printer
option_b: Delete the video from the internet
option_c: Save the page or video link for easy access later
option_d: Block the person who uploaded the video
explanation: 'Bookmark' (yer imi eklemek), daha sonra kolayca ulaşmak için sayfayı veya videoyu kaydetmek anlamına gelir.

question_text:
Read the note:
'Remember: Anything you write in a public comment section can be read by teachers, future employers, and strangers—even years later!'

What lesson does this note teach?
option_a: Only write comments in secret languages.
option_b: Never use the Internet to look for a job.
option_d: Write respectful and thoughtful comments online.
explanation: Herkese açık yorumların yıllar sonra bile herkes tarafından okunabileceği hatırlatılarak internette saygılı ve düşünceli yorumlar yazılması gerektiği öğretilmektedir.

question_text: Which term refers to 'buying and selling products or services over the Internet'?
explanation: İnternet üzerinden ürün veya hizmet alıp satmaya e-ticaret (E-commerce) denir.

question_text:
Read the summary:
'In 2025, a survey of 500 teenagers showed that 72% use the Internet mainly for educational videos and homework help, while 28% use it mostly for gaming. Interestingly, 85% said they prefer face-to-face hangouts with friends over online chatting.'

Which statement is TRUE according to the summary?
option_a: Only 28 students took part in the survey.
option_b: Most teens still value meeting friends in person more than online chatting.
option_c: Teenagers never watch educational videos online.
option_d: Gaming is the main reason teenagers use the Internet.
explanation: Özet metinde gençlerin %85'inin çevrimiçi sohbet yerine arkadaşlarıyla yüz yüze buluşmayı tercih ettiği belirtilmektedir.

question_text:
Leo: "I love extreme water sports. What about you?"
Mia: "Me too! Especially ---- because paddling on a wild river with a team is thrilling."
explanation: Diyalogda vahşi bir nehirde ekiple kürek çekmekten (paddling on a wild river) söz edildiği için doğru spor raftingdir.

question_text: Which equipment do you definitely need if you want to go skydiving?
explanation: Gökyüzünden atlama (skydiving) sporu için mutlaka paraşüt (parachute) gerekir; kürek, palet ve el feneri diğer sporlara aittir.

question_text: Read the note on the sports club board: "Attention! Never go rock climbing without a helmet and a strong rope." What is this note about?
option_b: The cost of a climbing course
explanation: Not, tırmanış sırasında kask ve sağlam ip kullanılması gerektiğini vurgulayarak güvenlik kurallarını (safety rules) hatırlatmaktadır.

question_text:
Tom: "Which one do you prefer, bungee jumping or trekking?"
Eva: "I prefer trekking to bungee jumping because I think jumping off a bridge is ----."
explanation: Eva köprüden atlamak yerine doğa yürüyüşünü tercih ettiğine göre bungee jumpingi çok riskli (too risky) bulmaktadır.

question_text:
Look at the mini brochure: "Blue Cave Diving
• Depth: 18 m
• Equipment: Oxygen tank, wetsuit, mask
• Age limit: 15+" Which question CANNOT be answered according to the brochure?
option_a: How much does the dive cost?
explanation: Broşürde derinlik (18 m), yaş sınırı (15+) ve ekipman bilgisi vardır; ancak ücret (cost) bilgisi yer almamaktadır.

question_text: Riding a hot-air balloon over Cappadocia is ---- than watching TV at home.
explanation: İki etkinlik karşılaştırıldığı için comparative yapı kullanılır; "exciting" uzun sıfat olduğundan "more exciting" doğru biçimdir.

question_text:
Sam wrote in his diary:
"Today I explored dark underground tunnels with a headlamp. It was cold and wet, but seeing stalactites was amazing!"
Which activity did Sam try?
explanation: Yer altı tünellerini kafa lambasıyla keşfetmek ve sarkıtlar görmek mağaracılık (caving) etkinliğidir.

question_text:
Jack: "I would rather go canoeing than try motor racing."
What does Jack mean?
option_a: He dislikes both canoeing and motor racing.
option_b: He prefers motor racing to canoeing.
option_c: He has never tried canoeing before.
option_d: He wants to go canoeing more than motor racing.
explanation: "Would rather A than B" kalıbı A'yı B'ye tercih etmek anlamına gelir; Jack kanoyu motor yarışına tercih etmektedir.

question_text:
Look at the table of two weekend trips:
TripPriceDuration
Forest Trekking25 EUR3 hours
River Canoeing40 EUR2 hours
Which statement is TRUE?
option_a: Forest trekking is cheaper than river canoeing.
option_b: Forest trekking is more expensive than canoeing.
option_c: Both trips cost the same amount.
option_d: River canoeing lasts longer than trekking.
explanation: Tabloya göre orman yürüyüşü 25 EUR, nehir kanosu 40 EUR'dur; yani orman yürüyüşü daha ucuzdur.

question_text: Before you jump out of an airplane, you must check your ---- carefully.
explanation: Uçaktan atlamadan önce kontrol edilmesi gereken temel güvenlik ekipmanı paraşüttür (parachute).

question_text:
Clara: "Why don't we try zip-lining this Saturday?"
Ben: "No, thanks. I'm afraid of heights."
Why does Ben refuse Clara's offer?
option_a: He has a math exam on Saturday.
option_b: He thinks zip-lining is too cheap.
option_c: He doesn't feel comfortable in high places.
option_d: He prefers jumping from high bridges.
explanation: Ben yükseklikten korktuğunu (afraid of heights) söyleyerek yüksek yerlerde rahat hissetmediğini belirtmiştir.

question_text: Among all the sports in our camp, heli-skiing is ---- one.
explanation: Kamptaki tüm sporlar (üç ve üzeri) arasında en tehlikelisi anlatıldığı için superlative yapı "the most dangerous" kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the text message:
"Hi Mert! Our mountain biking group meets at 8 a.m. at Pine Gate. Don't forget your knee pads and water bottle. – Ali"
What should Mert bring?
option_a: Protection for his knees and something to drink
explanation: Mesajda dizlik (knee pads) ve su şişesi (water bottle) getirilmesi istenmektedir.

question_text: You wear a ---- to protect your head while skateboarding or cycling.
explanation: Kaykay veya bisiklet sürerken başı korumak için kask (helmet) takılır.

Which activity is the most popular among teens?
explanation: Grafikte en yüksek çubuk 42 kişi ile Camping (kampçılık) etkinliğine aittir.

question_text: Nora enjoys swimming underwater to see colorful fish and coral reefs. Her favorite sport is ----.
explanation: Su altında renkli balıkları ve mercan resiflerini görmek için yapılan spor tüplü dalıştır (scuba diving).

question_text:
Read the poster: "Sunset Paragliding
Fly like a bird over Oludeniz! Professional pilots guide every beginner. Safe, unforgettable, 30 minutes in the sky!" Who can join this activity?
option_a: People trying paragliding for the first time
option_b: Only professional pilots with 10 years of experience
option_c: People who hate being in the air
option_d: Swimmers who want to dive underwater
explanation: Posterde profesyonel pilotların her yeni başlayana (every beginner) rehberlik ettiği yazmaktadır.

question_text: A cheetah is ---- than a horse, so it can catch its prey easily.
explanation: Tek heceli "fast" sıfatının comparative biçimi "-er" eki alarak "faster" olur.

question_text:
Olivia: "I went trekking in the Alps last summer."
Liam: "Really? ----"
Olivia: "Yes, the view from the top was breathtaking!"
Which question completes the dialogue?
option_b: How much did the flight cost?
explanation: Olivia "Evet, zirvedeki manzara nefes kesiciydi!" diyerek olumlu yanıt verdiğine göre soru "Beğendin mi / Keyif aldın mı?" olmalıdır.

question_text: In my opinion, camping in the forest is ---- than staying in a noisy city hotel.
explanation: "Good" düzensiz sıfattır; iki durumu karşılaştırırken comparative biçimi "better" kullanılır.

question_text:
Check the weather note for adventurers:
"Wind speed: 65 km/h. Heavy clouds over the valley. All air sports are cancelled today."
Which sport CANNOT be done today?
explanation: Rüzgâr nedeniyle tüm hava sporları (air sports) iptal edilmiştir; hang-gliding (yelken kanat) bir hava sporudur.

question_text: To find your way in a thick forest without GPS, you need a map and a ----.
explanation: Ormanda GPS olmadan yön bulmak için harita ve pusula (compass) gerekir.

question_text:
Read the e-mail snippet:
"Dear Tim, I'm going to try kayaking on Sunday morning. The river is calm, so it's suitable for beginners. Would you like to come?"
What is the purpose of this e-mail?
option_b: To ask Tim to lend his kayak
option_c: To invite Tim to a water sport
option_d: To warn Tim about a dangerous river
explanation: E-posta Tim'i pazar sabahı kano/kayak yapmaya davet etmek (invite) amacıyla yazılmıştır.

question_text: Which word is a synonym for "fascinating"?
explanation: "Fascinating" büyüleyici/harika anlamına gelir; eş anlamlısı "amazing"dir.

question_text:
Look at the activity list:
• Rafting — River
• Skiing — Snowy mountain
• Scuba diving — Sea
• ---- — Sky
Which sport fits the blank?
explanation: Gökyüzünde (sky) yapılan macera sporu yamaç paraşütüdür (paragliding).

question_text:
Eda: "What do you think about ice climbing?"
Can: "I think it's ----. You can easily slip on frozen waterfalls."
explanation: Donmuş şelalelerde kolayca kayılabileceğini söyleyen Can, buz tırmanışını tehlikeli (dangerous) bulmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the warning sign at the beach:
"Red Flag: High waves! Surfing and swimming are forbidden until 4 p.m."
When can people safely enter the water?
explanation: Saat 16.00'ya kadar yasak olduğu belirtildiğine göre suya saat 16.00'dan sonra (after 4 p.m.) girilebilir.

question_text: We need a ---- when we go rafting so that we can stay afloat if we fall into the river.
explanation: Nehre düşüldüğünde su yüzeyinde kalabilmek için can yeleği (life jacket) gereklidir.

question_text:
Compare the two ratings:
• Canoeing: ★★★★☆ (Fun) · ★☆☆☆☆ (Risk)
• Skydiving: ★★★★★ (Fun) · ★★★★☆ (Risk)
Which sentence matches the ratings?
option_a: Canoeing is less risky than skydiving.
option_b: Canoeing is more dangerous than skydiving.
option_c: Both sports have the same risk level.
option_d: Skydiving is less fun than canoeing.
explanation: Kanoda risk 1 yıldız, paraşütle atlamada 4 yıldızdır; dolayısıyla kano daha az risklidir (less risky).

question_text: My brother is crazy about speed, so he wants to try ---- next month.
explanation: Hıza tutkun olan biri macera sporlarından motor yarışını (motor racing) denemek ister.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Coach: "Welcome to our adventure camp! Before we start rafting, everyone must wear a helmet and a life jacket."
Selin: "Do we need to bring our own paddles?"
Coach: "No, the camp provides all the gear. Just bring dry clothes for afterwards."
What should Selin bring from home?
explanation: Antrenör tüm ekipmanın kamp tarafından sağlandığını, sadece sonrası için kuru kıyafet (dry clothes) getirilmesi gerektiğini söylemiştir.

question_text:
Look at the comparison table of three extreme sports:
SportCostRisk (1-5)Min. Age
Zip-lining30 EUR210
Rock Climbing55 EUR414
Paragliding110 EUR316
Which sentence is CORRECT according to the table?
option_a: Rock climbing is riskier than paragliding.
option_b: Zip-lining is more expensive than rock climbing.
option_d: Paragliding is the cheapest sport in the table.
explanation: Tabloda kaya tırmanışının riski 4, yamaç paraşütünün riski 3'tür; yani kaya tırmanışı daha risklidir.

question_text:
Arda: "I'd rather explore a mysterious cave than ride a jet ski."
Bora: "Why? Jet skiing sounds so cool!"
Arda: "Because ----."
option_a: jet skiing is much slower than walking
option_b: I love quiet natural places and hate loud engines
option_c: I am afraid of dark underground tunnels
option_d: caves are always full of noisy crowds
explanation: Jet ski gürültülü motor sesine sahipken mağaralar sessiz doğa alanlarıdır; Arda sakin doğal yerleri sevdiği için mağarayı seçmektedir.

question_text:
Four friends talk about their weekend plans:
• Alex: "I'll test my courage by jumping from a bridge with an elastic rope."
• Maya: "I'm going to sleep under the stars in a tent."
• Noah: "I want to glide over the mountains using wind currents."
• Zoe: "I'll paddle down a fast-flowing river."
Who is NOT going to do an air or water sport?
explanation: Maya çadırda kamp yapacaktır; bu bir kara/doğa etkinliğidir. Noah (hava), Zoe (su) sporları yapar; Alex ise bungee jumping yapmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the safety checklist:
1. Check weather forecast.
2. Pack a first-aid kit and extra water.
3. Tell someone your route.
4. Wear sturdy boots.
This checklist is MOST suitable for someone going ----.
explanation: Hava durumu kontrolü, ilk yardım çantası, su, rotayı birine bildirme ve sağlam botlar dağ yürüyüşü (mountain trekking) içindir.

question_text: Which sentence expresses a preference DIFFERENT from the others?
option_a: I can't stand going rafting; it's terrifying.
option_b: I'd rather go rafting than stay indoors.
option_c: I'm keen on trying rafting this summer.
explanation: Üç cümle raftingi tercih etmeyi/sevmeyi anlatırken, "I can't stand..." raftinge katlanamadığını ve korkutucu bulduğunu belirtir.

option_a: Kayaking is the most popular choice.
