explanation: Grafikte climbing 16, trekking 24 öğrencidir; dolayısıyla tırmanışı seçenler yürüyüşü seçenlerden fazla değildir.

question_text:
Read the text:
"Last month, Deniz tried windsurfing for the first time. At first, she fell into the water many times, and the board felt heavy. However, she didn't give up. By the third day, she could balance easily and ride the waves."
What can we learn about Deniz?
option_a: She hated windsurfing and quit on day one.
option_b: She never fell into the water during the camp.
option_c: She was patient and succeeded after practicing.
option_d: She was already a professional windsurfer.
explanation: Metinde Deniz'in başta sık sık düşmesine rağmen pes etmediği ve üçüncü günde başardığı anlatılmaktadır.

question_text:
Reporter: "What makes base jumping ---- than skydiving?"
Athlete: "You jump from a much lower height, like a cliff or a building, so you have less time to open your parachute."
explanation: Daha alçaktan atlayıp paraşüt açmak için daha az zaman olması base jumpingi skydivingden daha tehlikeli (more dangerous) kılar.

question_text:
Ege wants to join a weekend adventure club. He has 50 EUR, loves water sports, and hates high places.
Look at the options:
• Skydiving: 120 EUR (Air)
• Rafting: 45 EUR (Water)
• Rock Climbing: 40 EUR (Land/High)
• Canoeing: 60 EUR (Water)
Which activity should Ege choose?
explanation: Ege'nin 50 EUR bütçesi var ve su sporunu seviyor. Canoeing 60 EUR ile bütçesini aşar; Skydiving ve Rock Climbing yüksektir. Rafting 45 EUR ile uygundur.

question_text:
Teacher: "Why do adventurers carry a whistle in the mountains?"
Student: "----"
option_a: To scare away small fish in the lake.
option_b: To signal for help if they get lost or injured.
option_c: To measure the temperature of the snow.
explanation: Dağda kaybolma veya yaralanma durumunda yardım sinyali vermek için düdük (whistle) taşınır.

question_text:
Read the forum post:
"User: AdventureFan99
I tried ice climbing in Erzurum yesterday. The frozen waterfall looked like a crystal palace! My hands froze a bit, though. Next time, I'll buy thicker gloves."
Which problem did the user experience?
option_c: Cold hands due to thin gloves
explanation: Kullanıcı ellerinin biraz üşüdüğünü ve bir dahaki sefere daha kalın eldiven alacağını belirtmiştir.

question_text: Which pair of words is INCORRECTLY matched?
explanation: Tüplü dalışta (scuba diving) paraşüt kullanılmaz; paraşüt hava sporlarına aittir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Lucas: "Have you ever tried horseback riding in the countryside?"
Hannah: "Yes, once! It was wonderful, ---- I fell off when the horse saw a snake."
Lucas: "Oh no! Did you get hurt?"
Hannah: "Just a small bruise on my arm."
Which word fits the blank?
explanation: Öncesinde "harikaydı" deyip sonrasında attan düştüğünü anlattığı için zıtlık bağlacı "but" kullanılmalıdır.

question_text:
Look at the schedule for Adventure Day:
• 09:00 – Safety briefing
• 10:00 – Mountain biking
• 13:00 – Picnic lunch
• 14:30 – Zip-lining
Which statement is TRUE?
option_a: There is no food break in the program.
option_b: Participants learn safety rules before riding bikes.
option_c: Mountain biking starts in the afternoon.
explanation: 09:00'da güvenlik bilgilendirmesi, 10:00'da dağ bisikleti vardır; yani katılımcılar bisiklete binmeden önce güvenlik kurallarını öğrenir.

question_text:
Sarp: "To me, surfing is the ---- sport in the world because riding giant ocean waves feels incredible."
Kaan: "I agree! Nothing beats the sea."
explanation: Dev okyanus dalgalarında sörf yapmanın inanılmaz hissettirdiğini söyleyen Sarp için sörf dünyadaki en iyi (best) spordur.

question_text:
Read the advertisement: "Desert Safari Adventure!
Ride 4x4 jeeps over golden dunes! Sunset tea included. Bring sunglasses and a scarf for the sand." Why should visitors bring a scarf?
option_a: To use it as a parachute
option_b: Because it always snows in the desert
explanation: İlanda kum için (for the sand) güneş gözlüğü ve eşarp/atkı getirilmesi önerilmektedir.

question_text: Mina prefers ---- to ---- because she finds underwater life more fascinating than high mountains.
explanation: Su altı yaşamını yüksek dağlardan daha büyüleyici bulduğuna göre dalışı (diving) tırmanışa (climbing) tercih etmektedir.

question_text: Read the two reviews about White River Rafting: • Review 1 (Emir): "The guides were super helpful and the river was exciting. Worth every penny!" • Review 2 (Defne): "The water was freezing and the helmet was uncomfortable. I won't go again." What do we know about the reviews?
option_a: Both Emir and Defne want to go rafting again.
option_b: Emir was satisfied, whereas Defne had a bad experience.
option_c: Emir complained about the unhelpful guides.
option_d: Defne loved the temperature of the river.
explanation: Emir memnun kalmışken Defne suyun buz gibi ve kaskın rahatsız olduğunu söyleyerek olumsuz bir deneyim yaşamıştır.

question_text: Which sentence has a GRAMMAR mistake?
option_a: This mountain is the highest peak in the region.
option_b: I would rather go hiking than watch TV.
option_c: Bungee jumping is more scary than trekking.
option_d: Paragliding is more expensive than cycling.
explanation: Kısa sıfat "scary" comparative yapılırken "more scary" yerine "scarier" şeklinde yazılmalıdır.

question_text:
Look at the gear bag of an adventurer:
[Oxygen tank, wetsuit, fins, underwater camera]
Where is this person going?
option_c: To the top of Mount Everest
option_d: To a coral reef in the sea
explanation: Oksijen tüpü, dalış kıyafeti, palet ve su altı kamerası denizdeki bir mercan resifine dalışa gidildiğini gösterir.

question_text: In caving, explorers need a strong ---- because there is no natural light inside deep caves.
explanation: Derin mağaraların içinde doğal ışık olmadığı için güçlü bir kafa lambasına (headlamp) ihtiyaç vardır.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Ali: "I think highlining is the craziest extreme sport."
Ece: "What's that?"
Ali: "Walking on a tight rope stretched between two high cliffs."
Ece: "Oh! That sounds ----. I could never look down!"
explanation: İki yüksek uçurum arasındaki ipte yürümeyi duyan Ece "Asla aşağı bakamazdım!" dediğine göre bunu korkutucu (terrifying) bulmuştur.

question_text:
Look at the table of 3 adventure parks:
ParkDistance from CityActivities
Green Valley20 kmTrekking, Camping
Eagle Peak85 kmParagliding, Climbing
Blue Rapids50 kmRafting, Kayaking
Which park is the CLOSEST to the city and offers land activities?
explanation: Şehre en yakın olan 20 km ile Green Valley'dir ve yürüyüş ile kamp gibi kara etkinlikleri sunmaktadır.

question_text: A good adventure guide should be calm and experienced ---- emergencies can happen anytime.
explanation: Acil durumlar her an yaşanabileceği için rehberin sakin ve deneyimli olması gerekir; neden bildiren "because" uygundur.

question_text:
Read the note:
"Before you go snowboarding, warm up your muscles for 10 minutes. Also, never ski alone off the marked trails."
Why shouldn't you leave the marked trails?
option_a: To avoid getting lost or facing avalanche danger
option_b: Because the snow is warmer off the trails
option_d: To ski faster than everyone else
explanation: İşaretli pistlerin dışına tek başına çıkmamak kaybolma veya çığ gibi tehlikelerden korunmak içindir.

question_text: Which activity requires snow and cold weather?
explanation: Heli-skiing kar ve soğuk hava gerektiren bir kış macera sporudur.

question_text:
Read the interview excerpt:
"Interviewer: What was the hardest part of climbing Mount Ararat?
Climber: Not the steep rocks, actually. The freezing wind at 4,500 meters made every step a real struggle."
What was the biggest challenge for the climber?
option_b: Forgetting his climbing boots at home
option_c: The extremely cold wind at high altitude
option_d: The hot sun in the valley
explanation: Dağcı dik kayaların değil, 4.500 metredeki dondurucu rüzgârın (freezing wind) en zor kısım olduğunu söylemiştir.

question_text:
Compare:
• Swimming in a pool: Safety 10/10
• White-water kayaking: Safety 5/10
Swimming in a pool is ---- than white-water kayaking.
explanation: Havuzda yüzmenin güvenliği 10/10, akarsu kanosunun 5/10 olduğundan havuzda yüzmek çok daha güvenlidir (much safer).

question_text:
Look at the club rules:
• Rule 1: Listen to the instructor at all times.
• Rule 2: Leave nature clean; take your trash back.
• Rule 3: Respect wildlife.
Which rule is about protecting the environment?
explanation: Doğayı temiz bırakmak (Rule 2) ve yaban hayatına saygı göstermek (Rule 3) çevreyi korumakla ilgilidir.

question_text: Read the brochure carefully and answer: "Canyon Explorers Club • Canyoning: 65 EUR | Age 16+ | Good swimming skills required | 4 hours • Via Ferrata (Iron Path Climbing): 50 EUR | Age 12+ | No climbing experience needed | 3 hours • Night Forest Trek: 30 EUR | Age 10+ | Headlamp provided | 2.5 hours" Kerem (15) can swim very well, has 55 EUR, and wants to try an activity that lasts at least 3 hours. Which activity can he join?
explanation: Kerem 15 yaşında olduğu için 16+ olan Canyoning'e katılamaz (bütçesi de 55 EUR). Night Forest Trek 2.5 saattir (en az 3 saat istiyor). Via Ferrata 12+, 50 EUR ve 3 saattir.

question_text:
Four teenagers took a survey about extreme sports. Here are their clues:
1. Mert hates heights, so he never does air sports.
2. Zeynep loves underwater adventures.
3. Bora prefers speed on land rather than water.
4. Elif wants to fly over coastal hills.
Which matching is CORRECT?
option_a: Mert: Zip-lining · Zeynep: Caving · Bora: Surfing · Elif: Diving
option_b: Mert: Caving · Zeynep: Scuba diving · Bora: Mountain biking · Elif: Paragliding
option_c: Mert: Paragliding · Zeynep: Skiing · Bora: Rowing · Elif: Bungee jumping
option_d: Mert: Skydiving · Zeynep: Rafting · Bora: Canoeing · Elif: Trekking
explanation: Mert yükseklikten nefret ettiği için yer altı/kara sporu (caving), Zeynep su altı (scuba diving), Bora karada hız (mountain biking), Elif uçuş (paragliding) seçer.

question_text:
Read the text:
"Unlike indoor climbing walls where holds are colorful and predictable, natural rock climbing challenges you to read the cliff face, deal with changing winds, and trust your own strength."
What is the main difference highlighted in the text?
option_a: Indoor climbing is much more dangerous than cliff climbing.
option_b: You don't need strength when climbing natural rocks.
option_c: Natural cliffs have colorful artificial holds.
option_d: Natural rock climbing involves unpredictable outdoor conditions.
explanation: Metin, yapay duvarların öngörülebilir olmasına karşın doğal kaya tırmanışının değişken rüzgâr ve doğal koşullarla başa çıkmayı gerektirdiğini vurgular.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Instructor: "Before you jump, check your harness twice. Are your carabiners locked?"
Tuna: "Yes, both are locked."
Instructor: "Great. Keep your knees slightly bent when you land, and pull the brake lines when I say so on the radio."
Which sport is Tuna about to do?
explanation: Harness (kuşam), karabina, inişte dizleri bükme ve telsizle fren iplerini çekme talimatları yamaç paraşütüne (paragliding) aittir.

question_text:
Analyze the table:
ActivityThrill LevelFitness NeededCost
Stand-up PaddleLowLow20 EUR
KitesurfingHighHigh90 EUR
River RaftingHighMedium45 EUR
Aslı wants a high-thrill water sport, has medium fitness, and doesn't want to spend more than 60 EUR. Which statement is TRUE about her choice?
option_a: Stand-up paddle is best because she wants high thrill.
option_b: She should choose river rafting because it fits all her criteria.
option_c: She must choose kitesurfing since it has high thrill.
option_d: None of the activities fit her budget and thrill level.
explanation: Aslı yüksek heyecan (High), orta kondisyon (Medium) ve 60 EUR altı bütçe arıyor; River Rafting tüm kriterlere uyar.

question_text:
Read the expedition log:
"Day 4: We reached Base Camp at 3,800 m. Yesterday's snowstorm blocked the north path, so our team leader decided to take the longer but safer west ridge tomorrow. Everyone's morale is high despite the freezing night."
Why did the team change their route?
option_a: Because they lost their tents in the valley
option_b: Because they wanted to finish the climb faster
option_c: Because snow blocked their original way and the new route is safer
option_d: Because their morale was too low to continue
explanation: Kar fırtınası kuzey yolunu kapattığı için lider daha uzun ama daha güvenli batı sırtını seçmiştir.

question_text:
Which sentence best summarizes the main idea of this paragraph?
"Many people think extreme athletes are reckless. In reality, professionals spend months training, studying weather patterns, and checking every piece of equipment. Taking calculated risks is very different from being careless."
option_a: All extreme athletes ignore safety rules.
option_b: Weather patterns never affect extreme sports.
option_c: Extreme sports require no preparation if you are brave enough.
option_d: Professional extreme athletes prepare carefully rather than acting carelessly.
explanation: Paragraf, profesyonel ekstrem sporcuların dikkatsiz değil, aylarca antrenman yapıp ekipman ve hava kontrolü yapan kişiler olduğunu vurgular.

question_text: Read the messages between two friends: • Yusuf: "I booked two spots for canyoning on Sunday! Wait—did you say you can't swim?" • Emre: "I can swim, actually, I'm just scared of jumping into deep water from high rocks." • Yusuf: "No worries, the guide says there's a walking path around the high jumps." What will Emre probably do?
option_a: He will join the trip and use the walking path around high jumps.
option_b: He will stay home because there is no safe option.
option_c: He will go skydiving instead of canyoning.
option_d: He will cancel immediately because he cannot swim.
explanation: Emre yüzebiliyor ama yüksek kayalardan atlamaktan korkuyor; Yusuf atlama noktalarının etrafında yürüyüş yolu olduğunu söyleyince Emre katılabilir.

question_text: Compare the two adventure packages: • Package A (2 days): Trekking + Camping | Tent included | Meals not included | 70 EUR • Package B (2 days): Trekking + Rafting | Cabin stay + Breakfast included | 115 EUR Which inference is CORRECT?
option_b: If you choose Package A, you have to arrange your own food.
option_c: Package B is cheaper than Package A.
option_d: Package A offers a cabin stay.
explanation: Paket A'da "Meals not included" yazdığı için katılımcı kendi yemeğini ayarlamak zorundadır.

question_text:
In a debate about extreme sports, Pelin says: "If you wear proper gear and follow the guide, the risk drops dramatically."
Which opinion directly OPPOSES Pelin's view?
option_a: Checking your rope before climbing is a smart habit.
option_b: Beginners should always listen to experienced instructors.
option_c: Even with the best gear, nature is unpredictable and accidents happen.
option_d: Training and helmets definitely help reduce injuries.
explanation: Pelin doğru ekipman ve rehberle riskin çok düştüğünü savunuyor; buna doğrudan karşı çıkan görüş, en iyi ekipmanla bile doğanın öngörülemez olduğudur.

question_text:
Read the safety notice at a zip-line park:
"Weight limit: 35 kg – 110 kg. Guests must tie back long hair and empty their pockets before stepping onto the platform. Loose phones or coins may fall and injure someone below."
Why must guests empty their pockets?
option_a: Park staff want to keep visitors' phones
option_b: The zip-line cable cannot carry keys or phones
option_c: Pockets make it impossible to wear a helmet
option_d: Falling objects from high up could hurt people underneath
explanation: Düşebilecek telefon veya bozuk paraların aşağıdaki birini yaralayabileceği açıkça belirtilmiştir.

question_text:
Complete the dialogue logically:
Ayla: "I've always dreamed of flying, so I'm signing up for a paragliding course."
Cem: "----"
Ayla: "Not really. You run down a grassy slope and smoothly lift off into the air."
option_a: Why do you prefer indoor sports?
option_b: Isn't it scary to jump off a high cliff?
option_c: Do you need a heavy oxygen tank for that?
option_d: How deep is the water in that valley?
explanation: Ayla "Aslında hayır. Çimenli bir yamaçtan koşup yumuşakça havalanıyorsun" dediğine göre Cem yüksek bir uçurumdan atlamanın korkutucu olup olmadığını sormuştur.

question_text: Read the two paragraphs: Text 1: "Caving teaches patience and teamwork. In narrow passages, everyone helps the person behind them." Text 2: "Solo free climbing requires extreme focus, as you rely only on your own hands and feet without any partners." What do these two texts show when read together?
option_a: Both sports require large teams to succeed.
option_b: Caving is always done alone without any equipment.
option_c: Different adventure sports demand different skills, from teamwork to solo focus.
option_d: Solo climbing is easier for beginners than caving.
explanation: İki metin birlikte okunduğunda farklı macera sporlarının takım çalışmasından bireysel odaklanmaya kadar farklı beceriler gerektirdiği görülür.

question_text:
Four friends compare three sports: Rafting, Skydiving, and Trekking.
• Can: "Skydiving is more thrilling than trekking, but rafting is the most fun of all."
• Ela: "Trekking is safer than rafting, and I hate jumping from planes."
• Berk: "I'd rather jump from a plane than paddle in cold water."
Which statement is TRUE?
option_a: Can thinks trekking is more exciting than skydiving.
option_b: Ela wants to try skydiving next weekend.
option_c: All three friends agree that rafting is the best.
explanation: Berk uçaktan atlamayı soğuk suda kürek çekmeye tercih ettiğini söyleyerek skydivingi raftinge yeğlediğini belirtmiştir.

question_text: Which sentence uses the superlative form INCORRECTLY?
option_a: That was the most bad weather we had during our trek.
option_b: K2 is one of the most challenging mountains to climb.
option_c: For me, scuba diving is the best way to explore nature.
option_d: This canyon has the narrowest passage in the country.
explanation: "Bad" düzensiz sıfattır; superlative biçimi "the most bad" değil "the worst" olmalıdır.

question_text:
Read the weather advisory for mountaineers:
"Temperature: -12°C at summit. Visibility: below 20 meters due to heavy fog. Avalanche risk: High (Level 4/5)."
What is the MOST responsible decision for a climbing team?
option_a: Ignore the fog and follow old footprints
option_b: Postpone the summit climb until conditions improve
option_c: Leave ropes behind to carry less weight
option_d: Climb faster to reach the top before noon
explanation: -12°C soğuk, 20 metrenin altında görüş mesafesi ve yüksek çığ riski varken en sorumlu karar tırmanışı ertelemektir.

question_text:
Read the equipment review:
"I bought this waterproof backpack for my 3-day kayak trip. Even after my kayak flipped over in the rapids, my camera and dry clothes stayed completely dry inside. However, the shoulder straps are a bit thin for heavy loads."
What is a disadvantage of the backpack?
option_a: It is only usable for one-day trips.
option_b: Water leaks inside when it touches the river.
option_c: The straps may feel uncomfortable with heavy items.
option_d: It cannot fit a camera and clothes.
explanation: Yorumda çantanın su geçirmezliği övülmüş ancak ağır yükler için omuz askılarının biraz ince (thin) olması bir dezavantaj olarak belirtilmiştir.

question_text: Which statement does NOT match the meaning of "I'd rather go rock climbing than try bungee jumping"?
option_a: I prefer rock climbing to bungee jumping.
option_b: Given the choice, I would pick rock climbing over bungee jumping.
option_c: Rock climbing sounds better to me than bungee jumping.
option_d: Bungee jumping is more appealing to me than rock climbing.
explanation: "I'd rather A than B" A'yı tercih etmek demektir; bungee jumpingin daha çekici olduğunu söyleyen şık bunun tam tersini ifade eder.

question_text:
Look at the table of 4 adventure camps:
CampAgeFocusAccommodation
Pine Camp12-15Trekking & OrienteeringTents
Wave Camp14-17Surfing & KayakingBungalows
Peak Camp15-18Rock ClimbingMountain Hut
Cave Camp16-18Caving & RappellingTents
Deniz is 14 years old. She doesn't want to sleep in a tent, and she loves water sports. Which camp fits her?
explanation: 14 yaşında olan, çadır istemeyen (Bungalows) ve su sporlarını seven Deniz için Wave Camp uygundur.

question_text:
Read the quote:
"True adventure isn't about conquering a mountain; it's about learning your own limits and respecting nature."
What does the speaker emphasize?
option_b: Self-discovery and respect for the environment
option_d: Breaking speed records on every climb
explanation: Alıntı, gerçek maceranın dağı fethetmek değil, kendi sınırlarını tanımak ve doğaya saygı duymak olduğunu vurgular.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Nil: "Have you seen the photos from our caving trip?"
Tarik: "Yes! The underground lake looked unreal. By the way, are you signing up for ice climbing next month?"
Nil: "I'd love to, ---- my doctor advised me to avoid extreme cold because of my asthma."
What can we infer about Nil?
option_a: She has already climbed frozen waterfalls.
option_b: She thinks ice climbing is boring.
option_c: She wants to join, but a health issue stops her.
option_d: She prefers ice climbing to caving.
explanation: Nil katılmak istediğini ("I'd love to") ancak astımı nedeniyle doktorunun aşırı soğuktan kaçınmasını önerdiğini söyleyerek sağlık engeliyle reddetmektedir.

question_text:
Which question CANNOT be answered by the text below?
"Wingsuit flying lets athletes glide through the air using a special suit with fabric wings. Because jumpers reach speeds over 150 km/h, only skydivers with at least 200 regular jumps are allowed to try it."
option_a: How much does a wingsuit cost?
option_b: Who is allowed to try wingsuit flying?
option_c: How fast can wingsuit flyers travel?
option_d: What makes the wingsuit work in the air?
explanation: Metinde özel kumaş kanatlı kıyafet, 150 km/s hız ve en az 200 atlayış şartı yer alır; ancak kıyafetin fiyatı (cost) belirtilmemiştir.

question_text: Read the two opinions: • Hakan: "Adventure tourism brings money to small mountain villages and creates jobs for local guides." • Seda: "That's true, but large groups of tourists can damage fragile trails and leave litter behind." What are Hakan and Seda discussing?
option_a: Why cities are better than villages
option_b: The economic benefits and environmental risks of adventure tourism
option_c: The best equipment for mountain biking
option_d: How to train local ski instructors
explanation: Hakan ekonomik faydaları, Seda ise çevresel zararları vurgulayarak macera turizminin artılarını ve eksilerini tartışmaktadır.

question_text:
Arrange the steps of preparing for a safe rafting trip:
I. Put on your life jacket and helmet properly.
II. Listen to the guide's paddle commands on the shore.
III. Board the inflatable boat carefully.
IV. Check the river conditions and weather.
What is the logical order?
explanation: Önce nehir/hava kontrol edilir (IV), kıyıda komutlar dinlenir (II), can yeleği ve kask giyilir (I) ve bota binilir (III).

question_text: In the sentence "Rafting is far more thrilling than fishing," what does the word "far" do?
option_a: It means rafting is done in a distant country.
option_b: It changes the sentence into a negative statement.
option_c: It means fishing is slightly more thrilling.
option_d: It makes the comparison stronger (much more thrilling).
explanation: Comparative önünde kullanılan "far" sıfatı güçlendirir ve "çok daha" (much more) anlamı katar.

question_text:
Read the scenario:
"During a forest hike, your friend twists her ankle two kilometers away from the main road. You have a phone with weak signal and a basic first-aid kit."
What should you do FIRST?
option_a: Keep her still, apply a cold compress/bandage, and call for help
option_b: Leave her alone without telling anyone where she is
option_c: Ask her to run back to the main road quickly
option_d: Continue the hike to the mountain peak
explanation: Bileği burkulan kişiyi hareket ettirmeyip ilk yardım uygulamak ve yardım çağırmak ilk ve en doğru adımdır.

question_text:
Which sentence accurately combines these two ideas?
Idea 1: Scuba diving is expensive.
Idea 2: Many people still save money to try it.
option_a: If scuba diving is expensive, it will be free next year.
option_b: Although scuba diving is expensive, many people still save money to try it.
option_c: Scuba diving is expensive, so people avoid saving money for it.
option_d: Because scuba diving is expensive, nobody wants to try it.
explanation: Pahalı olmasına rağmen insanların para biriktirip denemek istemesi zıtlık içerir; "Although" bu iki fikri doğru birleştirir.

question_text: Have you ---- visited the ancient city of Ephesus?
explanation: Present Perfect sorularında "hiç" anlamında deneyim sormak için "ever" kullanılır.

question_text: Tourists usually buy small gifts called ---- to remember the places they visited.
explanation: Ziyaret edilen yerleri hatırlamak için alınan küçük hediyelik eşyalara "souvenir" (hatıra eşyası) denir.

question_text:
Read the hotel sign: "Welcome to Seaside Inn
Check-in: 14:00 · Check-out: 11:00
Free Wi-Fi and breakfast included." Which service is FREE for guests?
explanation: Tabelada ücretsiz Wi-Fi ve kahvaltının (Free Wi-Fi and breakfast) dahil olduğu yazmaktadır.

question_text:
Liam: "Have you ever been to Antalya?"
Emma: "Yes, I ---- there twice with my family."
explanation: "Have you ever...?" sorusuna "I" öznesiyle "Yes, I have been..." şeklinde yanıt verilir.

question_text:
Look at the travel postcard:
"Hi Mom! We arrived in Rome this morning. Tomorrow we are taking a guided tour to the Colosseum. The weather is sunny and warm. Love, Ece."
What will Ece do tomorrow?
option_a: Visit a famous historical monument with a guide
option_c: Fly back home in the morning
explanation: Kartpostalda yarın Colosseum'a rehberli bir tur (guided tour) yapacakları yazmaktadır.

question_text: You need a valid ---- when you travel from Turkey to another country.
explanation: Yurt dışına seyahat ederken geçerli bir pasaporta (passport) ihtiyaç vardır.

question_text:
Look at the museum ticket: "Topkapi Palace Museum
Open: 09:00 – 18:00 (Closed on Tuesdays)
Audio Guide: Available in 6 languages" When is the museum CLOSED?
explanation: Bilet üzerinde müzenin salı günleri (on Tuesdays) kapalı olduğu belirtilmiştir.

question_text: Cappadocia is famous ---- its fairy chimneys and underground cities.
explanation: "Bir şeyle ünlü olmak" anlamında "famous for" kalıbı kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Tourist: "Excuse me, how can I get to the Blue Mosque?"
Local: "Go straight ahead and turn left at the traffic lights. It's on your right."
What is the tourist asking for?
option_c: The price of a bus ticket
option_d: The opening hours of a shop
explanation: Turist Sultanahmet Camii'ne nasıl gidileceğini sorarak yol tarifi (directions) istemektedir.

question_text: My sister prefers staying in a ---- because she likes home-cooked meals and a quiet garden.
explanation: Ev yapımı yemekler ve sakin bir bahçe sunan konaklama türü pansiyon/konukevidir (guesthouse).

question_text:
Read the travel blog note:
"In Gaziantep, you must try baklava and kebab. Every street smells delicious!"
Which aspect of Gaziantep does the blogger highlight?
explanation: Baklava ve kebaptan söz edilerek Gaziantep'in yerel mutfağı (local cuisine) vurgulanmaktadır.

question_text: Omer has ---- seen the Eiffel Tower; this is his first trip to Paris.
explanation: Paris'e ilk kez gittiğine göre Eyfel Kulesi'ni daha önce hiç görmemiştir (never).

question_text:
Look at the city tour table:
CityFamous ForBest Season
MardinStone housesSpring
BodrumBeaches and castleSummer
UludagSki slopesWinter
Where should someone go if they want to see historical stone houses in spring?
explanation: Tabloya göre taş evleriyle (stone houses) ünlü ve ilkbaharda (Spring) gidilmesi önerilen şehir Mardin'dir.

question_text: A ---- is a person who shows tourists around historical places and explains their history.
explanation: Turistlere tarihi yerleri gezdiren ve tarihini anlatan kişiye tur rehberi (tour guide) denir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Receptionist: "Good evening, sir. Do you have a reservation?"
Guest: "Yes, under the name Demir, for three nights."
Where does this conversation take place?
option_c: At a train station ticket machine
explanation: Resepsiyonist ve üç gecelik rezervasyon konuşması bir otel resepsiyonunda geçmektedir.

question_text: Which word means "the activity of visiting interesting places as a tourist"?
explanation: Turist olarak ilgi çekici yerleri gezme etkinliğine "sightseeing" denir.

question_text:
Read the advertisement: "3-Day Black Sea Tour
• Visit Sumela Monastery & Uzungol
• Traditional breakfast every morning
• Departure: Friday 07:00" What does the tour include?
option_b: Scuba diving lessons in the Mediterranean
option_c: Visits to cultural and natural sights plus breakfast
option_d: Five nights in a desert camp
explanation: İlanda Sümela Manastırı ve Uzungöl ziyaretleri ile her sabah geleneksel kahvaltının dahil olduğu yazmaktadır.

question_text: The view of the Bosphorus from the ferry was ----! I took fifty photos.
explanation: Elli fotoğraf çekecek kadar beğenilen manzara harika/muhteşem (magnificent) olmalıdır.

question_text:
Sude: "----"
Kaan: "Last July. We stayed there for a week."
Which question completes the dialogue?
option_a: When did you go to Marmaris?
option_b: How many languages do you speak?
option_c: What is the capital of Spain?
option_d: Have you ever been to Marmaris?
explanation: Cevapta belirli bir geçmiş zaman ("Last July") verildiği için soru "When did you go...?" olmalıdır.

question_text: We booked an ---- resort, so meals, drinks, and pool activities are all in the price.
explanation: Yemek, içecek ve aktivitelerin fiyata dahil olduğu tesis türü her şey dahil (all-inclusive) tesistir.

question_text:
Read the text message:
"Hey Bora, my flight was delayed by 2 hours because of fog. I'll land at 19:30 instead of 17:30. – Selim"
Why will Selim arrive late?
option_a: He forgot his passport at home.
explanation: Sis (fog) nedeniyle uçuşun 2 saat ertelendiği belirtilmiştir.

question_text: Istanbul is a ---- city with millions of people, heavy traffic, and lively streets.
explanation: Milyonlarca insan ve yoğun trafiğe sahip şehir kalabalıktır (crowded).

question_text:
Look at the signs at an airport:
• Gate 12: Boarding Now
• Baggage Claim: Belt 4
• Currency Exchange: Ground Floor
Where should a passenger go to change Euros into Turkish Lira?
explanation: Döviz bürosunun (Currency Exchange) zemin katta (Ground Floor) olduğu yazmaktadır.

question_text: She has ---- returned from Izmir; her suitcase is still by the door.
explanation: Valizi hâlâ kapının yanında olduğuna göre İzmir'den henüz/az önce (just) dönmüştür.

question_text:
Read the short review:
"The rooms at Mountain Lodge were spotless and the staff smiled all the time, though the Wi-Fi was a bit slow."
What did the guest LIKE about the hotel?
explanation: Misafir odaların tertemiz (spotless) ve personelin güler yüzlü olmasını beğenmiştir.

question_text: Anıtkabir and Göbeklitepe are famous ---- sites in Turkey.
explanation: Anıtkabir ve Göbeklitepe ünlü tarihi (historical) alanlardır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Ali: "Which one do you prefer for holidays, seaside resorts or cultural city tours?"
Zeynep: "Cultural tours, definitely. I love visiting museums and old castles."
What kind of traveler is Zeynep?
option_b: She only wants to sunbathe on the beach.
option_c: She prefers staying in her bedroom.
explanation: Müze ve eski kaleleri gezmeyi seven Zeynep tarih ve mimariden hoşlanan bir gezgindir.

question_text: Don't forget to put on ---- before walking under the hot Mediterranean sun.
explanation: Sıcak Akdeniz güneşinin altında yürürken güneş kremi (sunscreen) sürülmelidir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Travel Agent: "Good morning! How can I help you?"
Customer: "I want a 4-day holiday in June. I love ancient ruins and quiet beaches, not crowded nightclubs."
Travel Agent: "Then I recommend Side or Kaş. Both have calm coastlines and historical theaters."
Why does the agent suggest Side or Kaş?
option_a: They match the customer's interest in history and peaceful beaches.
option_b: They are famous for noisy nightclubs.
option_c: They are the coldest towns in June.
option_d: They have no historical ruins at all.
explanation: Müşteri antik kalıntılar ve sakin plajlar istediği için acente hem sakin kıyılara hem tarihi tiyatrolara sahip Side veya Kaş'ı önermiştir.

question_text:
Look at the table of 3 hotels in Antalya:
HotelPrice/NightDistance to BeachRating
Coral Hotel120 EUR50 m4.6/5
Palm Inn75 EUR800 m4.2/5
Sun Palace180 EUR0 m (Private)4.9/5
Which statement is TRUE according to the table?
option_a: Coral Hotel is farther from the beach than Palm Inn.
option_b: Palm Inn is the cheapest option, but it is the farthest from the beach.
option_c: Sun Palace has the lowest rating among the three.
option_d: Coral Hotel is more expensive than Sun Palace.
explanation: Tabloda Palm Inn 75 EUR ile en ucuz oteldir ancak plaja 800 m ile en uzak olanıdır.

question_text:
Look at the difference between two sentences:
1. "I have been to London." 
2. "I went to London in 2022."
Why do we use different tenses?
option_a: There is no difference in meaning or grammar.
option_b: Sentence 1 means I am still in London; Sentence 2 means I never went.
option_c: Sentence 1 talks about a life experience; Sentence 2 gives a specific past time.
option_d: Sentence 1 is about the future; Sentence 2 is about today.
explanation: Present Perfect zamanı belirtilmemiş yaşam deneyimlerini anlatırken, Simple Past belirli bir geçmiş zamanı ("in 2022") ifade eder.

question_text:
Read the traveler's diary:
"Day 2 in Kyoto: I woke up at 6 a.m. to visit the bamboo forest before the crowds arrived. The morning mist made it feel magical. Later, I tasted matcha tea in a wooden teahouse."
Why did the traveler wake up early?
option_a: Because the teahouse only serves breakfast at 6 a.m.
option_b: To catch an early flight back home
option_c: Because the forest closes at 7 a.m.
option_d: To enjoy the bamboo forest while it was still quiet
explanation: Gezgin kalabalıklar gelmeden önce bambu ormanını gezmek için saat 6'da uyanmıştır.

question_text:
Bora: "Have you bought your train ticket to Ankara yet?"
Selin: "Yes, I've ---- bought it online. Here is the QR code on my phone."
explanation: Eylemin beklenenden önce veya çoktan tamamlandığını olumlu cümlede ifade etmek için "already" kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the museum rules:
• Flash photography is prohibited.
• Please do not touch the artifacts.
• Large backpacks must be left at the cloakroom.
What is a visitor ALLOWED to do inside?
option_b: Carry a huge camping backpack into the gallery
option_c: Use bright camera flashes near paintings
explanation: Flaşlı fotoğraf yasak olduğuna göre flaşsız fotoğraf çekmeye izin verilmektedir.

question_text: Which sentence expresses a RECOMMENDATION for a tourist?
option_a: The museum was built in the 15th century.
option_b: Did you lose your luggage at the airport yesterday?
option_c: You should definitely take a boat trip along the Dalyan River.
option_d: Our bus arrived at the terminal ten minutes ago.
explanation: "You should definitely..." kalıbı bir turiste öneri/tavsiye (recommendation) verir.

question_text:
Four friends share their holiday preferences:
• Efe: "I love snow and wooden chalets."
• Ada: "I want to explore ancient temples."
• Mert: "I just want to lie on golden sand."
• Sila: "I enjoy green plateaus and waterfalls."
Where should Ada go?
option_a: A historical site like Petra or Ephesus
explanation: Ada antik tapınakları keşfetmek istediğine göre Petra veya Efes gibi tarihi bir alana gitmelidir.

question_text:
Tourist: "Excuse me, is there a pharmacy near here?"
Pedestrian: "Yes, walk two blocks down this street. It's ---- the bank and the bakery."
explanation: İki yerin ("the bank and the bakery") ortasında anlamı için "between" edatı kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the flight boarding pass details:
"Passenger: K. YILMAZ | Flight: TK402 | From: IST to: LHR | Gate: B7 | Boarding: 10:15 | Departure: 10:55"
What does "10:15" indicate?
option_b: The number of the passenger's seat
option_c: The time the plane lands in London
option_d: The time passengers start getting on the plane
explanation: "Boarding: 10:15" yolcuların uçağa alınmaya başlanacağı saati gösterir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Nil: "What was the best part of your trip to Safranbolu?"
Eren: "Staying in a restored Ottoman mansion. The wooden ceilings were artworks!"
Nil: "What about the food?"
Eren: "I tried local Turkish delight with saffron—it was unforgettable."
What did Eren NOT mention?
option_c: The cost of the bus ticket
explanation: Eren kaldığı yeri, ahşap tavanları (mimarisi) ve safranlı lokumu anlatmış; otobüs bileti fiyatından bahsetmemiştir.

question_text:
Complete the dialogue:
A: "Have you ever eaten sushi in Japan?"
B: "No, I haven't, ---- I'd love to try it one day."
explanation: Henüz yemediğini söyleyip bir gün denemek istediğini belirttiği için zıtlık bağlacı "but" gerekir.

question_text:
Read the notice at a national park:
"Stay on wooden walkways to protect the travertines. Shoes are not allowed on the white pools."
Which famous Turkish landmark is this notice from?
explanation: Travertenler (travertines) ve beyaz havuzlara ayakkabısız basılması kuralı Pamukkale'ye aittir.

question_text: Which word is the OPPOSITE of "ancient"?
explanation: "Ancient" çok eski/antik demektir; zıt anlamlısı "modern"dir.

question_text: Read the two hotel comments: • Guest A: "The location is right in the city center, so we walked to every museum." • Guest B: "Because it's on a busy street, traffic noise kept me awake at night." What is true about the hotel's location?
option_a: It is far from all museums and very quiet.
option_b: Guests need a taxi to reach the city center.
option_c: It is convenient for sightseeing, but noisy at night.
option_d: It is in a peaceful village outside the city.
explanation: Merkezi konum müzelere yürümek için avantajlı olsa da işlek caddedeki trafik gürültüsü gece rahatsızlık vermektedir.

question_text:
Look at the travel budget of Zeynep for a 3-day trip:
ExpenseAmount
Bus Tickets40 EUR
Hostel (2 nights)70 EUR
Museum Passes25 EUR
Food & Souvenirs65 EUR
What did Zeynep spend the MOST money on?
explanation: En yüksek harcama 70 EUR ile Hostel (konaklama / accommodation) kalemidir.

question_text: My uncle is a photographer. He ---- to more than twenty countries to take wildlife photos.
explanation: Yaşam boyu edinilen deneyim anlatıldığı ve özne "He" olduğu için "has travelled" kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Waiter: "Are you ready to order?"
Tourist: "Yes, I'd like to try a local dish. What do you suggest?"
Waiter: "Our Iskender kebab is very popular."
What is the tourist doing?
option_c: Asking for a recommendation on regional food
explanation: Turist yerel bir yemek denemek istediğini söyleyip garsonun önerisini (recommendation) sormaktadır.

question_text: Which sentence has a mistake in Present Perfect tense?
option_a: Have you ever ridden a camel?
option_b: We have already booked our flights.
option_c: They haven't arrived at the hotel yet.
option_d: She has saw the Pyramids twice.
explanation: "See" fiilinin 3. hali "saw" değil "seen"dir; doğru kullanım "She has seen..." olmalıdır.

question_text:
Read the itinerary:
• Morning: Visit Göreme Open Air Museum
• Afternoon: Pottery workshop in Avanos
• Evening: Watch sunset at Red Valley
This itinerary is planned for a trip to ----.
explanation: Göreme Açık Hava Müzesi, Avanos çömlek atölyesi ve Kızılçukur gün batımı Kapadokya gezisi programıdır.

question_text: If you want to learn about a country's past, visiting ---- is much more informative than shopping at malls.
explanation: Bir ülkenin geçmişini öğrenmek için arkeoloji müzelerini (archaeological museums) ziyaret etmek daha bilgilendiricidir.

question_text:
Read the email:
"Dear Guest, thank you for booking with Sunny Tours. Please wait in the hotel lobby at 08:15 tomorrow. Our white minibus will pick you up for the city tour."
Where should the guest wait tomorrow morning?
explanation: E-postada misafirin yarın saat 08:15'te otel lobisinde (hotel lobby) beklemesi istenmektedir.

question_text: I prefer eco-tourism ---- mass tourism because I want to support local villages and protect nature.
explanation: "Prefer A to B" kalıbında iki isim arasına "to" edatı gelir.

question_text:
Look at the weather forecast for Rome (April):
• Mon: 19°C Sunny | Tue: 18°C Partly Cloudy | Wed: 15°C Rainy | Thu: 20°C Sunny
On which day should a tourist definitely carry an umbrella?
explanation: Çarşamba günü (Wed) 15°C ve yağmurlu (Rainy) olduğu için şemsiye taşınmalıdır.

question_text: Which question asks about someone's OPINION of a place?
option_a: Who did you go to Madrid with?
option_b: What did you think of Madrid?
option_c: How did you travel to Madrid?
option_d: How long did you stay in Madrid?
explanation: "What did you think of...?" sorusu bir yer hakkındaki görüşü/fikri (opinion) sorar.

question_text:
Read the note:
"Tip: In busy tourist markets, always ask the price before buying souvenirs and compare two or three shops."
What is this tip about?
explanation: Alışveriş öncesi fiyat sormak ve dükkânları karşılaştırmak seyahatte akıllı alışveriş (smart shopping) tavsiyesidir.

question_text: The castle sits on top of a steep hill, offering a ---- view of the entire bay.
explanation: Tepeden tüm koyu gören geniş manzara "panoramic" (panoramik) olarak tanımlanır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Cem: "Have you finished packing your suitcase?"
Derya: "Not yet. I still need to put my chargers and comfortable walking shoes in."
What hasn't Derya packed yet?
option_c: Her winter coat and ski boots
explanation: Derya henüz şarj aletlerini (chargers) ve rahat yürüyüş ayakkabılarını (walking shoes) yerleştirmediğini söylemiştir.

question_text: Rural tourism allows city residents to experience ---- life, such as milking cows and picking fresh fruit.
explanation: İnek sağmak ve taze meyve toplamak gibi etkinlikler kırsal/köy yaşamını (countryside life) deneyimlemeyi sağlar.

question_text: Read the four travel profiles and match the right destination: • Hakan: "I want to visit an ancient amphitheater and swim in warm turquoise water." • Selin: "I'd like to see misty mountains, drink fresh tea, and cross old stone bridges." • Ozan: "I'm fascinated by 12,000-year-old stone pillars and ancient history." • Mira: "I dream of riding a hot-air balloon over volcanic valleys." Which destination list matches Hakan, Selin, Ozan, and Mira in order?
explanation: Antik tiyatro + turkuaz deniz = Side; sisli dağlar + çay + taş köprüler = Rize; 12.000 yıllık dikilitaşlar = Göbeklitepe; sıcak hava balonu + volkanik vadiler = Kapadokya.

question_text:
Look at the table of 3 tour packages to Spain:

Andalusia Art5680 EURBreakfast & DinnerYes

Tarik has 550 EUR, wants at least 4 days, and prefers to explore the city on his own without a guide. Which package should he pick?
explanation: Tarik'in bütçesi 550 EUR (Andalusia Art 680 EUR elenir), en az 4 gün istiyor (Express Madrid 3 gün elenir) ve rehbersiz gezmek istiyor. Barcelona Free 4 gün, 490 EUR ve rehbersizdir.

question_text:
Read the text:
"Mass tourism often brings rapid economic growth, yet it can also lead to overcrowded streets, rising housing prices for locals, and pollution along fragile coastlines. That is why many cities now promote sustainable tourism."
What is the main idea of this passage?
option_a: Cities should completely ban all tourists to protect housing prices.
option_b: Sustainable tourism stops economic growth in coastal cities.
option_c: Mass tourism never causes pollution or crowding.
option_d: Tourism has both economic advantages and negative effects that require sustainable solutions.
explanation: Metin, kitle turizminin ekonomik büyüme sağlarken kalabalık, kira artışı ve kirlilik gibi sorunlara yol açtığını, bu yüzden sürdürülebilir turizmin teşvik edildiğini anlatır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue carefully:
Pelin: "Have you ever been to Venice?"
Murat: "Yes, I went there last autumn. The canals were stunning, though the central square was packed with tourists."
Pelin: "Would you go back?"
Murat: "Only in winter, when it's quieter."
What bothered Murat in Venice?
option_a: The heavy crowds in the main square
explanation: Murat merkez meydanın turistlerle dolu olmasından (packed with tourists) rahatsız olduğunu ve sadece daha sakin olan kışın geri döneceğini söylemiştir.

question_text: Read the museum leaflet: "City History Museum • Regular Ticket: 12 EUR | Students (with ID): 6 EUR • Free entry on the first Sunday of every month. • Note: The Roman Mosaic Hall is closed for restoration until May 15." A group of 3 university students visits on May 10 (a Wednesday). How much do they pay in total, and what can they NOT see?
option_a: 18 EUR in total; they can see the Roman Mosaic Hall.
option_b: 18 EUR in total; they cannot see the Roman Mosaic Hall.
option_c: 36 EUR in total; they can see all halls.
option_d: 0 EUR; they cannot enter on Wednesdays.
explanation: 3 öğrenci (3 × 6 EUR = 18 EUR) öder. 10 Mayıs, 15 Mayıs'tan önce olduğu için Roma Mozaik Salonu restorasyon nedeniyle kapalıdır.

question_text: Which sentence uses "been" and "gone" CORRECTLY?
option_a: Where have you gone? You look sunburned! Welcome back!
option_b: She has gone to Antalya three times and loved it every time.
option_c: Dad isn't here; he has gone to Izmir on a business trip.
option_d: I have never gone to Rome, so I want to visit it.
explanation: Bir yere gidip henüz dönmemiş kişi için "has gone" (Dad isn't here; he has gone...), gidip dönmüş veya deneyimlemiş kişi için "been" kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the travel review:
"We booked a boutique hotel in Alaçatı because the website promised a peaceful garden and sea views. While the garden was lovely, a tall building next door blocked the sea completely. Still, the homemade jam at breakfast made us smile."
Which statement is TRUE according to the review?
option_a: The hotel was located right on the sandy beach.
option_b: The guests hated both the garden and the breakfast.
option_c: There were no other buildings around the hotel.
option_d: The hotel's sea view did not match what the website advertised.
explanation: Web sitesi deniz manzarası vadetmesine rağmen yan taraftaki yüksek bina denizi tamamen kapatmıştır.

question_text:
Look at the four clues about a famous world landmark:
1. It is located in South America, high in the Andes Mountains.
2. It was built by the Inca civilization in the 15th century.
3. Visitors often reach it by train or by hiking the Inca Trail.
4. It is famous for its dry-stone walls without mortar.
Which landmark is described?
explanation: Güney Amerika'da And Dağları'nda yer alan, İnkalar tarafından yapılan ünlü antik kent Machu Picchu'dur.

question_text:
Choose the BEST question to complete the dialogue:
Tourist: "----"
Information Officer: "Yes, the 24-hour City Pass covers all buses, trams, and ferries, plus a 20% discount at three museums."
option_a: How many ferries cross the river every morning?
option_b: Is there a ticket that includes both public transport and museum discounts?
option_c: Could you show me the nearest currency exchange office?
option_d: What time does the central train station close tonight?
explanation: Görevli 24 saatlik City Pass'in tüm toplu taşımayı ve müze indirimini kapsadığını söylediğine göre turist böyle bir bilet olup olmadığını sormuştur.

question_text: Compare the two opinions about souvenir shopping: • Ece: "Buying handmade crafts directly from local artisans helps keep traditional skills alive." • Kaan: "True, but tourists should avoid buying items made from endangered shells or corals." What do Ece and Kaan agree on?
option_a: Factory-made plastic magnets are better than handmade crafts.
option_b: Tourists should never buy any souvenirs.
option_c: Supporting local culture is good, as long as wildlife is not harmed.
option_d: Coral jewelry is the best gift to bring home.
explanation: Ece yerel zanaatkârları desteklemeyi savunur, Kaan bunu onaylar ("True") ancak nesli tükenen deniz canlılarından yapılan ürünlerden kaçınılması gerektiğini ekler.

question_text:
Look at the flight connection schedule:
• Flight 1: Ankara (07:30) → Istanbul (08:40)
• Minimum transfer time required: 60 minutes
• Flight 2 Options from Istanbul to London:
  - TK1981: 09:20
  - TK1985: 10:30
  - TK1989: 13:15
Which flight(s) can a passenger from Flight 1 catch?
explanation: 08:40'ta inen yolcunun en az 60 dakika (09:40'a kadar) aktarma süresine ihtiyacı vardır. 09:20 uçağına yetişemez; 10:30 (TK1985) ve 13:15 (TK1989) uygundur.

question_text:
Which sentence does NOT fit the paragraph?
"(I) Eco-lodges are becoming popular among conscious travelers. (II) They use solar energy and recycle water to reduce environmental impact. (III) Many big city airports have duty-free perfume shops. (IV) Guests also eat organic food grown by nearby farmers."
explanation: Paragraf doğa dostu konaklama tesislerini (eco-lodges) anlatmaktadır; III. cümle ise büyük şehir havalimanlarındaki parfüm dükkânlarından bahsederek akışı bozar.

question_text:
Read the notice in a historic village:
"Please ask for permission before taking photos of local residents, and dress modestly when entering places of worship."
What is the main message of this notice?
option_a: Local residents sell photos to visitors.
option_b: Respect local customs and people's privacy.
option_c: Tourists are not allowed to enter old buildings.
option_d: Photography is banned everywhere in the village.
explanation: İzin isteyerek fotoğraf çekmek ve ibadethanelere uygun giyinmek yerel geleneklere ve kişisel mahremiyete saygı göstermeyi öğütler.

question_text: Four students discuss their dream destinations: • Defne: "I've never been abroad, and I want to see the Pyramids." • Yigit: "I've already seen Paris, so now I want a tropical island." • Sarp: "I've visited London twice; I'd like to try Japanese cuisine in Tokyo." • Nehir: "I prefer exploring ancient Lycian cities in Turkey." Who wants a domestic (in-country) trip?
explanation: Nehir Türkiye içindeki antik Likya kentlerini gezmek istediğini söyleyerek yurt içi (domestic) seyahat tercih etmektedir.

question_text:
In a guidebook, you read: "Skip the overpriced cafes on the main square and walk two streets behind the cathedral for authentic local dishes."
What does the author advise?
option_a: Never eat anything near a cathedral.
option_b: Only visit cafes on the main square.
option_c: Avoid trying local dishes while traveling.
option_d: Eat at quieter side streets for better value and real local food.
explanation: Yazar, ana meydandaki pahalı kafeler yerine iki sokak arkadaki yerlerde daha otantik ve uygun fiyatlı yerel yemekler yenmesini tavsiye etmektedir.

question_text:
Look at the table of 4 Turkish cities:
CityRegionKey AttractionClimate (July)
TrabzonBlack SeaSumela MonasteryMild & Rainy
SanliurfaSoutheastBalikligolVery Hot & Dry
AntalyaMediterraneanAspendos & BeachesHot & Sunny
NevsehirCentral AnatoliaFairy ChimneysWarm & Dry
A traveler who hates extreme heat wants to visit a monastery in July. Which city fits best?
explanation: Aşırı sıcaktan nefret eden ve temmuzda bir manastırı ziyaret etmek isteyen gezgin için ılıman iklimli ve Sümela Manastırı'na ev sahipliği yapan Trabzon uygundur.

question_text: Which sentence has the SAME meaning as "I haven't been to Bodrum for five years"?
option_a: I stayed in Bodrum for five years.
option_b: The last time I visited Bodrum was five years ago.
option_c: I am going to Bodrum in five years.
option_d: I have never visited Bodrum in my life.
explanation: "Beş yıldır Bodrum'a gitmedim" cümlesi "Bodrum'u en son beş yıl önce ziyaret ettim" ile aynı anlamdadır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Guest: "Excuse me, my room faces the street and the noise is terrible. Is it possible to move to a quieter room?"
Receptionist: "Let me check... We have a room overlooking the inner courtyard on the fourth floor. It's completely quiet."
Guest: "That would be wonderful, thank you!"
How is the problem solved?
option_a: The guest pays double for a louder room.
option_b: The receptionist closes the main street outside.
option_c: The receptionist offers a courtyard-facing room on a higher floor.
option_d: The guest leaves the hotel immediately.
explanation: Resepsiyonist dördüncü katta iç avluya bakan sessiz bir oda önererek sorunu çözer.

question_text:
Read the sentence: "Although the flight was long and exhausting, seeing the Northern Lights made every hour worth it."
What does the speaker mean?
option_a: The amazing experience compensated for the tiring journey.
option_b: The flight was short and very comfortable.
option_c: The Northern Lights were disappointing after the long flight.
option_d: They regretted going on the trip.
explanation: Uzun ve yorucu uçuşa rağmen Kuzey Işıkları'nı görmenin her saate değdiği, yani deneyimin yorgunluğu telafi ettiği anlatılmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the cultural etiquette guide:
"In Japan, it is polite to take off your shoes before entering traditional inns (ryokan) and to speak quietly on trains."
If a tourist talks loudly on a phone inside a Japanese train, locals will probably find it ----.
explanation: Trenlerde sessiz konuşmanın kibarlık olduğu belirtildiğine göre yüksek sesle telefonda konuşmak kaba (impolite) bulunacaktır.

question_text: Read the two paragraphs: Paragraph A: "Virtual museum tours allow students anywhere in the world to zoom in on famous paintings for free." Paragraph B: "However, standing in front of a 2,000-year-old marble statue in person creates an emotional connection no screen can replace." What is the relationship between Paragraph A and Paragraph B?
option_a: Both paragraphs say real museums are useless.
option_b: Paragraph A disagrees with free education.
option_c: Paragraph B presents a limitation of what Paragraph A praises.
option_d: Paragraph B gives another example of virtual tours.
explanation: A paragrafı sanal turların faydasını överken, B paragrafı ("However") ekranın gerçek deneyimin yerini tutamayacağını belirterek sınırlılığını ortaya koyar.

question_text:
Which question CANNOT be answered by the text?
"Located in Jordan, Petra is a famous archaeological site carved into pink sandstone cliffs over 2,000 years ago. Visitors walk through a narrow canyon called the Siq to reach the Treasury building."
option_a: How do visitors reach the Treasury?
option_b: In which country is Petra located?
option_c: What color is the stone in Petra?
option_d: How many tourists visit Petra each year?
explanation: Metinde Ürdün'de olduğu, pembe kumtaşından oyulduğu ve Siq kanyonundan geçildiği yazar; ancak yıllık ziyaretçi sayısı belirtilmemiştir.

question_text:
Arrange the travel steps in the most logical order:
I. Pass through security check and passport control.
II. Pack your suitcase and check your travel documents.
III. Board the plane at the assigned gate.
IV. Arrive at the airport and drop off your luggage at the check-in desk.
What is the correct order?
explanation: Önce evde valiz hazırlanır (II), havalimanında check-in yapılır (IV), güvenlik ve pasaporttan geçilir (I) ve kapıdan uçağa binilir (III).

question_text:
Which word best replaces the underlined phrase?
"The old town is <u>well worth visiting</u> because of its colorful markets and friendly locals."
option_c: too boring to spend time in
explanation: "Well worth visiting" görülmeye kesinlikle değer, yani görülmesi tavsiye edilir (definitely recommended to see) anlamındadır.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Eda: "Did you enjoy your trip to Edinburgh?"
Buse: "Yes! The castle on the volcanic rock was dramatic. Just one tip: bring a waterproof jacket even in July!"
Eda: "Why? Isn't July warm there?"
Buse: "Warmish, yes, but sudden rain showers can surprise you any afternoon."
What does Buse warn Eda about?
option_b: Lack of hotels in the city
explanation: Buse temmuz ayında bile ani yağmur sağanakları olabileceği için su geçirmez ceket getirilmesi konusunda uyarmaktadır.

question_text: Compare two types of vacations: • Solo Backpacking: Flexible schedule, budget-friendly hostels, meet new people, carry your own heavy bag. • Guided Package Tour: Fixed timetable, comfortable coach, hotel & meals arranged, less free time. Who would prefer Solo Backpacking?
option_a: Someone who needs a guide for every museum
option_b: Someone who hates carrying a backpack and wants fixed meal times
option_c: Someone who refuses to stay in hostels
option_d: Someone who wants freedom to change plans and spend less money
explanation: Planlarını özgürce değiştirmek (flexible schedule) ve daha az harcamak (budget-friendly) isteyen biri tek başına sırt çantalı geziyi tercih eder.

question_text:
Complete the sentence accurately:
"Not only ---- rich historical monuments, ---- also offers stunning natural beaches."
explanation: "Not only" cümle başında devrik yapı gerektirir ("does Turkey have") ve devamında "but ... also" ile bağlanır.

question_text:
Read the sign at an eco-resort:
"Help us save water: Hang your towels if you want to reuse them; leave them on the floor only if you need fresh ones."
What should a guest do to help the environment?
option_a: Ask for three extra towels daily
option_b: Hang their towels back up after using them
option_c: Wash towels in the swimming pool
option_d: Throw all towels on the floor every morning
explanation: Çevreye ve su tasarrufuna destek olmak için havluları tekrar kullanmak üzere asmak (hang) gerekir.

question_text: After dinner, I always ---- the dishwasher and put the clean plates back into the cupboard.
explanation: Temiz tabakları dolaba yerleştirmeden önce bulaşık makinesini boşaltmak (empty the dishwasher) gerekir.

question_text: In our house, everyone ---- share the chores so that nobody gets too tired.
explanation: Kimsenin aşırı yorulmaması için herkesin ev işlerini paylaşması gerekir (must).

question_text:
Look at the family chore list:
• Mom: Cook dinner
• Dad: Take out the rubbish
• Elif: Set the table
• Mert: Water the plants
Who is responsible for a garden or balcony chore?
explanation: Çiçekleri/bitkileri sulamak (water the plants) bahçe veya balkonda yapılan bir görevdir ve Mert'e aittir.

question_text: Today is Saturday, so students ---- go to school.
explanation: Cumartesi günü okula gitme zorunluluğu olmadığı için "don't have to" (zorunda değil) kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the note on the fridge: "Dear Can,
Don't forget to feed Snowy before you leave for football practice! His food bowl is next to the back door. – Dad" Who or what is Snowy?
explanation: "Feed Snowy" ve "food bowl" (mama kabı) ifadeleri Snowy'nin bir evcil hayvan olduğunu gösterir.

question_text: My shirts are very wrinkled. I need to ---- them before the school ceremony.
explanation: Kırışık gömlekleri düzeltmek için ütülemek (iron) gerekir.

question_text:
Read the classroom rule sign: "Library Rules:
1. Keep quiet.
2. Return books on time.
3. ----" Which rule fits the blank?
explanation: Kütüphane kurallarına uygun olan ifade içeride yiyip içmemektir (Don't eat or drink inside).

question_text: You ---- touch that hot pan without oven gloves! You will burn your hands.
explanation: Ellerini yakmamak için sıcak tavaya dokunmak yasaktır/tehlikelidir; "mustn't" kullanılır.

question_text:
Look at the table of weekly chores:
DayChore
MondayDo the laundry
WednesdayVacuum the carpets
FridayMop the kitchen floor
Which chore is done in the middle of the week?
explanation: Hafta ortası Çarşamba (Wednesday) günüdür ve görev halıları süpürmektir (Vacuum the carpets).

question_text: Could you please ---- the table? Dinner will be ready in five minutes.
explanation: Akşam yemeğinden beş dakika önce masayı kurmak için "set the table" kalıbı kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Mom: "Your room is in a complete mess, Bora! Toys and books are all over the floor."
Bora: "Sorry, Mom. I'll ---- right now."
What will Bora do?
explanation: Odası dağınık olan Bora odasını toplayacaktır (tidy up his room).

question_text: Selin hates ---- the furniture because the dust makes her sneeze.
explanation: Toz hapşırmasına neden olduğu için Selin mobilyaların tozunu almaktan (dusting) nefret etmektedir.

explanation: Grafikte en yüksek çubuk 40 kişi ile Ironing (ütü yapma) görevidir.

question_text: Every morning, Kerem ---- his bed before having breakfast.
explanation: Yatağı toplamak/düzeltmek İngilizcede "make one's bed" kalıbıyla ifade edilir.

question_text:
Read the text message:
"Hi Sis! Can you do the grocery shopping on your way home? We have no milk or bread left. – Mom"
What does Mom ask her daughter to do?
option_b: Walk the dog in the park
option_d: Buy food and basic items from the market
explanation: Süt ve ekmek bittiği için market alışverişi (grocery shopping) yapması istenmektedir.

question_text: My brother ---- walk the dog every evening at 7 p.m. It is his daily duty.
explanation: Üçüncü tekil şahıs ("My brother") için zorunluluk "has to" ile kurulur.

question_text: Read the chore card: "Task: Collect all dirty clothes, separate whites and colors, and put them in the machine." Which chore is described?
explanation: Kirli giysileri toplayıp renklerine göre ayırarak makineye koymak çamaşır yıkamaktır (doing the laundry).

question_text: After we finish eating, my sister and I ---- the table and put leftovers in the fridge.
explanation: Yemek bittikten sonra masayı toplamak için "clear the table" kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Ada: "Who takes out the rubbish in your family?"
Efe: "----. I do it on Mondays, and he does it on Thursdays."
Which answer fits best?
option_b: I hate watching TV at night
option_d: My dad and I take turns
explanation: Pazartesi ben, perşembe o yapıyor dediğine göre babasıyla sırayla (take turns) yapmaktadırlar.

question_text: To clean the wet juice spilled on the kitchen floor, we need a ---- and a bucket.
explanation: Yere dökülen sıvıyı silmek için paspas (mop) ve kova gerekir.

question_text:
Look at the school notice: "Attention Students!
Keep your desks clean and put litter in the recycling bins." Where should students throw empty plastic bottles?
explanation: Duyuruda çöplerin geri dönüşüm kutularına (recycling bins) atılması istenmektedir.

question_text: In Turkey, people usually take off their shoes at the door to keep the carpets ----.
explanation: Halıların temiz (clean) kalması için kapıda ayakkabılar çıkarılır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Dad: "Could you help me wash the car?"
Deniz: "Sure! I'll get the sponge and soap."
How does Deniz react to his dad's request?
option_b: He refuses because he is busy.
option_c: He asks his dad to wash his bike.
explanation: "Sure!" diyerek sünger ve sabunu almaya giden Deniz babasının ricasını memnuniyetle kabul etmektedir.

question_text: When the trash bin is full, it is time to ----.
explanation: Çöp kutusu dolduğunda çöpü dışarı çıkarmak (take out the garbage) gerekir.

question_text:
Look at the weekend plan:
• 09:00 – Tidy bedroom
• 11:00 – Help Mom bake a cake
• 14:00 – Meet friends at the park
When is the person free to have fun outside?
explanation: 14:00'te (2 p.m.) parkta arkadaşlarla buluşma olduğu için öğleden sonra dışarıda vakit geçirecektir.

question_text: Which chore is usually done OUTDOORS?
explanation: Çimleri biçmek (mowing the lawn) dış mekânda yapılan bir iştir.

question_text:
Read the sentence:
"I don't mind washing the dishes, but I really hate cleaning the bathroom."
Which statement is TRUE?
option_a: The speaker refuses to wash any dishes.
option_b: The speaker never helps at home.
option_c: The speaker loves cleaning the bathroom.
option_d: The speaker dislikes bathroom chores more than dishwashing.
explanation: "Don't mind" sorun etmemek, "really hate" ise çok nefret etmek anlamındadır.

question_text: You ---- speak loudly in a hospital corridor; patients need rest.
explanation: Hastaların dinlenmesi gerektiği için hastane koridorunda yüksek sesle konuşmak yasaktır/yanlıştır (mustn't).

question_text:
Read the note:
"Thanks for sweeping the balcony, Arda! Now it looks spotless. – Grandma"
What did Arda use to clean the balcony?
explanation: Balkonu süpürmek (sweeping) için süpürge (broom) kullanılır.

question_text: My little sister is only four, so she ---- do heavy chores like vacuuming.
explanation: Dört yaşındaki bir çocuğun elektrik süpürgesi çekmek gibi ağır işleri yapma zorunluluğu yoktur (doesn't have to).

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Mom: "Sarp, why haven't you taken out the rubbish yet? The truck comes in ten minutes!"
Sarp: "I'm sorry, Mom! I was finishing my science project. I'm taking it out right now."
Why was Sarp late with his chore?
option_a: He was sleeping in his bedroom.
option_b: He was busy working on a school assignment.
option_c: He forgot where the trash bin was.
option_d: He thought the truck came tomorrow.
explanation: Sarp fen projesini bitirmekle meşgul olduğu için çöpü çıkarmakta gecikmiştir.

question_text:
Look at the chore schedule for 3 roommates:
RoommateMon & ThuTue & FriWeekend
AliCook dinnerWash dishesGrocery shopping
BoraWash dishesVacuum floorLaundry
CemTake out trashCook dinnerClean bathroom
Who cooks dinner on Tuesday and washes the dishes on Monday?
option_a: Cem cooks on Tuesday; Bora washes dishes on Monday.
option_b: Bora cooks on Tuesday; Ali washes dishes on Monday.
option_c: Ali cooks on Tuesday; Cem washes dishes on Monday.
option_d: Cem cooks on Tuesday; Ali washes dishes on Monday.
explanation: Tabloda Salı (Tue) akşam yemeğini Cem pişirir; Pazartesi (Mon) bulaşıkları Bora yıkar.

question_text:
Compare:
1. "You mustn't park here."
2. "You don't have to pay for parking on Sundays."
What is the difference?
option_a: Both sentences mean you must pay money.
option_b: Both sentences mean parking is forbidden.
option_c: Sentence 1 is optional; Sentence 2 is a strict rule.
option_d: Sentence 1 shows a prohibition; Sentence 2 shows no necessity.
explanation: "Mustn't" yasak (prohibition), "don't have to" ise gereksizlik/zorunlu olmama (no necessity) bildirir.

question_text:
Read the paragraph:
"At our home, chores are not divided by gender. My brother cooks pasta very well, and I enjoy fixing broken chairs or painting the garden fence. Sharing responsibilities fairly makes our family happier."
What is the main message of this text?
option_a: Fixing chairs is much harder than cooking.
option_b: Only boys should cook and only girls should paint.
option_c: All family members can do any chore regardless of gender.
option_d: Families should hire cleaners instead of sharing chores.
explanation: Metinde ev işlerinin cinsiyete göre ayrılmadığı, adil paylaşımın aileyi mutlu ettiği vurgulanmaktadır.

question_text:
Teacher: "Before leaving the science lab, you ---- turn off all microscopes and clean your workbench."
Student: "Okay, we'll do that right away."
explanation: Laboratuvardan çıkmadan önce mikroskopları kapatmak ve masayı temizlemek uyulması gereken bir kuraldır (must).

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Nil: "I hate folding clothes after doing the laundry. It takes forever!"
Kaan: "I actually find it relaxing. How about a deal? I'll fold the clothes if you vacuum the living room."
Nil: "Deal! I prefer vacuuming anyway."
What do Nil and Kaan agree to do?
option_a: Leave all the clothes unfolded on the sofa
option_c: Swap chores according to what each person prefers
option_d: Ask their parents to do both chores
explanation: Kaan çamaşır katlamayı sevdiği, Nil ise süpürmeyi tercih ettiği için işleri kendi tercihlerine göre değiş tokuş ederler.

question_text: Which sentence expresses a COMPLAINT about a chore?
option_a: I'm really proud of how clean my desk looks today.
option_b: Would you like me to help you water the garden?
option_c: We always finish cleaning in thirty minutes when we work together.
option_d: It's so annoying that my brother never puts his dirty socks in the laundry basket!
explanation: Kardeşinin kirli çoraplarını sepete koymamasından yakınan cümle bir şikâyet (complaint) ifadesidir.

question_text:
Read the house rules for guests:
• Please take off outdoor shoes at the entrance.
• Quiet hours start at 23:00.
• Keep shared kitchen counters clean after cooking.
Which behavior would BREAK the house rules?
option_a: Washing your plate right after dinner
option_b: Leaving dirty pans on the kitchen counter overnight
option_d: Wearing indoor slippers in the living room
explanation: Ortak mutfak tezgâhını temiz bırakma kuralına göre kirli tavaları gece boyunca tezgahta bırakmak kuralı ihlal eder.

question_text: My mom is out of town for two days, so my dad and I ---- prepare dinner ourselves.
explanation: Anne şehir dışında olduğu için baba ve çocuk akşam yemeğini kendileri hazırlamak zorundadır (have to).

question_text: Four teens talk about their chores: • Ece: "I take care of our cat, Boncuk." • Mert: "I dry and put away the plates." • Zeynep: "I sweep the dry leaves off the porch." • Bora: "I separate plastic, glass, and paper." Who is helping with recycling?
explanation: Plastik, cam ve kâğıdı ayıran Bora geri dönüşüm (recycling) görevini yapmaktadır.

question_text: Which pair of chore and room is INCORRECT?
explanation: Çimleri biçmek (mowing the lawn) banyoda değil bahçede yapılır.

question_text:
Read the email from a camp leader:
"Dear Campers, tomorrow is Cabin Inspection Day! Make sure your beds are neat, wet towels are hung outside, and there is no food inside your tents."
What will camp leaders check tomorrow?
option_b: Cleanliness and order inside the sleeping areas
option_c: How fast campers can swim across the lake
explanation: Yatakların düzeni, ıslak havlular ve çadırlarda yiyecek olmaması uyuma alanlarının temizlik ve düzeninin kontrol edileceğini gösterir.

question_text:
Complete the dialogue:
A: "Do I ---- wear a uniform on Fridays?"
B: "No, Fridays are casual dress days, so you can wear jeans."
explanation: Soru kalıbında "Do I + V1" yapısıyla zorunluluk sormak için "have to" kullanılır.

question_text:
Look at the checklist on Pelin's desk:
[✓] Feed the goldfish
[✓] Empty the trash bin
[  ] Iron school shirt
[  ] Water balcony flowers
Which chores has Pelin NOT done yet?
option_b: Feeding the fish and emptying the trash
option_c: Ironing her shirt and watering the flowers
option_d: She has finished all four chores.
explanation: İşaretlenmemiş (boş) kutular ütü yapmak ve balkon çiçeklerini sulamaktır.

question_text: In my opinion, teaching children small chores at an early age helps them become ---- adults.
explanation: Çocuklara küçük yaşta ev işleri öğretmek onların sorumlu (responsible) yetişkinler olmasını sağlar.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Dad: "Why is the kitchen floor all soapy?"
Eren: "I tried to mop it, but I put too much detergent in the bucket."
Dad: "No problem! Let's rinse the mop with clean water and go over it again."
How does the dad react?
option_a: He tells Eren never to clean again
option_c: He refuses to enter the kitchen
explanation: Baba "Sorun değil! Paspası temiz suyla durulayıp tekrar geçelim" diyerek sakin ve yardımsever bir tutum sergiler.

question_text: Which sentence has a GRAMMAR error?
option_a: She musts tidy her desk before dinner.
option_b: We don't have to wake up early tomorrow.
option_c: He has to walk the dog twice a day.
option_d: You mustn't leave the fridge door open.
explanation: "Must" bir modal fiildir ve "-s" takısı almaz; "She must tidy..." olmalıdır.

question_text:
Read the note from a teacher:
"Thank you to Group B for cleaning the art room after painting! The brushes are washed and the tables are spotless."
What did Group B do?
option_b: They left the tables covered in paint.
option_c: They forgot to wash the paintbrushes.
option_d: They tidied up the art room after the activity.
explanation: B Grubu resim etkinliği sonrası fırçaları yıkayıp masaları tertemiz yaparak resim odasını toplamıştır.

question_text: When you finish using the bathroom, you should ---- the lights to save electricity.
explanation: Elektrik tasarrufu için ışıkları kapatmak (turn off) gerekir.

question_text:
Look at the table showing how long chores take in the Kaya family:
ChoreTime Needed
Vacuuming the house40 mins
Washing & drying dishes25 mins
Taking out trash5 mins
Making beds10 mins
If Arda has only 20 minutes before his bus arrives, which TWO chores can he finish completely?
option_b: Taking out trash and making beds
option_c: Washing dishes and taking out trash
explanation: Çöp çıkarma (5 dk) ve yatak toplama (10 dk) toplam 15 dakika sürer ve 20 dakikanın içine sığar.

question_text: I really ---- doing the ironing; I always watch a funny show while ironing to make it less boring.
explanation: Daha az sıkıcı hale getirmek için dizi izlediğine göre ütü yapmaktan hoşlanmamaktadır (dislike).

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Maya: "Could you lend me a hand with these heavy grocery bags?"
Tuna: "Of course! Let me carry the water bottles."
What does "lend me a hand" mean here?
explanation: "Lend someone a hand" birine yardım etmek (help) anlamına gelen bir deyimdir.

question_text: Which duty belongs to STUDENTS at school rather than at home?
explanation: Dersten sonra tahtayı silmek (erasing the whiteboard) okuldaki öğrenci sorumluluklarındandır.

question_text:
Read the tip:
"To finish weekend cleaning twice as fast, put on upbeat music and set a 20-minute timer for each room."
What is the purpose of this tip?
option_a: To buy more expensive cleaning products
option_b: To make household chores faster and more enjoyable
option_c: To avoid cleaning the house altogether
option_d: To listen to music instead of working
explanation: Hareketli müzik açıp zamanlayıcı kurmak ev işlerini daha hızlı ve keyifli hale getirmeyi amaçlar.

question_text: You ---- forget to lock the front door when you are the last person to leave the house.
explanation: Evden son çıkan kişi kapıyı kilitlemeyi unutmamalıdır; yasak/kesin uyarı anlamında "mustn't" kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the diary entry:
"Today I cooked vegetable soup all by myself for the first time! Everyone at the table asked for a second bowl. Doing chores feels great when your family appreciates it."
How does the writer feel?
explanation: Herkes ikinci kaseyi isteyince ve ailesi takdir edince yazar gururlu ve mutlu (proud and happy) hissetmektedir.

question_text: Before putting clothes into the washing machine, you should always check the ---- so nothing shrinks.
explanation: Giysilerin çekmemesi için yıkamadan önce etiketlerini (labels) kontrol etmek gerekir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Asli: "Is it your turn to clean the hamster cage?"
Berk: "No, I cleaned it on Tuesday. Today it's my sister's turn."
What does this dialogue show?
option_a: Berk refuses to take care of the hamster.
option_b: Berk and his sister share pet care duties.
option_c: The hamster cage is never cleaned.
option_d: Asli has to clean the cage today.
explanation: Salı günü Berk'in, bugün ise kız kardeşinin temizlemesi evcil hayvan bakımını paylaştıklarını gösterir.

question_text: Which word is closest in meaning to "duty"?
explanation: "Duty" görev anlamına gelir; anlamca en yakın sözcük "responsibility" (sorumluluk) kelimesidir.

question_text:
Read the rules for a shared student flat:
1. Everyone must wash their own dishes immediately after eating.
2. Vacuuming the living room rotates every Sunday (Week 1: Deniz, Week 2: Emir, Week 3: Can).
3. Quiet hours are 22:30–07:00 on weekdays.
4. Nobody has to cook for others; everyone prepares their own meals.

It is Week 2 (Sunday afternoon). Emir is vacuuming, and Can leaves his dirty mug in the sink. Which rule(s) are followed or broken?
option_b: Both Rule 1 and Rule 2 are broken.
option_c: Rule 2 is followed, while Rule 1 is broken by Can.
explanation: 2. haftada Emir süpürdüğü için Kural 2'ye uyulmuştur; Can kirli kupasını lavaboda bıraktığı için Kural 1'i bozmuştur.

question_text:
Look at the survey results of 100 parents and 100 teens about household chores:
ChoreTeens Who Enjoy ItParents Who Expect Teens to Do It
Tidying bedroom45%92%
Cooking simple meals62%55%
Taking out trash28%78%
Doing laundry19%40%
Which conclusion is SUPPORTED by the table?
option_a: Parents expect teens to do laundry more than taking out trash.
option_b: Over 80% of teens enjoy tidying their bedrooms.
option_c: Teens enjoy doing laundry more than tidying their bedrooms.
option_d: Cooking simple meals is the only chore where teen enjoyment exceeds parent expectation.
explanation: Tabloda gençlerin sevme oranının (%62), ebeveyn beklentisinden (%55) yüksek olduğu tek görev basit yemekler pişirmektir.
