Which statement is TRUE if their parents want equal chore distribution (around 4–5 hours each)?
option_a: All four siblings spend the exact same time on chores.
option_b: Kerem does the least work among all siblings.
option_c: Ozan does too little, while Seda does slightly more than the target.
option_d: Eda does fewer hours than Ozan.
explanation: Hedef 4-5 saatken Ozan 2 saatle çok az yapmakta, Seda 6 saatle hedefin biraz üstüne çıkmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the text:
"Some parents pay their children pocket money for doing basic chores like making their beds. However, many educators argue that everyday tasks teach teamwork and belonging, not just working for cash."
What do those educators believe?
option_a: Basic chores should be done as part of family membership, not for money.
option_b: Children should never help around the house.
option_c: Making a bed does not teach any useful skill.
option_d: Parents must pay high wages for every small task.
explanation: Eğitimciler günlük işlerin para için değil, aile üyeliği ve takım ruhunun parçası olarak yapılması gerektiğini savunmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue carefully:
Mom: "Wait! You don't have to mop the hall today; the plumber is coming at 3 p.m. and will walk through in boots."
Ali: "Oh, good thing you told me! Should I dust the living room instead?"
Mom: "Yes, please, and don't forget you must keep the cat inside while the door is open."
Which statement is FALSE?
option_a: A plumber is visiting the house in the afternoon.
option_b: Ali has to mop the hall before 3 p.m.
option_c: The cat must stay indoors when the door is open.
option_d: Ali will dust the living room instead of mopping.
explanation: Anne bugün koridoru paspaslamak zorunda olmadığını ("don't have to mop") söylemiştir; dolayısıyla 3'ten önce paspaslamak zorunda olduğu yanlıştır.

question_text: Four classmates are assigned duties for the School Eco-Day: • Duty 1: Water the newly planted saplings. • Duty 2: Sort paper and plastic waste. • Duty 3: Wipe the classroom windows. • Duty 4: Sweep the schoolyard. Clues: Defne is allergic to dust, so she shouldn't sweep. Yigit works outdoors with plants. Ela prefers indoor tasks. Mert handles recycling. Who does Duty 3?
explanation: Yigit bitkileri sular (Duty 1), Mert geri dönüşümü yapar (Duty 2). Defne toz alerjisi yüzünden süpüremez ama Ela iç mekân görevi olan sınıf camlarını silmeyi (Duty 3) seçer.

question_text: Which sentence has a DIFFERENT meaning from the other three?
option_a: It isn't necessary for you to bring lunch to the picnic.
option_b: You needn't bring your own lunch to the picnic.
option_c: You mustn't bring your own lunch to the picnic.
option_d: You don't have to bring your own lunch to the picnic.
explanation: Üç cümle yemek getirmenin zorunlu olmadığını ("don't have to / not necessary / needn't") söylerken, "mustn't" getirmenin yasak olduğunu ifade eder.

question_text:
Read the short story:
"Whenever guests visited, Emir used to hide all his toys inside the closet in two minutes. One day, his aunt opened the closet for a coat hanger, and a mountain of toys tumbled out!"
What lesson does Emir probably learn?
option_a: Closets are only meant for storing toys.
option_b: Real tidying means organizing things properly, not hiding messes.
option_c: Cleaning in two minutes is always the best method.
option_d: He should never invite his aunt to the house.
explanation: Oyuncakları dolaba tıkıştırınca hepsi döküldüğü için Emir gerçek toplamanın dağınıklığı saklamak değil, düzenli yerleştirmek olduğunu öğrenir.

question_text:
Analyze the table of robot vacuum vs. manual vacuum:
FeatureRobot VacuumManual Vacuum
Effort neededVery lowHigh
Stairs & cornersCannot clean wellCleans thoroughly
PriceHighModerate
Which conclusion is MOST accurate?
option_a: A robot vacuum saves effort, but a manual vacuum is better for stairs and corners.
option_b: Both vacuums require the exact same physical effort.
option_c: A robot vacuum cleans stairs better than a manual one.
option_d: A manual vacuum is more expensive and takes less effort.
explanation: Tabloya göre robot süpürge az çaba gerektirir ama merdiven ve köşeleri iyi temizleyemez; manuel süpürge ise buraları iyice temizler.

question_text:
Complete the dialogue:
Parent: "Why did you leave the iron plugged in after finishing your shirt?"
Teen: "----"
Parent: "Please be careful next time; it's a serious fire hazard."
option_a: I always plug in the dishwasher before going to bed.
option_b: Because ironing shirts is my favorite weekend hobby.
option_c: You don't have to wear a shirt to the office today.
option_d: Oh no, I completely forgot! Let me unplug it right away.
explanation: Ebeveyn ütüyü fişte bırakmanın yangın tehlikesi olduğunu söylediğine göre genç unuttuğunu fark edip hemen fişi çekeceğini söylemelidir.

question_text: Read the two opinions on teen responsibilities: • Mr. Kaya: "High schoolers have heavy exam schedules, so they shouldn't do any chores on weekdays." • Mrs. Demir: "Even 15 minutes of daily chores helps teens take breaks from screens and stay organized." What do they disagree on?
option_a: Whether screens are bad for eyesight
option_b: Whether adults should work on weekends
option_c: Whether teenagers should do chores during school weekdays
option_d: Whether exams are difficult for students
explanation: Bay Kaya hafta içi hiç ev işi yapmamaları gerektiğini, Bayan Demir ise günde 15 dakikanın bile faydalı olduğunu savunarak hafta içi ev işi konusunda ayrışırlar.

question_text:
Read the weekly routine of Ece:
"Every morning I make my bed and feed our parrot. On Wednesdays and Saturdays, I vacuum my room. I never iron clothes because my dad enjoys ironing while listening to podcasts."
How many times a week does Ece vacuum her room, and who irons?
option_a: Twice a week; her dad irons.
option_c: Once a week; her mom irons.
explanation: Çarşamba ve Cumartesi günleri haftada iki kez (twice a week) süpürür; ütüyü ise babası yapar.

question_text:
Which sentence does NOT belong in the paragraph?
"(I) Doing chores together can strengthen family bonds. (II) When parents and kids cook or clean as a team, they chat and laugh. (III) Modern washing machines have eco-friendly programs that save water. (IV) Children also feel valued when their help makes a real difference."
explanation: Paragraf birlikte ev işi yapmanın aile bağlarını güçlendirmesinden söz ederken III. cümle çamaşır makinesi programlarına geçerek akışı bozar.

question_text:
Read the notice in a school science club:
"Rule 1: Always wear safety goggles during experiments.
Rule 2: Wash beakers and wipe tables before leaving.
Rule 3: Never taste any chemical substance."
Which rule is specifically a CHORE (cleaning duty) rather than a personal safety rule?
explanation: Beherleri yıkamak ve masaları silmek ikinci kural kapsamındaki temizlik görevidir; birinci ve üçüncü kurallar kişisel güvenlik kurallarıdır.

question_text:
Look at the conversation:
A: "Can you take out the recycling?"
B: "I'd love to help, ---- I'm carrying a pot of boiling soup right now. Ask me in five minutes!"
Which statement best describes B's response?
option_a: B dislikes helping with kitchen duties.
option_b: B wants A to carry the boiling soup instead.
option_c: B is willing to do the chore, just not at this exact second.
option_d: B completely refuses to ever take out the recycling.
explanation: B yardım etmek istediğini ama şu an kaynar çorba taşıdığını söyleyerek beş dakika sonra yapabileceğini belirtir.

question_text:
Which question CANNOT be answered by the text?
"In Japan, students clean their own classrooms, hallways, and even school restrooms for about 20 minutes each day. This tradition, called 'o-soji', teaches respect for shared spaces."
option_a: What time of day do students eat lunch?
option_b: What is the main purpose of o-soji?
option_c: How long does daily cleaning take?
explanation: Metinde 20 dakika sürdüğü, sınıf/koridor/tuvaletlerin temizlendiği ve ortak alanlara saygıyı öğrettiği yazar; öğle yemeği saati yoktur.

question_text:
Arrange the steps of doing the laundry safely:
I. Hang the wet clothes on the drying rack.
II. Check pockets for coins or tissues.
III. Select the right temperature and start the machine.
IV. Sort clothes into whites, darks, and colors.
What is the correct sequence?
explanation: Önce renkler ayrılır (IV), cepler kontrol edilir (II), program seçilip makine başlatılır (III) ve ıslak çamaşırlar asılır (I).

question_text:
Read the sentence: "The harder we work together on Saturday morning, the sooner we can go to the cinema."
What does this sentence mean?
option_a: Only one person should clean while others watch movies.
option_b: We cannot go to the cinema if we clean on Saturday.
option_c: Working together makes cleaning take longer.
option_d: Cooperating well on chores gives us more free time earlier.
explanation: "Ne kadar sıkı birlikte çalışırsak sinemaya o kadar erken gidebiliriz" cümlesi iş birliğinin daha erken serbest zaman kazandıracağını anlatır.

explanation: Işıkları kapatmak (%88), yemek kompostu yapmanın (%25) üç katından fazladır (25 × 3 = 75).

question_text: In which sentence is "have to" used to express a PAST obligation?
option_a: Yesterday, I had to stay home and look after my little brother.
option_b: Every day, she has to water the tomatoes.
option_c: Tomorrow, I will have to clean the garage.
option_d: Do you have to wear a helmet on a bike?
explanation: Geçmişteki bir zorunluluk "had to" (Yesterday, I had to...) ile ifade edilir.

question_text:
Read the scenario:
"Your parents come home exhausted from work. The sink is full of dishes, and the living room floor has crumbs on it. You have finished your homework."
What is the MOST considerate thing to do?
option_a: Ask them to cook dinner immediately
option_b: Wash the dishes and sweep the floor before they ask
option_c: Leave the room and play video games loudly
option_d: Wait until tomorrow afternoon to tidy up
explanation: Ödevini bitirmiş biri olarak yorgun ebeveynler istemeden bulaşıkları yıkayıp yeri süpürmek en düşünceli davranıştır.

question_text:
Choose the best word to complete both sentences:
1. Please ---- the trash out before it smells.
2. My sister and I ---- turns walking the dog.
explanation: "Take the trash out" ve "take turns" (sırayla yapmak) kalıplarının ikisi de "take" fiiliyle kurulur.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Lale: "Why are you separating paper from plastic?"
Cem: "Because our building started a zero-waste program. If we mix them, they can't be recycled properly."
Lale: "That makes sense. Let me bring the glass jars from the kitchen too."
What is Lale's attitude?
explanation: Lale "Mantıklı, mutfaktaki cam kavanozları da getireyim" diyerek destekleyici ve katılımcı bir tutum sergiler.

question_text: Compare two weekly chore plans for a 13-year-old: • Plan X: 3 hours of heavy cleaning only on Sunday night. • Plan Y: 20 minutes of light tasks every day. Why might a student prefer Plan Y?
option_a: It prevents a huge pile-up of work right before Monday school.
option_b: It requires cleaning only once a month.
option_c: It leaves no time for homework on weekdays.
option_d: It takes more total time than Plan X.
explanation: Her gün 20 dakikalık hafif işler, pazar gecesi okul öncesinde büyük bir iş yığını birikmesini önler.

question_text: Which sentence accurately uses "neither ... nor"?
option_a: Neither Ali and Bora enjoy ironing.
option_b: Neither Ali nor Bora enjoys ironing shirts.
option_c: Neither Ali nor Bora don't enjoy ironing.
option_d: Neither Ali or Bora enjoys ironing shirts.
explanation: "Neither A nor B" yapısı olumsuz anlamı kendisi taşır ve "nor" ile bağlanır; ayrıca fiil olumlu çekimlenir.

question_text:
Read the note from a roommate:
"Hey, I noticed we're out of dish soap and sponges. I'm busy until 7 p.m., so could you pick some up on your way back? I'll pay you half tonight!"
What does the roommate offer?
option_a: To go to the store before 7 p.m.
option_b: To wash all the dishes for a month
option_c: To clean without using any soap
option_d: To share the cost of the cleaning supplies
explanation: Ev arkadaşı temizlik malzemelerinin ücretinin yarısını ödemeyi ("pay you half") teklif etmektedir.

question_text: What does the idiom "many hands make light work" mean in the context of chores?
option_a: Working alone is always faster than working in a group.
option_b: You should turn on many lights before cleaning.
option_c: A task becomes much easier when several people share it.
option_d: Only people with small hands can do housework.
explanation: "Bir elin nesi var iki elin sesi var / çok el işi hafifletir" deyimi, bir iş paylaşıldığında çok daha kolay hale gelir demektir.

question_text:
Read the pet care guide:
"Dogs need daily walks for exercise, fresh water at all times, and regular brushing. Never leave chocolate within a dog's reach, as it is toxic to them."
Which chore is a MUST for a dog owner's safety rule?
option_a: Keeping chocolate away from the dog
option_b: Washing the dog only in winter
option_c: Walking the dog once a month
option_d: Giving the dog chocolate as a treat

question_text: Scientists use a ---- in the laboratory to see tiny cells and bacteria.
explanation: Küçük hücreleri ve bakterileri görmek için mikroskop (microscope) kullanılır.

Born: 1946, Mardin, Turkey

explanation: Doğada zaten var olan bir madde bulunduğu için "keşfedildi" (discovered) fiili kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the lab sign: "Science Lab Safety
Always wear safety goggles and a lab coat during chemical experiments." What should students wear in the lab?
option_b: Protective glasses and a lab coat
explanation: Tabelada kimyasal deneylerde koruyucu gözlük (safety goggles) ve laboratuvar önlüğü (lab coat) giyilmesi istenmektedir.

question_text: Astronomers look through a ---- to observe distant stars and planets.
explanation: Uzak yıldızları ve gezegenleri gözlemlemek için teleskop (telescope) kullanılır.

explanation: Tabloya göre uçağı (Airplane) 1903'te Wright Kardeşler icat etmiştir.

explanation: Marie Curie radyoaktivite (radioactivity) üzerine yaptığı araştırmalarla tanınır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Teacher: "What are the students doing in the science room?"

What are the students doing?
explanation: Deney tüplerinde sıvıları karıştırıp not almak bir deney yapmak (conducting an experiment) anlamına gelir.

question_text: Vaccines help protect people from serious ----.
explanation: Aşılar (vaccines) insanları ciddi hastalıklardan (diseases) korur.

explanation: Posterde ziyaretçilerin gerçek göktaşlarına dokunabileceği ve robot köpekleri izleyebileceği yazmaktadır.

question_text: The light bulb ---- improved by Thomas Edison so that it could burn for many hours.
explanation: Tekil özne ("The light bulb") ile Simple Past Passive yapısı "was + V3" şeklinde kurulur.

question_text:
Read the note:
"In 1969, Neil Armstrong stepped onto the Moon and said, 'That's one small step for man...'"
What field of science is this historic event part of?
explanation: Ay'a ayak basılması uzay keşfi (space exploration) alanına aittir.

question_text: A ---- is a person who designs buildings, bridges, or machines using science and math.
explanation: Bilim ve matematik kullanarak köprü, bina veya makine tasarlayan kişi mühendistir (engineer).

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Ada: "Who is your favorite scientist?"
Efe: "Nikola Tesla. He worked on alternating current and wireless energy."
Why does Efe admire Nikola Tesla?
option_a: Because he painted the Mona Lisa
option_b: Because of his work on electricity and energy
option_c: Because he discovered gravity under an apple tree
option_d: Because he invented the first bicycle
explanation: Alternatif akım ve kablosuz enerji çalışmaları elektrik ve enerji alanındadır.

question_text: Doctors use ---- to look at broken bones inside the human body.
explanation: İnsan vücudundaki kırık kemikleri görmek için röntgen (X-rays) kullanılır.

question_text:
Look at the science fair schedule:
• 10:00 – Robotics Demo
• 11:30 – Solar Car Race
• 14:00 – Chemistry Magic Show
When can you watch cars powered by sunlight?
explanation: Güneş enerjili araba yarışı (Solar Car Race) saat 11:30'dadır.

question_text: Modern smartphones ---- changed how people communicate and find information.
explanation: Çoğul özne ("Modern smartphones") ile Present Perfect yardımcı fiili "have" kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the short text:
"Louis Pasteur discovered that heating milk kills harmful bacteria. This process is now called pasteurization."
How did Pasteur's discovery help people?
option_a: It turned milk into solid plastic.
option_b: It made milk and food safer to consume.
option_d: It stopped cows from producing milk.
explanation: Zararlı bakterileri öldürmek sütü ve yiyecekleri tüketim için daha güvenli hale getirmiştir.

question_text: Which word means "to watch something carefully to learn about it"?
explanation: Bir şeyi öğrenmek için dikkatle izlemek "observe" (gözlemlemek) fiilidir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Mom: "What are you reading, Selin?"
Selin: "An article about bionic arms. Engineers are building artificial limbs that move with brain signals!"
What is the article about?
option_c: Medical technology helping people with missing limbs
option_d: A new video game about robots
explanation: Beyin sinyalleriyle hareket eden yapay uzuvlar (bionic arms) tıbbi teknoloji ile ilgilidir.

question_text: In a laboratory, liquids are often measured and heated inside glass ----.
explanation: Laboratuvarda sıvılar cam deney tüplerinde (test tubes) ölçülür ve ısıtılır.

question_text:
Look at the invention timeline:
1876: Telephone → 1903: Airplane → 1928: Penicillin → 1969: Moon Landing
Which event happened FIRST?
explanation: Zaman çizelgesinde en erken yıl 1876 (telefonun icadı) olarak verilmiştir.

question_text: Many factories now use ---- to assemble cars quickly and accurately.
explanation: Fabrikalarda arabaları hızlı ve hassas bir şekilde birleştirmek için robotlar (robots) kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the science quiz clue:
"I am a metal needle that always points north. Sailors have used me for centuries to cross oceans."
What am I?
explanation: Her zaman kuzeyi gösteren metal iğneli yön bulma aracı pusuladır (compass).

question_text: Isaac Newton formulated the laws of motion and ---- after watching an apple fall.
explanation: Elmanın düşmesini gözlemleyen Isaac Newton yerçekimi (gravity) yasalarını formüle etmiştir.

question_text:

option_a: Using fewer colors on his poster
option_b: Recording and presenting his experiment data
explanation: Öğretmen sonuçları bir grafikte açıkça yazmasını söyleyerek deney verilerini kaydetmesini önermektedir.

question_text: 3D ---- can create plastic, metal, or even medical parts layer by layer from a digital design.
explanation: Dijital tasarımdan katman katman nesne üreten cihazlar 3 boyutlu yazıcılardır (3D printers).

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Kerem: "Did Thomas Edison invent electricity?"
Teacher: "No, electricity is a natural form of energy—it was discovered, not invented. Edison developed a practical long-lasting light bulb."
What is the teacher explaining?
option_a: That Thomas Edison never worked with light bulbs
option_b: That light bulbs are a natural form of energy
option_d: The difference between discovering a natural phenomenon and inventing a device
explanation: Öğretmen, doğal bir olguyu keşfetmek (discover) ile bir cihazı icat/geliştirmek (invent/develop) arasındaki farkı açıklamaktadır.

option_a: Marie Curie won Nobel Prizes in two different scientific fields.
option_b: Albert Einstein won his Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
option_c: Marie Curie won her prizes in 2015.
option_d: Aziz Sancar received his prize before Albert Einstein.
explanation: Tabloda Marie Curie'nin hem Fizik (1903) hem Kimya (1911) olmak üzere iki farklı alanda Nobel kazandığı görülmektedir.

option_a: The first vaccine developed by Louis Pasteur in 1885.
option_b: The first vaccine was develop by Louis Pasteur.

option_d: Louis Pasteur was developed the first vaccine for rabies.
explanation: Edilgen geçmiş zaman yapısı "was/were + V3 + by ..." şeklindedir; doğru cümle "was developed by" içerir.

option_a: Only kings were allowed to read printed books.
option_b: Books became heavier and more expensive.
option_d: More people could access books and learn new ideas quickly.
explanation: Matbaa sayesinde kitaplar ucuzlamış ve bilgi hızla yayılmıştır.

option_a: Astronomy is much more exciting than chemistry.

option_c: Marie Curie is the most inspiring scientist ever.
option_d: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
explanation: Suyun deniz seviyesinde 100°C'de kaynaması gözlemlenebilir bilimsel bir gerçektir (scientific fact).

option_a: It was invented in the 18th century.
option_b: It started as a military tool and later became useful in daily life.
option_c: It only works underwater without satellites.
option_d: Only pilots are allowed to use GPS today.
explanation: Başlangıçta askeri navigasyon için geliştirilen GPS'in bugün sürücülere, yürüyüşçülere ve kurtarma ekiplerine yardımcı olduğu belirtilmiştir.

question_text: Ibn Sina (Avicenna) wrote "The Canon of Medicine," which ---- used as a medical textbook for centuries.
explanation: Tekil özne ("The Canon of Medicine") ve geçmiş zaman ("for centuries" in history) nedeniyle "was used" uygundur.

question_text: Four students talk about inventions: • Ece: "Thanks to refrigeration, food stays fresh for days." • Bora: "Without the compass, sailors easily lost their way." • Nil: "Solar panels turn sunlight into clean electricity." • Kaan: "High-speed trains cut travel time in half." Who is talking about renewable energy?
explanation: Güneş panellerinin güneş ışığını temiz elektriğe dönüştürmesinden söz eden Nil yenilenebilir enerji (renewable energy) hakkındadır.

question_text: When an experiment doesn't give the expected result, a good scientist ----.
option_b: changes the numbers to look successful
option_c: throws away all the lab notebooks
option_d: checks the data and tries to understand why
explanation: Beklenen sonuç çıkmadığında iyi bir bilim insanı verileri kontrol eder ve nedenini anlamaya çalışır.

Reporter: "Dr. Yilmaz, what are you working on currently?"

What problem is Dr. Yilmaz trying to solve?
explanation: Mısır nişastasından doğada çözünebilir plastik üretmek okyanuslardaki plastik kirliliğini azaltmayı amaçlamaktadır.

explanation: 2021 yılında fırlatıldığı için Simple Past Passive "was launched" kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the safety warning in a chemistry lab:
"Never pour water into concentrated acid! Always add acid slowly to water while wearing gloves."

option_a: The acid will turn into sweet juice.
option_c: A dangerous chemical reaction or splash might occur.
option_d: The gloves will melt before touching the bottle.
explanation: Uyarıya uyulmazsa tehlikeli bir kimyasal tepkime veya sıçrama meydana gelebilir.

option_a: Archaeology — Study of ancient human remains

explanation: Botanik (botany) uzak galaksileri değil bitkileri inceleyen bilim dalıdır.

3. ----

explanation: Hipotez kurduktan sonraki adım hipotezi test etmek için deney yapmaktır (conduct an experiment).

option_d: She invented the first television screen.
explanation: Frekans atlamalı sinyal sistemi fikri Wi-Fi ve Bluetooth gibi kablosuz iletişim teknolojilerinin temelini atmıştır.

explanation: Egzoz gazı üretmedikleri için şehir havası açısından daha temizdirler; sonuç bağlacı "so" uygundur.

explanation: Güneş ve Ay'ın konumlarını hesapladığına göre astronomik hareketleri takip etmek için kullanılmıştır.

option_b: Many galaxies have been observed by astronomers.
option_c: Who was the radio invented by?

explanation: Edilgen yapıda fiilin 3. hali kullanılmalıdır; "was invent" yerine "was invented" yazılmalıdır.

What is Ece's opinion?
option_a: Teachers cannot use computers in classrooms.
option_b: AI is a helpful tool, yet human teachers remain irreplaceable.
option_c: Human empathy is not important in education.

explanation: Ece yapay zekânın sınavları hızlı okuyabileceğini ancak insan empatisi ve teşvikinin yerini alamayacağını savunmaktadır.

explanation: Dünya yörüngesinde dönerek hava durumu, TV sinyali ve navigasyon sağlayan araç uydudur (satellite).

question_text:

"Did you know? Velcro—the sticky tape on your sneakers—was invented after Swiss engineer George de Mestral noticed burrs sticking to his dog's fur!"

option_a: Watching airplanes take off at an airport

option_c: How does a solar panel work?
explanation: "Who created...?" sorusu bir şeyin mucidini (inventor) sorar.

Which conclusion is TRUE?
option_a: In 2015, renewables made up over 25% of electricity.
option_d: By 2024, more than half of the country's electricity came from renewable sources.
explanation: 2024 yılında oran %54'e ulaşmıştır; yani elektriğin yarısından fazlası yenilenebilir kaynaklardan gelmektedir.

question_text:
Read the text:
"Serendipity means making a happy discovery by accident. For instance, Percy Spencer noticed a chocolate bar melting in his pocket while standing near radar equipment—an observation that led to the microwave oven."
What does the example of Percy Spencer illustrate?
option_a: Accidents in labs are always dangerous and useless.
option_b: Unexpected observations can lead to major inventions.
option_c: Microwave ovens were planned for fifty years before radar.
option_d: Engineers should never carry chocolate in laboratories.
explanation: Metin, beklenmedik bir gözlemin (cebindeki çikolatanın erimesi) mikrodalga fırın gibi büyük bir icada yol açabileceğini göstermektedir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Nil: "Did you know that Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood?"
Kaan: "Really? Why is their blood blue?"
Nil: "Because it uses copper instead of iron to carry oxygen!"
Kaan: "Nature's chemistry is amazing."
What explains the color of an octopus's blood?
option_a: A copper-based molecule for oxygen transport
option_d: Having three hearts instead of one
explanation: Oksijen taşımak için demir yerine bakır (copper) kullanılması kanın mavi olmasına neden olur.

question_text: Read the two paragraphs: Text A: "Self-driving cars use sensors and AI to react faster than tired human drivers, potentially reducing road accidents." Text B: "However, heavy snow or faded road lines can confuse sensors, raising questions about who is responsible if a crash occurs." What is the main point of reading both texts together?
option_a: Self-driving cars are completely unsafe in all weather.
option_b: Sensors work best during heavy snowstorms.
option_c: Autonomous vehicles offer safety benefits but still face technical and legal challenges.
option_d: Human drivers never get tired on long trips.
explanation: A metni güvenlik faydalarını, B metni ise teknik (kar/silik çizgiler) ve hukuki (sorumluluk) zorlukları ortaya koyar.

question_text:
Which sentence correctly changes the active sentence into PASSIVE?
Active: "Guglielmo Marconi sent the first transatlantic radio signal in 1901."
option_a: Guglielmo Marconi was sent the first radio signal in 1901.
option_b: The first transatlantic radio signal sent Marconi in 1901.
option_c: The first transatlantic radio signal is sent by Marconi in 1901.
option_d: The first transatlantic radio signal was sent by Guglielmo Marconi in 1901.
explanation: Geçmiş zamanlı aktif cümlenin edilgen hali "was sent by Guglielmo Marconi" şeklinde kurulur.

question_text: Four students are matching inventions to their impacts: • Ada: "The steam engine powered factories and trains." • Eren: "The microscope revealed bacteria and cells." • Sila: "The compass made long ocean voyages possible." • Mert: "The printing press cured deadly infections." Whose statement is FACTUALLY WRONG?
explanation: Matbaa (printing press) ölümcül enfeksiyonları tedavi etmez; bunu yapan antibiyotikler/aşılar olmuştur. Mert'in ifadesi yanlıştır.

question_text:
Look at the table of Mars Rover discoveries:
MissionYear LandedKey Finding
Spirit2004Evidence of ancient hot springs
Curiosity2012Organic carbon molecules in rocks
Perseverance2021Ancient river delta sediments
What do all three missions suggest about Mars?
option_a: Mars may have had liquid water and conditions suitable for tiny life in the past.
option_b: Mars is currently covered by deep blue oceans.
option_d: Mars has no rocks or soil at all.
explanation: Antik sıcak su kaynakları, organik karbon molekülleri ve nehir deltası tortuları Mars'ta geçmişte sıvı su ve yaşam koşullarının olabileceğine işaret eder.

question_text:
Which question CANNOT be answered by the text?
"Marie Curie was born in Warsaw in 1867. Unable to attend university in Poland as a woman, she moved to Paris to study physics and math at the Sorbonne. She later discovered two elements: polonium and radium."
option_a: Which two elements did she discover?
option_b: Why did she move to Paris?
option_c: How many children did Marie Curie have?
explanation: Metinde doğum yeri, Paris'e gitme nedeni ve keşfettiği iki element yer alır; ancak kaç çocuğu olduğu belirtilmemiştir.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Student: "Why do astronauts float inside the International Space Station?"
Professor: "People often think there is zero gravity there, but Earth's gravity is still about 90% as strong! Astronauts float because the station is constantly falling around Earth in orbit."
What common myth does the professor correct?
option_a: The claim that space suits are heavy
option_b: The fact that Earth orbits the Sun
option_c: The idea that astronauts work inside a station
option_d: The belief that there is no gravity at all on the space station
explanation: Profesör, uzay istasyonunda hiç yerçekimi olmadığı yönündeki yaygın yanlış inancı düzeltmektedir.

question_text:
Which sentence does NOT fit the paragraph?
"(I) Vaccines train the immune system to recognize dangerous viruses before we get sick. (II) Thanks to global vaccination campaigns, smallpox was completely wiped out in 1980. (III) Many tourists enjoy visiting historic bridges in Europe. (IV) Ongoing research aims to create even safer vaccines for future diseases."
explanation: Paragraf aşılar ve bağışıklık sisteminden bahsederken III. cümle turistlerin tarihi köprüleri gezmesine geçerek bütünlüğü bozar.

question_text:
Read the scenario:
"A team of 8th graders wants to build a solar oven from a pizza box, aluminum foil, and plastic wrap. On test day, it is cloudy and windy."
What will MOST likely happen to their test?
option_a: The oven will heat up much more slowly because there is less direct sunlight.
option_b: The aluminum foil will produce electricity on its own.
option_c: The pizza box will freeze immediately.
option_d: The oven will cook food twice as fast without sun.
explanation: Bulutlu ve rüzgârlı havada doğrudan güneş ışığı azaldığı için güneş fırını çok daha yavaş ısınacaktır.

question_text:
Complete the sentence accurately:
"Not until the invention of the electron microscope ---- scientists see individual viruses clearly."
explanation: Cümle başında "Not until..." olumsuz zaman zarfı devrik yapı gerektirir; geçmiş zaman yeteneği için "could" öznenin önüne gelir.

question_text: Read the two opinions on space budgets: • Dr. Aksoy: "Space research isn't wasted on Mars; technologies like memory foam, scratch-resistant lenses, and water filters came from space programs." • Mr. Tan: "Even so, governments should prioritize solving hunger and clean water shortages on Earth first." What is the core of their debate?
option_b: Whether space exploration funding brings enough benefits compared to urgent Earth needs
option_c: Who landed on the Moon in 1969
explanation: Dr. Aksoy uzay araştırmalarının günlük yaşama kazandırdığı teknolojileri savunurken, Bay Tan dünyadaki acil sorunlara öncelik verilmesi gerektiğini belirterek bütçe önceliğini tartışmaktadır.

question_text:
Arrange the history of communication technologies from OLDEST to NEWEST:
I. World Wide Web
II. Telegraph
III. Smartphone
IV. Radio broadcasting
What is the correct chronological order?
explanation: En eski telgraf (II), sonra radyo yayını (IV), ardından World Wide Web (I) ve en son akıllı telefon (III) gelir.

question_text:
What does the underlined word mean?
"Thomas Edison's <u>persistence</u>—trying thousands of materials before finding the right filament—finally paid off."
option_b: Working for only five minutes a day
option_c: Never giving up despite repeated failures
explanation: "Persistence" tekrarlanan başarısızlıklara rağmen pes etmemek, azim göstermek anlamındadır.

question_text:
Read the science news:
"Researchers at a coastal university built a machine that turns ocean waves into electricity without harming fish. Currently, it powers a small lighthouse."
What is a current limitation of this machine?
option_a: It only works in dry deserts.
option_b: It uses coal to create ocean waves.
option_c: It harms marine animals near the shore.
option_d: Its power output is still small, enough only for a lighthouse.
explanation: Şu an yalnızca küçük bir deniz fenerine yetecek kadar güç üretmesi mevcut bir sınırlılıktır.

question_text: Which sentence uses "by" INCORRECTLY in a passive sentence?
option_a: The telephone was invented by Bell.
option_b: The letter was written by a blue pen.
option_c: The windows were cleaned by the students.
option_d: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.
explanation: İşi yapan kişi için "by", araç/alet için "with" kullanılır; "by a blue pen" yerine "with a blue pen" olmalıdır.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Deniz: "Why do scientists repeat the same experiment three or four times?"
Teacher: "To make sure the results aren't just luck or a measurement error."
What principle of science does the teacher highlight?
option_b: Making experiments as expensive as possible
explanation: Deneyin birkaç kez tekrarlanması sonuçların şans eseri olmadığını kanıtlamak, yani güvenilirlik ve tekrarlanabilirlik (reliability) içindir.

question_text: Which statement best summarizes the role of curiosity in science?
option_a: Scientists already know every answer in the universe.
option_b: Curiosity prevents scientists from following safety rules.
option_c: Asking "why" and "how" is the starting point of every major discovery.
option_d: Only people with expensive labs can be curious.
explanation: "Neden" ve "nasıl" diye sormak (merak) her büyük keşfin başlangıç noktasıdır.

question_text:
Look at the table comparing two water-purifying methods:
MethodElectricity NeededKills BacteriaSpeed
BoilingYes (or fire)Yes10 mins
Solar Disinfection (SODIS)NoYes6 hours (sunny)
In a remote village with plenty of sunshine but no electricity or firewood, which method works?
explanation: Elektrik ve yakacak olmayan ama bol güneşli bir köyde SODIS yöntemi çalışır.

question_text: Which word is a synonym for "groundbreaking" in "a groundbreaking discovery"?
explanation: "Groundbreaking" çığır açıcı/devrim niteliğinde demektir; eş anlamlısı "revolutionary"dir.

question_text:
Read the bio note:
"Katherine Johnson was a brilliant mathematician at NASA. Before electronic computers were trusted, astronauts asked her to double-check the orbital calculations by hand for John Glenn's 1962 spaceflight."
Why was Katherine Johnson so important to NASA?
option_a: Her accurate math calculations ensured safe spaceflight trajectories.
option_b: She built the rocket engines out of steel.
option_c: She invented the first digital smartphone.
option_d: She was the first woman to walk on the Moon.
explanation: Elektronik bilgisayarlara tam güvenilmeden önce yörünge hesaplamalarını elle doğrulayarak güvenli uzay uçuşunu sağlamıştır.

question_text:
Read the ethics note:
"While genetic engineering could cure inherited diseases, scientists warn that strict international rules are needed to prevent misuse."
What do scientists recommend?
option_a: Testing new genes without any supervision
option_c: Using genetic technology responsibly under clear regulations
explanation: Bilim insanları kötüye kullanımı önlemek için katı uluslararası kurallar altında sorumlu kullanım önermektedir.

question_text:
Complete the analogy:
Microscope : Tiny cells :: Seismograph : ----
explanation: Mikroskop küçük hücreleri inceler; sismograf ise deprem dalgalarını (earthquake waves) ölçer.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Asli: "Look at this fossil of a sea shell I found on top of a mountain!"
Mert: "Wait—how did a sea shell get on a mountain?"
Asli: "Geologists say this mountain range was once at the bottom of an ancient ocean millions of years ago."
What does the fossil prove?
option_a: Sea animals can fly to mountain tops.
option_b: Earth's surface has changed dramatically over millions of years.
option_c: Oceans never existed in the past.
option_d: Mountains are only a few decades old.
explanation: Dağın tepesinde deniz kabuğu fosili bulunması, Dünya yüzeyinin milyonlarca yıl içinde büyük değişimler geçirdiğini kanıtlar.

question_text: Which sentence expresses a FUTURE prediction about science?
option_a: By 2050, doctors will probably use nanobots to deliver medicine inside the body.
option_b: Students are observing onion cells under the microscope right now.
option_c: Scientists have already mapped the human genome.
option_d: Penicillin was discovered in the early twentieth century.
explanation: "By 2050, doctors will probably..." cümlesi bilimle ilgili gelecek tahmini (prediction) içermektedir.

question_text:
Read the lab note:
"We tested three materials (Wood, Copper, Plastic) to see which conducts heat fastest. Butter melted on the copper spoon in 25 seconds, while on wood and plastic it stayed solid after 3 minutes."
What is the valid conclusion?
option_a: None of the materials transfer heat.
option_b: Wood melts butter faster than copper.
option_c: Copper conducts heat much better than wood and plastic.
option_d: Plastic is the fastest heat conductor.
explanation: Tereyağının bakır kaşıkta 25 saniyede erimesi, bakırın ısıyı ahşap ve plastikten çok daha iyi ilettiğini gösterir.

question_text: When there is no rain for a long time and the soil dries up, a ---- occurs.
explanation: Uzun süre yağmur yağmadığında ve toprak kuruduğunda kuraklık (drought) meydana gelir.

question_text: Heavy rain for days caused the river to overflow, resulting in a terrible ---- in the town.
explanation: Günlerce süren şiddetli yağmurun nehri taşırması sel (flood) felaketine yol açar.

question_text:
Read the emergency kit checklist:
• Bottled water
• Flashlight and extra batteries
• First-aid kit
• Whistle
Why should you keep a whistle in an earthquake kit?
option_b: To signal rescuers if you are trapped
explanation: Düdük, enkaz altında kalınması durumunda kurtarma ekiplerine ses duyurmak/sinyal vermek için konur.

question_text: A huge mass of snow sliding rapidly down a mountain slope is called an ----.
explanation: Dağ yamacından hızla kayan büyük kar kütlesine çığ (avalanche) denir.

question_text:
Look at the safety poster: "During an Earthquake:
1. DROP onto your hands and knees.
2. COVER your head and neck under a sturdy desk.
3. HOLD ON until shaking stops." What should you do if an earthquake starts while you are in class?
option_a: Jump out of the second-floor window
option_b: Take the elevator to the basement
option_c: Get under a strong desk and protect your head
explanation: Posterde Çök-Kapan-Tutun (Drop-Cover-Hold On) kuralı gereği sağlam bir sıranın altına girip başı korumak gerektiği yazmaktadır.

question_text: If we cut down too many trees, there ---- more landslides and soil erosion in the future.
explanation: Gelecekteki olası sonuçlar için "If + Simple Present, ... will + V1" yapısı kullanılır.

question_text: Read the news headline: "Giant Waves Hit Coastline After Undersea Quake!" Which natural disaster is described in the headline?
explanation: Deniz altı depreminin ardından kıyıyı vuran dev dalgalar tsunami felaketini tanımlar.

question_text: To slow down global warming, we should use ---- energy sources like wind and solar power.
explanation: Küresel ısınmayı yavaşlatmak için rüzgâr ve güneş gibi yenilenebilir (renewable) enerji kaynakları kullanılmalıdır.

question_text: Look at the weather warning: "Alert: Wind speeds will reach 130 km/h along the coast tonight. Stay indoors and secure loose balcony items." Which natural force is approaching?
explanation: Kıyıda saatte 130 km hıza ulaşan rüzgârlar şiddetli bir fırtına/kasırganın (hurricane / storm) yaklaştığını gösterir.

question_text: Hot lava, ash, and gases shooting out of a mountain top is a ----.
explanation: Dağ zirvesinden sıcak lav, kül ve gaz püskürmesi yanardağ patlamasıdır (volcanic eruption).

explanation: Grafikte en yüksek çubuk 40 öğrenci ile Recycle (geri dönüşüm) seçeneğidir.

question_text: Don't leave the tap running while brushing your teeth. We must ---- water!
explanation: Diş fırçalarken musluğu açık bırakmamak suyu korumak/tasarruf etmek (save) içindir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Ali: "What should we do to prevent wildfires in summer?"
Ece: "----"
Which answer completes the dialogue?
option_a: We should waste electricity at home.
option_b: We should cut down all green trees.
option_c: We should use more plastic bags.
option_d: We should never leave glass bottles or campfires in forests.
explanation: Orman yangınlarını önlemek için ormanlarda cam şişe veya söndürülmemiş kamp ateşi bırakılmamalıdır.

question_text: Smoke from factories and cars causes serious ---- in big cities.
explanation: Fabrika ve araba dumanı büyük şehirlerde hava kirliliğine (air pollution) yol açar.

question_text:
Look at the disaster table:
DisasterMain Cause
EarthquakeMovement of tectonic plates
LandslideHeavy rain on steep, treeless hills
DroughtLack of rainfall for months
According to the table, what triggers a landslide?
option_d: Heavy rain on steep hills without trees
explanation: Tabloya göre dik ve ağaçsız tepelere yağan şiddetli yağmur heyelanı (landslide) tetikler.

question_text: You ---- use the elevator during an earthquake; always use the stairs after shaking stops.
explanation: Deprem sırasında asansör kullanmak kesinlikle yasak/tehlikelidir; "mustn't" kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the sign in a national park: "Protect Our Forests!
Do not light fires during windy summer days." Why is this rule important?
option_a: Fires help trees grow taller in summer.
option_b: Wind puts out forest fires immediately.
option_c: A small spark can quickly turn into a wildfire.
explanation: Rüzgârlı yaz günlerinde küçük bir kıvılcım bile hızla orman yangınına (wildfire) dönüşebilir.

question_text: Global warming is causing Arctic ---- to melt, which makes sea levels rise.
explanation: Küresel ısınma Arktik buzulların (glaciers) erimesine ve deniz seviyesinin yükselmesine neden olmaktadır.

question_text:
Read the text message:
"Warning from City Hall: Heavy snow is expected tonight. Please avoid driving unless necessary. – Emergency Desk"
What does City Hall advise citizens to do?
option_b: Wash their cars in the street
option_c: Stay off the roads if possible
explanation: Belediye yoğun kar beklendiği için zorunlu olmadıkça araç kullanılmamasını (yollara çıkılmamasını) tavsiye etmektedir.

question_text: A ---- is a violently rotating column of air that touches the ground and destroys buildings.
explanation: Yere temas ederek binaları yıkan şiddetli dönen hava sütunu hortumdur (tornado).

question_text:
Read the school club motto:
"Reduce, Reuse, Recycle!"
Which action is an example of "Reuse"?
option_b: Buying a brand-new plastic bag every day
option_c: Throwing plastic bottles into the sea
option_d: Using a glass jam jar to store pencils
explanation: Cam reçel kavanozunu kalemlik olarak kullanmak "yeniden kullanma" (Reuse) örneğidir.

question_text: Planting trees helps prevent ---- because tree roots hold the soil firmly together.
explanation: Ağaç kökleri toprağı sıkıca tuttuğu için ağaç dikmek erozyonu (erosion) önlemeye yardımcı olur.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Can: "Why are polar bears losing their habitat?"
Deniz: "Because the sea ice is melting faster every year due to climate change."
What threatens polar bears?
option_b: Too many trees in the Arctic
option_d: Melting ice caused by rising temperatures
explanation: İklim değişikliği nedeniyle deniz buzunun erimesi kutup ayılarının yaşam alanını tehdit etmektedir.

question_text: Scientists ---- that average temperatures will continue to increase if we don't cut carbon emissions.
explanation: Bilim insanlarının gelecekteki artışla ilgili öngörüsü "predict" (tahmin etmek) fiiliyle ifade edilir.

question_text:
Look at the home energy tips:
• Unplug chargers when not in use.
• Switch to LED bulbs.
• Take shorter showers.
What is the common goal of these tips?
explanation: Şarj aletlerini çekmek, LED ampul kullanmak ve kısa duş almak enerji ve su tasarrufu (saving energy and water) sağlar.

question_text: When the ground suddenly shakes violently, we experience an ----.
explanation: Yerin aniden şiddetle sarsılması deprem (earthquake) olayıdır.

question_text:
Read the short news:
"Volunteers collected 500 kilograms of plastic waste from the beach yesterday to protect sea turtles."
Why did the volunteers clean the beach?
option_a: To build a new hotel on the sand
option_b: To catch sea turtles for a zoo
option_c: To keep marine animals safe from plastic trash
option_d: To throw more plastic into the sea
explanation: Gönüllüler deniz kaplumbağalarını korumak amacıyla plajdaki plastik atıkları toplamıştır.

question_text: Using public transportation instead of private cars helps reduce ---- gases.
explanation: Özel araçlar yerine toplu taşıma kullanmak sera (greenhouse) gazlarını azaltmaya yardımcı olur.

question_text:
Look at the matching:
1. Earthquake → Magnitude 6.4
2. Hurricane → Wind 150 km/h
3. Drought → 0 mm rain in 6 months
4. ---- → 40°C water in the street
Wait—which disaster matches "3 meters of water covering city streets"?
explanation: Şehir sokaklarını 3 metre suyun kaplaması sel (flood) felaketidir.

question_text: After a major earthquake, people should turn off gas and electricity valves to prevent ----.
explanation: Deprem sonrası gaz ve elektrik vanalarını kapatmak yangınları (fires) önlemek içindir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Reporter: "What caused the mudslide in the mountain village last week?"
Geologist: "Two things: heavy rainfall for three days and deforestation on the hillside above the village."
What made the hillside unstable?
option_a: A volcanic eruption under the sea
option_b: A long period of hot drought
option_c: Cutting down trees combined with continuous heavy rain
option_d: Too many solar panels on roofs
explanation: Üç günlük şiddetli yağmur ve yamaçtaki ormansızlaşma (ağaçların kesilmesi) toprak kaymasına yol açmıştır.

question_text:
Look at the table of 3 regions and their main environmental challenges:
RegionMain RiskSuggested Action
Coastal ValleyFloodingBuild drainage canals & plant trees
Dry PlateauDroughtUse drip irrigation in farming
Seismic ZoneEarthquakeStrengthen buildings & prepare kits
Which action is MOST helpful for farmers on the Dry Plateau?
option_b: Using drip irrigation to save water
option_c: Leaving water taps open all day
explanation: Kurak plato (Dry Plateau) için tabloda önerilen önlem tarımda damla sulama (drip irrigation) kullanmaktır.

question_text: If people continue to dump chemical waste into rivers, many fish species ---- disappear.
explanation: Gelecekteki olasılık ve koşul cümlesi ("If people continue...") ana cümlede "will" gerektirir.

question_text:
Read the paragraph:
"Deforestation is not just losing trees; it also destroys the homes of millions of animals and increases carbon dioxide in the air. Trees absorb CO2 and release oxygen. Without them, Earth heats up faster."
Why do trees help slow down global warming?
option_a: They block all sunlight from reaching rivers.
option_b: They cause heavy floods in valleys.
option_c: They absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere.
option_d: They produce toxic gases at night.
explanation: Ağaçlar atmosferdeki karbondioksiti (CO2) emerek küresel ısınmayı yavaşlatmaya yardımcı olur.

question_text: Which sentence gives the BEST advice for earthquake preparedness BEFORE a disaster strikes?
option_a: Fix heavy bookshelves and wardrobes firmly to the walls.
option_b: Stand right next to large glass windows during shaking.
option_c: Place heavy vases on the highest shelf above your bed.
option_d: Wait until an earthquake happens to buy a flashlight.
explanation: Deprem olmadan önce ağır kitaplık ve dolapları duvara sabitlemek en doğru hazırlık tavsiyesidir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Seda: "Have you noticed how mild the winters have become?"
Bora: "Yes! Last January felt like spring, and there was barely any snow in the mountains."
Seda: "Scientists say this is a clear sign of ----."
Which phrase fits the blank?
explanation: Kışların ılımanlaşması ve dağlara kar yağmaması iklim değişikliğinin (climate change) açık bir işaretidir.

question_text: Which pair of disaster and safety rule is INCORRECT?
option_a: Earthquake — Drop, cover, and hold on
option_b: Wildfire — Evacuate the area as instructed by officials
option_c: Tsunami — Run toward the beach to watch the waves
option_d: Flood — Move to higher ground immediately
explanation: Tsunami sırasında dalgaları izlemek için sahile koşmak ölümcül bir hatadır; yüksek yerlere kaçılmalıdır.

question_text:
Read the text:
"In 2023, our town replaced old streetlamps with smart solar LEDs that dim automatically when no cars are passing. As a result, the town cut its electricity use by 45%."
What was the benefit of the smart streetlamps?
option_b: Significant energy savings without leaving streets dark when needed
option_c: More air pollution in the town center
option_d: Complete darkness even when cars are driving
explanation: Akıllı güneş enerjili LED'ler sadece araç yokken kısılarak elektrik tüketimini %45 azaltmıştır.

question_text: Because of ----, fertile topsoil is washed away by rain or blown away by strong winds.
explanation: Verimli üst toprağın yağmur veya rüzgârla taşınması erozyon (erosion) olayıdır.

question_text: Four students suggest ways to reduce their carbon footprint: • Mert: "I ride my bicycle to school instead of going by car." • Ada: "I bring a reusable cloth bag when shopping." • Efe: "I always leave my computer on overnight." • Nil: "I unplug my phone charger at 100%." Whose habit actually INCREASES energy waste?
explanation: Bilgisayarını gece boyunca açık bırakan Efe enerji israfını artırmaktadır.

question_text: When a volcanic eruption happens, thick clouds of ---- can block sunlight and disrupt airplane flights.
explanation: Yanardağ patlamasında güneş ışığını engelleyip uçuşları aksatan şey kalın kül (ash) bulutlarıdır.

question_text:
Read the weather report:
"Due to a sudden rise in temperature, thick mountain snow is melting rapidly. Rivers in the valley are expected to rise above danger level by tomorrow morning."
Which secondary disaster could this rapid melting trigger?
explanation: Dağlardaki karın hızla erimesi vadideki nehirleri taşırarak sel (flood) felaketini tetikleyebilir.

question_text:
Complete the sentence:
"---- we protect endangered species today, future generations won't ever see them in the wild."
explanation: "Eğer korumazsak... göremeyecekler" anlamı için olumsuz koşul bağlacı "Unless" (If not) kullanılır.

question_text: Look at the emergency alert on a phone: "Tsunami Warning: Strong 7.5 quake 40 km offshore. Move inland or to high ground immediately. Do not return until officials say it is safe." What should residents do FIRST?
option_b: Stay on the ground floor near the beach
option_c: Go down to the harbor to check their boats
option_d: Head away from the coast to higher elevation
explanation: Uyarıda hemen iç kesimlere veya yüksek yerlere (high ground) gidilmesi istenmektedir.

question_text: Which word is the OPPOSITE of "destroy"?
explanation: "Destroy" yok etmek/yıkmak demektir; zıt anlamlısı "protect" (korumak) kelimesidir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Zeynep: "Why do people build homes with flexible steel frames in earthquake zones?"
Engineer: "Because rigid concrete cracks easily when the ground shakes, while flexible structures bend without collapsing."
Why are flexible frames safer?
option_b: They can absorb shaking without falling down.
option_c: They are made of dry wood that floats.
option_d: They are much heavier than stone castles.
explanation: Esnek çelik çerçeveler sarsıntı sırasında yıkılmadan esneyerek depremi soğurabilir.

question_text: The ozone layer protects life on Earth by blocking harmful ---- rays from the Sun.
explanation: Ozon tabakası Güneş'ten gelen zararlı morötesi (ultraviolet) ışınları engeller.

question_text:
Read the recycling guide:
• Blue Bin: Paper & cardboard
• Yellow Bin: Plastic & metal cans
• Green Bin: Glass bottles
• Brown Bin: Food scraps
Where should you put an empty soda can and a newspaper?
option_c: Soda can in Brown Bin; newspaper in Yellow Bin
option_d: Soda can in Yellow Bin; newspaper in Blue Bin
explanation: Metal içecek kutusu sarı kutuya (Yellow Bin), gazete ise mavi kutuya (Blue Bin) atılır.

question_text: Which sentence describes a CAUSE-AND-EFFECT relationship?
option_a: We should pack water and a whistle in our emergency bag.
option_b: Solar panels are installed on many sunny rooftops today.
option_c: Because factories released untreated waste, the lake became polluted.
option_d: Earthquakes and tsunamis are both powerful natural disasters.
explanation: "Because..." ile başlayan cümle neden-sonuç (cause-and-effect) ilişkisini kurar.

question_text:
Look at the water usage chart of a household:
ActivityLiters per Day
Showers140 L
Toilet90 L
Washing machine70 L
Cooking & drinking20 L
Where can this family save the MOST water by changing their habits?
explanation: En yüksek su tüketimi 140 litre ile duşlarda (Showers) olduğu için daha kısa duş almak en büyük tasarrufu sağlar.

question_text: During a lightning storm, it is very dangerous to stand under a tall ---- in an open field.
explanation: Açık alanda şimşek fırtınası sırasında yüksek bir ağacın (tree) altında durmak çok tehlikelidir.

question_text:
Read the note:
"Did you know? Recycling one aluminum can saves enough energy to run a television for three hours!"
What is the purpose of this fact?
option_a: To explain how aluminum is mined from rocks
option_b: To warn people not to drink canned juice
option_c: To tell people to watch more television
option_d: To encourage people to recycle metal cans
explanation: Tek bir alüminyum kutuyu geri dönüştürmenin sağladığı enerji tasarrufunu göstererek insanları geri dönüşüme teşvik etmektedir.

question_text: If sea levels rise by one meter, many low-lying coastal towns will be ----.
explanation: Deniz seviyesi bir metre yükselirse alçak kıyı kasabaları sular altında kalacaktır (flooded).

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Kaan: "Look! The river near our picnic area is full of plastic bags." 
Lale: "That's awful. Let's put on gloves and collect what we can before leaving."
What does Lale suggest?
option_a: Blaming the fish for the pollution
option_b: Taking immediate action to clean up the litter
option_c: Ignoring the trash and going home
option_d: Throwing more bags into the river
explanation: Lale eldiven takıp toplayabildiklerini toplamayı önererek hemen harekete geçmeyi tavsiye eder.

question_text: Which natural disaster CANNOT be predicted days in advance with today's technology?
explanation: Kasırga, yağış kaynaklı sel ve sıcak hava dalgası günler öncesinden tahmin edilebilirken, depremler (earthquake) günler öncesinden kesin olarak tahmin edilemez.

question_text:
Read the poster: "Walk or Cycle Short Distances!
A 2-kilometer car trip produces unnecessary exhaust fumes." Who is this poster targeting?
option_d: Drivers making short trips that could easily be walked or biked
explanation: 2 kilometrelik kısa mesafelerde araba kullanan sürücülere yürümeleri veya bisiklete binmeleri önerilmektedir.

question_text: We must take serious ---- now to prevent a severe water crisis in the coming decades.
explanation: Gelecek on yıllarda su krizini önlemek için şimdiden ciddi önlemler (precautions) almalıyız.

question_text:
Read the short report:
"After the 2020 wildfire, local students planted 3,000 pine saplings on the burned hill. Four years later, birds and squirrels have returned to the young forest."
What does this report show?
option_b: Community tree-planting efforts can successfully restore damaged ecosystems.
option_c: Wildfires never allow trees to grow again.
option_d: Squirrels prefer living on bare, burned hills.
explanation: Öğrencilerin diktiği 3.000 fidan sayesinde dört yıl sonra kuşların ve sincapların dönmesi, ağaçlandırma çabalarının ekosistemi onarabildiğini gösterir.

question_text: Which word means "a sudden event that causes great damage or loss of life"?
explanation: Büyük hasar veya can kaybına yol açan ani olay felaket/afet (disaster) kelimesidir.

question_text: Read the four news briefs and match them to the disasters: • Brief 1: "Soil and rocks slid down the steep slope after three days of non-stop rain, blocking the highway." • Brief 2: "Reservoirs dropped to 15% capacity as farmers struggled with the driest summer in 40 years." • Brief 3: "A 6.8 magnitude tremor shook the city at 04:12 a.m., causing residents to rush outside." • Brief 4: "Skier warnings were issued after heavy snowfall piled up on unstable mountain ridges." Which order matches Briefs 1, 2, 3, and 4?
explanation: Toprak/kaya kayması = Landslide; 40 yılın en kurak yazı = Drought; 6.8 büyüklüğünde sarsıntı = Earthquake; kar birikmesi uyarısı = Avalanche.

question_text:
Look at the table of CO2 emissions per passenger for a 500 km journey:
Transport ModeCO2 per Passenger
Airplane115 kg
Private Car (1 person)85 kg
Bus25 kg
Electric Train12 kg
If a family of 4 travels 500 km together in one private car (sharing the 85 kg car total, or assume 85 kg is for 1 person = 340 kg if 4 cars), wait: compare 1 passenger traveling by Electric Train vs. Airplane. How many times more CO2 does the airplane produce than the electric train?
explanation: Uçak yolcu başına 115 kg, elektrikli tren 12 kg CO2 üretir; 115 / 12 ≈ 9,6 yani neredeyse 10 kat daha fazladır.

question_text:
Read the text:
"Some people think climate change only means hotter summers. In fact, it disrupts the entire weather system, leading to heavier storms in some places and longer droughts in others."
What misconception does the text correct?
option_a: The fact that droughts happen in dry regions
option_b: The claim that weather systems are complex
option_c: The belief that climate change only brings warm, sunny days
option_d: The idea that storms can cause floods
explanation: Metin, iklim değişikliğinin yalnızca daha sıcak yazlar anlamına geldiği yönündeki yanlış düşünceyi düzeltmektedir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Mayor: "Last winter, our riverside neighborhood flooded twice. Engineers propose two solutions: widening the river channel and creating a green park along the bank to absorb extra water."
Citizen: "Why a park instead of just concrete walls?"
Mayor: "Because soil and grass soak up rainwater naturally, whereas concrete pushes water faster downstream."
Why does the mayor favor the green park?
option_a: Concrete walls are cheaper than planting grass.
option_b: Citizens asked for more concrete highways.
option_d: Natural soil absorbs floodwater instead of speeding it up.
explanation: Toprak ve çimin yağmur suyunu doğal olarak emmesi, betonun ise suyu akıntı yönüne daha hızlı itmesi parkın tercih edilme nedenidir.

question_text: Read the two paragraphs: Text 1: "Early warning systems for tsunamis use deep-ocean pressure sensors to detect sudden waves and alert coastal towns minutes or hours before impact." Text 2: "However, if a town lies very close to the earthquake's epicenter, the first wave may arrive in just 10 minutes, leaving little time for evacuation." What do both texts together emphasize?
option_a: Coastal towns always have several hours to evacuate.
option_b: Warning technology saves lives, but coastal residents near fault lines must also react immediately.
option_c: Deep-ocean sensors can stop tsunamis from forming.
option_d: Tsunamis never happen near earthquake epicenters.
explanation: Erken uyarı sistemleri hayat kurtarsa da merkeze yakın kıyı kasabalarında sadece 10 dakika olabileceği için anında tahliye gerektiği vurgulanır.

question_text: Which sentence expresses a HYPOTHETICAL future condition correctly?
option_a: If factories used clean filters, the city air would be much healthier.
option_b: If factories will use clean filters, the air is healthier.
option_c: If factories used clean filters, the air will be healthy.
option_d: If factories use clean filters, the city air would be healthier yesterday.
explanation: Varsayımsal (2. tip) koşul cümlesi "If + Simple Past (used), ... would + V1 (would be)" şeklinde kurulur.

question_text:
Read the disaster drill evaluation:
"During today's school earthquake drill, Class 8B evacuated the building in 90 seconds using the stairs. However, three students stopped to pick up their heavy backpacks, blocking the doorway."
What should Class 8B improve in the next drill?
option_a: Using the elevator to carry heavy backpacks
option_b: Hiding inside lockers after the shaking stops
option_c: Running faster than 90 seconds by pushing others
option_d: Leaving belongings behind and exiting without blocking the door
explanation: Üç öğrencinin ağır sırt çantalarını almak için durup kapıyı tıkaması hatadır; eşyaları bırakıp çıkışı engellememek gerekir.

question_text:
Look at the table of 4 cities' green policies:
CityBike LanesPlastic Bag BanSolar Buses
City AYes (120 km)YesNo
City BYes (80 km)YesYes
City CNoYesYes
City DYes (40 km)NoNo
Which city has implemented ALL THREE environmental policies?
explanation: Tabloda üç sütunda da "Yes" olan tek şehir City B'dir.

question_text:
Which question CANNOT be answered by the text?
"Mangrove forests grow along tropical coastlines. Their tangled underwater roots slow down storm waves, protect shores from erosion, and provide safe nurseries for young fish."
option_a: How do mangrove roots help coasts during storms?
option_b: How many countries have mangrove forests?
option_c: Why are mangroves important for fish?
explanation: Metinde tropikal kıyılarda yetiştikleri, fırtına dalgalarını yavaşlattıkları ve balık yavrularına yuva oldukları yazar; ancak kaç ülkede bulunduğu belirtilmemiştir.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Deniz: "Our family bought a new washing machine with an A+++ energy label."
Mert: "Wasn't it more expensive than the standard model?"
Deniz: "Yes, slightly, ---- it uses 40% less electricity and water, so it pays for itself over time."
Which word fits the blank, and what is Deniz's point?
option_a: but — long-term savings make up for the higher initial price
option_c: so — the machine wastes more electricity
option_d: or — we never use the washing machine
explanation: Başta biraz pahalı olmasına rağmen ("but") %40 daha az elektrik ve su tüketerek uzun vadede kendini amorti ettiğini savunmaktadır.

question_text:
Which sentence does NOT fit the paragraph?
"(I) Microplastics are tiny plastic pieces smaller than five millimeters. (II) They enter oceans when larger plastic bottles break down or when synthetic clothes are washed. (III) Many tourists enjoy buying handmade pottery in coastal villages. (IV) Fish often mistake microplastics for food, passing them up the food chain."
explanation: Paragraf mikroplastiklerin okyanuslara ve besin zincirine etkisini anlatırken III. cümle turistlerin çömlek almasından bahsederek akışı bozar.

question_text:
Read the scenario:
"A severe drought has hit a farming region. Local authorities must choose how to manage limited water."
Which policy is the MOST sustainable long-term solution?
option_a: Draining the last underground water reserves in one month
option_b: Ignoring the drought and hoping for rain tomorrow
option_c: Allowing unlimited car washing every day
option_d: Fixing leaking pipes and switching to drought-resistant crops
explanation: Sızdıran boruları onarmak ve kuraklığa dayanıklı ürünlere geçmek uzun vadeli en sürdürülebilir çözümdür.

question_text:
What does the underlined word mean?
"To <u>mitigate</u> the effects of floods, engineers built wider storm drains and restored wetlands."
explanation: "Mitigate" bir sorunun veya felaketin etkisini hafifletmek, azaltmak (make less severe) anlamındadır.

question_text: Read the two viewpoints on plastic packaging: • Producer: "Plastic keeps food fresh longer and prevents food waste during shipping." • Environmentalist: "True, yet single-use wrappers pollute oceans for centuries; we need compostable alternatives." What do both speakers care about?
option_a: Throwing away fresh food every day
option_b: Banning all food shipping between cities
option_d: Balancing food preservation with environmental responsibility
explanation: Üretici gıda israfını önlemeyi, çevreci ise okyanus kirliliğini önleyecek doğada çözünür alternatifleri vurgulayarak gıda koruma ile çevre sorumluluğu dengesini tartışır.

question_text:
Arrange the steps of what to do AFTER a strong earthquake:
I. Check yourself and nearby people for injuries.
II. Listen to official radio or emergency alerts for aftershock updates.
III. Shut off gas and electricity if you smell gas or see damaged wires.
IV. Evacuate the building calmly using the stairs.
What is the safest logical order?
explanation: Sarsıntı durunca önce yaralanma kontrol edilir (I), gaz/elektrik kaçağı varsa kapatılır (III), merdivenle sakinçe çıkılır (IV) ve resmi duyurular dinlenir (II).

question_text: Which sentence uses "due to" CORRECTLY?
option_a: Due to it rained heavily, the match stopped.
option_b: Several flights were cancelled due to the thick volcanic ash cloud.
option_c: Several flights were cancelled due to the volcano erupted.
option_d: The town flooded due to it was near a river.
explanation: "Due to" bir edattır ve ardından tam cümle değil isim/isim öbeği ("the thick volcanic ash cloud") gelir.

question_text:
Read the text:
"Urban heat islands occur when cities replace green parks with dark asphalt roads and concrete buildings, which absorb heat all day. As a result, city centers can be 3–5°C warmer than nearby villages."
How can cities cool down this effect?
option_a: By planting street trees and creating green roofs
option_d: By cutting down remaining city parks
explanation: Yeşil alanların yerini koyu asfalt ve betonun alması ısı adası oluşturduğuna göre ağaç dikmek ve yeşil çatılar yapmak şehri serinletir.

question_text:
Read the quote:
"We do not inherit the Earth from our ancestors; we borrow it from our children."
What responsibility does this quote highlight?
option_c: Protecting the planet's resources for future generations
option_d: Using up all fossil fuels as fast as possible
explanation: Dünyayı çocuklarımızdan ödünç aldığımızı söyleyen söz, gezegenin kaynaklarını gelecek nesiller için koruma sorumluluğunu vurgular.

question_text:
Read the dialogue:
Asli: "Why shouldn't we pour used cooking oil down the kitchen sink?"
Cem: "Because just one liter of oil can pollute thousands of liters of clean water and clog the city pipes."
Asli: "Oh, I didn't know that! What should we do with it?"
Cem: "Collect it in a bottle and take it to a waste-oil recycling point."
What new habit will Asli probably adopt?
option_a: Pouring hot oil into the garden soil
option_b: Throwing glass bottles into the river
option_c: Mixing cooking oil with dish soap in the sink
option_d: Storing used cooking oil in a bottle for proper recycling
explanation: Aslı kullanılmış yağı lavaboya dökmek yerine şişede biriktirip atık yağ geri dönüşüm noktasına götürecektir.

question_text: Which statement accurately reflects the difference between "weather" and "climate"?
option_a: Weather never changes, while climate changes every afternoon.
option_b: Weather is short-term daily conditions, whereas climate is the average pattern over decades.
option_c: Climate only refers to rain, while weather only refers to wind.
option_d: There is no scientific difference between weather and climate.
explanation: Hava durumu (weather) kısa vadeli günlük koşulları, iklim (climate) ise on yıllar boyunca süren ortalama örüntüyü ifade eder.

question_text: Look at the emergency bag audit of two families: • Family X: Water (3 days), canned food, flashlight, radio, batteries, whistle, copies of IDs. • Family Y: Snacks, video game console, umbrella, perfume, heavy winter coat. Why is Family X better prepared for a disaster?
option_a: Their bag contains essential survival, communication, and identification items.
option_b: Family Y has more water for three days.
option_c: Family X forgot to bring a flashlight.
explanation: X ailesi 3 günlük su, konserve, fener, radyo, pil, düdük ve kimlik fotokopileri gibi temel hayatta kalma ve iletişim malzemelerini hazırlamıştır.

question_text:
Complete the sentence:
"The more energy we waste today, ---- harder it will be to slow down climate change tomorrow."
explanation: "The + comparative ..., the + comparative ..." (Ne kadar çok ... o kadar ...) kalıbı gereği "the harder" kullanılır.

question_text:
Read the news report:
"After heavy rains, a landslide blocked the only road to Pine Village. Helicopters delivered medicine and food until crews cleared the mud two days later."
How were the villagers' urgent needs met while the road was closed?
option_a: By boats sailing up the dry mountain
option_b: They waited without any food or medicine
explanation: Yol kapalıyken ilaç ve yiyecekler helikopterlerle (hava yoluyla) ulaştırılmıştır.

question_text: Which sentence shows a POSITIVE step toward disaster resilience?
option_a: Builders ignored safety codes to save money on concrete.
option_b: Engineers retrofitted old school buildings to withstand strong earthquakes.
option_c: Residents built houses directly inside a dry riverbed.
option_d: Factories dumped plastic waste into drainage canals.
explanation: Eski okul binalarını güçlü depremlere dayanacak şekilde güçlendirmek (retrofit) afet dayanıklılığı için olumlu bir adımdır.

question_text:
Read the conversation:
Ece: "I heard that fast fashion—buying cheap clothes every week and throwing them away—hurts the planet."
Bora: "Yes! Making a single cotton T-shirt takes around 2,700 liters of water, and synthetic fabrics shed microfibers."
What can teenagers do to reduce this impact?
option_a: Buy fewer, longer-lasting clothes and donate or swap items they outgrow
option_b: Throw away T-shirts after wearing them once
option_c: Wash a single shirt in a full washing machine every day
option_d: Only buy clothes that cannot be repaired
explanation: Daha az ve uzun ömürlü kıyafet almak, küçülenleri bağışlamak veya takas etmek hızlı modanın çevresel etkisini azaltır.

question_text:
Which word best completes the sentence?
"When a disaster strikes, ---- among neighbors—sharing water, blankets, and shelter—saves lives."
explanation: Afet anında su, battaniye ve barınak paylaşarak gösterilen komşu dayanışması "solidarity"dir.

question_text:
Read the weather forecast summary:
"Monday: Heavy rain (60 mm) | Tuesday: Heavy rain (55 mm) | Wednesday: Clear & sunny | Thursday: Clear & sunny"
If a river is already full on Monday evening, when is flood risk HIGHEST?
explanation: Pazartesi akşamı nehir zaten doluyken Salı günü 55 mm daha şiddetli yağmur yağacağı için sel riski Salı günü en yüksektir.

question_text: Which sentence summarizes the main goal of environmental education in 8th grade?
option_a: To memorize the names of every volcano without learning safety rules
option_b: To raise informed citizens who prevent waste and respond wisely to natural hazards
option_c: To teach that individual actions have zero effect on nature
option_d: To encourage students to use more single-use plastics
explanation: Çevre eğitiminin temel amacı israfı önleyen ve doğal tehlikelere bilinçli yanıt veren bireyler yetiştirmektir.
